notes.title: [Sacrum Romanum: Crown and Cross] Season Update Log
notes.content:
[Sacrum Romanum: Crown and Cross] Season Update Log

I. Seasonal Unit
3- Star: Doppelsoldner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/96f5ba6c57f57624b7192cda7c952df9ebeacc90.jpg
Unit Background
The Doppelsoldner are an elite infantry unit hailing from the ranks of mercenaries in the Holy Roman Empire during the late 15th and early 16th centuries. Named for the heavy two-handed swords they bore and the double wages they earned, these warriors fought on the very front lines, risking their lives for twice the pay of ordinary mercenaries. Founded by Emperor Maximilian I to counter the famed Swiss mercenaries, the unit was composed primarily of seasoned veterans. Their weapon—the flamberge two-handed greatsword—measured up to 180 centimeters in length and weighed over 3.5 kilograms, specially crafted and carried wrapped in leather for protection. It is said that these double-pay mercenaries wielded their immense swords to break through pike formations, particularly those of the Swiss. With mighty swings, they shattered spearheads or swept aside pikes, striking directly at the enemy and collapsing their ranks.
Unit Characteristics：
Imperial mercenaries with unique effects against specific enemies and in certain scenarios.
Masters of the two-handed greatsword, unleashing sweeping area damage with every swing.
Their battle song carries a silencing effect, disabling enemy skills within range.
Skill Design：
Skill 1: Windmill (Unleash a flurry of greatsword attacks)
Skill 2: Song of Landsknecht (Battle song silences enemies)

4- Star: Zealot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/10e39de2953724749f769f196ab6dcc3e53352da.png
Unit Background
They are the most faithful guardians of imperial creed, clad in Milanese plate with sigil shields and hammers of judgment. They hold the line like stone and purge heresy with crushing blows.
Yet years facing the dark have stained their souls with a touch of madness. When the heretics surge without cease, the guards' repressed bloodlust is loosed. They cast aside shields, tear of livery of order, and become inquisitors wielding great two‑handed mauls — each swing carrying the purging fire and sacred wrath.
Unit Characteristics：
Carnage on the field lays bare the Zealots' nature, increasing [Mad Malice]. Killing 3‑star‑and‑below units and other Heraldic units grants more [Mad Malice]. At max, transform into "Inquisitor".
The smooth, shell‑like plates can deflect blows, reducing damage taken by 18% and offering some fire resistance; the asymmetrical left pauldron provides superior protection for blocking when meeting the foe.
While transformed into "Inquisitors", they will anoint their weapon with black powder. Each strike burns the target and triggers a small blast
Skill Design：
Normal State
Skill 1: Righteous Charge – Launches a fearless charge toward the target location.
Skill 2: Zeal Whirlwind – Spins the sacred hammer around a pivot of faith, sweeping through foes.
Skill 3: Judgment Day – Takes on the aspect of the judge, purging all in divine fire!
Judge State
Skill 1: Dies iræ – Slams the holy hammer into the earth, unbalancing nearby enemies before sending them flying.
Skill 2: Saeclum in Favilla – Unleashes a flurry of holy hammer swings, each blow erupting in a cascade of small blasts.

5- Star: Order of the Dragon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/38c3ecf876af9068915779b6b2be9f97c7ec54cd.jpg
Unit Background
Drawn from the highest nobility and armored in plate etched with the ouroboros, they fight not for coin or fame — for their very being is the Empire's highest honor.
When the horns of expedition sound, their singular "Sacred Expedition" makes their charge dragon‑swift and deadly, rending lines thought unbreakable. Beneath the imperial banner, they are both arbiters of justice and bearers of blessed light.
Unit Characteristics：
An elite order of knights formed by monarchs and nobles from across the land. They answer only to the Emperor’s command, sworn to battle the enemies of the Empire.
When [Emperor's Expedition] is activated, you enter a special control mode where the Unit’s movement and abilities are directed by mouse.
Their masterfully crafted gilded armor not only marks their noble status but also offers formidable protection.
Skill Design：
Skill 1: Emperor’s Expedition – Enter a unique control mode: change your perspective and use the mouse to command Unit movement and unleash skills.
Skill 2: Sacred Verdict – Deliver swift justice with your sword; unleash a flurry of attacks to deal burst damage.
Skill 3: Blessing of Light – Remove continuous damage effects from yourself and restore health.

II. Battle Pass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ccc488d0e571cfb82fb7b9c41e88d4e41a14d2e7.jpg
During the "Sacrum Romanum" season, purchase the Battle Pass to unlock additional Battle Pass rewards.
Pass Level Rewards:
At Battle Pass Level 1, obtain Hero Attire: Margrave of the Border
At Battle Pass Level 50, obtain Unit Attire: Imperial Campaign
At Battle Pass Level 70, obtain Mount Attire: Gloria
At Battle Pass Level 100, obtain Hero Attire: Emperor in Steel
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2599b662978d90a356099fe2cd0e6b9b9f277f59.jpg

III. Season Vault
During the Sacrum Romanum season, the Season Vault will feature the return of Lionfire season attire. You can redeem these attires at a 20% discount using Blades.
Aurora's Glory (Sealed) exchange cost reduced from 2500 to 2000.
Northern Lion (Sealed) exchange cost reduced from 5000 to 4000.
Vasa Royal Guards (Sealed) exchange cost reduced from 2500 to 2000.
The following attires will return to their original price:
Hellenic Court Robes (Sealed) exchange cost increased from 2000 to 2500.
Vergina Sun (Sealed) exchange cost increased from 4000 to 5000.
Twelfth Trial (Sealed) exchange cost increased from 2000 to 2500.
The following attires will be removed from the Season Vault:
Snow Falcon Attire (Sealed) (Hero Attire)
New Dawn Attire (Sealed) (Hero Attire)
Tiger Battalion (Sealed) (Units Attire)
"Dragonrise" season returning weapon attire.

IV. World

VI. Season Challenges

Challenge Unlock Date: September 19, 2025 (After Maintenance)

VII. Season Runes
Armor Runes
Helm:
[Blood Rain]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, deals damage equal to 30% of the enemy's current health to up to 10 nearby enemy units; costs 3 rune power.
[Venom Claw]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, inflicts poison on nearby enemy units, dealing 0.2% of their maximum health per second, increasing by 0.2% per second for 20 seconds. If the enemy leaves the affected area, the effect is immediately removed; costs 3 rune power.
[Crimson Gaze]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, inflicts burning on nearby enemy units, dealing 1.5% of their maximum health per second while accumulating burning value for 10 seconds. If the enemy leaves the affected area, the effect is immediately removed; costs 3 rune power.
[Vital Essence]: Restores 2% maximum health per second while at a supply point; costs 2 rune power.
Armour:
[Warding Banner]: Reduces damage taken by 8% while on a Capture Point; costs 3 rune power.
[Winged Havoc]: Javelin throw skills of Javenlin Infantry deal 15% more damage to Towel Shield units; costs 3 rune power.
[Sacred Light]: Reduces [Bandage]'s duration by 40%, while keeping the total heal amount unchanged; costs 2 rune power.
[Blood for Blood]: For [Polearm] units, 30% of healing from Lifesteal is converted into damage to the target; units only; costs 2 rune power.
[Mountainbreaker]: [Melee Infantry - Special] units' Blunt Damage increases by 20%; units only; costs 3 rune power.
Bracers:
[Iron Cavalry]: Lance Cavalry gain [Immunity] while Charging, and exit [Immunity] after they take 1 hit or after 10s; costs 3 rune power.
[Full Quiver]: [Javelin], [Bow], [Musket], and [Crossbow] units restore 2 Ammo for each enemy unit killed; costs 3 rune power.
[Piercing Fang]: Javelin Infantry's attacks deal an additional 200 block damage to units; costs 3 rune power.
[Fertile Blessing]: Increases maximum health by 3%; upon death, nearby allies restore 10% of their maximum health; costs 2 rune power.
[Stone Shell]: Increases hero maximum health by 2500; when health is below 30%, reduces damage taken from units by 20%; costs 2 rune power.
Boots:
[Gale Stride]: Reduces the [Chargers] amplification interval from 1.5 seconds to 0.5 seconds; costs 3 rune power.
[Judgment Horn]: Increases damage dealt by 8% while at a Capture Point; costs 3 rune power.
[Amber Veil]: While using [Bandage], the slowdown effect is lowered from 50% to 30%; costs 2 rune power.
[Ghost Wind]: Increases speed by 4%; upon death, nearby allies gain a 8% speed boost for 10 seconds; costs 2 rune power.
Weapon Runes
Poleaxe:
[Minotaur's Axe]: [Sideways Sweep] can now be used fourth time; costs 3 rune power.
[Shattering Axe]: For each enemy hit by [Weapon Dance], the [Ultimate]'s cooldown is reduced by 0.5s; costs 3 rune power.
[Hercules' Final Battle]: Reduces damage taken by 10% when using ultimate skill; costs 2 rune power.
Glaive:
[Demigod Authority]: Grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] when using [Hail of Blades] and [Flying Reaper]; costs 3 rune power.
[Dragon Aflight]: The stamina cost of Glaive's [Sprint Attack] is reduced by 30, and damage is increased by 30%; costs 3 rune power.
[Titanic Physique]: Grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] during [Turn and Attack]; costs 2 rune power.
Maul:
[Tortoise's Boon]: The stamina cost of all skills of [Maul] is reduced by 30%; costs 3 rune power.
[Titanic Shockwave]: Increases [Earthsplitter] impact area by 25%; costs 3 rune power.
[Hermes' Leap]: Reduces stamina consumption for [Dodge] by 20%; costs 2 rune power.
Longsword & Shield:
[Jason's Golden Fleece]: After using ultimate, restores 0.5% maximum health per second for 10 seconds; costs 3 rune power.
[Hippocrates' Oath]: [Mercy of Heaven] increases nearby allies' defense by 10% for 5 seconds; costs 3 rune power.
[Perfect Provisions]: When health is above 70%, increases all damage dealt by 100 points; costs 2 rune power.
Sword & Shield:
[Spartan Resolve]: Grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] when using [Centurion's Battle Drill] and [Thunderstruck]; costs 3 rune power.
[Realm Bulwark]: When using [Ironsides], your unit’s Defense increases by 30%; costs 3 rune power.
[Discus Thrower]: [Throw Shield]'s slowdown effect reduced to 20%, with cooldown reduced to 3 seconds, and range increased by 20%; costs 2 rune power.
Spear:
[Serpent's Malice]: Each stack of [Hard-Hitting] additionally increases all types of damage by 2%; costs 3 rune power.
[Great Horsemanship]: Reduces stamina consumption by 20% when using [Mounted Right Click]; costs 3 rune power.
[Unified Charge]: Increases damage of mounted attacks by 5%; costs 2 rune power.
Pike:
[Dionysus's Ecstasy]: [Water Dragon], [Sky Dragon], [Green Dragon], and [Cold Dragon] skills apply [Strong as a Storm] when hitting enemies. [Strong as a Storm] increases piercing armour penetration by 15% per stack; costs 3 rune power.
[Treads the Sea]: When using [Green Dragon], gain the damage and knock‑up of a 1‑second charge without charging; costs 3 rune power.
[Shadow Pursuit]: Each time using the third strike of [Wandering Dragon], [Water Dragon], or [Sky Dragon], the cooldown of the [Ultimate] is reduced by 2s; costs 2 rune power.
Nodachi:
[Heroic Strike]: [Ichi-no-Tachi] no longer requires charging to achieve the damage and knockback effect of a 2-second charge, also refreshing all cooldowns except ultimate. Hitting enemies with skills grants [Heroic Blessing], increasing damage by 2% and life drain by 1.5% per stack (up to 15 stacks, lasting 6 seconds). When the effect ends, 3 stacks are removed; costs 3 rune power.
[Ares' Sacrifice]: During [Bloodbath], increases critical value by 120% +1000; costs 3 rune power.
[Macedonian Costume]: During [Bloodbath], reduces damage taken by 15%, but the reduced damage is steadily dealt to you over the next 10 seconds; costs 2 rune power.
Musket:
[Thunder in Tandem]: After using [Blackpowder Grenade], you can cast it 1 more time within 10s; triggers only 1 time per cooldown cycle; cooldown increases by 15s; costs 3 rune power.
[Poseidon's Tide]: Changes [Five Rounds Rapid] to fire grape shot; using [Five Rounds Rapid] also increases critical value by 120% +2000 for 10 seconds; costs 3 rune power.
[Yang Metal]: [Normal Attack] are now grapeshot; costs 2 rune power.
Bow:
[Sun Chaser]: Each enemy hit by [Lightning Bolt] reduces cooldown by 3s; costs 3 rune power.
[Hydra's Fangs]: [Normal Attack] apply [Wound] stack, which explodes at 3 stacks, dealing 3% of current health +300 damage per second for 3 seconds. [Wound] also reduces speed by 5%; costs 3 rune power.
[Hippolyte's Demise]: Increases damage to ranged units by 15%; costs 2 rune power.
Short Bow:
[Plague Arrow]: markers and explosions can now spread to up to 5 nearby targets. The bleed damage from spreading is reduced by 50% and is not affected by the [Desert Warrior] set bonus; costs 3 rune power.[Hunt of Hercules]: [Wrath of Artemis] and [Angry Hornets] apply markers to enemies, which can be detonated by [Normal Attack]; costs 3 rune power.
[Animus of Kronos]: Each stack of [Enhanced Attack] now increases pierced damage by 4.5% and speed by 4.5%, but the maximum number of stacks is reduced to 5, and duration is increased by 2 seconds; costs 2 rune power.
Dual Blades:
[Selene's Warding]: Increases [Quick March]'s damage by 30%; costs 3 rune power.
[Shadowstep]: Entering [Sneak] via [Infiltrator] allows Sprinting and Jumping; costs 3 rune power.
[Troy's Tragedy]: Increases damage to units by 15%; costs 2 rune power.
Chain Dart & Scimitar:
[Achilles' Sorrow]: Each [Stinging Strike] hit reduces [Scorpion's Snare]'s cooldown by 1 second; costs 3 rune power.
[Yin Metal XVI]: [Scorpion’s Snare] now gain Armour Piercing effect for an additional 1 second; costs 3 rune power.
[Hephaestus' Blade]: Increases damage dealt to enemies with over 600 slashing defence by 10%; costs 2 rune power.
Shield & Spear:
[Spartan Greeting]: During [Spartan Kick], reduces damage taken by 30% and grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded]; costs 3 rune power.
[Skull‑Taker]: [Heracles' Throw] and [Heracles Mounted Throw] deal 10% more damage on headshots; costs 3 rune power.
[War Steps]: Reduces stamina consumption for [Sidestep] and [Sidestep Attack] by 25%; costs 2 rune power.

VIII. Season Fame
Fame Store
Fame of the Dynasty Awakening Season will be reset, and be replaced by Sacrum Romanum Fame for the Sacrum Romanum Season.
[Fame Store] rewards are as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/150edc04f7d48058084332c134073bf738e6de1d.jpg

Other Adjustment
[Field Battles] and [Ranked Battles] now grant Season Fame. The weekly Season Fame cap for all matchmaking modes is 1,500.

IX. System Optimizations
New Player Experience Optimizations
This Season, our revamped new player flow will be available across all servers—freshly created characters can immediately experience the latest combat stages and personal tent.
The [Unit Training Camp] has been completely rebuilt, with more battle demonstrations and counter-play content added.
We’ve also introduced enhanced trigger-based tutorials: aspiring warlords will encounter context-aware tutorial pop-ups on the battlefield at just the right moment.
Some weapons now unlock [Specialisation] automatically and feature a trial function—access this via the bottom-right "Trial" button under [P] – [Specialisation].
The weapon and equipment panels now display armor compatibility information. Should you equip incompatible armor, a prompt will warn you before removal.
All matchmaking battle modes now include mouse-hover tooltips for added clarity.

Battlefield Replay Improvements
The [Battlefield Replay] function now supports player-created training scenarios: Talking to [Sheriff] in the [Capital] to craft custom combat stages, then review these battles under [ESC] – [Career] – [Battlefield Replay].

Unit Skill Tags Added
All [Units] skills now display relevant tags in the Barracks, Deployment, and Battle screens, providing clearer function at a glance. Note: In the battle interface, these skill tags may adjust the icons’ positions. If you’d like to restore their previous location, turn off [Show Unit Skill Tags in Battle] under [ESC] – [Settings] – [UI].

Territory War Optimizations
The World Fief info panel now features a rules overview—click the [Rules] button (bottom right) for gameplay explanations on Fief and Territory War mechanics. The rules section also now details how ownership is determined after battles conclude.
For Territory War, defending forces must now meet Prestige requirements on front regions within cities or forts. If a defending House's Alliance falls below the minimum Prestige in that region, its members will be unable to reinforce the frontline until battle ends. (The front itself will remain active.)

House Reputation Adjustments
The methods of acquiring [Reputation] have been updated: [Reputation] can now only be earned by completing Weekly House Challenge Quests. Additionally, higher House levels grant increased Reputation rewards and higher weekly caps.
The use of Reputation has also changed: it is now only consumed in the following cases:
Declaring War on a Fief. The required Reputation varies by Fief type and level.
Every Tuesday and Saturday at 22:00, Reputation will be deducted based on the number of Fiefs held—150 for each Fief.
If the Command House fails to open a Front within 3 minutes, 1,000 Reputation is deducted.
Minimum Reputation required to declare war now varies by Fief type and level.
A new Fief Reputation value has been added, indicating how much Reputation is currently in effect for each Fief. This value determines Front commanders for each Fief.
At the start of every Territory War, all Fiefs reset their Fief Reputation to equal the House's current Reputation.
When a House becomes Front commander for a Fief and fails in attack, Fief Reputation for that Fief will decrease by 20% (up to a maximum total reduction of 100%), but overall Reputation remains unchanged. Fief Reputation is reset after each Territory War.

Battlefield Score
To enhance in-battle feedback, a new [Battlefield Score] system has been introduced.
Players are now awarded real-time scores for various in-match actions.
You can press [Tab] during battle to view the score panel, where players are ranked by total score—higher scores grant higher rankings.

Battle Pass Experience Storage
The [Power Growth] bonus function of the [Battle Pass] has been improved.
50% of the bonus Glory earned from [Power Growth] will be stored in a special pool if you have not purchased the [Battle Pass].
After purchasing the [Battle Pass], all stored bonus experience will be granted at once, allowing you to receive the full [Power Growth] bonus no matter when you make your purchase during the Season.

Other Improvements
Increased maximum storage: The [Supply Dump] – [Personal Storage] can now be expanded by 80 additional slots.
Improved the UI for the new player sign-in event.
Raised the max stack size for several commonly used items and resources.
Added interaction: In your personal tent, clicking on a [Unit] model will trigger a special Unit interaction animation.

X. Balance Adjustments
Bow Balance Adjustment

The Bow's weapon trait—“Dealing 36% more Armor Penetration to Units target, but 36% less to non-Units target”—has been removed.

Empire Chariot Balance Adjustment

Base Leadership reduced from 320 to 310

Current Health and Damage
When Health is between 80% and 100%, damage dealt is increased by 15%.
When Health is between 60% and 80%, damage dealt remains unchanged.
When Health is between 30% and 60%, damage dealt is reduced by 30%.
When Health is between 0% and 30%, damage dealt is reduced by 70%.

Instant Speed and Control Effects
When Instant Speed is ≥12, all types of Units and Heroes are affected by Knock Up.
When 12 > Instant Speed > minimum collision speed, the Knock Back effect only applies to Infantry Units. Heroes and Cavalry Units are no longer affected by additional control effects.
The impact damage effect during [Squall Edict] status is not included.
*If the corresponding Unit Training Node is activated, the minimum collision speed is set to 6.

“Instability” System
The Empire Chariot Instability System has been added:
Initial Instability Value is 0.
When the Empire Chariot receives damage from different Weapons, Instability Value varies according to Weapon type and skills:
Heavy Weapons inflict more Instability Value per hit, such as the Maul.
Melee Weapons inflict greater Instabilityty Value per hit than Ranged Weapons.
Weapons with combo damage or high-frequency attacks accumulate more Instability Value, such as Dual Blades.
All Ultimate Skills of Weapons inflict extremely high Instability Value, even if they do not have Knock Up effect.
Ambush and Accurate strike both grant additional single-hit Instability Value.
When all Units deal damage to the Empire Chariot, various Unit types and damage types will inflict extra Instability Value:
Melee Units generate greater Instability Value compared to Ranged Units.
Burning Damage causes higher Instability Value than other damage types.
Cavalry Units inflict higher Instability Value when dealing damage.
Chariot collisions result in extremely high Instability Value.
Ambush and Accurate strike both grant additional single-hit Instability Value.
Large Siege Artillery, such as Trebuchet, now inflict higher Instability Value damage. Player-deployed small Artillery will inflict varying Instability Value damage depending on the ammo type.
When the Empire Chariot’s Instability Value reaches its maximum, it will “Overturn”: the Chariot’s maximum speed reduces to 0; speed is decreased by 100% and this effect lasts for 8 seconds. The effect occurs even if the Chariot is not being controlled by a Hero.
If a Hero is controlling the Chariot at this moment, the Hero will be knocked off and will fall to the ground.
If there are allied Heroes from the same faction near the Chariot during “Overturn”, they will also receive the Knock Up effect due to the overturn.
After the “Overturn” effect ends (after 8 seconds), Instability Value resets, and all negative effects caused by the “Overturn” are removed. Instability Value accumulation starts again.
If maximum value is not reached, Instability Value will decrease over time.
Instability Value Recovery reduced by 25 points every 3 seconds
The Empire Chariot’s battlefield Health bar and the Units' Health display in the lower left corner will now show information related to the Instability System.
Updated the description text for the active skill [Thunder Mandate] and the unit’s trait tag [Thunderous Gallop].
When a target is hit again by the Empire Chariot in a short period, the damage received is reduced by 25%. If struck continuously, damage can be reduced by up to 85%. This effect lasts for 5 seconds.
A corresponding resistance buff will now be displayed and explained in the player character’s status bar.

notes.title: September 4 Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:
APAC: September 4, 14:00-17:00 (UTC+8). 
EU/AMS: September 4, 7:00-10:00 (UTC+1). 
The maintenance is expected to last for 4 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *10000, Honor *400, and Unit Medal *20 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. 
The update will contain the following:
 
I. Events
1. [Sacrum Romanum] Season is Coming—Season Battle Pass preorder is Available!
Introduction:
Preorders for the all-new Season Battle Pass will start after maintenance on September 4. Warlords can go to the Store via [C] to purchase the Season Battle Pass Preorder Pack.
Preordering the Season Battle Pass grants extra rewards including Treatise, Nobility XP, and more. You'll also unlock all [Victory Pass] content and get early access to the new 3-star Season Unit — empowering your journey in the new season!
Event Time:
September 4th (After maintenance) - September 19th (Before maintenance)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/849408787a9846ed0ecfed730a50661fc055a059.jpg
 
2. Preorder the new Season Battle Pass and unlock the [Victory Pass]—Receive the New Season Unit!
Details:
Preorder [Sacrum Romanum] Season Battle Pass and complete [Victory Pass] challenges to receive 2 Challenge Tokens for the new 3-star Season Unit. After the new season begins on September 19, you can directly unlock and obtain the new 3-star Season Unit.
Introduction：
Warlords can participate in the [Victory Pass] event via [O] – [Activities].
During the event, some [Victory Pass] rewards can be unlocked for free. If you preorder the new Season Battle Pass, you can unlock all [Victory Pass] rewards.
During the event, completing [Victory Quests] will get XP to level up your [Victory Pass] — the higher the level, the better the rewards.
New [Victory Quests] will unlock daily at 00:00, and all quests can be completed anytime during the event period.
Event Time:
  September 4th (After maintenance) - September 19th (Before maintenance)
 
3. Dragonhunter's Mantra Embraces a Time-limited Return!
Event Introduction:
During the event, Warlords can obtain [Mechanical Rod] through Siege Battles, Field Battle, Free Battles, and Colosseum, with a daily cap of 100 [Mechanical Rod].
Using [Mechanical Rod], you can draw rewards on the event interface. The Dragonhunter's Mantra reward pool consists of three phases: [Dragon's Awakening], [Shadowed Relics], and [Endless Hunt].
Opening [Dragon's Awakening] 300 times guarantees all rewards, including [Pure Wisdom].
After acquiring [Pure Wisdom] in [Dragon's Awakening], the [Shadowed Relics] pool unlocks. Opening [Shadowed Relics] 500 times guarantees all rewards, including an [Epic Hero Schematic Crate].
After obtaining the [Epic Hero Schematic Crate] in [Shadowed Relics], the [Endless Hunt] pool will open. [Endless Hunt] offers opportunities to acquire the Epic Mount [Golden Dragon], Legendary Kills Announcer [Valor of the Vanguard], and massive other rare items.
A maximum of 3,000 [Mechanical Rod] can be purchased during the event.
Event Duration:
[Mechanical Rod] Drop Duration: After the maintenance on September 4, 2025 – until 00:00 on September 18, 2025
Event Duration: After the maintenance on September 4, 2025 – until 00:00 on September 25, 2025
Special Notice:
If you have already acquired the Epic Mount [Golden Dragon] or the Legendary Kills Announcer [Valor of the Vanguard] in the previous [Dragonhunter's Mantra] event, you will not receive them again this time. Other rewards can be obtained as normal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f4886118d9c4a253493f6c3d3b513f8e54a4af31.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e3f7b3cb8f9245667ed29174b86202fe069ffe8e.gif
4. New Season Approaching, Reserve on Official Website for Great Rewards! 
Event Details: 
The new season and new server reservation will soon open in an official website reservation format. Warlords who successfully reserve and create a character on the new server before 00:00 on September 25 will receive generous rewards via mail after the maintenance on September 25. Exclusive permanent hero attire - [Black Rose Attire] and permanent epic title are included!
Event Duration: 
Reservation opens from September 5 to 00:00 on September 19
New Season Reservation Character Creation opens until 00:00 on September 25
 
II. System Adjustments & Optimizations
1. Season Server Transfer System
(1) New Season Server Transfer Reservation:
After maintenance, reservation for new Season server transfer will be available. After successfully applying for server transfer, you can log in directly to the target server after new Season Maintenance. Server transfer applications will remain open until the new Season Maintenance. For detailed server transfer information, please refer to subsequent transfer notices.
(2) Server Merge Notice:
After new Season maintenance, some servers ([Saga Blade] and [Khan of Heaven], [Europa Frontier] and [Bulguksa]) will be merged. Detailed information on server merges will be provided in upcoming merge announcements.
 
2. Ranked Battles
(1) Ranked Battles Settlement
The Ranked Battles in current Season will end at 24:00 on September 14, and rewards will be settled during the maintenance period for the new Season.
 
3. Hero Skill Adjustments
Pike:
The grab range logic for the [Sky Dragon] skill after using the Ultimate skill has been optimized.
The cooldown time for all skills except the Ultimate skill has been adjusted from 4 seconds to 3 seconds.
The global cooldown for the third consecutive skill activation has been reduced from 3 seconds to 1 second.
 
III. Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations
(1) Fixed an issue where the [Empire Chariot] could access abnormal passable areas on maps such as [Linwu Fortress], [Hangu Pass], and [Shield of the Capital].
(2) Fixed an issue where the exclusive Title [Between Cloud and Abyss] for the [Azure Dragon - Tempest] Attire was not fully displayed in certain language settings.
(3) Fixed abnormal sound effects with the [Azure Dragon] series Attire in the showcase interface.
(4) Fixed an issue causing incorrect shield orientation when female characters wore the [Past Resonance] Shield & Spear Attire.

notes.title: August 21 Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:
APAC: August 21, 14:00-18:00 (UTC+8).
EU/AMS: August 21, 7:00-11:00 (UTC+1).
The maintenance is expected to last for 4 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *8000, Honor *400, and Unit Medal *20 as compensation.
Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. The update will contain the following:

I. Events
1. The 6th Anniversary Faction Showdown Comes to End
Rewards Introduction:
After more than a month of fierce conflict, the 6th Anniversary Faction Showdown has drawn to its epic conclusion. In the clash between the mighty Terracotta Army and the formidable Grand Coalition, victory goes to the Terracotta Army! Both factions' warriors displayed remarkable tenacity and battle prowess, unlocking all six tiers of event rewards. Now it's time to honor your achievements!
All warriors who participated in the Faction Showdown can log in to claim their full six-tier rewards, including: Treatise*60, Anniversary Reward Box*60, Uncommon Scrolls of Mastery*600, Silver Keys*60, Discount Coupon (40% OFF)*1, exclusive Faction Avatar and other massive rewards! All these rich rewards are yours simply by logging in!
As the winning faction of the Showdown, every member of the Terracotta Army will also receive the exclusive "All Victorious" Title!
Missed out on the event? No need for regret — log in and you'll still receive a commemorative gift.
Raise a toast with your warriors and celebrate Conqueror's Blade's 6th Anniversary together!
How to Claim:
Click the \[Conqueror's Blade 6th Anniversary Event] button at the top of the main interface to claim your rewards.

2. Claim Generous Anniversary Rewards for Free!
Event Introduction:
Conqueror's Blade celebrates six glorious years with gratitude for every Warlord who has fought by our side!
Log in daily during the event and sign in to receive up to Treatise*50 and Illusionist Key*10!
Warlords who logged in between January 1, 2025, and August 22, 2025, can claim an additional special anniversary gift by logging in on August 23, which includes Treatise*10 and will be delivered via in-game mail by 24:00 on the same day.
Sign-In Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).
3. Limited-Time Free Doctrine Removal!
Event Introduction:
During the event, Doctrine Removal is free! Enjoy the fun of free combination！
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – 0:00, August 28
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b3cacc0cd0dcaef964456bcd9dd8b7a9d87f3275.jpg"]4. Limited-Time Attire Chest \[Evolving Divine Attires - Azure Dragon] Now Available — Upgradeable Hero Attire \[Azure Dragon] Debuts!
Clad in depths armor, awaken the soul of the dragon — you become the abyss itself!
Event Introduction:
During the event, the \[Azure Dragon] Hero Attire Chest will be available under \[Evolving Divine Attires] on the main interface. Spend an Illusionist Key to draw.
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).
How to Obtain:
  (1) Obtain through the limited-time Attire Chest event \[Evolving Divine Attires].
  (2) Receive all components (Helm, Armour, Gauntlets, Boots) upon first acquisition.
How to Upgrade:
  (1) The initial Attire grade is Tier I; spend specific upgrade materials to increase Attire tier, up to Tier VI.
  (2) Attire starts at Epic quality and evolves to Legendary quality at Tier IV.
  (3) Attire appearance changes with each upgrade.
Upgrade Materials & Draw Item:
  Divine Soul: Obtained by automatically dismantling duplicate Upgradeable Attire acquired from the \[Evolving Divine Attires] event.
  Shattered Armor of Divinity: Obtained by automatically dismantling duplicate Non-upgradeable Attire acquired from the \[Evolving Divine Attires] event.
  Illusionist Key: Obtained through cumulative Sign-ins, Victory Pass, Honour Store exchanges, or by spending Sovereigns.
Special Upgrade Rewards:
Upgrade the \[Azure Dragon] Attire to receive exclusive rewards at certain tier:
  Tier IV: Exclusive Kills Announcer — \[Tidal Surge]
  Tier V: Exclusive Title — \[Between Cloud and Abyss]
  Tier VI: Exclusive Avatar Frame — \[Dragon's Dominion], Exclusive Emote — \[Parting of the Sea]
Probability Details:
  Upgradeable Hero Attire \[Azure Dragon]: 2.72%
  Epic Hero Attire: 10.7%
  Rare items (including rare Hero and Weapon Attire, and Shattered Armor of Divinity): 42.75%
  Uncommon Hero and Weapon Attire: 43.83%
  For detailed probabilities, you can visit \[Main Interface – Evolving Divine Attires] in-game.
Additional Notes:
  (1) After upgrading \[Azure Dragon] to Tier II \[Awaken], you can complete exclusive Attire achievements and unlock Avatars: Azure Dragon (male) / Abyssal Radiance (female).
  (2) \[Azure Dragon] attire features an exclusive background image in \[P] – \[Personalise] – \[Attire].
  (3) Each part of \[Azure Dragon] can be individually unequipped and freely mixed, but all visual effects remain bound to their respective components.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/25df2f68faeadd98590678e6a53ce9a670006913.jpg"]5. Brand-new Appearance System \[Illusion Orb] Arrives — Exclusive Illusion Orb \[Millennia of Vigil] for Halberd Elite!
Forged from the night pearls of the Qin Mausoleum, this artifact allows Halberd Elite to transform into terracotta warriors under special conditions, unleashing the awe of the ancient terracotta army.
Event Introduction:
Open an \[Anniversary Reward Box] for a chance to obtain this exclusive item.
How to Acquire \[Anniversary Reward Box]:
(1) Receive it for free through the 6th Anniversary Faction Showdown event.
(2) Earn it by exchanging anniversary event items gained from \[Siege Battles] and \[Return to Battlefield] mode.
(3) Purchase directly in the Store.
Probability Details:
Opening an \[Anniversary Reward Box] grants a random rewards including brand-new Unit appearance items — the Illusion Orb \[Millennia of Vigil], the Sealed Legendary Seasonal Attire, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, Pure Wisdom, and other surprise rewards.
  Legendary-quality reward: 0.21%
  Epic-quality reward: 34.79%
  Rare-quality reward: 25%
  Uncommon-quality reward: 40%

6. New Anniversary PVE Mode — Return to Battlefield Released!
Event Introduction
Victory to Warlords! Have you yearned for a more exhilarating PVE challenge? The brand-new Anniversary PVE event has arrived!

Gameplay Rules Overview
Starting Leadership Limit: 300
You can earn Leadership by vanquishing foes, completing quests, and overcoming Altar challenges. Use your Leadership to purchase Units, unique Traits, and Artillery from the shop, or draw new Units from the Shrine.
Unit Deployment: Deploy any available Units, including your personal Units and Contracted Units.
Support Units: Level up within the battle to recruit additional Support Units.
Shrine: Spend Leadership to draw for Support Units at the Shrine.
Mystery Shop: Seek out these Mystery Shops hidden across the map and spend your Leadership to unlock wishing Units, Unit Traits, and massive Artillery. Each time the Shop is upgraded, the quality of goods increases!
Unit Development:
  (1) Purchase Unit Traits from the shop to permanently enhance attributes of Units you command. Forge your unique Unit Traits in this mode!
  (2) Unit Traits cannot be applied to Support Units.
  Hero Development:
  Purchase Unit Traits in the shop to raise your Hero's level. Reaching certain Hero levels lets you field an additional squad of Support Units.
Trial Altar:
  Interact with Altars on the map to face mysterious trial challenges. Victory brings generous rewards.
Mission Event:
  Special missions will randomly appear on the map — complete them to earn reward resource.
  Gameplay Map Introduction:
  Sanada Maru: Team up to strike enemy base, complete missions to forge a mighty Chariot, and carve a bloody path through flaming trebuchets and waves of foes!
  The Great Wall: Launch daring raids for flags and fiercely defend the wall! Advance stage by stage along the ramparts, shatter enemy ranks, and deploy cunning tactics against relentless onslaughts!
  Dasuo Fort: Break down the fort together — push relentlessly forward! Advance from the outer walls pushing to the final battle in the fort, all while dynamic reinforcement mechanics deliver an epic siege experience!
Event Duration:
Open all day from August 21 (After maintenance) to September 4.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4b4c92fcc5d4bd48157886cc2c77312cf9ca6333.jpg"]7. Extra Prizes for Specific Mode!
Event Introduction:
Participate in \[Siege Battles] and the exclusive anniversary PVE mode \[Return to Battlefield] to earn random event exchange items, which can be used to exchange rare rewards, including Anniversary Reward Box, Pure Wisdom, Golden Key, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, Treatise, and more! Don't miss your chance to claim the powerful battlefield slayer: \[Party Bombard]!
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 4 (Before maintenance).
Exchange Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – 0:00 (UTC+1 EU/AMS), September 11.

8. Anniversary Shopping Festival Begins — Limited-Time Offers on New Arrivals!
Event Introduction:
(1) The 6th Anniversary Celebration brings a series of special offer packs to the Shop. Enjoy ultra-value Monthly Pass for a limited time, along with all-new Lotus Water Pack!
(2) Take advantage of time-limited discounts on regular Attires — Attires for Warlords, Units, Mounts, and more, with prices slashed up to 50% off!
(3) Legendary Historical Attire Chests and Legendary Attire Exchange are now permanently available in the \[Attire Chests].
For detailed information, Warlords can visit the \[Shop] and check the exclusive \[6th Anniversary Shopping Festival] page, or simply click the \[Conqueror's Blade 6th Anniversary Event] button on the main interface.
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).

9. Anniversary Spending Rewards Unlocked!
Event Introduction:
Spend Sovereigns during the event to earn \[Illusionist Key] and exclusive exchange tokens.
Spending Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – 0:00, September 11.
Exchange Shop Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).

10. Doctrine Pool Rotation — New Epic Doctrine Now Available!
Doctrine Pool Introduction:
The limited-time doctrine pool \[Hedge of Pikes] is now available in \[War Scholar]. The drop rate of epic doctrines for Polearm Infantry Units is increased here.
New Doctrine Introduction:
Name: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
Quality: Epic Polearm Doctrine
Effect: After dealing damage, gain 12% Life Drain for 6 seconds. If Units' health falls below 30%, gain an additional 12% Life Drain for 3 seconds; if Units' health exceeds 60%, damage dealt increases by 12%.
II. System Adjustments & Optimizations
1. System
Battlefield Marker Feature:
The \[Marker] issued in battle with the mouse middle button will now sync directly to the Mini-Map and includes new 3D sound effects.
\[Order] issued via the mouse right button will no longer be limited by maximum visible distance, and now feature enhanced visual effects.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f85fb7a3dd2905825a21b91d90b5abbc30b534f0.jpg"]III. Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations Fixed an issue where the \[Modao Battalion]'s \[Modao March] skill targeted an abnormal number of enemies. Fixed an issue where the \[Charge] skill given by \[Epic Polearm Doctrine III] would not display for \[Demesne Pikemen] after interacting with a Supply Point. Fixed an issue where \[Serfs] could not equip Charge-type Doctrines. Fixed an issue where the Chronicle of the \[Spartan Chosen] Unit would not display properly. Fixed an issue where some opposite-gender Attire showed incorrect hairstyles when browsing in the Attire Shop. Fixed an issue where redundant Build buttons would occasionally appear in the \[Barracks] interface.

notes.title: August 7 Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:
APAC: August 7, 14:00-17:00 (UTC+8). EU/AMS: August 7, 7:00-10:00 (UTC+1). The maintenance is expected to last for 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *8000, Honor *300, and Unit Medal *15 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. 
The update will contain the following:
 
I. Events
1. Energetic Vibes, Shine This Summer! First Summer Themed "Cool" Attire Available for a Limited Time!
Event Introduction:
Princess Starlight basks in scarlet serenity, as the battle wave crowns a true surge champion by the summer shore.
During the event, the Store will feature the following four exclusive summer Hero Attires for a limited time:
  Female – Princess Starlight & Scarlet Serenity
  Male – Battle Wave & Surge Champion
Purchase the Cool Summer Exclusive Gift Box to receive a bonus Gender & Appearance Reset item!
Warlords can visit the Store for more details.
Availability Period:
August 7th (After maintenance) - September 3rd (Before maintenance).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/545a1fc5280170db18b97ede0309c3e6f5c3205f.jpg
 
2. All or Nothing Limited-Time Returns!
Event Introduction:
In All or Nothing mode, consecutive victories will earn you stars. However, a single defeat will reset your current star count. Warlords can use Required stars to exchange different treasure troves:
 
(1) 1 Star: Iron Treasure Trove
(2) 2 Stars: Silver Treasure Trove
(3) 3 Stars: Gold Treasure Trove
When opening the [Gold Treasure Trove] for the first time, Warlords are guaranteed to receive [Season Weapon Attire Selection Box] ×1.
Rules: 
(1) This All or Nothing mode follows the leadership return rule: defeated units will not return leadership, while retreating returns 50% of remaining unit leadership.
(2) All units are available except those from the Dynasty Awakening Season, Chevaliers, and Falconetti Gunners.
1. All equipments, units, and artilleries are provided by the system. Hero's equipments in this mode are reforged.
2. All Warlords have 1800 leadership.
3. Attackers can deploy 2 rare artilleries, and defenders can deploy 1 rare artillery.
4. Season limits have no effect. Up to 5-star units may be deployed.
5. Up to 3-player teams are allowed.
6. Each player may deploy a maximum of 3 Cavalry units.
7. Flag capture can only be interrupted by heroes. Units will no longer interrupt captures.
8. Every time a unit respawns or is switched at a supply point, it gains +30% movement speed for 8 seconds.
Special Restrictions:
（1）Quest progress gained from this mode will be halved.
（2）Only affects quests based on total accumulation, such as “Accumulate 2000 Troop Kill Score in any Field Battle or Siege Battle.” And Quests based on match count, such as “Participate in 5 PvP matches,” are not affected.
Event Duration：
August 7th (After maintenance) - August 21st (Before maintenance).
Warlords can check the exact event start time in-game via [J] - [Events].
 
3. New Season Weapon Attires Available! Join the All or Nothing Challenge to Get Free Attire Rewards!

notes.title: July 17 Online Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!

This week's maintenance will be conducted online, with no server downtime. We wish all warlords an enjoyable gaming experience!

The update will contain the following:
Bug Fixes and Optimizations
Fixed an issue where rotating the camera could occasionally result in clipping

Fixed an issue where the camera might shake abnormally at certain angles

Fixed an issue where the female Hero with Shield & Spear would only take melee damage when in right-click defending state in certain situations

Fixed an issue where the Hero might not be able to switch weapons in the beginner Weapon tutorial

Fixed an issue where some gift packs displayed incorrect items on the anniversary event page

Fixed an issue where certain weapons' unlock conditions were missing

Fixed an issue where progress rewards in the \[Arabian Nights] event were incorrectly sorted

Fixed an issue where cursor prompts were incorrect in the \[Arabian Nights] event

Fixed an issue where the quest refresh button was missing in the \[Arabian Nights] event
Balance AdjustmentsEmpire Chariot
The interaction cooldown for the \[Empire Chariot] has been reduced from 10 seconds to 5 seconds. Now, Hero can get back onto the Chariot more quickly.

An interaction cooldown has been added for the \[Empire Chariot]. Repeated interactions within 2 seconds will not be possible. Issues where players failed to board the Chariot due to rapid repeated interaction inputs will no longer occur.

Collision effects between the \[Empire Chariot] and large objects such as Siege Towers or Battering Rams have been optimized. When a Hero drives the Chariot and collides with a Siege Tower or Battering Ram, the Hero will be thrown from the Chariot, consistent with the logic when riding the Mount.

The movement logic for the \[Empire Chariot] has been optimized. The Chariot's passable area logic now matches that of Cavalry. Additionally, access to edge areas on several map stages has been restricted for the Chariot. We will continue to monitor Chariot mobility performance for further targeted optimization.

The collision effects between the \[Empire Chariot] and Artillery have been optimized. The \[Empire Chariot] now deals damage to enemy-deployed Artillery, dealing 50% of its base damage.

Fixed an issue where some skills without the knock-back effect could still cause a Hero to be thrown off the Chariot.

Widened the accessible area atop the right-side rampart at the \[Camp], and added a new path leading directly from inside the camp onto the rampart.

Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations

Fixed missing text on the eighth Mastery Node for \[Demesne Arquebusiers].

Fixed an issue where Hero might be unable to interact with NPCs after dismounting with the \[Q] key.

Fixed an issue where Hero could get stuck on a wall step in the \[Sun City] map.

Fixed an issue where Units could get stuck at a certain point on the \[Hangu Pass] map.

Fixed an issue where a system prompt interface overlapped on the \[Deploy & Defend] map.

Fixed abnormal Siege Battles record counting in \[Career] - \[Ranked Battles].

Fixed duplicated Doctrine options in the Rare Doctrine Selection Box.

notes.title: July 3 Online Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
This week’s maintenance will be conducted online, with no server downtime. We wish all warlords an enjoyable gaming experience!
The update will contain the following:
 
System Adjustments and Optimizations


Adjusted Troop Kill Score gained from defeating certain Units, based on their strength.

Participating in [Hangu Pass] battles now grants [Dynasty Awakening Fame].

[Hangu Pass] Map Balance Adjustments:


Adjusted the number of Flame Arrows engines for the attacking side. The initial number changed from 3 to 2; the number after capturing the [Camp] changed from 5 to 3. And adjusted the firing directions of the Flame Arrows.

Reduced the ammunition density of Flame Arrows and increased firing intervals.

Adjusted the positions of the attacking side's [Dam Guard], as well as the interaction position for the defending side to trigger [Breach the Dam].

Adjusted the position of the defending side's Supply Point near the dam.

Adjusted the location of the Supply Point near the defending side's [Pass Wall] base.

Removed the invisible wall from the defender's respawn point on the wall high ground.

Adjusted the time extension after the attacking side captures the [Camp], changed from 2 minutes to 3 minutes.

 

Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations


Fixed an issue where the penetration target count on the unit trait [Heavy Footbow] for Qin's Footbow was displayed incorrectly.

Fixed an issue where players could rarely get stuck on the loading screen when entering the Free Training Camp.

Fixed an issue where the yellow dot on the [U-Units] entrance would not disappear if the player's character level had not reached the unlock level for the Honour Store.

Fixed an issue where the navigation bar would disappear the first time the [F5-Season] tab was opened without purchasing the Battle Pass.

Fixed an issue where the Mastery of Symmachean Stalwarts was not unlocked in Fair Match mode.

[Hangu Pass] Map Bug Fixes:


Fixed an issue where players could instantly drown after respawning near point A.

Fixed an issue where the limit on the number of deployed Artillery was not working correctly.

Fixed an issue where the defending side's units could not retreat automatically in certain map locations.

Fixed an issue where some players received incorrect prompt messages when the [Dam Guard] was under attack.

Fixed an issue where the [Breach the Dam] mechanism could not be correctly triggered under certain conditions.

Fixed an issue where background music played abnormally during the game-ending phase.

Fixed an issue where units could randomly be teleported onto the pass wall when the left Siege Tower arrived.

Fixed an issue where some buildings on the map could cause Heroes and Units to get stuck.

Fixed an issue where the floodwaters damage area exceeded the warning zone.

notes.title: New Season Map — [Hangu Pass] Unveiled!

Here, the waters of the Wei River break, sheer cliffs converge, and forged fangs thrust forth from cleft mountains — this is Qin's eastern gateway: Hangu Pass!

notes.title: June 26 Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:
APAC: June 26, 14:00-17:00 (UTC+8). EU/AMS: June 26, 7:00-10:00 (UTC+1). The maintenance is expected to last for 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *8000, Honor *300, and Unit Medal *15 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly.

Here, the waters of the Wei River break, sheer cliffs converge, and forged fangs thrust forth from cleft mountains — this is Qin's eastern gateway: Hangu Pass!

Breach the Dam

After defeating the [Dam Guard], you can actively trigger the [Breach the Dam] event. Floodwaters will surge down the channel, eliminating all Heroes and Units within the downstream river area and destroying any floating bridge on the river.
Attention! After the [Breach the Dam] event is triggered, the two Supply Points in the river area will be destroyed and become unavailable. The water level will rise, flooding parts of the riverbank — any Heroes and Units caught in this zone will drown.

After the attackers capture the [Camp] flag, the number of waves per [Flame Arrows] will increase.
 
3. Hangu Pass Event — [Call of Unity] Begins!
With the launch of the Season Map [Hangu Pass], participating in [Hangu Pass] battles will reward you with [Qin Brick]. Donate [Qin Brick] during the [Call of Unity] event to earn generous rewards.

Event Rules:
Warlords can obtain [Qin Brick] as drops in the [Hangu Pass] mode (weekly drop limit: 200, which resets every Thursday at 00:00).
By donating [Qin Brick], Warlord contributes to the server progress, and gains individual Contribution Points and random reward packs.
Accumulate Contribution Points to gradually unlock personal rewards. You can check each reward stage in the donation progress bar. Once server progress is full, individual donations still grant rewards.
Any undonated items at the end of the event will be reclaimed automatically and converted to Bronze Coins.
Event rewards include: Emote [Tribute to All Under Heaven], Epic Hero Schematic Box, Treatise, Optimal Divine Crow, and more.

June 26th (After maintenance) - July 10th, 00:00 (Elysium Peak server: drops end July 9th, 18:00)

June 26th (After maintenance) - July 14th, 00:00

[olist]

Quest available: June 26th (After maintenance) - July 10th, 00:00

June 26th (After maintenance) - July 10th (Before maintenance)

Optimized the flight trajectory and speed of [Flame Arrows] summoned with the G key on certain maps.

Fixed an issue in the [Sun City] Siege map where cavalry could get stuck on terrain.
Fixed an abnormal reward issue in [Training Battle] mode.
Fixed incorrect description text in the manual units building popup.
Fixed an issue on certain servers where Doctrine-related side quest progress would not record properly.

notes.title: June 26 Balance Update Annoucement
notes.content:
Adjustments on HeroPike
[Wandering Dragon], [Water Dragon], [Sky Dragon]: After using any of the first two stage skills, you can use the third stage enhanced skill consecutively within 4 seconds.

Other skills can now be activated during the ending lag of the third stage of [Wandering Dragon], [Water Dragon], and [Sky Dragon].

[Wandering Dragon], [Water Dragon], [Sky Dragon]: First stage skill cooldown 3 → 4 seconds.

[Wandering Dragon], [Water Dragon], [Sky Dragon]: Third stage enhanced skill cooldown 0 → 3 seconds.

After each stage skill, you can use the next stage within 3.5 → 4 seconds.

Optimized the hitbox for [Sky Dragon] after using Ultimate, making it easier to hit enemies.

The second stage of normal attack can inflict the dazed effect on Heroes.

[Water Dragon]: The third-stage triple thrust's Armour Piercing coefficient: 60% → 100%.

 
Adjustments on UnitsQin's Footbow
Base Piercing Damage: 1596 → 1746

Base Piercing Armour Penetration: 2024 → 2124

Attack Penetration Targets: 2 → 3

Single Penetration Damage Reduction: 50% → 40%
Vassal Longbowmen
[Overwatch] cooldown increased from 5 → 15 seconds. The first two volleys now gain 100% increased fire rate.
Imperial Arquebusiers
Adjusted [Volley Fire] skill firing sequence to maintain continuous fire in the specified direction during the skill duration, improving firing efficiency by approximately 35%:

After the unit forms up, they first unleash a volley. Then, soldiers in the front, middle, and rear ranks take turns to unleash quick shot. Each rank fires three volleys in sequence; after two volleys, the next rank finishes reloading and begins firing.

During the [Volley Fire] skill, units will continue shooting in the specified direction and will not reposition.
Fortebraccio Pikemen
Base movement speed increased from 3.8 → 4.3.

Turning speed increased from 50 → 120.

Optimized unit [Brace] turning logic: Soldiers now prioritize turning only when they can attack an enemy.

Soldiers in crouched brace: Turn toward the enemy if an enemy is within 11 → 4 meters.

Soldiers in standing brace: Turn toward the enemy if an enemy is within 11 → 6 meters.
Shieldmaidens
Unit headcount increased from 28 → 32, with formation adjusted accordingly.

Base Max Health increased from 6585 → 8577.

Base Piercing Damage increased from 1090 → 1390.

Base Slashing Damage increased from 1248 → 1608.

Base Blunt Damage increased from 976 → 1269.

Enhanced defence capabilities in spear-shield mode and attack capabilities in sword-shield mode:

Significantly reduced weapon-switching time.

Spear-shield:

After any attack in sword-shield mode, switching to spear-shield mode restores 2% max health per second per soldier for 10 seconds.

While under [Cover Commander], switching to sword-shield mode retains the Block effect in moving state.

Sword-shield:

After any attack in spear-shield mode, switching to sword-shield mode increases Piercing Armour Penetration and Slashing Armour Penetration by 500 per soldier for 10 seconds.

The damage detection of [Triple Strike] is advanced by 0.3 seconds and deals an additional 300 damage to Block Value.

Attacks in sword-shield mode can no longer be blocked.
Shenji Grenadiers
[Throw Grenades] cooldown reduced from 37 → 30 seconds, initial Ammo increased from 2 → 3.

[Throw Grenades] core explosion area increased from 2.2 → 2.5, maximum explosion area increased from 4 → 4.2. Blunt Armour Penetration coefficient outside the core area increased from 80% → 100%, Blunt Damage coefficient increased from 100% → 110%
Kheshigs
Base Max Health increased from 8491 → 9144.

Base Slashing Damage increased from 1284 → 1516.

While moving, if there are no enemies within 15m, will attempt to throw a lasso at distant enemies, applying a 50% slow for 2 seconds on hit.

[Sabre Combo] skill adjustments:

Targeting rule adjustment: changed from prioritizing team targets to each soldier prioritizing the nearest enemy.

After activation, quickly charges towards the enemy and performs 4 slashing attacks. The first 2 attacks can hit up to 4 targets each, and the last 2 can hit up to 6 targets each. If already in high-speed at activation, the first 2 attacks cannot be interrupted.

After finishing slashing attacks, accelerates and dashes in the current direction to exit the enemy encirclement.

No longer deals extra damage at low speed; deals an additional 80% damage in high-speed mode. Deals increased damage to enemies moving toward them, while also receiving more damage from speed boosts.
Hwarang
When equipped with [Bowmanship Doctrine], [Epic Archery Doctrine V], and [Legendary Archery Doctrine II] Doctrines, the [Arrow Rain] skill uses the standard archery projectile trajectory and range (approximately 100m), retains Hwarang's own firing speed, and is affected by the \[Arrow Rain] damage coefficient. This skill does not stack with other skills.

notes.title: [Dynasty Awakening: Terracotta's Art of War] Season Update Log
notes.content:
I. Seasonal Unit
Qin's Footbow
Background:
Rising from ancient depths, the Terracotta Crossbowmen serve as the deadly long-range support for the Emperor. Clad in practical armor and wielding formidable foot-drawn bows, they strike with precision from 100-150 meters. Their volleys darken the sky, piercing armor, shattering bones, and tearing banners, all to decisively end wars with their strategic firepower. Embodying order and strength, they march to bring wars to a decisive close.
Combat Style:
The footbow represented the most advanced ranged weapon of its time, and the Qin's Footbow were among the most elite Units in Great Qin. Rigorously trained, they possess exceptional strength and skill: sitting, drawing, and firing in one seamless motion. Their bolts with spark inflict continuous damage and fear upon enemies. When the time is right, they decisively detonate these sparks to deliver a fatal blow.
Unit Characteristics：


Targets hit by the footbow will be marked with Spark, stacking up to 10 times. The higher the stack, the greater the damage upon detonation.

The footbow is a large crossbow with long range that can pierce and attack 2 targets. However, since it is a handheld crossbow, the crossbowman moves slowly and cannot push siege engines or climb ladders. All attacks require issuing a command to execute.

Skill Design：


Skill 1: Set Up/Pack Up Footbow (The unit must set up footbows before attacking and must pack it up before moving again)

Skill 2: Attack Area (Launches a long-range attack at an area chosen by the Hero. The system automatically adjusts the firing angle based on distance for precise coverage)

Skill 3: Spark Detonation (Detonate all the enemies with "Spark" within range, the damage depends on the "Spark" stacks)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/33cf090e79a3d697682fcb20095fb875b9f19e8e.jpg
Halberd Elite
Background:
Rising from the ancient earth, the Halberd Elites serve as the elite vanguard for the Eternal Emperor. Clad in sturdy armor and wielding formidable halberds, they embody order and discipline. Their precision strikes pierce armor and shatter bones, bringing wars to a decisive close.
Combat Style:
In the realm of Qin, they are known as the sharpest blades. Wielding halberds approximately 2.8 meters long, these weapons combine the features of a spearhead affixed to the front end of a dagger-axe. They can hook, pull, and thrust with deadly precision. Masterful in their technique, the Halberd Elites launch preemptive strikes on the battlefield, swiftly following up with ferocious attacks that overwhelm foes. Under the stern reward and penalty system, they exhibit unparalleled bravery and invincibility, instilling fear in their enemies.
Unit Characteristics：


The elite main battle units of Qin, wielding halberds as their weapon.

Utilize hooking and dragging attacks combined with strategic movement to control and suppress enemies effectively.

Upon killing enemies, they gain health recovery and a temporary boost.

Skill Design：


Skill 1: Cloud Cleave

Charge in the designated direction, dragging enemies towards them, ignoring all defenses.


Skill 2: Storm Surge

Immediately break free from control effect and retreat in the chosen direction, hooking enemies in front and pulling them away. Damage taken is reduced during the skill.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7927a0e6d1e352c37b301d6eded0ce39d37a2cc3.jpg
Empire Chariot
Background:
Chariots were used by the Qin state in warfare for both offense and defense. Assault chariots engaged enemies directly, while defensive chariots were used for garrison duty and transporting supplies. In general historical records, assault chariots are commonly referred to as Chariots and the records of small-scale chariot battles can date back to the Xia dynasty.
Combat Style:
During the Warring States period, chariots were the dominant force on the battlefield. Organized in formations, they charged enemy infantry phalanxes, disrupting their lines and creating opportunities for following infantry attacks. At the time, the number of chariots often served as a key indicator of a state's military strength. High-ranking generals commonly commanded on chariots, and even rulers would sometimes take the field in person, inspiring their troops.
Unit Characteristics:


The chariot is not only an assault force on the battlefield but also serves as the warlord's command platform and a symbol of status.

The chariot can charge at the front lines, pursue fleeing enemies, and assist in protecting the flanks of allied units.

Skill Design：


Skill 1 Thunder Mandate: (Hold the [Sprint Key] to accelerate the chariot, increasing ramming damage, but continuously consuming horse stamina.）

Skill 2 Squall Edict: (While at high speed, press the [Jump Key] and rotate the camera to veer. The chariot will ram targets with its body, dealing massive damage and allowing you to change direction with the camera. This greatly consumes horse stamina.）

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/88c91cc2060eab42010e0f70ffabaf587443ca86.jpg

VII. Season Runes
Armor Runes


Helm:


[Blood Rain]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, deals damage equal to 30% of the enemy's current health to up to 10 nearby enemy units; costs 3 rune power.

[Stormhoof]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, deals damage and knocks back nearby enemies; costs 3 rune power.

[Venom Claw]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, inflicts poison on nearby enemy units, dealing 0.2% of their maximum health per second, increasing by 0.2% per second for 20 seconds. If the enemy leaves the affected area, the effect is immediately removed; costs 3 rune power.

[Crimson Gaze]: Reduces unit damage taken by 20%; upon death, inflicts burning on nearby enemy units, dealing 3% of their maximum health per second while accumulating burning value for 10 seconds. If the enemy leaves the affected area, the effect is immediately removed; costs 3 rune power.

[Vital Essence]: Restores 2% maximum health per second while at a supply point; costs 2 rune power.

Armour:


[Warding Banner]: Reduces damage taken by 8% while on a Capture Point; costs 3 rune power.

[Winged Havoc]: Javelin throw skills of Javenlin Infantry deal 15% more damage to Towel Shield units; costs 3 rune power.

[Unyielding Guard]: Reduces block damage taken by 20%; costs 2 rune power.

[Sacred Light]: Reduces [Bandage]'s duration by 40%, while keeping the total heal amount unchanged; costs 2 rune power.

[Phantom Rush]: After a charge, Lancer Cavalry takes 10% less damage for 15 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

Bracers:


[Blood Vow]: Increases damage dealt by 3%; upon death, nearby allies gain a 10% damage increase for 10 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Piercing Fang]: Javelin Infantry's attacks deal an additional 200 block damage to units; costs 3 rune power.

[Fertile Blessing]: Increases maximum health by 3%; upon death, nearby allies restore 10% of their maximum health; costs 2 rune power.

[Stone Shell]: Increases hero maximum health by 2500; when health is below 30%, reduces damage taken from units by 20%; costs 2 rune power.

Boots:


[Judgment Horn]: Increases damage dealt by 8% while at a Capture Point; costs 3 rune power.

[Gale Stride]: Reduces the [Chargers] amplification interval from 1.5 seconds to 0.5 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Amber Veil]: While using [Bandage], the slowdown effect is lowered from 50% to 30%; costs 2 rune power.

[Ghost Wind]: Increases speed by 4%; upon death, nearby allies gain a 8% speed boost for 10 seconds; costs 2 rune power.

 
Weapon Runes


Poleaxe:


[Minotaur's Axe]: [Sideways Sweep] can now be used fourth time; costs 3 rune power.

[Nemesis' Will]: Increases damage dealt by 14% when health is below 30%; costs 3 rune power.

[Hercules' Final Battle]: Reduces damage taken by 10% when using ultimate skill; costs 2 rune power.

Glaive:


[Demigod Authority]: Grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] when using [Hail of Blades] and [Flying Reaper]; costs 3 rune power.

[Divine Oppression]: [Flying Reaper] no longer knock back heroes, but stuns them for 4 seconds instead; costs 3 rune power.

[Titanic Physique]: Grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] during [Turn and Attack]; costs 2 rune power.

Maul:


[Typhon's Demise]: When using [Maelstrom], the third attack increases defense by 10%, and the fourth attack grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] while increasing defense by 18%; costs 3 rune power.

[Titanic Shockwave]: Increases [Earthsplitter] impact area by 25%; costs 3 rune power.

[Hermes' Leap]: Reduces stamina consumption for [Dodge] by 20%; costs 2 rune power.

Longsword & Shield:


[Jason's Golden Fleece]: After using ultimate, restores 0.5% maximum health per second for 10 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Hippocrates' Oath]: [Mercy of Heaven] increases nearby allies' defense by 10% for 5 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Perfect Provisions]: When health is above 70%, increases all damage dealt by 100 points; costs 2 rune power.

Sword & Shield:


[Spartan Resolve]: Grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded] when using [Centurion's Battle Drill] and [Thunderstruck]; costs 3 rune power.

[Hercules' Greatness]: [Ironsides] increases defense by an additional 20%; costs 3 rune power.

[Discus Thrower]: [Throw Shield]'s slowdown effect reduced to 20%, with cooldown reduced to 3 seconds, and range increased by 20%; costs 2 rune power.

Spear:


[Fearless Thrust]: Each stack of [Hard-Hitting] increases armour penetration by 1%; costs 3 rune power.

[Great Horsemanship]: Reduces stamina consumption by 20% when using [Mounted Right Click]; costs 3 rune power.

[Unified Charge]: Increases damage of mounted attacks by 5%; costs 2 rune power.

Pike:


[Dionysus's Ecstasy]: [Water Dragon], [Sky Dragon], [Green Dragon], and [Cold Dragon] skills apply [Strong as a Storm] when hitting enemies. [Strong as a Storm] increases piercing armour penetration by 15% per stack; costs 3 rune power.

[Cronus' Authority]: [Green Dragon] resets its cooldown upon killing a hero; costs 3 rune power.

[Sylph Guardian]: Reduces damage taken by 30% during the first and second strikes of [Wandering Dragon]; costs 2 rune power.

Nodachi:


[Heroic Strike]: [Ichi-no-Tachi] no longer requires charging to achieve the damage and knockback effect of a 2-second charge, also refreshing all cooldowns except ultimate. Hitting enemies with skills grants [Heroic Blessing], increasing damage by 2% and life drain by 1.5% per stack (up to 15 stacks, lasting 6 seconds). When the effect ends, 3 stacks are removed; costs 3 rune power.

[Ares' Sacrifice]: During [Bloodbath], increases critical value by 120% +1000; costs 3 rune power.

[Macedonian Costume]: During [Bloodbath], reduces damage taken by 15%, but the reduced damage is steadily dealt to you over the next 10 seconds; costs 2 rune power.

Musket:


[Oceanic Wildfire]: Increases the impact area of [Blackpowder Grenade] and [Liquid Fire] by 15%; costs 3 rune power.

[Poseidon's Tide]: Changes [Five Rounds Rapid] to fire grape shot; using [Five Rounds Rapid] also increases critical value by 120% +2000 for 10 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Yang Metal]: [Normal Attack] are now grapeshot; costs 2 rune power.

Bow:


[Apollo's Marksmanship]: Hitting an enemy hero with [Lightning Bolt] stuns them for 2 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Hydra's Fangs]: [Normal Attack] apply [Wound] stack, which explodes at 3 stacks, dealing 3% of current health +300 damage per second for 3 seconds. [Wound] also reduces speed by 5%; costs 3 rune power.

[Hippolyte's Demise]: Increases damage to ranged units by 15%; costs 2 rune power.

Short Bow:


[Plague Arrow]: markers and explosions can now spread to up to 5 nearby targets. The bleed damage from spreading is reduced by 50% and is not affected by the [Desert Warrior] set bonus; costs 3 rune power.

[Hunt of Hercules]: [Wrath of Artemis] and [Angry Hornets] apply markers to enemies, which can be detonated by [Normal Attack]; costs 3 rune power.

[Animus of Kronos]: Each stack of [Enhanced Attack] now increases pierced damage by 4.5% and speed by 4.5%, but the maximum number of stacks is reduced to 5, and duration is increased by 2 seconds; costs 2 rune power.

Dual Blades:


[Selene's Warding]: Increases [Quick March]'s damage by 30%; costs 3 rune power.

[Cerberus' Chase]: Killing a Hero increases slashing damage by 4% (stacks up to 5 times, resets on death); costs 3 rune power.

[Troy's Tragedy]: Increases damage to units by 15%; costs 2 rune power.

Chain Dart & Scimitar:


[Achilles' Sorrow]: Each [Stinging Strike] hit reduces [Scorpion's Snare]'s cooldown by 1 second; costs 3 rune power.

[Thanatos' Fetters]: [Trap Prey] stuns enemies for 2 seconds; costs 3 rune power.

[Hephaestus' Blade]: Increases damage dealt to enemies with over 600 slashing defence by 10%; costs 2 rune power.

Shield & Spear:


[Spartan Greeting]: During [Spartan Kick], reduces damage taken by 30% and grants immunity to all control effects except [Winded]; costs 3 rune power.

[Champion Technique]: [Heracles' Throw] can now pierce one additional target; costs 3 rune power.

[War Steps]: Reduces stamina consumption for [Sidestep] and [Sidestep Attack] by 25%; costs 2 rune power.

VIII. Season Fame


Fame of the Silla Season will be reset, and be replaced by Dynasty Awakening Fame for the Dynasty Awakening Season.

[Fame Store] rewards are as follows:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f6bb8fe10c1fcdc14533772eb686cd440483305f.jpg

IX. System Optimizations
Barracks Interface Optimization:
The  - Barracks interface has been redesigned.
  Warlords can now find all owned and unowned units on the new Barracks main page, view detailed information about unowned units, and directly navigate to locations where units can be acquired.
  Each Unit can be tested in the Training Camp, and for some Units, battle demonstration videos are available.
  You can view specialty tags for each Unit to quickly understand their combat characteristics and battlefield roles.
  More comprehensive and accurate filtering functions are now available, making it easier and faster to find specific Units.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5a3563ca851503809b41214a8aa096d4c872b3bd.jpg
Unit Building Process:
Optimized the process of Unit Building has been optimized:
Unlocking a Unit in the Unit Tree will now automatically complete its build without consuming any materials or Bronze Coins.
Optimized the setting of Barracks Unit Capacity:
Manual Unit Build is no longer restricted by the Units Capacity limit.
For Units that have already been built, repeating the build will consume the item: Expansion Permit *1.
Only Units built multiple times can be disbanded; otherwise, the disband option will not be available.
 
Unit Training Camp:
More Mastery Units will be added as options in the Unit Training Camp.
 
Store:
Exclusive Unit attires have been newly added to the [Store]. Warlords can view the available attire via [C] - [Store] - [Attire] - [Unit Attire]. The new attire includes: Iron Reapers: Tradition's Power, Sunward Phalanx: Fairytale Guard, Onna-Musha: Lone Fox Unit Attire.
 
X. Visual and Interaction Adjustments
Hero Outline
When a hero is blocked by Units or other dynamic objects on the battlefield, a distinct outline will appear to clearly show the hero's position.
This function can be opened or closed in [Settings] - [Graphics] - [Graphics Settings] - [Hero outline].
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/66f520c9b788ad6cc8593e759e67831d5255076a.jpg
Dynamic Object Transparency

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c8562c60443cad9134461fce869ce40fa00b7c22.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9ec691ab8892b62c0462cb7c2dd178967908208b.jpg
Unit Off-Screen Indicators
When Units are outside your field of view, more prominent indicators will point to their direction.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/09a28624e2b0aa0396865d77b3d97cbf38a3a6f0.jpg
Damage Number Animation Optimization
The animations for damage numbers dealt by players in battle have been enhanced. Damage numbers for Brace Weapon types have also been added, allowing for better battle experience.
UI Visual Style Optimization
We will gradually update the overall UI with a more stylized design to better match the characteristics of the game.
 
XI. New Player Experience Adjustments
 
New Player Privileges: To help new warlords with Unit development decisions, we have introduced an exclusive privilege system for new players. Before reaching level 100, warlords can reset Unit levels, Unit Mastery, and Veterancy Points for free. Additionally, Doctrine removal and sealing of unit tree nodes are also free.
 
New Player Benefits: The welfare for unlocking Units for new warlords has been upgraded. Newly registered accounts will unlock the 4-star Unit: Kriegsbruders after completing the [Recruitment I] quest. Upon completion, the beginner login bonus event will also be unlocked. On the second day of the event, the login reward will be upgraded to the 5-star Unit Tercio Arquebusiers.
 
Match Battles: To improve early battle experience for new warlords, a new matching mode [Training Battle] has been introduced, and the required level to unlock matched Siege Battles has been adjusted to level 15. In Training Battle, warlords can focus on and become familiar with maps suitable for beginners, then gradually transition to more intense matched Siege Battles. The New Player Training Camp is not affected by World Campaigns and allows deployment of up to 5-star Units.
 
Training Camp: Free Training Camp and Unit Training Camp have been optimized, improving the practice experience for Units, Artillery, and Siege Battles.
Access Method 1: [J] - [Training Simulation] - [Free Training Camp] / [Unit Training Camp].
Access Method 2: [TAB] - [Free Training Camp] / [Unit Training Camp], or speak with the respective Trainer to enter.
 
Other:
The rules for displaying Units in the tent have been adjusted. Units will now change based on recent usage frequency in matched battles.
Guidance effects have been optimized in the Unit deployment, Unit interface, and Skills interfaces.
 
XII. Territory War Adjustments
Cross-Region Migration Adjustment


In the following servers, migration and expeditions between Longting, Liangyun, and Ostaria Regions can be conducted via Cross-Server Forts or Agents.
  （APAC）


Lotus Ash Sea、Dragonrise Island、Jaderock Creek。

  （EU/AMS）


Crytal Sea、Elysium Peak。

In future seasons, we will explore more combinations of open Regions, allowing warlords to migrate through Cross-Server Forts and Agents.
Adjustment to House Level Requirement for War Declarion
The required House level to declare war on the following City Fiefs in Territory War has been adjusted from level 4 to level 3:
Daur, Kerlich, Huegelstadt, Gruenefeld, Tura, Óváros, Kisbér, Hatvan, Horka, Rubusta, Hexi, Gaoda, Narth, Hebao, Jindai, Zandin, Louge, Yixing, Renlin, Mingyu.
 
 
XIII. BUG Fixes
Fixed an issue where the unit type description for [Matchlock Ashigaru] was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where [Demesne Pikemen] could not use [Sprint] while in [Block] formation.
Fixed an issue where [Janissaries] would behave abnormally when following in C-key state.
Fixed an issue in the Battle of Thermopylae where certain areas could trap heroes and prevent movement.
Fixed an issue where Leaders, Vice-Leaders, and Marshals of non-Command Houses at the same Fief could supervise Fronts started by other Houses.
Fixed a rare crash that could occur when entering a stage with DLSS enabled.
Fixed a rare issue where shield break visual effects would behave abnormally after a Unit performed a shield break attack.
