notes.title: CBL 2025: Eastern Conference Championship Highlights – May 29
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ScUfjUnRMK4;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: ZT VS BOD [Reginopolis / Harbour City] 3-0
Round 1 (ZT Defense - BOD Attack, Reginopolis)
ZT gives up outer positions right from the start, meeting BOD head-on at Gate C for the opening clash. With sharp unit composition and split tactics, ZT fends off BOD’s first assault. A miscalculated trebuchet strike from BOD hurts their own units, and their damaged second wave at Point C gets isolated and crushed by ZT. With all their forces spent, BOD can’t recover—ZT takes the opener!
Round 2 (BOD Defense - ZT Attack, Reginopolis)
BOD sets up a solid defense at Point C, but ZT takes some artillery fire and shrugs it off. Gathering their forces at the central gate, ZT launches a quick and furious assault on C. Their cavalry swings in from behind, smashing BOD’s ranged units and punching holes in the defense. With C in hand and their unit-count advantage established, ZT ramps up the pressure. Another clash erupts at the broken wall—ZT storms through, blocks BOD’s backup on the stairs to Base, and secures another swift win.
Round 3 (BOD Defense - ZT Attack, Harbour City)
BOD rolls out with an all-cavalry lineup, picking off isolated ZT units early with hit-and-run tactics. But dragging the fight out costs them dearly. At the main gate, BOD can’t regroup effectively, and ZT picks them apart one by one. With no defenders left in the Base, ZT sweeps in for the finish. ZT closes it out 3-0—a flawless advance to the next stage!
 
 [previewyoutube=gJwoHvPw570;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 2: PAE VS TWT [Heilung Fjord / Wall Fort] 3-1
Round 1 (PAE Attack - TWT Defense, Heilung Fjord)
PAE charges in with a full-on assault at A, putting Siphonarioi at the core for heavy damage, backed by Schutzdieners for support. They brawl in the tunnel, cavalry stirring up chaos, and after wiping out the defenders, PAE secures a unit advantage. Spotting TWT regrouping at the C resupply point, PAE launches a surprise strike on the main base, flips the tables, and locks down reinforcements with their trebuchet, quickly wrapping up the first win.
Round 2 (TWT Attack - PAE Defense, Heilung Fjord)
TWT rushes straight for B, but gets bottlenecked in the corridor where PAE and Siphonarioi’s fire stop their push cold, earning a solid unit-count lead. TWT swaps to A and makes progress, but can’t hold out as PAE keeps pouring in reinforcements. TWT's last-ditch rush grabs the front yard at A, but PAE breaks through with a fierce counter, cleaning up weakened units and taking another round.
Round 3 (TWT Attack - PAE Defense, Wall Fort)
PAE’s slow breach at broken bridge gives TWT time to swing through the walled keep and threaten B. PAE holds back just enough at the broken wall to chip away at TWT’s frontline, taking out several units in the rubble. TWT’s mobile teams swoop in to capture C, then battle it out in the Base. Even with a unit advantage, PAE can’t hold—TWT’s precise dueling chops whittle down the heroes and snatch a point back.
Round 4 (PAE Attack - TWT Defense, Wall Fort)
PAE pulls TWT into multiple skirmishes out front at C, then rallies for a full-force Brace units to shatter the defense and seize the point. The tug-of-war moves to the Base flag; after PAE seizes the supply, they barrel straight for the finale. Perfect unit counterplay and an iron teamwork push lets PAE storm the Base, sealing up the 3-1 series win!

Introduction:
Access:
  Participate in the mode directly through [J] - [Onslaught]. You can also switch between "Challenge Mode" and "Endless Mode" there.
Details:
  [Onslaught] is available for a limited time. [Hwarang], [Tiger Fists], and [Silla Guards] are joining the battlefield. New [Tactics] are introduced, [Trait] effects fully updated, and several new battle scenarios have been added for a more challenging experience.
Gameplay Introduction：
Battle Rules:
   (1) Bring a unit that can be operated by heroes to participate in the battle.
   (2) The battle is divided into multiple rounds, each round consisting of a [Deployment Phase] and a [Battle Phase].
   (3) At the start of the [Deployment Phase], all units and hero's statuses are reset (fully restored), and a certain amount of leadership are provided as funds. During the [Deployment Phase], players can consume leadership to deploy or upgrade units. The [Battle Phase] begins once deployment is complete.
   (4) During the [Battle Phase], if one side's units are entirely defeated, that round ends and the next round's [Deployment Phase] begins.
  Victory Conditions:
    Both sides have a certain amount of [Morale]. At the end of each round, the losing side will have their [Morale] deducted. If the enemy's [Morale] reach zero, the player wins the game. Conversely, if the player's [Morale] reaches zero, the game is lost.
  Talent System:
    Complete an Onslaught battle to earn [Talent Points]. Spend [Talent Points] to unlock new abilities that aid in completing the game.
  Trait System:
    Units deployed during the [Deployment Phase] carry several [Traits]. When enough units with the same [Trait] are on the field, the [Trait] effect is triggered.
  Tactics System:
    Unlock tactics in the talent system. After unlocking tactics, there will be an opportunity to choose a tactic at the start of specific rounds' deployment phases. Tactics have powerful effects that can enhance your overall strength.
  Economy System:
    There is a maximum limit on the number of units that can be deployed on our side, which increases with the number of rounds.
Rewards Preview:
Earn [Onslaught Points] after each round of Onslaught based on your result and rounds reached.
Accumulate [Onslaught Points] to receive milestone rewards, including Pure Wisdom, Treatise, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, and other valuable items.
Leaderboard Introduction:
How to Participate:
  Compete for the highest score in [Endless Mode]; your highest single score will automatically enter the leaderboard.
Leaderboard Rules:
  Scores in [Endless Mode] of Onslaught count toward the leaderboard.
  In [Endless Mode], scores are calculated each round based on unit losses for both sides. The highest score you achieve will be used for leaderboard ranking (for equal scores, the player who reached it first ranks higher).
Leaderboard Rewards:
  When the event ends, leaderboard players will receive valuable rewards based on rank, including exclusive Title, Frame, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, Treatise, and more.
Event Time:
[Challenge Mode] and [Endless Mode] will be open all day after maintenance on June 5 and will close before maintenance on June 19.
After maintenance on June 19, the event page remains open until maintenance on June 26 for you to claim rewards with the points earned.

notes.title: CBL 2025：May 26th AMS Region Finals Highlights
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aAOMrMtkhXc;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: COPE vs ZOD [Harbour City / Kurak Castle / Grasslands] 2-3
Round 1 (COPE Attack - ZOD Defense, Harbour City)
COPE's initial push with the Siege Tower faltered as their trebuchets were quickly dismantled. They then redirected their assault through the center gate to seize the supply point and press up the stairway. However, ZOD capitalized on the terrain with their Spartan Chosen, crushing COPE's main offensive line. Even after breaching the wall with a single tower, COPE's Siphonarioi could not withstand ZOD's Spartan-driven counter, leading to a decisive win for ZOD.
Round 2 (ZOD Attack - COPE Defense, Harbour City)
At the start, COPE chose to forfeit point A, allowing ZOD to swiftly assault the left supply point. COPE attempted an encirclement but fell into disarray due to strategic misalignment. ZOD capitalized on this confusion, breaking COPE apart point by point and advancing straight to The Base, securing another victory and a lead of 2-0.
Round 3 (COPE Defense - ZOD Attack, Kurak Castle):
COPE boldly opened with a cavalry charge, trading blows with ZOD's elite forces, and subsequently retreated to fortify their Base. In the endgame skirmish at the Base, COPE's mobility allowed them to target ZOD's heroes effectively. With all ZOD heroes slain, COPE clawed back a win, making it 2-1.
Round 4 (COPE Attack - ZOD Defense, Kurak Castle):
COPE observed ZOD massing forces at point A and cleverly maneuvered through the central gate to an undefended point B. Although the tail of their unit line was cut off, they managed to secure point B, overwhelm the reinforcements, and even their losses. In the final moments, COPE encircled The Base using the nearby staircase, crushing ZOD's defense to even the score at 2-2.
Round 5 (Grasslands):
Both teams clashed fiercely at the onset, with ZOD losing their advantage position and redirecting efforts towards undefended point B. Despite successful reclamation, COPE had already begun cementing their control. Continuous skirmishes ensued at all points, but ZOD, leveraging superior positioning, counter-pushed point B in the final countdown and maneuvered towards COPE’s Base, securing the win with greater capture progress. Congratulations to ZOD for claiming a 3-2 victory and becoming the AMS region champion!

notes.title: CBL: May 26 EU Region Finals Highlights
notes.content:
YB vs WSS [Hidden City / White Elk Fort / Grasslands] 3-2

[previewyoutube=fzNfJa_yy2I;full][/previewyoutube]

Round 1 (YB Attack - WSS Defense, Hidden City)
YB's opening offensive struggle led to several skirmishes with WSS, finally concentrating forces to scale the wall via a single Siege Tower with 4 minutes remaining. WSS's surround neutralized the attack. Follow-up attempts stalled at the tower, draining time, as WSS held strong defensively.
Round 2 (WSS Attack - YB Defense, Hidden City)
YB strategically abandoned point A, sparking a fiercer confrontation at the B point path. Opting for a bait-and-circle tactic, YB initially struggled but leveraged shorter supply lines to fend off WSS. WSS's extended supply lines led to a second assault failure, allowing YB to even the score.
Round 3 (WSS Attack - YB Defense, White Elk Fort)
WSS commenced an attack from the broken wall to A, only to be blasted away by YB's defense anchored on Siphonarioi and Shenji Grenadiers. Next round saw WSS targeting the right stairs, yet facing Shenji Grenadiers’ firepower before engagement. Though they briefly seized A, YB's ongoing reinforcement led to WSS's faltering, earning YB another victory.
Round 4 (YB Attack - WSS Defense, White Elk Fort)
YB's scattered harassment diluted their frontal power, leading to a failed first assault on A. Hastily pushing forward without regrouping, YB suffered significant losses as WSS methodically countered their attacks, eventually exhausting time in vain, drawing the score to 2-2.
Round 5 (Grasslands)
YB initiated a blitz on A and C points , splitting forces for strategic control over the upper supply point to press WSS hard. Then Focusing forces, YB isolated and seized an unsupported B point, enforcing progress through triple-point dominance. YB's main bulk pressured the WSS's base, securing victory with full capture progress, advancing with a 3-2 triumph.

  Mastery Node 5: Health recovery increased from 40 health per second to 1% of maximum health per second.
  Mastery Node 6: Damage reduction from 5-star units increased from 200 to 400.
  Mastery Node 7: Damage reduction from Cavalry increased from 200 to 400.
  Spear Sergeants:
  Initial health increased from 7260 to 8508.
  Piercing damage increased from 978 to 1181.
  Maximum unit size increased from 32 to 40.
  Adjusted [Cover Commander] combat style: leveraging the spear's length for more aggressive attacks to enhance attack efficiency, which now reduces enemies' penetration values by 10% per hit, stacking up to 5 times.
  During [Cover Commander], maximum movement speed increased from 5.2 to 7, with added block effects during movement and attack.
  Symmachean Stalwarts:
  Maximum health increased from 7252 to 8432.
  Piercing damage increased from 1003 to 1237.
  Maximum unit size increased from 32 to 40.
  The damage reduction effect during successful blocks in brace state temporarily increased from 12% to 30%, with life recovery effects boosted from 7% to 9%.
  The brace attack's range remains unchanged, but the attack will be launched early as enemies are about to enter the attack range.
  Imperial Javelineers:
  Initial health increased from 6405 to 7035.
  Initial ammo amount increased from 90 to 120.
  Initial piercing damage increased from 1123 to 1201.
  Javelin attack piercing damage coefficient increased from 320% to 350%.
  Shield throw attack piercing damage coefficient increased from 135% to 150%.
 
2. New Unit Mastery
  Demesne Arbalists:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Piercing Bolts], which allows crossbow bolts to pierce up to 2 additional targets and disrupt cavalry charges; damage decreases by 30% for each target pierced. (Does not coexist with other skills)
  Node 6: Increase damage against cavalry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against melee units by 400 points.
  Node 8: [Piercing Bolts] apply a 40% slow to cavalry, lasting 3 seconds.
  Rattan Vipers:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Poison Barrage], causing small area enemies to be poisoned and take damage equal to 1.5% of their current health per second.
  Node 6: Increase damage against infantry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against ranged units by 400 points.
  Node 8: Increase [Poison Barrage] poisoning damage by 300 points per second.
  Ironcap Arquebusiers:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Rapid Fire], greatly increasing shooting speed for 12 seconds.
  Node 6: Increase damage against cavalry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against melee units by 400 points.
  Node 8: During [Rapid Fire], randomly throw firecrackers to deal area damage, which will comsume a large amount of ammo.
  Ironcap Archers:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Explosive Arrows], which shoots 2 rounds of arrows with attached firecracker causing small area explosions.
  Node 6: Increase damage against infantry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against ranged units by 400 points.
  Node 8: Reduce [Explosive Arrows] cooldown time by 9 seconds.
 
3. Basic System Updates
Quest System:
  Optimized rules for continuous victory quests. If you exit the game during a battle and lose, your win streak record will reset. If you win, the win streak count will continue as normal.
Server Transfer System:
  Added an item listing check in the market during server transfers and introduced appropriate notifications.
Replay System:
  The [Battlefield Replay] system is now available to all. Warlords can view recent [Ranked Battles] replays on the [ESC] - [Career] - [Battlefield Replay].
Interface Updates:
  New rule introduction content on [P] - [Character],  - [Barracks], and  - [Unit Tree] interfaces. Click the [Rules] button at the bottom right of the respective tab to view.
Unit Training Camp:
  Additional Units are now available for training in the Unit Training Camp.
 
 
4. Ranked Battles Related
[Ranked Battles] Settlement Time and Rewards Update:
  Starting from the Silla season, [Ranked Battles] settlement time will be changed to 00:00 (server time) on the Monday of the last week of the season. The settlement will last until the new season, during which [Ranked Battles] will be temporarily closed.
  After the maintenance of the new season, Warlords can log into the game and claim their settlement rewards on the [Ranked Battles] interface.
 
III. Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations
Fixed an issue where the shield position of [Psiloi Slingers] was abnormal when advancing with the Battering Ram.
Resolved the issue where [Hwarang] would unexpectedly replenish ammo when equipped with the [Double Strings] Doctrine.
Corrected the discrepancy between displayed and actual skill names in the training node of [Schutzdieners].
Fixed an abnormal unit model display issue after unlocking the final node of [Incendiary Archers] in the Veterancy.
Fixed the issue of unit models floating after being defeated.
Addressed the unresponsive issue when clicking the increase button in the purchase interface of the [Barding & Tack] shop.
Fixed an issue where using formation commands while climbing stairs would lead to voice loss for units.
Corrected the issue where the color of teammate names would display incorrectly on the [Front] interface.
Resolved an issue where weapon-related quests would progress while trying out Legendary attire in the trial level.

notes.title: CBL 2025: May 25th APAC Region Finals Highlights
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=loPM0Jom-do;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: BOD vs PAE [Harbour City / Reginopolis / Grasslands] 2-3
Round 1 (BOD attack – PAE defend, Harbour City)
BOD stacked up at the side gate, spotted the PAE swarm, then quickly rotated and split forces at the main gate to snipe the right supply. They rushed the base flag, but were spread thin and failed on the first push. Next, a heavy assault on the left supply point was constantly disrupted by PAE heroes. In the grand finale, PAE held their ground in base until the clock hit zero—first-round defense for PAE!
Round 2 (PAE attack – BOD defend, Harbour City)
PAE launched down the right stairs to hit the right supply, but BOD pushed up for an early fight. Even so, PAE’s cavalry doubled back, smashed through, and took the point, leaving both sides bleeding evenly. In the base siege though, PAE split their forces too often and had no punch up front, getting repelled over and over by BOD. Time out—score tied!
Round 3 (PAE attack – BOD defend, Reginopolis)
BOD gave up the front and both teams clashed for the first time at the C-point platform. PAE locked BOD down, bombarded them with trebuchet, and snagged C with ease. In the C-point backyard, PAE led with artillery, and with BOD lacking heavies and support units, they got swept. At the base, PAE’s second wave overran the outnumbered defenders, racking up another win.
Round 4 (BOD attack – PAE defend, Reginopolis)
PAE gave up the early points, locking in at C for a hard defense. BOD flanked and took the rear C supply, split their push from the side and back gates. After PAE plugged the side, BOD burst through the front, squeezed the defenders, and snatched C. In the end, BOD stormed in mid, surrounded the last PAE troops, and took base for the equalizer—2-2!
Round 5 (Grasslands)
BOD grabbed B and C first, but PAE pulled out the “double pressure, B-point all-in” strat—constant C-point raids while sending the main force to smash and retake B on raw numbers. When BOD made their own B-point push, PAE dug in and held out to the bitter end. With more points capped as the timer hit zero, PAE sealed it 3-2 and took the final victory!

notes.title: CBL 2025: May 23nd Chinese Mainland & APAC Highlights
notes.content:
Chinese Mainland Region
[previewyoutube=WUANHHvd6gA;full][/previewyoutube]
TWT vs SDYL [Heilung Fjord / White Elk Fort / Grasslands] 2-3
Round 1 (TWT Attack - SDYL Defense, Heilung Fjord)
TWT swiftly moved to Point A after some back-and-forth at Points A and B, using the Siphonarioi for maximum output. When their main force faltered, they brought in cavalry to crush SDYL. In the base battle, TWT launched a surprise attack from the left path, while SDYL mistakenly reinforced from Supply Point C, allowing TWT to capture the flag and turn the tables. SDYL fell due to terrain disadvantages, giving TWT the first victory.
Round 2 (SDYL Attack - TWT Defense, Heilung Fjord)
SDYL seized the chance as TWT struggled to secure their position, quickly capturing Point A and gaining unit advantage. At Point C, SDYL used artilleries to compress TWT's space, strategically deploying forces to maximize their advantage, steadily pushing and seizing the base to equalize the score.
Round 3 (TWT Defense - SDYL Attack, White Elk Fort)
SDYL's aggressive push was baited by TWT, splitting their forces and opening them to cavalry charges. In the second wave, SDYL set up Grapeshot Cannons upfront, while TWT's cavalry held firm to trade losses, repelling the offense. SDYL lacked infantry and fell behind in unit count, exhausting their time and handing another point to TWT.
Round 4 (SDYL Defense - TWT Attack, White Elk Fort)
TWT's advance through broken walls was surrounded and annihilated by SDYL, who counterattacked using artilleries in the narrow terrain to regain unit count balance. In the base clash, TWT's flank was countered by SDYL's regroup, successfully defending to even the score at 2-2.
Round 5 (Grasslands)
Both teams targeted the other's strategic points. TWT abandoned Point B to rally everyone at Point A, giving SDYL an opening to reclaim Point B and unlock TWT's base flag, accelerating capture progress. Amidst chaos, SDYL focused on the base flag, gaining control and advancing with a 3-2 victory, securing their ticket to the next round.
APAC Region
 [previewyoutube=8LNPLmgHcCk;full][/previewyoutube]
AMG VS BOD [White Elk Fort / Kurak Castle] 1-3
Round 1 (AMG attacks – BOD defends, White Elk Fort)
AMG faked a left supply raid at Point A, baited BOD into the choke, then slammed the flank with cavalry—seizing the lead early. But at the base, AMG’s fragmented lines were picked apart as BOD boxed in and wiped them several times. BOD takes Round 1!
Round 2 (BOD attacks – AMG defends, White Elk Fort)
BOD played keep-away, pressuring AMG then snagging Point A cleanly. At the base, AMG tried for the wraparound, but BOD drove in hard with artillery center and Lionroar Crew on the side, splitting off to block the supply. One crushing teamfight later, BOD seizes the base—up 2-0!
Round 3 (AMG defends – BOD attacks, Kurak Castle)
AMG skipped AB and charged straight for the base. BOD locked down the side entrance and kept tugging AMG between supply and base. AMG rotated rapidly, and despite losing their base camp supply, managed to clear out all defenders in base, grabbing a point back.
Round 4 (BOD defends – AMG attacks, Kurak Castle)
BOD went for a slow-burn at A, baiting AMG up the tower for a clean front-back surround—blasting AMG’s first push and knocking out high-value units. In the final base clash, BOD caught AMG shifting positions, pushed up for a forced fight, used a smooth troop comp, and shut down both defenses. Victory sealed—BOD advances!

notes.title: CBL 2025: May 25th Chinese Mainland Region Finals Highlights
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FIv6wApYL0Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: ZT vs. SDYL [Wall Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (SDYL Defense - ZT Attack, Wall Fort):
SDYL deployed an all-out harassment strategy at the bulwark, but ZT predicted and countered effectively, resulting in SDYL losing over a hundred units right out of the gate. ZT then used a crafty maneuver at the C Supply Point, trapping SDYL's main force there. With a trebuchet assault advantage, ZT surrounded and decimated the forward defense, expanding their troop lead by another hundred. In the main camp battle, ZT initiated the engagement, breaking SDYL's units amassed at the lower left and clinching the first round.
Round 2 (ZT Defense - SDYL Attack, Wall Fort):
SDYL's units were insufficiently concentrated as they breached the broken wall, allowing ZT's cavalry and Incendiary Archers to incinerate front-line units and control the battlefield, quashing the initial SDYL assault. SDYL regrouped for a counteroffensive at the C point's left platform, leveling the troop difference, but ZT pursued retreating forces, reclaimed their advantage, and encircled SDYL again, leaving them unable to mount another attack—ZT took their second round.
Round 3 (SDYL Attack - ZT Defense, Wall Fort):
SDYL captured point A and moved on to point C's right Supply Point, where ZT stalled them with frontal delays and multi-line attrition, picking off SDYL's units at the supply fringe. When SDYL attempted a frontal assault on C, their lower troop quality let ZT wipe them out, exhausting their offensive capabilities and running out the clock. ZT swept the series 3-0, claiming the final victory.

notes.title: CBL 2025: May 24 EU Highlights
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Cl3-SDtKTzo;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: YB VS LOS [Hidden City / Dasuo Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (YB attack - LOS defend, Hidden City)
LOS started off with a poor unit composition, leaving them 500 troops behind YB right from the get-go. The first clash broke out at the left supply gate, but after YB capped Point A and pushed up the left stairs, they were wiped out by LOS’s cavalry sweeping back in. No sweat—YB immediately surged through the main gate, set the left flank ablaze with Siphonarioi at the core, swiftly seized the left supply point, and forced LOS to turtle up at base. Outnumbered and outgunned, LOS just couldn’t hold the line—YB stormed the final push and took Game 1 with style.
Round 2 (LOS attack - YB defend, Hidden City)
YB came out swinging, repelling LOS’s attempt at the towers and forcing them toward the main gate. With a shorter supply line and numbers advantage, YB took small fights and then stalled on the walls. Even with LOS using trebuchets and terrain to inch up on Point A, YB’s relentless attrition wore them down. The timer expired with LOS never able to capture—the scoreboard reads 2-0 YB.
Round 3 (LOS attack - YB defend, Dasuo Fort)
The two teams locked horns at the middle gate, but YB’s artillery fire combined with tight Siphonarioi formations absolutely crushed LOS in the gate tunnel—first blood to YB. LOS regrouped and tried pushing left at the stairs, but YB split their forces to hit the flank, outnumbering them again. Time ticked away and LOS ran out of options—YB sweeps the series 3-0 and marches on!
 
Match 2: HF VS WSS [Hidden City / Wall Fort / Grasslands] 2-3
Round 1 (HF attack - WSS defend, Hidden City)
HF’s opening play was a bold charge up the right stairs, ambushing Point B while WSS pushed back up front. Using Siphonarioi in the main lane and distraction tactics on the right, HF snagged the right supply point, forcing WSS back. In a brutal B point brawl, WSS fended off the initial wave, but depleted their units and couldn’t hold base. HF claims Game 1!
Round 2 (WSS attack - HF defend, Hidden City)
WSS went for B off the rip but got sandwiched by HF flanking from the rear. A quick cavalry response let WSS steal the left supply point. As HF tried to retake B, WSS ambushed backup troops near the left crossroads, evening the numbers game. In the chaotic final base fight, WSS’s superior unit quality broke HF’s defense—game tied 1-1!
Round 3 (WSS attack - HF defend, Wall Fort)
WSS made their move at the shattered wall, but then turned to climb straight to Point A. In a nail-biter at the C supply point, WSS’s slick teamwork overpowered HF’s reinforcements, tipped the attrition battle their way, and forced HF back to base. WSS hit the defenders from behind with cavalry for the win—2-1 lead to WSS!
Round 4 (HF attack - WSS defend, Wall Fort)
A dicey start for WSS as their unit setup left them down almost 600 troops. HF massed up left of Point C, and when WSS’s forward push ignored the critical stair troops, HF steamrolled the fight, capped Point C, and surged for base. WSS tried to encircle with cav but got blocked—HF took the win and leveled it 2-2!
Round 5 (Grasslands)
HF wasted no time, capping B and C points right away and sending heroes to harass WSS’s base. WSS snatched B back, but HF had already built up an advantage. After several failed flanking assaults, WSS split their forces—diverted HF at C and sneaked into the base. With just 1:30 left on the clock, WSS flipped the capture and pulled off a stunning comeback to snatch the series and advance!

notes.title: CBL 2025: May 22nd Chinese Mainland & APAC Highlights
notes.content:
Chinese Mainland Region
 [previewyoutube=pg2_-KSLleo;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: QIN vs. ZT [Hidden City / Wall Fort] 1-3
Round 1 (QIN Defense - ZT Attack, Hidden City):
QIN started with a mass deployment of mobile units to harass outside the city. However, ZT predicted this move and countered effectively, turning it into a power shift. A major clash erupted at the right Supply Point where despite being outnumbered, QIN strategically rotated Shortsword & Shield Heroes at point B to stall ZT, holding on just enough to let the clock run out and securing a nail-biting win.
Round 2 (ZT Defense - QIN Attack, Hidden City):
ZT aggressively countered towers, delaying QIN's start. QIN made an attempt to capture the left Supply Point from the left wall but only held momentarily before ZT mounted a significant comeback. The battle shifted to the right Supply Point where QIN's supply lines broke, and ZT capitalized with flanking maneuvers, leveling the score.
Round 3 (QIN Attack - ZT Defense, Wall Fort):
At the C Supply Point, a cavalry skirmish ensued with QIN leveraging their attacker advantage to seize C. During the main base battle, ZT cleverly advanced while QIN regrouped, cutting QIN’s supplies from behind. QIN launched a heavy infantry push from the right, but ZT's cavalry kept breaking through, rapidly depleting QIN’s Heroes, and securing another win for ZT with targeted eliminations.
Round 4 (ZT Attack - QIN Defense, Wall Fort):
QIN's early harassment outside the city proved ineffective, hindering ZT's pace but at a cost of over a hundred units. Cavalry battles at C saw QIN holding the point but having their Supply Line blocked by ZT, causing serious logistical issues. In the main stronghold fight, QIN's Siphonarioi pushed forward but were decimated by ZT's cavalry, losing vital firepower, and collapsing under ZT’s pressure. ZT turned the tables with a 3-1 victory, advancing to the next stage.
 
APAC Region
 [previewyoutube=IN4KmYqcViA;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: PAE vs. OSS [Reginopolis / Wall Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (PAE Attack - OSS Defense, Reginopolis):
PAE faked some movements near the broken wall, then surged through the small gate at point C, capturing the rear Supply Point. The first clash saw PAE slightly disadvantaged, but OSS's broken supply lines left them unable to reinforce, allowing PAE to capture point C and pursue towards the main base. With a clever distraction at the front gate and a strong push from the side platform, PAE leveraged their superior unit deployment to seize the main base, taking the first round.
Round 2 (OSS Attack - PAE Defense, Reginopolis):
A skirmish erupted at the left Supply Point of point C, where OSS maintained control but struggled due to poor terrain positioning. PAE's Shenji Grenadiers gradually wore OSS down. A misstep at the front stairs of point C led to OSS's line breaking, and PAE pushed them down the stairs. Although OSS took the platform outside point C, their forces were too depleted to continue the assault, giving PAE their second win.
Round 3 (OSS Attack - PAE Defense, Wall Fort):
OSS launched an attack at the broken wall but coordination issues plagued them despite having a solid unit composition. PAE deftly utilized Artillery alongside Incendiary Archers to trigger Zykalian Militia's explosive chain reactions, allowing their cavalry to dominate the first engagement. In the battle for point C, PAE expertly executed a pincer movement: main forces clashed head-on from the left, while cavalry crashed through from the right, smashing OSS's remaining forces, and sealing the victory with a sweeping 3-0 advance.

notes.title: CBL 2025: May 18-EU&AMS Highlights
notes.content:
EU Region
[previewyoutube=HAi1FIXYXbE;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: LOS vs DL [Reginopolis / Hidden City] 3-0
Round 1 (LOS defends - DL attacks, Reginopolis)
LOS gave up A and B early, bunkering down around C and the supply point. The first clash erupted on the outer platform, where LOS’s Shenji Grenadiers and Incendiary Archers rained AoE havoc near the supply. DL breached through the broken wall but were boxed in and wiped out mid-stairs. Despite throwing bodies at the objective in desperation, the troop gap was too wide—LOS secured the hold and took Game 1.
Round 2 (DL defends - LOS attacks, Reginopolis)
DL tried a similar hold at C, but LOS brought the heat with infantry pressure from the side gate and a cavalry blitz at the front. DL lacked utility units and quickly lost C. In the final base clash, LOS climbed the side gate while DL charged out—only to be blasted by trebuchets and Shenji again. With no frontline to hold the line, DL crumbled. Another win for LOS.
Round 3 (DL defends - LOS attacks, Hidden City)
DL abandoned A and the right-side supply, LOS rolled in siege weapons at the main gate. DL pushed forward first, but LOS's Sunward Phalanx held firm and shattered the left flank. Grabbing the side supply and B point in one swoop, LOS forced DL into a split defense. DL snagged a few moments of glory, but their forces were spent. LOS closed in from the center and cleaned house—sweeping the series 3-0.
 
Match 2: YB vs DOGS [White Elk Fort / Dasuo Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (YB attacks - DOGS defends, White Elk Fort)
YB opened strong against DOGS’ cavalry at the center gate, crushing them with multi-angle charges. In the A point skirmish, DOGS tried trebuchets but their Siphonarioi were shredded by Shenji bombardment. YB took A and rolled straight into the base, claiming the high ground and an easy first win.
Round 2 (DOGS attacks - YB defends, White Elk Fort)
Small skirmishes sparked during the tower push. Once DOGS got on the wall, YB’s Siphonarioi slammed them in the narrow lane. DOGS circled to flank from the broken wall and captured the right supply, but as they tried to regroup, YB struck from the rear, turning the troop gap into a 500+ lead. Another dominant win.
Round 3 (DOGS attacks - YB defends, Dasuo Fort)
YB’s aggressive anti-tower tactics left DOGS wall-less. Forced to climb ladders and sneak units through the middle gate, DOGS ran into a fiery Siphonarioi defense. YB rotated fast, severing their advance routes. Time ran out, and the line never broke. A 3-0 sweep for YB.
 
 
AMS Region
[previewyoutube=-ng5tffbSRY;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: ZOD vs RAT [Heilung Fjord / White Elk Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (ZOD attacks - RAT defends, Heilung Fjord)
ZOD focused B point, clashing head-on in the first wave. Then, they unleashed a cavalry surge down the long path to B, while trebuchets pinned reinforcements. With a slim troop lead, ZOD kept up the pressure. RAT retreated to the base, but their flank trap was trampled by ZOD’s cavalry. Clean base capture—ZOD up 1-0.
Round 2 (RAT attacks - ZOD defends, Heilung Fjord)
RAT tried breaking through the broken wall near A, but ZOD pre-emptively pushed the slope and flanked from both sides, taking a 100+ troop lead. Siege fire from the C point square slowed RAT further. At the riverbank flag, ZOD used “Siphonarioi flames + cavalry flanks” to carve through the core. RAT’s forces collapsed. Another win.
Round 3 (RAT attacks - ZOD defends, White Elk Fort)
RAT slipped through the broken wall to grab the back supply, then pivoted to the left for a quick pick-off. ZOD, spotting RAT’s base formation was still incomplete, rushed forward to cut the troop line and pick off units piecemeal. They evened the numbers and took the supply near RAT’s base. In the final clash, RAT’s last wave crumbled, and ZOD locked the gate on a clean 3-0 sweep.
 
Match 2: COPE VS APM [Wall Fort / Dasuo Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (COPE defends - APM attacks, Wall Fort)
COPE gave up Points A and B without hesitation, consolidating forces around Point C and the nearby supply. They baited APM into overextending into the C supply, then collapsed from both front and flank, shredding their formation and gaining an early unit lead. APM tried a desperate cavalry rush, but with so many polearm units, their maneuvering was clunky at best. In the second clash at the C supply, COPE pulled the same move—surrender the point, then encircle and annihilate. APM barely held that fight but paid dearly in troops. Without enough reserve troops for a final push, time ran out, and COPE locked in Game 1.
Round 2 (APM defends - COPE attacks, Wall Fort)
APM tried a city gate garrison strategy with out-of-gate harassment, but COPE wasn’t biting. Instead, they massed on the left and rolled out a polearm wall—goodbye harassment plan. A brutal brawl broke out at Point A, where COPE’s Siphonarioi turned the fight into a bonfire. APM’s frontline melted. Seizing momentum, COPE split their units and charged Point C, pulling APM’s forces into a tug-of-war. In the final seconds, COPE snatched C and ran it straight into APM’s undefended base. Game 2—done and dusted.
Round 3 (APM defends - COPE attacks, Dasuo Fort)
APM stuck with their out-of-gate raids, but COPE was ready. Grouped and disciplined, they swatted the harassment aside, draining APM’s mobility troops for little gain. COPE pushed up to the central gate and ambushed APM’s scattered vanguard, quickly flipping the tempo. After securing Point A, the fight shifted to the stairs behind the second wall—classic meat grinder. With infantry soaking and trebuchets pounding, COPE ground their way forward. In the base showdown, COPE’s unit comp proved too much. They steamrolled APM’s heroes and crushed the core. A flawless 3-0 sweep—COPE storms into the next round.

notes.title: CBL2025 Global Conference Championship is coming soon!
notes.content:
Dear Warlords
The 2025 Conqueror's Blade League (CBL) is reaching its peak intensity! The regional knockout rounds are in full swing, with exciting battles you won't want to miss! This year's competition spans four major regions: Chinese Mainland, Asia Pacific, Europe, and Americas, gathering top teams worldwide to compete for specialized championship rewards and exclusive glory. The CBL champion and runner-up will ascend to higher stages of Conference Championship, so take a look at the competition rules!
 
I. CBL2025 Conference Championship Rules
[Highlights of the Conference Championship]
This competition introduces the cross-region confrontation mode, divided into two major battlefields: The Eastern and the Western:
Eastern Region: Brings together the strongest teams from Chinese Mainland (CN) and the Asia-Pacific region (APAC)
Western Region: Assembles top teams from Europe (EU) and the Americas (AMS)
[Participation Eligibility]
The champion and runner-up teams from each CBL region automatically earn the honor of representing their region. Special Reminder: In cases where a team withdraws due to special circumstances, replacements will be strictly based on regional rankings to ensure fairness.
[Core Competition Format]
Knockout Stage Setup:
[olist]

The first round and the final use a BO5 single-elimination format (including 4 siege battles and a potential field battle decider).

[/olist]
 
II. Conqueror's Blade International Champion Cup (CBIC) Rules
[Participation Eligibility and Rules]
The Conference Championship's champion and runner-up automatically qualify.
The BO5 single-elimination rule remains in use.
 
For more competition details, see the full competition rules: 
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YFQWehSWs6XdAe1C_6t9m_axDDfr51jyxmpW7XxB7TI/edit?usp=sharing

Limited-time server-wide display of customed champion team's photo in game

Upcoming Schedule

notes.title: May 18 Chinese Mainland & APAC Highlights
notes.content:
Chinese Mainland Region
[previewyoutube=Hs24hJyvJv4;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: TWT vs ZTPQ [Wall Fort / Heilung Fjord] 3-0
Round 1 (ZTPQ Attack - TWT Defense, Wall Fort)
TWT anchored their defense at Point C, baiting ZTPQ into the right-side supply. Suddenly, TWT unleashed a massive cavalry charge. ZTPQ, lacking anti-cavalry measures, was decimated. A second assault on the supply point met a similar fate—TWT's frontal pressure combined with flanking maneuvers shattered ZTPQ's forces. A textbook defense; TWT takes the first game.
Round 2 (TWT Attack - ZTPQ Defense, Wall Fort)
ZTPQ fortified Point C, but TWT advanced from Point B's staircase to the left high ground. ZTPQ attempted a pincer move but gained only a slight edge. TWT then launched a massive cavalry assault into the supply point, capturing Point C and pushing the battle to the base. With overwhelming artillery fire, TWT seized the base supply and, through relentless hero eliminations, secured a bloody victory. TWT leads 2-0.
Round 3 (TWT Attack - ZTPQ Defense, Heilung Fjord)
TWT executed a lightning assault: infantry cleared ZTPQ's troops at Point B, followed by cavalry striking Point A and looping back to B and the supply point. This wide maneuver encircled and crushed B's defenders. In the final moments, TWT chased down ZTPQ's retreating units, forcing a direct confrontation. ZTPQ, though victorious in battle, suffered heavy losses and couldn't hold the base. TWT sweeps the series 3-0.
 
APAC Region
[previewyoutube=gMikBjpWWWw;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: FGGG vs AMG [Reginopolis / White Elk Fort] 0-3
Round 1 (FGGG Attack - AMG Defense, Reginopolis)
AMG abandoned Points A and B to focus on defending Point C. FGGG attempted to draw them out by pressuring the left-side supply and rear supply points. AMG countered by pushing from the side gate, catching FGGG off-guard. Lacking frontline units, FGGG's Zykalian Militia were targeted by AMG's musket hero, causing chain explosions. Two failed assaults later, FGGG's forces were depleted. AMG claims the first victory.
Round 2 (AMG Attack - FGGG Defense, Reginopolis)
AMG capitalized on FGGG's overextension near Point A's rear supply, eliminating isolated units before capturing Point C. In the battle for the rear supply, AMG utilized wall breaches and the rear gate for flanking, eventually overwhelming the defenders. During the base fight, FGGG's encirclement strategy failed, leading to their forces being divided and defeated. AMG secures another win.
Round 3 (FGGG Defense - AMG Attack, White Elk Fort)
FGGG made a bold move, abandoning Point A to defend the base directly. Initial skirmishes in the upper-right corridor were evenly matched. However, AMG's superior artillery gradually eroded FGGG's defenses. With infantry advancing methodically and splitting FGGG's formation, AMG captured the base flag. A clean 3-0 sweep for AMG.
 
Match 2: NBY vs BOD [Harbour City / Reginopolis] 0-3
Round 1 (BOD Attack - NBY Defense, Harbour City)
After breaching the towers, NBY's mobile units ventured out but achieved little, eventually retreating to the base. Multiple skirmishes ensued near the base. BOD, while regrouping in the courtyard, was surrounded but managed to eliminate flanking units and counterattack. Though the first flag capture failed, BOD broke through the center and, after a tug-of-war, secured the base. First game to BOD.
Round 2 (NBY Attack - BOD Defense, Harbour City)
BOD delayed the opening, eventually conceding Point A and retreating to secondary defenses. Midfield skirmishes were frequent. NBY's initial assault on the base supply failed, prompting a central push. BOD's versatile unit composition balanced the losses. In the final clash, NBY's inferior unit quality and numbers led to their defeat. BOD takes a 2-0 lead.
Round 3 (NBY Attack - BOD Defense, Reginopolis)
NBY focused their attack on Point B, with diversions at Point A, gaining an early advantage. However, during the battle for Point C, their right-gate assault was blocked by BOD at the staircase and repelled by a combination of veteran and new artillery units. Although NBY later eliminated C's defenders, their attack on the supply point was thwarted by BOD's returning cavalry. Leveraging hero eliminations, BOD crushed NBY's heros and sealed a 3-0 victory.

notes.title: May 17 EU Highlights
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=AMgXz_-7X0k;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: HF vs UD [Dasuo Fort / Hidden City] 3-0
Round 1 (UD Attack - HF Defense, Dasuo Fort)
UD secured Point C and pulled back for resupply, but HF seized the moment, encircling and wiping out the attackers to even out troop losses. The two sides clashed again at the supply tunnel near the base. Despite trebuchet pressure, HF held strong, rallied their forces, and pushed back hard. Time ran out with UD still at bay—HF takes Game 1 with a solid hold.
Round 2 (HF Attack - UD Defense, Dasuo Fort)
UD stacked troops at Point A using the tower cover, but HF went straight through the center gate with artillery pressure. With trebuchets hammering down and superior units in tow, they cracked A wide open. In the final push down the main road, HF deployed Siphonarioi and cut off reinforcements with trebuchets, breaking UD’s last stand. Another point on the board for HF!
Round 3 (HF Attack - UD Defense, Hidden City)
UD clustered on the left tower, only to get smoked out by trebuchets. HF charged in, picking off the tail end of the retreat, gaining a slight edge in unit losses. UD made the classic mistake—splitting their forces. HF punished it hard, wiping out squads one by one. The gap widened, and UD’s base crumbled under pressure. HF locks in a clean 3-0 sweep to advance!
 
Match 2: RJ vs WSS [Reginopolis / Dasuo Fort / Grasslands] 2-3
Round 1 (RJ Attack - WSS Defense, Reginopolis)
RJ rolled up with heavy artillery and a frontline packed with Spartan Chosens. They stormed Point A, tearing through the defense and opening a 300-unit gap. At Point C, they brute-forced the push while Yanyuedao Cavalry broke the lines wide open. With a lead of 500+, WSS had no way back. RJ grabs the opener in style.
Round 2 (WSS Attack - RJ Defense, Reginopolis)
RJ gave up Points A and B, focusing all-in on C. A bloody brawl broke out at the top of the stairs. RJ, backed by artillery and superior numbers, held off the first wave. WSS regrouped and pressed through the short supply line, but RJ used Siphonarioi to torch the push and opened up another troop gap. RJ leads 2-0.
Round 3 (WSS Attack - RJ Defense, Dasuo Fort)
WSS’s first right-wall assault flopped, so they switched gears—countering RJ’s Spartan Chosens and combining utility units to scale the left wall. A single Spartan Chosen squad pulled off a backline flank and snatched Point A just before time ran out! After demolishing RJ’s elite units, they steamrolled B. Comeback on track—WSS gets a point!
Round 4 (RJ Attack - WSS Defense, Dasuo Fort)
WSS pulled off a textbook “cavalry maneuver” strat, swarming the map with hit-and-run riders. They shaved off 200 units and shattered RJ’s rhythm. At Point A, it was a gritty standoff. But WSS reinforced quicker and burned down the clock. Tie game! 2-2—bring on the decider.
Game 5 [Grasslands]
Cavalry clashed above Point B with both sides taking hits. WSS kept charging while RJ failed to counter the cavalry effectively. With RJ’s frontline infantry picked off, WSS launched a lightning raid on the base, speeding up the capture. RJ’s last-ditch push on B came up short—WSS completes the reverse sweep 3-2!

notes.title: May 11–12 APAC/EU/AMS Highlights
notes.content:
APAC  Region Highlights

[previewyoutube=f74uBEnlvg4;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: NBY VS DOC 【Kurak Castle】 0-2
Round 1 (NBY Attack - DOC Defense)
NBY kicked off with a standard push using Siege Towers, but DOC's artillery barrage stopped all but one. A frontal assault followed, inflicting heavy damage—but DOC’s respawns from nearby points held the line. NBY’s rooftop charge faltered as their lead Hero rushed in too deep, leaving the main force stuck in tight terrain and crushed under vertical pressure. Several final pushes to A Point came up short. Unit losses were even, but time ran out—DOC took the round.
Round 2 (DOC Attack - NBY Defense)
NBY opened with artillery pressure and launched a cavalry raid with Dagger-Axe Lancers, slicing down a hundred troops before retreating. DOC climbed the walls and executed a pincer strike on A Point, forcing NBY back to base. During DOC’s final assault, NBY unleashed a suicide squad of Heroes into the enemy backline—wiping out ranged units at the cost of every hero. The frontline countered hard, opening a 200-unit lead. DOC held firm, using Brace Weapons and Sunward Phalanx to grind down NBY’s cavalry. With key Heroes down, NBY crumbled. DOC sealed the comeback as the timer hit zero.
Match 2: PAE VS GCA 【Hidden City】 2-0
Round 1 (PAE Attack - GCA Defense)
PAE massed forces on the left flank and stormed A Point right after their Siege Tower hit the wall. Their main force and a flanking squad formed a deadly pincer. GCA’s right-side reinforcements were blocked by a Sunward Phalanx wall, and the core collapsed under pressure. PAE quickly captured both Supply Points and B Point, then rushed the base. GCA’s last stand couldn’t hold—PAE took the round in dominant form.
Round 2 (GCA Attack - PAE Defense)
PAE’s artillery couldn’t stop GCA’s climb, so they abandoned A Point to lure them in. GCA pushed for the right Supply Point but walked into a deadly ambush on the main road—troops mid-march were shredded, and the point flipped. PAE held the main gate and repelled several waves. Near the end, their cavalry stormed out and wiped the last of GCA’s troops. Out of units and options, GCA fell hard—PAE swept into the next round.
Match 3: OSS VS FGGG 【White Elk Fort】 2-0
Round 1 (OSS Attack - FGGG Defense)
OSS scaled the walls and opened fire, pinning down FGGG with artillery pressure. Their right-flank strike team charged through the horse path and took A Point fast. FGGG tried to retake it, but OSS dug in and—backed by the Lionroar Crew—crushed the defenders. A push to expand collapsed mid-fight, but OSS regrouped and split forces to outmaneuver FGGG’s terrain defense. With overwhelming numbers, OSS secured the win.
Round 2 (FGGG Attack - OSS Defense)
FGGG opened strong, taking the high ground and bombarding OSS. Their right-flank strike hit A Point while ranged troops pressured the left. OSS fell back to base, then used the terrain advantage to repel the first wave. With both sides neck and neck, FGGG’s distant spawn points slowed their reinforcements. OSS dragged the fight to the buzzer and held for the win.
Match 4: VNH VS NMAD 【Wall Fort】 2-0
Round 1 (VNH Attack - NMAD Defense)
NMAD blew the inner bridge and shelled VNH’s Siege Towers. After a bloody struggle, VNH captured A Point and stormed the city via the right horse path, taking the C supply point. NMAD tried to regroup but got caught in alley ambushes—VNH closed from both sides and broke their core. With two minutes left, VNH made a final push to C Point, capturing it in the last 30 seconds, then struck the base as NMAD’s Heroes were down.
Round 2 (NMAD Attack - VNH Defense)
NMAD blasted through A Point’s wall and quickly captured A and B. But their final push toward C crashed into a fortified VNH defense. A brutal fight broke out—VNH held strong, then countered with cavalry. With NMAD’s Brace Weapons depleted, the Dagger-Axe Lancers trampled the survivors. NMAD’s last-ditch push at 150 seconds failed—VNH finished with a cavalry sweep to lock the win.
 
 
EU Region Highlights
[previewyoutube=4dqYjEMfZ1Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Match 1: UD VS WLD [Dasuo Fort] 2-1
Round 1 (UD Attack - WLD Defence)
UD’s tower push stalled early. Switching to mid-gate assault, they were crushed by WLD’s functional units and a decisive Yanyuedao Cavalry charge. When UD went for A, WLD boldly pushed up to the right wall, using the height to shut down UD’s trebuchets and cripple their offensive. WLD locked in the first win.
Round 2 (WLD Attack - UD Defence)
WLD’s initial tower advance failed. They tried scaling the left stairs from mid-gate, but UD collapsed on them from front and right, wiping the squad. Once towers breached, WLD flanked A from both sides—but UD baited them in, counter-surrounded inside the flag zone, and shredded their Units. Score tied.
Round 3 [Grasslands]
WLD took B first, but UD regrouped with Siphonarioi and superior numbers, retaking B and bleeding WLD out. As WLD tried rotating between B and C, UD held strong with sharp rotations and zone control. With more points under control, UD secured the reverse sweep to take the win 2-1.
Match 2: DL VS HF [Wall Fort] 2-0
Round 1 (DL Attack - HF Defence)
HF disrupted DL hard at the outer gate with heavy Unit pressure, breaking their early rhythm. DL adapted with counter-raids to even the losses. At C point, DL caught HF slipping out of the mid-gate and punished their reinforcements from the right stairs. With slow attrition and smart positioning, DL took the first round.
Round 2 (HF Attack - DL Defence)
HF ditched the Siege Towers and charged the breach, only to get sandwiched by DL and pushed back outside. They rushed C Supply too soon, and DL shut them down mid-deploy. With HF’s army drained and regrouping too slow, DL held firm and claimed a clean 2-0 advance.
Match 3: LOS VS FOW [Harbour City] 2-0
Round 1 (LOS Defence - FOW Attack)
LOS went aggressive from the start, flanking through the side gate to trap FOW’s center lane force. FOW never recovered. Their push up the A-point right ladder was countered and crushed. LOS held strong, taking the round with style.
Round 2 (FOW Defence - LOS Attack)
FOW gave up A and the Supply Point, turtling around the Base. LOS swept the lower half, then launched wave after wave on the Base Supply. Though one wave was pushed back, LOS had already torn through FOW’s core Units. Final push: clean victory. LOS dominates with a 2-0 sweep.
 
AMS Region Highlights
[previewyoutube=fpc0efRwxzk;full][/previewyoutube]

Match 1: RAT VS SHRK [Hidden City] 2-0
Round 1 (SHRK Defence- RAT Attack)
SHRK’s counter the Siege Tower failed, so they gambled on a forward raid—but RAT saw it coming. As SHRK’s Units clogged the gate, RAT dropped stone shots to cut off retreat, then sealed the gate with infantry, charging in to claim the left Supply Point. The clash at the Supply went RAT’s way: with “endless ammo” Siphonarioi holding firm and Dagger-Axe Lancers circling through mid-gate, SHRK’s reinforcements were wiped out. RAT chased them deep, even pressuring the Base’s left corridor. In the final stand at the Base archway, RAT baited a push and slammed SHRK from both ends with cavalry charges. Flawless execution—first round to RAT.
Round 2 (SHRK Attack - RAT Defence)
SHRK pushed up despite having only one Siege Tower. RAT responded with a brutal pincer, throwing them off the wall. At point B, SHRK dropped from the left stairs but got pinned at the stairwell—frontline Units crumbled to cavalry flanks, while their rear assault force was intercepted by RAT’s rotated cav. SHRK’s formation broke down completely. No regroup, no recovery—RAT takes two in a row to seal the series.

notes.title: CBL: May 16 Highlights
notes.content:
Chinese Mainland Region
[previewyoutube=nRUyGF3wp24;full][/previewyoutube]
ZT vs. KZ [Harbour City] 3-0
Round 1 (ZT Attack - KZ Defense, Harbour City)
ZT quickly identified KZ stacking heavily behind the right Supply Point. Reacting fast, ZT maneuvered most of their troops through the small gate to the left Supply Point, seizing the right Supply Point while KZ was busy repositioning. Engaging in a cannon battle at the middle gate, they drew KZ into a premature advance. Despite KZ's attempts at a three-pronged surround, ZT's structured counterattack led to minimal losses, creating a nearly 400-unit advantage. They steamrolled the main camp, clinching the first victory.
Round 2 (KZ Attack - ZT Defense, Harbour City)
KZ made their move using the right staircase as a pivot, deploying Siphonarioi and Zykalian Militia to pressure ZT. However, ZT maintained control of the battle beneath the staircase, using Incendiary Archers to trigger chain explosions among enemy units and steadily push back. A misstep from KZ at the middle gate led to isolated units being easily picked off by ZT. Another defeat followed for KZ as they failed to rebuild.
Round 3 (KZ Attack - ZT Defense, Harbour City)
Frustrated by tower progress, KZ shifted to advance through the small gate but neglected anti-cavalry strategies. ZT's cavalry capitalized, repeatedly breaking the formations of KZ's first wave. When KZ attempted to seize the right Supply Point from the middle gate, ZT abandoned the supply skirmish to dismantle KZ’s main forces first. This strategy forced a breakdown in KZ's unit lines, allowing ZT to pick them apart. ZT rolled over KZ with a decisive 3-0 sweep, advancing to the next stage.
APAC Region
[previewyoutube=j_8kGDrp1I8;full][/previewyoutube]
OSS vs. VNH [White Elk Fort / Wall Fort] 3-0
Round 1 (VNH Attack - OSS Defense, White Elk Fort)
VNH kicked off with a versatile unit combo but stretched their lines too thin, weakening their frontline presence. At point A, OSS used the Lionroar Crew to deliver long-range, angled heavy fire. VNH managed to capture point A but paid dearly for it. In the main camp skirmish, VNH's lack of manpower led to a failed two-front battle as OSS strategically allowed them in before wiping them out. Loss for VNH.
Round 2 (OSS Attack - VNH Defense, White Elk Fort)
OSS launched an artillery offensive, pushing VNH back to secondary lines and swiftly seized point A. They then stormed towards the main camp. VNH attempted a flanking maneuver but was divided and conquered by OSS, who seized the geographical upper hand. OSS Heroes fearlessly broke reinforcement lines, leading to VNH's defense crumbling under poor unit composition, giving OSS another win.
Round 3 (OSS Attack - VNH Defense, Wall Fort)
OSS bombarded the C Supply Point from Point A's walls, forcing VNH to retreat and bolster their defenses at Point C. During the initial clash, OSS progressed to Point C but faced counter-attacks by VNH cavalry. The struggle ensued, but OSS leveraged their superior numbers to secure the point. Early in the main camp battle, OSS's deployment faults left them vulnerable but they swiftly reorganized, capturing the main camp and sealing their victory with a 3-0 triumph.

notes.title: May 15th Chinese Mainland/APAC Regional Knockout Stage Highlights
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=H3Tzhrf5BE4;full][/previewyoutube]
Chinese Mainland Region
Match: QIN VS YZY | [Heilung Fjord / White Elk Fort] | 3-0
Round 1 (QIN Attack - YZY Defense, Heilung Fjord)
QIN launched a full-force assault on Point A, blending a frontal infantry push with a flanking cavalry sweep. Inside the point, they steadily tightened the pressure. When both sides clashed in a cavalry duel, QIN’s anti-cav unit setup gave them the edge, gradually widening the unit loss gap. They then maneuvered to the backline Supply Point at C, seized the terrain advantage, and wore down YZY through relentless poking and zone control. Clean win for QIN in the opener.

But QIN spotted a split in their forces—countered hard on the left with heavy units, stalled them on the right using their own Siphonarioi formation, then converged for a full-on push to retake control. YZY did manage a brief back-cap of C, but QIN crushed the bait force on the left and swung back through the flank near main base, securing the win through smart composition and map control.
Round 3 (YZY Attack - QIN Defense, White Elk Fort)
YZY breached the right wall, rotated from right supply to left, aiming to cut off QIN’s reinforcements. But QIN’s Hero led a cavalry charge straight from base into YZY’s rear, throwing their formation into chaos. With two minutes left, YZY went all-in on A from the left—but QIN struck from both flanks, collapsing YZY’s line and turning the tide. QIN locked down every point, sweeping the series 3-0 to punch their ticket to the next stage.
APAC Region
Match: PAE VS DOC | [Heilung Fjord] | 3-0
Round 1 (PAE Attack - DOC Defense, Heilung Fjord)
PAE pulled a classic bait at Point B, drawing out DOC’s main force, then snapped hard onto A in a surprise strike. Catching DOC’s Units out of position and low on stamina, they quickly secured the point and surged ahead with a 300-unit lead. In the brawl for the rear Supply Point at C, PAE steamrolled through with sheer numbers and quality, smashing DOC’s backline and locking in the first win.
Round 2 (DOC Attack - PAE Defense, Heilung Fjord)
DOC tried a synchronized A-B double push, but PAE read the play. They gave up A without hesitation, collapsed on DOC’s mobile force at B, then pounced on their isolated core. In the skirmish to the right of B, PAE chipped away with utility Units and wiped out all of DOC’s Heroes, growing their lead and claiming another dominant round.
Round 3 (DOC Attack - PAE Defense, Heilung Fjord)
DOC rushed A with their full squad, ignoring the trap—PAE’s shield and spear Units lying in wait near the courtyard. From the rear, PAE cut off DOC’s formation, encircled the A-point attackers, and wiped them out clean. At B, it was textbook execution—soften with functional Units, then let the cavalry sweep up the frontliners. PAE seals the sweep 3-0 and powers into the next stage.

notes.title: APAC Day 10 – Highlight Recap
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FijH9o8tj8Q;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Match 1: HBB vs OSS
Map: Heilung Fjord
Score: 1-2
Round 1 (HBB Attack – OSS Defense)
HBB kicked off with a double-pronged assault—main force drawing fire at A while a 5-man elite squad snuck through the broken wall near B. OSS split too thin, and HBB capitalized with a pincer strike to steamroll Point A, B and C in record time.
The sneaky squad pushed all the way to the Base through the left path, drawing OSS back. HBB dropped Mortars on C Supply and decimated the defenders—gaining over 200 in Unit advantage.
They closed it out with a Sunward Phalanx and Dagger-Axe Lancers combo—OSS couldn’t hold. 1-0 for HBB!
Round 2 (OSS Attack – HBB Defense)
OSS went full force at A, with Imperial Spear Guards, Sunward Phalanx, and Siphonarioi leading the charge. Lionroar Crew and Zykalian Militia lit up the field with a deadly crossfire.
HBB split to flank but left A too thin. OSS shredded them and swept ABC. HBB fell back to defend C Supply but got hammered by Mortars before a full-on assault broke through.
Though HBB managed a surprise Cavalry raid to delay the Base push, the main force was gutted. OSS regrouped with Dagger-Axe Lancers and Camel Lancers, bulldozed the Base, and tied the series 1-1!
Round 3 (HBB Attack – OSS Defense)
Map: Grasslands
OSS stormed Point C early and secured A, leaving B open. HBB took B and pushed to reclaim C through a brutal brawl.
OSS then snatched B back and pressured C nonstop, locking HBB into a corner.
With 2 minutes to go, OSS launched a focused assault on C. HBB’s Heroes dropped one by one, and OSS took all three points under control, triggering a fast-point drain.
OSS completes the comeback—2-1 reverse sweep!
 
Match 2: BOD vs MMMD
Map: Harbour City
Score: 2-0
Round 1 (BOD Attack – MMMD Defense)
MMMD opened with a sneaky Companion Cavalry raid through the left gate and Hwarang bowfire from the walls.
BOD adapted fast—neutralized the Cavalry, then sent flanking squads over the right wall to seize A.
While BOD pushed for A Supply, MMMD countered with a Dagger-Axe Lancers sandwich. The brawl was brutal.
MMMD baited a retreat to the Base, but BOD’s Trebuchets rained pain and secured a narrow win. MMMD’s Heroes were nearly all dead, and the defense collapsed. 1-0 to BOD.
Round 2 (MMMD Attack – BOD Defense)
MMMD split their forces—main push through the left gate to tie up BOD’s defenders, while a small squad went straight for A. They took A, set up Artillery, and forced BOD back to A Supply.
Going for a Base Supply and Base double push, they misfired a Trebuchet and walked into a BOD counterstrike—total wipe.
MMMD regrouped and took Base Supply again, but got overrun before they could dig in. With a nearly 400-Unit deficit, BOD went on the hunt, crushing scattered MMMD squads.
Time ran out, MMMD couldn’t recover—BOD sweeps the series 2-0!

Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:
APAC: May 15, 14:00-17:00 (UTC+8).
EU/AMS: May 15, 7:00-10:00 (UTC+1).
The maintenance is expected to last for 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *8000, Honor *300, and Unit Medal *15 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. 
The update will contain the following:
 
I. Events
1. The All or Nothing Event Series Returns with New Challenges and Free Appearance Rewards!
Not a fan of tough fights? Stick with the basic rewards. Feeling bold? Go for the big prizes! The greater the challenge, the greater the glory! Accept the Champion’s Challenge, complete All or Nothing quests to earn [Proof of Hope] and [Proof of Courage], and win limited-time titles, frames, epic equipment schematics, and more!
Details：
(1) Warlords can participate in the challenge via [O] - [Activities] page. Only one quest can be accepted and completed per day.
(2) The event offers two difficulty options: [Normal] and [Hard]. Accepting a quest consumes 10 or 20 [Proof of Hope] based on the difficulty. Completing the normal quest grants 30 [Proof of Hope], while the hard task grants 60 [Proof of Hope] and 1 [Proof of Courage].
(3) If a quest is not completed, the consumed [Proof of Hope] will not be refunded. Quests will be force-refreshed at 00:00 server time each day. Unclaimed rewards will not be retained.
(4) [Proof of Hope] and [Proof of Courage] can be exchanged for rich rewards in the [O] - [Champion Vault].

Season Weapon Attire Selection Box
Epic Hero Schematic Selection Box
Treatise
