notes.title: [Wargames Fest] | Attire Showcase
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords,
The fierce Wargames Fest is approaching -- and so are your cool battle-ready attires!
 
Get ready for the debut of [Dragon Slayer], the exclusive set for the Spartan Chosen; the brand-new legendary Shield & Spear attire [Curse of Cadmus]; and the limited-time return of the hero attire [Evolving Divine Attires: Olympus Gods]

[previewyoutube=IatE6uy85do;full][/previewyoutube]
Spartan Chosen Exclusive Attire: [Dragon Slayer]
During the Battle of Thermopylae, 300 Spartan warriors stood against the vast Persian army, forming a wall of flesh and steel.
Even when faced with fiercest dragons, these warriors will not falter -- they rise, fearless and unyielding, until the beast is brought to its knees.
We will introduce you the exclusive attire: Spartan Chosen - Dragon Slayer:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/68470c6df9e9fff726df55a4753152f0c6de1467.jpg 
Design Concept:
Only those Spartan warriors tempered in blood and fire earn the title of Dragon Slayer.
The draconic crests emblazoned upon their armor and shields symbolize both their valor and indomitable spirit.
Remember this: when moonlight kissed their crimson spearpoints, they became the eternal silver flame illuminating the pass at Thermopylae.
 
Legendary Shield & Spear Attire: [Scourge of Cadmus]
The highly anticipated Shield & Spear attire has finally arrived! This meticulously designed set is not only a visual breakthrough but also a stunning fusion of myth and might.
 
Inspired by Cadmus, the legendary dragonslayer and founder of Thebes, this set incorporates dragon motifs in every detail. When equipped, dynamic dragon wings unfurl from the flanks of the shield and spear, moving fluidly with the wearer’s motion -- bringing the weaponry to life.
 
At its peak, a dragon's head emerges from the spear’s tip, unleashing flames in a blaze of fury. This awe-inspiring spectacle ignites the battlefield and strikes terror into the hearts of your enemies, heralding your arrival with the power of dragon.
 
Every scale, every ember has been refined to perfection. From the intricate textures of the dragonhide to the immersive flame effects, this attire offers an unmatched visual and combat experience -- guaranteed to make you the center of every battlefield.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cfba16b6ac0f4e32a66fe415c714dd0bbba7f810.jpg
 
Appearance Description:
"The Oracle Declares: Cadmus shall become a mighty dragon, leading a foreign horde to ravage the Aegean realms."
O Cadmus, Dragon Slayer, first king of Thebes! Yet mortals cannot escape divine machinations. When he severed the head of Ares' dragon son, calamity was sealed. The hero became the enemy of heroes, his soul cursed to wander eternally, barred from the Underworld...
Cadmus' fate remains shrouded. Some claim he wielded the dragon's skull as his shield and horn as his spear, his essence merging with the shield as a watchful eye—a silent vow to the gods: Cadmus will have his vengeance.
 
Lore Reference:
Cadmus is a figure from Greek mythology, the founder of Thebes and grandfather of Dionysus. One of his feats was slaying the dragonic son of Ares; from where its teeth fell, warriors sprang forth. In many tales, Cadmus is cursed later in life or voluntarily transforms into a serpent.
The excerpt featured in the appearance description is inspired by the final lines of The Bacchae, a tragedy by the ancient Greek playwright Euripides.
 
Original excerpt:u
  CADMUS:
  Child, we’ve stumbled into this disaster, this terrible calamity—you and me, both in agony—your sisters, too. So I’ll go out to the barbarians, a foreign resident in my old age. And then for me there’s that oracle which says I’ll lead a mixed barbarian force back into Greece. And I’ll bring here with me Harmonia, Ares’ daughter, my wife. I’ll have the savage nature of a snake, as I lead my soldiers to the altars, to the tombs, in Greece. But even then, there’ll be no end to my wretched sorrows. I’ll never sail the downward plunging Acheron and reach some final peace.
 
The Bacchae tells the tragic tale of one of Cadmus’ grandsons, who shows irreverence toward Dionysus. As punishment, Dionysus manipulates the fate of Cadmus’ entire bloodline -- his grandson meets a brutal end, and Cadmus himself receives a dreadful prophecy.
 
This story is an artistic fusion of various legends, with a twist: Cadmus chooses defiance over fate.
 
[Evolving Divine Attires: Olympus Gods] Attire Chest Limited-Time Return
The light of Olympus shines once more. The will of the War God burns bright. Fate shall be reshaped by divine might. [Evolving Divine Attires: Olympus Gods] returns for a limited time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e9352fb2a458cc8bc7a76a9832339bf68c48fff3.jpg

notes.title: 2025 CBL Competition Rule Revisions and Supplementary Explanation
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, during the competition's point race stage, we have received many feedback and suggestions. As appreciation for all your valuable suggestions, we will provide additional rewards to all players who successfully form a team and complete the registration (rewards will be sent to the official server registration account within 7 working days, please check your mail).
 
After discussion, the competition organizers have decided to make the following revisions and supplementary explanations to the [2025CBL Competition Rule]:
The Supplementary Explanation and Revision On The Competition Rule
Regarding the supplementary explanation and revision on the rules:"Section III: CBL Registration and Eligibility" - "Team Eligibility"-"If a team member's official server character receives a ban or mute during the competition, the affected player will be disqualified. The team remains eligible to continue competing."
 
Revise the original rule "If a team member's official server character receives a ban or mute during the competition, the affected player will be disqualified. The team remains eligible to continue competing." to "If a team member's official server account is banned for any reason (including severe speech violations) during the competition, the affected player will be disqualified. The team remains eligible to continue competing."
 
Due to the rule revision, the leaders of the teams that have already advanced will now be allowed to replace team members during the specified period to ensure the team can continue to participate in subsequent matches if some members are affected by the previous mute rule. The specific rules are as follows:
Teams can not replace the team leader, only team members. The maximum number of replacements is 5 (up to 5 members).
 
The team leader can submit a replacement request within the player admin-established group (QQ/Discord) to the player admin. The player admin will notify the group of which admin is responsible.
 
If you have not yet joined the player admin-established group, please contact the relevant player admin.
Player Admin Contact Information:
 
Chinese Mainland
QQ：583907572 / 359961303 
Discord：CBL-saya
APAC
QQ：583907572 / 359961303 
Discord：CBL-saya / Paladinx
EU/AMS：
Discord：BruderRidda / Cool01
 
The submission period for team member replacement requests is as follows:
[olist]

Chinese Mainland and Asia-Pacific: April 22, 2025, 18:00 (UTC+8) – April 23, 2025, 17:59 (UTC+8)

Europe and Americas: April 22, 2025, 12:00 (CET/UTC+1) – April 23, 2025, 11:59 (CET/UTC+1)

[/olist]
Note: The team leader must submit the replacement request within the specified time. If the request is not submitted by the deadline, the original team roster will remain unchanged.
 
Supplementary Explanation: The previously published rules regarding this matter, discussed by the competition organizing committee, may not fully address the issue where some players are unable to participate in subsequent matches due to being muted. Therefore, from the start of this announcement, the rules outlined in the [Section III: CBL Registration and Eligibility] - [Team Eligibility] will follow this announcement.
The previously published rules in the community are now void. The content of those rules is as follows:
"Clarification on Mute Standards:
1.Players will not be disqualified for short-term mutes. However, severe speech violations will result in disqualification and forfeiture of all rewards.
Severe speech violations include: Mutes lasting more than 15 days. Violations such as "offensive remarks about a country or region," "racist remarks," "selling cheats," "malicious insults with wide impact," and "repeated or frequent violations" will result in severe speech violations.
Short-term mutes: Mutes lasting 1-15 days. Violations such as "general inappropriate comments" and "mild insults" will result in short-term mutes."

At the edge of the Silla, the snowland lies perpetually shrouded in blizzards. Once a sacred land for monks, it now burns with war. Temple bells have fallen silent, villages lie in ruins, and only the clash of steel echoes across the bloodstained snow.
 
Map Intro:
Mode: 15v15 Field Battles
Rules: Central Objectives: Three contested points along the midline. Both sides have a camp.
Control more than two points to unlock the enemy camp for a limited time. Capturing the camp drastically reduces enemy points.
At the end of the countdown, the side with higher remaining points wins. If tied, the side holding more objectives claims victory.
 
Special Mechanics:
Snowland Guards: As the match progresses, Snowland Guards and warhorses spawn randomly across the map. Defeating Snowland Guard allows players to interact with nearby warhorses, summoning a warhorse herd to join the battle. Warhorse Herd: Warhorse herd follow the summoning hero and can be ordered to charge using specific commands. Once charging begins, the warhorses becomes uncontrollable.
Acceleration Bonfires: Multiple acceleration bonfires are scattered near the ridges on both sides of the battlefield. Characters entering their range gain a movement speed buff lasting several seconds after leaving the bonfire's area.

Open time: April 2 (after maintenance) - April 17 (before maintenance). Available for limited time daily.

notes.title: New Mechanics in Seasonal Map Snowland — Frostborn Horse Herd
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlord!
A new snowy battlefield has arrived: Snowland of Silla, featuring brand-new mechanics!
 
On Silla's frozen border, endless blizzards veil a land once known for peace. Villages now lie in ruins, their stories etched into icy rubble. Warhorses carve paths through crimson snow, their riders locked in unending battle.
 
Snowland Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f048d993bbd071e8e7ac996ba742552c7e33818d.jpg
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0f6125ae8ad65d4e95d47298797424fc0fdceae6.jpg

Point Layout
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8ccf6a24068d6fb3f1f7c184a4be4e4e480015f7.jpg


New Mechanics
Snowland Guards
Snowland Guards and warhorses will spawn at random locations as the match progresses. Defeating Snowland Guards allows you to interact with a nearby warhorse and summon a warhorse herd to fight alongside you.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3b1c332efb3d44aa5c7c279e45fe599692b395dc.jpg

Warhorse Herd
Once summoned, the warhorse herd will follow your hero. You can activate a charge command (hotkey) for an unstoppable assault and lose control on them post-charge.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/765933db63333c338f0e0b8cf690c27430b914ab.jpg

Speed Bonfires
Bonfires placed near both ridgelines grant a movement speed boost to any hero entering the area. The buff lasts for several seconds even after leaving the bonfire’s circle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b6e835fda4fba987e58ee2013f08e26ffcbec31e.jpg
 
Pro Tips
Secure B-Point First – Central control boosts map dominance.
Flank via Forests – Use terrain for ambushes/rotations.
Bonfire Sprint – Boost ridge allies for rapid camp pushes.
Herd Raid – Trigger charges to disrupt enemy formations.
Steal Warhorses – Ambush foes attacking Snowland Guards for free warhorses.
 
The snow demands conquest. Will you answer the call, Warlord?

notes.title: Territory War Rules Adjustment Notice
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,

In Season XXII, we will be making adjustments to the territory war rules to create a fairer and more dynamic world ecosystem.
 
Rules of War Declaration: Giving the Right to the Houses Who Need It
We have received feedback about "slotblocking": "Some houses declare war on fiefs but never actually fight. They don’t participate in territory war yet block our fronts."
Our observations show that some of the most impactful "slotblocking" behaviors come from houses and alliances that have little prestige but have accumulated large amounts of reputation. In the mid-to-late stages of the season, they utilize the reputation system at a low cost, significantly disrupting normal territory war participation. To address this, we are adjusting the war declaration requirements to filter out passive competitors who misuse the reputation system while ensuring other houses/alliances can still engage in diplomacy and strategic planning.
 
Starting from Season XXII, the new war declaration requirements will be:
  Declaring war on a city requires house prestige ≥ 150
  Declaring war on a fort requires house prestige ≥ 200
(Declaring war on villages is not subject to these restrictions.)
Expected Implementation: March 27 (After maintenance）
 
In the near future, prestige will become more deeply integrated with reputation, war declarations, and other mechanics. Warlords, expand your territories and prepare for the battles ahead!
 
Level 1 Villages: A Growth Buffer
Newly established houses have raised concerns about attacking level 1 villages: Fighting territory war for a level 1 village is just a slow battle of attrition—there’s no room for surprise tactics! This makes it frustrating!
After careful consideration, we believe that new houses need a phase for training and adaptation—using level 1 villages to establish a foundation and gain combat experience. To support this, we will slightly reduce the initial difficulty to better align with the needs of houses at different stages.
 
For level 1 villages, the number of default defence garrisons will be reduced. Expected Implementation: March 20 (After maintenance）
 
In the future, optimizing the fief defence system will be a key focus. Garrisons will become smarter and more flexible, while higher-tier fiefs will introduce more diverse defence mechanics.
 
Elite Showdown: A Testing Ground for Tactical Diversity
We've received positive feedback from small and mid-sized houses regarding Warrior Showdown: "The rules of Warrior Showdown give smaller houses a real sense of presence." We will continue refining Warrior Showdown mechanics to provide small and mid-sized houses with more opportunities to showcase their elite combat capabilities.
This Season, the Warrior Showdown system will remain in place for battles at Forts.
We aim to gather more data and feedback over a full cycle to determine whether this system should be expanded to other types of fief battles in the future.
Our vision is to make the activation of Warrior Showdown a strategic alliance right, allowing one of the warring sides to decide whether to enable the system.
 
Encyclopedia: Your Trusted Guide
New warlords often ask fundamental questions such as:"Why is my Food gone?", "Why can’t I move?" and "How do I resupply Food?"; Some warlords also struggle with territory war mechanics, causing them to withdraw from battles, while misunderstandings of attack and defense rules sometimes lead to disputes over fief ownership. To address these issues, we are introducing the Encyclopedia, a system designed to help all warlords better understand the world and territory war mechanics.
 
The Encyclopedia will cover basic rules and advanced strategies for territory war. Expected Implementation: Mid-to-late Season XXII
 
This system aims to help new warlords get up to speed quickly, learn world mechanics, and engage more effectively in territory war. In the future, the Encyclopedia will expand to include topics such as weapon combos and advanced units tactics.
Marching Optimization: Less Frustration, More Strategy
Many warlords have voiced concerns about navigation: "Crossing the sea feels like navigating a maze—I don’t know where to go!"
 
We found that some warlords struggle with territory war because of difficulties understanding navigation, while naval routes add extra complexity for newcomers. Our goal is to improve auto-pathing so that warlords can focus on strategic battles instead of getting lost.
 
We are currently optimizing the auto-pathing system for seamless navigation between city interiors and exteriors.
Expected Implementation: Mid Season XXII
Final Thoughts
We remain committed to improving territory war declaration rules and refining the world experience to make game mechanics clearer and combat smoother. Our goal is to ensure that veterans have room for mastery while newcomers can quickly adapt—so that all warlords can enjoy an exciting and rewarding territory war experience!
We look forward to meeting you on the battlefield!
   Conqueror’s Blade Develop Team

notes.title: [Silla] Season Update Log
notes.content:
I. Seasonal Unit
3-Star Unit: Silla Guards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4e818bc8f23173f000dd55195fbfc77ae9597f88.jpg

Background:


Forged from Silla's spear-bearing phalanx tactics, the Silla Guards became a formidable force across the land. Wielding rectangular shields and long spears, this unit dominated battlefields with their signature shield throw tactic. This battle-hardened unit gained distinction through over a decade of fierce engagements.

Combat Style:


The Silla Guards are an elite national defense force armed with square shields and long spears. They can use their shields for effective ranged defense when setting up brace formations and throw them to stun enemies in close combat. Coordinating with allies, they enhance melee engagement efficiency—holding firm to secure their lines or advancing to break enemy formations. They also leverage the reach of their spears, delivering powerful strikes to repel melee infantry units, making them invaluable for choke-point defense and team advancement.

Unit Characteristics：


A polearm infantry unit clad in heavy black armor, offering balanced attack and defense.

Utilizes shields for defensive duties, providing better coordination for both defense and offensive pushes.

Well-timed shield throws and spear strikes maximize their reach advantage.

Skill Design：
Skill 1 Shield Throw: Throws shields at enemies, slightly extending attack range beyond the spear, dealing blunt damage. The shield is destroyed upon impact.
Skill 2 Spear Slam: Strikes targets with a spear to prevent enemy units from closing in. If the shield is destroyed, an additional attack is performed.
 
4-Star Unit: Tiger Fists

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/936ee9b1497268a6a749b19fed7a7884b46cd8c0.jpg

Background:


Silla had a martial art passed down among the people, granting those who mastered it the ability to subdue tigers even barehanded. Masters of this art often lived in seclusion within the mountains, only emerging to serve their country in times of war. Yet, after victory, they sought no reward, returning to the mountains. The world revered them as the Tiger Fists.

Combat Style:


The Tiger Fists do not rely on weapons in battle. Through years of rigorous training, their bare fists alone are enough to subdue even the fiercest tiger. Their punches were capable of splitting stones. Their momentum is unstoppable. They excel at breaking enemy formations with powerful charges and strikes, yet their resilience allows them to remain steadfast despite enemy assaults.

Unit Characteristics：


Masters of close-quarters combat, entering the battlefield at the right moment to destroy enemies.

Their skills can deal massive damage and exert control over enemies in crowded fights.

Their formidable physique and unyielding will reduce incoming damage and grant resistance to certain control effects.

Skill Design：


Skill 1 Courage Charge: Charges forward in a short burst, ignoring control effects. The charge also ignores block and knocks down enemies.

Skill 2 Tiger’s Fury: Swiftly closes in on a target and unleashes a two-round punch combo.

Skill 3 Mighty Slap: The next attack is a powerful, fully-charged palm strike with high block-breaking capability, knocking back enemies upon impact.

 
5-Star Unit: Hwarang

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa2cc827c4c60834b6435bbdfa24a1c2da8a7355.jpg

Background:


The King of Silla selected noble youths of distinguished lineage, instructing them in the classics, training them in archery, and adorning them in elegant attire. Ever at the King’s side, they were known as the Hwarang—elite warriors who followed their ruler into battle, their arrows never missing their target, earning them the title of the nation’s finest.

Combat Style:


These noble youths from Silla are anything but sheltered aristocrats. Armed with bows, they are masters of archery, using their agility and keen adaptability to navigate ever-changing battlefields. They can convert damage dealt into health, enhancing their survivability in battles. Additionally, they can continuously adjust their position while shooting—retreating swiftly when at a disadvantage and relentlessly pursuing enemies when victorious. Graceful and swift, courageous and determined, they fight for their homeland without fear or hesitation.

Unit Characteristics：


Agile and versatile archers, utilizing advanced archery techniques to adapt to complex battle conditions.

Rapid learners in combat, growing stronger the longer they fight on the battlefield.

A ranged unit that combines strong survival capabilities with a high skill ceiling.

Skill Design：


Skill 1：Flying Petals (During the skill’s duration, each successful hit on an enemy can restores health.)


Flying Petals - Enhanced (During the skill’s duration, any excess healing beyond the maximum limit gained from damaging enemies is converted into a shield)

Skill 2：Windstep (After selecting a direction, the Hwarang rolls forward and shoots in that direction, up to two rolls.)


Windstep - Enhanced (Increases the number of rolls performed by +1.)

 
II. Battle Pass
Battle Pass Level 0 Unlock: Snowbloom Heir
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0937435302846b42e0acefc9972877e5acf1202d.jpg 

Battle Pass Level 100 Unlock: Sage Monarch
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5640bfe08eed67d2e83b1f0ab30e368c294f97eb.jpg

notes.title: March 20 Unit Balance Adjustments & Free Doctrine Removal Event
notes.content:
Recently, we have received a lot of feedback from warlords regarding Spartan Chosen. We have been closely monitoring the performance of this unit on the battlefield. Additionally, we have also received balance-related feedback regarding Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry and Sunward Phalanx.
 
We highly value the opinions of our warlords and have conducted multiple rounds of internal product discussions. Conqueror's Blade now features 120+ units from diverse cultures and backgrounds, along with various maps and artilleries. Maintaining a dynamic balance in the battlefield ecosystem is a challenging task, but we firmly believe that balance is the foundation and lifeline of Conqueror's Blade.
 
General Adjustment Approach
Our unit balance design revolves around balance, strategic depth, and player experience, ensuring a healthy battlefield ecosystem through continuous optimization.

1. Balance Adjustments: Strengths and Weaknesses Complement Each Other
By fine-tuning unit stats, skill mechanics, and roles, we attempt to ensure that units of different levels and types have their own advantages and disadvantages on the battlefield. For example:


Buffing 3-star units that underperform compared to design expectations.

Adjusting units that do not meet intended design goals.

Optimizing low-pick-rate units to improve their battlefield presence.

2. Targeted Optimizations: Aligning with Design and Player Feedback
Adjustments are made based on a unit’s intended role and real battlefield performance:


Enhancing functionality where necessary.

Optimizing control and survivability.

Improving unit synergy and skill interactions.

 
3. Data-Driven and Periodic Iterations
We actively monitor game data, battlefield recordings, and player feedback to quickly address balance issues:


Regular adjustments to underused units.

Ensuring changes do not disrupt fairness.

Most importantly, we highly value warlords' feedback on unit balance adjustments. We recognize that players often develop a deeper understanding of certain aspects of the game than we do, and we aim to refine the game together with you to build an even better Conqueror’s Blade.

How to Avoid Over-Powered and Over-Nerfed?
Before launching new units or balance changes, we conduct multiple rounds of numerical validation and iterative testing. For adjustments to popular units or major version updates, we also open a PTR test for warlords to test with us. Your feedback is crucial to our balance adjustments. We do not want overpowered "dominant" units, nor do we want previously nerfed units to become unusable. We take every adjustment seriously and sincerely ask for your honest and direct feedback. The more feedback we receive, the better we can refine unit balance—your voice shapes the battlefield!
 
Balance Ajustements
We will implement unit balance adjustments after maintenance on March 20.
For this update, Spartan Chosen, Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry, and Sunward Phalanx have received some downward adjustments. We would like to share our thought process with our warlords.
Spartan Chosen
The primary role of Spartan Chosen on the battlefield is that of a Tower Shield unit, with warrior capabilities as a secondary function. We aim for them to embody the defensive resilience of the Spartan warriors in history—holding their shields firm against enemy advances and creating opportunities for their allies to counterattack. However, due to their unit trait, their damage absorption has exceeded expectations. As a result, we have adjusted the trait values and reduced burst damage during counterattacks, emphasizing their shield role.
Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry
The single-use target count for [Disciplined Assault] was too high, and the charge acceleration effect further boosted its total damage output, allowing it to clear battlefields too efficiently.
Additionally, [Disciplined Assault] and [Thunder Charge] could refresh each other, creating high uptime and reducing their damage downtime compared to other charge-type cavalry units with even higher leadership cost. Given these factors, we decided to make some adjustments for this unit.
Sunward Phalanx
The intended battlefield role of [Sunward Phalanx] is anti-cavalry, but [Ares’ Flurry] had an overwhelmingly high uptime, allowing it to suppress both cavalry and melee infantry beyond our original design. Additionally, since the unit carries a small buckler, it also has some defensive capabilities against ranged units, making it highly versatile and effective in nearly any combat scenario. This exceeded our intended design scope, so we have made small adjustments to [Ares’ Flurry] by increasing its cooldown and slightly reducing its damage. These changes will not impact its anti-cavalry effectiveness, but they will slightly reduce its pressure on melee infantry.

Detailed Balance Adjustments
Dimachaeri


[Siccae Lunge]


Reduces damage taken by 65% for 3 seconds.

The two Siccae Stabs triggered by this skill deal an additional 1500 damage to buckler and tower shields units.

Siccae Stabs grant 2 seconds of immunity to control effect after a brief delay.

[Siccae Torrent]


Jump attack's block break value increased from 250 → 660.

Cudgel Monks


[Six Way Staff]


Six Way Staff can now block enemy attacks while spinning the staff, damage increased by 38%, and block break values increased from 100/150/200 → 200/300/400.

Ronin


[Charge]


Reduces ranged damage taken by 80% during the Charge.

[Iaido Strike]


Now knock down enemy units.

Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue where the final node in inner growth did not match its description; the effect has been changed from reducing cooldown by 0.3s per kill to reducing cooldown by 1s per kill for [Iaido Strike].

Fixed an issue where [Ronin] sometimes had abnormal attack damage when following orders via the C-key.

Jangjus


[Venom Blades]


Throwing blades now poison enemy units, dealing 90 damage per second for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times; against polearm infantry, reducing their damage dealt by 15% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue where [Jangjus] sometimes had an incorrect number of attack targets during free attacks.

Spartan Chosen


[Spartan Vengeance]: Shield bash counterattack damage reduced by 15% during the stance.

[Spartan Vengeance]: Jumping spear attack damage at the end of the stance reduced by 15%.

Unit Trait - [Oath of Unity]:


Base Effect: Shared damage absorption increased from 70% → 80%.

Final node in Veterancy: Shared damage absorption increased from 50% → 60%.

Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue where the final node in Veterancy for [Spartan Chosen] caused an abnormal [Oath of Unity] duration during [No Mercy].

Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry


[Disciplined Assault]: Maximum number of attack targets reduced by 1.

[Disciplined Assault]: Damage reduced by 15%.

Base leadership cost increased by 10 points.

Sunward Phalanx


[Ares' Flurry]: Base cooldown increased by 4 seconds.

[Ares' Flurry]: Damage reduced by 10%.

Bug Fixes


Fixed an issue where the duration text description for [Ares' Flurry] was incorrect, but the actual effect remains unchanged.

Besides—
Limited-Time Free Doctrine Removal Event!

notes.title: 2025 CBL is Getting Started, the Global Throne is Awaiting!
notes.content:
The 2025 Conqueror's Blade League (CBL) is set to reignite the flames. We will open four regional divisions globally, including the Chinese Mainland, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and Americas, spanning 17 global servers. Compete for cash prizes and exclusive in-game rewards! Registration opens on March 19 - teams from all regions can apply via the official website. Fight for glory!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a17a3c0d60fcee8cfa4dd2694f7893a4ef4faf72.png

For more information：
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1o2PraUJo8-9VatW-cZcw0Cll-y5mNc_FHVKN4SKe6X8/edit?tab=t.0 

Note: The following is a concise version of the rules. Detailed rules will be synchronized to the official website of CBL before the start of the tournament.
 
[Event Stages]
Regional Qualifiers (Regional Point Race): Refers to point races in four regions: Chinese Mainland (2 server sequences), Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. Each region calculates team rankings based on the sum of the top 15 player scores within each team. Advancement to the Group Stage is determined by regional leaderboards and qualification rules.
 
Regional Tournaments (Group Stage & Knockouts): Refers to group race and knockout race among teams that advanced from qualifiers and wildcard teams in each region (Chinese Mainland, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas). Competitions determine regional rankings (1st–8th place).
 
Regional Finals: Each region (Chinese Mainland, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas) crowns its champion and runner-up.
 
[Key Dates]
2025 CBL Registration:
[olist]

Chinese Mainland and Asia-Pacific: March 19, 2025, 12:00 (UTC+8) - April 6, 2025, 11:59 (UTC+8)

Europe: March 19, 2025, 6:00 (CET/UTC+1) - April 6, 2025, 5:59 (CET/UTC+1)

Americas: March 19, 2025, 00:00 (EST/UTC-5) - April 5, 2025, 23:59 (EST/UTC-5)
[/olist]
2025 CBL Point Race:
[olist]

Mainland China and Asia-Pacific: March 21, 2025, 12:00 (UTC+8) - April 20, 2025, 11:59 (UTC+8)

Europe: March 21, 2025, 6:00 (CET/UTC+1) - April 20, 2025, 5:59 (CET/UTC+1)

Americas: March 21, 2025, 00:00 (EST/UTC-5) - April 19, 2025, 23:59 (EST/UTC-5)
[/olist]
2025 CBL Group and Knockout Stage: April 25, 2025 - May 11, 2025
CBL Regional Knockout Stage: May 15, 2025 - May 18, 2025
2025 CBL Regional Semi-Final Race: May 22, 2025
2025 CBL Regional Final Race: May 23, 2025
2025 CBL Region Rivalry Race: May 25, 2025
2025 CBIC: June 5, 2025 - June 14, 2025
2025 CBIC Final Race: June 15, 2025
The CBIC tournament schedule is provided as a general timeframe for reference, with specific dates to be announced separately.
 
[How to Registrate]
To register for the 2025 CBL, teams can log in to the CBL official website and complete their registration.
Chinese Mainland Registration: cbl.zhanyi.com
Asia-Pacific Registration: https://cbl.conquerorsblade.com
Europe and Americas Registration: https://cbl-global.conquerorsblade.com
 
[Registration Requirements]
[olist]

Individual Requirements: Characters must be at least level 100 to register; Accounts must not be under any form of ban; Duplicate registrations are not allowed; Only one character per account can be part of a team at the same time.

Team Requirements: Teams must consist of a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 20 eligible members; Teams must consist of a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 20 eligible members; During the registration period, the team leader can click "Register Now" if the team meets the requirements.
[/olist]
[Prize]
The champion team will receive a massive prize including cash reward, exclusive attire, avatars, frames, and more. The cash prize pool will reach $60,000. Additionally, all participants in this CBL will receive exclusive rewards!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be86bfda60e3a9f87a281b5b6b07ebce0cd43fd7.jpg 

[Tournament Format]

The CBL tournament follows a format of points race, group stage, and knockout stages. The points race calculates the total ranked points of the top 15 players in the registered team. Teams will be ranked and promoted based on the number of teams in each region.


This CBL will be divided into four regions: Chinese Mainland, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and Americas. Details regarding the servers and the teams advancing from the ladder points tournament in each region are as follows:

1）Chinese Mainland: 16 teams will be selected from the Point Race for the Group Stage. Due to differences in the score rankings between the Chinese server sequence and the Global server sequence in "Ranked Battles", the region is split into two sub-regions:
6 teams will be selected from Chinese Server Sequence for the Group Stage from Point Race. These servers involved: Jiulongzhuri, Kaijiangtuoyu, Weijiahainei.
10 teams will be selected from Global Server Sequence for the Group Stage from Point Race. These servers involved: Xianfengjingji, Tianceshangjiang, Baizhantiejia, Jingetiema, Xianyinuma, Hengdaolima.
 
2）Asia-Pacific: 16 teams will be selected for the Group Stage, including 6 official-invited wild cards. Details are as follows：
10 teams will be selected from Asia-Pacific region for the Group Stage from Point Race. These servers involved: Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Saga Blade, Khan of Heaven, Aurora Ridge, Hades Gate
The remaining 6 wild-card teams will be directly invited by the officials to participate in the Group Race.
 
3）Europe: 16 teams will be selected for the Group Stage, including 4 official-invited wild cards. Details are as follows：
12 teams will be selected from the Europe region for the Group Stage from Point Race. These servers involved: Crystal Sea, Europa Frontier, Lionforge Fjord, Lakonía.
The remaining 4 wild-card teams will be directly invited by the officials to participate in the Group Race.
 
4）Americas: 8 teams will be selected from the Point Race for the Group Stage. Details are as follows：
8 teams will be selected from the Americas region for the Group Stage from Point Race. These servers involved: Elysium Peak.
 
[Rules for Team and Player Naming]
[olist]

Team Naming Rules:
[/olist]
1）The team name in the CBL server is the same as the house name created by the team leader. For global event consistency, team names can currently only consist of English letters and numbers, with a character requirement of 4 to 32 characters.
2）Names must not contain any insulting or discriminatory meanings. If found, the team will be disqualified directly.
3）Teams must provide an abbreviation consisting of 3 to 4 characters.
4）In special cases, abbreviations with meanings can be determined and publicly announced after communication with the official team.
5）Officials reserve the right to modify team names or abbreviations based on actual circumstances.
[olist]

Individual Naming Rules
[/olist]
1）The character name in the CBL server is the individual's name.
2）The format is [Team Abbreviation_Individual Nickname], with no restrictions on the individual nickname.
3）For example, if a team abbreviation is BOOM and their character name is LEON, the name would be [BOOM_LEON].
4）Names must not contain any insulting or discriminatory meanings. If found, the team will be disqualified directly.
5）Players with names that do not meet the naming rules are not allowed to participate.
6）Officials reserve the right to modify individual’s name or abbreviations based on actual circumstances.
 
 
[Point Race Rules]

1.Since the point is mainly calculated based on rank, the final result of the point race will be subjected to the total team points data as recorded on the CBL official website.
2.If the registration period overlaps with the point race period, players are allowed to switch between teams freely. However, the final list of participants will be based on the team composition at the registration deadline.
3.At the start of the point race, players who have not joined a team but have any score changes from participating in [Ranked Battles] will also be included in the point race calculation. (For example, if "CN-Leon" does not choose a team at the start of the point race but continues to participate in the [Ranked Battles] and joins a team on March 29, after the point race ends on April 19, the points earned from participating in the [Ranked Battles] from the start of point race to April 19 will still be calculated for "CN-Leon.")
4.At the end of the point race, only the total [Ranked Battles] scores of the top 15 players in the team will be considered as the team's score.
5.Points Race Notices:

1) If a team leader has characters on multiple servers or multiple characters on the same server, the point calculation will be based on the server where the character with the highest [Ranked Battles] score is located. If team members have characters on multiple servers or multiple characters on the same server, the server where the team leader is located will be used to calculate the point race.
2) Duplicate registrations are prohibited in the CBL. If a player is found to have created multiple characters and joined multiple teams on the CBL server during calculations, the player's eligibility will be revoked, and the teams will not be allowed to add replacement members.
3）Forming teams across different server sequences, such as Jiulongzhuri and Kaijiangtuoyu, is not allowed. Members belonging to different server sequences will be considered invalid registrations, and their teams will not be allowed to add replacement members. The server sequence of the team will be based on the character registered by the team leader, and team members must confirm the server sequence of the team with the leader.
4）Teams that do not provide contact information (Discord) or cannot be contacted by the official team will be considered invalid registrations.
5）The final list of the team and [Ranked Battles] scores used in calculation are all based on the status at the registration deadline.
6) The seasonal level or [Ranked Battles] score of promoted team members will be publicly displayed.
 
 
Because the promotion for the 2025 CBL Point Race is primarily based on the total points in "Ranked Battles" of the registered team members. So, don't miss the "Ranked Battles" when the new season starts on March 21th. Warlords, make sure to call your team for ranking matches.
 
Wishing all our warlords good luck and great success!

notes.title: Hwarang (T5): Arrows Rain on the Battlefield!
notes.content:
Who shapes the battlefield with their arrows? Who rides the wind to strike down their foes from above? The Hwarang warriors of Silla, clad in pristine white and wielding bows like crescent moons, carve their legacy in blood upon the battlefield!
 
 [previewyoutube=7W29TPWIG3U;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[Unit Background]
The name "Hwarang" originates from royal court of Silla, where the finest noble youths were selected for their mastery of both scholarship and martial prowess. Trained in disciplines for mental fortitude and composite archery for physical strength, they wore ornate silks symbolizing status. Deployed alongside kings in battles, their meteoric arrows decimated enemy commanders mid-battlecry, earning them the title "Kingdom's Vanguard". More than soldiers, they epitomized Silla's golden age - each shot a brushstroke in blood, etching martial legacy across battlefields for generations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa2cc827c4c60834b6435bbdfa24a1c2da8a7355.jpg 
[Key Features]


Agile and versatile archers, utilizing advanced archery techniques to adapt to complex battle conditions.

Rapid learners in combat, growing stronger the longer they fight on the battlefield.

A unit that combines strong survival capabilities with a high skill ceiling.

[Skills]
Flying Petals 
Draws the bow and releases a piercing wind-arrow volley. During the skill’s duration, each successful hit on an enemy restores 20% of the damage dealt as health. 
Flying Petals - Enhanced
During the skill’s duration, any excess health beyond the maximum limit is converted into a shield, storing the surplus as additional protection.
Windstep 
After selecting a direction, the Hwarang rolls forward and shoots in that direction. During the skill’s duration, they perform two rolls in total. 
Windstep - Enhanced 
Increases the number of rolls performed by +1.
 
[Tactical Role]
A master of survival and battlefield control. With fluid movement, the Hwarang weaves through arrow storms, sustaining the front line through their self-healing mechanics. They excel at wearing down enemy elites through persistent skirmishing and can escape dire situations using [Windstep]. Their enhanced self-healing mechanic turns them into an unstoppable force in late-game battles - while enemies struggle to retreat to supply point, Hwarang's arrows are already aimed at their next target!
 
With this, Warlords—have you now glimpsed the unrivaled splendor of the Silla archers? Let's witness the Hwarang rain down arrows upon a thousand foes!

notes.title: Tiger Fists (T4): Mountain-Forged Carnage Unleashed!
notes.content:
Who shatters stone with iron fists? Who storms fortresses with bare hands? The Tiger Fists strike like thunderclaps, their fury crumbling mountains - turn all enemies into dust!
 
 [previewyoutube=OiPDc3YhuUU;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[Unit Background]
Named after Silla's millennium-old legends, Tiger Fists master secret combat arts to dominate beasts barehanded. These hermits bodies and hone power under waterfalls, their fists shattering steel. When kingdoms tremble, they charge through battlelines as living weapons, vanishing post-victory without reward.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/936ee9b1497268a6a749b19fed7a7884b46cd8c0.jpg
[Key Features]


Great damage resistance

Battlefield penetration specialists

Berserker-style sacrificial combat

[Skills]
Courage Charge
Bull-rush through targets in direction, ignoring control effect and blocks and knocking down enemies
 
Tiger's Fury
Deliver rapid meteor-fist combos closing distance, dealing massive damage.
 
Mighty Slap
Empower next strike for heavy blow that has great block break effect and launches enemies skyward.
 
[Tactical Role]
Breach specialists excelling at dense formation breaks. Shatter shield walls as vanguards or execute commander in chaos. Their unique [Robust Form] strengthens themselves when taking damage, enabling comeback victories. Ideal for narrow-area "Last Stand" tactics - the ultimate game-changer.
 
Do you feel the tiger's roar shaking the mountains? These fortress-breaking fists bring primal combat artistry to Conqueror's Blade S22!
Clench your fists - the battlefield awaits!

notes.title: Silla Guards (T3): Hurled Shields Break Enemy Lines!
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
Who stands unyielding under the storm of arrows? Who hurls their shields to shatter enemy ranks? The Silla Guards march into battle with spears as their backbone and shields as their soul, ensuring the banner of Silla remains proudly raised over blood-soaked battlefields!
 [previewyoutube=CXQTGRcJimM;full][/previewyoutube]

[Unit Background]
Forged from Silla's spear-bearing phalanx tactics, the Silla Guards became a formidable force across the land. Wielding rectangular shields and long spears, this unit dominated battlefields with their signature shield throw tactic. As masters of desperate warfare, they'd hurl shields to breach enemy lines before closing in with spears - a devastating all-or-nothing approach that crushed defenses through a decade of campaigns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4e818bc8f23173f000dd55195fbfc77ae9597f88.jpg
[Key Features]


Square shields block incoming ranged arrows

Unique tactical ability: Shield Throw

Balanced polearm infantry

[Skills]
Shield Throw
Hurl the square shield with full force, dealing blunt damage and applying a control effect. This ability destroys the shield upon use, so timing is critical.
 
Spear Slam
Swing the spear for a powerful strike to keep enemies at a distance. If the shield is destroyed, the Silla Guards will perform an additional slam attack.
 
[Tactical Role]
The battlefield polymath combining shield defense and spear offense. Their shield walls provide exceptional ranged protection when fortifying positions, while shield throws deliver precise stunning attacks in close quarters. Through coordinated tactics, they amplify melee effectiveness while exploiting spear reach to deliver powerful knockback strikes - invaluable for both chokehold defense and unit advancement.
 
With this, Warlords, how do you feel about the new 3-star unit for the upcoming season?
Let us all look forward to the official release of Conqueror's Blade S22 on March 20!
Rally your forces now and prepare for battle!

notes.title: The Glory and Wisdom of Silla: Snowbloom Heir & Sage Monarch Showcase
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
 
As Viking berserkers still roar through northern fjords, Spartan shields shatter Thermopylae's pass, and the smoke of Gustavus' muskets fades—only for Queen Seondeok's golden crown to ignite the eastern shores. CB's world surges with tidal waves of civilizations, already home to a vast array of cultures. More war cries awaken across eras, and every conquest reforges this world's destiny.
 
To this day, a thousand years have passed. Now it's time to embrace the new season and embark on your journey of conquest. East of the great sea, where snow-capped mountains stand tall and the cold river flows endlessly, the Kingdom of Silla once thrived. Set against the backdrop of Korea’s Three Kingdoms era, the new season unfolds with the epic saga of the Silla Dynasty.
 
Preorder the Silla season pass now, unlock the Victory Pass, and earn a Silla season unit for free. Set yourself apart on the battlefield. prepare in advance, the battle draws near!
 
[previewyoutube=Ys0xVp2H0ws;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Preorder the "Silla" Season Pass now
 Preorder the Silla pass grants access to the Victory Pass challenge. Complete it to earn 2x Unit tokens for the「Silla Guards」when the new season launches on March 20.
Event Rules


Duration : March 6 (post-maintenance) – March 20 (pre-maintenance).

How to Participate:


Navigate to [O] → [Events] → [Victory Pass] .

Complete daily quests for XP to level up and unlock rewards.

Pre-purchasers unlock all rewards; free players earn partial tiers.

Key Notes: Daily quests reset at 00:00 server time and stack throughout the event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dd8e589c1e2d9547e9a0f9b64f47949382e0857c.jpg 
Silla season introduces two attires-Snowbloom Heir and Sage Monarch, capturing the purity of a crown prince’s vow and the transcendent wisdom of a queen.
 
Snowbloom Heir 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0937435302846b42e0acefc9972877e5acf1202d.jpg 
Design Inspiration
In Silla, the pure white robe symbolizes unwavering virtue, representing the noble responsibility —when the flames of war reach the city walls, only the frost-like color on the robes can pierce through the darkness, bringing a glimmer of hope.
 
Regardless of bloodline, the members are always dressed in white robes. On a snowy night in Gyeongju, the robes of the Silla people are sharper than the moonlight and snowflakes. Notice the flowing silver light in the attire. It's not just embroidery, but the reflection of the sharpness when the legion charges, shattering the ice beneath their feet.
 
The design of the attire echoes the tradition of wearing white robes, and donning this attire signifies a resolute determination—because they knows their responsibility: to protect the people of Silla at any cost, even at the cost of their own life.
 
Sage Monarch 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5640bfe08eed67d2e83b1f0ab30e368c294f97eb.jpg 
Design Inspiration
 
When the first arrow pierced through the peony fields outside Gyeongju, Queen Seondeok’s garments billowed with a speed faster than the trembling of the bowstring. “Peony—brilliant yet scentless, unnoticed by all.” Her unique perspective on the peony symbolized her emergence as a ruler with foresight.
 
This attire is inspired by the legend of Queen Seondeok—"The youthful peony foretells the heavenly kingdom." Notice how the peony, scentless, blooms at the cuffs with every step she takes, harboring the power to sever the enemy's bowstrings, as if to remind us that a true ruler holds prophecies within every crease of their attire.

notes.title: A Letter to All Players from the Development Team of Conqueror's Blade
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords,
As the start of the new year, we, the entire development team of Conqueror’s Blade, would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to every player who has fought alongside us over the past five years. As we step into 2025, we will continue to forge ahead with clearer strategic direction and bolder content innovations to build a truly 'war world across time and space' with all of you.
 
 
New Journey in 2025: Expanding the Boundless Possibilities of the War World Together
 
I. Upholding the “Multi-Civilization, Cross-Era” Strategy
1. Space Dimension: The Clashing of Civilizations is the Soul of the War World
The heart of Conqueror’s Blade lies in the chaos of Chinese cavalry clashing with Viking berserkers, samurai dueling Roman legions beneath crumbling walls. It’s the convergence of different civilizations, their troops, tactics, and cultural symbols that infuse every battle with an unpredictable "chemical reaction." And it is the players from all corners of the globe that truly bring this battlefield to life (yes—we see you, there are players who stay up until 3 AM in their time zone to fight in a capital city battle across the ocean).
 
2. Time Dimension: Breaking the Boundaries of Time to Explore the Possibilities of War
Last year, we bridged millennia: Alexander the Great’s phalanxes marched alongside Gustavus Adolphus’ artillery lines. The cross-time portrayal not only enriched battlefield strategy but revealed countless surprises in the tactical interplay between cold and hot weapons eras.
 
In 2025, we’re pushing further: Warring States chariot hordes? Renaissance city-state cannons? Every ripple in history’s tide could become your next battlefield in Conqueror’s Blade.
 
 
II. Core Directions for 2025
Direction 1: Multi-Civilization Warfare – Deeper, Richer, Bolder


Eastern Civilizations: There will be at least two seasons focused on Eastern civilizations in 2025, which will definitely include Chinese-themed seasons, while the other will explore underrepresented Asian battlefield cultures like Silla, Southeast Asia’s Siam, or Central Asia.


Western Civilizations: There will also be more seasons focused on Western civilizations in 2025. These are more likely to appear in the second half of the year.


Cross-Civilization Interactions: In the future, we may introduce “Multi-Civilization Cooperative Seasons” (for example, Tang Dynasty armies and Silla troops fighting together), exploring interesting combinations of civilizations throughout history.


 
Direction 2: Evolving Gameplay Systems – No More "One-off Updates"


Territory War Innovation: We will update the rules with each season, continuing to expand the current City Garrison system. Mechanisms like “Warrior King” and “Warrior Showdown” will remain in future seasons. With each new season, we will keep adding more strategic decision-making elements.


Permanent Fun Modes: Our Spring Festival Onslaught mode (Season 2) sets the tone. Past popular modes will be continually optimized, generating new variations to ensure players can regularly engage with these fun elements.


Less Grind, More Strategic: Simplified progression lets veterans experiment freely and newcomers charge into battle faster. Meanwhile,we will deepen the strategic limits of core gameplay - Siege Battle, ensuring that the essence of Conqueror’s Blade becomes a timeless classic.


 
Direction 3: Combat Revolution – Embrace the Variables


Seasonal Validation: Starting mid-year, we will focus on optimizing the core combat experience. We’re listening—your feedback will pinpoint areas in need of improvement and help shape new mechanics like unique skill systems or mysterious item effects, keeping the game fresh and challenging.


System Optimization: Once these new mechanisms are validated, they will become part of the enduring content in the game, allowing the Combat Strategy to continuously evolve. Adjustments will be made based on player feedback to fine-tune the parameters and balance of these new mechanisms.


 
III. Our Original Intention and Commitment to You
Some players have asked, "Aren’t you afraid the content might feel too scattered with so many civilizations and eras?" Our answer remains: Conqueror’s Blade isn’t a history simulator—it’s a war fantasy sandbox. Whether it’s the armor details that history enthusiasts love, the tactical maneuvering that strategy fans crave, or the playful debates like “What BGM should we use when Polish Winged Hussars charges?”—it’s these things you love that define the soul of Conqueror’s Blade.
 
We fully understand that the development of Conqueror’s Blade would not be possible without the support and passion of our players. We pledge to keep you at the heart of every update. With the continued effort of both you and us, Conqueror’s Blade will become the definitive global war game legend.
 
Epilogue: The Ever Burning Fire in Our Heart
Over the past five years, we’ve seen players write in-depth articles about seasons, perform stunning cavalry flanking maneuvers, and witnessed countless moments where players fought against all odds and thought, “We can still turn this around!” It’s these moments that make us truly believe: Conqueror’s Blade will, in time, become a second home for all war game enthusiasts.
 
2025 awaits. Let’s carve this saga belonging to global warlords into history—with blades as our quills.
 
The Conqueror’s Blade Dev Team
February 17, 2025

notes.title: A New Year Letter: Let's talk about units
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlord,
 
Over the past year, we’ve heard your voices loud and clear: “Grinding my units feels exhausting.” Every time we read these messages, we feel it deeply—new commanders brimming with ambition, yet held back by the grind, forced to retreat before their armies even take shape. 
 
“The first lesson on the battlefield shouldn’t be compromise.” 
 
As veterans who’ve fought alongside you in Conqueror’s Blade, we understand: Building your units shouldn’t feel like a soulless chore, and your tactical freedom shouldn’t be shackled by resource costs. For months, we’ve been fine-tuning a solution that balances your freedom to play your style with the core integrity of the battlefield.
 
This Lantern Festival, we’re ready to unveil our phased answer: LIMITED-TIME EVENT: [Potential Unleashed Initiative: Elite Unit Access]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1860af7c119e7beedca27e9108d3f76cc59ded8e.jpg
 
Tactical Playground (Time-Limited Free Access)
Log in and claim 16 max-level units (pre-equipped with Doctrines). Four core features ensure pure, unbridled combat:


Time-Limited Free Access — Jump into battle instantly without limit.

Full Freedom— Use these units in all matchmaking modes.

Elite Builds — Reduced Leadership costs let you mix and match for endgame-ready strategies.

Diverse Playstyles — Spears, shields, bows, cavalry—find your true calling.

 
Seamless Transition (Post-Event) 
After the free period ends: Extend for 30 Days — Keep your favorite units longer with a low-cost renewal.
 
Why launch this during Lantern Festival? 
Because we remember the Warlord who messaged us last New Year’s Eve: “Three straight losses ruined my holiday feast.” This update isn’t just a lantern guiding you through resource struggles—it’s our pledge: “We’ll dismantle every barrier to your glory, one by one.” Your feedback will directly shape future updates (e.g., extending free access, and making it available in more modes). 
 
May these 16 battle-hardened units ignite your conquests. See you on the battlefield, Warlords!

notes.title: [Snake's Fortune] Time to set off fireworks with legendary musket!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=g1VPBAZ6GDs;full][/previewyoutube]
 
 
Ancient people worshipped the golden snake as a deity, believing that when encountering storms, it could rise with the wind, control thunder and lightning, overlook all living beings, and even calm the rivers and seas.
 
For the upcoming Spring Festival, we will release a legendary musket attire [Snake's Fortune], based on the legend of the Golden Snake. This attire combines the worship of the Golden Snake deity with the beauty of cloisonné, bursting with unprecedented brilliance inside the colorful barrel.
 
 
[Snake's Fortune] will make your musket a fireworks launcher, and all of the skills are accompanied by dazzling golden effects: the incendiary bullets turn into flowering fireworks; the iron caltrops turn into spinning top fireworks; the Five Rounds Rapid will shoot out fireworks shells. Blackpowder Grenade causes thunderous explosions, and both of these ultimate skills end with the soaring golden snake.
 
With one bang of the cannon, a fortune in gold is brought. [Snake's Fortune] will make the saying come true, accompanied by a barrage of bullets hitting targets with the scattering of gold coins, a physical manifestation of wealth.
 
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/465d427add100069751fbbb8775c5226.jpg
Background Story
According to legend, there was an ancient kingdom in the Far East. Under the rule of a wise king, the kingdom prospered, except for the raging waves of a great river flowing through, which brought great suffering to the people on both banks.
 
The wise king tried to calm the turbulent waters and bring peace to the people. On the day when the river was at its highest, he summoned tens of thousands of elite soldiers to fire a barrage of arrows at the river's crest, forcing the tide to recede and gradually calming the water disasters.
 
During this battle, a golden snake is said to appear at the king's side and aided his success. From then on, future kings regarded the golden snake as a symbol of auspicious weather and adorned it on their ceremonial weapons to demonstrate their divine favour and ensure peace throughout the empire.
 
The design of [Snake's Fortune] incorporates the legend of the Golden Snake, with two red-eyed golden snakes winding around the body of the musket, which is carved with ancient Chinese patterns. The snakes' scales are cast in gold and decorated with lotus blossoms, shining brightly as if imbued with the power to vanquish evil and ward off malevolent spirits.
 
Gold and silver threads, cloisonné colors, a rare unique treasure in the world. In the barrel section, we refer to the texture of cloisonné, crystal clear like glass, deep and captivating like a gem. Looking into it, you can almost feel the swirling energy of time and space.

notes.title: [Sparta] New Map Spotlight: Thermopylae
notes.content:
Map Structure

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/67171eb5f7856cc542cd9b6b6b12fdbb.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/beec39e18f4ea15bf4898ec7b44546a3.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/8459a6e3001d2f36a31bd67e1c9340bd.png
 
The battlefield is divided into the Thermopylae city walls area and the Anopaia Path within the valley -- this is the path indicated by the traitor Anopaia.
Through the Anopaia Path, the attacking side can directly reach the core defense area for battle.

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/748f3e18d2b8c2e37fc47df98629f082.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/8e479829a634a2dcdc73d36d905d50b6.png
 
First Stage Battlefield
The city walls area has two key capture focuses: Point A is located at the center of the city walls area, while the supply point is next to the statue at the coastal end. The path area contains two other important capture focuses: the outpost point at the valley entrance and the supply point within the valley. During the initial stage of the battle, both areas' capture points are available for the attacking side to seize.

The attackers can choose to breach the city through the gates and broken walls of the city walls area or launch a strong assault on the supply point along the path to secure the outpost. This allows them to use closer respawn points and supply distances to flank Point A from the rear and sides.

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/6f06d32691e2981db35ff4ab4b2c2d6d.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/166d9bc2cc79ec2060d6557939dad956.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/74d9b4fa51e3f55d31fe099a02d00ea5.png

Second Stage Battlefield

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/c89e4a30c4cc75e6cacfa203818ef460.png

After capturing Point A, the dock area at Point B will be unlocked. The attackers can then choose to advance step-by-step along the main road from the city walls area, or launch an assault from the path entrance towards both sides of the river, breaking the defense's line.

 
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/e4596d3937b0b6b2ab7b008bab09e2e2.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/447e4055f56fb5360e65f679331d5c81.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/a93f4c96906629917f1bd5fbbfe0a714.png
 
Third Stage Battlefield

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/b7e8421b533cbcda0855bc5ff57a8ac3.png

In the final stage, the attackers can advance towards the main camp from multiple directions. The primary approach is to cross the bridge from the front battlefield and launch an uphill assault near the main camp plaza. Additionally, after capturing the outpost and supply point towards the end of the path, attackers will have the opportunity to cut off the defenders' supply route from there.

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/939b3960cdccf1d6a20d95de06fcf01e.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/97c9db4bbc073c7aa357e20b45702411.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/01f9da4fde0af06ec624dc587b02104d.png


Map Mechanism
Flame Arrows

In Thermopylae, the attacking side's trebuchets have been replaced with frame arrows rain. Players can aim and release the flame arrows using the G key, launching multiple waves of flame arrows from ships on the sea. These rockets deal significant damage to a wide area, with added knockback and burning effects, and are particularly effective against units without shields.

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/cc90d9ac011f657e8c473ab451e08247.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/071a241b651b8a08f8ee5f4c8fd535cb.png
 

After capturing the dock area at Point B, more warships will join the battlefield, and players will receive an additional flame arrows use.
The rocket barrage can effectively harm both allies and enemies, so choose your targets and timing carefully.
 
Outposts
There are two outpost points set up near the path area, providing additional respawn points for both sides. By controlling these outposts, you can shorten the time for your side to rejoin the conflict.
 
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/5fc72456ad10c5897cdacf11af1f3906.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/97c9db4bbc073c7aa357e20b45702411.png
 
Drowning Damage
In the Thermopylae map, there are multiple terrains where heroes can fall into water and drown. Be mindful when choosing your combat locations, as drowning will result in death.
 
Drowning deaths are recorded as environmental damage, and you can view the details by pressing T while in the death waiting state.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade: Territory War Adjustment Plan
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
Territory War has always been the heart of Conqueror's Blade, a crucible where warlords forge their legends and empires rise and fall.  It's more than just a battle, it's a war for dominance, a struggle for every inch of land.

Over countless seasons, we've closely monitored the ever-shifting landscape of Territory War across all servers, constantly refining the rules of the open world.  In the upcoming season, we're introducing a series of changes designed to revolutionize your Territory War experience.

This week, we serve up the first course: a significant overhaul of NPC garrison behavior.  Currently, small-scale raids can easily capture undefended cities.  A coordinated team can scale walls, disable supply points, and capture the final flag in a matter of minutes.  The existing NPC garrisons often stand idly by, offering little resistance.  They’re more spectators than defenders.

This changes on Thursday.  Prepare for a dramatic improvement in NPC garrison effectiveness.  These troops will now operate with near-human intelligence, prioritizing the defense of key supply points around the main flag.  If the main flag falls, they will regroup and defend their base, rather than mindlessly charging into the enemy.  Wall-scaling and supply point rushes will face unprecedented resistance.  Expect to encounter a fully manned unit of infantry waiting for you when you breach the walls.  Five-man speedruns will become a thing of the past.

Our goal is to encourage greater participation in open-world warfare.  Stronger NPC garrisons will provide a crucial defensive layer, buying valuable time for reinforcements to arrive.  This doesn't mean the end of strategic raiding; unguarded cities will still be vulnerable.  The key, as always, is finding weak points.
These changes may even empower smaller houses to hold their ground against larger forces, creating more dynamic and unpredictable conflicts.  

Warrior Duel
In the mobilization of the big world, the fort is the key focus on every unified battle board. Often, the controller of the fort can issue a closure order, causing great distress to the enemies both inside and outside the fort.

In Season 21, we will make significant changes to the fort battles. Both sides can only send 15 players to fight, meaning that it's an absolute test of strength. Small families can hold their ground, just like the 300 Spartans at the Battle of Thermopylae.

Establishing merit in the "Warrior Duel" can earn you unique avatar frames and family emblem frames exclusive to this gameplay, which will be a testament to your courage and strength.

Artillery Warehouse
Many people have experienced the struggle of hauling a cart full of artillery on the battlefield, with a long line of artillery that draws more attention than the troops themselves. As a result, when you're dragging a line of artillery, you often become the prime target for enemy pursuit forces.

Now, we will introduce the artillery warehouse mechanism to the big world.

The artillery warehouse will be similar to self-fief strongholds like frontline camps and managed by houses. All house members, except for new ones, can store and retrieve artillery. Imagine sending a supply team to build an artillery warehouse at the front line before the battle starts, and then the main force only needs to travel light, retrieve the artillery directly from the warehouse when they arrive at the battlefield.

This way, all house members can participate better in the division of labor in Territory War. High-combat warlords can focus on fighting, while lower-combat warlords can find their place, contributing to supply.

The Warrior Duel and artillery Warehouse will be launched this season. You can follow subsequent announcements for detailed rules, and we will also open testing on the PTR beforehand. 

In each subsequent season, we will introduce big world gameplay that matches the theme of the season and continuously adjust and control the ecosystem. We hope to create the fairest possible competitive environment for everyone, so that houses of all sizes can find their place in the big world.

notes.title: [Sparta] Season Update Log
notes.content:
I. New Weapon - Shield & Spear
Core Mechanism
- Use sidesteps to adjust positioning, raise your shield, and always face the enemy head-on.
- Gauge the distance between you and the enemy, looking for the right moment to perform a sidestep attack, which will protect you while striking the enemy.
- Combine sidestep attacks, sprint attacks, and active skills to quickly unleash the final segment of the Normal Attack.
- Accumulate rage through blocking and attacking, then unleash the [Spartan Kick].

Class Traits:
- Sidestep
  - This hero has two evasion methods: Roll and Sidestep
    - In normal state, the evasion method is Roll
    - In defensive state, the evasion method is Sidestep. During Sidestep, the hero remains in defensive state
    - After Sidestepping, left-click to directly release the fourth segment of the Normal Attack
  
- Shield Defense
  - Defensive Effects: 
    Successfully blocking prevents being pushed back, knocked down, or knocked away.
  - Buff Effects: 
    Successfully blocking grants 40 rage points.
  - Node: Fury Stance
    - Rage gained from successful blocks increases by 20%.

- Counterattack
  - Base Effect:
    While in shielded state, attack targets. Each hit on an enemy unit grants 15 rage points.
  - Node: War Steps
    - Reduces stamina consumption for sidesteps and sidestep attacks by 25%.
  - Node: Frenzy of Rage
    - Ignore collision when sidestepping to the left, right, or backward.

Skill Description:
- Normal Attack:
  - Four stages; the final stage attack is immune to daze, deals increased damage, and accumulates more rage.

- Aegis Retribution:
  - Base Effect:
    - Cooldown: 16 seconds; deals blunt damage; pressing it again deals blunt damage and stuns the enemy.
  - Control Removal Effect:
    - Releases the skill to remove dazed and knockdown effects.
  - Buff Effect:
    - If the block is successful, block recovery rate is increased by 100% for 5 seconds; each hit on an enemy unit grants 30 rage points.
  - Node: Vow of the Hunt
    - The second stage of the Aegis Retribution increases the damage the enemy receives by 20% for 4 seconds.

- Ares' Cleave
  - Base Effect:
    - Cooldown time: 16 seconds; deals 123% base + 477 blunt damage; pressing it a second time deals 178% base + 1558 slashing damage.
  - Buff Effect:
    - Each hit on an enemy hero grants 30 rage points.
  - Node: Breathing Control:
    - Reduces the cooldown of Ares' Cleave by 2 seconds.
  - Node: Divine Punishment
    - Increases the critical hit of the second stage of Ares' Cleave by 6000 points.
    
- Heracles' Throw
  - Base Effect:
    - Cooldown: 8 seconds; deals 175% base + 1451 piercing damage.
  - Buff Effect:
    - Each hit on an enemy unit grants 30 rage points.
  - Node: Breath of the Warrior
    - Heracles' Throw returns 2 seconds of cooldown when hitting an enemy.

- Heracles Mounted Throw
  - Base Effect:
    - Cooldown time: 8 seconds; deals 175% base + 1451 piercing damage.
  - Buff Effect:
    - Each hit on an enemy unit grants 30 rage points.

- Spartan Kick
  - Base Effect:
    Cooldown time: 5 seconds. [Spartan Kick] can be used when you have [Fury]. By attacking and blocking, you accumulate [Rage]; once Rage reaches a certain level, it converts into [Fury]. A maximum of 2 stacks of [Fury] can be accumulated; dealing 558% base + 2098 blunt damage and knocking enemies back.
  - Effect on Enemies:
    Enemies knocked away will cause damage and knock away other enemies in their path.
    Enemies knocked into a wall will receive an additional 1500 damage.
  - Node: After unlocking the skill "Wrath of the God"
    - A maximum of 3 stacks of [Fury] can be accumulated.
II. Season Units
T3: Helot Auxilary
Click here for more info:https://www.conquerorsblade.com/en/news/1347/
T4: Laconic Javelins
Click here for more info:
https://www.conquerorsblade.com/en/news/1349/
T5: Spartan Chosen
Click here for more info:https://www.conquerorsblade.com/en/news/1355/
III. Battle Pass
[Crimson Warriors Tunic]: Unlocked at Level 0 of Battle Pass
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/4f3371b176154d177d90dd0169a28f84.jpg
 
[Warrior Kings' Panoply]: Unlocked at Level 100 of Battle Pass
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/ae3632f527eaa60c1f81ec8f8d5ad1e1.jpg
 
IV. Season Vault


During the "Spartan" Season, attire sets from the Avalon Season will return to the vault. Players can redeem them at a 20% discount using [Blades]:


Nightmare of War (Sealed): Price reduced from 2500 to 2000


Eternal Crown (Sealed): Price reduced from 5000 to 4000


Camelot's Nightmare (Sealed): Price reduced from 2500 to 2000




Prices for the following attires will return to original prices:


Greycloak Zealot Attire Set (Sealed): Price increased from 2000 to 2500

The following attires will be removed from the Season Vault:

"Sengoku" Season Weapon Attire




V. Open World Updates
System Optimizations and Adjustments:


Territory War Contribution Calculation:


If the attacking side wins the fief, it will be the total contribution of the alliance to be compared with other alliances.


The house with the highest contribution under the winning alliance with the highest contribution will take ownership.




Any role with Strategist permissions can now manage defensive or offensive fronts for any house within the alliance.


If a house's Reputation drops below the requirement for declaring war, it will be automatically removed from the declaration queue.


Fishing Ports can now be used during Territory Wars.


Ship speed increased: trade Port ships' speed increased from 2.5 to 4; fishing Port ships' speed increased from 3 to 5.


On single-region servers: Prestige provided by the Capital is reduced from 3900 to 1625.


On single-region servers: part of the Alliance/House Prestige requirements for Liege's title has been lowered.


Requirements of occupying a Regional Capital for Hegemon/Monarch remain unchanged.




https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/29f6c5dcf11f8f0832d320164ec77281.jpg
 
"Spartan" Season-Specific Value Adjustments


Resource Adjustments:


Restored values for [Copper Mines] and [Iron Mines] storage and gathering rates.


Restored [Culverin] and [Mortar] Forge resource costs.


Open World movement speed of [Culverin] and [Mortars] is reverted from 3.5 to 2.8.




Storage for Food Fields, Cotton, and Timber increased by 20%; gathering rates for all Food, Cotton, and Timber increased by 10%.


Food consumption during [Forced March] reduced: consumption rate multiplier lowered from 2x to 1.5x.


VI. Campaigns

[Hercules' Greatness]: Using [Ironsides] additionally increases Defence by 20%; consumes 3 Rune Power.

IX. Season Fame


The Lionfire Season Fame will be reset to zero, and the Spartan Season Fame will commence.


The rewards in the Fame Store for the new season are as follows:


https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/1b9dc29fb2f1b12f49d363ee14573ac6.jpg
 
X. System Optimization
Consolidation of Residual Resources During Territory Switch
To address the issue where resources and items might be left in currently closed regions in specific scenarios, making them uncollectible, we have introduced a new quick collection feature for leftover resources.
[olist]

Access
[/olist]


Navigate via ESC -> Account Services -> [Regional Lost Resources]

[olist]

Feature Details
[/olist]


This update will open the tabs for [Reforged Equipment] and [Resource Piles].

Under the [Reforged Equipment] tab, you can view all reforged equipment left in unopened regions.


You can choose to keep the original equipment or obtain the reforged equipment.


Under the [Resource Piles] tab, you can view all Resource Piles left in unopened regions.


Each Resource Pile in the residual list will still have a time limit. If not collected within the time limit, the Resource Pile will disappear.

When there is enough capacity in the Supply Dump, you can click to collect and directly deposit the resources from the piles into the Supply Dump.


Display of Block Value-Related Attributes
To more clearly show the blocking capabilities of different units and heroes, the new season will introduce the display of Block Value and Block Recovery Value in both the unit attributes panel and the hero attributes panel.
XI. UI/UX Interaction
[olist]

Brand-New In-city HUD and ESC Interface
[/olist]

[olist]

Continuously improving the consistency of the user interface design.
[/olist]

https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/b4a10c9a64ced20839332ce8f6b00cd7.png
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/4ca0eedfefc0ad8c0314b1313db9539a.png
 
[olist]

Addressed the issue where the field of view was vertically cropped and narrowed on widescreen monitors. Now, widescreen monitors will have an expanded field of view on both sides.
[/olist]

[olist]

In-game tips will now automatically scale with the player's game resolution to address the issue of text being too small at higher resolutions. When players manually adjust the Tips scaling, the game will no longer automatically resize the Tips.

The seasons are now arranged in reverse order, with the latest season appearing first.
[/olist]
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/6b030dc13e17191680a4fd56c545df90.jpg
 
XII. Optimization of Unit Behavior
Units are a core element of the gameplay in Conqueror's Blade and play a crucial role on the battlefield. We will continue to optimize various behaviors of units within the battlefield to make their actions more reasonable and closer to realistic combat performance.


Unit Formation Optimization: Improved formation algorithms to resolve issues with front and back rows crossing during formation.


https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/78b98e0af3388a426b679584c1478ada.gif
https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/a9b6c182c8c82b46ed782836e8f89ba7.gif

Fixed the issue where Dual Blades hero using Deity's Footsteps near the end of invisibility, would experience stiffness when attacked after exiting Deity's Footsteps and using normal attacks in the non-stealth state.

XIV. New Launcher


The brand-new launcher has finally been unveiled! Veteran players can upgrade directly from the old version.


Supports one-click access to various official Conqueror's Blade media accounts for real-time updates.

Offers settings for download speed and automatic updates, so you won't have to wait for updates.
