A new siege battle map, inspired by a famous Spartan battle, will be added mid-season. Stay tuned for this exciting update!

notes.title: December 19 Update Log
notes.content:
Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following times:
APAC: December 19, 00:00 - 15:00 (UTC+8)
EU/AMS: December 18, 17:00 - December 19, 8:00 (UTC+1)
The maintenance is expected to last for 15 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *35000, Honor *1500, and Unit Medal *75 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. 
The update will contain the following:
 
I. [Arabian Nights] Returns with New Rewards!
A fantastical world with the brightest colors. [Arabian Nights] returns with a fresh update, and by participating in the event, you have a chance to earn the new exclusive attire for the Sunward Phalanx!

Info:



Warlords will play a Bingo game on a 12x7 board. Upon successfully completing a row or column, you will receive corresponding rewards. Each time you unlock a row or column, the progress bar will light up. When the progress reaches certain levels, cumulative rewards will be given.

The lighting up process consists of [Random Lighting] and [Directional Lighting]:


[Random Lighting] lights up 5 random areas (may overlap, and each lighting action grants a few Silver Coins).

[Directional Lighting] allows you to select a specific area to light up.


Warlords can earn [Random Lighting] points by completing daily tasks, or directly purchase [Random Lighting] points using Sovereigns.

notes.title: [Sparta] Season Unit Spotlight: Spartan Chosen (T5)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=a5iP_8euiEk;full][/previewyoutube]
 
The very name "Sparta" evokes images of unwavering discipline and martial prowess. While the fertile plains surrounding the city provided sustenance, it was Spartan blood and iron that truly defined them. From birth, every Spartan citizen was prepared for war. Torn from their families at a young age, they entered the agoge, the rigorous and all-encompassing system of Spartan education, emerging as hardened warriors. Their lives were dedicated to the mastery of combat, inextricably linked to the spear and shield. In a world where professional soldiers were a rarity, Spartans were warriors by nature, by nurture, and by necessity. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c690fbe48b77a096128da4579f8fb010a73d0f53.jpg
Unit Inspiration:
The Spartan phalanx, a tightly packed formation of heavily armed hoplites, was an unstoppable force. Within its ranks, every warrior, regardless of social standing, fought as one. At the Battle of Thermopylae, a small band of Spartans held off a massive Persian army, showcasing their legendary courage and resilience. The Spartan Chosen represent the best of these warriors, the pinnacle of Spartan military might. They are the sharpest edge of the Spartan spear, unwavering in the face of danger.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7c14fc946a5bacba59622c945f696ed3240030b4.jpg
Gameplay:
The Spartan Chosen are a heavy infantry unit specializing in coordinated assaults and defensive formations. Their abilities focus on damage mitigation, sustained offense, and devastating counter-attacks, making them an unstoppable force on the battlefield.
Abilities:


Leonidas' Wrath: All damage taken by the unit builds Wrath. Attacking and killing enemies with No Mercy generates Wrath more quickly. At maximum Wrath, Spartan Vengeance can be unleashed.


Oath of Unity: While any active ability is in use, the unit's damage taken is reduced to 70%, and all damage received is shared equally among its members, reflecting their unwavering commitment to one another.


Bloodthirst Vigor: Each successful attack against enemy soldiers heals the Spartan Chosen for 1% of their maximum health over 5 seconds. Healing is doubled when below 30% health, fueling their relentless assault.


No Mercy: Spartans lower their shields and aggressively thrust their spears forward, dealing high damage in a flurry of brutal attacks. Hits and kills during this ability generate Wrath rapidly.


Spartan Vengeance: Upon activation, the unit enters a counter-attack stance, rhythmically advancing and thrusting at enemies in their path. Reactivating the ability within a set time executes a shield bash that knocks down enemy units. After the advance, the Spartans charge towards nearby enemies, leaping into the air for a powerful piercing attack, a testament to their unmatched martial skill. Each successful shield bash increases the final leap attack's damage by 50%.

notes.title: [Sparta] Season Unit Spotlight: Laconic Javelins (T4)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=A81FsLzdIHU;full][/previewyoutube]
In ancient Sparta, not all were forged in the crucible of relentless martial discipline. While the citizen-soldiers formed the spearhead of Spartan power, other groups contributed significantly to their military dominance. 

The Perioeci, inhabiting the fringes and coastlines of Laconia, were a people of craft and commerce. Unlike their Spartan counterparts, who lived by the sword, they embraced a more nuanced approach to warfare – one of cunning and precision. 

The Laconic Javelins, drawn from the ranks of the Perioeci, embody this tactical approach, bringing a deadly ranged threat to the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1cb530373c65a19102b404ea93077c75b37d59c2.jpg
Unit Inspiration:

The Perioeci, unlike the Spartans raised for war from birth, thrived as artisans and merchants. In their coastal and border settlements, they cultivated a different kind of strength – a strength born of ingenuity and skill. Serving as javelin throwers in the Spartan army, they provided essential ranged support, screening the advance of their Spartan allies and exploiting vulnerabilities in enemy formations. 

Their powerful throws, honed through years of craft, propelled meticulously balanced javelins capable of piercing even the thickest armor. Those who dismissed them as mere craftsmen quickly learned the deadly effectiveness of their javelins. At Thermopylae, these stalwart defenders stood alongside their Spartan brethren, their javelins – a storm of piercing steel – answering the Persian arrows and claiming their place in legend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e9fa374d2cf96a85393ab554be492f258f5db13d.jpg
Featured Gameplay:

The Laconic Javelins excel at ranged harassment and support. Their mobility and specialized javelin techniques allow them to disrupt enemy formations, pick off key targets, and provide crucial cover for advancing Spartan troops.

Unit Skills:


Javelin Onslaught: Throw a round of javelins at the current target, inflicting significant damage.


Cooldown: 10s


Glorious Dash: Sprint in a chosen direction for a fixed duration, allowing use of [Olympian Volley] during the sprint.


Cooldown: 20s

Dash Duration: 5s


Olympian Volley: Throw javelins at extremely distant targets after a long-distance sprint. Range and damage increase with sprint duration.

Note: The final in-game effects and unit values are subject to change upon the season's launch.

notes.title: [Sparta] Season Unit Spotlight: Helot Auxiliaries (T3)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=esLNYIEs5io;full][/previewyoutube]
In the heart of ancient Greece, the Spartan war machine stood as a testament to discipline and martial prowess. While the Spartan citizen-soldiers, the Spartiates, dedicated their lives to the pursuit of martial excellence, a less celebrated class formed the very foundation of their military strength: the Helots. These individuals, bound to a life of service, ensured the Spartans could maintain their unwavering focus on the art of war. The Helot Auxiliaries arrive to embody this crucial logistical role, bringing vital support and resupply to the battlefield.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/42de2f400cbeb5051ea0eae4bcb10bec870e52c2.jpg
 
Unit Inspiration:
The Spartan military system was unique in ancient warfare. Every Spartan warrior, a highly trained and disciplined soldier, was accompanied by several Helots. These individuals, drawn from the Helot population under Spartan rule, acted as attendants and support personnel. They carried the burdens of weapons, armor, and supplies, freeing the Spartans to concentrate solely on the art of war. Though often overshadowed in historical accounts, the Helots played a critical role in Sparta's military successes. Their tireless efforts allowed the Spartan phalanx to operate with unparalleled efficiency and endurance. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Helots fought and died alongside their Spartan masters, demonstrating their courage and loyalty in the face of impossible odds. Even Leonidas, the iconic Spartan king, relied on Helots to prepare him for battle.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/530516af0e4c947eb0b2e584363da13ca8e54c87.jpg
 
Featured Gameplay:
The Helot Auxiliaries are a dedicated support unit, vital for maintaining the fighting strength of your Spartan forces. Their abilities focus on resupply and battlefield sustainment, allowing your front-line troops to remain engaged without interruption.
Unit Skills:


Ammo Cache: The Helot Auxiliaries deploy a cache of ammunition in front of them. Allied ranged units can replenish their ammunition by collecting supplies from this cache. This ability allows for extended engagements and reduces the need to withdraw for resupply.


Ammo Depot: The Helot Auxiliaries construct a temporary supply depot on the battlefield. This depot provides a continuous source of ammunition for nearby allied units, ensuring they can maintain a sustained barrage against the enemy.


Note: The final in-game effects are subject to change upon the season's launch.

notes.title: Battle Metal: Sabaton & Conqueror's Blade
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/eb04c2ea47a684f7f7a802cad9e1fbe14d4af701.jpg

Greetings, Warlords!
We are beyond excited to unveil an extraordinary collaboration that will set the battlefield ablaze with epic music and legendary warfare. Conqueror's Blade has joined forces with the renowned Swedish band, Sabaton, to bring you an event like no other!
Watch the new Trailer!
Don't miss Joakim Brodén, Sabaton's lead singer, as he transforms into an in-game hero. Witness the power of Sabaton and Conqueror's Blade in our brand-new trailer, featuring the song "Lion from the North".  

[previewyoutube=Lxlhj4IjRgw;full][/previewyoutube]

Battle Metal Event Duration
November 21 - December 5, 2024
This time-limited event is part of the ongoing Lionfire Season, inspired by the mighty Swedish king Gustavus Adolphus. Get ready to immerse yourself in the powerful symphony of Battle and Metal!

Why Sabaton & "Lion from the North"?
Conqueror's Blade collaboration with Sabaton is rooted in a shared passion for history and epic battles. Sabaton’s powerful metal music brings historical legends to life, while Conqueror's Blade immerses players in grand history-inspired warfare. This partnership celebrates our mutual love for history through different crafts—music and video games—making it a perfect and organic fit.
We chose the song "Lion from the North" for its deep connection to King Gustavus Adolphus, the inspiration behind our Lionfire Season. Our composer has created a stunning orchestral version of this iconic song, which will be the main soundtrack for the newly renamed "Sabaton Fortress" map. When the event begins on November 21, dive into the epic music and battles, glorifying both the band and our friendship with Sabaton.
Check out this newly-reworked song below: 



Sabaton Metal Legend Attire
Sabaton's star Joakim Broden reimagined in Conqueror's Blade

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a72a1b75ccd6f4704c5821335ba18e8727575041.jpg

Transform into the legendary front singer of Sabaton Joakim Brodén with the exclusive Sabaton Metal Legend Attire. This one-of-a-kind skin reimagines Joakim as a fierce Swedish warrior, complete with his custom voice-over fully recorded by Joakim Broden himself! It is the first ever attire of such kind in Conqueror's Blade! Show your strength on the battlefield and stand out with this unique attire.

- In-Game Skin: Joakim Brodén as a Conqueror's Blade warrior
- Custom Voice-Over: Joakim's voice brings your hero to life -  200 voice lines fully remade by Joakim Broden himself in English and Swedish to let you feel the voice power of a Metal Legend fighting on the battlefield. 
- Sabaton Player Avatar: 2 unique avatars are available for owners of the Sabaton Metal Legend 

Sabaton Rockcrusher Attire
One of a kind Maul Attire with unique Sound Effects

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bba2f91a17816a9a1e83dccbb46e0a57471c6609.jpg

Wield the epic Sabaton Rockcrusher -  a Maul attire inspired by the brutal might and the iconic design of an electric guitar. Joakim Broden personally asked for this weapon. Feel the power with newly-created unique custom sound effects of this maul that will make every strike resonate with Sabaton's legendary energy.

- Design: A fusion of electric guitar and maul
- Sound Effects: Custom guitar reverbs and combat sounds
- Unique Guitar Emote: Rock the crowds with the unique emote 

 Sabaton Mini Battle Pass - Unlock Your Rewards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/26f8b934bb80e2cdb344a05b2d68dcbc5e72077d.jpg

By getting the Sabaton Metal Legend attire or the special pack including both the Metal Legend and Maul's Sabaton Rockcrusher Attire, you will gain access to the "Sabaton Battle Metal" Mini Battle Pass. Complete missions, unlock dozens of rewards, and show the world your dedication to the legendary band! The final reward is the unique version of Sabaton attire - Emerald Warrior Attire

Community Events - Join the Fun and Win Big!

Starting from November 15, we're running multiple community events with exciting rewards:

Community Event 1: Use AI tools like Midjourney to create two images: one featuring Joakim Brodén in the universe of Conqueror's Blade, and another featuring any famous character, athlete, comic book, movie, or game character in the universe of Conqueror's Blade.  Top1 (with the highest likes/reactions) from Facebook or Discord will receive the Recolored Unique version of Sabaton attire.

Community Event 2: Use any Sabaton music of your liking and create a video featuring Conqueror's Blade gameplay or trailers (or a mixture of both). Top1-Top3 based on views will receive the Recolored Unique version of Sabaton attire. And a highlight on CB's official social channel.

Community Event 3: What's your dream crossover for Conqueror's Blade?  Imagine epic collaborations and tell us which universe you'd love to see clash with ours!  Share your idea for a chance to win big if your dream becomes reality!  Tell us your favorite Sabaton collab moments and then unleash your imagination for the next big thing!

Stay tuned for more community events that we will announce in the upcoming days.

Warlords, the time has come to answer the call of battle with Sabaton by your side. Stand tall, wield your weapons, and let the Battle Metal music of war guide you to victory! 

Sabaton & Conqueror's Blade

II. Halloween Event Begins. [Dark Writ] Descends upon the World!
[previewyoutube=dawD9iDAQ9Q;full][/previewyoutube]
On the eve of Halloween, the legendary [Dark Writ] descends on the outskirts of Augolia. A legendary adventure is unveiled ...

Info:
1. This Halloween event will consist of two themed game modes: [Halloween Defense] (PVE) and [Demon Showdown] (PVP). These modes will gradually unlock over time.
2. With the event progressing, four chapters of story that have been buried for a long time will be known again. Also, the Halloween duel between the Pumpkin Knight and the Headless Knight is awaiting the heroes to unfold.

Rewards:

2. Various rare items including Halloween-themed random attire boxes, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, Treatise, etc., can be redeemed in the [Exchange Shop].

10/31 - 11/21 0:00
 
III. Introduction to the All-new Halloween PVE and PVP Modes
[Halloween Defense]
Info:
The Blood Moon descends, and the Dark Knight leads the undead towards the Heilung Fjord. The heroes unite and build the legendary Halloween Defense front.
Heroes need to carefully plan and use limited resources to repel numerous enemies and protect the civilians in the city.

Victory Condition:
Hold your ground and ensure the survival of the protected targets in the city. If the protected target dies, it leads to a decrease in battlefield morale. The battle fails when morale drops to zero.

Other Info:
Leadership Shop
You can open the Leadership Shop anywhere in the battlefield to recruit [Units] or purchase [Artillery] by using Leadership. The summoned Units will move from the nearest supply point to the heroes’ location.

Reputation Acquisition:
You may obtain reputation by defeating enemies. Furthermore, a higher reputation may allow you to complete additional bounty quests, granting you bonus rewards of special event items [Fruity Candy].

Difficulty:
The [Halloween Defense] mode will have two difficulty levels: Easy and Hard. The Easy mode will be available after maintenance on 10/31, while the Hard mode will open on 11/2.

[Bounty Quest]:
After the hard mode of [Halloween Defense] is activated, [Bounty Quest] will refresh in the matching interface.
The [Bounty Quest] will be refreshed along with the progress of the Halloween Story chapters, and there will be a total of three different quests. [Bounty Quest] must be completed within a limited time, or they will disappear after the required time has passed.
The [Bounty Quest] are quite challenging. It is recommended for players to form a team to tackle them. You will get rewards after completing the quests. There's even a chance to activate a hidden mechanism.

Event Start Time:
Daily Opening Hours: All day.
10/31 after maintenance - 11/14 0:00

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a313f28049aa1932717b6f23dc492c838da8e3da.jpg

Global Match PVP Mode [Demon Showdown]
Info:
After defeating the Black Knight's scheme, the heroes can finally celebrate Halloween. One side dresses up as pumpkins, the other as ghosts, and they battle it out in the arena, striving for the ultimate victory!
Heroes can fully enjoy the thrill of battle. Upon hitting a certain kill count, you get to summon the opposing team's boss. Defeat their boss to get the ultimate victory.

Match Rules:
Heroes need to choose between the defender side [Pumpkin] and the attacker side [Ghost] during matchmaking. In the defense team, all six heroes will come from the same region; while in the attack team, the six heroes will come from other regions and will compete against the heroes from the defense team.

Victory Conditions:
Each side initially has 13 souls. Each time a heroes or Vanguard dies, they lose one soul. When either side loses all their souls, the Boss of that side steps onto the field. The side that defeats the enemy Boss will achieve the ultimate victory.
If only one side loses all the souls and summons the Boss, the other side wins.
If neither Boss appears, the side with the highest remaining sould number wins.
If both Bosses appear and neither is defeated, the side whose boss has higher health wins.

Other Info:
Lord BOSS:
When only one BOSS appears, it will stays at the back of the battlefield. When the Bosses of both sides appear, they will move to the center of the battlefield.
The match ends when the Boss of any side is defeated. The side that defeats the enemy's Boss achieves the final victory.

Units:
The units used in this mode are all provided by the system. When the Heroes die, they will lose all the units they have acquired, and at the same time, they will receive three random troops. Only the units on the battlefield will be retained when heroes respawn, and any other units previously obtained will be lost.

Chest:
When Heroes or Vanguard are defeated, they drop a treasure chest. Heroes who pick up the chest gain an additional random unit and an effect that increases maximum health for 30 seconds. Before the BOSS appears, collecting treasure chests will further increase the BOSS's health.

Rewards:
During the opening period of [Demon Showdown], you can obtain the special event item [Fruity Candy] by participating in this game mode. notes.title: [Legendary Poleaxe] The Fateful Judgement You Cannot Escape From
notes.content:
Halloween Event Time: 10/31 - 11/20, for 21 days
 
When the ancient power reawakens, the Black Knight's scythe spreads death across the land.
In the face of this unspeakable horror, mortals once faltered.
The heroes conquered their fear of death, repelled the darkness with courage and faith, and restored light to the land.
If it was you who were faced with the destined judgment, what choice would you make?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ea4f7a0146244dcc1f3e950bebf1d33d9c6a08e9.jpg
Legendary Poleaxe [Destiny Judgment] is Making its Debut!
 
Background Story
[previewyoutube=GKeRAuazhiw;full][/previewyoutube]
Mortals always fear death, for it is the fairest rule in the world. It cares not for poverty, wealth, kindness, or evil.
When death approaches, thus, mortals turn devout, begin to pray, sacrifice, and descend into madness, all to delay its arrival.
Yet death never halts its stride, following the path destiny dictates, bringing fate to the chosen.
[Destiny Judgment] -- The bearer of this scythe will become death's envoy, just like the Dark Knight of old -- where the Dark Knight descends, death alone is revered, and all malevolent spirits find no refuge.
 
Design Reference
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4faeda8058181cf69b61e218b1a4e276d1601b4d.jpg
The poleaxe curves slightly, resembling a scythe more in shape.
It’s adorned with an armored ram's head to emphasize a “demonic” image. In many legends, scythes are known as the weapons of death, symbols of judgment and fate, wielding the power to decide the fate of others, steeped in a sense of destiny.
 
Acquisition Method
You can acquire it in [G] - [Abyss Nightmare] Attire Chest. Wield the Poleaxe of Destiny in the name of death and enforce judgment on your enemies!

notes.title: [Lionfire] New Map Spotlight: Star Bastion
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UV_sxBTLWtA;full][/previewyoutube]

Map Structure
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c0094fc7513d501998014c66040bca5ab3ea1236.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d7469ebc9e88ea895c1022400062a28aa11a2510.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c03ce5669d893509931514ec0bb9f24e51e51e2a.jpg

The battlefield includes two parts: the trenches outside the city walls and the streets and alleys within, connected by bastion walls and sloped terrain. The outer city area dominates the map more than in the previous siege maps.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5d63ff90a7c5e886e82a08b7fa485979d4d86f3c.jpg

There are four significant strategic targets: Point A, one Trebuchet strategic point, and two supply points. All can be occupied by the attacker from the beginning of the battle.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f13fe613841691eb4b0fcf30fb2de9208122af9d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4e90ccc7cff00db95f20e754379ad68b48c4c286.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4f16dd4d85bb5a11fce4f7f3cf3690ca510abebd.jpg

After Point A is seized, there will be three primary paths leading into the inner city: one requires repairing the Point A drawbridge to directly access the city's supplies, another demands breaching the city walls to reach the strategic point atop the triangular bastion, and the last one winds covertly at a corner of the city walls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4e90ccc7cff00db95f20e754379ad68b48c4c286.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9ea61a96a7e737e882e79a6e58cf936205a118ba.jpg

Within the city area, a double-layered structure of corridors divides it. The main base flag and defensive safe zone for the defenders are on one side of the corridor, while on the other side, away from the main base flag, lies a contested supply point.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5d47f3dc7b730960bcb470fc132b07eb528005a6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fb9e38819978fe9bce986ff728b888617a1837d4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c03ce5669d893509931514ec0bb9f24e51e51e2a.jpg

Map Mechanism
The attacker gains access to the trebuchet upon capturing the first strategic point on the map, granting them one use count. Capturing the second strategic point resets the trebuchet's use count back to one.
 
Aiming phase: the trebuchet has a larger aiming range. It will marks multiple enemy players within its range for a time, with the mark revealed to all.
 
Launching phase: once the aiming ceases, the trebuchet hurls fiery stones towards the target's center and the marked players' final positions, the stones unguided in the air.

notes.title: Battle-Ready: Fully-Equipped Wuxing Pikemen and Palace Guards at Your Command!
notes.content:
Hi Warlords,
 [Lionfire] season has now reached the Age of Kingdoms, with more powerful units joining the battlefield, making it even more unpredictable.
 
Now, the Global Battle Brawl is underway. With the dawn of a truly global battlefield, we’re more than ready to welcome new warlords. It’s time to rally more warlords to fight together! New warlords, don’t be intimidated by the battle-hardened veterans, because---supplies are fully stocked and waiting for you! For new warlords stepping onto the battlefield, these supplies will help you grow quickly. And for veterans, these new warlords will bring fresh blood to you, giving you the edge needed to lead your troops to victory in the battle!

Newbie Wuxing Pikemen Gift
[previewyoutube=kU7IFwnfomg;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Purchasing this bundle will grant you the unit: Wuxing Pikemen. The Wuxing Pikemen is large in number, wielding a special weapon: Wuxing Spear. This weapon actually existed in ancient China.
These mighty warriors carried spears fitted with tubes that sprayed iron pellets and flames when ignited. In battle, a simple stab, a lunge, would be followed by fire, iron and destruction.
Later generations mused that while the Wuxing Pikemen consisted of mostly untrained villagers, their spears of fire remained ever-victorious for twenty whole years.
 
  Additionally, the Wuxing Pikemen in this bundle comes with the following features:


Purchase to get a fully-cultivated unit: Starts at level 18, ready for battle, saving significant time on leveling up.

Equipped with Doctrines: We've equipped the Wuxing Pikemen with some Rare-quality Doctrines: [Rare Life Doctrine], [Breakthrough Doctrine], [Rare Piercing Damage Doctrine], [Rare Piercing Doctrine], and [Wuxing Blood Doctrine], specifically enhancing their survivability.

Price: 108 sovereigns ($1.08)

Unit Background


The greatest heroes serve the country and its people. Whenever the nation is in peril and the land is in turmoil, there are always valiant heroes who step forward to save the country from disaster.

Unit Skills


[Wuxing Blast]: The unit fires their fire pikes, each soldier sending three blasts of fragments and shoots into the enemy. This can cause bleed damage.

[Fiery Blast]: The unit uses their fire pikes as short-ranged flamethrowers, setting enemies alight and causing chaos.

 
Unit Strategy


The Wuxing Pikemen can swiftly deal massive damage to densely packed enemy units during siege battles, making them ideal for pairing with frontline troops to break through concentrated enemy formations. In ground combat, their [Swamp] attribute enables them to hold their own even against cavalry.

After charging the enemy, the Wuxing Pikemen can use [Fiery Blast] to ignite enemies, followed by [Wuxing Blast] to cause continuous attacks on the enemy.

 
[previewyoutube=Lj3XaWqRJUU;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Purchase to get a fully-cultivated unit: Palace Guards. Other than enduring great damage on the battlefield, they can also bitterly hit their enemies. Additionally, the Palace Guards in this bundle comes with the following features:


Purchase to get a fully-cultivated unit: Starts at level 24, ready for battle, saving significant time on leveling up.

All unit mastery nodes are fully unlocked, there is no need to invest hundreds of scrolls of mastery to unlock them.

Equipped with Doctrines: It comes with five Rare-quality Doctrines to comprehensively enhance the combat effectiveness of the palace guards.

Price: Price: 540 sovereigns ($5.4)

Unit Background
The name ‘Palace Guards’ embodies resilience and determination. They are the elite troops most relied upon by the dynasty in the central plains. With their high defense, the Palace Guards can advance as the vanguard or retreat to cover the rear, making them a versatile force in both offense and defense. On the battlefield, they often play a crucial role in frontline combat and positional defense, earning them the title of the Empire’s Wall.
 
Unit Skills


[Shield Rush]: Order your unit to charge in a designated direction, inflicting high damage on enemies hit along the way. Charging soldiers takes less damage.

[Patient Snipers]: The unit immediately takes a defensive stance, reducing charge damage taken from the front. It also gets control immunity for 5 seconds. Attacking enemies while in this state will increase the amount of damage dealt.

Unit Strategy


With high defense, the Palace Guards can advance as a vanguard or fall back to cover the rear, making them a versatile unit for both offense and defense. On the battlefield, they often play a key role in front-line conflicts and positional defense.

When facing polearm infantry, use Shield Rush to rush the enemy, then follow up with Patient Snipers by crouching to absorb the first wave of damage. Afterward, use the second skill to deal massive damage in an instant.

When facing a cavalry charge, the Palace Guards can quickly crouch using Patient Snipers before engaging the enemy, avoiding being directly trampled. This makes them one of the few swordsmen capable of fighting cavalry head-on.

After learning shield, the Palace Guards' defensive capabilities are greatly enhanced. In narrow terrains like stairs or alleys, forming a shield can effectively block the frontlines, making them a powerful force that can hold off numerous enemies.

Limited-time Attire Sale
 
Overlord Attire：Great armour for a great warrior, a warlord who has earned his fame in countless battles.


Outfit Suggestion: The weapons that best match this attire are naturally Longsword & Shield. A Longsword & Shield knight wearing the Overlord Attire, they are the backbone of the battlefield.

Limited-time Price: 108 Sovereigns ($1.08)

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/05bb9c8aee21017e104ceab60b55bc2214553118.png
 
Varangian Attire：The splendid outfit of the Emperor's personal bodyguards.


Outfit Suggestion: Varangian Attire is an Eastern-style armor set, featuring a white-gray color scheme with a blue cloak. Wearing this armor, using Eastern weapons feels natural, but the most fitting weapon is Glaive. Inside Wall Fort stands a statue of a Glaive dressed in Varangian Attire.

Limited-time Price: 510 Sovereigns（$5.1）

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/513078f426b6e7d74bfb87569e26e6f6249ae28c.png
 
Titan Dread Attire：The legends of the Calamity knight vary across different regions. Among the people of Pays-de-la-Gloire, the most famous story is about a knight who broke away from his companions to help the suffering people of Pays-de-la-Gloire. Perhaps it was the beauty of the people of Pays-de-la-Gloire land or the charm of a lovely maiden that awakened the benevolence in the once brutal Calamity Knight, transforming him into the ‘Titan Dread Knight’ who punished the wicked and upheld justice. In his final moments, he turned into red soil, merging with the land he protected. Later, people of Pays-de-la-Gloire, who also revered the chivalric spirit, crafted armor named after the Titan Dread Knight to honor the legend.
 


Outfit Suggestion: The Titan Dread Attire combines fantasy and romance, with its gold-trimmed battle-worn style perfectly complementing the tattered dark red cloak. The V-shaped visor of the helmet adds a dragon knight aesthetic. Its versatile style pairs well with a variety of weapons, as long as the color scheme matches.

Limited-time Price: 1100 Sovereigns（$11）

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4f9e1d96716555e285edbc8debb84e21725ed6ee.png
 
Draconic Set：This set bears the image of the Royal Dragon, suitable for an honoured warrior.


Outfit Suggestion: The horse Brunellus with its reddish-brown coat is perfectly suited for draconic set.

Limited-time Price: 108 Sovereigns ($1.08)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b46dc6ecc51ebf7b3e0a2bd9473a6a549f07d523.png
Ducal Set：Burnished oak and silvered chainmail convey the wealth & refinement of the lands from whence this set comes.


Outfit Suggestion: The all-black horses Dark Light and Night Charger, along with the ducal set featuring large segments of chainmail, are highly compatible.

Limited-time Price: 108 Sovereigns ($1.08)

 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3702aff6f5fcc963d9584f8b639391901d828ffc.png
 
Pirate Horse Set：Adorned with nautical paraphrenalia such as rope netting, shells of sea creatures, sail cloth and a miniature ship's wheel.


Outfit Suggestion: The Pirate Horse Set is recommended to be paired with the white horse Flying Snow.

Limited-time Price: 1680 Sovereigns（$16.8）

notes.title: New Horizons, New Battles—Two-week global events are here!
notes.content:
Hi warlords,
The time has come to enter a new chapter in Conqueror’s Blade history—welcome to the age of global operations! With the merge of our Steam and official website, we want to create an even more connected and vibrant community. To celebrate this milestone, we have a ton of rewards lined up, including free attire, treatises, and special offers for new warlords to kickstart their CB’s journey.
 
But wait, there’s more—many of you have been asking, “When can I battle it out with players from the East? Will cross-region matchmaking ever happen?” Here you are, warlords. Get ready to dive into our Global Battle Brawl，where we‘re trying to bring a truly global ecosystem to the battlefield.
 
Global Battle Brawl
Now, you’ll be able to clash against warlords from the East. In the past CBL global conference, we witnessed a thrilling tournament between the Western and Eastern champions, with the final victory claimed by the team from the East. This clearly shows the strength of the Eastern warlords. However, the opportunity to challenge them has come again!
 
With global operations underway, the momentum is building, and warlords around the world are gearing up for this global battle brawl. Are you ready to challenge the warlords of the East and claim your place in Conqueror’s Blade history? The battlefield awaits.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6b94228023b8f6fd3b8c5c63061843a0541eaa10.jpg
 
Rules of global battle Brawl
During the event, warlords with a character level of 40 or higher can participate in the [Global Battle Brawl] in three timeslots via [J] - [Events].


Each region has independent event entrances: Global Battle Brawl (APAC), Global Battle Brawl (AMS) and Global Battle Brawl (EU).

Warlords from other regions may experience higher network latency when participating in the cross-regional event.

Time: 2024/9/29 after maintenance - 2024/10/10 before maintenance

 
50 Ancient Treatises Await!
 
War is on the horizon, and every warlord needs to be battle-ready. To ensure you’re fully equipped for the challenges ahead, we’ve secured 50 Ancient Treatise just for you! Simply log in daily to claim them. Arm yourself, rally your troops, and let the clash of steel and roar of battle echo across the world! 
 
Time: 2024/9/29 after maintenance - 2024/10/17 before maintenance
 


Note: The Ancient Treatise can only be used by War Scholar for【The Conqueror's Reckoning】. 【The Conqueror's Reckoning】 has a chance to obtain the following doctrines: [ Epic Leadership Doctrine], [Epic Combat Doctrine], [Tactic: Trench Warfare], [Devastation], [Artemis], [Sword Cavalry Battle Doctrine], [Epic Spear Doctrine VI], [Epic Polearm Doctrine IV]

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/775e77b69431a417b68b1529c86cfa570a180ce4.png
Moonchase Ode Acquisitor Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8f6173df42d142d522572f8d401d7a6709318e8e.jpg
 
In the world of CB, West and East may be separated by time and distance, just like the Sun and Moon, representing two sides of the same world. When you’re marching under the blazing Sun, your Eastern rivals are already moving in the calm of the Moonlit night. However, the battlefield unites us all.
 
Together, they reflect the global harmony we’re striving for—one where warlords from every region clash and compete, day or night, in a truly unified battlefield. The war is endless, but now, the stage is set for you to shine—whether under the Sun or the Moon!
 
And speaking of Sun and Moon—did you know that there’s an ancient myth in China about it? This ancient myth inspired us, and that’s how the [Sunset Ode] (Male) and [Moonlight Serenade] (Female) were born---symbolizing the eternal clash and connection between two different worlds.
 
Now, brand new epic hero attire [Sunset Ode] (Male) and [Moonlight Serenade] (Female) are online. Warlords can obtain rewards for free through the in-game event [Battlefield Treasures: Moon Pursuit].
 
The design of this outfit is inspired by an ancient myth of a legendary archer and his beloved. In the tale, the world was scorched by ten suns blazing in the sky. A young warrior took up his bow and, with unmatched skill, shot down nine of the fiery suns, bringing peace back to the world. As a reward, the gods gifted him a potion of immortality and a suit of divine armor.
 
But the story took a tragic turn. The warrior disappeared from history, rumored to have left on a quest to reunite with his lost love, who accidentally consumed the potion and ascended alone to the moon. Thus, the lovers were eternally separated. One roams the earth, while the other is bound to the moon—forever apart, yet eternally longing for each other.
 
Time: 9/29 after maintenance - 10/20, 00:00. Rewards can be exchanged for until 10/24.
 
Newbie Bundles for You to Kickstart The Glory
 
Of course, with the dawn of a truly global battlefield, we’re more than ready to welcome new warlords. It’s time to rally more warlords to fight together! New warlords, don’t be intimidated by the battle-hardened veterans, because---supplies are fully stocked and waiting for you! For new warlords stepping onto the battlefield, these supplies will help you grow quickly. And for veterans, these new warlords will bring fresh blood to you, giving you the edge needed to lead your troops to victory in the battle!

notes.title: A New Era of Conquest：Territory Wars Reforged!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/049b3cd14d74a065290be1b25dfb943039561030.png
Greetings warlords!
Remember the promise we made during the livestream? To stay active, never stop improving, and always keep iterating? Well, we're holding true to our word. The upcoming season, launching on September 19th, heralds a new era for Conqueror's Blade, inspired by none other than Gustav II Adolf, the "Father of Modern Warfare" himself. Just as he revolutionized 17th-century warfare, we're about to unleash a wave of updates and reforms that will reshape the very foundation of Territory Wars.
 
Conquering the Past, Building the Future
The Open World and its Territory Wars have witnessed the rise and fall of countless warlords and Houses. It's a core part of the Conqueror's Blade experience, and now it's time for a major evolution. Our goal is clear: to deliver a more enjoyable and engaging Territory War experience for all warlords through impactful content updates and strategic rule adjustments.
 
No More Slot Blocking: Taking Action Now!
Earlier this month, we addressed the elephant in the room – the long-standing frustration with "Slot Blocking." Your feedback on the proposed adjustments was heard loud and clear, and we're happy to confirm that these changes will be officially implemented in the new season of Territory Wars.
 
This is just the beginning. We're committed to open communication and taking decisive action on the issues that matter most to you. Expect ongoing adjustments, optimizations, and a constant drive to create a better gaming environment for everyone. Keep that feedback coming!
 
The King is Present, His Spirit Inspires!
Gustav II Adolf wasn't just a military genius; he was the "Lion of the North", a fearless leader who inspired his troops to achieve the unthinkable. From securing his throne at the age of 17 to facing down the might of the Holy Roman Empire, his victories echoed across Europe. And while his star may have fallen too soon at the Battle of Lützen, his legacy of tactical brilliance and unwavering courage lives on.
 
This legacy is at the heart of the new Territory War battlefield rule: King of the Battlefield!
 
Here's how it works:
For Houses:


Lead the Charge: When a House Leader enters a Territory War battle, they'll be marked for all to see. Their presence will inspire all warlords and units from their House on the battlefield, granting them the "King of the Battlefield" buff. This buff increases damage against enemy units, scaling with the House level up to a mighty 10%.


Avenge the Fallen: Should a House Leader fall in battle, their sacrifice will not be in vain. An announcement will ring out across the battlefield, and the "King of the Battlefield" buff will transform into the even more potent "Glory and Vengeance" buff. This enhanced buff doubles the damage increase, also scaling with the House level up to a devastating 20%!


The inspiration for this "Damage Buff upon House Leader's Death" mechanic comes directly from the Battle of Lützen, where the Swedish army, fueled by the rallying cry of "Avenge the King!", turned the tide and achieved a hard-fought victory.
 
We know what you're thinking, House Leaders – "Time to become a glorious, buff-granting sacrifice!" And you know what? We wouldn't have it any other way.
 
For Cohorts:


Strength in Unity: When a Cohort Commander enters a Territory War battle, they too will be marked, inspiring their comrades. All warlords and units from their Cohort on the battlefield will receive the "King of the Battlefield" buff, increasing their damage against enemy units by a solid 10%.


Fight to the Last: If a Cohort Leader falls, their Cohort will lose the "King of the Battlefield" buff. But the fight is far from over!



 

Gustav's Legacy: Fueling the War Machine
Gustav II Adolf's Sweden was a nation forged in iron and driven by innovation. Their abundant copper and iron ore resources fueled a military industrial complex that was ahead of its time. To reflect this, Season 20 brings the following changes:


Resource Boom: The reserves and production rate of all Copper and Iron Ore in the Dasuo region will be increased by 20% and 10% respectively.


Artillery Primed: The crafting material cost of Field Artillery and Mortars will be reduced by 20%.


Mobile Artillery: The Open World movement speed when carrying both a Field Artillery and a Mortar will be increased from 2.8 to 3.5.



 

An Army Marches on Its Stomach: Logistics Redefined
You may have heard whispers of "supply lines" and "supply depots" from our developers in recent livestreams. Well, those whispers are about to become a reality. Logistics have always been the backbone of any successful military campaign, and Gustav II Adolf knew this better than most. That's why Supply Line Rules and Supply Depots are coming to Territory Wars in a major way.
We'll be diving deep into the specifics of these mechanics soon, but for now, just know this: Supply Lines and Supply Depots will add a whole new layer of strategic depth and decision-making to Territory Wars. Keep an eye out for their arrival in the Open World within the next month!
 
This is Just the Beginning
These changes represent a bold step forward for Territory Wars, inspired by the strategic genius of Gustav II Adolf. But this is just the beginning. We're committed to continuous improvement, to listening to your feedback, and to making Conqueror's Blade the best it can be.
 
Get ready, Warlords. The battlefield is about to change forever.

notes.title: LIONFIRE - New Season Starts Now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nK38j4gvu9I;full][/previewyoutube]
1. Season Units
T3 Reitar Pistoleers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/52cd068db6a34decf0c57c19e955a383ce13fbde.jpg
Background Story:


During the brutal thirty-year war, a gunpowder revolution took root. Knights from the Rhineland region shed their heavy armor, retaining only essential defenses, abandoning their lances in favor of matchlock guns for combat. Employing a stately caracole tactic, they relied more on firearm than charges. However, Gustav II Adolf took a different approach. He instructed his Rhineland cuirassiers to forsake the tactic and the cumbersome long muskets, opting instead to engage fearlessly with short ones at close range before unsheathing their swords to charge.
  "The cuirassiers of Rilmore do not open fire until they see the whites of their enemy's eyes." Such were the words of a general who witnessed firsthand these cuirassiers firing at point-blank range, then drawing their cavalry swords to ruthlessly cut down their mechanically advancing enemies who adhered to the caracole tactic. Amidst the chaos of war, where the desperate seek life, this unit seemed to resurrect the fearless charging stance on the battlefield, a century after the fully armored knights had succumbed to gunpowder defeat.

Battle Tactics:


Although the cuirassier is few in number, they are well-equipped. Each soldier is armed with a pair of improved short muskets and a knight sword, with armor that does not hinder shooting or close combat for protection. As the mainstay of the Gustavian military reforms, the cuirassiers differ from conventional heavy cavalry and dragoon musketeers. They utilize their mobility and advanced pistols to harass enemy formations, swiftly piercing through enemy lines like lightning at the opportune moment, unleashing specialized bullets and expert swordsmanship upon their foes. Much like a lion tearing into its prey, they instill fear and dread in the enemy ranks.

Unit Traits:


Carrying a pair of improved pistols, they can freely and flexibly shoot, and use special bullets to deal burst damage.

Close-range shooting could be highly destructive and has a controlling effect on target units.

Skill Design:


Skill 1: Roar of Powder (Utilize special bullets to shoot a powerful round at the target.)

Skill 2: Tearing Strike (Utilize the knight sword for several fierce thrusts at close range.)

T4 Swinefeathers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/700880175c5b1a823d24d56819887cc143a06c36.jpg
Background Story:


In the long years of war, if one were to ask which kind of people were most common, the answer would undoubtedly be the mercenaries who traversed between various factions. These seasoned arquebusiers never fought for honor; rather, they viewed chaos as a ladder, aiming to seize fame in the midst of conflict. The northern nation, with its small territory and a population fewer than the Rhineland states, found itself in greater need of their strength to partake in this grand war. Interestingly, these fickle mercenaries ended up staying within the army of the Northern Lion, even becoming the backbone of the military. In their own words: "
  "We can smell victory here." Gustav II Adolf devised new tactics for these experienced veterans. Utilizing rapid maneuvers and shooting, their great gunpower can overwhelm enemies many times their number. When cavalry charged like a torrent, they would counter with their swinefeather spears, sending the enemy straight to hell. These veterans, who had brushed shoulders with death countless times, were adept at handling any situation on the battlefield.
  "You lads, stick with me! There may be plenty of kings in this world, but there's only one who knows how to fight."" — Mercenary leader, Monroe.

Battle Tactics:


They are composed of British mercenaries recruited by Sweden, capable of repelling enemies with portable anti-horse stakes and inflicting significant casualties on the enemy using modern volley fire techniques. They maintain strict military discipline, possess exquisite skills, and fully utilize the Gustavian formation's tactic of firing in lines. The portable pigtail gun stock they carry provides significant assistance for their precise shooting. Moreover, when they insert the gun stock into the ground, forming variously shaped anti-horse stakes, the strategic value is self-evident, forcing would-be aggressors to disarm and surrender.

Unit Traits:


Having relatively short attack range but powerful burst damage, strict military discipline, and exquisite skills.

Having a gunstock provides higher accuracy, but when the gunstock is inserted into the ground, it generates Cheval de Frise sufficient to deter enemies.

Skill Design:


Skill 1: Attack Area (continuous shooting into a designated area)

Skill 2: Triple Shooting (Six column formation instantly transforms into three columns, then opens fire simultaneously, providing powerful firepower suppression to the target area.)

Skill 3: Cheval de Frise (insert the butt into the ground within a certain range to form a strong Cheval de Frise)

 
T5 Lionroar Crew
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c78e25a91aecc42de4371ef74f3d6be352e3ea4c.jpg
Background Story:


During the era of wars, cannons were commonly used by all nations. However, among the military leaders, it was only Gustav II Adolf who saw cannons as the core of revolutionizing warfare in that age. He handpicked the best of his country's officers and formed a dedicated artillery unit. The establishment of an independent artillery unit was an unprecedented initiative. During that time, military commanders of various countries often viewed cannons as cumbersome heavy artillery, which lack mobility. However, the king believed that by modifying the cannons themselves to overcome their mobility issues, cannons would become the decisive weapons of the next era's battlefield. He shortened the cannon barrels, lightened the carriages, and standardized the production of cannon parts. Consequently, that northern nation's artillery units could deploy and move cannons at any time and place. The excellent battlefield judgment and combat determination of artillery officers also made this unit a undefeatable force in Western world of that time.

Those who surpass are always blessed by the era. This unit, along with their king, became legends of that era, with their cannon fire described by poets as the "roar of a lion," shaking their enemies.

Battle Tactics:
After setting up the artillery at the appropriate location, push it to the front line; while using the pistol to guard against enemy sneak attacks, pour high-density shotgun shells at the enemy.
Unit Traits:
Set up a powerful cannon, with fifteen soldiers divided into three artillery teams, launching dense and numerous shotgun shells to saturate the enemy with firepower.
Skill Design:
Skill 1:


Set Up Artillery (Set up the artillery at the designated location)

Move Artillery (Move the artillery to the designated location)

Skill 2:


Attack Area (Immediately fire at the designated location)

Skill 3:


Defensive Shooting (Shoot the nearest enemy with a pistol)

 
2. Conqueror's Path


Rank 0: Aurora's Glory

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/51a9c84b262578e22f9c7e16faa722714705f5fa.jpg


Rank 100: Northern Lion

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ccebf85fb925533c804bce252e61f75dc19bcf4f.jpg
3. Seasonal Store


Attires from the Knightfall season will be returning to the Seasonal Store for the duration of the Lionfire season. These will be available at a 20% [Badges of Heroism] discount.


Antique Greycloak Zealot Attire will now cost 2,000 instead of 2,500.

Weapon attire of the Eternal season returns


4. World Map Update
Territory War Battlefield Mechanism - "Warrior King"


Against the Houses


When the Liege participates in the territory war, all the warlords and units of the house on the battlefield will receive the "Warrior King" buff, which increases the damage dealt to enemy units by a certain percentage.

If the Liege dies on the battlefield, all warlords and units of the house on the battlefield will lose the "Warrior King" buff and gain the "Glory Revenge" buff.

The "Glory Revenge" buff increases damage by twice the original "Warrior King" buff and lasts for 30 seconds.

The damage enhancement effect of "Warrior King" and "Glory Revenge" buffs increases with the increase in house level, and the specific bonuses are as follows


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7ce2aa3f44c53ec2d27523a80e794064e12096b1.jpg


When the Liege enters the battlefield and dies in battle, there will be broadcast information.


The Liege of the house will be specially marked on the battlefield.


Against the Imperial Restorationists


When the commander of the Imperial Restorationists participates in the territorial battlefield, all the warlords and units of the Imperial Restorationists in the battlefield gain the "Warrior King" buff, increasing damage to enemy troops by 10%.

When the commander of the Imperial Restorationists dies in the battlefield, all the warlords and units of the guard in the battlefield lose the "Warrior King" buff, without triggering any other buffs.

There will be broadcast information when the commander of the Imperial Restorationists enters the battlefield or dies in the battlefield.

The commander of the Imperial Restorationists will be marked specially in the battlefield.


Resource Rules during the Lionfire Season


The reserves of all copper and iron mines in the Ostaria region increase by 20%, and the extraction rates of copper and iron increase by 10%.

The resource consumption for crafting all culverins and mortars has been reduced by 20%.

notes.title: Transition of players from the Western Steam page
notes.content:
Effective on September 19th (UTC+8) the original Poros Interactive Steam Page and the website conquerorsblade.com become official global channels of the game.

The Western Steam Page and the website global.conquerorsblade.com of Conqueror's Blade are retired. 
If you previously played on Western Steam Page, your Steam Achievements will be replicated and given to you on the Poros page. 

We also value the effort and time you put into your Steam Community content, such as screenshots, guides, messages, so we preserve them on our website and you can find them by following this link: https://conquerorsblade.com/en/media/


To play the game, simply find “Conqueror’s Blade” in your Steam library by typing “conqueror’s blade.” You will be able to locate the game in your Games library. After downloading and launching the game, you will be able to access your in-game character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b1b8c82b1725f4a4c636d83fa640d05d4d465cbe.jpg

For accounts that already have a character:
1. Area 1: The last login information will be displayed based on the server and character selected during the last login.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ef6327473a7e2ae5f9f045cd7ac2251f9b5eff91.jpg

2. Area 2: This area shows the regions to which each server belongs, including Asia, Middle East, EU, and AM. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9ada5b685d26c524d35ccb1108faffbd7ca48c7b.jpg

- The region of the server last logged into by this account will be selected by default.
3. Area 3: This area displays specific server information, including server name, server progress, server status, server latency, and character account information. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7d34b4dde20356d031807be600cdcf5870774f0a.jpg

The server list is sorted in the following order of priority:
- Character Presence: Servers with characters will be ranked higher.
- Character Level: Servers with higher-level characters will be ranked higher.
- Recommended Server: Recommended servers will be ranked first. 
- Latency: Servers with lower latency will be ranked higher.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1fe683020ef7eef12e59dd8fe4ed9d4eba1845e7.jpg

Below you can find frequently asked questions regarding the process of unification. 

Section 1: General Questions

1. Q: Why are we unifying Steam Pages and Websites?
Answer: The unification aims to create a more cohesive and streamlined experience, enhance community engagement, and simplify access to game features.

2. Q: What advantages does unification offer?
  Answer: There are multiple advantages: 
  - The introduction of time-limited events for cross-server matchmaking.
  - Enabling players to connect and add friends from different servers.
  - Launching time-limited events for cross-server Territory Wars.
  - Offering a unified platform for in-game purchases and transactions.
  - Hosting Twitch Drops on the unified website.
  - Providing a centralized location for all game-related announcements.
  - Standardizing English localization for a consistent gameplay experience.

Section 2: Steam Pages' Unification

3. Q: I already play on the original Poros Steam Page. Do I need to take any actions?
Answer:
  - No, you can keep playing as usual. 
  
4. Q: What will happen if I play on the Western Page? (EU/NA) 
Answer: 
  - On September 19th when searching for "Conqueror's Blade" you will see the unified Steam page (original Poros Interactive page), and won't be able to find the previously-used page of NA/EU (originally MY.GAMES' page)
  - You will be able to download the game and play as usual from the original Poros Page. 
  
5. Q: Do I need to re-download the game from scratch again? Why? 
  Answer: 
  - Yes, a complete download will be required. After researching possibilities of avoiding that together with the Steam staff, we confirmed that Steam platform functionality does not allow us to avoid this process, and a full re-download is required. 
  
6. Q: Do I need to take any extra actions to start playing? 
   Answer: 
  - Just download and play, as usual. No extra actions are required. 

7. Q: What benefits does the unified global Steam page offer?
  Answer:
  - Enhanced interregional connectivity and community interaction.
  - Ability to share content and engage with players from different regions.

8. Q: Will my community activity and reviews on the Western (ex MY.GAMES) Steam Page be removed? 
Answer: 
  - None of the content from the Western page will be removed, but you won't be able to access that Steam page because it will become innactive. 
  
9. Q: Achievements on Steam - what will happen to them? 
Answer: 
  - Your Steam Achievements will be duplicated to the Poros Unified Steam page, and you will receive those achievements in the following days after September 19th 

Section 3: Websites' Unification

10. Q: Why are we transitioning to conquerorsblade.com as the official website?
Answer: The transition aims to centralize game news and information, simplify account systems, and enable the development of new features.

11. Q: Does it mean that I can't visit global.conquerosblade.com any longer? 
Answer: You will be able to browse global.conquerorsblade.com, but it will automatically redirect you to conquerorsblade.com 

12. Q: What will happen to my Web Inventory/items/top-up money? 
  Answer:  All items/top-ups, other data will be transferred automatically. No actions on your side required. 
  
13. Q: Do I need to transfer my Web Account data to the new website? 
Answer: No, the process will be automatic. After September 19th, you can login to conquerorsblade.com with the same credentials as you used on global.conquerorsblade.com 

14. Q: How will Twitch Drops work? 
Answer: After unification of websites, you will be able to visit your Twitch Drops Cabinet and claim items from future campaigns. 

Section 4: Impact on Gameplay
15. Q: How will unification impact my in-game experience?
Answer: 
  - Players can befriend others from different regions.
  - Players will be able to create groups (parties) including players from other servers.
  - Unified in-game events and prices for consistent experience.
  - Unified voice overs with language choices available within the game 
  - Upcoming cross-server gameplay events and functionality. 

Please stay tuned for the exciting in-game and community events, rewards that we've prepared for the global unification of the game. 

Yours, 
Conqueror's Blade Team

notes.title: [Lionfire] Season Unit Spotlight_ Lionroar Crew (T5)
notes.content:
Gustav II Adolf, the innovative genius of artillery tactics. He devoted himself to streamlining the army and optimizing equipment, successfully turning artillery into an independent branch of the military, closely cooperating with infantry, cavalry, and logistics teams to improve tactical execution efficiency.
This artillery unit, composed of local Swedish warriors, was the first independent artillery force in the Western world. Their name, along with Gustav's glorious achievements on the battlefield, together became an eternal memorial.
 
Unit inspiration


During the era of wars, cannons were commonly used by all nations. However, among the military leaders, it was only Gustav II Adolf who saw cannons as the core of revolutionizing warfare in that age. He handpicked the best of his country's officers and formed a dedicated artillery unit. The establishment of an independent artillery unit was an unprecedented initiative. During that time, military commanders of various countries often viewed cannons as cumbersome heavy artillery, which lack mobility. However, the king believed that by modifying the cannons themselves to overcome their mobility issues, cannons would become the decisive weapons of the next era's battlefield. He shortened the cannon barrels, lightened the carriages, and standardized the production of cannon parts. Consequently, that northern nation's artillery units could deploy and move cannons at any time and place. The excellent battlefield judgment and combat determination of artillery officers also made this unit a undefeatable force in Western world of that time.


Those who surpass are always blessed by the era. This unit, along with their king, became legends of that era, with their cannon fire described by poets as the "roar of a lion," shaking their enemies.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e7b7174fad9cf9fcddf84e37ebf7b97cc7bf194f.jpg
 
Featured Gameplay


Deploying powerful artillery, fifteen soldiers are divided into three artillery groups, firing dense and numerous shells at the enemy to create a saturation attack.


 
Unit skill
Skill 1:


Set Up Artillery (Set up the artillery at the designated location)


Move Artillery (Move the artillery to the designated location)


Skill 2:


Attack Area (Immediately fire at the designated location)


Skill 3:


Defensive Shooting (Shoot the nearest enemy with a pistol)

notes.title: Season Unit Spotlight_ Swinefeathers (T4)
notes.content:
[Lionfire] Season Unit Spotlight: Swinefeathers (T4)
In the early 17th century, a new era of warfare dawned. Gustav II Adolf of Sweden revolutionized the battlefield with his innovative use of linear infantry tactics. His armies, organized into lines of disciplined musketeers, could unleash a devastating barrage of fire, leaving a profound impact on Europe. By the latter stages of the Thirty Years' War, both the Habsburg Empire and the Electors of the Rhine had adopted similar reforms, forever changing the face of warfare.

Background Story:


In the long years of war, if one were to ask which kind of people were most common, the answer would undoubtedly be the mercenaries who traversed between various factions. These seasoned arquebusiers never fought for honor; rather, they viewed chaos as a ladder, aiming to seize fame in the midst of conflict. The northern nation, with its small territory and a population fewer than the Rhineland states, found itself in greater need of their strength to partake in this grand war. Interestingly, these fickle mercenaries ended up staying within the army of the Northern Lion, even becoming the backbone of the military. In their own words: "


"We can smell victory here." Gustav II Adolf devised new tactics for these experienced veterans. Utilizing rapid maneuvers and shooting, their great gunpower can overwhelm enemies many times their number. When cavalry charged like a torrent, they would counter with their swinefeather spears, sending the enemy straight to hell. These veterans, who had brushed shoulders with death countless times, were adept at handling any situation on the battlefield.
"You lads, stick with me! There may be plenty of kings in this world, but there's only one who knows how to fight." — Mercenary leader, Monroe. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b82f91253b8447434f18fc14acc3424611d10505.jpg
Unit Inspiration:


They are composed of British mercenaries recruited by Sweden, capable of repelling enemies with portable anti-horse stakes and inflicting significant casualties on the enemy using modern volley fire techniques. They maintain strict military discipline, possess exquisite skills, and fully utilize the Gustavian formation's tactic of firing in lines. The portable pigtail gun stock they carry provides significant assistance for their precise shooting. Moreover, when they insert the gun stock into the ground, forming variously shaped anti-horse stakes, the strategic value is self-evident, forcing would-be aggressors to disarm and surrender.


Featured Gameplay:


Having relatively short attack range but powerful burst damage, strict military discipline, and exquisite skills.


Having a gunstock provides higher accuracy, but when the gunstock is inserted into the ground, it generates Cheval de Frise sufficient to deter enemies.


Unit skill:


Skill 1: Attack Area (continuous shooting into a designated area)


Skill 2: Gale Strike (Six column formation instantly transforms into three columns, then opens fire simultaneously, providing powerful firepower suppression to the target area.)


Skill 3: Spears & Thorns (insert the butt into the ground within a certain range to form a strong Cheval de Frise)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/700880175c5b1a823d24d56819887cc143a06c36.jpg

notes.title: [Lionfire] Season Unit Spotlight: Reitar Pistoleers (T3)
notes.content:
After Gustav II's military reforms, the cavalry of the Northern Kingdom underwent a dramatic transformation compared to the mainstream cavalry on the continent.
 
At this time, the continental cavalry still followed the traditions of the classical era, dominated by aristocrats, while the cavalry of the Northern Kingdom was entirely composed of mercenaries. This allowed Gustav to put into practice his tactical vision for the cavalry of the new era: "Fire only when you see the whites of the enemy's eyes!"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9abc984e572c2be7afdc18e58cbd8b9c4210abc0.jpg
 
Unit inspiration
During the Thirty Years' War, a gunpowder revolution was brewing. Knights from the Rhine region shed their heavy armor, retaining only essential protective gear, and abandoned their lances in favor of matchlock muskets. They often employed a tactic known as the "Half-wheel tactics" and relied more on harassing with firearms rather than engaging in direct charges. However, Gustav II Adolphus took a different approach. He ordered the cuirassiers from the Rhine in his army to abandon the half-wheel tactics and cumbersome long muskets. Instead, they used short muskets at extremely close range and then fearlessly charged with their swords.


“The lionhearted cuirassiers do not open fire until they see the whites of their enemy's eyes."， a warlord once remarked. He had personally witnessed the cuirassiers firing at extremely close range, then drawing their cavalry swords and ruthlessly cutting down their enemies who mechanically followed the "half-wheel tactics." On the battlefield, those who sought death survived. A century after the fully armored knights had been defeated by gunpowder, this army seemed to have brought back the fearless charge to the battlefield.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/89d77fb5dd1b458bcc84eca8405a5c5f40fffa25.jpg
 
Featured Gameplay


The cuirassiers, first introduced by Gustav II Adolphus, carried a pair of improved muskets that were not affected by rainy weather. They excelled at close-range shooting against their enemies. This combat method maximized the power of gunpowder, offering high shooting accuracy and destructive force. It was particularly effective in controlling and inflicting damage on heavily armored enemies.


After firing at close range, the cuirassiers could charge into enemy lines at extremely high speed, launching swift and fierce attacks until they tore apart the enemy's defenses.


 
Unit skill


Roar of Powder


Firing special gunpowder bullets at their targets, the cuirassiers inflicted significant damage and had a knockdown effect on enemy troops. After both muskets were fired with special gunpowder bullets, they entered a cooldown period during which the cuirassiers could not use their muskets for regular attacks.


Tearing Strike


The knightly posture returns to the world! Using their knightly swords, the cuirassiers execute several fierce thrusts at close range.
 
 
Note: The final effect is subject to the actual in-game performance after the season launch.
