notes.title: Lion of the North | Aurora's Glory & Northern Lion Attire Showcase
notes.content:
When Gustavus Adolphus landed in northern Germany with his army, intervening in the long-running Thirty Years' War, the Free Imperial Cities regarded him with skepticism. How could these barbarians from a distant winter, who couldn't even equip their cavalry with proper armor, defeat the Imperial army under the Habsburg banner?
[previewyoutube=XDZOelBh8Wk;full][/previewyoutube]


Aurora's Glory Design Notes

It was not until after the Battle of Breitenfeld that the independent city-states within the Holy Roman Empire realized the profound transformation that had taken place within the northern reinforcements. They began to rally around this king, even as his enemies began to learn from him..

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/51a9c84b262578e22f9c7e16faa722714705f5fa.jpg


Rumor had it that the new King of the North was an eccentric man. He disliked royal etiquette and rarely attended high-society gatherings. Instead, he preferred to spend his time in workshops with engineers and mathematicians, discussing obscure theories that would make ordinary people's eyelids droop after a few sentences. Court attendants even attested to seeing the king disguised as an officer, sneaking into other countries to inspect their armies and arsenals, often putting himself in danger. Yet, he reveled in it. He was more like a general or a ranger than a king. However, only those closest to him knew that the king had long foreseen the dark clouds gathering over the Western world. A great war was coming, and as king, only by surpassing the times could he make the name of the Northern Kingdom resound throughout the world.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2ce70ad7cf51357440c7a37bf62dba78806c0690.jpg


Primarily inspired by the attire of musketeers and military nobility during the Thirty Years' War. The female attire is based on the sword training garb of Queen Christina, Gustavus' daughter, while the male attire references historical depictions of Gustavus himself.

Northern Lion Attire Design Notes

As Gustavus Adolphus arrived at Lützen under a shroud of fog, Generalissimo Wallenstein and his 20,000 elite troops awaited. The King, eager to crush them before Imperial reinforcements arrived, charged into the thick fog with his royal guard...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1b6d8a2cf0f559bdfe67f9136a9d62264ea92d9e.jpg


Brigands, massacres, plunder, blood...
In the dark years of war, a hopeless night enveloped all, as if hell had returned to earth. People, numb and driven mad, slaughtered each other. It was then that the roar of the "Lion of the North" tore through the heavy darkness. His cannons drove back the demons disguised as men, his sharp blade severing their ignorance.
People remembered the prophecy: "The northern star heralds the arrival of the lion, who will bring light back to the world." The king, from then on, was seen as a symbol of transcendence. All believed that the king, clad in the symbol of the morning star, forever charging at the forefront of his army, would lead the world out of the darkness, through the fog, and towards the future of their dreams.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4cb615e33d1d8da6ed3984888c998bc3c82090c7.jpg


Based on Gustavus' image at the Battle of Lützen, emphasizing his title of "Warrior King."
The cape on his back bears the imagery of the morning star, alluding to the prophecy of astrologers that Gustavus, as the Lion of the North, would become the savior of the West.
The lion-shaped helmet emphasizes his title, "Lion of the North."


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b0d206e13f471bc8e30dec256fb96935e64ccb83.jpg


The fires of war intensify.
Witness the revolution in warfare on September 19th.

notes.title: One CB, One World
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords,
 
We have been working on forming a global community over the past couple of months, with some important steps taken already. we have taken more and more steps to unify the CB experience for players around the globe.
Today we have some very important announcements that affect a large part of our fantastic community, that we think will spark a lot of joy amongst you! These will take effect when the new season starts on the 19th of September 2024. Please read the following carefully.
 
One CB, One World
Our aim with this move is to tie our community much closer together and empower you to truly participate in our global ecosystem. We want you to feel a greater sense of belonging, of cameraderie and healthy competition. To that end we have planned a lot of improvements to how we are running CB moving forward:
 


Global Community Events with cross-server competition

Global matchmaking for special events

Cross server friending and teaming: make friends and enemies globally

Easily create characters on ANY server through Steam (no more IP block)

Unified global website and store

 
Our ultimate goal here is to build a world where everyone can connect with everyone, no matter which server you are a part of. As you can see above we have a lot planned with the start of the new season and our global community unification, which will be packed with fun events that emphasize the global nature of our game. And in the future we even want you to participate in cross-continental Territory Wars!
This is an extension of our unification efforts that we implemented last month and each of these points will get more details The previous update balanced the in-game economy and shop, to get rid of different items and sovereign pricing. Now everyone's values are the same, no matter which server you joined, and best of all we reduced prices of a majority of shop items to enable more players to enjoy benefits.
In this step we also introduced our new approach to monetization, where we focus more on vanity and skins, rather than progression in the game. We hope this eases new players into the game reduces some of the friction that CB has had to game progression in the past. This new system was introduced in the first iteration as a luxury commodity and we understand that more players want to participate in such systems in the future. Thankfully, this iteration was successful and will enable us to more broadly develop in this direction. We got a lot of feedback from you about what you'd like to see in the next iteration and we hope you will like it!
 
Unified Presence
With the beginning of the next season and in our quest to build a truly global community, we will implement the following changes :
[olist]

Steam merge: We will merge our western Steam page (ex MyGames) into our original Poros Steam page (CB: Frontier), now simply called "Conqueror's Blade". The current situation of having two different Steam pages is a vestige of our old publishing relationship with MyGames. Since we are publishing the game now globally ourselves, having a fractured Steam presence is a hinderence and can actually be confusing to new players as well. So we decided that we are going to change that moving forward and only have one Steam page globally to emphasize the global nature of CB.
[/olist]
 
[olist]

New launcher：For those of you do not use steam, we will combine two different versions of official launcher. In other words, starting from the new season, the Launcher will also be unified into one. However, we will try our best to lighten your burden. You won't need to re-download the launcher. The old launcher will auto-upgrade to the new version! Let me also reveal to you that the new Launcher has a completely new upgrade and design, and everyone only needs to download the client.
[/olist]
 
[olist]

Unified website：We will merge the two webistes into one CB global website and remove all IP block restrictions. So we have a unified hub to look for information and also the same webshop.
[/olist]
 
Once the merge is completed, all players on those servers are required to download the game again, as required by Steam. While we can't change that, we are currently working with Steam to reduce the download burden as much as possible.
 
All in all, EVERY player on every server, is now allowed to freely create new characters on EVERY other server. Yay! We know quite a few players are doing this already, so this change is going to make that MUCH easier for you in the future. Now you can prove that your house is definitely better at CB than the noobs in the other regions ;). Which servers are you going to haunt first and what is your battle cry? 
We are also working on possible ways for you to transfer your current characters to other servers. However, this won't be part of the new season's start yet and we will come back to this once we have more to share.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/146f4cf70710d7f5e0622c40f7ca03e2a210b603.jpg
 
 
Stay tuned to the upcoming announcements related to our in-game and community events during the Unification celebration. A livestream with the developers will be held on September 14th. You will be first to revel in more details about our roadmap, the new season and first-hand information about the upcoming changes.
 
Yours, The CB Dev Team

notes.title: A vast world, but every inch matters| Territory War Adjustment Plan
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords,
 
The theme of the coming new season is [Gustav II Adolf], the father of modern warfare. We hope to emulate Gustavus Adolf and bring about true change and reform in CB.
 
As CB moves towards global operations, we also hope to bring a better CB world to warlords. We promise all warlords that there will be adjustments to the rules of TW with each new season, new events will be introduced every season; and a new weapon will be added every year, etc. This belief of [taking action] will be carried through every update of CB. In summary, our four major guidelines for innovation are:
 


Tactics: New heroes and units. A new weapon every year

Battlefield: New event maps for each season

War: Constant changes to TW rules every season

Situation: More global ecology and interconnected actions

 
As for war, which is related to the open world and territory war, it is one of the core gameplay elements of CB. From the initial The southern border and northern towns to the Conqueror's City in the Alexander season, countless warlords have been fighting in the open world. Every city, fort, and village in each region has witnessed numerous similar stories – They are the stories of all the warlords. For the reform of territory war, we hope that with each season's content updates and rule adjustments, warlords can have a different territory war experience:
 


Territory war Mechanism: We will try to introduce unique mechanisms related to the season's theme into the territory battlefields, bringing more variables to the course of the battle and allowing warlords to experience more interesting gameplay.

Open World Strategic Competition: We will work towards making the strategy more abundant and the competition deeper, building upon it season by season.

Seasonal Resource Rules: We will also adjust the basic content, such as the open world resource output, in line with each season's theme. By doing so, we aim to connect the open world with the seasons.

 
In fact, the reform of territory war needs to be very cautious, as every change in the rules has far-reaching consequences.
 
Therefore, as the first step in taking action, we will start by addressing some of the long-standing issues in territory war that have been troubling warlords. We will begin making some adjustments and tests from this week, and we hope that during the truce in open world, warlords can also help with testing and let's work together to improve the gameplay of open world.
 
[olist]

Raise the requirement for opening and maintaining front (The following changes have already been implemented in the update maintenance on September 5)
[/olist]
 


The number of players required to open a territory front

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2976b1431bdc049d3500550c8543ef8936afd051.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c1e9b742b4ac6ade357340f6e4dca8926bd1e39b.jpg


During the territory war, when interacting with the fief in open world to open a front, the attacking side needs to have a queue of players that meets the fief's requirement for front to open. If the attacking side does not meet the required number of players to open the front, all participating attacking players will enter the siege queue and wait for the front to open.

The number of players required to open a front is determined by the type of front, as follows:


Village, Field Camp, and Ruler's Flag: 1 attacking player can open the front

City and Fort: 5 attacking players can open the front

Region's capital, Gate of Conqueror's City, and Conqueror's City: 8 attacking players can open the front

 

Rules for the morale of the attacking side in territory war

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6becbb75bd2dae58c3f919cc4a70874f849838ad.jpg
 


After the front is opened, the attacking side will have a morale value, initially set at 100%. When the morale value reaches 0, the attacking side is considered defeated, and the defending side wins.

When the number of attacking players in a stage does not meet the requirements for opening a front, the morale value will decrease at a steady rate of 1% per second. When the attacking side has enough players, the morale value will stop decreasing and remain unchanged.


For example: In a battle for a city in open world, if there are only 3 attacking players left on the battlefield, the morale value of the attacking side will decrease according to the rules.

It should be noted that if there are no attacking warlords on the battlefield in a battle for a village in open world, the morale value of the attacking side will still decrease according to the rules.


Morale value will not recover during a single battle.

 
[olist]

Reporting mechanism for "Slotblocking" in territory war
[/olist]
 
The "blocking front" in territory war has long been a issue for warlords. Some families have taken advantage of loopholes in the rules for opening and maintaining fronts to gain unfair advantages in territory war. We hereby clarify that "Slotblocking" is a serious violation of the rules in territory war.
 
On the basis of raising the front requirements, we will also introduce a reporting mechanism for warlords. We hope that all warlords will join us in supervising the healthy ecosystem of the entire territory war. In cases where there is solid evidence, we will impose strict penalties on individuals, families, and alliances that engage in "Slotblocking". We will soon launch specific reporting measures, channels, and evidence verification methods and announce them as soon as possible.
 
Of course, maintaining a healthy game ecosystem cannot be achieved solely through rules. It also requires the participation of all warlords in improving these rules. If you have any suggestions or ideas, please feel free to share them with us. We are very eager to communicate with you.
"Take action" is an important concept during the Gustav reform in CB. We encourage all warlords to speak their minds and participate actively. Let's work together to build the "best wargame in the world"!

notes.title: Gather to the Beacon
notes.content:
Greetings, warlords!
 
We are truly grateful for your support towards Conqueror's Blade over the years! Now, the new chapter of global operations in the game is unfolding, with many warlords who once left the battlefield returning to fight again.
 
To help these returning warlords quickly regain their power and allow new comiong warlords to develop their power swiftly, the Auctioneers has launched a new event named [Gather to Beacon], packed with a lot rewards, eagerly awaiting your return!
 
Initiate or respond recruitment can both receive a wealth of rewards, and you can even get a 5-star Season Unit Selection Box!
 
Recruitment
During the event, warlords can recruit through the event page. When the respondent completes the corresponding quests in the game, the recruiter can obtain [Beacon Points].
 
Once the recruiter meets the requirements for the [Beacon Points] stage reward, the reward will be sent to the character's in-game mailbox. The email is valid for 30 days from the date of receipt, so please check it promptly. After the event ends on October 8, 2024, 00:00 (UTC+8), all rewards on this event page will no longer be claimable.
[Beacon Points] stage rewards include Pure Spirit, Divine Crow, Epic Hero Schematic Crate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dd78c231ffb92ea549a0ea76975ec604523476aa.jpg
Accept Recruitment

[olist]

New Warlord

Accounts created before 00:00 on September 5, 2024(UTC+8), but currently have zero characters, are also considered new warlords.


New warlords who activate the  [Beacon Decree]  will trigger the [Recalling of Beacon] quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2f8d0e004d3e5d60e8eeff40b0d2299e62692ded.jpg
Greeting of Beacon
During the event, completing the [Greeting of Beacon] related tasks will reward players with items like  Epic Leadership Doctrine, Hand-picked 4-star Season Unit Selection Box, Hand-picked 5-star Season Unit Selection Box. 3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/60078417e5817aa38ff79bba80877b68facddafd.jpg
Event rules
[olist]

Each account can recruit up to 10 players, including returning players and new players.


After the event ends, the "Beacon Decree" will no longer trigger event tasks. All incomplete event tasks will be removed.


Only one character per account can participate in this event, and the event rewards are limited to that character's participation and claim. Each account can only receive the event rewards once.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade: Conquer More for Less - Discounts Await!
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords,
Five years of thunderous cavalry charges, five years of clashing steel and hard-won sieges. From the war-torn Borderlands to the shimmering peaks of Olympus, we've carved our legend onto the very soul of Conqueror's Blade. But the greatest battles are yet to come. As we stand on the precipice of a new era - an era where Warlords from across the globe will finally clash under a single banner - we're taking a crucial step towards unifying our global community. Every victory in Conqueror's Blade has been a testament to your unwavering passion and support. Today, we mark a new chapter in our shared journey: Conqueror's Blade goes truly global!
Starting August 22nd, we're permanently reducing the real prices in USD on a vast array of in-game items. But that's not all! We're also taking steps to unify our global pricing structure, ensuring a fair and unified experience for all players.


Battlepass - 17% Off


Pay Off - 44% Off:


Shop Attires - 44% Off


All Other Items - a variety of discounts


Phase One: Immediate Discounts - Conquer for Less! From August 22nd to September 18th
Starting August 22nd, enjoy significant discounts on a variety of in-game items. These discounts are applied directly to the existing prices :
 
Phase Two: One Realm, One Price - Unifying the Global Battlefield! On September 19th, Conqueror's Blade will transition to a single global price for Sovereigns. This means:


APAC Server Sovereigns price: Effective September 19th, the APAC server will adopt the global standard Sovereigns price of 1:100 (1 USD = 100 Sovereigns).


Standardized Item Prices: Also starting September 19th, in-game item prices will be standardized across all servers, based on the lowest real price in USD for each item. This ensures price parity for all Conquerors.


1.8x Sovereign Boost: As a thank you for your early support, on September 19th, all existing Sovereigns held by players in the APAC server will be amplified by a factor of 1.8. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2e2e50df5631ce2b5ab752b7a81025d3b6d61911.png
Phase Three:Lifetime Spending Payback Events - Thank You For Your Loyalty!
To show our deepest appreciation for your dedication, we're launching a Lifetime Top up Rebate Event on September 19th.


How It Works:


Rewards Fit for a Sovereign: You'll earn valuable rewards based on your total lifetime spending in USD on a per-character basis.


Treasures for Every Warlord: Standard spending tiers players will get a bounty of items such as Treatises, Epic Schematics, Unit Medals, and Pay off, ensuring every Warlord has the resources to dominate the battlefield.


Prestige Awaits the Worthy: As your legend grows, so too will your rewards. Higher spending tiers players will unlock increasingly prestigious items, including exclusive Avatars, Titles, and other rare cosmetics to make your mark on history.


A Legacy Forged in Steel: This event will be a permanent fixture of Conqueror's Blade, ensuring your loyalty is celebrated for years to come! 




The Dawn of a New Era
While we understand that adjustments can take time to get used to, we are fully confident that global price unification will ultimately benefit all Conquerors, creating a fairer and more unified battlefield for everyone. We are deeply grateful for your understanding and continued support as we embark on this exciting new chapter together.
We will continue to closely monitor feedback and optimize the Conqueror's Blade experience to deliver the best possible gaming experience for our incredible global community.
Let the Global Conquest Begin!
Forged in Steel,
The BOOMING & POROS Team

notes.title: Chaosbane Monarch| The King Who Ends Chaos, [Chaosbane Monarch Suit] Attire Show
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d4fd988ac7dab8bd4726a13db6db7363647c5e91.jpg
 
As the great millennial empire crumbled, the once-prosperous lands were plunged into a century of turmoil, ravaged by warlords vying for power.
 
In this forsaken world, abandoned by the gods and plagued by the ambitious, the trampled common people faced unimaginable hardships, until the rise of a king known as the End of Chaos.
 
Adorned in armor embellished with jewels and gold, the king charged into battle, his magnificent cloak undisturbed by the howling winds that swirled around him. Yet, this armor was not a symbol of extravagance, but rather an emblem of the ending he brought to the chaos.Legend has it that the great empire's treasured gemstone were broken into pieces and divided among the warlords. As the king vanquished each warlord, he embedded fragments of the gemstone from their weapons into his armor, signifying the end of chaos in that region. As the once-ordinary iron armor transformed into a dazzling masterpiece adorned with precious stones, the chaotic lands would eventually find peace and order once more.
 
The Savior King, the Chaosbane Monarch, the Undefeatable One, the Testament of Heroes.
 
Ambitious warlords, Now please allow me to introduce to you all the brand-new Chaosbane Monarch Suit, crafted exclusively for the [Alexander season] in the Land of Chaos - the [Chaosbane Monarch Suit].
 
Design Sharing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e56729d1eec2c1d5db6d2e404c60055b677c4846.jpg
After Rome, rebuild the Empire. After the great Roman Empire collapsed, the former imperial territories fell into a prolonged period of chaos, with warlords vying for power. Eventually, the powerful king Charlemagne defeated countless enemies, restored order, and brought peace to the land.Therefore, when designing the attire for the Chaosbane Monarch Suit, we drew inspiration from the image of Charlemagne. Generals who obtain this set of attire will, like the great emperor, put an end to the chaos in the Land of Chaos, bringing peace to the people of this land!
 
Crown
The crown is inspired by the one worn by Charlemagne during his coronation in ancient European paintings. It is adorned with jewels and gold, embodying both luxury and authority. In the Middle Ages, wearing this crown signified that one's authority was approved by the gods, making them a king who ruled over the people.
 
This type of crown remains a symbol of the European monarchy to this day.
 
Attire
The attire is largely inspired by the royal garments of the kings from the Carolingian dynasty, with extremely long Cape and luxurious armor being its distinctive features.The Frankish kings were known as "warrior kings" because they often served as military commanders, leading their troops from the front lines!
 
Respond to the call of the miserable, put an end to this chaos and disaster, and become the supreme king!
Become the embodiment of an epic tale! Let the bards sing your story for a thousand years!
The new "Song of Roland" shall be composed by you.The time to end the chaos has come. Warlords, charge towards the Borderlands!

notes.title: Limited-time Event: Classic PVE challenges are about to come!
notes.content:
Limited-time Event: Classic PVE challenges are about to come!! 
Auctioneers calls upon warlords from all corners to gather at the land of heroes, embarking again on an epic journey.
Fine wine awaits, calling forth warriors bold and true!
 
Journey Overview
Starting on August 22nd, classic PVE challenge stages will be available 24/7, rotating weekly. Participate in the event to earn Colosseum Scores, which can be exchanged for Epic Artillery Selection Chest, Epic Divine Crow, and the brand-new Epic Mount [Blazing]!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7e024e7983ac04f11f6462b37a58573f5e180351.jpg
Storming the Great Wall
The Rangifer Mountains lie north of the Borderlands, serving as a natural barrier against invasions from the north. Thus, the old empire built a "Great Wall" of linked forts along the ridges to discourage invaders.
During the last snowstorm that struck the Heartland, to bolster the warlords' resolve against the harsh winter, the Auctioneers hosted the Storming the Great Wall Competition. They rallied warriors to charge towards the Great Wall, infusing the siege battles with furious passion.
Now is the time to return to the old battlefields, reigniting the spirit of tackling tough!
 
Event Period: August 22nd to August 29th
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1d29a230949e44692bb11f643a50805f81b7fc62.jpg
 
Raid on Sanada Maru
Chaos brewed within the realm of Yayoi. Under the leadership of their lord, the Sanada clan chose a strategic site within their domain to establish their main stronghold, fortifying it for self-preservation. Though its original name has faded into the mists of time, it is now universally known as Sanada Maru. Through the long years of strife, even when the Sanada forces faced defeat on the battlefield and teetered on the brink of collapse, as long as the main stronghold stood firm, they could always rise again, ensuring the survival of their lineage.
Now, the unbroken fortress stands tall before you, the time for glory has come, and victory lies just ahead!
 
Event Period: August 30th to September 5th
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/855fac0b0a366b16e732440bd6a030e2697ff935.jpg
Dasuo Pass
The Dasuo Pass once stood between the East and the Borderlands, a vital passage for eastern travellers venturing into the heart of the continent. The broader the expanse, the more alluring the conquest it seemed. In the past, valiant warriors from the East, driven by the ambition to expand westward, launched grand campaigns to breach the formidable Dasuo Pass. Amid the relentless waves of war, it eventually succumbed, the frontlines pushing westward, and power dynamics reshaped.
Now, warriors, come back to the Dasuo Pass! Let us reignite the flames of battle upon this land, and bring the storm back again!
 
Event Period: September 6th - September 12th

notes.title: Global Conquest Begins: Warlords of the World, Conquerors Assemble!
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords,
Five years have passed since we first raised banners in Conqueror's Blade. Since then, millions of you, hailing from across Asia and beyond, have answered the call to arms. For five years, we've ridden across steppes, sailed icy seas, scaled treacherous peaks, navigated scorching deserts, and even basked in the glory of Olympus – all side-by-side. Every cavalry charge, every clash of steel, every hard-won siege has proven the strength of this community.
Conqueror's Blade has never belonged solely to its developers. It belongs to you, the players. You are the lifeblood of this game, and building a vibrant, transparent, and supportive community has always been our top priority. Your voices – whether through surveys, forum discussions, or in-game feedback – are incredibly valuable to us. Every suggestion, every word of praise, and yes, even every critique, helps shape Conqueror's Blade for the better. From Project Nirvana to the gameplay improvements we've implemented this year, and even the thrilling first steps of a truly global CBL tournament, everything we achieve is a testament to the passion and dedication of this community.
For too long, our global community has been divided. Different publishers meant separate servers, forums, and even in-game friends lists. But no more! In June, we took a major step towards unifying Conqueror's Blade by reclaiming publishing rights for the West and America region. This is just the beginning of our commitment to creating a single, unified battlefield where warlords from all corners of the world can clash.
So, what comes next?
Are you tired of grinding or feeling pressured to spend?
Do you yearn for a battlefield where different cultures collide?
Do you crave the thrill of forging rivalries and alliances with players from across the globe?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e7f7adef03eaded5eec3e780971c46bcb6376d18.jpg
If you answered "yes" to any of these questions, then prepare yourselves! We're about to embark on the next stage of our journey!
In the coming weeks, we'll be rolling out a series of exciting events and updates, some of which have never been done before. But for now, consider this a taste of what's to come:


Free Doctrine Removal

Time-limited Legendary Attires Drops

 
Free Doctrine-removing!
 
We will offer you free "Doctrine Removal" for the weekend. From 08/17, 0:00 (UTC+8) - 08/18, 24:00 (UTC+8). You can remove any doctrine, regardless of its quality, without spending any Lotus Water.
 
Mark your calendars and make the most of this event to optimize your units!

Free Try-on of Legendary Attires!

Join in [Siege Battle] or [Field Battle] and you may get a [Limited-time] Random Legendary Attire Chest of 12 hours.

The chest contains several 12-hour legendary attire including Shore's Edge Pike, Falling Star, The Inner Flame, Onibi Tenmu and more.

You can acquire the chest up to 3 times a day. The limit will be reset at 24:00 every day.

Time: 08/15 after maintenance - 08/22 before maintenance.

These are just appetizers! We have three major events planned, each shrouded in mystery. Can you guess what they are? We will give away 3 x 500 sovereigns among commenters on all our platforms, one gift code for each correct guess of an event.


Reliving the Past

Money Doesn't Smell

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ab4936e32f0c4e2bb3a292a703acd23123acf394.jpg
The drums of war never cease, and neither will our dedication to you. Thank you for your unwavering support and passion. We are here, always ready to listen.
 
Let the global conquest begin!
 
Forged in Steel,

notes.title: Code of Conduct: CBL Participants & Content Creators
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,

As we gear up for the  “Conqueror’s Blade League”, lets ensure a respectful and positive environment for everyone involved. Whether you are a CBL participant who's planning to create videos or livestream the games and their reviews, or you're given Observer rights for the CBL, please pay attention to the following Code of Conduct. 

Established guidelines:

Players with Observer permissions:


1. Players who have received special observer accounts must refrain from using racial, political, or abusive offensive language, targeting other individuals or teams based on political, or racial factors.


2. Violations will result in the removal of Observer privileges, and other penalties.


CBL Players:


1. If you’re a CBL player without additional permissions (such as observer privileges), and you are creating videos or livestreaming during the event (including inbetween the matches)- the same language standards apply. Offensive behavior of such kind will not be tolerated.


2. Whether you’re streaming matches or creating videos related to CBL, maintain a respectful tone.


3. Any racial, political, or abusive language found in your streams or videos during CBL dates may lead to disqualification from CBL participation and other penalties.


Our Stance on Offensiveness:


1. We reserve the right to determine what constitutes offensive behavior.

2. We’ll be vigilant in enforcing these standards to maintain a positive community.



Remember, your conduct reflects not only on yourself but also on your team.


Let’s keep the CBL spirit alive by fostering a welcoming and sportsmanlike atmosphere.

Thank you for your cooperation, and we'll see you on the battlefields of CBL!

notes.title: 12 Labours Begin & Demigod Hero Epic: Legendary Maul Roars!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/98fc53021e721e12e56fbf6b5b9b7f6e6fb26f92.jpg

When forging this weapon, although people named it after the fierce beast, the Nemean lion, it was actually to commemorate the great deeds of the mighty hero Hercules. In mythological tales, the god set twelve arduous tasks for Hercules, and the first was to slay the beast.
-- Legendary Maul Attire [Flame of Nemean Lion] is making its debut!

[previewyoutube=G_Sk5aIC2ng;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[Where All Began]
A legend among western Aegean nations is that there was a giant lion resides within the Nimia Mountains. It is said to be a descendant of the volcanic behemoth Typhon, hence it has tremendous body and the ability to control flames. This monster was incredibly ferocious, from whom the local residents suffered a lot. Countless heroes come to kill it, but none of them survived.
 
[Pace of Hero]
Until one day, a demigod hero named Hercules answered the clarion of the destiny goddess and accepted twelve great trials, first of which is to hunt this beast. Rumor has it that the fierce battle between the demigod and the beast was earth-shattering - the divine blood shed by both turned the mountain's crystal mines red. Hercules eventually achieved victory, marking the start of his legendary journey.
 
[He is Legend]
In honor of his achievement, the king of this region had a powerful weapon crafted out of the red crystals on the mountain. When the chosen one wields this weapon, the blood of the hero and the beast would transform into an everlasting flame, illuminating the hero's destiny.
 
Acquisition Period：
You can acquire it via [G] - [Lion's Flame Attire Chest]. Let the legendary maul strike down powerfully with the thunderous roar of the Monster!

notes.title: [Alexander: The Great] Season Unit & Hero Mount Attires!
notes.content:
Warriors! Welcome to the [Alexander: The Great] Season!
In this magnificent chapter, we will guide you back to the wartime of Alexander's Conquest. We hope the exquisite attires we provided will brighten your conquerors' journey.
Let's unveil Alexander's great story in this epic season, and write down our own heroic legends.
In the Conqueror's Blade [Alexander: The Great] season, we are waiting for your presence!
 
New Season Unit Attires- Twelfth Trial
Under the blessings of the Olympian gods and the brilliance of valiant Hercules's Twelfth Trial, the legendary tales of the demigod hero resound in epics.
The lion and blade signify the prelude to the return of the hero; as the warhorn blares, the hero will dominate on the battlefield and retrieve the past glory.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/41ef81880140565be2151494d32e495fdddda122.jpg
While the era of gods and heroes may fade into the annals of time, the saga of the greatest demigod hero, Hercules, shall forever resonate in the hearts of warriors. This legendary figure, imbued with unparalleled strength and boundless compassion, undertook twelve Herculean labors, ultimately earning the blessing of the Olympian gods to ascend to the heavens. Tales recount how the bare-chested hero donned the fearsome hide of the Nemean lion he vanquished and wielded a blade that none could withstand. Even the gods themselves stood powerless in his wake as he charged into battle. Inspired by his legend, warriors often emulate Hercules's attire, transforming into heroes reborn on the battlefield. Though such heroes may have departed the earthly realm, their legends and indomitable spirit endure eternally in the fabric of the world.
[Alexander: The Great] Unlocks at Season Level 50!
 
New Unit Mount Attires - Fiery Trial Steed
In the long line of epics, the tyrant's steed thirsts for human blood, and enemies wail beneath its iron hooves. In valorous might, Hercules subdued the tyrant, offering sacrifice to the fiery steeds, his heroic will bending the horses to submission. On the battlefield, the fiery steeds reignited their fierce spirit, hooves trampling and tearing at enemies, unleashing relentless fury.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5853dc4b11401014c07ad4f87130413f9f5ea02a.jpg
During his Twelve Labors, the hero Hercules encountered a tyrant named Deimos. Deimos was infamous for raising horses that feasted on human flesh, something which rendered them ferocious and insatiably hungry. In his quest for justice, Hercules vanquished the tyrant king and fed him to his own man-eating steeds, thus delivering the retribution he deserved. Curiously, these once-fierce horses turned remarkably docile after consuming the flesh of their former master. Was it the gods' punishment upon the cruel king, or did the horses submit to the hero's might? Divine motives remain inscrutable, yet whispers persist that only upon the battlefield will these equine predators revert to their savage nature, mercilessly tearing into their foes with relentless fury.
[Alexander：The Great] Unlocks at Season Level 50!
 
New Hero Mount Attires - Bucephalus Attire
By the decree of the gods! The fiery steed yearns for its king. Together cloaked in divine light, they march into battle.
As the wheel of fate turned, the threads of destiny tightly bound to the conqueror's command. The hero descended, his radiance shining upon the sky.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/54700e29d86c7d647f6841032cbe41caae641216.jpg
In his youth, the Lord of Conquest tamed a wild and ferocious horse, christening it Bucephalus. This formidable steed remained his faithful mount throughout his life, accompanying him through countless battles, adorned in barding that evoked divine light. Legend holds that even before the Conqueror mastered this horse, the Delphic Oracle had prophesied: "He who controls this fierce stallion shall control the world." Thus, the threads of fate appeared to weave together, placing the destiny of the world within the conqueror's reach even amidst the veils of uncertainty.
[Alexander：The Great] Unlocks at Season Level 70!
 
 
Warriors, as time marches on, the flames of war reignite, the [Alexander：The Great] season's melody reaches its crescendo. Beneath this illustrious throne, the hero's radiance never fades, the path of conquest stretches endlessly.
The saga will once again be penned by you, warlords. Together in this stirring feast, let's inscribe eternal glory, weaving an immortal legend! Warriors, seize the moment to unveil the mask of conquest, grip your weapons tightly, and unleash your boundless passion and courage to create brilliance together!

1. Brand-New Siege Map-Mystara Castle!

Nestled within mountains lies a thousand-year-old fortress. From the ancient Aegean city-states' wars to the sacred Crusades, its outer walls have been baptized by iron and fire countless times. Numerous heroes perished, countless empires vied, yet the castle still stands tall, much like a old veteran, mocking the ambitious who were thirsty for his blood.
As the battles in the "Alexander" season heat up, we're excited to introduce a brand new siege map for our Warlords- Mystara Castle! 

Map Intro:

Mystara Castle is situated in a gorge surrounded by mountains, leaving the southwest and southeast gap to resist enemies. Throughout history, attackers often focus their main attack on the lowlands to the southwest of the castle. Zip lines are particularly effective here, so defenders usually prioritize the southwestern wall for defense.

Also, attackers may blast away the southeastern walls and catch the defenders off guard.

notes.title: Mystara Castle | A Thousand-Year-Old Fortress
notes.content:
Background：

Nestled within mountains lies a thousand-year-old fortress. From the ancient Aegean city-states' wars to the sacred Crusades, its outer walls have been baptized by iron and fire for countless times. Numerous heroes perished, countless empires vied, yet the castle still stands tall, much like a old veteran, mocking the ambitious who were thirsty for his blood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2f9f96c9bc845c7a15be7544dd539806a09959d5.jpg

As the battles in [Alexander: The Great] heat up, we're bringing you with a new Siege Battle map – Mystara Castle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2bac5d8156d6e8ba3a24c5ddcd987256bd67e196.jpg

Introduction:

Mystara Castle is situated in a gorge surrounded by mountains, leaving the southwest and southeast gap to resist enemies. Throughout history, attackers often focus their main attack on the lowlands to the southwest of the castle. Zip lines are particularly effective here, so defenders usually prioritize the southwestern wall for defense.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/763b1e9856d484a1aaac6f45f7dec506215916fc.jpg

Also, attackers may blast away the southeastern walls and catch the defenders off guard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c0b0c48a61e384e755b655228f093c357e5e6fff.jpg

Point A: Street Battle Zone

After breaching the southwestern gate, then attackers have to choose their routes much more wisely. Recklessly penetrating the residential area at Point A risks being trapped in narrow alleys. Attackers should divide their forces and enter from the east to cut off the defenders’ rearguard, allowing the other forces to enter through the main gate without interference.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ad3182e84627ddad1fde2354fd86762ee499a295.jpg

Point B: No Cavalry Zone

Note that Point B is located atop the wall, making it inaccessible for cavalry units of the Attackers. Only infantry can pass and be summoned at Supply Point at Point B. Compared to Point A, Point B offers a more open view, so perhaps Attackers should consider it as a primary target for trebuchets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b2d459d956469b25080fc7961de43cc477d66e79.jpg

Base: Meat Grinder

The defenders’ base will be accessible once either Point A or B is captured. There are 3 or 4 paths leading to the base from the perimeter, but only the fittest can survive. Cannot imagine how bloody the battles will be in these narrow passages between the walls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c5d8aaead82117001c6f28be5accbb747b2609b3.jpg

The ultimate battles will occur in the church area of the base, which is dooming to be a “meat grinder”. There are flat terrain, numerous intersections and cluster houses, not a suitable condition for ranged units or cavalry, but a perfect battlefield to reap enemies’ lives for melee fanatics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/91e3c329e6e30edbb470380c4c7c80a5ee392131.jpg

notes.title: Ranked Battles Time Slot Adjustment and Server Merger Supplementary Notes
notes.content:
I. Adjustment of the Ranked Battles Time Slot

At the beginning of the season, we made adjustments to the timing of the ranked matches, hoping to allow more people to participate during concentrated time slots, and increase the quality of each match-up.

After observing for approximately a week, we have indeed found that the new schedule encourages more intense matches during weekday opening hours, allowing everyone to easily find suitable opponents.
However, we have also encountered issues with the weekend schedule. Many Warlords have provided feedback that the weekend hours are insufficient, limiting players from fully utilizing their weekend time for gaming and entertainment.

Considering everyone's request for a better experience in weekend ranked battles, as well as ensuring the quality of the matches, we have decided to make some adjustments to the time slot for ranked battles on weekends. We are expanding the opening hours for Saturday and Sunday afternoons to make it more convenient for everyone to participate.

At the same time, our commitment to delivering a high-quality and intense ranked match experience remains unwavering. Hence, we will persist in monitoring actual battle performance and may consider making necessary adjustments to the timing of ranked battles in the middle of the season.

Once again, we extend our gratitude to all the Warlords for your valuable suggestions and feedback!!

The specific adjustments are as follows (UTC+8):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/07b49286a56a1b6fdb44cbb7c26e341dbe2a975a.jpg

Detailed event timings can also be viewed in-game at [J] - [Event Schedule]

 Due to differing pricing of Sovereigns in the South and North America servers, adjustments will be made to the [Sovereigns] and [Sovereign Chest] of Warlords in the South America server following the server merge.
 Post-merger of South America and North America servers, the existing [Sovereign] within characters will be converted into [Sovereigns]. After the merge is completed, the [Sovereigns] and [Sovereign Chest] held by Warlords in the South America server will be increased by 180%, rounding up to the nearest whole number.


2. Name-Related Issues

（1）Duplicate Character Names

 The character's name of the higher level will be retained after the server merge. Lower-level Warlords will need to set a new name upon logging in.

（2）Duplicate House Names

 The House Names of the higher level will be retained after the server merge. If levels are equal, the House Name created first will be retained. Lieges requiring a name change post-merger will receive a House Renaming item via mail to alter the House Name.

notes.title: CBL 2024 Reward Reveal - Sign-up Extended By 1 Week
notes.content:
Sign-ups for 2024's Conqueror's Blade League, a tournament where the top Conqueror's Blade players from all around the world clash, are in hot swing! Create a squad and sign up while you can!

Latest Information + Q&A

1. Considering the recent changes to the Ranked Battles schedule along with the server transfers, we've decided to give everyone a bit more time to finalize their squads. Which is why we're extending the sign-ups to July 7th. The Regional  Qualifiers Phase remains unaffected.

2. Characters affected by the server transfers will be removed from their squads, even if previously signed up. This means that these players will have to rejoin their squads again following the transfers.

3. Is it possible to create and sign up with squad members from different regions? Such as having players from both the Mainland China servers and Asia Pacific servers in a squad, or players from Jiulongzhuri and Tianceshangjiang?
[Asia Pacific] Squads can contain players from all Asia Pacific servers (except for Espada Forest).
[Mainland China Server] Players from the Jiulongzhuri, Kaijiangtuoyu and Weijiahainei servers may be in the same squad.
[Mainland China Server] Players from the Tianceshangjiang and Xianfengjingji servers may be in the same squad.
Players from the [Mainland China Server] may not group up with players from the [Asia Pacific] servers.

4. Can I compete for a squad on the Mainland China servers and a squad from the  Asia Pacific servers?
No, you may not. Each player may only sign up with and play one character. Multiple sign-ups are strictly forbidden.

5. If you have any other questions regarding CBL, contact us at .

CBL 2024 Scoring Phase - Rules

Sign-Up Here
How to Sign Up:
 
You can sign up for the 2024 CBL via our official website or by pressing F7 in-game and following the instructions.
CN link: https://cbl.z.163.com/
APAC sign-up link: https://cbl.conquerorsblade.com
Europe and Americas link: https://cbl-global.conquerorsblade.com


Sign-Up Requirements

Each character may only be played by a single player, and each player may only participate in one division with one character. Should we find that a player has several characters on the tournament server or is part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament. Their squad will not be able to invite a new member to take their place.
Squads may only contain members from the same server cluster (e.g., Jiulongzhuri and Jingjixianfeng. Squads with members from more than one server cluster will have their sign-up annulled, and may not invite new players to remedy this. A squad belongs to the same server cluster as the character of its squad captain. Members should verify which server cluster a squad belongs to before joining.
If a squad does not provide contact information (such as Discord or QQ) and we are unable to reach them, their sign-up will be considered void.
The total Ranked Battle scores of house squads will be tallied according to players'scores as of July 19th.
The Season Level or Ranked Battle scores of all participants will be made public.


Squad Selection

We will be selecting 40 squads among those signing up to participate in the tournament. 14 Wild Card quads will also be participating.


12 squads from the CN Regional Tournament will be selected to participate in the Group Stage.


Squad Quota & Servers:
8 squads will be selected from the Jiulongzhuri, Kaijiangtuoyu and Weijiahainei servers.
4 squads will be selected from the Xianfengjingji and Tianceshangjiang servers.
We will also be inviting 4 CN Wild Card squads to participate.


10 squads from the APAC Regional Tournament will be selected to participate in the Group Stage.
Squad Quota & Servers:
10 squads will be selected from the Jaderock Creek, Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Sandstorm Gorge, Excalibur and Khan of Heaven servers.
We will also be inviting 6 APAC Wild Card squads to participate.


12 squads from the Europe Regional Tournament will be selected to participate in the Group Stage.

Servers:
Crystal Sea and Sicania.
We will also be inviting 4 Europe Wild Card squads to participate.


8 squads from the Americas Regional Tournament will be selected to participate in the Group Stage.
 Servers:
 Eagle Range and Espada Forest
.

Selection Criteria
- Selection Criteria for CBL 2024: Ranked Battle Score.
- Each squad's total Ranked Battle score is based on the total score of their top 15 Warlords.
- We will be calculating the Ranked Battle scores of all participants.
- The final score for the Qualifiers Phase is based on the statistics as shown on the CBL's official site.

Wild Card Squads:
Wild Card squads are those invited directly by CBL official. We will be inviting squads to participate based on the following:
- Squads from fairly new servers, such as Tianceshangjiang and Khan of Heaven.
- Squads from regions with large time differences that have a difficult time participating in Ranked Battles.
- Squads from countries and regions with lower populations or from minor language regions.
- Squads that have participated in regional tournaments or community ones.

Rewards
Participation reward: Rewards for the Qualifiers Phase will be issued to those on the name list as shown when the sign-ups conclude once the Qualifiers Phase has ended. To be eligible for any Qualifiers Phase rewards, every member of a squad must have either won or lost Ladder Score during the Qualifiers Phase (e.g., all 15 members for a 15-player squad or all 20 members for a 20-member squad). If even a single member of a squad's Ladder Score stands unchanged, none of that squad's members will receive rewards.


Exclusive Knockout Stage Rewards:
Top 16: A title for achieving top 16 in the CBL 2024.
Top 8: A title for achieving top 8 in the CBL 2024 and an exclusive Unit Flag.
3rd Place: An exclusive CBL 2024 Unit Flag, Top 3 Frame and $2,000 in Cash.
2nd Place: An exclusive CBL 2024 Unit Flag, Runner Up Frame, Runner Up Title and $5,000 in Cash.
1st Place: An exclusive CBL 2024 Unit Flag, Champion Frame, Champion Avatar, Champion Title, Exclusive Champion Attire and $8,000 in Cash.


- Rally your allies and sign up to compete against the best!

notes.title: "Alexander: The Great" Event Schedule Adjustment
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,

The server ecosystem of “Conqueror's Blade” has entered a new era. To ensure that all Warlords have a smooth experience in various in-game activities, the schedules for [Ranked Battles] and [Territory Wars] will be adjusted accordingly, along with the star requirements for ranking up in [Ranked Battles].

1. [Territory War] Adjustments

[Formal Servers] and [Growth Servers]:


 To ensure that houses have adequate time to level up and accumulate Prestige at the start of the new season, the first [Territory War] for all formal and growth servers will take place on June 25th (Tuesday). On June 22nd (Saturday), we will hold [Military Exercise] to help Warlords become familiar with the territory war battlefield of this new season.

[Newbie Servers]: 


 To give new players sufficient growth time, the first [Territory War] for newbie servers will take place on June 29th (Saturday). No [Territory Wars] or [Military Exercise] will be scheduled on June 22nd (Saturday) or June 25th (Tuesday).

The final [Territory War] before the season's end will be on August 31st (Saturday). On September 3rd (Tuesday), [Military Exercise] will be available on all servers.

The settlement time for the territory war rewards for this season is scheduled for September 5th (Thursday). After the reward settlement and before the next season launch, Territory War will continue to be available every Tuesday and Saturday on all servers.


2. [Ranked Battles] Adjustments

In previous seasons, the extensive daily availability of [Ranked Battles] led to player fatigue and longer queue times during off-peak periods. Additionally, queueing in off-peak period made it easier for unfair play, affecting the integrity of [Ranked Battles].

The high star requirement for ranking up also caused boredom and fatigue in the mid to late season for many warlords.

To allow more players to enjoy high-quality matches without pressure and to better manage their playtime, we are adjusting the [Ranked Battles] time slots and star requirements:

 The time slot for [Ranked Battles] will be more concentrated on the daily peak hours of players to enhance match quality.
 Increase the number of days per week that players can access Ranked Battles to accommodate different play schedules.
 Reducing the overall time required to rank up and earn rewards, making it less stressful.

This is a new attempt, and we will keep monitoring the overall situation during the season and make timely adjustments. Thank you for your attention and participation in [Ranked Battles]!

New Time Slots:

notes.title: [Alexander] Update Log
notes.content:
1) Season Units

Psiloi Slingers (3 Stars)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c10e9e3e0743e034932b36fa757b2cdf3536c0e2.jpg

Back Story

   "The island of Rhodes, located on the Aegean Sea, with its important strategic position, has always been the object of ambition for aspiring nations. Throughout its long history of resisting foreign invasions, the resilient and intelligent residents of Rhodes have developed a unique form of warfare, the art of stone throwing: with just a pile of rocks and a roughly made sling, farmers, craftsmen, and even frail shepherds can transform into powerful warriors capable of killing enemies from hundreds of feet away in wars.

  Initially, the noble generals and kings looked down upon this "peasant" strategy. Only the Conqueror recognized the potential of this tactic. He incorporated the stone-throwers of Rhodes into his army. The great battle that took place in Chaeronea proved the wisdom of the king. In this ultimate battle between Macedonia and Persia, the stone-throwers invoked the name of the sun god, hurling a myriad of stones towards the enemy. The proud elite Immortals of the Persian Empire found themselves cornered and ultimately defeated by this army composed of commoners. After the war, the Conqueror collectively bestowed upon this legion the title of heroes. In an era where lineage meant everything, they, with humble origins, became the heroes of a great conquering age."

Battle Style

      They are the stone-throwers from Rhodes, dressed simply in coarse cloth and straw hats, carrying a bag of stones, wielding shields and slingshots. Their primary attack method is stone-throwing, using slingshots to hurl stones with force. This technique allows them to inflict significant armor-piercing damage at close to medium range, with a chance to stun enemy units. Moreover, the resilient and clever stone-throwers of Rhodes are well-versed in the art of stone-throwing, able to turn nearby pebbles into weapons at any moment to replenish their ammunition.

Unit Characteristics:

 Able to replenish ammo at anywhere. Stuns enemies from afar and deals high burst damage when close.

Skills:：

 Skill 1: Attack Area (Begins firing in the designated area.)
 Skill 2: Say "Cheese" (Shakes their slingshots and fires in unison, dealing greater damage than normal attacks with a higher chance to stun.)
 Skill 3: Quarry (Squats down to quarry and replenish ammo.)

Companion Cavalry (4 Stars)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/baa1a325935a5e7de9ca651c1f75b38474ccfcb7.jpg

Back Story

       "By the side of the kings of Macedonia often stand guards known as "Companions," noble-born and fiercely loyal. The kings view them not just as subordinates, but as brothers-in-arms. Each "Companion" of a Macedonian king will follow their king anywhere, until the king passes or the last drop of blood is shed.

  The majority of the "Companion" cavalry are born of nobility, hence they often bear the finest equipment: riding swift steeds, wielding the lethal lance, and resorting to sharp swords once their lances are broken in combat. Under the banner of the conquering king, these units become an unparalleled elite force, playing a pivotal role on the battlefield. Poets have likened the king's tactics to a "hammer and anvil": if the infantry units holding the line in a tug-of-war with the enemy are the "anvil," the Companion cavalry are the "hammer," swooping in to exploit enemies' weaknesses and shattering them in a single charge. After several rounds of hammer strikes, even the mightiest of foes will crumble. In the grand Eastern conquest, this legion has accompanied the conquering king all the way to the ends of the world, beyond the farthest reaches of the sea."

Battle Style

  They are the most loyal companions of Alexander, playing a crucial role in his tactics. Often launching flank attacks on enemy formations with the king, they draw immense inspiration simply by being by his side, enhancing their combat abilities significantly.
he Companions Cavalry are also highly skilled in guerrilla tactics, utilizing dual weapons to adapt to various battle scenarios. Their exceptional flexibility allows them to engage at the right moment, creating significant advantages for their side with their high burst damage.

Unit Characteristics:

 A highly mobile light cavalry with low defense.
 Works great when striking with the hero in guerilla-like attacks.
 Deals sustained damage while using their short swords and draws close to the hero, waiting for the opportune moment to strike.

Skills

Skills
Spear:

 Skill 1: Gale Strike (Revolves their spears and stabs at the enemy, dealing high damage.)
 Skill 2: Storm Pound (Leaps from their mounts and strikes with their spears from the air. May knock enemy units down.)

Short Sword:

 Skill 1: Zephyr Blade (Remains on guard, striking at anyone who draws close to the hero.)


Sunward Phalanx (5 Stars)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cbdc2149bbd1d142fc1c2a4930c8d0626c29cf6a.jpg

Back Story

      "The father of the Conqueror, the former ruler of Macedonia, created a new legionary tactic, known as the Macedonian phalanx: warriors clad in heavy armor, wielding long spears, formed an unstoppable phalanx and advanced. The Conqueror further elevated this legionary tactic to its pinnacle: he commissioned the creation of spears longer than people of that time could imagine. When warriors equipped with these long spears formed their lines and pointed their spearheads towards the enemy, the very nature of war was fundamentally altered. War ceased to be a game of individual valor and became a unified front of thousands. The clash transformed, inexorably consuming and dispersing the enemy like scattered troops and mercenaries. Stirring battle cries turned into subdued commands, as even the most skilled and valiant warriors found attacking such a formation akin to striking a mountain or the vast sea.
   This highly effective strategy aided the Conqueror in vanquishing all his foes. On the battlefield, his units stood like a silent mountain, slowly advancing towards the enemy. The figure of the emperor before the formation thus became immensely towering, bowing seemingly as the sole choice to this great monarch."

Battle Style

       Wearing the iconic style helmets, linen cuirasses, and leather kilts, the finest warriors of Macedonia wielded spears of extraordinary length, their arms secured by large round shields, advancing in an indomitable phalanx formation. Shielded by their round shields, they stood fearless against attacks from afar. Following the king's command, they could adopt the phalanx formation, moving steadily back and forth with their long spears, continuously compressing the enemy's lines. 

Unit Characteristics:

 Through skillful manipulation of the distance from the enemy, Macedonia could evade harm while seizing the opportune moment on the ever-changing battlefield, swiftly penetrating for the kill!


Skills

Skill 1：

  Imperial Spears (The Sunward Phalanx props their spears up and begins to Brace.)
  Fierce Advance (The Sunward Phalanx advances with their spears held high. You may choose the direction in which they advance.)

Skill 2：

 Ares' Flurry (The Sunward Phalanx strikes forward multiple times.)


2) Conqueror's Path

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e459c364bdd7b4c5fe491a00cd9023214a5f60fe.jpg

Seasonal Store
Attires from the Sengoku season will be returning to the Seasonal Store for the duration of the Alexander season. These will be available at a 20% [Badges of Heroism] discount.

Changes to Hegemon/Monarch Title Rewards

 Added a brand-new Territory War attire as an end-of-season reward, which will only be awarded to the Hegemon/Monarch who claims Conqueror's City.
 Starting from the Alexander season, those acquiring the Hegemon/Monarch titles will no longer receive an Imperial Dawn Attire Chest.

World Map Availability & Fief Distribution Improvements

 The regions available in the Alexander season have been thematically chosen, and they are Anadolou, Ungverija and The Borderlands.


 Anadolou will be the one available for single-region servers.
 For three-region servers, The Borderlands will be the core region, meaning that players must contend over Conqueror's City for the coveted Hegemon title.
 For single-region servers, Anadolou will be the core regions, meaning that players must contend over Reginopolis for the coveted Hegemon title.
 Considering the overall distribution and density of fiefs and their effect on Territory War, we've reduced the number of fiefs in the Anadolou, Ungverija and The Borderlands regions.

notes.title: Espada Forest Relocation! The Beginning of a Global Era!
notes.content:
Based on continued discussions with the affected players and much consideration, we've decided to: 

Merge the [Espada Forest] server into the EU/NA server cluster and embark upon a journey of taking Conqueror's Blade global!

[Espada Forest] will be merging with the NA region's [Eagle Range] server on June 27 with the launch of the [Alexander: The Great] season, thus forming the [Elysium Peak] server—a matchmaking ecology with servers from the EU and NA, creating an all-new server ecology for both EU and US players alike!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/496b858b4f8dcf36f6bd872eb781f76a791879db.jpg

This decision is based on our community's wishes along with the dev team's wish for a wider server ecology. Providing high-quality services and a great gameplay experience to our global playerbase has been something the team has always been striving for. We want to take this opportunity to improve the experience for those affected and put the expansive world of Conqueror's Blade out there for all to experience—in a more global format than ever.

As we respect each individual player's choice, you will be given a choice between June 20 and June 27 (around when [Espada Forest] forest merges into the NA [Eagle Range] server)

 to select whether your characters on [Espada Forest] transfer to the [Asia] servers or the [NA - Eagle Range] one. Those of you who would prefer not to merge into the EU/NA playerbase, may instead opt to transfer to the Asia servers (LA/DI/JC/EX).
 Characters for which no selection is made during this time will be transferred to the NA [Eagle Range] server and be part of forming the [Elysium Peak] server.
 Following the server merge, players that transfer onto the [Elysium Peak] server will need to log in to the website pertaining to the International servers (global.conquerorsblade.com), and then use their old account (Poros/Steam) and re-download the game.
 Character data transferred from the [Espada Forest] server will be processed based on the destination server, after which they will have to adhere to that server's ecology and rules. This includes payment, online modes, events, etc.


Merge Schedule

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/20fa4d8a93f2bbd2f18220ebf3c721210b86ffb8.jpg

[Espada Forest] Post-Transfer Data Processing
Sovereigns

 Due to the differing Sovereign ratios on the Asia and EU/NA servers, players with outstanding Sovereigns/Sovereign Notes will have those converted to the new server at a 1.8 ratio (rounded up).
 The future exchange rates when Topping Up will adhere to the rates of the EU/NA servers.•Game 

Modes & Rules

 Rules and times for events and game modes, as well as Store sales, will adhere to those of the EU/NA servers.

Platform Data

 Starting from June 27, due to IP block restrictions,

 you will no longer be able to access Conqueror's Blade's Asia Steam store page.
 This will not affect your Steam library or your Steam achievements.
 Upon accessing our website, you'll be redirected to global.conquerorsblace.com, the official site for the EU/NA servers.

 Those South American players among you who tend to play on Steam need to search for Conqueror's Blade again in the Steam store, and download the EU/NA version that's currently not in your library.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/02c11c9b0f66eaa96e42525a8ed76183952489ad.png
Server Location Changes

 If you choose the NA servers, your user data will be stored in Virginia in the east of America.
 If you choose the Asia servers, your user data will be stored in Hong Kong, China.


Conclusion
The merging of [Espada Forest] to the EU/NA servers is the first step in creating a global ecology. We'll continue to expand the scope of Conqueror's Blade's international servers to allow players across more regions to participate in this feast of medieval battles, no longer bound by regions! We firmly believe that Conqueror's Blade has what it takes to shine brightly and reach a more global playerbase. Thank you all for your continued support and trust!

notes.title: [Alexander: The Great] Season Unit Spotlight: Sunward Phalanx (5 Stars)
notes.content:
In the name of conquest, carry the dreams of the masses! Bring civilization to the wilderness, and glory to the world! Season [Alexander: The Great] is about to begin!

On June 20th, join forces with the new season's Sunward Phalanx to crush the enemy together and shout the call of victory!

[previewyoutube=KETRwOxIArY;full][/previewyoutube]

Unit Inspiration:

   The father of the Conqueror, the former ruler of Macedonia, created a new legionary tactic, known as the Macedonian phalanx: warriors clad in heavy armor, wielding long spears, formed an unstoppable phalanx and advanced. The Conqueror further elevated this legionary tactic to its pinnacle: he commissioned the creation of spears longer than people of that time could imagine. When warriors equipped with these long spears formed their lines and pointed their spearheads towards the enemy, the very nature of war was fundamentally altered. War ceased to be a game of individual valor and became a unified front of thousands. The clash transformed, inexorably consuming and dispersing the enemy like scattered troops and mercenaries. Stirring battle cries turned into subdued commands, as even the most skilled and valiant warriors found attacking such a formation akin to striking a mountain or the vast sea.
   This highly effective strategy aided the Conqueror in vanquishing all his foes. On the battlefield, his units stood like a silent mountain, steadily advancing towards the enemy. As the figure of the emperor stood before the formation gradually became towering, bowing seems to be the only choice to this great monarch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2a9e816f14d37ce7f9f98e179299e77c73b024a1.jpg

Featured Gameplay:

Wearing the iconic style helmets, linen cuirasses, and leather kilts, the finest warriors of Macedonia wielded spears of extraordinary length, their arms secured by large round shields, advancing in an indomitable phalanx formation. Shielded by their round shields, they stood fearless against attacks from afar. Following the king's command, moving steadily back and forth with their long spears, continuously compressing the enemy's lines. Through skillful manipulation of the distance from the enemy, Macedonia could evade harm while seizing the opportune moment and launch a lethal strike on the ever-changing battlefield!

Unbeatable like a mountain, march alongside the Sunward Phalanx, sweeping across the world in "Conqueror's Blade"!
It's the ultimate battle, the pursuit of ideals! For more information about the new season and new units, please follow our official community.
