notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] 2024 CBL is Getting Started, the Global Throne is Awaiting!
notes.content:
With the summer approaching and the return of the European and American regions of Conqueror's Blade, the 2024 CBL is set to reignite the flames. As a premier official tournament of Conqueror's Blade, the 2024 CBL will be unprecedented in scale. We will open four regional divisions globally, including the Mainland China division, Asia-Pacific division, European division, and Americas division, culminating in four stages to truly showcase a global showdown between the East and the West.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b6cd0f452a14fc904ecb785d524b9810f404da9d.jpg

Note: The following is a concise version of the rules. Detailed rules will be synchronized to the official website of CBL before the start of the tournament.

【Event Stages】

 Stage 1:

Regional  Qualifiers：Players need to accumulate rank points through the [Ranked Battle] gameplay. Teams from each region and sequence will advance to the next stage based on the overall team scores (excluding official invitations).

 Stage 2:

Regional  Tournaments：Teams that advance from Stage 1 will be drawn into Regional Tournaments, with the winners progressing to the knockout stage. The top three from each of the four divisions will emerge after the knockout stage.

 Stage 3:

Conference Championship：The top two teams from the Mainland China and Asia-Pacific division will compete in the Eastern Championship to determine the CBL Eastern Champion. The top two teams from the European and Americas division will compete in the Western Championship to determine the CBL Western Champion.

 Stage 4:

Conqueror's Blade International Champion Cup (CBIC）：The CBL Eastern Champion and CBL Western Champion will join forces for the Conqueror's Blade International Champion Cup, showcasing the best of CBL competition.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/807672bfab14a023c8a894a500645b99884b6e21.jpg

Notice: The Espada Forest server in South America will be merged into the Americas server. Players cannot form teams with players from the Asia-Pacific region. The registration period is from June 27th to June 30th. For any exceptional circumstances, please contact our community manager.


【Key Dates】

 Registration: June 14, 2024, 12:00 (UTC+8) - June 30, 2024, 11:59 (UTC+8)
 Regional Qualifiers: June 20, 2024, 12:00 (UTC+8) - July 19, 2024, 11:59 (UTC+8)
 Regional Tournaments: July 19, 2024 - August 25, 2024
 Conference Championship: August 26, 2024 - September 10, 2024


【How to apply】

 Press "F7" in game to enter the sign-up page, or visit the links below to register:
 Mainland China Division Registration: https://cbl.z.163.com/
 Pan-Asia Division Registration: https://cbl.conquerorsblade.com 
 Europe and Americas Division Registration: https://cbl-global.conquerorsblade.com 


【Registration Requirements】

 1. Individual Requirements:


 Characters must be at least level 100 to register.
 Accounts must not be under any form of ban.
 Duplicate registrations are not allowed. Only one character per account can be part of a team at the same time.



 2. Team Requirements:


 Teams must consist of a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 20 eligible members.
 Members must be part of the team in the squad system by the registration deadline.
 During the registration period, the team leader can click "Register Now" if the team meets the requirements.


【Prize】

 The champion team will receive a massive prize from the pool including exclusive attire, avatars, avatar frames, and more. The prize pool will reach an unprecedented $60,000. Additionally, all participants in this CBL will receive exclusive rewards!！


【Tournament Format】

 The CBL tournament follows a format of points race, group matches, and knockout stages. The points race calculates the total ranked points of the top 15 players in the registered team (from June 20, 2024, to July 19, 2024, 11:59). Teams will be ranked and promoted based on the number of teams in each division.


 2. This CBL will be divided into four divisions: Mainland China, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. Details regarding the servers and the teams advancing from the ladder points tournament in each region are as follows:：




 1）Mainland China Division:


 16 teams will be selected from the Regional Qualifiers for the Regional Tournament (including 4 official invitations).

 Due to differences in the rankings between the national server sequence and the international server sequence in "Ranked Battles " points, the region is split into two sub-regions:

 8 teams will be selected from National Server Sequence for the Regional Tournament from Regional Qualifiers. These servers involved: Jiulongzhuri, Kaijiangtuoyu, Weijiahainei

 4 teams will be selected from International Server Sequence for the Regional Tournament from Regional Qualifiers. These servers involved: Xianfengjingji, Tianceshangjiang

 The remaining 4 teams will be directly invited by the official xians to participate in the Regional Tournament.



 2）Asia-Pacific Division


 16 teams will be selected from the Regional Qualifiers for the Regional Tournament, including 6 official invitations. Details are as follows：

 10 teams will be selected from Asia-Pacific Division for the Regional Tournament from Regional Qualifiers. These servers involved：Jaderock Creek、Lotus Ash Sea、Dragonrise Island、Sandstorm Gorge、Espada Forest、Excalibur、Khan of Heaven、Eastern Conquest

 The remaining 6 teams will be directly invited by the officials to participate in the Regional Tournament.



 3）European Division，


 16 teams will be selected from the Regional Qualifiers for the Regional Tournament, including 4 official invitations. Details are as follows：

 12 teams will be selected from European Division for the Regional Tournament from Regional Qualifiers. These servers involved：Crystal Sea、Sicania

 The remaining 4 teams will be directly invited by the officials to participate in the Regional Tournament.



 4）Americans Division，


 8 teams will be selected from the Regional Qualifiers for the Regional Tournament. Details are as follows：

 8 teams will be selected from Americans Division for the Regional Tournament from Regional Qualifiers. These servers involved：Eagle Range、Espada Forest



【Rules for Team and Player Naming】


 1. Team Naming Rules:


 1）The team name in the CBL server is the same as the house name created by the team leader. For global event consistency, team names can currently only consist of English letters and numbers, with a character requirement of 4 to 32 characters.

 2）Names must not contain any insulting or discriminatory meanings. If found, the team will be disqualified directly.

 3）Teams must provide an abbreviation consisting of 3 to 4 characters.

 4）In special cases, abbreviations with meanings can be determined and publicly announced after communication with the official team.

 5）Officials reserve the right to modify team names or abbreviations based on actual circumstances.



 2. Individual Naming Rules


 1）The character name in the CBL server is the individual's name.

 2）The format is [Team Abbreviation_Individual Nickname], with no restrictions on the individual name.

 3）For example, if a team abbreviation is BOOM and their character name is LEON, the name would be [BOOM_LEON].

 4）Names must not contain any insulting or discriminatory meanings. If found, the team will be disqualified directly.

 5）Players with names that do not meet the naming rules are not allowed to participate.

 6）Officials reserve the right to modify individual’s name or abbreviations based on actual circumstances.



【Point Race Rules】


 1、Since the current ranking system mainly relies on division calculations, the final result of the point race will be based on the total team points data as recorded on the CBL official website.

 2、If the registration period overlaps with the point race period, players are allowed to switch between teams freely. However, the final list of participants will be based on the team composition at the registration deadline.

 3、At the start of the point race, players who have not joined a team but have any score changes from participating in [Ranked Battles] will also be included in the point race calculation. For example, if "CN-Leon" does not choose a team at the start of the point race on June 20 but continues to participate in the [Ranked Battles] and joins a team on June 29, the points earned from participating in the [Ranked Battles] from June 20 to July 19 will still be calculated for "CN-Leon."

 4、At the end of the point race, only the total [Ranked Battles] scores of the top 15 players in the team will be considered as the team's score.

 5、Points Race Notices:


 1）If a team leader has characters on multiple servers or multiple characters on the same server, the point calculation will be based on the server where the character with the highest [Ranked Battles] score is located. If team members have characters on multiple servers or multiple characters on the same server, the server where the team leader is located will be used to calculate the point race.

 2）Duplicate registrations are prohibited in the CBL. If a player is found to have created multiple characters and joined multiple teams on the CBL server during calculations, the player's eligibility will be revoked, and the teams will not be allowed to add replacement members.

 3）Forming teams across different server sequences, such as Jiulongzhuri and Kaijiangtuoyu, is not allowed. Members belonging to different server sequences will be considered invalid registrations, and their teams will not be allowed to add replacement members. The server sequence of the team will be based on the character registered by the team leader, and team members must confirm the server sequence of the team with the leader.

 4）Teams that do not provide contact information (Discord/QQ) or cannot be contacted by the official team will be considered invalid registrations.

 5）The final list of the team and [Ranked Battles] scores used in calculation are all based on the status at the registration deadline of July 19.

 6）The seasonal rank or [Ranked Battles] score of promoted team members will be publicly displayed.



Because the promotion for the 2024 CBL Regional Tournaments is primarily based on the total points in "Ranked Battles" of the registered team members. So, don't miss the "Ranked Battles" when the new season starts on June 20th. Warlords, make sure to call your brothers for ranking matches together.

Wishing all our warlord good luck and great success!

notes.title: [Alexander] Season Unit Spotlight: Companion Cavalry (4-Star)
notes.content:
The Eastern conquest, a testament of the gods! Advance! The ideals will soon spread throughout the world. Season [Alexander: The Great] is about to begin!
On June 20th, raise a toast to ideals with the new season's Companion Cavalry!

[previewyoutube=7YLbbdsAyIY;full][/previewyoutube]

Unit Inspirations
  By the side of the kings of Macedonia often stand guards known as "Companions," They are noble-born and fiercely loyal. The king regarded them as brothers and sisters, not as mere subordinates. Each "Companion" will follow their king anywhere, until the king passes or the very last drop of blood is shed.
  The majority of the "Companion" cavalry are born of nobility; hence they often bear the finest equipment: riding swift steeds, wielding the lethal lance, and resorting to sharp swords once their lances are broken in combat. Under the banner of the conquering king, these units become an unparalleled elite force, playing a pivotal role on the battlefield. Poets have likened the king's tactics to a "hammer and anvil": if the infantry units holding the line in a tug-of-war with the enemy are the "anvil," the Companion cavalry are the "hammer," Searching for any opportunity to exploit the enemies' weaknesses and shattering them with a single decisive charge. After several rounds of hammer strikes, even the mightiest of foes will crumble. In the grand Eastern conquest, this legion has accompanied the conquering king all the way to the ends of the world.

They are the most loyal companions of Alexander, playing a crucial role in his tactics. Often launching flank attacks on enemy formations with the king, they draw immense inspiration simply by being by his side, enhancing their combat abilities significantly.
Companions Cavalry are also highly skilled in guerrilla tactics, utilizing dual weapons to adapt to various battle scenarios. Their exceptional flexibility allows them to engage at the right moment, creating significant advantages for their side with their high burst damage.

Fearless in facing any obstacles, march alongside the Companions Cavalry to the end of the sea in "Conqueror's Blade"!
It's the ultimate battle, the pursuit of ideals! For more information about the new season and new units, please follow our official community.

notes.title: [Alexander: The Great] Season Unit Spotlight: Psiloi Slingers (3-Star)
notes.content:
Under the gaze of the gods of Olympus and the king, advance! Until the world becomes your ideal kingdom, proclaim to the world that we stand here! Season [Alexander: The Great] is about to begin! 
On June 20th, join the new season's Psiloi Slingers as we embark on this journey together, singing the song of heroes loud and proud!!

[previewyoutube=8B_vA4owrW8;full][/previewyoutube]

Unit Inspirations
   The island of Rhodes, located on the Aegean Sea, with its important strategic position, has always been the object of ambition for aspiring nations. Throughout its long history of resisting foreign invasions, the resilient and intelligent residents of Rhodes have developed a unique form of warfare, the art of stone throwing: with just a pile of rocks and a roughly made sling, farmers, craftsmen, and even frail shepherds can transform into powerful warriors capable of killing enemies from hundreds of feet away in wars.
  Initially, the noble generals and kings looked down upon this "peasant" strategy. Only the Conqueror recognized the potential of this tactic. He incorporated the stone-throwers of Rhodes into his army. The great battle that took place in Chaeronea proved the wisdom of the king. In this ultimate battle between Macedonia and Persia, the stone-throwers invoked the name of the sun god, hurling a myriad of stones towards the enemy. The proud elite Immortals of the Persian Empire found themselves cornered and ultimately defeated by this army composed of commoners. After the war, the Conqueror collectively bestowed upon this legion the title of heroes. In an era where lineage meant everything, they, with humble origins, became the heroes of a great conquering age.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be7f4a3ee6791ca86be7c339cf577f949e7f5166.jpg

Featured Gameplay
They are the stone-throwers from Rhodes, dressed simply in coarse cloth and straw hats, carrying a bag of stones, wielding shields and slingshots. Their primary attack method is stone-throwing, using slingshots to hurl stones with force. This technique allows them to inflict significant armor-piercing damage at close to medium range, with a chance to stun enemy units. Moreover, the resilient and clever stone-throwers of Rhodes are well-versed in the art of stone-throwing, able to turn nearby pebbles into weapons at any moment to replenish their ammunition.


The song of conquest is about to resound, join forces with the stone-throwers from Rhodes, and share victory in "Conqueror’s Blade"! 
It's the ultimate battle, the pursuit of ideals! For more information about the new season and new units, please follow our official community.

notes.title: Hero Awakened | Attire Spotlight [Hellenic Court Robes], [Vergina Sun]
notes.content:
Rise under the sun, King of the continent, set forth on your journey...

In the golden dawn, he leads fearless warriors, illuminating the dream of conquering the world.

His destiny intertwined with history,

He shall be the architect of legends,

The lighthouse of conquerors.

[previewyoutube=lLGwILIjrng;full][/previewyoutube]

[Hellenic Court Robes] Design Philosophy
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/faed53449597739654047e5b15c593a493ab2734.jpg

In the beginning, a king in a small foreign land did not attract much attention until he defeated enemies in a great battle once deemed invincible. 

The city-states welcomed their savior and conqueror, causing a stir throughout the continent. They bowed to the king, crowning him with the legendary Golden Palm Leaf!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2585f96daf41c1ea7a01092c30bf10b99d4ad329.jpg


The design team drew inspiration from the city-states and enhanced classical attire to create fashion that exudes the attributes of a conqueror.

The attire incorporates numerous elements of palm leaf crowns, symbolizing victory, prestige, and wisdom in the culture of the city-states. Under the protection of the palm leaves, the Conqueror King carries the dreams of the people and embarks on the journey towards his ideal conquest...


[Vergina Sun] Design Philosophy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a0154698b6b1a6e32ffaa32660517d17dde9cd8c.jpg

The royal family bears the sun as its emblem, praying for the eternal prosperity and peace of the kingdom under the ruler's command. 

As a member of royal lineage clad in the sacred Sun armor, one must never boast of nobility and distance oneself from the battlefield. The Conqueror King forever stands at the pinnacle of the battlefield, proclaiming his mighty presence to the enemy, indomitable until the endpoint of victory....

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9571ddc786766a1d054fc22380a81d4cd62dbe18.jpg


The attire features the Vergina Sun emblem prominently displayed on cloaks and breastplates, symbolizing the royal family's desire for abundant lands and sunlight.

The feathers on the sides of the helmet represent the god Zeus from classical myth, symbolizing the divine status of Alexander the Great. Legend has it that the kings were descendants of Zeus. Each king was clad in eagle feathers and a dark cloak and conquered city-states in the name of the god-king….

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fefcb883b8f892270081af0bcd7999c9371728be.jpg

We're pleased to present the following updates for this maintenance:

 [Alexander] Season Pass x1
 Treatise x1

Price: 680 Sovereigns

June 6th after maintenance ~ June 20th before maintenance.

2. Pre-order the New Season Pass, unlock Chivalric Oath, and Get the New Seasonal Unit for Free!!

 Enter the O-Events page to participate in the [Chivalric Oath] event.

June 6th after maintenance ~ June 20th before maintenance.

Quality: Epic

June 6th after maintenance ~ June 20th before maintenance.

II. Adjustments and Optimizations

Season Settlement Notice

Season Settlement:

 "Dragonrise" season is coming to an end, and the season settlement will take place after the maintenance on June 6th.

Unit adjustment

 Reduce damage to heroes by 30%.
 Decrease the damage of [Weapon Veteran] by 15%.
 Reduce the damage of [Weapon Veteran] by 15% in low-speed states.

[Azaps] adjustments:

 Remove crowd-control effects immediately when activating [Counterstrike].
 Ignore collisions with allied units when activating [Counterstrike].

[Azaps] Mastery:

 Increases slashing damage by 80 points.
 Increases blocking by 80 points.
 Increases slashing Armor penetration by 100 points.
 Increases blocking by 80 points.
 Reduce block loss in [Counterstrike], gain 20% damage reduction for 4 seconds.
 Reduce damage from polearm units by 300 points.
 Increase damage to polearm units by 300 points.
Gain 1 [Counterstrike] stamp when being attacked in [Counterstrike] state, up to a maximum of 5 stacks; when using "Counterstrike", restore health equal to "Counterstrike stamp stacks * 300" per second for 3 seconds, gain damage bonus equal to "Counterstrike stamp stacks * 10%" for 5 seconds, and remove all "Counterstrike stamp".

[Siege Battle] Related

Post-battle rating feature in [Siege Battle]:

 In order to better understand the preferences of our warlords regarding various maps in the "Siege Battle," a rating feature will be introduced in some of the maps in the "Siege Battle." The rating button will be displayed on the settlement interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0499f417f8df6c277ad0a1be858e2da4dd79016d.jpg

[Siege Battle] Map Pool Adjustment:

 Adjustment to the map pool in "Siege Battle," temporarily removing the maps of Allenburg, Quinn Ruins, Shield of the Capital, and La Grande Gloire, increasing the probability of matching with Haojing.


III. Bug Fixes and Optimizations


 Fixed the issue of clicking on the "Unit Mastery (II)" in the task bar did not redirect to the Barracks interface.
 Fixed the issue in the Siege Battle map "The Great Wall," where players were unable to construct siege engines on certain accessible towers.
 Fixed the issue in "Clash Frenzy" where units were unable to move within Augolia, and some barriers, gates, and walls were missing.
 Fixed the issue with the legendary horse attire special effects, only the owner could see the effect under certain circumstances.
 Fixed the issue where the unit color displayed as an ally's unit when opening the U interface in the Open World.
 • Fixed the issue in the "Ranked Battles" settlement where the displayed rank did not match the actual rank.
 Fixed the issue in Streamer Mode where players' ID were still displayed in some battlefield notifications.
 Fixed the issue of missing kits when using the "Replenish All Kit" function from the [Warband Builds] interface under some circumstances.
 A new confirmation interface has been added to the Warband Builds kit replenishment, allowing for a more detailed display of the amount of kits and Bronze coins required.
 Fixed an issue with the hero attire "Eternal Spirit" for female characters where a gap appeared in the hand model after removing the gloves.
 Fixed an issue where some models left invisible obstacles after being destroyed, causing abnormal obstructions.
 Fixed the issue of incorrect voiceover after donating in the Fame Envoy.
 Fixed the issue of no voiceover for the unit defeated in Banner Guards, Berserkers, Crescent Monks, and Zykalian Militia.
 Optimized the layout of the "The Arabian Nights" event page for better compatibility, 16:9 and 21:9 display ratios are recommended for gaming.

notes.title: #6 – Conqueror’s Report
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, long time no see!

#6 – Conqueror’s Report finally meets everyone. We apologize for the delay of this.

Curious about the factors causing the delay? Let's dive into #6 – Conqueror's Report together to uncover the details!

Newsletter Prelude

 Player Moderators: Elevating Our Gaming Community Together!
 Frontline Letters:  What is the development team actually doing? Latest updates from the team!
 Song of the Battlefield


Player Moderators: Elevating Our Gaming Community Together!!
Each of our newly appointed Player Moderators is an experienced and passionate gamer, committed to cultivating a friendly and uplifting atmosphere within our community. They will actively collect feedback from players and maintain close communication with everyone, ensuring that we are always in tune with your needs and expectations.

In order to better serve you, our amazing Mods will focus on engaging with the community, assisting with any issues, sharing valuable game knowledge, and offering helpful tips. They will help transform our community into a platform where we all support and learn from one another. Furthermore, they will work closely with us to localize and deliver essential information, guaranteeing that every player has access to accurate and timely updates!

•Frontline Letters:  What is the development team actually doing? Latest updates from the team!

It has been several weeks since the last Conqueror’s Report, and some warlords may be speculating whether we have abandoned this again. No! Listening to players' voices diligently has always been the core mission of Conqueror’s Blade development team and Conqueror’s Blade community team. We deeply understand that player feedback is crucial to us, as it forms the milestone of shaping the future of our game. The Conqueror’s Report serves as an important channel of communication between us and the generals, and we will not give up on this column.

So, what have we been done in the past few weeks? 

We have collected and organized all bugs and suggestions from players across various platforms over the past few years, totaling over 3,600 feedback in more than 11 languages. Based on the quantity and priority of these feedbacks, we have conducted a comprehensive evaluation and detailed scheduling of these suggestions and bugs.

Most importantly, we and the development team promise to do our best to turn your valuable feedback into reality!

We sincerely invite you to witness the first wave of changes in Conqueror’s Blade.

Q: We need a bulk unboxing feature!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0c84bab56b38e31e41fdc96f2dee62e2ab1dfe04.jpg

A: Great! Your needs are our development direction! Based on you guys feedback, a new feature has been added, allowing bulk opening of selected and random chests. The maximum number for bulk opening of chests is 20 each time. We will continue to monitor and optimize the user experience for this feature.

Q: When will the issue of artillery view obstruction be fixed?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3b7d6ef82dd02692497a3a66430ca8ddcdc9e92f.jpg

A: Fixed! The version on May 23, 2024, we optimized the view when using artillery. Nearby heroes, units, and walls will become semi-transparent during artillery usage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c97592c1c026ca89be01df0ec0b2d864eca044be.jpg

Q: We need more colors to mark teammates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5b88421b078892e3ade613facc7625ea2086611c.jpg

A: Great! The battlefield information optimization is now online! In order to help our Warlords to better identify grouped teammates, the following updates have been made to differentiate teammates and grouped teammates:

1. Added team colors for teammates in the group. The default color for grouped teammates is green, making it easier to distinguish different teammates on the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/95495b5c57ac9464ca3d30460ae89616adb7fa04.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ac6abf78eda703d8d4881447b2523980d19169a4.jpg

(2) Unified the color of unit indicators and the hero's health bar to yellow, ensuring consistency with the default color in the settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/173f7b20534bc5dcf0fd893a36f32f48f1902a27.jpg

(3) Differentiated chat colors for "Allies" and "Group" chats. The text color for group chat is green, while the text color for allies is blue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3a13e406c61ebc54b085fb1ae1032ffb32c28782.jpg

Q: The sound effects of the heroes and units are too loud!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dea495ea8c7338451c09657e4302cd04d8f3e4e4.jpg

A: The development of an independent audio control system is in progress! We will provide detailed independent volume control, allowing warlords to adjust/turn off/on different sections of voiceovers independently. We will also remix the in-game audio (volume balance) to address issues such as excessively loud audio or overly frequent triggers.

Q: When will the series of heroes bugs be fixed!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/93b8aa65cd4d38a2ce114be97478aa06dc60dbb9.jpg

A: Fixes have begun! The Maelstrom in the fifth stage of Maul could not be triggered, dismounting skills might fail when used on stairs/slopes, musket reload logic optimization, heroes getting stuck due to the interruption of Choke skill casting, and more. These issues have already been queued up to be fixed! Warlords, don’t worry, your concern is our top priority!

Q: In anonymous mode, player’s nicknames still appear in some notification and kill prompts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8b04b70714c0efee566ae75ee0ed3aea4938e00d.jpg

A: Fixed!

Q: We have more suggestions...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/aa714a732613bb3bfafa0297e426f8db8937419a.jpg

A: Please be assured! We have carefully reviewed and evaluated each of the 3600+ suggestions, and we will work diligently to incorporate your feedback into the game in the future. This is truly our dedication to improving the game based on your input!

So, what would be our next move…?

1. We realize that balance is extremely crucial to the warlords and Conqueror’s Blade. We've received numerous reports about the balance of the season's units, and we apologize for not taking action sooner. The balance adjustment for Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry is about to be launched!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0fd58b5ec79bf9c78d8c767755cc1d655dbb0875.jpg

2. We have received recent feedback regarding abnormal collision effects on models and have arranged a team to fix it. A big thank you to all of you for assisting in diagnosing the problem! However, we realize that it is beyond our capability to review all maps alone. We humbly ask for your help and hope that everyone can collaborate in identifying such issues. Please leave us a message in the designated DC channel! Many thanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/54a9c54a8d64411372973aa0562c3a2fdbf0af9d.jpg

3. Here are some other optimizations that we will work on in the near future: match history, improvements to House display, optimizations for preparing/mustering in Barracks EU/NA...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8ac66f665496c8ba1f5c1bdb4d868e3e4363cd41.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a34ab2428928028b9a2999b5547812da799c30fa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6ae71c52c659b9f1d4fadc790a45e32df501479e.jpg

In addition to the issues mentioned above, we have identified hundreds of topics worth further exploration based on your feedbacks. The development team will revisit these topics in the near future and do their best to address the related needs according to practical considerations.

To ensure our Warlords will receive optimizations and updates promptly, the community support team will increase communication frequency in the relevant channels on Discord, keeping everyone informed of every step taken by the optimization team!

We will do our utmost to accompany players and work together with all warlords to build the future of our game!!

Battlefield's Song: Player Creations

Content creation is an irreplaceable part of our community. We respect, encourage, and thank every content creator!

This week's exciting content from the "Conqueror’s Report" comes from QhyLAN – Burak. Witness the impact from cavalry!

notes.title: New Arrival: [The Arabian Nights] event & New epic hero attire [Eternal Spirit].
notes.content:
The brand new epic hero attire [Eternal Spirit] & new special mount attire [Aeternum] will be unveiled on May 23.

[previewyoutube=aI6JUEORYHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Eternal Spirit

Like a dream at dawn, the mist disperses and illusions fade. Everything will eventually come to an end. New event " The Arabian Nights" is unveiled. Participate in the event and obtain the new epic hero attire [ Eternal Spirit ]!

Design Sharing


 Eternal Spirit’s Crown


The Eternal Spirit's Crown is a symbol of the Golden Kingdom, representing the sacred mission and eternal power of the ruler. When the chosen one wears this crown, they feel an unparalleled power surging from the top of their head, as if connecting to the mysterious forces from the heaven.



 Eternal Spirit’s Armour


The Eternal Spirit's Armor is the most mysterious part of the entire legend. It is said that this armor was brought from afar by traveling merchants who endured countless hardships to reach the Golden Kingdom. It is believed to be a gift bestowed by the gods. The master of this armor is destined to become the ruler of all kings.



 Eternal Spirit’s Gloves


In the sacred halls of the Golden Kingdom, the Eternal Spirit's Gloves are solemnly presented before the chosen one. Crafted by ancient divine artisans, these gloves are adorned with rare materials and mystical runes. Embedded with shimmering gemstones, each gem seems to carry the blessings and wisdom of the spirits.



 Eternal Spirit’s Boots


The Eternal Spirit's Boots are the steadfast companions of the chosen one, symbolizing the trust and sacred mission bestowed by the spirits. These boots snugly fit the feet, granting extraordinary speed and agility, enabling one to move swiftly like the wind and strike with thunderous might on the battlefield.



Legend has it that in a distant golden kingdom in the desert, the ruler is a god with the head of an eagle and the body of a human, possessing eternal life. He is the guardian of the true kings of the world, and he will bestow upon the destined ruler the symbol of eternal life. Those who receive this mark will be able to see glimpses of the future in the sky and become the eternal kings of kings. This suit of armor with the mark of the god is said to have been brought by merchants from afar. Under the spinning of the threads of fate, can this armor find its final owner? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/efa4cb2d122c9f5417f758bf8930c4f4f3d1b2b9.jpg

Aeternum

When the soul of a king sets foot on the path to the afterlife, a blessed black steed empowered by the gods of the sky will come to escort them to the eternal paradise. Introducing new mount attire with special effect, Aeternum!

Design Shaing


 Aeternum Saddle


 The Aeternum Saddle is a mysterious and sacred item, believed to be a bridge connecting life and death, the present world and the afterlife. Legend has it that this saddle is worn on the back of the legendary black steed blessed by the gods of the sky. More than just equipment, it is a symbol carrying the significance of eternity and hope.



 Aeternum Chanfron


The presence of the Aeternum Chanfron enables souls to resist interference and temptation from the outside world, maintaining afterlife peace and clarity, ensuring soul can safely traverse the golden fields and reach the paradise.



 Aeternum Barding


 Aeternum Barding is a sacred equipment for souls to journey to the afterlife. It symbolizes the pursuit of eternity and belief in the afterlife, allowing every soul to face the challenges of life and death with courage, move forward boldly, and find their own eternal path.



 Aeternum Leg Guards


Aeternum Leg Guards will be worn by souls ready to embark on the path to eternity. These leg guards offer protection and strength to the soul, symbolizing resilience and determination. They enable the soul to move steadily forward, overcoming all difficulties and temptations on the journey ahead.



In the faith of the kingdom of desert, death is not the end of life but the beginning of another life. This is especially true for the souls of great kings. Legend has it that when their souls embark on the path to the afterlife, a black steed blessed and empowered by the gods of the sky will come to receive them and take them to the eternal paradise. The steed will soar into the sky, carrying their souls to the golden waves that extend to the end of the sky. The beautiful world that can be seen but not reached.

notes.content:
Feedbacks and suggestions from Warlords have always been a valuable asset for us.

After the development team's tireless efforts, the highly anticipated " Retrospect" (replay function) has finally been completed and is about to be officially launched!!

How to use the Retrospect?

1. Press the "P" key to open the Character interface, click on "Career", find the " Retrospect", and enter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/64f5159b7fe5f33d42a98b53e991beac629fb752.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/249f323368c429f1621fef71a5c0258ec873edeb.gif

5. Use the “E” to zoom out the camera and the “Q” key to zoom in, giving you control over both the finer details and the bigger picture of the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dfd7e12e59c11ee09f766279ee5d9bd62f5aa713.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5cecad7c38a89ce9de4bf53fa6c1c2367c20fc5b.jpg

Limitation of “Retrospect” 

The replay function has just been launched and there may be some unknown issues exist. Therefore, the replay function will only be available to warlords who participated in the official content creator program. We appreciate your understanding!
For those eager to experience this new feature, don't worry! We are working hard to prepare a public testing for everyone. We hope to gather more feedback from warlords during this limited access period to further optimize the“Retrospect”. 
We believe the official release of the “Retrospect” won't be far, and we look forward to its debut with all the warlords!

notes.content:
The Conqueror’s Report #5 has finally arrived! Without further ado, we present to you the latest updates for Conqueror’s Blade!
This week's [Conqueror’s Report] focuses on the DNK Series events and the new unit attire and doctrine.

Report Prelude

 Attire Optimization: [Spring Jade] special effects optimized.
 Kitsune Kagura: Exclusive attire for Onna-Musha [Lone Fox] is now available.
 Flying Meteor: The brand-new doctrine [Warborn: Trench Warfare] arrived

 Regional tournament: DNK began, bringing endless excitement on the first day!
 Frontline Letters: Q&A 
 Song of the Battlefield


Attire Optimization: [Spring Jade] special effects optimized

[Spring Jade] is the first special effect hero attire in "Conqueror’s Blade". notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!

There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. In the chaotic times, a group of righteous bandits wearing white fox masks emerged unexpectedly. They were all well-equipped with naginatas and possessed superb martial skills, and all of them were women. 

There is a rumor that this mysterious team could even defeat a daimyo's army head-on. When the defeated generals angrily asked where they came from, they often sneered and replied, "We are the incarnations of the chaotic fox." Perhaps, the girls from a martial arts background who had lost everything in the war could only give such an answer. 

Although the maple leaves are beautiful, they have long been stained with blood. Maybe one day, the elegant and dance-like long sword techniques will no longer be used to take people's lives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/232ca17e76ec90dad5e2062a46cd81504e12c61a.jpg

Young girls wear the White Fox Mask, hoping that the gods will bestow upon them the courage and strength to bring peace to the chaotic world.

 Cherry Blossom Mark - Amidst the turmoil, the girls imprint the memories of their hometown on their shoulders, constantly reminding themselves of their hatred and mission. However, they also look forward to the day when the war ends, when they no longer wander in exile, and can return to their hometown to perform sword dances under the cherry blossom trees.

 Soft Armor - From shoulder guards to skirt armor, from breastplates to shin guards, the armor exudes a sense of combat and strength. The girls, who have lost everything, remove their makeup and adorn themselves with silver helmets and delicate armor, making themselves unbreakable and unwavering.

notes.title: Open World PTR Testing Recruitment
notes.content:
Greeting, Warlords,

Player experience has always been our top priority in the game.

Following the announcement of the new Open World Overhaul, our team has received a lot of feedback and various opinions from our esteemed generals. We realized that the new Open World still needs time to be polished to become ideal!

Therefore, we will be inviting players from around the globe to participate in this New Open World Collaborative Testing.

Through this collaborative testing, we will employ various methods to collect genuine player experiences, as well as expectations for the future official version, and continuously obtain guidance for further adjustments.

Newsletter Prelude

 Frontline Letters: Q&A 
 Song of the Battlefield


Must-Read: Sign up for the Open World PTR Testing!

After the first reveal of new Open World rules, we received a lot of feedback from all of you through various platforms! We realized that the new Open World still needs time to be polished to become ideal!
So this time, We will open the PTR and invite everyone to research together!

This test will be divided into two types of registration: House registration and individual registration.

House Registration

 House registration will be notified uniformly through in-game mail. So, all House leader please pay attention to your in-game mailbox.

Individual Registration

 Time: April 12, 2024 ~ April 18, 2024
 Individual Player Registration Form: https://forms.gle/G8LrqqPu5Tdb1DgZ9


Test Time:

 April 19, 2024, 18:00 ~ April 25, 2024, 23:59


There will be plenty of rewards in this test event also. Please stay tuned for official news updates!

Frontline Letters: Q&A

Q: Class skills should be equipped onto specific weapons
Refugee Bobo：Similar to how runes work, skills should equip onto weapons so that mid-game you can change your weapon and thus change your skills to better suit what's happening at the time. 
The best example of this, if you have 2 musket crafts, one suited for agility musket build and the other stuited for bomb musket, if ablities were attached to specific weapons as runes are, you could switch between. This wouldn't just effect musket, just musket is the best example.

A: This is an very interesting idea! Adjust skills accordingly when switching weapons can indeed take the customization in game a step further, but it will affect weapon balance currently. We will not simply modify this issue; instead, we will consider optimizing it in a more user-friendly system in the future! Thank you all for your thoughts and discussion.

Q：Allow players to Rename their equipment during reforge.
3ro_Mickobo3ro : It would add some humor and flavor in allowing players to customize their equipment, especially weapons. 
e.g. Player X reforges his Spear and renames it to  "Cute Little Pinky."
Coinciding with this, it would be incredibly funny if the Death messages were changed if a player dies beause of a hero skill. 
e.g. "Player X killed Player Y with his Cute Little Pinky using Dragon's Roar.

A: A humorous battlefield broadcast seems interesting, but at the same time, there could be issues with filtered words. We could consider using an in-game system to provide a word library for players to make customized choices? How is this idea to everyone?

Q：Balancing Suggestion: Claymores
AkAzad：In response to the changes in the current environment, the slowdown effect of Claymores 3 skills after 15 seconds makes it difficult to operate effectively and flexibly in the current environment. In addition, the mechanism of forcing three-star units to cooperate is not suitable for the current environment, and the skill cycle is not reasonable enough, making it difficult to operate effectively in the current environment. The following suggestions are recommended for effective battlefield performance in the current environment:
Adjust the debuff effect of Claymores 3 skills and remove the movement speed penalty. The rest does not need to be adjusted; the cooldown of 3 skills is reduced to 40 seconds

A: Indeed, Claymores is among the units we're considering for adjustments. Your thoughts and suggestion of it are very helpful! Currently, we're think about to remove the movement speed penalty. If you have any further ideas, please feel free to start any new conversation. Don't worry, all these balance adjustments will be test strictly in PTR before officially launch.

Q: Make Ranked an acceptable House Quest requirement
StarBurst: House Quests is very important for Territory Wars and everybody wants to have as much reputation as possible for the eventual battle. People play and grind the game in all different ways... ranked, normal siege (with seal system) or free battles etc... General Suggestion: Add ranked as an acceptable game-mode for farming house quests, so that everyone can enjoy all parts of the game。

A: As the Open World announcement was made in previously, new rules for the Open World 2.0 is being explored carefully! This idea is very valuable, as we hope all generals can find enjoyment and a sense of accomplishment in various "Open World" activities. We will seriously consider this and look for ways to improve the experience for all generals.

Song of the Battlefield

This week's exciting content from the "Conqueror’s Report" comes from @rinre Mi channel. Let's see how he become the MVP of the match!

[previewyoutube=F34301YIDeM;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F34301YIDeM [/previewyoutube]

Did you check out the last guide for Grayhair Garrison? @omusubi-kororin has released the second guide. Let's check it out together!

[previewyoutube=xBjHTb8KQ-I;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xBjHTb8KQ-I [/previewyoutube]

Thank you very much for all the creations. Generals, the battlefield awaits your command. Let's forge the glory of victory together!

The king has arrived on the battlefield! Please lead your warriors to defend the Hulao Gate and protect the king's honor and glory!!

Preorder for the brand new 5 Stars Unit "Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry" is On!

In the past, they followed the Qin king on his conquests, attacking Hulao Pass, breaking through Luoyang, charging into the enemy lines, and being invincible. Whenever enemies heard the Xuanjia Cavalry was approaching, they would either raise the white flag or scatter like birds and beasts, with no one able to stand against them. Now, they have officially joined the battlefield! Don't forget to purchase the pre-order gift box before April 11th!!

In Battle 

Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry are characterized by their lightning-fast and unassailable charges in battle. They ride expertly trained warhorses covered in black armor, utilizing the speed and force of their mounts to approach enemies swiftly and unleash a devastating attack. Using spears to penetrate through their enemies as they approach or fully unleashing their violence during a charge. Frontline Letters: Q&A

Last week, we've diligently compiled all the feedback from our esteemed Warlords and handed it over to our development team for future optimizations. Today, we'll delve into some of the selected inquiries and feedback to provide you with answers and insights. Let's dive in and see what suggestions our Warlords had in mind!

 Q：classes vs pike mechanics
 EveryonelovesaZombie (LZ): In regard to the Longsword & Shield and Pike mechanics, given that Longsword & Shield skill [With Valor] is a staged skill, using basic attacks between stages leads to the skill entering the cooldown stage. I hope it can be considered to let it function like the Pike, where basic attacks can be mixed in with combos.
 A: This is a great idea, a very valuable thought. However, the longsword and shield are inherently heavy weapons, this special positioning makes them not as flexible as pikes. Swinging heavy weapons takes a lot of effort, and it also limits the emotes! Currently, heavy heroes are a bit overpowering in the game and won't be adjusted immediately in the short term. However, in the future, we will take into consideration the opinions of all players and we hope that you can express more to us! Thank you very much!

 Q: Mastery Surveys are Biased
 omar_uav: Heavy Prefecture Cavalry are the best from the category of masteries, just like as how Rattan Marksmen were only known good from the mastery and now meta.
Mastery was a good idea buffing units that were nearly non usable, now its buff already good units to meta.
 A: The team have received your suggestions regarding the Mastery. They will fully consider the unique circumstances of the Unit. Unit’s Mastery will be introduced to players early through questionnaires and tests, and we will continue to optimize the communication process. In the future, more units will receive Mastery upgrades, and we hope that everyone can join together and conduct a satisfied result!!

 Q: UI Improvement for House Diplomacy
 Foghladha：When listing houses under deplomacy sort the house list by level first in descending order. This will put all the active houses at the top of the list and all the sleeping houses at the end of the list. It will make the system more new player friendly and speed up the time it takes to find a house to join. Nobody wants to click through 100+ pages of dead houses.
Also please remove the same region requirement to join a house. It's an unnecessary roadblock.
 A: We have noticed it as well! The region restriction for joining a family is indeed an outdated setting, and we will consider removing it in future updates. Thank you for your suggestions; we will continue to optimize this part of the experience and hope everyone looks forward to the improvements!

 Q: XP Requirements for different star units
 HeManOfficial: The Gold, Purple, Blue and Green/White need to have different XP requirements to level up. 300,000 for leveling up once for both Winged Hussars and Ironcap Scout Cavalry doesn't make sense. At least new players should be able to catch up a bit quicker.
 A: The growth of new players has always been a focus for us. In future updates, we will use various methods to help players smoothly transition through their growth period! Thank you very much for your thoughts!!

notes.title: MY.GAMES License Agreement ends on June 4th, 2024
notes.content:
Conqueror’s Blade in North America, Europe, and CIS is Changing Publisher as of June 4, 2024
Important announcement incoming.


For the past five years, Booming Tech, and Poros Interactive have partnered with MY.GAMES to bring the world of Conqueror’s Blade to players in North America, Europe, and CIS regions. Today, we announce that our shared journey is coming to an end.

Effective June 4, 2024, MY.GAMES and Poros Interactive have mutually agreed to terminate their licensing agreement for the publishing of Conqueror's Blade in territories currently supported by MY.GAMES. From this date forward, the development and global publishing of Conqueror’s Blade will continue as normal under Booming Tech and Poros Interactive. 

MY.GAMES will continue to support Conqueror’s Blade up until June 4th, 2024, with a transition period starting from April 18th. 

Given our shared history, mutual respect, and the challenges we’ve overcome together, we are deeply grateful to our friends at MY.GAMES and wish them nothing but the best!


 What future holds for the global community of Conqueror's Blade 

While the teams at Booming Tech and Poros Interactive are saddened to part ways with our close partners and friends at MY.GAMES, we are also excited about the future as we usher in a new era for Conqueror’s Blade.

As Poros Interactive assumes the role of the game’s global publisher, our goal is to create the ultimate medieval and ancient warfare gaming experience by unifying all enthusiasts around the globe.

Global publishing opens new doors leading to: 
[olist]
 High-end servers to assure the game's technical stability 
 Unification of communities, events, content creation
 Global competitive events and tournaments 
 Development of new in-game systems and features
 Consolidation of technical and user support services
[/olist]
Together with you, players from all over the globe, the teams at Booming Tech and Poros Interactive are highly motivated and excited about the next chapters in Conqueror’s Blade history.

Please stay tuned to our social media channels to be the first to hear about the upcoming announcements. You can find links to our social media pages at the end of this article.

 How the publisher change will affect MY.GAMES players 

If you’re playing Conqueror’s Blade using the MY.GAMES version, your progression, characters, currency, and items are all safe. You can continue to battle in Conqueror’s Blade after the transfer. All your account data will be preserved and transferred to Poros Interactive with your consent. 

This process will involve a few simple steps for players who wish to continue using their game characters after June 4th: 

 Starting from now, you can access the webpage related to the Users Accounts Process & Publishing Transfer News hosted by Poros Interactive ：[https://global.conquerorsblade.com]
 Starting from April 9th, when you log into the MY.GAMES' conqblade.com website, you’ll see a pop-up window suggesting you starting your Account Data Transfer to Poros Interactive.
After accepting the terms of service, you’ll be redirected to the Poros Interactive webpage  where you can choose between two options. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0f29b29ba1e4eddefc54136fe9e60a1bac845610.jpg
a. If you play via Steam Page published by MY.GAMES: Link your Steam account to the Poros Interactive website of Conqueror's Blade.

b. If you play via MY.GAMES launcher:  Link your MY.GAMES account to the Poros Interactive website of Conqueror's Blade.

 After completing the user data transfer, you can continue playing Conqueror’s Blade using the MY.GAMES Steam Page and MY.GAMES Launcher straight until June 4th, the same way as always before.
 After June 4th, you can update Conqueror’s Blade game client by using the  Steam page or the Poros Interactive Conqueror’s Blade Game Launcher, and keep on playing as usual. 
 For following the news regarding the process, participate in the upcoming community events and livetests and if you have any questions, you now can:：

Join Poros Interactive Discord:：[https://discord.gg/DGsDX6tHne]
Follow the news on：[https://global.conquerorsblade.com]


As a MY.GAMES player, I have a few questions. 

  What if I won't be able to transfer my account prior to June 4th? Will my account be lost? 
  Your account data is safe if you won't be able to transfer before June 4th. We though urge you to complete the transfer before June 4th as it will bring you additional in-game rewards.  

  What does "publisher transition period" (starting from April 18th) mean? 
   Starting from that date, some parts of publishing services provided by MY.GAMES will be gradually transitioned to Poros Interactive. The first step will include localisation of the in-game text, voice-overs, and some of the official announcements' localisation that starting from that date onward will be executed by Poros Interactive

  I am Content Creator of MY.GAMES. Should I take any steps to join the CCP of Poros Interactive in the future?
 We welcome all existing and potentially-new Content Creators from all regions to join our global Content Creator Program planned to launch in late May 2024. Prior to that time, you can enjoy all benefits of being a part of MY.GAMES Conqueror's Blade Content Creator Program. We are working closely with MY.GAMES team to assure smooth transition for all Content Creators. Please stay tuned for the official announcement coming from MY.GAMES team regarding CCP. In the meantime, also feel free to pre-apply for the upcoming global CCP of Conqueror's Blade (operated by Poros Interactive) by completing the questionnaire：[https://forms.gle/wm9gzHZ8rhzqLgEk7]

  What will happen to the social media pages of Conqueror's Blade currently operated by MY.GAMES? 
  The vast majority of those pages will be re-purposed (not associated with Conqueror's Blade any longer), or retired after June 4th. Due to this fact we urge all players to subscribe to the official media channels of Poros Interactive that are listed below:

Discord, Twitter, Twitch, Youtube, Facebook


 A New Era for Conqueror’s Blade 

As we stand on the threshold of a new era for Conqueror’s Blade, marked by global unification and development, we want to take a moment to express our deepest gratitude. To all our partners, friends, and players who have been, are currently, and will be a part of our shared legacy, we say thank you. Your contributions have shaped the journey thus far, and will continue to influence the exciting chapters that lie ahead. Here’s to the future of Conqueror’s Blade! 
 
Conqueror's Blade Team

 Victory conditions for the attacking side: capture the wall flag point and eliminate the defending side's protected target, the 'Li ShiMing'
 Victory conditions for the defending side: eliminate the attacking side's protected targets that appear in the second phase, namely the 'Wang ShiCong' and 'Dou JianDe'; or at the end of the countdown, the side with the higher remaining health for their protected target wins 

Units:

 Using the Escalation, players can deploy their own units in the campaign by consuming Leadership;
 Upon entering the game, the player's maximum Leadership is 400, and it will continue to grow as long as it has not reached the limit;
 When a unit dies, 30% of the Leadership is returned, and when a unit retreats, 50% of the Leadership is returned;
 At the beginning of the second phase, all players’ Leadership are restored to 400.

Protect your target:

 The attacking and defending sides each have their own protection targets:
 The attacking side's protection target, "Li ShiMing" appears when entering the second phase;
 The defending side's protection targets, "Wang ShiCong" and "Dou JianDe" appear some time after "Li ShiMing" emerges;
 Both sides' protection targets have their own personal guard, which will appear successively;
 As the campaign reaches its end, "Wang ShiCong" and "Dou JianDe" will lead their personal guard to attack the location of "Li ShiMing”.

Siege Engines & Artillery:

 In this campaign, if the Siege Engine & Artillery (Cannon,Ballistas, etc.) is destroyed, it can be recreated by players after a period of time.

Supply Point Contention:

 In this campaign, capturing supply points will trigger an additional mechanism that can only be activated during the first phase and can be triggered up to two times for the entire team;
 When capturing an enemy supply point, the whole team gains 45 Leadership, and friendly units will be summoned at the supply point

Wear it, lick it, rule it. (Limited stock, while supplies last.)

 Because every wizard needs a cute sidekick.

See what’s happening in galaxies far, far away.

Mark your stardate calendars! Conqueror’s Blade: Star Ring Lord launches as a free update on June 31, 2042. Get ready to rewrite the fellowship saga! and happy April Fools' Day!!

notes.title: Conqueror’s Report #2: [KH] Big Adjustments
notes.content:
Newsletter Prelude

 Manly Love: "Hammer Brawl" Limited-Time Event Now Live
 Latest Optimization: AMD Performance Enhancement
 Must-Read: Major Adjustments in [KH], Collaborative Research on New TW
 Must-Read: Future Prospects of Conqueror’s Blade Ecosystem
 Frontline Letters: Q&A
 Song of the Battlefield


Manly Love: "Hammer Brawl" Limited-Time Event Now Live

Warlords, after countless battles, filled with laughter, songs, regrets, and farewells... Memories may have faded, but the bond among comrades remains eternal.

So, it’s time to give your good buddies a hearty embrace and let them feel the love of the manly men! Shout out your affection for your fellow warriors and then give them a vigorous hug 🫠!

The brand-new limited-time event "Hammer Brawl" is now live!

Grab your hammers tight and experience the thrill of smashing and sending foes flying in the chaotic battlefield!

Event Details:

Lift your hammers and give your good buddies a vigorous hug—just make enemy commanders fall to earn kill points. The first side to reach 60 points wins the victory.

Moreover, if you achieve consecutive kills in battle, your stamina regeneration speed will increase. When achieving 1, 2, or 3 consecutive kills, the stamina regeneration speed bonus will be 10%, 15%, or 20%, respectively (capped at 20%). Best wishes for your valor in battle! 

But hey, relying solely on enemy commander falls for points can be a bit dull, right? 

It's time for some excitement! As long as you cause the enemy to fall and die, you'll earn kill points equal to the player’s consecutive kills plus one—meaning, brothers, let's focus on taking down the kings and turning the tide at any moment!

(Note: If the enemy falls on their own, our team earns kill points, but no one gets the kill.)

Time: 

 From March 28th after maintenance ~ April 3rd before maintenance.


Latest Optimization: AMD Performance Enhancement

FSR Joins the Fray, AMD Performance Boosts, Game Frame Rates Soar

 "Conqueror’s Blade: Dragonrise" has implemented FSR technology, effectively enhancing the gaming experience for AMD users. Generals can now experience four optimization modes—Quality, Balanced, Performance, and Ultra Performance—boosting frame rates by up to 80%.

(FSR: A super sampling technology developed by AMD that renders images at a lower resolution and outputs them at a higher resolution, allowing players to achieve higher frame rates without upgrading their graphics cards.)
How to Increase In-Game Frame Rates:

  [ESC] - [Game Settings] - [Graphics] - [Super Resolution] & [Super Resolution Level]. 

AMD users select "AMD FSR," while NVIDIA users select "NVIDIA DLSS.


Must-Read of this Issue: [KH] New Territory Battle Rules Postponed, A Long and Arduous Journey of Collaborative Research

In our ongoing quest for an enhanced gaming experience, we've embarked on a journey of exploration with you. Together, we've realized that the path to new territory war rules is long and filled with challenges. 

As such, we've decided to postpone their introduction upon the launch of the new server.

We understand this may come as a disappointment, but your game quality and stability remain our top priorities. To show our appreciation for your patience, we'll be offering compensation to those who pre-created characters on the new server.

New Server - Khan of Heaven (POROS)

 Generals who successfully pre-create characters on the new server will receive: Treatises *10, 10-Battle Unit XP Card*1, and 10-Battle Hero XP Card *1 upon the server's opening.
 A new 14-day sign-in event will be introduced on the new server, offering various rare items such as Treatises, Pay Off Vouchers, Rare Hero Schematic, Epic Artillery Selection Box, and Unit Medal.
 Generals who purchase the "Dragonrise" Season Pass on the new server from March 28th after maintenance ~ April 11th before maintenance, will receive an additional 680 Sovereigns after the April 11th maintenance, making the Season Pass effectively free.

In addition to the new server, generals who create characters and reach level 20 before the maintenance on March 27th on the official servers will receive treatises *10.

But fear not, fellow warriors! Our journey doesn't end here. We believe that collaborative development and testing are vital for the success of the new territory war rules. 

Therefore, we're creating a dedicated testing server where you can join us in sieges, hone your strategies, and provide invaluable feedback without any barriers.

Invitations for testing will be sent out selectively, with priority given to those who supported us by pre-creating characters on the [Khan of Heaven] server. Your dedication fuels our resolve, and for that, we are eternally grateful.


Must-Read:  Preview of the Future of Conqueror’s Blade: Preparatory Servers and Official Servers!

As we march forward into the unknown, we're excited to unveil the roadmap for the future of our beloved game. Starting from the EX-server, where we tested and validated our novice server design, to the introduction of preparatory servers, we're paving the way for an even more immersive gaming experience.

What to Expect on the Preparatory Servers:

Dive into the Novice Server, a haven for new Warlords where they'll embark on two preparatory seasons. Here, they can hone their skills without the pressure of rankings, familiarizing themselves with the intricacies of Conqueror’s Blade.

Once the first preparatory season concludes, the Novice Server evolves into the Growth Server. Here, players have the freedom to match with the official server or continue their journey alongside Novice Server warriors, with rankings now open for those seeking glory.

After the second preparatory season, the Growth Server merges into the official server system, ensuring a seamless transition for all players. Check out the visual below to see the future lineage of server types! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9383843d74d474dbe2b6215467c9a0f3158ea946.png

With these optimizations to our server architecture, we're committed to ensuring that there's always a new challenge waiting for you on the battlefield. So rally your troops, sharpen your blades, and prepare to write your legend in the annals of history!


[Dragonrise] Unit’s Adjustment

Adjustments and optimizations have been made to three-star units for the upcoming season, as follows:

 Fix the issue where “Sudden Storm” could not be aim enemies target properly on terrain with height differences
 Added a mechanism and damage dealt to “Sudden Storm" reduce its cooldown time upon killing enemies

Changes have been made to the effects of " Unit Losses in the World " and "Unit Resupply Cost" for some units

	Serfs

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Gathering Amount".

	Tenant Farmers, Woodcutters

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Field Battle Damage, Increase Gathering Amount".

	Village Watchmen, Sword Militia, Demesne Pikemen, Javelin Militia, Pike Militia

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increased Field Battle Damage, Reduced Food Consumption".

	Demesne Archers

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Siege Battle Damage, Increase Ammo "

	Ironcap Arquebusiers

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Ammo"

	Coutiliers

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Charge Damage, Increase Health" effect.

	Ironcap Scout Cavalry

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Reduce Food Consumption".

	Selemchid Cavalry

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase movement speed".

	Vanguard Archers

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Ammo, Increase Health".

	Incendiary Archers

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Siege Battle Damage, Increase Ammo" effect.

	Namkhan Archers

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Field Battle Damage, Increase Health" effect.

	Prefecture Guards

 The node of " Decrease Unit Losses in the World, Unit Resupply Cost " changed to "Increase Slashing Defense, Blunt Defense".


Frontline Letters: Q&A
Last week, we've diligently compiled all the feedback from our esteemed Warlords and handed it over to our development team for future optimizations. Today, we'll delve into some of the selected inquiries and feedback to provide you with answers and insights. Let's dive in and see what suggestions our Warlords had in mind!

R---gee B--o: Skirmisher cooldown is too long, you can use close combat x3 in the time it takes for Skirmisher to come off cooldown. Nah just slight balance to skirmisher, would be nice if you could get 2 skirmishers off in the time it takes to get 3 close combats off, the pacing of Skirmisher is simply bad, you enter an engagement, complete your combo and by the time you and you're units are ready for next engagement, skirmisher is still on cooldown, this happens quite frequently

A: Thank you for your input! Balancing adjustments, especially concerning hero, skills, and units, are crucial for us. However, these adjustments often require meticulous testing to ensure overall game balance. While we can't provide specific directions at the moment, every piece of feedback serves as valuable input for us to continuously enhance the game and provide a better gaming experience.

V---r: UNIT XP RESET Give us the option to reset the levels/xp of our units. For example- I disband a unit which was at level 12, because i don't find a need for them in my warband. the xp doesn't get converted to shared xp and it's lost forever.

A: Your story highlights an important aspect. We've recognized the need to optimize resources and provide better guidance for new players to avoid resource misallocation. Improving the new player experience and offering comprehensive guidance are key priorities for us. We're actively working on refining systems to ensure a smoother learning curve for all newcomers.

 S--13：This game require a PVE that can grind for honor.

A: Thanks for suggesting a new gameplay mode! We'll certainly consider incorporating it into our future plans for gameplay enhancements.

Th------s：going up a ladder to the wall is a death sentence for the unit as they come in small group of 4 Solution: make them go up the siege tower instead

A: OK! We have fixed a batch of AI issues. If you encounter the problem again, please feel free to contact us anytime!

B---Bis--it：Here I thought we were told T5 wasn't getting masteries... mayhaps this was a oversight or a sign

A: Don't worry... A tiny bug, we'll fix it, we'll fix it!

!A--a：Various suggestions regarding siege battles, rankings, faction wars, generals, CBL, and more.
A: We sincerely appreciate your extensive suggestions! Your feedback on rankings, faction wars, and other aspects is incredibly valuable for our future optimizations. Moreover, your ideas for fun activities during CBL have piqued our interest. CBL is about to begin, and we'd love to have you join us and share your valuable insights!


Song of the Battlefield

Here at Conqueror's Blade, we cherish the vibrant tapestry of content that our community weaves together. Each piece, whether it's a helpful guide or an awe-inspiring creation, adds a unique flavor to our shared experience.

This week, we're thrilled to showcase the fantastic work of @ZT in our latest Expedition Update! His insightful guidance is invaluable, especially for our newcomers. Check out his latest video here: 
[previewyoutube=iDByUJlbxWc;full][/previewyoutube]

But that's not all! We also want to shine a spotlight on @超級歐洲人  as he unveils his incredible talents. Watch his mesmerizing content right here: 
[previewyoutube=aI3AE6srMhc;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's celebrate these amazing creators and their contributions to our community! Remember, whether you're a seasoned veteran or a fresh recruit, your creativity is always welcome here. Keep on crafting, commanders! 💪🏼✨

notes.title: Join our Content Creator Program
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d0ed4890f1613f7c4e57caff50a79b12d13a74b6.jpg

Greetings, Warlord!

Have you ever considered creating videos or live streaming? 
Would you love receiving exclusive perks & rewards or even making a living by creating content?  

At Conqueror's Blade, we believe in the power of creativity and community, and we are excited to introduce our Content Creator Program (CCP) for You.

This program is designed to empower Content Creators, providing you with the flexibility to shape your own content, acquire fair compensations while emphasizing quality and diversity.

We invite you to be a part of this exciting journey.

 We motivate Content Creators (CCs) to choose their own schedule for content publishing
 We motivate CCs to focus on content quality
 We motivate Content Creators to create multiple types of content as it helps to grow your channels faster 

Views calculation Period 

 90 days 


How to apply

Complete the questionnaire: https://forms.gle/fg5eniKXcJHa6zF57

1. Rewards and Benefits

By participating in CCP you will be able to enjoy a number of benefits including Twitch Drops support, Marketing Materials Library, access to new units & attires, PTR priority access, and many more. Below you may find the detailed list of benefits based on your Main Channel follower’s number. 

200+ Followers

By reaching 200 followers on any channel, you may apply for CCP Membership and obtain: 

Benefits

 Twitch Drops Access 
 Access to Marketing Art Materials Library
 Access to Content Creator Discord
 Priority access to PTR and Beta builds of the game
 
 Standard Sovereign Rewards

After every CCP period you will obtain in-game currency (Sovereigns) for your content. You may obtain rewards for multiple types of content. Rewards are unlimited - you can go as high as you like. Rewards are calculated based on total Views (Long or Short videos), and Stream Total Hours Watched (hours streamed multiplied by viewers) within 90 days. 

 YouTube Long Videos

 2160 Sovereigns on reaching 2,000 views
 1440 Sovereigns for every additional 10,000 total views

 Tik-Tok and YouTube Shorts

 2160 Sovereigns on reaching 3,000 views  
 1440 Sovereigns for every additional 15,000 views

 Live Streaming (Twitch & YouTube)

 2160 Sovereigns on reaching 400 Total Hours Watched  
 1440 Sovereigns for every additional 1,200 Total Hours Watched

You may pick One Main category 

YouTube Long Videos
Tik-Tok YouTube Short  
Streaming 

If you create multiple types of content (Long Videos, Tik-Tok/YouTube shorts, Streaming) then the rewards will be calculated as:

 Main Category Reward (100%) + Secondary Category Reward (50%) + Third Category reward (50%)

NOTE: Content Creators who write blogs and articles can apply for CCP and applications will be reviewed separately. 


Referral Gift Codes Rewards

As a Content Creator you will be given a personal unique gift code that you can publish anywhere (old and new videos, streams, communities, chats, social media, personal messages, etc.)

 180 Sovereigns will be added to your rewards for every new player who will Reach Level 50 in the game after using a Referral Gift Code 
 Additional 180 Sovereigns will be paid for characters that will later reach level 100 
 Gift Set codes can only be used on new accounts only with a level under 25
 By activating codes, your viewers will receive the following in-game items: 

 Premium Account (7 days)
 Honor x1000
 10-Battles Hero XP Card x3, 
 10-Battles Unit XP Card x3
 Rare Artillery Selection Box x1
 Treatise x1

 Regional Prizes

  - The top creators among all categories will be awarded based on their new player referral performance
    - Regions included: 
      - Korea
      - Japan 
      - Taiwan, Hong-Kong, Macao 
      - South-East Asia (excluding Korea, Japan, Hong-Kong, Macao, Taiwan) 
      - South America

 Prizes for Content Creation Challenges

Content Creation Challenges are official requests from the developers

 Those challenges will suggest types of content that needs to be produced by Content Creators

 Every month there will be 1-2 Content Creation Challenges held and announced in official Discord

Rewards for Selected Videos

 Will be published on the official Conqueror's Blade YouTube Channel (with links to the original authors' channels) - to give more exposure to best entries
 Authors will be rewarded with Sovereigns for selected videos (500~1,000 Sovereigns in average based on video complexity).


500+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally: 

 Content Creator in-game Name Title (time-limited)
 Free Access to New Seasonal Units (7 days after release, starting from January 2024) 
 Free Access to New Attires (7 days after release, starting from January 2024) 


1000+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally:

notes.title: Major Modification: About the Future of Conqueror's Blade
notes.content:
>[KH] New Territory War Rules Postponed, Embarking on a Long Journey of Collaborative Exploration Future of Conqueror’s Blade: Preparatory Servers and Official Servers

Starting from the EX-server, we have validated our design considerations for the novice server through the new world and family rule models. Next, building upon the foundation of the official server, we have introduced the concept of preparatory servers. Preparatory servers are divided into Growth Servers and Novice Servers. In the future, we will consistently open novice servers at the beginning of each season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3e014e1c8d59dba9e4b22d628dced21527c32571.png

The Novice Server serves as a novice village, where new generals will receive two preparatory seasons. New generals can grow without pressure in the Novice Server, familiarize themselves with the features of Conqueror’s Blade and the game environment, and amidst the tumult, grow into formidable Warlords.

During the first preparatory season, the Novice Server will not open rankings. Besides event gameplay, Novice Server and Growth Server matchmaking will be interconnected.
After the first preparatory season ends, the Novice Server will advance to become the Growth Server. Users in the Growth Server can freely choose to match with the official server or continue battling against Novice Server players, while also opening rankings.

For example: 
Currently, the Excalibur server has officially completed its first season and has become a Growth Server. In the future, we will undergo a period of feature development, allowing generals on the Excalibur server to freely choose their matchmaking preferences. For example, they can continue matching with Novice Server players or challenge players on the official server.

Following the end of the second preparatory season, the Growth Server will officially enter or merge into the official server system. The lineage of future server types will be as follows:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9383843d74d474dbe2b6215467c9a0f3158ea946.png

> Wish generals always have new challengers and comrades worth fighting alongside.

Of course, for the official servers that are currently operating, we will also integrate the new territory war rules and the operational experience from the Novice Server to introduce even bolder optimizations and adjustments in the upcoming seasons!!

Through the optimization of server architecture, we aim to ensure that generals always have new challengers and comrades worth fighting alongside. Fight, grow, and strategize to your heart's content!
