notes.title: Brand-New "Tang" Season, New Servers, New Rules! Dragonrise, You Are Destiny!!!
notes.content:
I. "Tang" Season features new server, new World Rules, new matchmaking, and a new Economic System!

1. Brand New Server, Gifts For Early Reservations. It's A New Attempt, But Not Just For The Present!


 In the brand new "Dragonrise" Season, we are set to launch a brand new servers: Steam Poros - [Khan of Heaven]. Across these servers, adjustments will be made to various game systems, each modification is aimed to bring a fresh gaming ecosystem and experience, we are very looking forward to the arrival of all Warlords!

 Pre-Creation Treatise ceaselessly! Pre-Creation for new server will be available from 12:00 March 22, 2024 to 15:29 March 28, 2024, Warlords who completed pre-creation process will receive Treatise x10, Ten-Battle Unit XP Card x1, Ten-Battle Hero XP Cardx1 after the server opens at 15:30 on March 28.


2. There Are No Kit Costs For Siege Battle, I'll Pay For Your Bill!


 The new server will remove the unit's kit system, meaning that in Siege Battle, damaged or missing unit kits will no longer exist. Over the course of 365 days, the satisfaction of having intact kits every day will be invaluable.

 The Open World will adopt a new Reserve Unit System, which only takes effect in the Open World. Reserve unit can be resupplied through the corresponding Kit. When the number of Kit become to 0, the Unit is unable to enter battle in the Open World (this does not affect the Matchmaking).


3. Updated Trade & Economic Systems!


 A new Resources Market is added, Warlord can sell the excessive resources or purchase desired resources through the market. The resource’s price will fluctuate according to the trading conditions across the server. Whether it's a buyer's market or a seller's market, it's all up to the market!

 Bronze Coins can be utilized to acquire specific resources and kits for 1-3 star Units, while Silver Coins offer a broader range of options. With Silver Coins, one can not only obtain items available with Bronze Coins but also procure limited quantities of Treatise, as well as Epic and Legendary Siege Engines & Artillery. Furthermore, Silver Coins enable the purchase of kits for 4 and 5 star Units, along with other crucial strategic materials.


4. War Sustains War, Conquer Territories. The All-New Open World Plundering Mechanism Is Now Online!


 Basic Resources obtained from plundering, including Siege Engines & Artillery Materials, will have binding Types.

 In the Open World, defeating other player units has a chance to seize unit equipment. The acquired unit’s kit will be distributed based on the ratio of binding and non-binding unit’s kit.

 In the Open World map, both allied and enemy forces will drop kits due to battle losses. Both sides can pick up the dropped kits from the map using their characters

 The plunder settlement mechanism will be adjusted.


5. Enhancement Of Fief System, More Rewards For Fief Upgrade!


 Every Monday, maintenance of fief does not require construction materials and does not affect Prosperity. Now it is modified to consume construction materials to increase Prosperity. The Prosperity affects the rise and fall of the base.

 Promoting your Fief boosts its daily Economy. As the Fief level increases, so do the rewards from the Economy.

 Upgrading your Fief increases the frequency of collection times for both the Occupying House and the Alliance.
 


6. A Overhaul Of The Open World Gameplay, More Rewards, Intense Contest!


 The collectible items found in the Open World, such as the Abandoned Camp, Derelict Hut, and others, will vary according to their respective regions.

 Upon defeating Robbers and Bandits in the Open World, you will receive Bronze Coins and have the opportunity to obtain either [Epic Artillery Crafting Schematics] or [Legendary Artillery Crafting Schematics].

 After clearing the rebel camp, players will have a chance to obtain limited non-bound epic and legendary artillery schematics for the entire server. However, a contest for entry qualification will be added, and only the victors can enjoy the final rewards. 

 Gathering in the Open World is free!


7. The House Is My "Home", I Am For The House, The House Is For Me!


 A new House Depository system has been added, allowing players to donate kit and siege engines. Donated resources cannot be sold, but the House can allow members to use them directly by setting permissions.

 While completing house tasks, not only the house will gain house XP, but individuals will also earn Open World gathering XP.


II. Experience True 'Seasonal' Warfare In Our New Season!!

1. Strategic Resources Are Reset Every Season, Making Each New Season a Fresh Experience!


 The System Shop reclaims all Basic Resources, Special Resources, Processed Resources, Rebel’s drops, and Kits at their corresponding prices. Bonded resources are reclaimed for Bronze Coins, while unbonded resources are reclaimed for Silver Coins. Bronze Coins and Silver Coins obtained from reclamation come with an acquisition limit.

 The top 5 valuable Siege Engines & Artillery will be retained, and the rest of the Artillery will be reclaimed at the corresponding prices set by System store. bonded Siege Engines & Artillery are reclaimed for Bronze Coins, while unbound Siege Engines & Artillery are reclaimed for Silver Coins. Bronze Coins and Silver Coins obtained from reclamation come with an acquisition limit.


2. More Unique Ecosystem, More Balanced Matchmaking!


 In order to better adapt to the ecosystem of the new server,  [Khan of Heaven] server will serve as pioneers for adjustments to all basic systems. This includes ' Standard Battles' and various event-based matchmaking activities, which will only take place between these two new servers.".

 [Khan of Heaven] servers will NOT host Ranked Battles in this season.


III. Conclusion

Regarding the "season reset" setting, we have deliberated extensively. We aim to provide a relatively equal starting point for the vast majority of players after each season change, whether they are newcomers or veterans. We hope to create a relatively fair gaming environment for everyone at the beginning of each new season. Additionally, for our loyal supporters, any unused strategic resources will be converted into a certain amount of Bronze Coins and Silver Coins for use in the new season.

This change is also a new attempt for us, and there may be many uncertainties and differing opinions. However, we hope that this change will bring a new ecosystem and a better gaming experience for our players. We will continue to strive towards this goal.

Regarding the future plans for the new server, we have considered possibilities such as merging servers or allowing transfers to other servers. Specific information will be announced in subsequent official announcements.
  
As for the old server, we will consider whether to promote the updates we made on the new server to other servers, especially the dramatic changes in the Territory War, we hope to synchronize on all servers as soon as possible. We hope that all our players can give us more suggestions and valuable comments! We hope that both new and veteran players can enjoy the game after this season maintenance!

notes.title: Conqueror’s Report #1: New Campaign in Territory War。
notes.content:
Conqueror’s Report:

The "Conqueror’s Blade" development team has always regarded all generals as the most precious treasures, and your continuous support and encouragement have motivated us to come this far. We promised to prioritize the establishment of the community as a key part of the next phase. We pledge to value every general who comes to the official community, value every piece of community feedback, and value closer communication with you all!

As promised, we have been working hard during this period: conducting one-on-one interviews with generals to better understand their real concerns; restructuring the community architecture to make it easier for generals to find information; actively planning community initiatives to benefit our generals......

We have been working hard, hoping to rebuild the glory of the 'Conqueror’s Blade' community with all generals.

However, in our communication with everyone, we find that merely working hard does not resolve all problems, timely two-way communication is very necessary.

Therefore, we have decided to restart Dev-Log, and promote the entire column:
——Conqueror’s Report!

In the [Conqueror’s Report], in addition to the weekly updates on "Conqueror’s Blade" and the musings of the development team, we will also select some feedback from the generals and provide responses!!

No more words needed. Let's begin this Conqueror’s Report!



Dragonrise: Crave your destiny is now available!!!!

This week's Conqueror’s Report will focus on the Dragonrise season’s content.

Newsletter Prelude
The Khan of Heaven has appeared, new Territory War is about to Fight!

  Season Units
  Balance Adjustment
  Special update for EX Territory War
  Frontline Messages (The long-awaited Q&A is finally back!)
  Song of the Battlefield


The Khan of Heaven has appeared, new Territory War is about to Fight!
In the brand-new "Dragonrise" season, we are launching a new server: Steam Poros-[Khan of Heaven]. In this server, adjustments will be made to various game systems, each modification is aimed to bring a fresh gaming ecosystem and experience. Moreover, we will conduct new VG tests for Territory War on this server. We aim to make the Territory War a real war, where everyone has their place, the rewards of the Open World are more apparent. Make Conqueror’s Blade great once again! we are very looking forward to the arrival of all Warlords!

Pre-Creation Treatise ceaselessly! Pre-Creation for new server will be available from 12:00 March 22, 2024 to 15:29 March 28, 2024, Warlords who completed pre-creation process will receive Treatise x10, Ten-Battle Unit XP Card x1, Ten-Battle Hero XP Cardx1 after the server opens at 12:00 on March 28.

Make Territory Wars a real war, all-new Open world plundering mechanism is now online!

In conversations with the generals, we discovered slight issues in the current Unit’s kit design. The cost for matchmaking battles is restrictive, and the importance of supplies is not highlighted in Territory Wars! Therefore, in order to enhance the overall strategic and exciting aspects of Territory Wars, we have decided:


  The new server will Remove the unit's kit system: The Siege Battle will not result in kit losses.

  The Open World will adopt a new Reserve Unit System: Unit’s kit will become the only way to resupply high-star reserve units, and the accumulation of unit’s kit in your daily activity will directly affect the result in battle.

  New plundering mechanism now online: defeating other player units has a chance to seize unit equipment. The acquired unit’s kit will be distributed based on the ratio of binding and non-binding unit’s kit. In the Open World, both allied and enemy forces will drop kits due to battle losses. Both sides can pick up the dropped kits from the map using their characters.

  A new House Depository system has been added, allowing players to donate kit and siege engines. Donated resources cannot be sold, but the House can allow members to use them directly by setting permissions.


In the Open World, everyone can be a general

We hope that the revamped Open World will truly be a place where players can actively engage. Large houses can mobilize forces and gather resources on a large scale, while small groups can set ambushes to sustain their warfare efforts. For those who prefer freedom, they can pursue the life of a free bandit or focus on production. Everyone can find their place and activities will yield benefits. This is what a true "Open World" should be like.


  In the Territory War, there will be a limitation on using Bronze Coins and Silver Coins to replenish the loss and damaged kit.

  Season Reset of Strategic resources: At the end of each season, existing resources will be recycled for rewards. Past resource accumulation will no longer be a crucial factor; instead, comprehensive planning and choices will determine the future.

  New House Depository: Donating Kits and Siege Engines & Artillery, not only the house will gain house XP, but individuals will also earn Open World gathering XP. Logistics talents will become indispensable roles in the family. Just like players who gather and manufacture, they can also contribute their own value!

  New Resources Market: Warlord can sell the excessive resources or purchase desired resources through the market. The resource’s price will fluctuate according to the trading conditions across the server.

  Gathering in the Open World no longer consumes Bronze Coins: PVE monsters also yield high returns, whether it's for self-healing, selling to other families, or trading with merchants for silver coins. Everyone can profit from the Open World.!

  More Open World’s Rewards: Upon defeating Robbers and Bandits in the Open World, you will receive Bronze Coins and have the opportunity to obtain either [Epic Artillery Crafting Schematics] or [Legendary Artillery Crafting Schematics]. After clearing the campaign, players will have a chance to obtain limited non-bound epic and legendary artillery schematics for the entire server. However, a contest for entry qualification will be added, and only the victors can enjoy the final rewards.


Better Fief mechanics, more rewards 

For players who enjoy managing fief, besides simplifying the calculation method for fief prosperity, the profits of fief will also be clearer. As the fief level increases, the daily fixed dividends from the fief will increase. In future updates, the capabilities of fief defense will also be strengthened based on fief level up, ensuring that every investment is worthwhile.


  Fief Economy mechanism has been improved: Upgrading fief will increase daily fief dividends. The higher the fief level, the higher the economic rewards.

  Engaging in plundering during battles will diminish the prosperity of the fief, (such as capturing the central area). Members can earn Silver Coins through the fief's Silver Coin dividends. Furthermore, we plan to introduce additional opportunities for silver coin plundering in the future, such as destroying the city gate and the stockade.

   Imperial Restorationists 1.0: Fiefs occupied by Imperial Restorationists will provide dividends to all players within the faction. The procedure of Fiefs upgrade and unit assemble have also been optimized.  Within the Imperial Restorationists will also have hostile relations among themselves, each striving for their own interests. Subsequent updates will introduce unique characteristics for each of them, providing more considerations and enjoyment in player choices.

Regarding the "season reset" setting, we have deliberated extensively. We aim to provide a relatively equal starting point for the vast majority of players after each season change, whether they are newcomers or veterans. We hope to create a relatively fair gaming environment for everyone at the beginning of each new season. Additionally, for our loyal supporters, any unused strategic resources will be converted into a certain amount of Bronze Coins and Silver Coins for use in the new season.

This change is also a new attempt for us, and there may be many uncertainties and differing opinions. However, we hope that this change will bring a new ecosystem and a better gaming experience for our players. We will continue to strive towards this goal.

Regarding the future plans for the new server, we have considered possibilities such as merging servers or allowing transfers to other servers. Specific information will be announced in subsequent official announcements.

  As for the old server, we will consider whether to promote the updates we made on the new server to other servers, especially the dramatic changes in the Territory War, we hope to synchronize on all servers as soon as possible. We hope that all our players can give us more suggestions and valuable comments! We hope that both new and veteran players can enjoy the game after this season maintenance!


"Dragonrise: CARVE YOUR LEGACY" Season Units

Dargonrise: Crave your Destiny! The new Season Units are ready:

Feathered Crossbowmen (3 Stars): Versatile in both melee and ranged combat, with bursts of power and decent survivability. Agile and adept at kiting enemies.

Wuwei Mansion Guard (4 Stars): Strong sustained combat and survivability. Utilizes control immunity to withstand bursts and maintain continuous damage output on the battlefield.

Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry (5 Stars): The control immunity in their skills enables them to harvest large groups of infantries within a considerable range.


"Dragonrise: CARVE YOUR LEGACY" Balance Adjustment

This adjustment will issue [Ironcap Scout Cavalry Doctrine Removal Token] and [Ironcap Scout Cavalry Scroll of Forgetfulness] to our warlords. After using these items, all activated Doctrines become removable, and 100% of the corresponding resources spent in Mastery will be refunded.

Units in this balance adjustment:


 [Shieldmaidens]: Shieldmaidens has demonstrated relatively weak performance in recent battlefield environments, their data even unable to match with units that have similar mechanics but lower leadership cost. As the only five-star Heavy Shield unit, we hope to give them better defensive capabilities.

 [Varangian Guards]: as a unit specializing in The Counterstrike, it has been performing poorly against some meta units. We aim to enhance their damage resistance during defense and their damage output during counterattacks, making the tactical gameplay on the battlefield more diverse.

 [Siphonaris]: Siphonaris has a unique attack style, providing significant suppression against high-density infantry. However, their overall performance is relatively poor at present. We aim to enhance their basic attributes appropriately to introduce some changes to the local dynamics of the battlefield.

 [Falconetti Gunners]: The Falconetti Gunners possesses unique strategic value and features a distinct attack style. However, its impact on the current battlefield environment is diminishing. We aim to increase their firepower output duration appropriately, allowing them to better utilize their unique advantages.

 [Grayhair Garrison]: As a uniquely versatile unit, it has been underperforming against some meta four-star units. Enhancing their survivability, especially when activating the 'Last Stand' skill, can bring more diversity to the current battlefield environment.

 [Alchemists]: Alchemists is the first unit in the warfront with an auxiliary healing mechanism, and their healing skills are unique and interesting. We aim to further reduce their command value and significantly increase the healing effect of their ' Healing Hands ' skill, encouraging warlords on the battlefield to engage in altruistic behavior.

 [Prefecture Pikemen]: As a unit primarily relying on charges for their damage output, reducing its charge cooldown would allow them to better adapt to the current dynamic battlefield environment.

 [Ironcap Spearmen]: The Ironcap Spearmen as a meta three-star with heavy shield unit, we aim to increase their health to differentiate them from other shield units.

 [Kriegsrat Fusiliers]: Kriegsrat Fusiliers stand out among the various rifle units due to their high movement speed and impressive firepower. We aim to slightly reduce their health to provide warlords with more opportunities to exploit their weaknesses when facing the Vienna Rifle Guards.

 [Ironcap Scout Cavalry]: Ironcap Scout Cavalry has been favored by warlords since its mastery was launched. However, its excessively high cost-effectiveness and significant control ability over heroes have greatly affected battlefield balance. We aim to increase their leadership cost and reduce their control ability over heroes, creating more opportunities for warlords to counter the Ironcap Scout Cavalry on the battlefield

 For detailed balance adjustments, please refer to the: "Conqueror’s Blade - Dragonrise" Season Update News


Dragonrise: CARVE YOUR LEGACY EX Territory War Special Update

Recently, we have given a lot of thought to the ecosystem of the [Excalibur], and made related modifications to the Territory War:

- The new Season will open access to the Imperial Restorationists.
- The World will continue to adopt the single region, opening the Maoyang region.
- The maximum number of members per house will remain at 30.
- Modify the Declare War/ Battle Requirement based on the Territory War ecology of [Excalibur] server.
- The total Influence required to Declare War on Anliang has been reduced.
- Adjusted the house level requirements for declaring/participating in wars at various fief in Maoyang.


Frontline Letters (Long-Awaited Q&A! It's Finally Back!)

Since the relaunch of the Conqueror's Blade community, many generals have provided valuable feedback! These inputs are not only treasures to us but also the cornerstone of Conqueror's Blade's future direction. Through daily interactions, we've noticed that many generals are eager to receive responses from the development team. Starting this week, we will use the "Conqueror’s Report" as a bridge to select and address hot topics from the community feedback!!

Q: We need a replay system! (Contributors: r****tycheckcb, D***r, B*****scuit, S***lord)

A: In the discussions with generals, particularly with various content creators, we've noted the high demand for a replay system. Now, please be patient as I have some good news to share with you all— -
The replay function is currently under development! It will meet everyone soon!
The replay function is currently under development! It will meet everyone soon!
The replay function is currently under development! It will meet everyone soon!

Q: We need the batch use item feature! (From !**i)

A: This feature is under development and we expect the Batch Open feature for Random loots to be launched soon. The batch use of other items will be gradually rolled out in the future.

Q: The Leadership costs of Ironcap Scout Cavalry at 95 is way too powerful!! (From R*P)

A: The Ironcap Scout Cavalry has been a favorite for many generals since its Mastery was released. However, due to its high cost-effectiveness and excessive control over the heroes, it has greatly affected the balance of the battlefield. Therefore, we have made the following adjustments to this unit: Leadership value 95 -> 120, [Dominate the World] no longer produces a Dazed effect on heroes.

Q: The Shieldmaidens lacks the ability to take damage, block damage, and deal damage! (From B*****scuit)

A: As the only five-star Heavy Shield unit, we hope to give them better defensive capabilities. Therefore, we’ve made the following changes to the unit: Leadership cost from 310 down to 280, damage reduction effect of [Cover Commander] has been increased from 15% up to 30%, defense boost effect of [Guardian] has been increased from 10% to 20%, Basic Slashing Damage has been increased by 10%, and Basic Piercing Damage has also been increased by 10%. 

Q: Korean translation needs improvement! (From: Naver user feedback)

A: Thank you for your feedback, General! Regarding the translation, you can now provide feedback on our official DC community's dedicated channel. We will regularly optimize it accordingly!

Q: New players are not sticking around; we need to utilize the power of the community! (From S***lord)

A: Thank you for your feedback. We have always revered the power of the community, and as you mentioned, we agree that the community's influence is crucial in guiding new players. Therefore, in addition to submitting the New Player Guidebook each season, we will also introduce a new feature related to newcomers in the community to assist new players in their growth!!

Q: Why isn't there an EX-server house recruitment channel in the community? (from I****T)

A: We have it now! At the same time, we are busily preparing for a new season of activities. There are activities every week, there are rewards every week, remember to follow us!

Q: We need more closer communication with the officials! (From ALL OF YOU)

A: We deeply understand the importance of communication and sincerely hope to regularly engage with all generals. To ensure that we hear the voices of generals firsthand and better understand their needs, we are planning to launch an AMA (Ask Me Anything) event soon—where the official team will be available in the DC (Discord Channel) to answer your questions directly. We promise to address as many questions as possible during this event. For those issues where conclusions cannot be made immediately, we will communicate with the entire development team and provide updates in the next edition of the Conqueror’s Report!

Currently, the entire Conqueror's Blade development team is working hard to optimize the new season based on feedback from PTR users. We will also address the newly received feedback as soon as possible. Please stay tuned for the details in the upcoming second edition of the Conqueror’s Report!

Song of the Battlefield (Player-created content Share)

Creative content is an indispensable part of our community, and we highly value every content creator. We encourage and appreciate each piece of content created!

Season Update Content

I. Season Units

Feathered Crossbowmen (3 Stars)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9506414b90d78fe7c9964311851a6d92f5a53ff3.jpg
Back Story

The western regions faced repeated invasions from Qiang and Hu forces before the Unified. Qin King called upon the heroes around the continent form the "Feathered Crossbowmen" to safeguard the region. The "Feathered Crossbowmen" was renowned for its martial arts, adept in using crossbows to shoot down powerful enemies from a distance, and skilled in close combat with blades. Qiang and Hu forces, relying on their formidable cavalry, often launched assaults, plundering and wreaking havoc. Qin King devised a plan and dispatched a unit of "Feathered Crossbowmen" to ambush the enemies. Qiang and Hu forces were greatly alarmed by the sudden arrival of the Feathered Crossbowmen, thinking that divine soldiers had descended. Seizing the opportunity, the Feathered Crossbowmen launched a powerful crossbow assault, catching the enemy off guard. The Qiang and Hu forces fall in panic, abandoned their camp and fled. As they retreated, they encountered another ambush set by the Feathered Crossbowmen, resulting in significant casualties. Since then whenever the Qiang and Hu forces heard the sign Feathered Crossbowmen they trembled in fear. Western regions and the people within had finally attain a peace.

Battle Mode

The Feathered Crossbowmen are skilled martial artists proficient in the art of dual wielding. They excel in using their crossbows to eliminate foes from a distance, but they are equally adept in close combat, wielding Tang Blades with precision and agility. Their mastery of both weapons allows them to execute swift and devastating attacks, manipulating their enemies' movements with expert techniques. As the King of Qin's secret weapon, their prowess is undeniable and their reputation well-deserved.

 Skill 1: Suppressing Fire (Same as other ranged skills)
 Skill 2: Sudden Storm (Burst attack, available in both Ranged and Melee)
 Features: Versatile in both melee and ranged combat, with bursts of power and decent survivability. Agile and adept at kiting enemies.


Wuwei Mansion Guard (4 Stars)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a9d9563ac0ce2b036fff2e6c0510d90bb42e985d.jpg
Back Story

Since the King of Qin conquered and pacified the Central area, he was able to establish his government, command thousands of troops to protect his territory. His old guards, expert in harnessing the mighty spear during battles, were all brave and fearless. The King of Qin then included them in his army, renaming them the Wuwei Mansion Guard. The Wuwei Mansion Guard is loyal to their leader and Unyielding even when facing slim chances of survival. A poem later praises: The Wuwei Mansion Guard reveals its mighty power, and heroes are seen everywhere.

Battle Mode

The Wuwei Mansion Guards consist of courageous and young warriors who adeptly wield their giant spears to pierce the enemy's throat, knock them off the ground, and disrupt enemy formations. They capitalize on every opportunity to defeat the enemy with minimal effort. With their exceptional skills and stamina, they prove to be a formidable force under the command of Qin King on the battlefield.

 Skill 1: Soul Breaking Claws (Inflict Thrown and considerable damage to enemy)
 Skill 2: Brutal Sweep The (Wuwei Mansion Guards sweep their pikes, causing massive damage to enemies and making themselves immune to control).
 Features: Strong sustained combat and survivability. Utilizes control immunity to withstand bursts and maintain continuous damage output on the battlefield.


Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry (5 Stars)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08e51e6df909b6a414de80e1f1441227890d4bc5.jpg
Back Story

Qin King and the Northern barbarians were engaged in perennial warfare. Enemy's cavalry causing tremendous distress and challenge to Qin's army. One day, as Qin King was devising a strategy to overcome the enemy, he witnessed General Jing De leading a cavalry force with black-armored horses and wore shining black armor. Each member is a warrior with high morale. Wherever they went, they left a trail of victories. Qin King was overjoyed and bestowed upon them the title of "Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry".

Battle Mode

Xuanjia Heavy Cavalry are characterized by their lightning-fast and unassailable charges in battle. They ride expertly trained warhorses covered in black armor, utilizing the speed and force of their mounts to approach enemies swiftly and unleash a devastating attack. Using spears to penetrate through their enemies as they approach or fully unleashing their violence during a charge. This high-speed charge along with unstoppable spear’s attack can quickly break through enemy formation, causing a lot of chaos and casualties.

 Skill 1: Swift As Lightning (Increases its speed and charges towards a designated location.)
 Skill 2: Weapon Veteran (Immediately becomes immune to controls, and launch several rounds of attack when close to enemies.).
 Features: The control immunity in their skills enables them to harvest large groups of infantry within a considerable range.


IX. Unit and System Optimization

Balance Adjustment

Based on recent battlefield performance data and feedbacks from the community, we will be making balance adjustments to several units in Season 18. With these balance adjustments, we aim to provide opportunities for some underperforming but unique seasonal units to see play, making the battlefield more diverse overall.

[Shieldmaidens]
Shieldmaidens has demonstrated relatively weak performance in recent battlefield environments, their data even unable to match with units that have similar mechanics but lower leadership cost. As the only five-star Heavy Shield unit, we hope to give them better defensive capabilities.
Changes:

         Leadership cost 310 -> 280
         The damage reduction of the [Cover Commander] has been increased from 15% to 30%.
         The effect of defense increase in the [Guardian] has been upgraded from 10% to 20%.
         Basic Slashing Damage increases by 10%.
         Basic Piercing Damage increases by 10%. 

[Varangian Guards]
as a unit specializing in The Counterstrike, it has been performing poorly against some meta units. We aim to enhance their damage resistance during defense and their damage output during counterattacks, making the tactical gameplay on the battlefield more diverse..
Changes:

         The effect of damage reduction in the [Unbreakable] has been increased from 30% ----> damage taken reduced by 40%.
         [Raging Onslaught] All types of armor penetration increased from 300 ——> 400. 

[Siphonaris]
Siphonaris has a unique attack style, providing significant suppression against high-density infantry. However, their overall performance is relatively poor at present. We aim to enhance their basic attributes appropriately to introduce some changes to the local dynamics of the battlefield.
Changes:

         Leadership Cost 315 ——>300
         Basic blunt damage increases by 200.
         Basic health increases by 20%

[Falconetti Gunners]
The Falconetti Gunners possesses unique strategic value and features a distinct attack style. However, its impact on the current battlefield environment is diminishing. We aim to increase their firepower output duration appropriately, allowing them to better utilize their unique advantages.
Changes:

         Leadership Cost 320 ——> 300
         Basic Ammo increases by 30%

[Grayhair Garrison]
As a uniquely versatile unit, it has been underperforming against some meta four-star units. Enhancing their survivability, especially when activating the 'Last Stand' skill, can bring more diversity to the current battlefield environment.
Changes:

         Leadership Cost 230 ——> 200
         Basic health increases by 20%.
         The effect of damage reduction in the [Last Stand] changes from 15% to 25%. 

[Alchemists]
Alchemists is the first unit in the warfront with an auxiliary healing mechanism, and their healing skills are unique and interesting. We aim to further reduce their command value and significantly increase the healing effect of their ' Healing Hands ' skill, encouraging warlords on the battlefield to engage in altruistic behavior.
Changes:

         Leadership Cost 90 ——> 60
         [Healing Hands]: Regeneration 1% of maximum HP --> Regeneration 10% of maximum HP

[Prefecture Pikemen]
As a unit primarily relying on charges for their damage output, reducing its charge cooldown would allow them to better adapt to the current dynamic battlefield environment.
Changes:

         Reduced the cooldown for Charge from 60 seconds to 40 seconds.

[Ironcap Spearmen]
The Ironcap Spearmen as a meta three-star with heavy shield unit, we aim to increase their health to differentiate them from other shield units..
Changes:

         Leadership Cost 150 ——> 130
         Base health increase by 30%.

[Kriegsrat Fusiliers]
Kriegsrat Fusiliers stand out among the various rifle units due to their high movement speed and impressive firepower. We aim to slightly reduce their health to provide warlords with more opportunities to exploit their weaknesses when facing the Vienna Rifle Guards.
Changes:

         Base health decreases by 30%.

[Ironcap Scout Cavalry]
Ironcap Scout Cavalry has been favored by warlords since its mastery was launched. However, its excessively high cost-effectiveness and significant control ability over heroes have greatly affected battlefield balance. We aim to increase their leadership cost and reduce their control ability over heroes, creating more opportunities for warlords to counter the Ironcap Scout Cavalry on the battlefield.
Changes:

         Leadership Cost 95 --> 120
         The [Dominate the World] no longer causes a Dazed effect on Heroes.

This adjustment will issue [Ironcap Scout Cavalry Doctrine Removal Token] and [Ironcap Scout Cavalry Scroll of Forgetfulness] to our warlords. After using these items, all activated Doctrines become removable, and 100% of the corresponding resources spent in Mastery will be refunded.

Ragdoll Physics

 We have added a ragdoll effect to the impact and explosive attacks of heroes, units, and artillery that deal powerful blows or explosions when killing enemy infantry units.
 You can turn on effect by [ESC -> Graphics -> Graphics Settings -> Ragdoll System].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f3422608f3259b3e21ce41df40cfa79177830659.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/767e17b14ad82590513a686814212ea41486989f.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/720fc53f1f1c10f35664287c08ee69a69a43516c.gif

New player Experience 

 It is the first time that we optimized the first-time matched game of our new player, we have replaced it with an optimized map based on the seasonal theme to enhance the new player’s experience

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f0eeaa07054025b099aa7102fbcfbe1f3f44eca9.png

notes.title: "Avalon" Season Server Transfer Announcement
notes.content:
Avalon Season Server Transfer 

The inexorable march of time. The Avalon season is about to an end, and new season is awaiting. We are pleased to inform warlords a chance to switch servers.

	Server Transfer Time:

[olist]
 the server transfer for this season is expected to open registration after the maintenance on March 7, 2024 and will close the registration on March 20, 2024, 23:59 (UTC+8).

 The process of Character transfer will take place during the maintenance of the new season.
[/olist]
Servers Available for Transfer

[olist]
 Lotus Ash Sea、Dragonrise Island、Jaderock Creek、Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest
are allowed transfers to each other.

[/olist]
Transfer Cost

[olist]
 It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.
[/olist]
	Transfer Restrictions

[olist]
 Lotus Ash Sea、Dragonrise Island、Jaderock Creek、Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest
have no restrictions on character creation for this server transfer. Warlords could freely transfer between servers based on their needs.


Server transfer to Excalibur will not be available this time[/olist]

Transfer Quotas
[olist]
 There are no limits on server transfers between Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest this time, warlords could freely transfer between servers based on their needs.[/olist]

How to Apply:

Select the character you want to apply for server transfer and enter the game. Open the System Menu (ESC), choose Account Service - Character Transfer and access to the server transfer interface. Choose your desired server and click Confirm. At this point, the system will deduct a certain amount of Sovereigns as a transfer fee, and your character will enter a "Transfer Application" pending status. Once the new Season maintenance is completed, we will transfer your account to the desired server.

Important Notices:
[olist]
 After submitting the server transfer application, you may withdraw your application before 23:59 on March 20 (UTC+8). After withdrawal the application, the system will refund the server transfer fee (limited to this server transfer activity), and you will not be able to apply for server transfer services again within 24h.
 Characters pending for server transfer cannot be deleted. if the character transfer failed, the transfer fee will be refunded to your account.
 The character must leave the House (The Imperial Restorationists and The Free Houses) when applying server transfer, and cannot join any House during the server transfer application period;
 The chosen character can still be played in the game on the original server during server transfer application period;
 If the server transfer success, the character's friends and blacklist information will be cleared. When entering the target server, players need to re-select their region.
 Items and resources that can be carried:
1) Only the items and materials in your inventory, Supply Dump, Wagon, and deposit slip can be carried over in server transfers
2) Items and resources listed on the Auctioneers cannot be carried over in server transfer, please make sure to clear the Auctioneers in advance to avoid any loss.
3) Emails and the items attached within can transferred to the new server.
 Duplicate Name Concerns:
If a character with the same name as you exists on the server you are transferring to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer complete, we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.
 Additional information:
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if the server has login restrictions. Please ensure you could log in to the server before transfer your character.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Guts & Glory] with [Dragon's Scale & Jade] is now available for a limited time!
notes.content:
Dear Warlords!

The old Wu King's battle attire [Dragon's Scale & Jade] has arrived on February 1st!

The Dragon's Scale & Jade, a masterpiece of craftsmanship, was first fashioned during the King of Wu's western tour. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/691c2b8a42a10994b6692c5eeeb88990dab140c6.jpg

【Dragon's Scale & Jade】

 Dragon's Scale & Jade Crown

- The regal crown sits imposingly atop the head, aglow with the radiance of both moon and sun, embodying the majestic essence of a mighty dragon. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a7bbd054c33d45ad6e4180c669045edb5dbf1b80.jpg


 Dragon's Scale & Jade Armor

- A silver dragon graces the shoulder, its eyes gleaming, skin luminous, and claws sharp as hooks, symbolizing the noble spirit of the king.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/50c0f0cdd5a6ae0006de74a5cf71de3a5651ec2d.jpg


 Dragon's Scale & Jade Coat

- At the waist, a green brocade flows like water, agile as the wind, adorned with an embroidered water pattern that shimmers like ripples. The brocade is lined with dazzling yellow satin, radiating extreme splendor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2500f13d1e9b11aa99885edaf2518bf33335f554.jpg


 Dragon's Scale & Jade Boots

- Adorning the black boots are silver-lined dragon claws with iron hooks, exuding an aura of unparalleled mightiness.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/84d9e928ab442177916160bcd666d09ffa8083d7.jpg

There is a rumor in the past:

In ancient times, there was a legend that Assassin Zhuanchu killed the dependents of the Chu Kingdom, which is commence of the rise of new Wu. they began plotting to rule the city. The King of Wu led his troops to campaign against the Western Chu, gaining a great victory over the Chu army, and capturing Yingdu the capital of Chu Kingdom.

Kingdom Wu has ruled the southwest, and its might shine all over China. Behind the brilliant governance is the hegemonic presence that was built upon force. The King of Wu, in high spirits, inspecting newly conquered territories and oversees national affairs. Hence, he ordered skilled craftsmen to forge this dragon suit, to commemorates the King's achievements, and named it: [Dragon's Scale & Jade].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/691c2b8a42a10994b6692c5eeeb88990dab140c6.jpg


【Thunder Strike】

The silver-like blade emits a bright glow, the golden carving shines with dazzling light, the blue blade triggers the alarm of thunder and lightning, and the dragon's roar shakes the sky.
 
Legendary Weapon attire, Dual Blades [Thunder Strike] has arrived!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/408d62b1be802bbb8c815ec5323ea49a3bd6c50a.jpg



The ability of [Thunder Strike] cannot be underestimated. It harnesses the power of Thunder, attaching it to the blade. When used, it triggers a thunderbolt to help to restrain enemies and gain victory. In the contrary, it can also summon lightning around, conceal warlord’s form and Retreat safely. Whether attacking or retreating, it helps warlord easily controls the battlefield, enabling warlords to overcome and win every battle. It's a treasure in the Wu and Chu regions. An elderly once recalled the Legendary tale of this treasure, saying as follows:

In ancient times, the Prince of Wu perpetrated regicide, proclaiming himself king and seizing the twin hook blades, famously known as the "Thunder Strike". These blades take the form of crescent moons, their edges as sharp as the chill of autumn frost. In every pivotal battle, the King of Wu boldly leads the charge with the twin blades in hand. Amidst the billowing clouds and mists, a golden dragon, seemingly ethereal yet almost tangible, twirls gracefully, accompanied by bursts of lightning and resounding thunder on his right. 

Its shape like a crescent moon, with a sharply edged blade reflecting enemy’s images. Every time the King of Wu goes into a decisive battle, he must rush to the front with a [Thunder Strike] in his hands, amidst the rushing clouds and fog, a golden dragon seems real and illusory, dancing in it, flashing lightning and booming thunder, accompanying him on his side.

As the poem says:

The glistening blade casts reflections on the spring water, its cold steel mirroring the essence of autumn frost. 
As the Thunder Strike dragon emerges, excitement courses through the ranks, stirring the spirits of all armies.   


【Azure Dragon’s Crown】

During the reign of Emperor Tai Kang, rumors of immortals dwelling in the East Sea reached the emperor's ears. Intrigued, he dispatched envoys to investigate. The following year, the envoy returned with a young girl of ethereal beauty, graced with snowy skin and adorned with stunning azure horns that radiated crystal clarity. 

The emperor, both curious and captivated by her charm, treated her with utmost courtesy. Three years later, when the emperor fell critically ill, the Dragon Lady, as she came to be known, made a profound gesture. She cut off one of her azure horns and placed it on the emperor's crown. Miraculously, the emperor's health improved, bringing him immense joy. Eager to express his gratitude, the emperor sought the Dragon Lady, only to find her vanished without a trace. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/20d72c4cd064b40bb6b15ff93ddc27a36c9382c7.jpg

Time flies, the era of great prosperity is now past. The prince brings chaos to central plains with his army, the governance of the era of prosperity seems like a fleeting moment, the whole world has undergone major changes, the flame of wars are everywhere, people are suffering from battle. After the prince's chaos, tranquility was restored for a moment; however, not long after, the barbarian cavalry assaulted from the north, the royal family is in a panic, the places north of the long river all fell into the chaos aroused by the barbarians. The [Azure Dragon’s Crown] was lost in the war. After passing through the south of the river, travelers found [Dragon's Scale & Jade], when exploring the old domains of Wu and Chu. Addition to this, there is a sign of [Azure Dragon’s Crown] from the north of Jing at the meanwhile….

After the February 1st update, [Azure Dragon’s Crown] has arrived!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be76518bf4e3e69dc41ebcec072d131a111a80bd.png
Greetings, Warlords! 

We will update the game during our maintenance on February 1st, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly. 
Due to the extensive content involved, a routine maintenance will be conducted from 12:30 to 15:30 (UTC+8) on February 6th to guarantee the game's stability. No maintenance is scheduled for February 8th and 15th. 
Additionally, the Territory Wars on February 10th and February 13th will be substituted with Military Exercises.
The update will contain the following:

I. EVENT NOTICES

I. Year of the Dragon Login Rewards

Embrace the auspicious energy of the jade rabbit in the old year and witness the golden dragon's glory for the future. Log in during the event to receive [Secret Treatise] x50.

Runs from Feb. 1 (after maintenance) through Feb. 22 (until maintenance).

II. Plenty of Rewards to Assist You in Campaign

To express our gratitude, all Warlords will enjoy three benfits during the event.

 Doctrines Removal: The removal process will not consume any items.
 Unit Kits: Siege and Field Battles, as well as Expeditions, will not consume kits during this time. However, attacking fiefs, pursuits, and rebels will still consume kits as usual.
 Unit XP Boost: The unit XP gained from Siege and Field Battles, as well as Expeditions, will be doubled. Note that the unit XP gained from attacking fiefs, pursuits, and rebels will remain unchanged.


Runs from Feb. 10th 00:00 (UTC+8) until Feb. 17th 23:59 (UTC+8)

III. [Guts & Glory] (With [Dragon's Scale & Jade]) Available for a Limited-time
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/691c2b8a42a10994b6692c5eeeb88990dab140c6.jpg

 Part of the [Guts & Glory] rewards can be unlocked for free. You can also purchase the [Dragon's Scale & Jade] Hero Attire to rank up in [Guts & Glory] and unlock all premium rewards!
 You may claim all premium rewards of ranks you've earned by purchasing [Guts & Glory] at any time.
 After [Guts & Glory] ends, rewards can be claimed until the next version update. (You may still purchase [Guts & Glory] during this time to get all premium rewards.) Rewards still unclaimed at the time of the next version update will be lost, so claim them in time!

[Guts & Glory Rank]:

 Complete event quests to earn experience and rank up for tons of rewards.
 The event contains daily, sign-in, badge, and matchmaking quests. Daily quests refresh at 00:00. You can earn 1,100 points from sign-in and daily quests. Badge and matchmaking quests can be completed at any time, and each of these may be completed up to 30 times. You can earn 600 points from these.
 You will no longer be able to obtain experience from these event quests after reaching maximum rank (1,500 experience). Experience can only be gained from quests and cannot be bought.

Partial Reward Overview:

        Epic Hero Equipment Schematic Crate
        Treatises
        Golden Treasure Orders
        Unit Mastery Materials
        Random Kit for T4 Doctrines

Runs from Feb 1 (after maintenance) through Feb 15 8:00
Rewards can be claimed until Feb 22 (until maintenance); you may still purchase [Guts & Glory] during this time.

IV.  [Echoes of Dragon's Roar] Attire Treasure Is On
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/408d62b1be802bbb8c815ec5323ea49a3bd6c50a.jpg

       Silver edges flow with a clear glow, golden sculptures solidify into dazzling light, the azure blade summons thunderous surprise, the dragon's roar shakes the heavens. The legendary Dual Blades skin [Thunder Strike] now available! Runs from Feb 1 (after maintenance) through Feb 29 (until maintenance).
 
You can acquire it under [Attire Treasure (G)], and the chances are as follows:
The Dual Blades Attire [Thunder Strike] - 0.5%
Sealed Weapon Skin (Previous Seasons) - 14%
Uncommon or Rare Attire - 85.5%
You can check the exact drop rates in the [Attire Treasure (G)] menu in-game.

V. New Gameplay [Secret of Sands] Comes

Intro:

 In [Secret of Sands], you can bring one of you own Units into battles. Additional draft units will also be given to assist you. Those additional draft units are obtained by choosing the Tactic, and they will be automatically placed in a fixed cell with 3*3 grid in your camp. When the battle starts, these units will automatically enter the battle.
 Enemy will appear in hostile camp, and they will become stonger when you enter into the next level.

Special Rule: 

 In the mode, battles are divided into multiple rounds, and at the beginning of each round, the status of all units and hero resets (fully restores). Before each round begins, you have the opportunity to choose multiple tactics, providing additional units that can automatically fight in battles or unit’s strength.
 You can enter the mode with one of your units that can be operated to participate in the battle.


Win Conditions:


 In each round, you can win by eliminating all enemy units.
 Complete all rounds of battle to achieve the final victory.
 The total number of rounds varies with different difficulty levels.


Defeat Conditions:


 Hero Deaths
 Failed to defeat defeat all enemy units before each round's time runs out.


Tactic:


 Tactics are mainly divided into two types: Unit and Unit Strengthening.
 When selecting Unit Tactics, the chosen unit will appear in your formation, assisting you in all subsequent battles (the unit's status will reset at the beginning of each new round).
 When choosing a Unit Strengthening Tactic, units that meet the tactic's requirements will receive special effects, and these effects will be active in subsequent rounds.


Talent:

Obtained by completing [Secret of Sands], spending Talent points can unlock new abilities in the [Talent] System. These newly unlocked abilities will provide significant assistance.

[Secret of Sands] Score:

 Complete the [Secret of Sands] to earn [Secret of Sands] Score, which can be exchanged for rewards from the [Secret of Sands] Store, the reward includes Epic Hero Equipment Schematic Selection Boxes, Treatise, and others.
Partial Reward Overview:
[olist]
        Epic Hero Equipment Schematic Crate
        Treatises
        Divine Crow (Epic)
        Unit Mastery Materials
        Pure Spirits
[/olist]

Time:
Available all day from Feb 1 (after maintenance) until Feb 22 (until maintenance).

VI. Conqueror's Journey Battlefield is Available, Doctrine Pool Rotation

Embark on the Conqueror's Journey Battlefield where Warlords can utilize [Secret Treatise] to obtain the esteemed War Scholar. Additionally, a new Doctrine has been introduced to the Conqueror's Journey Battlefield: Epic Javelin Doctrine IV. Explore the battlefield and enhance your strategies!

Runs from Feb 1 (after maintenance) through Feb 22 (until maintenance).

VII. Gift of Time is Here to Assist Your new Season Journey.

      The [Gift of Time] event can be accessed from the bottom left of the [C-Store]menu. The event consists of a total of 7 stages. Upon purchasing pack 1, pack 2 will unlock, and the pattern continues. Each pack can be purchased only once.
Event Pack Overview:

Pack 2: Golden Treasure Order x2, Reforged Stones x50, Price: 300 Sovereigns.
Pack 3: Golden Treasure Order x3, Rare Honor Medal x5, Price: 980 Sovereigns.

Pack 6: Golden Treasure Order x10, Doctrine Water x15, Price: 2,580 Sovereigns
Pack 7: Heroic Epic x10, Epic Schematic Crate x1, Price: Free

Runs from Feb 1 (after maintenance) through Feb 22 (until maintenance).

VIII. New Year Exclusive Warfare Challenge Pack & [Eternal] Seasonal Pack Now Accessible

The [Helheim] and [Colosseum] Challenge Packs will be taken off the shelves under Store - Warfare Packs, and the [Dynasty] and [Eternal] packs will become available.
Runs from Feb 1 (after maintenance) through Feb 22 (until maintenance).
Note: The [Eternal] season's exclusive items are now accessible, and the [Epic/Rare Seasonal Doctrine Selection Box] now contains doctrines exclusively from the [Eternal] season.

IX. Total Spendings Return & Pavilion of Glory Available For a Limited Time!

Spend a total of 500 Sovereigns: Golden Treasure Order x1, [Thunder Coins] x50
Spend a total of 1,000 Sovereigns: Golden Treasure Order x1, [Thunder Coins] x50
Spend a total of 2,000 Sovereigns: Golden Treasure Order x2, [Thunder Coins] x100

Spend a total of 10,000 Sovereigns: [Thunder Strike] Title, [Thunder Coins] x500
Spend a total of 20,000 Sovereigns: Golden Treasure Order x5, [Thunder Coins] x1,000
Spend a total of 30,000 Sovereigns: Golden Treasure Order x8, [Thunder Coins] x1,000
Spend a total of 50,000 Sovereigns: Exclusive Hero Headwear [Azure Dragon’s Crown], [Thunder Coins] x2,000

Runs from Feb 1 (after maintenance) through Feb 22 (until maintenance).

You'll be able to exchange the limited-time item [Thunder Coins] you earn from Total Spendings Return events in the Pavilion of Glory for amazing rewards. Below are some of the available rewards. You can check out the full range of rewards in-game in the [Pavilion of Glory (O)] menu.


 Treasure Essence x150
 Doctrine Water x100
 New Year Headwear Selection Box

notes.title: Remold the Conqueror's Blade Community Together
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/754f74c1ba3afdbdc7a95bad7f62492126f97197.png
Greetings, Warlords!

The development team of [Conqueror's Blade] always considers all the Warlords as the most precious treasures, and it is your continuous support and encouragement that inspire us to reach where we are today. We value every piece of advice and feedback from everyone and are thankful for your willingness to embrace us and grow together with [Conqueror's Blade].
Not long ago, Project Nirvana came to an end. Looking back, [Conqueror's Blade] broke the old and established the new, with the development team putting forth their utmost effort to optimize performance. Here, we once again thank all the warlords for their strong support and assistance—[Conqueror's Blade] grows once again because of you!

After this battle, we once again marvel at the power of the warlords—within just a few days, hundreds of support and feedback messages from the community have helped the development team identify numerous hidden issues and optimize countless game experiences.

Project Nirvana has ended, but we find ourselves deep in thought…
——Project Nirvana has proven the community strength of Conqueror's Blade, but before this, it seems that we have ignored this power.

The importance of the community goes without saying, and your feedback is crucial for the growth and development of [Conqueror's Blade].

——The power of the community is awe-inspiring!

Regarding the community, we have many visions. We are very sorry for previously ignoring the awe of the community's strength, ignoring the interactions with community users, and many things that should have been done but were not. Now, we reflect once again and set out anew, hoping to rebuild the brilliance of the Conqueror's Blade community.

Building a community will be one of our key focuses in the Next Tier. We commit to valuing every general who comes to the official community, taking every piece of community feedback seriously, and fostering a closer connection with you all!

We sincerely invite all Warlords to join us once again in forging the glory of the [Conqueror's Blade] community!

We promise:

1. Value Warlord Feedback

*Your feedback is crucial to the Growth of "Conqueror's Blade" and also decides the future of "Conqueror's Blade".

We have promised all Warlords that we will hand over the choice of Unit mastery to you—this time, according to the results of the in-game survey, we will follow everyone's wishes and create mastery for the [Rattan Marksmen] and [Ironcap Scout Cavalry]!
This Unit Mastery vote is just the first step; we will continue to conduct related surveys of your preferences and give you more choices in the future!

*Daily feedback channels are also extremely important

It is an important step for us to value DC maintenance in order to rebuild the glory of our community!
We sincerely invite you to join the official Discord, where you can speak your mind in the relevant channel (YOUR THOUGHTS). We take all your feedback and suggestions seriously and ensure they are communicated to the relevant personnel promptly!

II. Conveying Development Ideas

*Convey the ideas of the development team, truly accompanying the general every step of the way

We hope to convey the thoughts and voices of the development team to the community and the Warlords, thus the Developer's Log (Dev-log) series will be relaunched!
We regularly collect community feedback and suggestions, communicate with the development team members, and integrate the developers' ideas into logs that are posted on the DC community.

III. Encouraging Creative Excellence

*The new Content Creator Program is available now, all creations deserve to be respected, and the rights and interests of creators are significantly increased!

Brilliant content creation is an irreplaceable part of community content. We respect every content creator, and we encourage every act of content creation!
The brand new Content Creator Program is now in effect, with various creative Great Force challenges and a wealth of benefits awaiting your participation!

For more details: https://www.conquerorsblade.com/en/news/1077/

Rekindling the splendor of the [Conqueror's Blade] community may not happen overnight, but we believe that with today's changes, the spark of the community will once again ignite into a blazing flame!
We promise that we will always be with all the Warlords, listen to the suggestions of the Warlords with an open mind, and wholeheartedly provide the best game and community services. The [Conqueror's Blade] community aspires to be the most steadfast support for our Warlords!

--Conqueror's Blade Community Portal--
Official Conqueror's Blade Discord: https://discord.gg/GYuS4Czbdp

Official Conqueror's Blade Twitter: https://twitter.com/ConquerorsBlade

Official Conqueror's Blade Facebook (EN): https://www.facebook.com/ConquerorsBladeASIA

Official Conqueror's Blade Facebook (JP): https://twitter.com/ConqB_JP

notes.title: Join our Content Creator Program
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8dc244df14ea2f7867a8a039e9f0e1fb4ef022db.jpg

Greetings, Warlord!

Have you ever considered creating videos or live streaming? 
Would you love receiving exclusive perks & rewards or even making a living by creating content?  

At Conqueror's Blade, we believe in the power of creativity and community, and we are excited to introduce our Content Creator Program (CCP) for You.

This program is designed to empower Content Creators, providing you with the flexibility to shape your own content, acquire fair compensations while emphasizing quality and diversity.

We invite you to be a part of this exciting journey.

 We motivate Content Creators (CCs) to choose their own schedule for content publishing
 We motivate CCs to focus on content quality
 We motivate Content Creators to create multiple types of content as it helps to grow your channels faster 

Views calculation Period 

 60 days (closest: December 14th, 2023 - February 14th, 2024). 

Rewards & Prizes Distribution Period

 14 days after CCP round completion (closest: March the 1st, 2024)

How to apply

Complete the questionnaire: https://forms.gle/fg5eniKXcJHa6zF57

1. Rewards and Benefits

By participating in CCP you will be able to enjoy a number of benefits including Twitch Drops support, Marketing Materials Library, access to new units & attires, PTR priority access, and many more. Below you may find the detailed list of benefits based on your Main Channel follower’s number. 

200+ Followers

By reaching 200 followers on any channel, you may apply for CCP Membership and obtain: 

Benefits

 Twitch Drops Access 
 Access to Marketing Art Materials Library
 Access to Content Creator Discord
 Priority access to PTR and Beta builds of the game
 
 Standard Sovereign Rewards

After every CCP period you will obtain in-game currency (Sovereigns) for your content. You may obtain rewards for multiple types of content. Rewards are unlimited - you can go as high as you like. Rewards are calculated based on total Views (Long or Short videos), and Stream Total Hours Watched (hours streamed multiplied by viewers) within 60 days. 

 YouTube Long Videos (Longer than 5 minutes) 

 1200 Sovereigns on reaching 3,000 views
 800 Sovereigns for every additional 10,000 total views

 Tik-Tok and YouTube Shorts

 1200 Sovereigns on reaching 4,500 views  
 800 Sovereigns for every additional 15,000 views

 Live Streaming (Twitch & YouTube)

 1200 Sovereigns on reaching 600 Total Hours Watched  
 800 Sovereigns for every additional 1,200 Total Hours Watched

You may pick One Main category 

YouTube Long Videos
Tik-Tok YouTube Short  
Streaming 

If you create multiple types of content (Long Videos, Tik-Tok/YouTube shorts, Streaming) then the rewards will be calculated as:

 Main Category Reward (100%) + Secondary Category Reward (50%) + Third Category reward (50%)

NOTE: Content Creators who write blogs and articles can apply for CCP and applications will be reviewed separately. 


Referral Gift Codes Rewards

As a Content Creator you will be given a personal unique gift code that you can publish anywhere (old and new videos, streams, communities, chats, social media, personal messages, etc.)

 100 Sovereigns will be added to your rewards for every new player who will Reach Level 50 in the game after using a Referral Gift Code 
 Additional 100 Sovereigns will be paid for characters that will later reach level 100 
 Gift Set codes can only be used on new accounts only with a level under 25
 By activating codes, your viewers will receive the following in-game items: 

 Premium Account (7 days)
 Honor x1000
 10-Battles Hero XP Card x3, 
 10-Battles Unit XP Card x3
 Rare Artillery Selection Box x1
 Treatise x1

 Regional Prizes

We believe that it is crucial to highlight the best works in every region and therefore we are introducing Regional Prizes for best works.

Every 2 months, the top videos with the highest views and top streamers will be selected in 3 groups:

 Top viewed YouTube Long Video (over 5 minutes long) 
 Top viewed Tik-Tok or YouTube Short
 Top Streamer (by Total Hours Watched)

Each of the 5 regions will have 1 Winner and 1 Finalist: 

 Korea
 Japan 
 Taiwan, Hong-Kong, Macao 
 South-East Asia (excluding Korea, Japan, Hong-Kong, Macao, Taiwan) 
 South America

Regional Winners' Prize: $100 
Regional Finalists' Prize: $50

Prizes will be distributed by JD/Amazon gift cards, or direct bank transfers for Affiliates (if available), or other preferred method.


 Prizes for Content Creation Challenges

Content Creation Challenges are official requests from the developers

 Those challenges will suggest types of content that needs to be produced by Content Creators

 Every month there will be 1-2 Content Creation Challenges held and announced in official Discord

Rewards for Selected Videos

 Will be published on the official Conqueror's Blade YouTube Channel (with links to the original authors' channels) - to give more exposure to best entries
 Authors will be rewarded with Sovereigns for selected videos (500~1,000 Sovereigns in average based on video complexity).


500+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally: 

 Content Creator in-game Name Title (time-limited)
 Free Access to New Seasonal Units (7 days after release, starting from January 2024) 
 Free Access to New Attires (7 days after release, starting from January 2024) 


1000+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally:  

 Access to Any Required Unit (7 days, on direct request) 
 Affiliate Partnership Application

 If you reach 1000 followers on your main channel, and have a good record of conduct, you can apply for Affiliate Partnership, and if it is approved:

 Your regular Sovereign Rewards changed to bank transfer payments or gift cards in your local currency. 
 Compensations are calculated based on a Content Creator's followers demographics and type of a channel alongside other factors. 


2500+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally: 

Custom Name Title for your fans - designed by yourself, distributed as a gift code. 


5000+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally: 

 Your Personal In-game Name Title designed by yourself


10000+ Followers

All previous benefits, and additionally: 

Custom Avatar (in-game) designed for you - can be sent to your fans via a Gift-code

Please note that in order to apply for a custom Avatar, a content creator must have an outstanding record of conduct, community reputation, and be a member of CCP for at least the last 3 periods. 


Community Contributor Bonuses

Are you a game veteran and know the game very well and helping new players? 
Do not have too many followers but love to share your game knowledge? 

Do not worry! We got you covered!

For exceptional community contributors with a good conduct record, and being in CCP for 3 periods, we suggest lower requirements for Number of Followers 
Community Contributor: 500+ Followers 

 Official Support for Your Community Events and Tournaments
 CBL broadcasting rights as an observer 
 Opportunity for Exclusive Interviews with devs 
 Opportunity for joint streaming with devs
 Opportunity for offline meetings with devs 


2. Guidelines 
NOTE: The listed rules, benefits, rewards are subject to change before or after 2024 February 14th - if such occurs, and announcement will be published on official Discord of CCP.
[olist]
 It is prohibited to make inappropriate remarks, including but not limited to insulting and defaming other players, racial discrimination, using cheats, inappropriate remarks about countries, false defamation, spam, toxicity (in any form decided by moderators) - in-game, community, own channels
 Cheating or Abusing Loopholes of Community Guidelines and Content Creation Guidelines is strictly prohibited
 AFK-streaming (including but not-limited to playing a pre-recorded footage during the stream for more than subsequent 20 minutes without adding any live commentary; streaming the game during Twitch Drops and being AFK for more than subsequent 30 minutes multiple times)
 It is strictly forbidden to increase the usage of promotional/referral/gift codes by creating multiple smurf accounts or by any other methods.
 The Rewards/Benefits/Guidelines of this Content Creation Program period are subject to change by developers within any time - if such occurs, an announcement of changes will be published on the Official Discord Channel of CCP. 
[/olist]
Thank you for considering become one of our Content Creators and playing Conqueror's Blade! We're excited to embark on this journey with you. For any inquiries, join us on our official Discord and let's create something amazing together!！

Official Discord:
 https://discord.gg/EjQvqjwHMb

CCP Application Questionnaire: 
https://forms.gle/fg5eniKXcJHa6zF57

notes.title: New Season Avalon is Available Now! Patch Notes.
notes.content:
Conqueror’s Blade: AVALON Descends December 14

THE LEGEND REBORN

Turn myth into a once and future legend in Conqueror’s Blade: Avalon. Embark on noble quests in the new Season inspired by King Arthur legend, and fight alongside legendary units inspired by knights of the Round Table. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c9dccff79aea3e745f5726b6b7c2c33f83aa3635.jpg

Season Units
S17 Season Units 
Bedivere Rangers (3-Star)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6e83fb1f72d1af5b632de3f0780a3520c4aabf2.png
Background
"Our determination is akin to silver bathed in fire, radiating a brilliant glow. The courageous heart of the one-armed hero Bedivere serves as a constant inspiration, urging us to confront the world of blood and sand with unwavering spears!"
They are the valiant Bedivere Rangers, serving under the command of Bedivere. In homage to their esteemed leader, they don the shoulder armor known as the "Arm of Bedivere." Regardless of the ferocity of the enemy, these warriors faithfully follow Bedivere onto the battlefield shrouded in smoke, demonstrating unparalleled courage. The Bedivere Rangers exhibit the fierceness of a diving dragon and the swiftness of a soaring eagle, executing unexpected attacks on their adversaries with precision and expertly crafted ammunition.
The Bedivere Rangers exhibit swift responsiveness to dynamic battlefield scenarios, seamlessly transitioning between offensive and defensive tactics. Their mastery lies in executing fast-paced, nimble light attack strategies, transforming into razor-sharp blades that cut through obstacles. On the battlefield, they are akin to a dazzling silver flash of lightning, instilling fear in the hearts of their adversaries.
Playstyle
Under the leadership of Bedivere, this group of light cavalries, skilled in the use of lances, stands as an elite chivalric order with a specialization in mobile tactics. Clad in lightweight equipment, they have honed their lance skills, allowing them to swiftly maneuver through enemy lines and launch decisive attacks. Their rigorous training and extensive combat experience enable them to execute strikes and tactical retreats with remarkable flexibility, all while showcasing exceptional horsemanship. As their commander, Bedivere employs his strategic acumen and spearhead to inspire the unit, transforming them into a formidable force on the battlefield.
•	Skill 1: Charge (Same as other Lancers’ Charge skill)
•	Skill 2: March of Avalon (Activated during charging, recovers HP and be able to charges towards the designated location again)
•	Skill 3: Camlann Assault (Activated during charging, increase damaged and be able to charges towards the designated location again)
The three Charge skills do not share a cooldown, enabling the unit to take full advantage of their light cavalry attributes and execute charges repeatedly.
Galahad Spearmen (4-Star)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9e4ff7847f1cb5f7280e06c9adbf26aac194aa38.png
Background
"With our spears piercing through the enemy's armor and the sturdy shield in our hands safeguarding the ground beneath our feet, we stand invincible against ten adversaries—all thanks to the strength of our clearest and purest souls!"
The Galahad Spearmen form an elite force under the noble command of the pure-hearted knight, Galahad. Having sworn an oath in the midst of a storm, they pledged that once they adorned the holy helmet—a symbol of justice and perseverance—they would fight relentlessly for their lord and the sacred land beneath their feet, even if it meant sacrificing their lives. They hold great reverence for Galahad's pure and pious heart and staunchly believe that the legendary Holy Grail will guide them on the path of heroic warfare. Upholding the sacred faith of the Knights of the Round Table, they wield their blood-soaked spear tips to forge glorious legends.
The Galahad Spearmen serves as both an impenetrable frontline defense and formidable spear throwers. When the enemy approaches, they unleash their spears with full force, creating a deadly storm in the air that swiftly annihilates foes. These guards exhibit loyalty and reliability akin to winter wolves and embody bravery and fearlessness reminiscent of summer eagles. With helmets gleaming under the golden sunlight, they persistently fight for the purest faith in their hearts.
Playstyle
Led by Galahad, the Celtic Heavy Shield Javelin units are an elite force proficient in the use of Javelins and Heavy Shields. They are renowned on the battlefield for their tight formations and precision with Javelins, employing the Shield Wall tactic against enemies and responding swiftly to counterattacks. As their leader, Galahad instills the group with his noble character and courage. They exhibit unmatched discipline and unity in battle, defending justice like true Celtic warriors.
•	Skill 1: Spear Throw (Same as other Javelin soldiers, throws a javelin to the designated location)
•	Skill 2: For Galahad (Increase the javelin damage after charging)
Combines the defense of heavy shield unit and the damage of javelin unit. A counterstrike-focused shield bearer that moderately counters Cavalry, suitable for a wide range of applications.
Lancelot Knights (5-Star)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/30781087316fa0497b6e01572f12243c3ee66f97.png
Background
"They should be afraid. When the rays of thousands of suns converge on our sword blades, we will tear apart all the rats until they are wiped out under the wrath of the lion."
Well-trained, the Lancelot Knights stand as the strongest elite among the Knights of the Round Table. They not only possess excellent swordsmanship skills but also embody the characteristics of Lancelot himself: gentleness, refinement, and politeness. On the battlefield, they are invincible, akin to the lion; off the field, they are pious and elegant gentlemen who inspire those around them with the virtues of knighthood.
In close combat, Lancelot Knights often emerge victorious against powerful opponents due to their excellent fighting skills. They excel in solo combat, inducing panic and despair in their enemies. No one surpasses them in combat prowess, facing opponents with unparalleled ease. Seasoned and undaunted, they allow their sharp swords to blossom like roses—a magnificent tribute to all their foes.
Playstyle
The Lancelot Gladiator Knight, led by Lancelot, is a highly skilled knight group specializing in sidearms and unwavering defense with the buckler. They are celebrated for their swift strikes and exceptional maneuvers on the battlefield, engaging the enemy with agility, piercing through openings with their sidearms, and offering some protection with the buckler. As their leader, Lancelot inspires the group with his adept swordsmanship and unwavering determination, enabling them to showcase their unique individual abilities in one-on-one duels and making them the elite choice on the battlefield.
•	Skill 1: Rapid Advance (Stabbing forward while granting invulnerability for a short time)
•	Skill 2: Lancelot's Dueling Techniques (After a Shield Bash, quickly strike and cause control effect or heavily wounded to enemy, reducing their combat ability)
High burst damage with a Dueling Sword, while relatively fragile on its own, Lancelot's Dueling Techniques provides burst damage, Rapid Advance ensures short-term survivability.

Conqueror's Path
Attire Cosmetics

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ca90bf0cd1c34ea3002ce5820bb3c685cf2d49ca.png
