notes.title: Optimization Campaign [Project Nirvana]: Journal #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/eb8417548b0fce3e01d51c207737cbe26b5e1430.jpg
Greetings, Warlords! 

In the latest update released on September 14th Conqueror's Blade has implemented the first round of performance optimization within [Project Nirvana] optimization campaign. 

Since the update on September 14th, Conqueror's Blade has achieved the following optimization goals:

1. Video Memory Optimization: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2d720f3bbca533ccc9ae29d12460a81eb133e249.jpg

In both high and medium-quality settings, video memory usage in Conqueror's City has been reduced by approximately 1.5GB, and by 1.0GB on average across other maps. This substantial reduction in video memory usage is a step toward enhancing client stability, resulting in fewer crashes and forced closings.

2. Texture Loading Optimization: Additional Video Memory Usage -50% 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1fa5ec811e3b595e3053f577d8d56ba10e17c7ef.jpg

A new feature has been developed for high and medium-quality settings. It allows the system to use textures with lower resolution, resulting in a mere 1/4 of the video memory usage compared to the highest resolution settings. By fine-tuning model details and optimizing texture quality, we've made significant strides in efficiently reducing video memory usage by 50%. By adjusting model details and optimizing texture quality, video memory can be efficiently reduced on Warlords' PCs. 


3. Customizable Texture Quality: A New Setting Added

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/65657143fd2257bc0f3a019d07d4d36a5947377a.jpg

Warlords can now select their preferred texture quality based on their PC configurations. We've retained the highest-quality texture settings for those with high-end setups. Players can effortlessly switch between high, medium, and low texture settings within the [Texture Settings] under the display options, allowing them to tailor the game's texture quality to their liking.

4.Lighting Optimization: Lighting Rendering Impact on Latency in Conqueror's City Reduced by 80

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d1c0f3fe7f592ce886591739b71aabb991169d59.jpg

The development team has optimized the number of lights in multiple maps. Various lighting configurations have been implemented for different graphics settings, significantly decreasing the proportion of light resource consumption while maintaining the overall visual quality.

5. Client Size Reduction: ~10GB

Following the update, the Conqueror's Blade client size has been reduced by approximately 10GB, resulting in a total size of around 39GB. 


These optimizations have been implemented with the primary aim of enhancing your Conqueror's Blade gaming experience. We sincerely appreciate your unwavering support and hope that these improvements contribute to smoother and more enjoyable gameplay for all our players.

Best Regards, 
Conqueror's Blade Developers

notes.title: Game Optimisation [Project Nirvana] Begins!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/65c1cdcefeaabd6092b20c66d4c28b6e35c6e8da.png
Dear Conqueror's Blade Community,

In the grand tapestry of life, dreams, and passions can often be eroded by the relentless grind of daily existence. Since its inception, Conqueror's Blade has dedicated itself to delivering new seasons of content. This focus is not inherently misguided, but our journey thus far has been marred by a lack of refinement and polish, resulting in frequent crashes and frustrating lag that overshadowed the launch of each new season.

Dimming the Flame of Dreams

Just like the dreams of commanding the Winged Hussars to resounding victories, raining arrows upon your enemies, unleashing your Berserkers in battle, or becoming the unyielding bastion, our aspirations have been gradually losing their luster due to these technical setbacks.

You, the Pillars of Our World

Conqueror's Blade thrives on the passion of dedicated Warlords like you. Your invaluable criticism has shown us the areas where we fall short. For far too long, our lack of self-reflection has led us astray, causing discord among our cherished player base.

We are especially grateful to those who shared their insights during the China Joy Shanghai 2023 Players Meetup held in late July. It was one of the key elements that directed us in the right way. Read the whole article here. 

Link to the Meetup Q&A

Following this period of introspection, we have fulfilled our promise by forming the new fully-dedicated Optimization Team. This endeavor is named "Project Nirvana" and will launch alongside the new season. Our goal is clear: we aim to rectify past mistakes and make Conqueror's Blade the best it can be!

A Wave of Optimizations

In our pursuit of excellence, we have undertaken several significant optimizations:

1. PvE Content Revamped

We've heeded your concerns about the overwhelming volume of PvE content and its detrimental effect on your gaming experience. To address this, our designers have immersed themselves in a month-long PvE marathon to better understand your perspective. After the Knightfall season, we will integrate and enhance daily and weekly quests, streamlining the rewards and objectives. Unique PvE drops will be replaced with daily/weekly quest rewards, featuring the versatile [War Tokens] that can be exchanged for various items.

2. Performance Enhancement

Our programmers have rigorously tested the game on various gaming rigs to pinpoint performance bottlenecks. This has led to improvements in art assets, resulting in reduced VRAM usage and a more streamlined game client. We're committed to enhancing stability and reducing crashes.

3. Unit Balancing

Unit stat values will undergo refinements, with regular changes planned to enrich gameplay and strategic depth.

A Journey Toward Excellence

While the initial update may not bring an abundance of new content, these optimizations are crucial steps on our path to continuous learning and improvement. We are devoted to providing you with the best possible gaming experience.

Please, share your thoughts and ideas with us at any opportunity. Your feedback guides us.

Our Pledge to You

The Conqueror's Blade team pledges the following:

1. Performance Optimization

We will diligently work on improving frame rates, reducing VRAM and RAM usage, enhancing stability, and minimizing crashes. We will enhance network connections and frame rates for a clearer gaming experience. Our focus includes ensuring smooth gameplay on lower-end systems and laptops.

2. Anti-Cheat Measures

We are committed to increasing transparency and reducing the prevalence of cheats. Our partnership with NetEase Shield will enable us to detect and take action against cheaters. Reporting cheaters will also be rewarded.

More Exciting Changes Await

Beyond these optimizations, we have exciting plans:

- Changes to Territory War
- Unit & Hero Balance Adjustments
- Progression Difficulty Decrease for New Accounts
- And much more!

Join Us on the Journey

Therefore, the Conqueror's Blade development team will host a live stream on September 24th to discuss our optimization plans as the next step towards our common goals with the community. We hope to share more information about our future plans and answer your questions. Our programmers and designers will also embark on online and offline meetups with the community in the near future after this stream.

Thank you for your support and love for this game,

The Conqueror's Blade Development Team

Maintenance Notice & New Gameplay

Dear players,

We estimate that the season maintenance will last between 00:00 to 15:00 (UTC+8) on September 14th. The servers will be unavailable during the maintenance, and for that, we are sorry.

This update will bring with it a ton of new content as well as changes to previous content. We will be performing updates and maintenance on our systems, and we estimate this will take around 15 hours. We will issue the following compensation following the update:

I. Colosseum Fierce Fray Comes Back with Map Updated

Time:
Runs from September 14th after maintenance until September 27th before maintenance

Locations:
- Lotus Ash Sea
- Dragonrise Island
- Jaderock Creek
- Sandstorm Gorge (UTC+8)
  - Available between 12:00-14:00 and 18:00-22:00 every day.

- Espada Forest (UTC-4)
  - Available between 10:00-13:00 and 16:00-19:00 every day.

Entrance:
Press J to open the Matchmaking interface and choose Colosseum Fierce Fray to enter.

Rewards:
You've got a chance to earn Poem Collections throughout the Colosseum Fierce Fray mode. Up to 50 Poem Collections drop each week.
- Poem Collection: Grants 500 Glory when used.
- Drop count resets every Thursday at 00:00 (server time).

Gameplay:
Rules:
- Maps:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5a1616fc722c41b2f65e863341870da68ace2e6e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/702fccc33e9a7aa6e89b1fb68d1fe7e832131f21.png

Win Conditions:
- Each team will have 500 points at first, and the team gains points when they're the only ones with heroes inside the capture range.
- When the time runs out, the team with the higher points wins.
- When the time runs out, the team with zero points loses.

Stage:
- The status of the flag changes as the match progresses.

Three brand-new Seasonal Units are coming to Conqueror’s Blade: Knightfall, starting on September 14. The third and final Unit that will be available to unlock are the most skilled fighters in the Order of the Sword: Zweihanders (5-Star Unit). 

[previewyoutube=TxR3sIKUaXU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Development Journal：Meeting FAQ
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/488d90d68766a952c55493499a71d03b2ef7ca5f.png
Greetings, Warlords!
At the end of July, we held a meetup with Chinese Mainland players where Warlords from all over the country gathered to discuss Conqueror's Blade's current issues and future plans with the developers.
First of all, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the Warlords for taking the time out of their busy schedules to participate in our meet-up and provide valuable suggestions for the game. Now, let's review the FAQ of the meet-up together.

1. In the recent two seasons, there have been frequent issues of crashes and sudden disconnects. When can these be resolved?
Optimization is always the lifeline of a game, and we have received lots of feedback from Warlords concerning improvements, whether it's from community feedback or this current meeting. So, we would like to discuss the issue of game optimization with everyone first.
Through data monitoring and customer feedback, we have indeed observed that the frequency of crashes and unexpected exits in recent seasons has increased compared to before. After internal analysis, we found that the main reasons are as follows:

Over the past few seasons, the development team has been continuously improving the game's graphics and performance. As a result, players may notice increased detail in attire textures, skin and hair materials, and special effects compared to when the game first launched. However, these new features come at a cost, such as higher memory usage, increased CPU calculations, and more complex algorithm logic. When implementing these features, we did not strike the right balance between visual quality and player system requirements. In some new levels, special effects, and attire production, we did not set reasonable asset budgets, causing some players to experience crashes due to insufficient memory or graphics memory after playing the game for a while.

Secondly, some crash issues are caused by corrupted data packets, which often occur after a Steam version update. As the game content increases, the size of the game client also becomes larger, and the probability of this situation occurring also increases.

In addition, we noticed that players with high-end hardware frequently experience crashes. After analyzing the issue, we found that part of the problem is due to some new hardware mechanisms. We did not have enough time to conduct thorough compatibility tests on a few recently released high-end RAM, motherboards, and graphics cards, leading to compatibility issues. For example, overclocked DDR5 memory on certain motherboards may cause crashes.

After analyzing, we've found that the majority of the problems players encounter, such as crashes, freezes, or frame drops, are closely related to game performance optimization. Therefore, we have formed a dedicated optimization team internally, planning to solve these issues [[within the next six months]. The optimization plan is divided into the following stages:

Game asset optimization: We will conduct a thorough scan of the game's art assets, optimizing some excessively used assets, such as highly complex effects, high-resolution textures, models without LOD, etc., in order to meet our set asset budget requirements. This can significantly resolve issues like crashes and frame drops caused by insufficient memory on the GPU.

Engine Algorithm Optimization: We will optimize some algorithms in the engine, such as upgrading the game's memory management mechanism to promptly release unused texture data from the system, thereby reducing the requirements on the graphics card; improving the memory management module, reducing memory fragmentation, and increasing memory usage efficiency; optimizing fabric algorithms to lower CPU workload.

Improve performance standard testing process: We will internally upgrade and refine our performance standard testing process. Before each version is launched, we will conduct a comprehensive performance test for all levels under different hardware configurations, to ensure that the game's performance is within an acceptable range.

Package size (game client) and compatibility issues: In addition to performance-related issues, we will also address compatibility and package size problems. On one hand, we will gradually control the package size by placing some less frequently used assets on the server and downloading them when needed. On the other hand, we will optimize the package integrity verification algorithm and process to ensure that players' downloaded packages are not damaged. The team will purchase new mainstream PC hardware every quarter and give it to the testing team for compatibility testing to ensure the game runs smoothly on these devices.

2. How will the balance of the battlefield be maintained?

With the recent balance adjustments and the addition of systems such as Unit Mastery, we have gradually found a suitable battle rhythm for the battlefield: it's neither Cavalry charges nor Arrow Rain, but rather a focus on ground Advance as the primary pace-setter, allowing various units to have room for performance in the battle rhythm.

Therefore, unit mastery and balance adjustments are crucial to gradually stabilize this ecosystem. This season, we have increased the mastery of many units in the Melee Infantry group, and these units have become important members of the battlefield due to the new combat mechanics brought by the mastery system, forming a diverse ecosystem.

Subsequent plans:
In the short term, we will not add new five-star Unit Mastery, but rather focus on balancing five-star Units. Our goal is to create a battlefield ecosystem centered on five-star Units, allowing other Units to have playable features and opportunities to enter the battle.
For lower star-level Units, we will gradually unlock their Mastery potential, exploring more possibilities in terms of gameplay experience, allowing for a wider variety of battlefield choices.
We understand that many Warlords may not have much time and are aware of the pressure to accumulate military manuals, unlock Mastery Units, and catch up with others. Therefore, you can also pay attention to the upcoming events, which will offer a lot of rewards. This will help everyone progress faster and make it an important part of finding the right development rhythm for maintaining balance and stability in the battlefield.

3. Anti-cheating Measures

Siege matchmaking is one of the core gameplay elements in Conqueror's Blade. We fully understand the negative impact that cheats have on the battlefield environment and everyone's overall gaming experience. For some time now, we have been dedicated to combating the endless surge of cheats through various methods such as self-developed encryption for game data transmission and client protection. However, there are still some that manage to slip through the cracks.
Based on everyone's feedback, we are aware that there are many new types of external plugins in the market, and they continue to be updated constantly, which causes us a great deal of trouble.

To improve the anti-cheating technology and samples, and detect different cheats through various methods, we have deepened our cooperation with NetEase YiDun anti-cheat system this year. By utilizing their comprehensive anti-cheating system and combining it with in-game character behavior data analysis, we constantly monitor and combat any suspicious accounts 24 hours a day.

However, we know that various anti-cheating measures need to be continuously updated to be effective, as cheats are constantly changing. In the meantime, if you encounter any players suspected of cheating in the game, you can report them through their Avatar or the Rating board, or contact us via our customer support system. We will follow up as soon as possible.

4. Regarding the future update plans for Territory Wars

After discussing Siege, let's talk about Territory Wars. Through Territory War, Warlords can forge deep friendships with their comrades while occupying cities in the World Map of Conqueror's Blade. We are delighted to see friendships being made through Territory Wars, but at the same time, we have noticed many issues that cannot be ignored from the feedback given by Warlords, these include:

 The game has a high learning curve and complex rules.
 The power development cycle in Territory Wars is long.
 The cost of unit kit and replenishing units exceeds the rewards
 Accumulation of resources yields no benefits.

Our primary goal is to involve more players in Territory Wars, and the above-mentioned issues may hinder their enthusiasm for participating. Therefore, these barriers and rewards-related issues are our top priority to address during the optimization of Territory Wars.

Next is the participation rhythm in the Territory War itself. During the fief battles, many players can only wait outside to join the frontline, which results in a lack of fun gaming experience and makes the individual's Territory War experience less interesting. How to make every participant valuable and involved in the war is the second problem we need to solve to improve the overall gaming experience of the Territory War gameplay.

It should be noted that the Territory War is a combination of various gameplay elements, such as the World Map and Siege Battles. Therefore, adjustments to the Territory War require considering many aspects, and the content to be adjusted is extensive. The development cycle will be relatively longer. Although we have a clear plan for the adjustments, it will take some time for them to be officially launched. Meanwhile, we hope that all Warlords can participate and provide more information and ideas.

In addition, we are also considering the possibility of conducting joint research tests for Territory War in the future. After making certain content adjustments, we will invite all Warlords to participate and work together to complete the testing of this large-scale gameplay.
We once again thank all the Warlords for providing us with valuable suggestions regarding the Territory War through meetings and the complaint system.

5. Will CBL (Conqueror's Blade League) be held again?

After eight seasons, the CBL has always been an event where Conqueror's Blade developers and players participate together. It's the biggest stage for players to showcase their tactics and represents the highest level of Conqueror's Blade tactical gameplay. During the CBL, we cheer all cheer for the legendary teams and support those who dare to challenge those. No matter the result, we see everyone's passion for Conqueror's Blade and the CBL. Therefore, we will continue to hold the Conqueror's Blade League and strive to involve more players in the pursuit of the highest battlefield standards.

At the same time, we also hope that apart from the Conqueror's Blade League (CBL), more players and organizations in the community can join us in organizing various community tournaments. Official support includes but is not limited to promotional assistance and reward incentives. For more details, please refer to the upcoming notice.
Finally, as the pinnacle of Conqueror's Blade gameplay, we hope that everyone can participate in sharing tactics and skill so that more Warlords can see and understand the fun in it.
Here's a little sneak peek: the CBL Winter Tournament is expected to open for registration in late October. See you on the battlefield, Warlords!

6. There are many game modes, but their replayability is low. Will reward acquisition and gameplay design exploration be improved in the future?

We have always hoped to bring different gameplay experiences to Warlords through updates in Conqueror's Blade, besides Siege matches, and allow them to earn more rewards and resources during the process. However, after some events were launched, Warlords' feedback on the game modes gradually became negative, with words like "forced" and "pushed" appearing in the comments. These, obviously, do not align with our original intentions.

In the future, we hope to make some changes that will allow warlords to freely manage their gaming time while still obtaining enough resources and enjoyment. Firstly, we will adjust the resource production logic in some game modes, similar to the well-received "different paths, same destination" mechanism in other games. As long as you invest time into the game, regardless of the game mode chosen, you can obtain the resources you want. This way, the freedom to play the game will be increased, and you can play the modes you want while still keeping up with the progress.

In terms of gameplay mode updates, we will also seek breakthroughs and try various directions until we eventually settle on some interesting content. However, this does not mean we will force everyone to spend their precious gaming time on content they do not enjoy.

7. Plans for updating hero/unit attire and the methods of obtaining these attires

We won't make the attire in Conqueror's Blade too exaggerated in terms of the sense of the era, in order not to lose the historical charm of a cold weapon warfare game. Thus, highly technological and modern attire like Cyberpunk is unlikely to appear in Conqueror's Blade.

As everyone's aesthetic appreciation improves, the demand for more sophisticated fashion design increases. We will take on this challenge and you can look forward to next season's seasonal attires to see if our design not only meets the historical requirements but also has a more uncommon aesthetic compared to the previous Conqueror's Blade designs released recently

 In the future, we may consider incorporating themes from ancient legends into the game, but these will not give players a sense of being disconnected from the era. We believe that some of the legendary stories and myths from ancient times represent people's expressions of beauty and imagination at that time. 

In terms of Attires acquisition, direct purchase and Attire Chest draws continue to be the main ways to obtain attire in the future.

P.S.
The above is the main content mentioned by the developers and warlords during this dev/player meetup. Once again, thank you all for taking the time out of your busy schedules to attend our offline meeting and providing us with a lot of valuable suggestions. Your enthusiasm far exceeded our expectations. Of course, this meeting is just the beginning, and we will hold more online and offline activities in the future, inviting more warlords to join our gatherings in multiple regions.

This FAQ comes to an end. For the next FAQ, we will seriously consider the opinions of Warlords in the comment section. See you there!

notes.title: Developer FAQ
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bfc0eaf828eb4fcacba2f7cfa949f47dff6aff61.png
Dear Warlords, the last developer Q&A session received many positive reviews. This time, we have collected 11 commonly asked questions from the complaint system and community feedback and invited relevant developers to answer them:

1. [Champion Trove Limited-time Event] The Champion Trove has already won two matches, accumulating two stars. Why were both stars deducted after losing one match?
The star accumulation rule for the Champion Trove gameplay is as follows: Consecutive wins in battles add up stars, but any single loss will reset all accumulated stars to zero (loss means losing everything~). At the same time, opening a treasure chest will also clear all obtained stars. Warlords can use Protection Tickets to avoid losing stars when they open a chest. Protection Tickets can be used during the deployment phase and will protect your stars even if the battle is lost (and they won't be consumed if you win~). Protection Tickets can be obtained from the Champion Trove rewards, event mails, and in-game store purchases.

2. [Champion Trove Limited-time Event] Warlods could have won Champion Trove, but due to disconnection/crash issues, they didn’t, it's so frustrating!
At present, if Warlords encounter Champion Trove disconnections, game crashes, star deductions or point deductions issues, you can report and get it rectified through the in-game customer service system. We plan to optimize the system settings in the future so that disconnections will no longer affect the battle result's judgment. Of course, losing a player in the battlefield can put the team at a great disadvantage, so it is recommended to fix the client and check the network connection before matching. PS: We recently optimized our network connection. Users from mainland China can try connecting to the game without a VPN accelerator.

3, [Champion Trove Limited-time Event]: I got two stars in the Champion Trove on Sunday, why were the stars reset to zero on Monday?
The rewards distribution for the Champion Trove occurs every Monday at midnight. After that, the stars will reset to zero. Therefore, it is important to redeem the chests before the deadline. However, we will also improve the settlement-related rules and notifications in the future so that everyone can better understand the rules.

4. [Champion Trove Limited-time Event]: The daily opening time for the Champion Trove is too short, leaving insufficient time to collect all the rewards!
We are honored by the Warlords' love for the Champion Trove. After the next Champion Trove event starts, the daily opening hours will be extended to 12:00 - 24:00 (Join the Champion Trove with your brothers~).

5. I used a Golden Army Warrant Double Drop Card in Latent Potential, but eventually obtained 11 books. Shouldn't the double drop amount be a multiple of 2?
The original reward mechanism for using the item involved the random drop of a sum of two reward quantities, not a single drop reward quantity multiplied by 2. Therefore, the final reward may be either odd or even. The item has since been renamed to "One-Match Extra Latent Potential Drops" to avoid confusion. The Latent Potential Extra Drop Card can be obtained after purchasing a Golden Order and completing the Initial Victory task.

6. Why do units sometimes not deal damage during their attacks, such as the Ironcap Scouts' Charge and the Halberdier Sergeants' Stand Firm?
After discussion with designers, the current mechanism of the relevant Units is functioning well. Designer’s Info: The weaker mechanisms of the related Units will be optimized in later versions. It is recommended for Warlords to regularly pay attention to game maintenance Notices to understand the details of Unit balance adjustments.

7. Previously, Uncommon Infantry Manuals could be exchanged for Rare Infantry Manuals in the O-key interface. Why can't they be exchanged now?
The feature to exchange Uncommon Infantry books for Rare Infantry books is currently being optimized. We will reopen the exchange function as soon as the optimization is complete. "Hidden feature": For now, Warlords can visit the units’ Mastery node upgrade panel and click the "+" button on the right to select lower-level Infantry books for exchange.

8. Why are the tasks of the newly purchased military order, the quest First Victory is already marked as completed, and I cannot claim the corresponding rewards?
Confirmed, this is a bug issue, and the bug has now been fixed. If Warlords have encountered the same problem before, they can report it to customer service for verification and correction through the in-game customer service system in a timely manner.

9. Why is there no sound from my microphone during the game, my teammates can't hear me, or the microphone is not detected, causing me to be unable to use the voice function normally?
Confirmed, this was a BUG issue. The BUG causing the built-in voice function in CC to malfunction has now been fixed, and Warlords can use the voice function normally. If anyone still encounters voice problems, please report them to customer service through the in-game support system for resolution.

10. The hero's control over the Chain Dart & Scimitar is too strong, making it difficult to deal with in the battlefield!
Control is the characteristic of Chain Dart & Scimitar heroes, and currently, their Skill mechanics are in line with their designed characteristics, so there are no plans to adjust their Skill mechanics in the short term. However, in the optimization of future balance updates, the developers will add countermeasures for Control Skills for some classes to improve the competitive gameplay in hero battles.

11. The Yanyuedao Cavalry's instant-kill ability is too strong, making it difficult to deal with them in the battlefield!
Previously on June 29th, we improved the balance of Yanyuedao Cavalry during maintenance for our game version. "Important Information": Yanyuedao Cavalry is expected to undergo further balance adjustments and optimizations in the new season. Stay tuned.

We would like to once again express our gratitude for your suggestions and feedback. We will continue to update the Q&A thread to bring you Warlords the latest news from our developers.
If you have more suggestions or questions, you can contact us in-game.
[ESC] - [Submit Issue]
Or visit the link: www.conquerorsblade.com/sc/  
Give us your feedback. At the same time, we will also strive tirelessly to bring more and more interesting game content to everyone!

notes.title: Sengoku Season server Transfer Info
notes.content:
The Sengoku Season is nearing its resolve, and a new season is about to be born. Warlords from Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers have an opportunity to transfer their characters to other servers. 

•Server Transfer Time:
1. The transfer service for this season is expected to open for registration after maintenance on August 24, 2023, and will end registration at 23:59 (UTC+8) on September 10, 2023.

2. Character transfer will take place during the maintenance period of the new season.

•Server Scope
Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

•Transfer Cost
It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

•Transfer Restrictions
1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
2. Players may transfer without restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest servers.

•Transfer Quotas
Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.

Each server has a limited number of spots for server transfers; therefore, once the spots are full, you will not be able to register for a transfer. If you, the Warlord, need to change servers, please register as soon as possible.

How to Transfer:
Input: Select the character you want to transfer servers with and enter the game. Open the System Menu (ESC) and choose Account Service - Character Transfer to access the server transfer interface. Choose your desired destination server and click Confirm Transfer. At this point, the system will deduct a certain amount of Sovereigns as a transfer fee, and your character will enter a "Transfer Application" waiting status. Once the new Season maintenance is completed, we will transfer your account to the target server.

Important:
1. After submitting a server transfer application, you can cancel the application before 23:59 on September 10 (UTC+8). After canceling the application, the system will refund the transfer fee (for this event only). Also, you cannot apply for the transfer service again within 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.
 
3.You must leave your house (Imperial Restorationists or Free House) when requesting a server transfer. You may not join a new house while your server transfer is pending.
 
4. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.
 
5. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.
 
6. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, Wagon, and Resource Piles will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
3) Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.

7. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.
 
8. Extra Info:
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.

notes.title: Jul 13 Unit Balance Changes Preview
notes.content:
Based on recent battle statistics and community feedback, we'll be rolling out the following balance to units on July 13.

Modao Battalion
1. The Modao Battalion is a polearm-type unit and can equip all polearm doctrines (apart from Charge ones).
2. The damage dealt by [Modao Defense], [Modao March] and [Carnage] is now considered as Brace damage.
3. Slightly increased the brace hitbox of [Modao Defense].

Iron Reapers
1. Changes to [Very Heavy Armor]: Gain immunity to Dazed while attacking. Grants an initial damage reduction to all types of damage of 48%. Each hit taken reduces the damage reduction by 2.5%, down to 18% after 12 hits.
2. Greatly increased the block break of flail attacks, so that they can break through the block of shield units in a single hit.
3. Flail attacks reduce the enemy's defenses by 10% until they retreat.

Monastic Knights
Changes to [Very Heavy Armor]: Gain immunity to Dazed while attacking. Grants an initial damage reduction to all types of damage of 48%. Each hit taken reduces the damage reduction by 2.5%, down to 18% after 12 hits.

Fortebraccio Pikemen
Reduced the speed at which they turn while moving or during Brace, making it more difficult for them to quickly turn and follow the enemy's movement.

notes.title: Sengoku: Blazing Katana Season Notice
notes.content:
We estimate that the new season's maintenance will last between 00:00 to 15:00 (UTC+8) on June 1.
The servers will be unavailable during the maintenance, and for that we are sorry.
This update will bring with it a ton of new content as well as changes to previous content. We will be performing updates and maintenance on our systems, and we estimate this will take around 15 hours. We will issue the following compensation following the update:
Bronze Coin x37,500, Honor x1,500, Unit Medal x60.

I. The [Daybreak Seal] purchase limit resets and the Daybreak Doctrine Selection Box is now for sale!
1. The Epic Leadership Doctrine can now be only be purchased 1 time.
2. New addition to Daybreak Doctrine Selection Boxes: the Ardent Knight doctrine.
How to get [Daybreak Doctrines]:
You get 1 [Daybreak Seal] for free by reaching rank 100 in the Season Pass and another one by completing the fifth stage of the season's 5-star unit challenge.

II. Updated customization with more appearances & a free Disguise Kit
Warlords at level 40 or above can speak to the [Warden], and by finishing the dialogue, you'll receive [Disguise Kit] x1 to immediately try out the new customization feature.
Runs from Jun 1 (after maintenance) through Sep 1 (until maintenance).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1613611c966e7db2d0aa3c91fe6ac677e9813797.gif

III. Attire Treasure Rotation
The [Jaden Attire Treasure] will be available and the hero attires [Octupusamurai] and [Samurai of Fury] return for a limited time!
Runs from Jun 1 (after maintenance) through Jun 15 (until maintenance).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1950ca9c693e5555118846a714d795a2d81841d1.png

IV. Conquest Attire Treasure Rotation | New Store Items
1. [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] sealed seasonal attires will be replaced by [Highlanders: Mountain Bagpipes] sealed seasonal attires in Conquest Attire Treasures.
2. Following the update, the following attires will be available in [Attire Exchange (G)]: Lord of Wrath Regalia (Sealed), Elite Warrior　(Sealed) and Iron Fist Uniform (Sealed).
3. The pike skin [Wyvern's Bite] and musket skin [Booming Roar] will now always be available in the exchange Store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0235c1a6b15b25859a76339e6017269810affc5f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1950ca9c693e5555118846a714d795a2d81841d1.png

V. Limited-Time Doctrine Pool Rotation | The Carnage Fields Available for a Limited Time
New Doctrine: Zealous Knight
Effect: When taking ranged damage, 100 points are converted into bleed damage lasting 3 seconds, during which damage and movement speed is increased by 15% (duration is not refreshed).
Applicable Units: Monastic Knights, Symmachean Stalwarts, Spear Sergeants, Symmachean Paladins, Men-at-Arms, Squires, Demesne Spearman
       The chance to excavate the Ardent Knight doctrine and epic doctrines for firearm infantry is increased in The Carnage Fields. The [Zealous Knight] doctrine will only be available from The Carnage Fields during this event, after which it will be available from The Carrion Bird's Banquet and The Field of Broken Lances.
Runs from Jun 1 (after maintenance) through Jun 15 (until maintenance).

VI. Preorder packs for the brand-new 4-star unit Onna-Musha hit the shelves!
Onna-Musha Basic Preorder Bundle
Basic Signaculum (used to complete the three first stages of this unit's quests)
Discount Price: 1,680 Sovereigns
 
Onna-Musha Deluxe Preorder Bundle
Deluxe Signaculum (used to complete all challenges required to unlock the unit)
Discount Price: 2,800 Sovereigns

Preorders are available between Jun 1 (after maintenance) through Jun 8 (until maintenance).

VII. Warfare Challenge Pack Rotation
The [Wrath of the Nomads] and [Soldiers of Fortune] Challenge Packs will be taken off the shelves under Store - Warfare Packs, and the [Blood of the Empire] and [Expedition] packs will become available.
Runs from Jun 1 (after maintenance) through Jun 15 (until maintenance).

notes.title: Sengoku: Blazing Katana Patch Notes
notes.content:
Unit Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ec0d5c5d85a16ced55726d4fedbbf4f70d8833a8.jpg

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3692433663122671675

Unit Mastery 

Overview

Unit mastery is a brand-new unit growth system available alongside what's already there. A unit's mastery gradually unlocks as you level it up, enabling you to increase its attributes and alter its skills or mechanics.
First Units to Receive Mastery:
Pike Militia
Prefecture Guards
Mace Sergeants
Palace Guards
Halberdier Sergeants

Mastery
Access
You'll be able to access [Mastery] while checking the details of [unit].
You can use the filter in the bottom right of the Barracks to quickly see which units mastery is available for.
Mastery unlocks at level 36.
Infantry Scroll of Mastery
Item required to unlock the mastery of infantry units. They come in uncommon and rare quality.
You'll be able to earn these from the all-new PvE mode [Latent Potential], buy them from the [Honor Shop] and from limited-time events.
Mastery Nodes
Leveling up a unit unlocks more mastery levels as well.
Mastery Level - Required Level (T2 Units) - Required Level (T3 Units) = Required Level (T4 Units)
1 - 10 - 10 - 12
2 - 11 - 11 - 14
3 - 11 - 11 - 14
4 - 12 - 12 - 16
5 - 14 - 14 - 18
6 - 14 - 14 - 18
7 - 16 - 16 - 20
8 - 18 - 18 - 24
Mastery units have 8 mastery nodes. The items required to unlock each mastery node depend on that unit's tier.
Mastery Level - Scroll of Mastery Quality - Required Quantity (T2 Units) - Required Quantity (T3 Units) - Required Quantity (T4 Units)
1 - Uncommon - 5 - 5 - 10
2 - Uncommon - 10 - 10 - 20
3 - Uncommon - 10 - 15 - 25
4 - Uncommon - 15 - 25 - 40
5 - Rare - 4 - 8 - 10
6 - Uncommon - 15 - 25 - 40
7 - Uncommon - 20 - 40 - 60
8 - Rare - 6 - 12 - 20

Latent Potential


Reward Chances
You get one reward chance for the [Latent Potential] each day, up to a maximum of 4. Winning a Latent Potential battle deducts a reward chance and nets rewards.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3709322795934656018

Honor Shop

Overview

•	You can purchase items for Honor in the Honor Shop.
•	The Honor Shop unlocks at level 100.
Mastery
•	Access
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bb266a18c1bb6a9eee215a7e3a10102d9627b454.png

￮	Navigate to the [Unit Tree (U)] to access the [Honor Shop].
•	Honor Shop Items
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5510f332fef9d266fbf33022e2be310c728cecec.png

￮	Purchase limits reset weekly.
Item Name - Weekly Quantity - Honor Cost
Uncommon Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 1 - 5-300
Uncommon Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 6 - 15-450
Rare Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 1 - 2,000
Rare Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 2 - 5-3,000
￮	Lifetime Limited-Buy Items
Item Name - Quantity - Honor Cost
Mace Sergeants Token - 1 - 10,000
Mace Sergeants: Protect - 1 - 5,000

Tutorial

We've updated the tutorial, meaning that players who join after the Sengoku season goes live get to experience different tutorials.
•	Veteran Players
￮	Nothing will change in terms of the tutorial for characters created before the Sengoku season. They'll still have access to the Hero's Path.
￮	They'll also be able to purchase the Mace Sergeants from the Honor Shop.
•	New Players (Sengoku Season)
￮	Characters created after the Sengoku season goes live will no longer have access to the Hero's Path.
￮	They'll instead be able to complete new main and side quests (including a new tutorial map and overall tutorial).
￮	They'll also be able to access the new Journey Manual, which includes Login Gift, Instructor Challenges and Instructor's Gift.
▪	By logging in each day, they'll be able to earn all Login Gift rewards.
▪	Completing the Instructor Challenges quests, you'll gain Instructor's Gift progress and earn rewards.
￮	New characters will no longer get to choose a unit but will unlock the Mace Sergeants by completing the new main quests. Both veteran and new players will in effect unlock the same number of units of an identical rarity throughout the old and new tutorials.
•	Unification Changes
￮	We're removing the Leveling & Growth Gift Assistance, Top-Ups and Auctioneer Login Pack with the Sengoku season.
￮	We're removing the Mercenary Envoy's quest granting a 4-star unit with the Sengoku season.
Conqueror's Path
Attire Cosmetics
•	Conqueror's Path Rank 0: Shadow Muraji
(Image 6 - Preorder BP0)
•	Conqueror's Path Rank 100: Crimson Stag Samurai
(Image 7 - Main KV)

Seasonal Store

•	Starting from the Sengoku season, attires from the Helheim season will be returning to the Seasonal Store, where they will be available at a 20% [Badges of Heroism] discount.
￮	Loptr's Hide (Sealed) will be available for 2,000.
￮	Bringer of Thunder (Sealed) will be available for 4,000. 
￮	Einherjar (Sealed) will be available for 2,000. 
•	The following items will have their Badge of Heroism cost reverted to their full price:
￮	 Knight Bachelor (Sealed) will now cost 2,500 instead of 2,000.    
￮	 Ordre de la Pucelle (Sealed) will now cost 5,000 instead of 4,000.  
￮	 Parissie Windrunner (Sealed) will now cost 2,500 instead of 2,000.

￮	Laird of the Isles (Sealed) - Hero Attire
￮	Zephyr's Bastion (Sealed) - Unit Attire
￮	Weapon skins from the Highlanders season return.

Campaign

Season Challenges

Ronin (Complete 6 out of 8 quests of each stage):
The challenge unlocks after the update on Jun 1, 2023.

notes.title: [Sengoku] Quality of Life Update Preview
notes.content:
With the June 1 update and the release of the new [Sengoku] season, we're improving what Honor is for, the tutorial and the character customization system. We've also made changes to improve the game's performance.

Honor Shop

We're adding a new Honor Shop, widening the use of Honor so that you've got more to spend all the Honor you gain on.

The Honor Shop unlocks at level 100. Inside, you'll be able to spend Honor on unit mastery items (has a weekly buy cap), a [Mace Sergeants] Token and doctrines exclusive to the unit (these have a total purchase cap).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bb266a18c1bb6a9eee215a7e3a10102d9627b454.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5510f332fef9d266fbf33022e2be310c728cecec.png

We'll continue to update the stock available at the Honor Shop in the future too!

Performance Improvements

A new season is on the horizon, but our effort to improve game performance won't end here. Following our changes, the standard test computers we used (configuration below), saw an average increase of 10 FPS.
Benchmark Configuration:
[code] Monitor: 1080P
CPU: Intel i7 7700K
GPU: GTX 1060 (6G)
RAM: 16G
DirectX 11 [/code]

The performance changes contain the following:

 New - Fullscreen Exclusive Mode

By playing on Fullscreen Exclusive (Settings - Graphics - Display Mode - Fullscreen Exclusive), you'll have an overall smoother experience.

 Improved - Unit Overhead Info Loading & Display Logic

By splitting up the information load of heroes and units (HP bar, name, defense values, etc.), we've reduced the amount of information that loads at any one time. What's more, by improving the information of visible objects rendered in real-team, we've further reduced the resources the game takes up.

 New - Option to Hide Dead Units

We've added an option to Hide Dead Units under Settings. The models of dead units will now be removed after a while to further reduce resource usage.

Improving performance is a long-term effort, and we'll continue to share with you all as we make further improvements.

You can find our previously published notice on performance improvements here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3683420125085983946

New - Team Colors

Following feedback we've received regarding teams' unit colors, we've added the following color options to [Settings] - [Unit Color]:
[My Units - Crimson], [Enemy Units - Chestnut] & [Enemy Units - Raven]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7be915bffbbe860c0f8304a00d7f6b15a4193487.png

Tutorial

Conqueror's Blade is a medieval action game that's difficult to master and caters toward a specific audience. It's been quite difficult for us to find a way in which to quickly help new players get accustomed. With the new season, players entering Conqueror's Blade for the first time will experience an all-new tutorial that'll hopefully enable them to learn the ropes quicker than ever.

We've made the following main changes to the tutorial:
All PvE stages are more focused on teaching the player about units, touching upon brace, damage types and back attacks.
We've also added a tutorial for each related action, making them an integral part of the stage itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/441715ce00bf58aff9150a21bb6303913870fdc1.png

We've also used tooltip boxes to touch upon other features, enabling newer players to come to terms with these faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0545474e003d7039bfeee9e49ab25424962632e9.png

We've also made a new unit for the tutorial, the [Mace Sergeants], and they have exclusive doctrines and Mastery available to them too. By guiding new players to focus on training this one unit, they'll better understand what makes up Conqueror's Blade's core.

Players who created a character before the start of the [Sengoku] season can purchase the Mace Sergeants Token and their doctrines from the [Honor Shop].

Character Customization

Our old character customization options have gone mostly unchanged since our launch. And so, we felt it was time to add some new options with this season. We've improved the detail for character faces, hair and added new face presets.

Characters created before the new season can speak to the Warden to receive a [Disguise Kit x1]. Naturally, none of our old customization options are going away, so you're free to use these if you prefer those.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/86f63ba3da60ed0839bcbd23c761ca5fd2dd024a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cba99484f49e99d1eb818f0e2a2affac33e5c9a5.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/933e07790413dcc426e0733744d231ce5f44e1f7.jpg

(These are only part of the new options and may be subject to change)

Keep an eye out for our Season Update Log and future notices for more info! See you in the [Sengoku] season!

notes.title: New Mode Preview: Latent Potential
notes.content:
Heya all your Warlords out there! Today we're bringing you more info on a new upcoming PvE mode that's coming in the update: Latent Potential.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/28c1081133b01aa0be5077003d369e2b73ba7b88.png

The Latent Potential mode goes hand-in-hand with Unit Mastery. By completing the [Latent Potential] daily, you'll get the following items required to unlock mastery for units:

 •[Uncommon Infantry Scroll of Mastery] 
 •[Rare Infantry Scroll of Mastery]


Latent Potential Rules

General Rules

You'll be taking with you your own units and equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7e692c4d28afb9cc31deebadaa4448fff3d858c5.png

You earn extra units by killing enough enemy soldiers. As you kill more, you'll get access to units of a higher and higher tier.

You'll have an ally that will continuously dispatch soldiers to attack the enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/96261da9296d839419f1b9ddbb3647894db15cdb.png

You cannot use either ranged units or cavalry in this mode.

Phase Rules & Victory

Once the battle has begun, you must work with your ally to break into and occupy the enemy's supply point. Phase one ends when you occupy the supply point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/841c29150bf9262b3e0e722da4be78b3e6bd9182.png

If your soldiers get wounded, head to a supply point to heal them up or replace them with another unit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4aade0ea20f381484f7764d5c9ea83a3f61c1ca9.png

During phase two, you must work to assault the enemy's stronghold and take down the enemy's officer if you're to win.
One way to achieve victory is to use high-burst units and simply focus down the enemy leader.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4a29c7f879bea755d5c01a90bbd830995673541b.png

Defeat

The enemy will dispatch soldiers against us too, and you must prevent our ally's leader from falling. You'll suffer defeat should he fall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b98ba3b038a63483dd9a0ec015c6035ef0d77e6b.png

Keep an eye on the timer too, as you'll suffer defeat if you fail to eliminate the enemy's leader within the allotted time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4bb2b7498827ef30a011bd564f6cf8ca92705ba1.png

While the [Latent Potential] map will be important to help you unlock and level up your units' mastery, it will also be a great place in which to test out new units and strategies!

notes.title: [Sengoku: Blazing Katana] Units Preview
notes.content:
The [Sengoku: Blazing Katana] season launches on June 1st! Six new units will join the ranks with the new season! So, let's get to know these a bit more!
We've created 3 units to fit the theme of the [Sengoku] season. But that's not all, we've created another 3 units to fit the modes too! You'll be able to unlock them all in the new season!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ec0d5c5d85a16ced55726d4fedbbf4f70d8833a8.jpg

Season Units

We've taken inspiration from Japan's Sengoku period, and some of these have joined the ranks of Conqueror's Blade. All you've got to do to unlock these is to complete their season challenges.
Right, so let's delve deeper into their stories and features!

Ronin (3 Stars)

[previewyoutube=v6brtNJQ0QY;full][/previewyoutube]

During the Sengoku period in Japan, heroes arose among lords, with each lord housing an army of their own. During the battles, countless smaller forces were defeated.
Some of the surviving samurai decided to not pledge their allegiance to a new lord, instead choosing to become wandering warriors. Their life was their own, and they lived to hone their skills and help the weak. Yet, ceaseless war stripped them of all dignity, and they began pillaging and committing crimes. This continued until a man clad in crimson armor appeared—
Ever since, whenever bandits bullied the weak, a group of warriors dressed in simple garbs would appear. They were masters of martial arts, and of the blade, and struck with sudden and lethal attacks. They called themselves the Ronin and wander the land without a place to call home. Legend claims they also participate in more than a few wars.
Unit Characteristics
•Skill 1: Charges toward the designated location and leap attacks the first enemy they encounter.
•Skill 2: Strikes immediately after sheathing their blades, dealing high damage. Killing units with this skill reduces cooldowns.
•Blocks while attacking during free attack mode. Successful blocks boost the damage of the subsequent attack, stacking up to 6 times.
•Excels at charging into enemy formations that don't have any shield units, only to use several Iaido Strikes for tons of damage.

Onna-Musha (4 Stars)

Wielding long-handled arced blades, they excel at fighting smaller skirmishes and cavalry. Their special-made weapons are light and highly nimble and can be wielded by most any woman after a bit of training.
The Onna-Musha are more often than not relatives of samurai or nobles. They've undergone rigorous training from a young age and are deadly indeed. Being directly commanded by the daimyo, any who underestimated them would do so at the cost of their life.
Unit Characteristics
•Skill 1. Charges toward a designated location, attacking enemies and reducing their block.
•Skill 2: Sakura Onslaught triggers 6 attacks against nearby enemies.
•Charge and Sakura Onslaught disarms enemies for 0.8 seconds, rendering them unable to attack.
•All attacks deal piercing damage and brace. Deals 26% increased damage to cavalry. Damaging a cavalry unit also slows them by 60% for 2 seconds.
•Excels at charging into enemy formations that don't have any shield unit to take out light infantry and control heavy infantry. Fairs poorly against shielded units, so it's vital that you choose their battles well.

Orochi Samurai (5 Stars)

The Orochi Samurai were one of the Sanada clan's most elite warriors, each one personally selected and trained by the commander.
They excel in martial arts and can launch quick and deadly combination attacks. Few foes can face their onslaught and live to tell the tale.
While their telltale crimson armor provides effective defense, it also instills terror into their enemies. Well-trained and brave, they do not cover before charging cavalry, instead they lash out with deadly force.
Whenever their crimson banner was seen in battle, their enemies would flee in terror. For the few who had fought them and survived simply called them the Red Demons.
Unit Characteristics
•Skill 1: Double Strike at targets in the target direction (and grants control immunity). Deals high damage to cavalry.
•Skill 2: Sweep attacks all enemies in a large area.
•Automatically triggers brace while in formation.
•All attacks inflict disarm, rendering the enemy unable to attack for 0.8 seconds.
•Blocks while attacking during free attack mode. Successful blocks boost the damage of the subsequent attack, stacking up to 6 times.
•Deals 26% increased damage to cavalry. Damaging a cavalry unit also slows them by 60% for 2 seconds.
•Assault grants temporary crowd-control immunity, and is great for initiating battles and disarming the enemy. Then they rely on skill 2 and their passive to continue fighting.
•When used well, Assault counters many non-shield units, especially cavalry.

Non-Season Units 

Naginata Monks (3 Stars)

Preordering the [Ronin] also unlocks the [Naginata Monks]. The Naginata Monks will also be available as mercenaries and can be unlocked for Sovereigns or Silver Coins.
Following years of war and chaos, many of the temples formed forces of their own to protect their faith. The most famous of these are the Naginata Monks.
Trained by both monks and samurai, their willpower and physique far exceed that of ordinary people. This intense training made them capable of wielding heavier weapons than others, weapons with which they could cut down horses and warriors alike. Armed also with their faith, they were known to never surrender.
Unit Characteristics
•Skill 1. Charges toward a designated location, attacking enemies and reducing their block.
•Skill 2: Running Strikes deal damage while running and their attacks have brace effect.
•All attacks deal piercing damage and brace effect. Deals 26% increased damage to cavalry. Damaging a cavalry unit also slows them by 60% for 2 seconds.
•Running Strikes deal continuous damage to enemies.

Mace Sergeants (3 Stars)

How to Unlock
This unit will be part of the tutorial, and new players unlock the [Mace Sergeants] by completing the initial quests. Players who have already completed the tutorial can unlock it for Honor.
The Mace Sergeants were a powerful order of knights during the middle ages. They were generally tasked with guarding the pope and the Church's interests, as well as defending against heretics and any would-be-invaders. Yet, with time, their influence grew and they soon gained both power and political influence.
Each member of the Mace Sergeants possesses outstanding fighting skills and a sense of honor. Wielding massive mauls, they draw close to enemies and crush bone and armor alike. But they have not forgotten their roots, and adhere to the code of chivalry to this day.
Unit Characteristics
•Skill 1: Rushes at the enemy and strikes with massive force.
•Skill 2: Meteor Strike excels at dealing with shield units.
•They deal high blunt damage and excel at taking out enemies with low-blunt defense.
•Use their skills at the most opportune moment to deal devastating damage to shield units.

Matchlock Ashigsaru (4 Stars)

How to Unlock
The Matchlock Ashigsaru can be unlocked for free via a community event. If you want these to join your ranks, follow us on social media, Join the community, and keep up to date with the latest info!

Matchlock Ashigsaru are a general category of firearms made on the island of Hinawaju. Manufacturing techniques and tactics developed rapidly during Japan's Warring States period. In the Battle of Nagashino, the great Oda Nobunaga used the Saika Ikki groups to organize squads of iron cannoneers.
   The Matchlock Ashigsaru are experienced soldiers from the Hinawaju Ashigaru ranks. They are not samurai, but their performance on the battlefield puts them among the elites. Their deeds are celebrated in classical military texts. In the Battle of Nagashino, Yamagata Masakage, veteran general of the Takeda family died under a fusillade from Hinawaju iron cannons.
Unit Characteristics
•Skill 1: Fires volley after volley in a designated direction.
•Deals the most damage when working together with allies to set up conditions where they can fire at will.

Note that the aforementioned information may be subject to change and what is described herein may differ from the final version. Follow us on social media to get the latest info! And lastly, we hope we'll see you in the [Sengoku] season!

notes.title: Development Journal: Unit Mastery
notes.content:
Before you read: the content only journals the thoughts during the developing stage. Please refer to the live version for specific details. 

Hey everyone!

Now we have over 100 units in the game. It brings more strategies in the game, but also makes some units not on-trend those days. A possible reason for this is that the skills of those are no longer unique and we can make better plans without those. Also, the iterating patches make those just behind the meta.

We've rolled out plenty of balance changes in the past year, and this has brought the underused Halberdier Sergeants and Dagger-Axe Lancers into an overall more comfortable place. Naturally, this is but a drop in the ocean as there are still plenty of underused units that gather dust.

We've therefore been looking for a new way to resolve this. Hopefully, this new way will help resolve this issue and give you all something new to work toward as well.

Unit Mastery

We'll be releasing our latest Unit Mastery system in a June update.
Now, let's delve deeper into what mastery brings, how to unlock it and how it becomes available.
What is Mastery?

Unit mastery is a brand-new unit growth system available alongside what's already there. A unit's mastery gradually unlocks as you level it up, enabling you to increase its attributes and alter its skills or mechanics. This system will bring new possibilities for all units, and who knows, Silver Era units with high mastery might even be able to stand their own against units of the Heroic Era.

Unlocking Mastery
First, if you select a unit you've unlocked for which mastery is available, you'll be met with a menu like this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/886040316d6b34395b5b6d6f77d2312b04275b1c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c8610ccc273da80a1a2189d8c6c8f0073dfcb211.jpg
(WIP)

A unit's mastery unlocks in stages based on its level. The items you need to unlock mastery can be found daily in specific PVE content and the Honor Shop (we'll describe this feature in greater detail at a later time). There are daily and monthly caps in place for each of the two acquisition methods. By completing the specific PVE content daily, you'll be able to unlock mastery for 1-3 units a month based on the level of that unit. Choose to train your favorite units further, and empower them so that currently underperforming units can stand their own in battle.

How Mastery Becomes Available

Initially, mastery will be available for tiers 2-4 units, and we'll be adding mastery for around 5 units each month. We'll most likely spread mastery evenly among the three unit tiers. We'll be announcing which units will be the first to get mastery in a few days!

 What's more, to reduce the attribute difference between older units and newer and seasonal units, we'll be raising the level cap of tier 2 and 3 units in the Unit Tree and Season Challenges to level 18, and that of tier 4 units to level 24. 

Promotions

With promotions we enabled some units to be promoted into new units. However, based on feedback from the Legacy of Fire and Snowstorm seasons, as well as our own observations, the promotion system is difficult to understand and just doesn't feel very great overall. And so, we'll discontinue adding new promotions.

We've kept an eye on promotions throughout the seasons, and have come to the conclusion that they don't fit Conqueror's Blade. We'll therefore be removing promotions with the June update, and simultaneously changing how promoted units are acquired.
Units affected by this:
￮Symmachean Stalwarts
￮Symmachean Paladins
￮Alp Halberdiers
￮Armiger Lancers
￮Liao's Rangers

We'll be making the following changes to the affected units:
￮You will now be able to create these units directly without relying on the base unit.
￮As for their season challenges, the first Unlock Order reward to create the base unit remains unchanged. Later rewards to promote said unit will however be replaced with rewards that enable you to unlock the other unit too. So, by completing the quests you won't have to promote the unit but get it directly.
￮Promoted units and their original version can be used together.

Note: With the removal of unit promotions, these units must now be created individually and will therefore not gain any of the original unit's levels. If you're planning on promoting a max-level base unit to get a high-level promoted unit, we advise you to do that before the update launches.

We'll continue to explore further possibilities for units. If you have any feedback whatsoever regarding units or mastery, feel free to get in contact or post in our communities. 

Thank you all for your continued support of Conqueror's Blade!

notes.title: 'Eternal' Season Server Transfer Info
notes.content:
'Eternal' season is about to end and a new season begins. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

Server Transfer Time:

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on May 11th, after maintenance, and run through May 24th, 23:59 (UTC+8), 2023.
2. Character transfers will be performed during the new season's maintenance.

Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
2. Players may transfer without restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Quotas

Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.

Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

How to Transfer

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred following the new season's maintenance.

Important:

1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before May 24th, 23:59 (UTC+8). Upon canceling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon canceling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.

3.You must leave your house (Imperial Restorationists or Free House) when requesting a server transfer. You may not join a new house while your server transfer is pending.

4. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.

5. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.

6. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, Wagon, and Resource Piles will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
3) Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.

7. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

8. Extra Info:
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.

notes.content:
This season’s Content Creator Program starts now! Valiant warlords, [Conqueror’s Blade] sincerely invites you to join this time’s Content Creator Program to win handsome rewards!

Signup Time: April 19, 2023 - April 29, 2023 (UTC+8)

星乃るる【私はマル吉！】

VVVV【First Look at the new season units (Testing) (Conqueror's Blade)】

ABOUT THE PROGRAM

What is Conqueror's Blade's content creator program? (CBCCP)

CBCCP is available each season to content creators wishing to cooperate with us. CBCCP is aimed at all who love Conqueror's Blade and for us to support those who create related content, and naturally, express our undying gratitude.

Whether you're a live streamer, a video creator, a strategy-guide writer, a painter or a musician, we cordially invite you to join us and help further Conqueror's Blade's community.

CBCCP SUPPORT

We'll be providing holistic support to help our content creators create more and better content.

EXTRA BONUSES

Our content creators will be able to stream or play the latest content before it hits the live servers, such as season previews, PTR testing, and more.

FREE PROMOTION

We believe that high-quality content should reach as big of an audience as possible. Once we've verified that your content upholds that standard, we will help you promote it for free and might even share it in-game, on Steam, our website, social media or Discord.

VIP CHANNELS

We believe that content creators are more likely to encounter a variety of issues than your average player, and therefore need better channels of communication with the devs.

TWITCH DROPS SUPPORT

We'll enable Twitch Drops events for your Twitch channel. At certain times, we'll enable rewards for those who watch your live stream to give back to the audience.

SIGN-UP REQUIREMENTS

We want as many of you as possible to be part of CBCCP, but to keep the quality as high as possible, you must meet the following requirements:
- You must be at least 16 years old.
- You must have over 200 followers.

CONTENT CREATOR REQUIREMENTS

Video Creators
•Create at least 10 original videos related to Conqueror's Blade each season
•Have 200+ followers on the platform
•Have above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video

Streamers
•Stream at least 45 hours per season
•Have 200+ followers on the platform
•Have above 30 viewers on each Conqueror's Blade stream

If you feel that you are unable to meet the above requirements, you still have a chance to become part of the program!
- Create content for Conqueror's Blade at least once per week (strategy guide, painting, music, novel, etc.).
- Conqueror's Blade must make up at least 20% of your creative content.

* Content creators bring us closer to our players, therefore it is important that you actively engage in publicity events that we hold (we'll issue notifications regarding these).

Code of Conduct

As a content creator of Conqueror's Blade, the content you produce will be seen and reposted by many of our players. As such, we need you to adhere to the following conduct so as to help maintain a friendly community:

- Follow the rules and regulations of your platform.
- Your contents must be original creations. We hold zero tolerance toward plagiarism and all sources must be elicited.
- Your content may not contain nudity or overly exposed skin.
- Your content may not involve religious beliefs, discriminate against a region or nation, and may not be discriminatory against others based on these.
- You may not abuse your influence to vilify others or otherwise incite conflicts.
- You may not use third-party software or use game loopholes to gain an edge. In essence, you must adhere to our rules and regulations.
- You may not divulge game content or related information before it is released without our explicit consent.
•Be frank with us and do not falsify any data.

VIOLATIONS

We will deal with those who violate the Code of Conduct in the following ways:
- Issue a warning via email. 
- Revoke your identity as a Conqueror's Blade content creator.
- Revoke your identity as a Conqueror's Blade content creator and withhold any rewards.

INCENTIVE

Meet the related requirements for your type of content.
2800 Sovereigns
30-Day Premium Account

Advanced Rewards
Meet the requirements of the Basic Rewards, and have at least 3 of your works be published by us on our website, Steam or social media (Be sure to @ us so that we can find your creations!).
5000 Sovereigns
30-Day Premium Account

Supreme Rewards
At the end of a program cycle, all content creators may submit the 1 or 2 works you are the most pleased with/have the best stats. We will then be selecting 5 content creators among these who'll also receive the Supreme Rewards.
$200 Amazon Gift Card
Limited-time Epic Avatar (Issued after each season and remains valid for 3 months)

Rewards for Top Videos
Platforms: YouTube, Twitch, TikTok
Get 10,000 or more plays on a single video and earn part of the $1,000 Top Video reward pool!
Get 100,000 or more plays on a single video and earn part of the bonus $1,000 Top Video reward pool!
*Rewards will primarily be issued as JD Gift Cards or Amazon Gift Cards based on each individual situation. We reserve the final right to decide how the rewards are redeemed.
