notes.title: Development Journal | New Siege Ruleset
notes.content:
Strategy Reins Supreme

Heya, Warlords! [Escalation (Siege)] where you can change your units on the fly has been available for a while now. As expected, we've received plenty of feedback, and we'll continue to delve deeper into our siege battle rulesets to explore further possibilities.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653017658296154941
Our goal is to retain the unique features of Siege Battle while also bringing more possibilities and fun. We wish to make unit selection an integral part of the strategic gameplay for an altogether more enjoyable experience.

Current Siege Battle & [Escalation (Siege)]

[Escalation (Siege)] builds upon the original Siege Battle ruleset with the ability to freely change your units so that you're no longer bound to what you choose initially. This enables players to change their strategy throughout the game and has made strategy even more important.

High Unit Deaths

Yet, leadership still remains a resource that is expended fairly quickly. With a restricted amount of leadership, the number of units you can take into battle is naturally also restricted while unit deaths keep ramping up. That's especially true for high-tier units. Oftentimes half of them are gone when the unit dies.

Exploring New Possibilities

Our goal is to lower the impact that unit deaths have on the overall outcome. By changing leadership from a consumable resource into a more dynamic one you can gain and spend throughout the course of a battle, we hope to deepen strategizing further and enable more possibilities. While keeping an eye on every battle, one must also focus on the selection and usage of each troop and the acquisition and spending of leadership.

So, based on the [Escalation (Siege)] ruleset, we're trying out a new Siege Battle mode: [Warfront (Siege)].

A Single Starter Unit

Identical to [Escalation (Siege)], you expend leadership to select a single unit during the preparation stage for [Warfront (Siege)]. We've also created a new feature, 'Main Units', to help you find your most-used units all that much faster. Simply set your most-used units as a 'Main Unit' and they'll be shown easily in the menu.

Leadership Refunds

Units that retreat or die will refund a certain amount of leadership.
Drafting units is no longer a one-time action. If a unit you're using is unsuitable for the situation at hand, you can command them to retreat, thereby refunding some leadership, and call upon another unit instead. Unit deaths now also accrue much lower losses and won't expend all the leadership used on them, instead, you'll be refunded a ratio of the leadership used. This means that you'll be able to call upon the aid of more units throughout a single battle for fiercer fights and more attempts at outmaneuvering your opponents.
Each unit has a set refund value. Units that are more likely to take damage or with generally less K/D will have a higher refund value.

Calling New Units

 You can use leadership to call on the aid of fresh units when you're required to after death or by visiting a supply point. With increased leadership, you can call on the units you need to fit the battle at hand.

[Warfront (Siege)] Availability

Will be available every day at set times following the Apr 13 update. Rewards, quest completion and challenge progress is shared with [Siege Battle].
You'll be able to access it from [Matching] -> [Events] -> [Warfront (Siege)]. You can check when it's available from the in-game event calendar. We'll be changing its availability in the future.

[Warfront (Siege)] Maps

The following maps will be available initially: Harbour City, Kurak Castle (Dune), Sun City, White Elk Fort, Heilung Fjord and Continopolis

The [Warfront (Siege)] mode is simply another try toward greater heights. We'll continue to improve and innovate the Siege Battle ruleset and hopefully changes like this one that fundamentally alter how such battles are played will lead to more fun for everyone.

notes.title: Mar 23 Balance Change Preview
notes.content:
Imperial Spear Guards
Being the unit with the largest shields in the game, they're tasked with the momentous task of defending both allied units and heroes. However, their [Cover Commander] skill doesn't grant enough protection in the current meta.
We're increasing their attack damage during [Cover Commander] by 30% and heroes within the effective range will take 24% reduced damage from enemy units.

Sword & Shield Infantry
Based on community feedback and statistics, we've seen that sword & shield infantry are currently underpowered, especially when pitted against polearm units with brace. We'll be making changes to how the three following units fare against the [Brace] and [Stand Firm] skills this time around to make them more viable.

Men-at-Arms
[Shield Rush] is now better at blocking [Brace] and [Stand Firm] attacks and now deals 38% more damage against units in [Brace] and [Stand Firm].
Improved the AI's pathing logic of [Cover Commander] so that they attack enemies near the hero and avoid narrow terrain.

Palace Guards
[Shield Rush] is now better at blocking [Brace] and [Stand Firm] attacks and now deals 33% more damage against units in [Brace] and [Stand Firm].

Banner Guards
[Charge] is now better at blocking [Brace] and [Stand Firm] attacks and now deals 21% more damage against units in [Brace] and [Stand Firm].

notes.title: Development Journal: Performance & Frame Rates
notes.content:
Our goal with Conqueror's Blade is to create a world in which you can fulfill your dreams of conquering the lands as a warlord. To this end, we've created vast areas, walls that zigzag the land and battles where thousands of soldiers charge, clash, fire arrows and let lose artillery fire...

The Difficulty of Massive Battles

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a962b41ebe09c82c7324f364f22fa57b8ffb7e74.jpg

Looking at it from the backend of things, huge maps, plentiful characters, items and special effects require an astonishing amount of calculations. Throughout the three years since we launched, we've continued to implement new content, units, bigger maps, as well as a series of graphical improvements. All of these put a strain on both software and hardware alike.

The interfaces for units, heroes and maps are all connected to highly complex systems. All of this working at once during the heat of battle puts a heavy strain on the CPU. To improve FPS, we've done plenty of work to enable as many algorithms as possible to process in parallel and get as much as possible out of multi-core CPUs. This combined has led to the game utilizing much of the CPU and straining the GPU's rendering capabilities. Add to that the sheer amount of high-quality textures that need to be processed, meaning that most players have little GPU memory to spare. On the other hand, as game interface, combat, scene effects and others are improved, GPUs face higher demands during rendering. Games that use a large number of high resolution textures also increase the demand for video memory. These factors lead to games requiring more GPU computing resources and video memory during operation. Therefore, in future game development, we will pay more attention to optimizing the GPU to ensure smooth gameplay experiences. 
Furthermore, huge scenes and massive numbers of characters add significant pressure on memory usage. Often times we have to increase our memory consumption in favor of processing performance. However, we admit there are many shortcomings in our current management strategy for algorithm optimization with this being one of our key targets.

As we continue to create and add new content, we also receive more feedback regarding frame drops, lag and performance issues. We know full well how important performance is. Even so, in the end we must try to find the sweet spot where performance and graphics meet.
Further on, we'll go into more detail on what we've done to improve performance and share with us our plans for the future.

What We've Done in the [Eternal] Season

Every action of every unit, be that moving, attacking or using skills, occupy system resources based on the quality of its special effects. When special effects are displayed, how much it strains the systems depends on how many particles it includes.Therefore, the number of particles is the most intuitive way to measure the performance impact of special effects. We will reduce the original overly high number of special effect particles to a reasonable range without compromising the overall game experience, thereby improving game performance.

Units & Combat
For example, many players are experiencing frame drops when the Zykalian Militia throw their kerosene canisters. That's a result of their skill's special effect using too many particles.
To improve performance across the board while still ensuring good visual effects, we have with the [Eternal] season reduced the number of particles of many skills' effects, including kerosene canister. This has directly improved performance. The following are before and after particle counts for some skills.

 Silahdars' Sideways Sweep - now 410 particles (was 1,200)
 Silahdars' Deathstrike - now 890 particles (was 1,120)
 Grayhair Garrison's Last Stand - now 420 particles (was 1,120)
 Shenji Grenadiers' Throw Grenades - now 210 particles (was 580)
 Zykalian Militia - now 118 particles (was 310)
 Grapeshot Cannon (Rare) - now 2,700 particles (was 6,400)
 Berserkers' Berserk state - now 370 particles (was 1,050)
 Special effect of units affected by the Glaive's God of Battles - now 240 (was 410)

Weather & Objects
The vast number of objects on each map adds to immersion and affects strategic choices too. Every wall, obstacle and vegetation breathes life into the map. Naturally, plentiful objects and large concentrations of units are demanding, which has resulted in low frame rates during many battles.
To remedy this, we've made improvements to the management of dynamic object performance for areas that are often home to large battles, greatly reducing rendering delay. This will lead to much more stable FPS in these circumstances.

Future Performance Optimizations

We've already made performance improvements to many areas of the game which has led to a slight overall increase in FPS. Naturally, certain problematic areas still exist and many of these exist at key points, something that affects the gameplay experience adversely.
We are currently performing large tests in an effort to do more targeted optimizations, and we're planning on doing the following:

Optimize the underlying interface algorithms to avoid complex ones reducing performance and worsening memory usage. Some of these include the mini-map, skill bars and unit info.
Rendering fidelity affects how things appear in game, and in most cases, the rendering of different layers does not have to be on the same fidelity level. For example, while battling on the walls of A at Wall Fort, you don't need to have the perfect view of the base flag as that would lower performance. The current rendering fidelity does not cover all situations, however, so we will be adding more rendering layers based on distance to objects on the map. For example, we can give objects 100m away a rendering fidelity of 1, objects 50m away a fidelity of 2, objects 10m away a fidelity of 3 and objects 5m away a fidelity of 4. This will reduce rendering calculations and therefore GPU usage.
Re-create the code of cloth and physics simulations to optimize the performance of many smaller modules such as hair, spear tassels, robe hems, capes, etc.
Continue to reduce the number of special effect particles to better balance graphics and performance.
Create a better distribution of texture quality to find a balance between that and performance to further reduce memory usage.
Improve graphics settings by adding more options and configurations, while also better recognizing hardware to improve the default settings.

Each one of the aforementioned improvements is complex and will take a long time to complete. As we continue to add more content, we also add more unknown variables to the equation. Even so, we're happy to share and discuss these issues with you all. We've been battling these issues in silence for a long time and we want to show our answer with actions and concrete results. We know that battling performance issues will take time, but even so, we will continue to improve one issue at a time. We're in this for the long haul.
We also want to invite you all to work with us! We're thinking of testing the results of our optimizations via open, alpha and beta tests. We'll reveal more about how these will work in future notices! Oh, and we'll be adding info on how things are going with our performance optimizations to future update logs too!

notes.title: [Eternal] Launch Q&A
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're the Conqueror's Blade dev team.
It's with great pleasure that we just recently released our new China-themed season, [Eternal]. It's the culmination of months of work, and the team was working on polishing it up to the very launch itself, all to give you the best experience as soon as possible. We're also incredibly thankful to all the players who reached out to us to share feedback ASAP after seeing the new content and those joining the tests we ran. Your feedback is incredibly important to us!

The season's been available for about a week now, and we've seen in our communities that you all have plenty of questions. We'll be answering some of these during today's Q&A, oh, and please do share any feedback and recommendation you have!

[hr][/hr]
Q: There are just too few donatable items as it stands and farming siege battles for a week isn't enough for me to max out on fame. Can you add more ways in which to earn fame?

A: ]As one of the most important resource acquisitions for each season, we want you to receive gains from it throughout each season. It's an integral part of the seasonal experience. We've seen for ourselves that earning fame has been somewhat too difficult. Rest assured, we're adding [basic resources, exotics and regional exotics] to the list of donatable resources with the March 2nd update. So, you'll now be able to gather resources on the World Map and trade these in for fame too.
Plus, some of the item rewards aren't all that helpful for daily gameplay, so we'll be replacing random attire rewards with other rewards this season. We'll keep an eye on how these changes pan out and follow feedback to see if we need to make further changes.

Q: How many Artificer's Stones can I expect to earn throughout a season, and how many reforges will that give me?

A: Disregarding any Artificer's Stones from limited-time events, you'll be able to earn 25 per week simply from weekly quests and the Fame Envoy. That amounts to 500 stones a season. If you've got all the other materials, you'll be able to reforge 35+ rare equipment per season.

Q: Will my equipment's endurance reach max if I can't reforge it?

A: We've raised the endurance cap of reforged equipment. Taking a pair of legendary Carnifex's Gloves as an example, we've raised the endurance cap from 115 to 330, plus we've reduced the rate of wear and tear. Reforging will reduce this rate to 28% of what it was before.
Furthermore, if you bring a piece of new equipment into about 5 siege battles per day, it'll still have some endurance left by the end of the season. For most players, endurance won't be a very pressing issue. On the other hand, you can earn Artificer's Stones throughout the season to refresh the endurance cap of equipment.

Q: How do I earn this season's weapon skins?

A: The season's weapon skins will be available from the [Champion Trove] as per usual. Oh, and we've made some improvements to it too! We're changing the mode into Escalation (Siege) with a fair ruleset. By fair we mean a mode where everyone has access to the same units regardless of what they've unlocked. Each Warlord will have 900 leadership, each attacker can deploy 2 rare artillery, and each defender can deploy 1 rare artillery. You may match for this mode with a party of up to 3. Hopefully, the gameplay will be as rewarding as the rewards themselves!

Q: We've had an influx of new players joining our house. Is unit sharing coming, and if so, when?

A: Yes, unit sharing is coming. We estimate that unit sharing will be available again following the April 6 update. The reason for this is that we've added new modes and features to the game, including [Escalation (Siege)], and we need to make revisions to unit sharing so that it fits these too. During this time we'll also work on improving it further!

I hope that these answers will shed light on some of the questions you've had for the new Eternal season. And, once again, please share as much feedback as you can with us! It truly is a tremendous help!

notes.title: Eternal Unit Spotlight: Yanyuedao Cavalry (5-Star)
notes.content:
Three Seasonal Units inspired by legendary Ancient Chinese heroes are coming to Conqueror’s Blade: Eternal when the update arrives on February 23. 

The third and final Unit is ready to be introduced: Yanyuedao Cavalry (5-Star).

"A colossus rises tall, casting a shadow over the valley beyond."
This is a Qian proverb meaning that men capable of great acts of war cast shadows so tall that all others are overshadowed. The Yanyuedao Cavalry, a force comprising only the elite of the elite, became one such colossus.

Wearing only the bare minimum of armor, these riders did all they could to ride as swiftly as the wind as they stormed through battle with their mighty glaives. Instead of a standard Cavalry charge, this Unit prefers to ‘charge up’ its slashing attacks, building momentum on horseback. Glaives deliver built-up strikes, delivering damage and armour penetration over a large area, dependent on how much charge was produced.

The bards of Qian would come to create songs and ballads in their honor for years and years to come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/29a74f74956b7b49e630a4471c704cd39c92b215.png

Unit Characteristics

- A close-quarters focused cavalry unit without any charge skill.
- Causes a single instance of high area damage.
- Deals greater damage over an area the longer they charge up their attack.
- Do not charge and are therefore not stopped by musket fire or braces, enabling them to pass through the enemy's defenses to clear out musketeers.

- Skill [Mounting Dread]: Begins gathering momentum and damage.
- Skill [Dread Unleashed]: Attacks over a wide area.
- Skill [Rushing Blow]: Holds their glaives horizontally as they ride past the enemy's lines, slashing about as they do.


Stirrup some trouble and draft the Yanyuedao Cavalry by completing new Unit Challenges in Conqueror’s Blade: Eternal when they arrive later in the Season on March 27.

notes.title: Development Journal: Equipment Reforging
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c92a42bb4597677d8ecb28aeb25a50759fbb034a.png

Armorer: "Bah, why's everyone asking that old bugger to make equipment? My shop's as silent as the grave..."
Time passed and the blacksmith returned from the east, having learned an ancient art of reworking equipment. Rumor has spread among the tea houses of Haojing that the blacksmith came upon a legendary town where he mastered a long-lost art of smelting. They say that he has already surpassed his master in skill.

In the Eternal season, reconditioning will be upgraded into reforging, enabling you to create more powerful gear!

The Quest for Leadership

For the longest time, Leadership has been the ONE attribute everyone's been trying to stack on their armor pieces. I'm sure most of you would've picked a piece with leadership over a high-armor piece any day of the week. While enabling you to bring more units into battle to counter any foe you may come up against, it makes it more difficult to also gain increased survival attributes like health and defense. This makes it difficult to raise your survivability with equipment, plus, this quest for only leadership greatly detracts from the enjoyment of forging itself.

To remedy this, we're launching the Artificer's Forge with the next season, a system where you can "Get it All", so to say. This new system will give a boost to all attributes and is a chance to improve the gameplay experience.

Artificer's Forge System

Reforging will enable you to upgrade the equipment you forge. With reforging, your equipment will retain its set effects while giving you more chances to upgrade its attributes, or even gain completely new affixes. Naturally, reforging will reset a piece of equipment's endurance.

Locking Key Attributes

Some of you may wonder: "But won't that just destroy the Leadership equipment I've worked so hard to gather?"
To prevent this, we've added the ability to lock attributes. You can choose to lock certain attributes during reforging, preventing these to be altered in the process. You'll also get to choose after a reforge whether to keep your previous unlocked attributes or change to the new ones. This enables you to try for better and higher attributes without having to worry about losing what you've worked so hard to get.

For example: If you have a piece of equipment with +25 leadership, you can lock it and reforge and still retain that +25 leadership.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/beef0a6121c05e8df42b43905a18cad620268066.png
  (This image is just a preview and might be subject to change)
                     
Effort is Always Rewarded

There are always those who get nothing but rare and epic weapons even after forging 10 times: "Hey, why aren't I getting any legendaries?"
We've reworked the reforging algorithm to remedy this very issue. If a reforging results in a rare or epic quality product, the chance for your next reforging to become legendary increases. This chance continues to increase until you create a legendary quality product.
Besides, the results of each reforging will be shown right there in the menu. This gives you a clear view of the chance for each possible outcome right from the get-go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8931905479405a2ec92412d255e886818c716036.png
(This image is just a preview and might be subject to change)

Reforging Materials

Reforging will require [Artificer's Stones], which you can acquire from matchmaking battles, Territory War, events, raising your Conqueror's Path rank and by donating resources to the Fame Envoy.
We're not scrapping previously used hero materials either. We've added drops of these to the aforementioned content, giving you the means to further upgrade your equipment no matter what you enjoy doing in the game.


We'll continue to iterate on equipment in our quest to further improve playability and of course, bring more enjoyment.

notes.title: Breaking News! Watch the Skies! The Divine Crow is Here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3bca5c81785c1962aba92f72fe915e0c6991ce44.jpg

In the world of Conqueror's Blade where battles are mainly fought steel against steel mano a mano, firearms can easily tip the tide of war. In a battle where fireballs can rain down from the sky at any moment, protecting your city's walls with pikes and shields may no longer be the best option.
The addition of artillery brought about great change, allowing for greater possibilities in each battle. On each map, you'll command your units and steer your hero through battle, while also needing to consider the strategic ramifications of each artillery. In some battles, choosing and using the correct artillery may well be what ultimately decides the outcome. Being a weapon that can cause such great effect, artillery has naturally been a focal point for our players. While we on our end, have always kept an eye on the enjoyment and balance of these powerful weapons.

All-New Artillery

With the launch of the new season [Eternal: The Jade Realm], we're adding an all-new artillery—The Divine Crow. Hopefully, this ancient Chinese weapon of war will bring about renewed vitality and enjoyment for our artillery!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c6de11d7fc49de33fba25359986807814692db05.jpg

The Divine Crow in History

Invented during the Ming dynasty, it was the first Chinese winged rocket featuring multiple tubes filled with gunpowder. Based on a book titled Weapons of War Compendium from 1412, the Divine Crow, was made from bamboo, reed and cotton. Shaped like a crow, its belly was filled with gunpowder. The four fuses on its back were connected to the four tubes beneath its belly. To launch it, one simply lit the four fuses, propelling the crow forward. Upon reaching its destination, the flames would engulf its belly and ignite the gunpowder stored within, creating a great fiery explosion that burned the target down. With the use of multiple tubes to push it forward and its supporting wings, it could hit targets over hundreds of meters away. It was thus capable of hitting targets behind walls or even in the back of the enemy's lines.

The Divine Crow in Conqueror's Blade

In Conqueror's Blade, the Divine Crow will become an important tool in your arsenal capable of causing devastating damage in a variety of scenarios. A single Divine Crow strike creates multiple explosions that deal lasting burn damage. All in all, it deals fairly high damage and enables you to exact control in a fairly big area. If set up ahead of time, it can be used to deal sustained damage and exact control over enemies in tight formations. Use it correctly and you can create openings for your own forces and more easily deal with tight groups of enemies.

Epic & Legendary Rarities

 The Divine Crow comes in two rarities: epic and legendary. Each rarity features a unique appearance and damage profile. We are naturally prudent when adding new artillery to the game, and so it will only be available in epic rarity for a time being. As we continue to gather data and observe how it fares in combat, we will decide later on when to make available the legendary version too. But rest assured, you'll be able to test out both rarities from the get-go, as we'll be adding them to some Eastern-themed maps.

New PvE Challenge
We're adding an all-new PvE challenge to the World Map that you can challenge a limited number of times each week. Rise to the challenge to find unbound epic Divine Crows.

Unit Sharing Rewards
Rewards from sharing units with your House/Imperial Restorationists have a chance to grant epic Divine Crows. As they say, sharing is caring!

Territory War Report Rewards
Superior Territory War report rewards have a chance to grant epic Divine Crows.
      
The Divine Crow becomes available in the middle of March.

(Descriptions and images used are not the final versions and may be subject to change) We'll continue to explore artillery as a whole in the future, be that perfecting existing ones or developing new interesting ones. After all, artillery enables greater variety in strategy!

notes.title: Development Journal | Brand-New Siege Battle Mode
notes.content:
Hello Warlords, today we're here to talk about siege battles.

Siege battles are a core part of Conqueror's Blade, a focus of both matchmaking and Territory War, and their experience and immersion are what have enabled us to accomplish as much as we've done. Naturally, we've received plenty of feedback throughout the years. We've used this to iterate on and improve current maps, release new ones and design new events and modes to keep the experience fresh.
Siege battles have been with us for years now and have stood the test of time. But we won't let it end here. With the help of your feedback, we've come to the realization that we must make more fundamental changes if siege battles are to remain fun in the long run and truly tap into the potential the mode holds.

The Core of Siege Battles

A staple of siege battles has always been that you choose your units before the battle begins. You might make an informed choice based on what map you're playing and whether you're playing as the attacker/defender. Once made, you cannot change your choice for this match. This integral ruleset has created a few unique setups.

Unit Setup & Strategic Stagnation

Being unable to tell what units the enemy will be bringing to the fray, most players rely on past experience and tends to favor meta units that are expected to perform well. Over time, this has led to stagnation in terms of unit and strategy variety. One player may even play dozens of matches with the exact same setup, which detracts from the fun over the long run.

High Teamwork Requirements

As each player can only bring a limited number of units, the 10-15 players of each team must quickly begin to cooperate in terms of unit selection and strategy. How else will they ensure to have the units required to counter the enemy's forces and win?

Little In-Match Strategizing

As your unit options are limited to what you chose before the match, it's difficult to adjust your strategy based on the situation. This has made battles inflexible and lacking in intensity. Most players go for the 'best' unit setup ahead of time, something which sometimes largely decides the outcome of a match before the battle has already begun. I'm sure you've had times when the enemy suddenly charges a point of interest with a squadron of heavy cavalry in a match where you didn't bring any polearm units to counter them. Things like that immediately put you and your team at a huge disadvantage.

How Can We Improve Variety?

For this time's experimental changes, we've decided to start by looking at our rules for units. We want players to be freer in terms of unit choices for more varied setups.

Escalation (Siege)
A new mode where you can replace your units at any time throughout a match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0f728c1cd9fa3d3aec189d2f22e32aa4781e6b83.png
  [This is just a preview and might be subject to change.]

Within this new ruleset, the strategic choice of which units to use will be an integral part of the battle itself. This will give you more means with which to counter your foe on the fly for more intense battles.
And owing to this, we've decided to launch a brand-new siege mode: [Escalation].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2b0fad169be0ba0fc5908c703157c98e9689d24f.png
  [This is just a preview and might be subject to change.]

Escalation Unit Ruleset
1. You only need to choose one unit to start with in the Pre-deployment menu.
2. Whenever you draft units in a battle, you can choose among all of your unlocked units.
3. Leadership
Each unit you draft costs leadership.
Naturally, drafting units you've previously used in that match doesn't require any leadership. Note: you'll draft the number of units that remained and enough units must remain for you to draft them again.
Leadership isn't affected by seasonal restrictions.


Escalation Availability
Escalation (Siege) will be available every day at set times sometime later on in the month. Rewards, quest completion and challenge progress is shared with [Siege Battle].
You'll be able to access it from [Matching] -> [Events] -> [Escalation (Siege)]. You can check when it's available from the in-game event calendar. We'll be changing its availability in the future.


Escalation's First Map Pool
Harbour City, Kurak Castle (Dune), Sun City, White Elk Fort, Heilung Fjord and Continopolis

About the Future
Escalation is only our first step toward greater heights. We'll continue to improve and innovate the rules for siege battles, and hopefully changes like this one that fundamentally alter how such battles are played will lead to more fun for everyone. Naturally, we'll still continue to work on the staple Siege Battle too!
We all want Conqueror's Blade to provide new and fun gameplay experiences. Your feedback is incredibly important for us in our quest to improve the game further. Any of your ideas might well be what helps us set the course for where to take the game next.
We'll continue exploring more possibilities and trying out new things, and with everyone's combined effort Conqueror's Blade will transcend itself time and again! Thank you for taking this journey with us!

notes.title: Jan 17 Balance Changes
notes.content:
Weapons

Upped heroes' base health to 18,500 (was 17,500).
[Bandage]'s cooldown reduced to 45 seconds (was 60).

Dual Blades

Being able to enter stealth is a unique feature for the Dual Blades, and with it, you can make a difference in the battle despite wearing light armor. However, the Dual Blades have a long cooldown on stealth and they're highly reliant on it. This makes it difficult to deal sustained damage in many situations.

Skills:

Common Skills:
[Skylark], [Butterfly], [Great Thunderbolt], [Bo-Shurikens]
Enters Stealth for 1.2 seconds after finishing casting the skill. Attacking or being attacked cancels stealth.

Stealth Skills:
[Deity's Footsteps]
Cooldown reduced to 7 seconds (was 12).

[Ambush]
1. Cooldown increased to 3 seconds (was 1).
2. Bonus slashing armor penetration reduced to 120% (was 200%).
3. Now deals 200% base slashing damage + 720 slashing damage (previously dealt 300% base).

Nodachi
As a weapon that focuses on dealing sustained damage to units, the Nodachi is incredibly reliant on its skills. What's more, it can't deal or withstand enough damage when facing high-tier units. Being surrounded by units means that you place yourself in harm's way but are seldom rewarded for it.

Basic Attacks:
1. Improved how animations are chained between successive basic attack hits for smoother strikes.
2. Reduced the damage decay when hitting multiple enemies with basic attacks to 10% (was 30%). Max damage decay reduced to 50% (was 75%).
3. Changes to damage and effects of each hit:
First attack: Now deals 100% base slashing damage (was 95%).
Second attack: Now deals 120% base slashing damage (was 130%).
Third attack: Now deals 135% base slashing damage (was 125%) and knocks units back.
Third attack: Now deals 145% base slashing damage (was 140%) and knocks units back.
4. Chaining basic attacks together grant the [Flurry] effect.
[Flurry] Takes 40% reduced damage from T4 and T5 units when pulling back the blade during consecutive basic attacks. The third attack gains 25% health steal and the fourth 50%.

Skills:
[Monstrous Blade]
I: Health steal increased to 30% (was 15%) and duration reduced to 8 seconds (was 12).
II: Health steal increased to 40% (was 22.5%) and duration reduced to 9 seconds (was 13).
III: Health steal increased to 50% (was 30%) and duration reduced to 10 seconds (was 14).

Short Bow

[Poison Arrow], [Steel-tipped Arrow]
Deals 200 bleed damage +6% of the enemy's remaining health over 2 seconds (was 200 + 4.5%).

[Angry Hornets]
Poison damage changed to:
I: Deals 50 damage per second +0.4% of the enemy's remaining health (was 50 + 0.3%).
II: Deals 60 damage per second +0.45% of the enemy's remaining health (was 60 + 0.35%).
III: Deals 70 damage per second +0.5% of the enemy's remaining health (was 70 + 0.4%).


Units

Imperial Pike Guards

 Their advance can't effectively inflict crowd control on high-block units. This means that most heavy shield units can simply enter formation to counter them. To remedy this, we've increased advance's effect on block.
The Imperial Pike Guards will shove at the enemy with their pikes if they're blocked during [Advance], knocking the enemy down. This attack can't be blocked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fc732404f07511ec5b8ba1e7c1c70906ccadf60f.gif

Grayhair Garrison

[Last Stand]
1. Increased damage while using sword and shield by 40%; Increased maximum target count while using longsword by 2; Increased damage while using spear by 30%.
2. Improved the backswing for sword and shield and longsword attacks for smoother consecutive attacks.

[Charge]
1. Changed the attack hitbox for various weapons so that more weapons work together for effective damage.
2. Enters [Last Stand] for 5 seconds after [Charge] ends.

Hashashins
1. Removed their [Weak Vs Heroes] trait. Their damage is no longer reduced when attacking heroes.
2. Changed the targeting algorithm of [Decimate]. They will now attack nearby targets when using skills.

Dagger-Axe Lancers
Increased the minimum interval between counterattacks during [Follow Charge] to 6 seconds (was 3) and reduced the maximum damage increase for counterattacks based on speed to 80% (was 120).

Symmachean Stalwarts
Blocks during [Brace] no longer consume less block than when not in [Brace].

Conqueror's Blade's ecosystem is complex, to say the least, and so we will continue to make changes and improve balance based on the data we collect and your feedback. Should you have any questions or feedback regarding the aforementioned changes and other balance changes, feel free to join in on the discussions going on in the community or leave a comment. We hope to make Conqueror's Blade even better with your help!

notes.title: Dev Q&A | Camel Lancers
notes.content:
In the [Scorpio] season, the special cavalry Camel Lancers were added to Conqueror’s Blade. Their unique characteristics and gameplay were hugely welcomed by players. And we’ve assembled your questions and our devs have answered. We hope you enjoy the new insights from the developers!

Q1: Why did you think now was the right time to add Camels to the game?

A: First, being an animal of the desert, camels fit the theme of the Scorpio season like a glove. Second, our plan was always to flesh out our roster of calvary units with the Scorpio season, and camels with their unique features were a solid option. What's more, camels have been used in warfare across history but they had yet to make an appearance in Conqueror's Blade. We felt that they would bring more enjoyment to the game, so we decided to add camels to the Scorpio season.

Q2: Which came first—-the idea to implement Camels or the Season theme? Was one implemented to fit around the other?

A: We came up with the season's theme first. Each season works as a complete mold, and units are but a part of this mold.

Q3: What is the process of designing the Camel Lancers. 

First, the camels stood out among our many designs and it was a new unit we really wanted to bring our players. Once we knew that, we completed the design by looking at their historical background, role in battle, weapons, armor and combat method. Finally, we decided to go with a heavy-armored lance-wielding cavalry. Camels are big and so with their heavy armor we really want to emphasize their endurance. That's why the Camel Lancers have fairly good defense and resistance to dazed. Plus, looking at the current meta, we wanted to add an anti-cavalry unit with high mobility to bring about some change. Our goal is to iterate on it to fulfill this design goal.

Q4: The Camel Lancers are a new kind of cavalry on the battlefield, how do you think they measure up to standard horse cavalries?

A: The Camel Lancers are bigger than our standard horse cavalries. Plus, they're a type of heavy-armored cavalry. So, we want to express their thick armor and skin by enabling them to retain their posture while attacked. Considering movement, while camels can march for long periods of time under harsh conditions, they tend to move slower than horses, so naturally, their charges will not be as impactful. That's why the Camel Lancers don't have a charge skill and have reduced movement speed while in formation of on follow. Owing to these two points, we're trying to make the Camel Lancers a unique cavalry unit to add to the roster.

Q5: We've seen hounds of the highlands, and now the camels—Will we see more animals enter the fray in Conqueror's Blade down the line?

A: By looking at history, we can see the usage of animals in battle for more or less every region and civilization, whether from stories or legends. Anecdotes like these serve as important inspirations for Conqueror's Blade, and we're bound to try more of these in the future to have more interesting units join the fray.

Q6: Are the Camels Bactrian or Dromedary?

A: Dromedary.

Q7: Camels scare horses, but what do you think would scare camels? 

A: First, fire is deadly to camels. Fire attacks will easily frighten camels. Second, while the Camel Lancers counter cavalry, they can effectively be taken down by high-damage infantry. Finally, when the Camel Lancers use their [Camel Brace] to block enemy attacks, it will be easy for the enemy to have their ranged units concentrate their fire on them.

notes.title: Bow & Short Bow Balance Changes
notes.content:
Many classes haven't seen updates or changes for a long time. Some of these have outdated mechanics and don't feel as good as they could, and even perform worse than others and have a hard time adapting to the current meta.
We're planning on reworking some classes to some extent, focusing on skill setups, combat feeling and attack rhythm. We hope that these changes will revitalize the various classes!
This time around we've made changes to the Bow and Short Bow classes. These changes take effect on Jan 5, 2023.

Bow

The bow's unique mechanic is how you can charge each attack for greater effect, however, that very same mechanic makes it difficult to really shine with it. Battles are fast-paced and ever-changing, making it difficult for Bow heroes to get the most out of charged attacks. Plus, they rely heavily on the [Marksman] skill to use their combos, something which doesn't give a good flow and is difficult to master. And even when mastered, the Bow has a hard time performing well.
So, while we want to retain its unique charging mechanic, we do want to improve upon it so that the Bow can combo attacks in more varied ways.

Skill Changes:

[Lightning Bolt]
1. [Lightning Bolt] no longer deals increased damage based on charge level. [Lightning Bolt] now deals the following damage:
I: 125% base + 5,196 piercing damage.
II: 125% base + 5,529 piercing damage.
III: 125% base + 5,824 piercing damage.
2. Charge Effect: Deals 35% extra base piercing damage on Full-Charge and penetrates 5-12 enemies based on charge level.

[Bodkin-Tipped]
1. [Bodkin-Tipped] no longer deals increased damage based on charge level. [Bodkin-Tipped] now deals the following damage:
I: 61% base + 1,060 piercing damage.
II: 61% base + 1,212 piercing damage.
III: 61% base + 1,333 piercing damage.
2. Charge Effect: [Bodkin-Tipped] inflicts Concussed for 0.3-1.1 seconds based on charge level.
3. [Bodkin-Tipped]'s cooldown increased to 18 seconds (was 15) and no longer causes high block break.

[Flaming Arrow]
1. [Flaming Arrow] no longer deals increased damage based on charge level. [Flaming Arrow] now deals the following damage:
I: 71% base + 752 piercing damage.
II: 71% base + 902 piercing damage.
III: 71% base + 1,003 piercing damage.
2. Charge Effect: [Flaming Arrow] fires 1-3 fire arrows based on charge level.

[Rain of Arrows]
1. [Rain of Arrows] no longer deals increased damage based on charge level. Each [Rain of Arrows] arrow now deals the following damage:
I: 21% base + 270 piercing damage.
II: 21% base + 291 piercing damage.
III: 21% base + 321 piercing damage.
2. Charge Effect: Each arrow that hits replenishes the cooldown of [Rain of Arrows] by 0.3-0.6 seconds based on charge level.

[Marksman]
1. [Marksman] now enables your next basic attack and all skills used within 2 seconds to attack as if they were fully charged. The skill previously enabled your next attack within 15 seconds to attack as if it was fully charged.
2. Cooldown Change:
I: Cooldown increased to 19 seconds (was 16).
II: Cooldown increased to 17 seconds (was 14).
III: Cooldown increased to 15 seconds (was 12).

Combat Improvements:
1. You can now chain basic attacks after skills’ ending animation.
2. You can now use other skills after [Bodkin-Tipped] and [Flaming Arrow] to quicker interrupt the animation.
3. [Rain of Arrows], [Bodkin-Tipped], [Flaming Arrow] and [Lightning Bolt] now have a fairly straight trajectory and high initial rate of fire even at no charge. Full-charging increases projectile speed by 18%.

Short Bow
The Short Bow has fast basic attacks that penetrate enemies and can use skills in quick succession. However, its attacks and skills don't really depend on one another and the Short Bow relies heavily on the burst damage of some skills to deal high continuous damage.
We want to make the Short Bow's gameplay experience and burst combos smoother, while also reducing reliance on some skills with long cooldowns. This should hopefully bring for better basic attack and skill combos and for a more compact attack pacing.

[Basic Attack]
Basic attacks grant [Armor Piercing] upon hit, increasing piercing damage by 1.5% and movement speed by 1.5% for 2.5 seconds, stacking up to 20 times. You drop 3 stacks whenever the duration runs out.

[Roll]
Roll no longer grants [Armor Piercing].

[Poison Arrow]
1. New Effect: Hits mark the enemy for 3 seconds. Basic attacks make the mark explode, dealing 200 Bleed damage plus 4.5% of the enemy's remaining HP over 2 seconds.
2. [Poison Arrow] reduces paragon skill cooldown by 2 seconds when hitting an enemy.
3. [Poison Arrow]'s base poison duration reduced to 3 seconds (was 8).

[Steel-tipped Arrow]
1. Steel-tipped Arrow's damage changed to:
I: 108% base + 595 piercing damage (was 100% + 942).
II: 110% base + 680 piercing damage (was 100% + 1,156).
III: 112% base + 750 piercing damage (was 100% + 1,370).
2. New Effect: Hits mark the enemy for 3 seconds. Basic attacks make the mark explode, dealing 200 Bleed damage plus 4.5% of the enemy's remaining health over 2 seconds.
3. [Steel-tipped Arrow] reduces paragon skill cooldown by 1 second when hitting an enemy.
4. Removed the effects that reduced the enemy's defenses and greatly reduced their block.

[Angry Hornets]
1. Poison damage changed to:
I: Deals 50 damage per second + 0.3% of the enemy's remaining health (was 90 per second).
II: Deals 60 damage per second + 0.35% of the enemy's remaining health (was 105 per second).
III: Deals 70 damage per second +  0.4% of the enemy's remaining health (was 120 per second).

notes.title: Dec 22 Chain Dart & Scimitar Changes
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord:
Ever since its inception, we've received plenty of suggestions and feedback regarding Chain Dart & Scimitar balance. Following this feedback and related statistics, we will be making a series of changes to the Chain Dart & Scimitar hero on Dec 22.

[Trap Prey]:

As the Chain Dart & Scimitar's most unique skill, Trap Prey has a short cooldown, applies an unremovable crowd-control effect, and enables this class to move quickly across long distances. All this combined has had a big effect on battles and their foes always need to be on their toes. If a few heroes find themselves attacked by a bigger force, any and all heroes become unable to resist under the Chain Dart & Scimitar's crowd control.

To remedy this and grant greater variety to controls and battles, we want Trap Prey to achieve the following effects:
1. There should be ways in which to combat [Trap Prey]'s crowd-control effect, so that each hero can use their skills.
2. When [Trap Prey] is used to close the gap to an enemy hero, other classes should be able to respond and trade skills and fight against the Chain Dart & Scimitar hero. Instead of as it is now, where other heroes at the mercy of the Chain Dart & Scimitar and their allies.

Changes:

1. [Trap Prey]'s crowd-control effect now causes the enemy to be Concussed. This state can be immediately removed by some skills that remove crowd controls. This makes it possible to regain control of heroes before the Chain Dart & Scimitar reaches you.
2. [Trap Prey]'s crowd-control effect now differs based on the distance between the two heroes: if the Chain Dart & Scimitar hero hits an enemy within 12 meters with Trap Prey, they can now chain an attack or skill before the enemy can move; if the Chain Dart & Scimitar hero hits an enemy more than 12 meters away, the enemy will be able to regain mobility before they can attack again.
All in all, we've reduced [Trap Prey]'s CC time by 0.2-0.8 seconds.

[Scorpion's Snare]

As an assassination-type hero, [Scorpion's Snare] is part of the Chain Dart & Scimitar hero's core kit. This skill comes with powerful mobility and a long crowd-control effect. Our intent with this was for the Chain Dart & Scimitar hero to be able to get behind and backstab enemies and roam the battle, however, the skill is far superior to other similar skills.

Changes:

1. [Scorpion's Snare]'s targeting works identically to other similar crowd-control skills and doesn't work on mounted heroes.
2. [Scorpion's Snare]'s Choke duration reduced to 2 seconds (was 2.4), and the Chain Dart & Scimitar can use the next skill 1.5 seconds earlier (was 1.85).

[Dune Blast]
Cooldown increased to 22 seconds (was 18).

Rune [Rockbreaker] 

Changes: 

1. The duration of slashing defense reduction effect is reduced to 1 second (was 2 seconds). 
2. The slashing defense reduction effect is decreased to 6.67% (was 10%).
3. Activating the Hoarfrost specialization now increases the slashing defense reduction effect to 40% (was 60%).
These rune changes are expected to be updated today.

We will continue to monitor combat balance and make more changes as needed. As always, your feedback is incredibly important to us! Feel free to share your thoughts and ideas with us so that we can make a better Conqueror's Blade together!

notes.content:
Heroes

[Shielded Charge]: Charges forward while blocking against frontal attacks.

[Clash of Shields]: Charges forward while blocking against frontal attacks.

Units

Myrmillones

Changes:

Myrmillones will attack the surrounding enemies when arriving at the target destination of skill [Myrmillo's Guard]. They will take over that area after send the enemies flying.

We've received your feedback about the round of changes posted on Dec 9. After  , we're making slight adjustments to the previous balance changes.

Shieldmaidens

As a defensive shield unit, the Shieldmaidens' attacks while in shield formation are too powerful. The reason for this is the [Cover Commander] trait they have with their shields up, enabling them to dish out high damage while taking little damage for an extended period of time. All in all, this comes at little cost and is difficult to counter.

Changes:

When switching to shield while in the [Cover Commander] state, they no longer permanently retain the defence increase effect of [Cover Commander].

When switching to shield while in the [Cover Commander] state, they retain the mobility and block ability of the skill, but no longer take 10% less damage. 

When attacking with spears, their attacks reduce damage taken by the unit by 15% (was 10%).

Varangian Guards

The fact that the Varangian Guards remain in axe form for a short period of time and their incredible burst damage makes it difficult to gauge when they'll strike, making them difficult to defend against. This also makes it possible for them to easily dish out high damage while keeping away from the enemy during their time of weakness.

Changes:

While [Raging Onslaught] is active, all skills share a cooldown of 2 seconds, during which the Varangian Guards will attack freely with their axes.

The above changes will take effect with the update on Dec 15.

notes.title: Patrol Officer Kahlen's Diary
notes.content:
[Conqueror's City]
Patrol Officer Kahlen's Diary

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5d2ce33597ed85a2f099e6d28cc99ccf86ce4e46.png

Dec 8 
The City Council has asked that the security office inspect the city's defenses, and groups of white-masked forces have entered the city.
What's the deal with them? And what's with those carrots for noses?
And where are they going? The battle between the Shahiri and Continopolis can't have reached Conqueror's City, can it?

Dec 9 
It snowed heavily and a few unlucky souls fell and hurt themselves in the morning.
The queues outside the shops are long and everyone's preparing for the holiday. I couldn't even find a single stocking!
Blasted, my superiors are having me shovel snow...and bring it to the INNER CITY... What on earth are those old fools up to this time?

Dec 11 
The army came up with a new helmet style this morning but those guys just put them down and hurried away; they probably had more urgent business. Could it be they are related to the reports about purple shooting stars the security office has been receiving?
Shooting stars... What on earth is the army up to?
Oh well, that's far above my pay grade. My time's better spent trying to think of a way to have the security office upgrade our equipment...

Dec 12 
I spent the day drinking and listening to songs at the tavern.
I have to admit, the Council sure has managed to get some holiday feeling going.
I reckon there are great festivities on the horizon for Conqueror's City...

notes.title: Dec 15 Balance Changes
notes.content:
The [Scorpio] season has begun and we've made a new round of balance changes based on the feedback we've received thus far. As for units, we'll start by making changes to two units that, when seen from data and community feedback, exceed expectations in terms of power. These changes aim to bring their power in line with these expectations to improve the overall gameplay. As for heroes, we're making slight adjustments to the charge skills of the shortsword & shield and longsword & shield heroes.

Units

Shieldmaidens

As a defensive shield unit, the Shieldmaidens' attacks while in shield formation are too powerful. The reason for this is the [Cover Commander] trait they have with their shields up, enabling them to dish out high damage while taking little damage for an extended period of time. All in all, this comes at little cost and is difficult to counter.

Changes:
When switching to shield while in the [Cover Commander] state, they no longer permanently retain the mobility method and effect of [Cover Commander].
When switching to shield while in the [Cover Commander] state, they retain the mobility and effect of [Cover Commander] for 2.5 seconds, whereupon they will remain by the hero's side and follow his movements and their attack rate will be identical to when Free Attack and their attacks no longer block.

Varangian Guards

The fact that the Varangian Guards remain in axe form for a short period of time and their incredible burst damage makes it difficult to gauge when they'll strike, making them difficult to defend against. This also makes it possible for them to easily dish out high damage while keeping away from the enemy during their time of weakness.

Changes:
While [Raging Onslaught] is active, all skills share a cooldown of 3 seconds, during which the Varangian Guards will attack freely with their axes.

Myrmillones

Changes:
Myrmillones will attack the surrounding enemies when arriving at the target destination of skill [Myrmillo's Guard]. They will take over that area after send the enemies flying.


Heroes

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] Violation Penalties
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade is run for the sake of players, and we work hard on creating a fair and just game environment. We have zero tolerance toward those who break our regulations and will crack down upon any such behavior to maintain a healthy game environment!
Common violations mainly include, but are not limited to, the following:

Chat Violations	
	
Minor Violations								

24-hour mute——For a first minor chat violation (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), abusive language, spam, etc.
72-hour mute——For a second minor chat violation (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), abusive language, spam, etc.
7-day mute——For a third minor chat violation (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), abusive language, spam, etc.
30-day mute——Multiple minor chat violations (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), or if a single player violates this on multiple characters.

Severe Violations

7-day ban	——For a first severe chat violation (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
30-day ban——For a second severe chat violation (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.). This includes violations of the same player on multiple characters.	
10-year ban——For multiple severe chat violations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.). This includes violations of the same player on multiple characters.		
						

Nickname Violations

Minor Violations								

Forced name change——Nicknames that violate our regulations (minor naming violations: those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.).

Severe Violations

7-day ban and forced name change——The first nickname of that player that severely violates our regulations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
30-day ban and forced name change——The second nickname of that player that severely violates our regulations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
10-year ban and forced name change——Multiple nicknames of that player that severely violate our regulations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).

THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE USAGE	

Permanent ban——Having been found to use or have used third-party software, including but not limited to, cheats, automatic scripts, and modifiers.				

Using unallowed third-party software to perform in-game actions——These include but are not limited to cheats, automatic scripts, and modifiers. Actions such as these are harmful to the game at large and seriously affect the fairness of gameplay. Using such hacks/software adversely affects the client and servers' stability, and may lead to you having your account stolen.
We will crack down on and severely punish anyone using third-party software that violates our regulations and anyone using any type of hacks.


OBSTRUCTIVE CONDUCT

Obstructive conduct includes but not limited to Negative behaviors, deliberate friendly fire, quit battles before ends, AFK, etc.

1. (Minor) suspension time: Restricted from playing matched battles for 2 hours——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 1-5 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
2. (Medium) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an A+ or better ranking ——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 5-10 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
3. (Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 10-15 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
4. 7-day soft ban——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 15-50 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
5. 30-day soft ban——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 50+ recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).	
6. Permanent ban——Those found to have been penalized for obstructive conduct multiple times due to, including but not limited to, using multiple alternate characters, scrips, or multi-clienting.

House (Territory War) Violations

Using third-party software to gain an advantage in Territory War——Houses found to have been using third-party software in Territory War will be penalized depending on the situation. If a house is found to have done so purposefully, their prestige will be set to 0 whether or not their actions garnered them any benefits. All fiefs in their possession will also be returned to their rightful lords.

IMPROPER TRADING

 Topping up using any non-official channel, or obtaining sovereigns in any way that violates our regulations.
 Be suspect of fraudulent trading.
Those deemed responsible for any of the above may have their accounts banned, purchased items revoked and will be required to top-up to make up for the disparity.

Malicious Abuse of Loopholes 

1. To, in a game or otherwise, maliciously abuse unintended bugs to disrupt the game order, game fairness, or severely affect the gameplay experience of others. Offenders will have their accounts banned for 7-30 days based on the severity of the offense. 
2. Maliciously abusing loopholes or third-party software to perform actions that violate our regulations, severely affect the game, affect the fairness of the game, or to get unjustified gains (including virtual items & property). We may perform rollbacks based on each different situation, and those found to have been maliciously abusing loopholes will have their accounts banned (permanently for severe enough cases). 
We will not under any circumstance compensate offenders for any loss of earnings or limited items missed during the course of their account ban. We implore that everyone works to maintain a fair gaming environment that everyone can thrive in. 

[Ranked Battle] Negative Behavior Violation Penalties 

1. Accounts found out to have been throwing games or resorted to severely negative behavior (including but not limited to intentionally leaving mid-game, AFKing, intentionally attacking allies) may be subject to the following penalties: 
- First offenders: Characters on that account will be unable to partake in Ranked Battle for 7 days. 
- If a character is found to violate the aforementioned two times, it will be banned for 1 month. 
- Throwing games multiple times will lead to a permanent ban. 
2. Penalties of the first article may be incurred at the same time as other penalties of the same type, including chat violations, usage of third-party programs, and other actions that severely affect the gameplay experience of other players. In special cases, the offending character may have part or all of their Ranked Score removed based on the severity of the violation. 

Note: Offenders will be unable to partake in Ranked Battle on their account during its ban. We implore that everyone works to maintain a fair gaming environment that everyone can thrive in. 

PENALTY INFORMATION	

•Mute——Being unable to send chat messages.	
•Soft ban——While a soft ban is in effect on someone's account, their qualification to partake in tournaments they are currently partaking in is also revoked. 
•Forced name change——They will be forced to change their character's name.
• (Minor) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in most game modes for the duration of the penalty and need to remain online to reduce their penalty time.
• (Medium) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in other modes, and must first complete xx Training Camp (AI) games with a rating of A+.
• (Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete xx Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating.
(In special situations, we reserve the right to adjust violation regulations and to apply stricter penalties when we deem required)


Our game's ecology and fair gameplay have and always will be a cornerstone of Conqueror's Blade. It is something we continue to work towards.
We will work together with the community to monitor and crack down upon the violations elicited above. For serious offenses, we reserve the right to pursue criminal responsibility through legal means.
Should you encounter anyone violating any of the above while playing the game, kindly Report them or contact us via our communities in a timely manner. We will deal with any kind of violation most severely.
Once again, thank you everyone so much for your support. We believe that to create a healthy game environment, we must work hard to solve these issues together!

notes.title: Play Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio Today!
notes.content:
Strike from the shadows in Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio, the new Season now available as a free update! 

Become a deadly assassin, battle through the ranks in a new Seasonal Campaign, unlock Units inspired by ancient Persian factions, and enjoy special launch events and sales. You can also ready yourself to wield a new Weapon Class: the Chain Dart & Scimitar, launching December 8 (preorders now available)!
The Scorpio Battle Pass is now available to buy in-game, with the Guild Agent Hero Attire granted as an instant unlock.

[previewyoutube=kb2EPY2uyw0;full][/previewyoutube]

Three New Seasonal Units

Three new Seasonal Units inspired by legendary factions of ancient Persia will be available to unlock via Unit Challenges throughout the Season, each bringing distinctive and deadly talents to the battle:

Jangjus (3-Star) — Available Now: The Jangjus specialize in both melee and close-range combat through the use of scimitars and throwing knives, and are able to attack while on the move.

Camel Lancers (4-Star) — Coming December 5: An elite cavalry who can trample enemies, brace for impact, and startle enemy horses.

Hashashins (5-Star) — Coming December 26:  The Hashashins use smoke to slip into the shadows. They can be ordered to deftly approach a target while avoiding arrows, and can quickly destroy enemies with low defence stats.

Scorpio Battle Pass: Exclusive Free & Premium Rewards

Scorpio is here, and many rewards are yours to earn in the Battle Pass! Over 100 levels of Free and Premium rewards can be claimed by completing Seasonal Challenges, earning Glory, and leveling up during the season. Equip your band of assassins with the Ashur Vanguard Unit Attire, and gallop into the sandstorm with the Shabdiz's Heir Mount Set. At Tier 100 sits a prize fit for a truly deadly assassin—-the Noble Hashashin Hero Attire.

Guild Agent Hero Attire will be granted as an instant reward when you purchase the Battle Pass in-game for 680 Sovereigns. Conqueror’s Blade is a free-to-play game, and there are many epic rewards to be earned on the Free Pass too.

Draw Blades from the Battle Pass to exchange in the Seasonal Store for Antique variants of cosmetics previously only available in Highlanders!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/59f6f80646fe69e742bf4295be5db225f2ea4084.jpg

Preorder the Chain Dart & Scimitar (New Weapon Class)

The Chain Dart & Scimitar is the thirteenth Weapon Class to arrive in Conqueror’s Blade and boasts a hook to pull enemies into your grasp, smoke bombs, and slashing capabilities with the Scimitar.

Art of the Scimitar: 
Use to complete the first and second Chain Dart & Scimitar challenge stages and all its skills.
Discount Price: 1,580 Sovereigns

Secrets of the Scimitar: 
Use to complete all Chain Dart & Scimitar challenges and all its skills, and receive exclusive rewards like the Attire.
Discount Price: 3,280 Sovereigns

Preorder is available from Nov 24 through Dec 8.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3ad0bb9097057139da9368226a3f8108c1c333d4.jpg

Revamped Maps

Rally your band of assassins and battle on reworked versions of two of your favourite maps. Take on foes in Kurak Castle - Dune and Areaktol, available now in matchmaking rotation (Siege). 

Check out more information on the revamped maps here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/291445e2e0c3224e98921975ea7c5bdf29c6b1b1.jpg

Seasonal Campaign: Scorpio

Prove your prowess in a brand new Seasonal Campaign and start your journey in the Borderlands or Bartholia, and play every week to follow the story and secure your standing. Battle in twice-weekly Territory Wars with your House and complete Stages to prepare for the final fight in Daicheng at the end of the Season.

Territory Wars 

Territory Wars begin on November 26 and will be waged every Tuesday and Saturday throughout Scorpio. Participate in epic server-wide PvP battles which form the lion’s share of endgame content in Conqueror’s Blade. 

Take part in Territory Wars by joining a player-controlled Free House or Alliance, or a Cohort (NPC-controlled House) and expand your empire by fighting alongside your fellow warlords via the ‘Battle’ interface or in the Open World to gain control of fiefs. 

This Season, the way you’re rewarded for Territory Wars in the new Season has changed. Triumph will now be awarded based on your Battle Score—to learn more, check out the dedicated article.

Scorpio Twitch Drops

Tune in to Twitch streams hosted by select Conqueror’s Blade content creators until 20:00 December 2 ( UTC+8), rack up enough viewing time, and claim your spoils.

Claim Rare Doctrine Reagents, Doctrine Water, Secret Training Missive, Heroic Epic to boost your Battle Pass Tiers, and much more.

You can also claim one additional instant reward every day by watching for a total of one hour per day to earn a Twitch Drops Progression Bundle containing a combination of two Basic Supply Crates, two Simple Honour Medals, or a Poem Collection.

Download and play Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio today!

For more information about the new Season, check out the latest patch notes. New to the game? Conqueror’s Blade is available to download and play for free from the official website and Steam. 

Get the latest Conqueror’s Blade news by subscribing our official accounts on Twitch, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Discord.

notes.title: Scorpio Spotlight: All-New PVE Map
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0a6046e252b031417d72e80d0d393727d870f0a9.png

Strike from the shadows on the new PVE map - Deploy & Defend.
Deploy units to set up a defense and fight the invaders. Defeat all enemies to achieve victory!

Mechanics

A new PVE mode where solo players can deploy multiple units at the same time to defend the camp all by oneself.

[previewyoutube=YecF8HPZRdo;full][/previewyoutube]

Victory & Defeat

100% drop on victory: [Uncommon Doctrine Reagent].
You can earn up to 4 [Uncommon Doctrine Reagents] per day.

Victory: Defeat all enemies within the allotted time to attain victory. 
The map features multiple flags. Interacting with one enables you to deploy units or change the ones stationed there.The units you can deploy will refresh each time you deploy new units or when you press the Change Unit button. And the units you deploy can change as the match progresses. But think before you leap! The number of times you can deploy and change units is limited and can be replenished over the course of the match. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7e2dc6d4f9308d3a0e1659e17c48f74a3db4266e.png

Defeat: You suffer defeat if enough invaders reach the safety area behind the base, or you fail to defeat all invaders within the allotted time. So take advantage of a unique effect on hero on this map: exchange for increased movement speed at the cost of greatly reduced damage and defenses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/62c90f4ffab7a5bb5736fa76f399d4d0c4f70f2e.png

This new PVE mode will be available on map Lesser Greenpeak. Rally your troops and embark on your new journey on PVE Mode - Deploy & Defend!

The Deploy & Defend is a Tower Defense like gameplay in Conqueror’s Blade. It’s one of the steps we take to bring you all a game with more fun. 

We'll keep an eye on your feedback and continue to iterate on the Deploy & Defend map to ensure an as great experience as possible. So don't be shy with your feedback!

notes.title: CBL 2022 Winter Tournament Participation | Asia Division
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3ced65ac0b6a400bf03274c5247c966233211142.png

Esteemed Warlord,
Signups are ongoing for the CBL 2022 Winter Tournament. Read the following for more info:

- Map Pool

Scoring Phase: Heilung Fjord, Harbour City, Linwu Fortress, Grassland Assault (Extra Match on Field Bttle)
Knockout Stage: Heilung Fjord, Harbour City, Linwu Fortress, TBC, TBC, Grassland Assault (Extra Match on Field Bttle)

- Signups

1. There is no Ranked Battle score requirement for either teams or players.
You must sign up using a character of level 100 or higher.
2. You can create teams with players from other servers.
Players on the LA, DI, JC and SG servers can create cross-server teams. Rewards will be issued to the character used when signing up for the tournament. Please use the character on which you want to receive rewards (you cannot change this later on).
3. Being added to the tournament server's whitelist.
Teams that have signed up should content us to request to be added to the whitelist. You can find our contact info at the end.
4. At least 4 members of a team must join the group chat created by the tournament host. This is to prevent us from being unable to contact the group in time.
 
DC: https://discord.gg/AURjrpZKHH

- Participation

1. Characters will be created for participants on the tournament servers. Each player can change their name once. The team's captain must provide a list of participants to the tournament host. If the name of a member's character does not match the name on the list, they will not be able to participate.

2. Contestants can only participate with their one character on the tournament server, and may not create several characters using multiple accounts.

3. Roster Changes
Teams that enter the knockout stage can change their roster. Rosters can only be changed during the time as notified by the tournament host.
- If a player is removed or added from a squad's roster, the tournament characters of that team's members will be deleted and recreated.
- Notes on Roster Changes
  - Team members that have not participated in the tournament may be added to the roster.
  - Members of already eliminated teams in the same division may be added to the roster.
  - Members of other divisions cannot be added to the roster.
  - Members that have been disqualified in the ongoing tournament cannot be added to the roster.

4. Map Selection and Ban & Pick Times

Scoring Phase Map Selection
We will issue a link for map selection at 18:00-18:10 (UTC+8) the day before the match. You can choose maps between 18:10-18:30 (UTC+8). We will notify related parties regarding the exact time of map selections. Any squad that is three or more minutes late is seen to have waived their rights to select a map.

Knockout Stage Ban & Pick
 Ban and pick starts at 19:50 (UTC+8) for matches starting at 20:00 (UTC+8). Any team that is three or more minutes late is seen to have waived their rights to select ban and pick maps and units.
 Ban and pick starts at 20:50 (UTC+8) for matches starting at 21:00 (UTC+8). Any team that is three or more minutes late is seen to have waived their rights to select ban and pick maps and units.

5. Team Spot-checks
We will do spot checks on team data from time to time. If a player is found to have logged in to multiple characters on the tournament server, the players and teams of all related characters will have their participation qualification revoked.

—Rules 
We are making the following changes to CBL to further competitiveness:

I. Scoring Phase
1. The Asia and China’s Mainland Divisions will use the same rulesets and scoring methods.
2. Scoring phases will be carried out individually to contend for spots in the knockout stage.
3. Scoring Phase Promotion
16 teams will be promoted during the scoring phase. The number of entrant teams is decided based on the number of signups in the China’s Mainland Division and Asia Division. The tournament host reserves the right to change the number of entrant teams.
The entrant quota for each division will be decided by the tournament host.
4. Promotion Quota for Next Season's Scoring Phase
The promotion quota will be decided based on the number of signups in the China’s Mainland Division and Asia Division. Based on the division of the previous champion, 1 quota will be added to one division and 1 removed from the other. For example: if a team from the Asia Division won the previous tournament, then 1 extra team may participate in the Asia Division's knockout stage, and 1 less team may participate in the China’s Mainland Division's knockout stage.
As the CBL 2022 Summer Tournament was held within divisions only, the outcome will not affect the number of entrants in the CBL 2022 Winter Tournament or future tournaments.

II. Knockout Stage
Teams promoted from the Asia and China’s Mainland Divisions will battle it out against one another in the knockout stage, where a final victor will be decided.
You can read about the tournament rules here: https://www.conquerorsblade.com/news/814/


Should you have any queries whatsoever, contact us on Discord: lunarshark#2865

notes.title: Nov 24 Update | Balance Changes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c4b28395ad7291b5a4c4941a5a6ca3ab56d58c96.png

Upon Conqueror's Blade's battlefield, heroes are tasked with a multitude of objectives: scouting, capturing points of interest, and controlling the battle, and these are all integral parts of the game. How a hero feels to use directly affects the gameplay experience. We want that this experience is varied and interesting, and so we are launching a new hero, we're also tuning the other heroes.

As it stands, the Longsword & Shield is currently one of the most popular support heroes due to its ability to heal, boost the movement speed of allies and crowd-control enemies. But on the other hand, having four skill buttons to press, it is forced to sacrifice damage to provide its support. All in all, this greatly restricts its ability to provide a more varied experience. So, we've put a lot of focus on the Longsword & Shield during this balance tuning. We're merging some of its support skills and improving its damage skills, and this will hopefully lead to an overall better feel and flow.

What's more, owing to the current meta, we've made changes to a series of other heroes too, changes we hope will improve the gameplay experience. Anyway, read on to find out what changes are coming with the new season on Nov 24!

Heroes

Longsword & Shield

[Knightly Vows] and [Mercy of Heaven]

We're merging the [Knightly Vows] and [Mercy of Heaven] skills so that you can switch between healing and speed.
[Mercy of Heaven]'s effect changed to:
