notes.title: Scorpio Unit Spotlight: Hashashins (5-Star)
notes.content:
Three Seasonal Units inspired by the factions of Ancient Persia are coming to Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio when the new update launches on November 24. 

The most dangerous and elusive of these Units are the Hashashins (5-Star).

[previewyoutube=q6OsBI8zlPc;full][/previewyoutube]

HISTORICAL INSPIRATION

The Hashashin was a faction of assassins that operated in Persia from the 11th to the 13th century and excelled in the assassination of important people. Their signature weapon was a dagger, which they used expertly while wearing very little armor. 

Their notoriety and skill spread across the Middle East, in particular their use of “psychological warfare”, which instilled fear into their enemies, and often led to submission from their target. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/335f1032e63050042a26eb000aa06e87e7fdf194.jpg

UNIT INFORMATION

In Conqueror’s Blade, the Hashashins have a long if much-obscured history, serving not only as assassins but also as dedicated reconnaissance and infiltration troops for the Shahiri army. Their training emphasizes agility, fast reflexes, and the utmost dedication to the missions they are entrusted with. 

Supposedly, a single Hashashin is capable of defeating any number of conscripted peasants in combat, but they are best used to cause maximum casualties among the enemy's troops and officers.

UNIT CHARACTERISTICS

- Using the Hashashins’ skills temporarily uses up its "Action Points" which will then recover over a short period of time
- The Hashashins make use of smoke to slip into the shadows and can utilize this to cover their own attack or make a hasty retreat. 
- Order your Hashashins to quickly approach a target while avoiding arrows, and quickly destroy enemies with low defence stats.

Add the Hashashins to your Warband by completing new Unit Challenges in Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio when the season launches.

notes.title: Scorpio Unit Spotlight: Camel Lancers (4-Star)
notes.content:
Three Seasonal Units inspired by the factions of Ancient Persia are coming to Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio when the new update launches on November 24. 

It’s time to meet the next group of fearless fighters: Camel Lancers (4-Star).

[previewyoutube=A3fvoB-sTO8;full][/previewyoutube]

HISTORICAL INSPIRATION

Camels were often used as cavalry animals in the Middle East due to their adaptability in arid desert environments. The size of camels was also said to have alarmed horses, making them effective in battle against conventional cavalry. 

The first documented use of camels as military animals was in the Battle of Qarqar in 853 BC by the Arab king Gindibu. Even later still, the Roman Empire used camel riders in the 2nd century for desert policing, scouting, and escort duties. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4388267db4dc7ac87f4b64750ec2bb021ef36bca.jpg

UNIT INFORMATION

In Conqueror’s Blade, the Camel Lancers are the elite cavalry of the Shahir. Drawn from the aristocracy, tying their fate to that of the regime they serve. 
Camels are not as fast over short distances as conventional horse cavalries, but their incredible endurance makes them ideal for long campaigns in the arid steppes and deserts of Shahir.

UNIT CHARACTERISTICS

- Attacks by the Camel Lancers can startle enemy horses.
- And the unit can also be ordered to launch short-range, straight-line raids, trampling enemies along the way.
- The Camel Lancers can brace enemies effectively, soaking up damage and gaining immunity to crowd control effects.

Recruit the Camel Lancers by completing new Unit Challenges in Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio.

notes.title: Scorpio Unit Spotlight: Jangjus (3-Star)
notes.content:
Three Seasonal Units inspired by the factions of Ancient Persia are coming to Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio when the new update launches on November 24. 

Today, meet the first new band of assassins: Jangjus (3-Star).

[previewyoutube=612nQtCIals;full][/previewyoutube]

The Jangjus wield scimitars with a long and storied history. Scimitar is used to describe a curved sword, in contrast to straight swords from the same time period. The earliest known appearance of a scimitar dates back to the 9th century in Khurasan, where it was used for its lightweight slashing capabilities, particularly when on horseback. A curved arc is better for slashing strikes, and the scimitar was widely used across the Middle East from the Ottoman period onwards for this very reason. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a424047f96fa0ef91fb181ce18e0df283acfd7fe.jpg

Background Info:

The Jangjus form the core of the Shahiri army. They specialise in both melee and close-range combat through the use of scimitars and throwing knives.
They are veteran warriors of the desert who can defend any position. They fight with incredible ferocity when the odds are stacked against them, but become lax when they have the upper hand.
General Hashem used his numerous Jangjus to rule the region with an iron fist. Most of these hail from the countryside where a man needs to master but two skills: farming and fighting.

Unit Characteristics:

Their throwing knife skill comes with a very short cooldown, which allows the Jangjus to attack multiple times, even while on the move. They can also launch ranged attacks in between melee strikes for some extra burst potential.

Preorder Info

Their preorder bundle [Jangjus Preorder Bundle] becomes available in the in-game shop on Nov 17.
Get the Jangjus Preorder Bundle to try this new 3-star unit out as soon as the new season launches.

notes.title: [Colosseum] Season Server Transfers
notes.content:
The Colosseum season is about to end and a new season begins. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

Server Transfer Time:
1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on November 17th, after maintenance (UTC+8), and run through November 21st, 23:59 (UTC+8), 2022.
2. Character transfers will be performed during the new season's maintenance.

Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:

Transfer Quotas

Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.

Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

How to Transfer

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred following the new season's maintenance.

Important:

1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before November 21st, 23:59 (UTC+8). Upon canceling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon canceling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.

3. You must leave your house (Imperial Restorationists or Free House) when requesting a server transfer. You may not join a new house while your server transfer is pending.

4. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.

5. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.

6. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, Wagon, and Resource Piles will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
3) Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.

7. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

8. Extra Info:
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.

notes.title: Development Journal | Unit Sharing
notes.content:
Hello, Warlords, today we're focusing on units.

We're always aiming at making Conqueror's Blade's combat experience more vibrant and richer. To this end, we've been adding new units with each season to join our ever-growing roster of units. As it stands, our game comprises more than 100 units spanning multiple eras and civilizations.

Even so, players new to Conqueror's Blade have access to very few of these. This has led to the early-game experience being somewhat rigid. New players don't have the opportunity to try out a big variety of units to find the path forward that suits them, plus, it makes it difficult for them to really team up with others. What's more, players returning after a longer break need a bit of time before they can try out the latest season's units and content.

Having thought about ways to remedy this, we're going to try out making a new in-game feature where you can share units with other members of your house.

Unit Sharing

Houses is the game's most crucial social feature as they connect players together. That's why we're first making unit sharing available within houses, and for its inception, the feature will be available via a limited-time event. Hopefully, this feature will help improve the experience for both new and returning players. Oh, and it should make it easier for new and veteran players to team up too.

Senior members of houses or veteran cohort members can share their max-level units to a shared unit pool. Once there are enough units in the pool, other members of your house/cohort can choose units from among the pool in matchmaking matches (shared units will retain their level, attribute points and doctrines). What's more, players who lend their units to others will receive rewards in return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0799851fc13d47045778c44dca62433f3677e297.jpg

Each player can borrow a limited number of units each day. When entering a matchmaking battle, you will get a choice among 3 random units from the pool (priority on high-level ones). There is no limit to the number of times a unit can be borrowed, yet, these units are still affected by leadership caps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ba6c7d96519d23f6e342190395b9cfe506668867.png

Auxiliary Unit Changes

While this new feature will give everyone a chance to try out new units, we're not about to abandon auxiliary units either. While you can still try out new units via this feature, we do want it to be more versatile. So, we're planning the following changes:

With the new season, we're changing Auxiliary Points into Auxiliary Orders, and you'll get an initial number of Auxiliary Orders every Monday. Oh, and you can complete daily quests for more of these as well. Whether or not you've spent all of your Orders, they reset to their initial value on Mondays.

But that's not all: Auxiliary Orders can also be used to refresh your recruitment selection, giving you access to a new batch of Auxiliary Units. This gives you even more chances at trying out the units you've got your eyes on. Auxiliary Units can be recruited for up to 3 days at a stretch, and those you've conscripted become unavailable on Mondays with the reset.

Unit sharing is new ground for us, and you'll soon be able to try it out in an event coming with the new season. We'll continue to iterate and improve on it based on the results and your feedback, and it's our goal to make it a permanent part of Conqueror's Blade.

Our aim is always to give you the best gaming experience we can, and your feedback helps us realize that to a greater extent. So, don't be shy now! Try out the new feature and share your thoughts and ideas!

Become A Leader Of Assassins With New Units

Even the deadliest of assassins need a loyal band of followers. Recruit new Seasonal units inspired by ancient Persian factions:

Jangjus (3-Star): This faction is specialized in melee and close-range combat, using scimitars and throwing knives. They fight fearlessly in the face of an unstoppable enemy army with unshakable bravery.

Camel Lancers (4-Star): An elite cavalry seen as a symbol of military might. Though their speed may not match horses, their stamina is unrivalled. Their great endurance enables them the ability of anti-horses.

Hashashins (5-Star): Dangerous, elusive, determined. The Hashashins are trained in agility and stealth, allowing them to sneak attack any foe with their guard down. 

Revamped Maps

Rally your band of assassins and revisit the sand-ravaged fortresses of two fan-favourite maps: Kurak Castle and Areaktol, now revamped with new features!

New Seasonal Campaign

Leap into a brand new Seasonal Campaign by starting your assassin’s quest in the Borderlands or Bartholia, and play every week to secure your standing. Battle in twice-weekly Territory Wars with your House and complete Stages to prepare for the final fight in Daicheng at the end of the Season.

The way you’re rewarded for Territory Wars in the new Season is changing! Triumph will now be awarded based on your Battle Score—to learn more, check out the dedicated article.

Preorder the Battle Pass

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0cb230741c3657f6fbd44e5a6d6dcd13f07066a9.jpg

Preorder the Scorpio Battle Pass to earn exclusive bonus content immediately and when Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio launches. The following rewards are only available when you preorder the Battle Pass in-game before November 24:

Scorpio Battle Pass: Active from November 24!

2x Heroic Epic: Receive 5,000 Glory per Heroic Epic to boost your Battle Pass level.

10x Unit Medals: Each Unit Medal grants 5,000 Unit XP to a selected unit.

50,000 Bronze Coins: In-game currency.

1x Treatise: This allows the War Scholar to excavate ancient battlefields and collect Doctrines to give your units useful bonuses.

Fight for exclusive rewards throughout the new Season, and rise to claim the Noble Hashashin Hero Attire at Tier 100. You’ll also unlock the Guild Agent Hero Attire straight away when you activate your Battle Pass.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/df1c044d7619ed2f689aa38dfb21a1b3d8fc9173.jpg

New Runes 

The Rune system is back! Augment your loadout with sacred artefacts earned by raising your Seasonal Level.

You can attach Runes to your Warlord’s weapon, helmet, armor, boots, and bracers via the Seasonal Runes tab (by pressing ‘F5’) to grant tactical improvements and special bonuses to your equipment.

Doctrine Changes

When Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio launches, there’ll be a new way to earn Doctrines! You'll be able to exchange Daybreak Seal for the Doctrines you want, and the new Doctrine Fusion system should give you a new use for your old Doctrines that are simply gathering dust.
There will also be a new item type: Doctrine Reagents. You can use Doctrine Reagents of an equal quality as materials in their place, and earn more powerful Doctrines. Check out the dedicated article for more information.

More information about Conqueror’s Blade: Scorpio and launch events will be coming soon, and you can stay informed by following Conqueror’s Blade on Twitch, Facebook, Twitter and Discord.

Conqueror’s Blade is now available to download and play for free on Microsoft PC via Launcher and Steam!

notes.title: Development Journal | Territory War Reward Revamp
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dd96172bc19a0fe8485876b0aeecebb248d0174f.png

Hello, Warlords.
Territory War is one of Conqueror's Blade's core game modes where warlords work together with members of their house and alliance to conquer cities on the World Map. We're happy to see how active everyone is and that you enjoy the experience. However, we've also spotted issues that we simply can't ignore with its current iteration, and we've received feedback on these too. While we encourage players to work together and the beauty of unity, the experience of each individual player is important too.

As it stands, most rewards are tied together with the glory of your house or alliance and don't grant individual players much growth. Besides, the way in which the rewards are currently issued poses an issue with their usage too. Going forward, warlords will be awarded Empire Coins and we're diversifying the types of rewards and reward quantity available in the Empire's Treasury. This means that we're giving you agency over what rewards you earn. This will in turn serve to give you the rewards that will best aid you in your future Conqueror's Blade journey.

But that's not all: previously, most rewards have been granted at season end, meaning that there was little to be gained from Territory War during the early and mid stages. This in turn meant that, during the later stages, the occupation or loss of a single fief could have a massive effect on a warlord's final rewards. We'll therefore distribute rewards more evenly across the entire Territory War period going forward. This should give you continuous rewards throughout the season to help you grow your account better.

With Empire Coins making up the core reward, we'll make the following changes to Territory War:

Simplify Rewards

Campaign quests and weekly title rewards will now only award Empire Coins. Completing all Campaign quests will net you 140 Empire Coins, which will get you close to ten Treatises, if you so choose.

[New] Territory War Report Rewards

You'll be awarded Empire Coins based on your Battle Score.

Empire's Treasury Changes

Added doctrine reconditioning materials.
Purchase limit of Treatises raised to 20.
All-new rare leadership doctrines (reduces leadership required by 6%; purchase limit resets each season).

We hope that this reward revamp will serve as an encouragement for more Warlords to participate in Territory War again with their houses. Naturally, this is not all we're working on: we'll continue to iterate on Territory War's rules and the baseline experience as we go forward. If possible, we also hope that you'll all give us as much feedback as you can.

The Future & More

During the past months, we've increased the cadence of unit balance changes and expanded the scope, attempted to add extra leadership to the Campaign phases, and designed new modes and mechanics for some maps (e.g., the well-received Clash Frenzy mode). We're doing these changes and new content designs to provide a more varied gameplay experience and make it more relaxing to train and level units.

We're excited to bring you all this update this year! (Check out our future notices for more in-depth details)

We'll be focusing on your feedback as we progress from here and continue to iterate on the game. We're also looking to try out more new things and see how they pan out. What's more, we'd love for the community to give us all the feedback you have, your feelings and thoughts on the game as a whole, and your boldest ideas!

A new season is on the horizon featuring new units, let's get ready for battle and sharpen our weapons for this new journey. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Ask the Devs #EP02
notes.content:
Welcome to another instalment of our Q&A series presented by the Conqueror’s Blade development team! In August, we concentrated on questions and answers regarding Conqueror’s Blade: Helheim, and in this new episode, we are focusing on Quality of Life, Customization, and Ranked Battles!
We’ve assembled your questions and our devs have answered! We hope you enjoy the new insights from the developers at Booming Tech.

1.  Do you have any plans to bring back the previous Open-World Map UI?

A: We hope that we can eventually bring you a beautiful and concise Open-World Map. Unfortunately, while improving the aesthetics of the map function, we did not take into account its interactive design to achieve ease of use. We know why players are missing the old one, which was more customizable and displayed more information on the map. We want to make it easy to read and use—-that's why we made those changes to the world map. At the moment, to be honest, we may not take the Open-World Map UI improvement as a very urgent task to be done. If there are any plans for this in the future, we will let you guys know and run a test before officially adding it to the live server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/acd06de40ef9bb89b3f3af967b5e9672878ad744.jpg

2. Are you considering adjusting the Valor Points system in the Ranked Battles?

A: The original intention of the Valor Points system is to give extra rewards to players who have performed bravely in qualifying matches. No matter whether the battle is won or lost, as long as they have a good performance on the battlefield, they will be rewarded. In the Colosseum season, we implemented Star-drop protection to ensure the basic qualifying experience for every player. We hope to encourage more active battlefield behaviors through the Valor Points system, curb the battlefield behaviors of passive games, and purify the battlefield ecology. We will continue to pay attention to the performance of the Valor Points system in the Colosseum season and continue to adjust the system.

3. Do you have any plans to optimize communication on the battlefield?

A: We want to bring players a real battlefield experience, but we also want to bring a team experience of full cooperation. Therefore, we have completed the production of the first version of the battlefield communication system, including a fast-marking system and a stable command system. The system is currently being optimized and adjusted. If it goes well, the system will be available in the next season! 

4. Are you considering creating a single web page or a spot in-game to view all of the lore of the game so far? 

We're really looking at better ways to present the story, including more acting and easier reading. At the same time, we have also achieved certain results. Of course, being able to experience the stories of past seasons is part of the plan. We are considering improving the way how people are going to read the story, like adding some visual performance to it and improving its readability—-we've already made some progress. We welcome feedback on how we present the story for the current season and the way it is shown. 
 
5. Are you considering allowing us to save character customization to be able to switch in one click between different combinations of Hero Attires? 

We understand the importance of an easy-to-use character customization system for players. Yet, currently, we redeem that laying emphasis on gameplay related things is more urgent to do, like improvements on battle performance and experience, or adding more fun and high-quality events to the game. It's a tough choice for us . We do want to have them both but have to make the choice.
Still a huge thank you to all of you guys for those good suggestions on the customization system. For now, we will be happier to see some gameplay related feedback and crazy ideas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5ddd3a6fd5f7bb6d1f5d9b43bd1c9933f0af01dc.png

6. Are you considering creating a 'Skill Reset Token' or something similar?

Compared to adding one more item to the game, we are likely to go for reducing the difficulty of earning Mastery Points in the game, or adding more interesting quests to the game to help you earn those points. We take the process of earning those points as a way to train yourself as well, so if it's free to reset skills and re-allocate points to different weapons, that will be losing the initial goals for what we designed.

7. Are there plans to open custom hotkey bindings for acceleration, basic attack, block, etc. in the future?

We fully understand the need for more detailed custom buttons, and freedom of control has always been what we are looking for. Binding keys for these very basic behaviors may not be necessary now, and doing it directly may cause more problems. From another perspective, we will try to do some more convenient operation optimizations (such as the operation methods of rolling and sprinting, etc.), and even do not rule out the possibility of doing some more radical exploration. However, if we don't think twice before taking action, the current ecosystem may not that welcome the new changes. For now, we think it is not a must but it doesn't mean no improvements will come.

8. Do you have plans to allow us to customize even more parts of the Hero Attire, such as removing or replacing elements like horns, features, and other certain details?


We have always paid attention to the need for personalized expression based on fashion. In the past two seasons, we have added the adjustment option of whether the costume mask/cloak is displayed. Of course, this level of expression is not enough. Therefore, there are related functions currently being processed by our research and development team. We will also continue to deepen the personalized expression so that each player can show their style. 

This will be the final instalment of Ask The Devs in its current form. Though we wanted to experiment with a general approach to questions and answers, we feel a more focused approach to development insights allows for a more interesting and timely read. Look forward to new interviews and development articles in the near future!

notes.title: Development Journal | New Doctrine Features
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In this development journal, we'll be discussing doctrines and the changes we have in store for them. We're hoping that this change make doctrines realize our initial intentions: to provide more varied gameplay and battles.

Naturally, the most important thing is to make the game fun.

No Longer Fun

We've heard plenty of players voice these opinions about doctrines:
"I finally managed to get a 10x draw, and all I got was trash!"
"Others can take 3 T5 units but I'm stuck with 2!"

Your feedback has helped us realize that the power difference between doctrines is too large and that they're too difficult to acquire. So much so that many Warlords find the entire system off-putting. Our initial design intention was for everyone to be able to use doctrines at a fairly level playing field and for them to create more variety in battle.

Going forward, our core idea is that "efforts must be rewarded." We want everyone to have a fun time growing their units and that effort gives an equal measure of reciprocation. That's why we're combining the core content of each season: Battle Pass, Seasonal Units, Territory War & Doctrine Acquisition.

A New Way of Getting Doctrines

Starting with the new season, we'll provide a new way for you all to earn doctrines. You'll be able to exchange the new season's item [Daybreak Seal] from the Exchange (X) menu for the doctrines you want.

What doctrines can I get this way?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5f3878132c4cb4ed72573503d73f9062f3376db9.jpg

You'll be able to exchange 1 [Daybreak Seal] for 1 epic doctrine. The types available will be based on the season's phase, and the new doctrines that will be available are: [Epic Leadership Doctrine], [Epic Sword Doctrine IV], [No Quarter], [Epic Lance Doctrine II], [Epic Lance Doctrine III], [Epic Melee Cavalry Doctrine], [Epic Crossbow Doctrine III], [Epic Arquebus Doctrine] and [Epic Archery Doctrine V].

How many [Daybreak Seals] can I get?

You'll be able to get 2 every season.
The acquisition cap of [Daybreak Seals] resets with each season.

How do I get these seals?

You can get one [Daybreak Seal] by getting rank 100 in the season's [Hero's Road] (the free part).
And you can get one by completing the fifth stage of the season's 5-star unit challenge. Progress toward this only counts toward the 5-star unit of the current season.
[Daybreak Seals] are retained over seasons. So, you can always stock up on some to get a head start in a new season.

By combining our seasonal content, you should have clearer goals to work toward for rewards while also giving you the chance to experience more of each new season's content.

New Doctrine Fusion

Have you ever found yourself opening your inventory only to see it full of doctrines, few of which are usable? Apart from taking up bag space, low-level, duplicates or old doctrines don't serve any purpose. And so, we present you with the new Doctrine Fusion system. This should give you a new use for your old doctrines that are simply gathering dust.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6daee3684f8ff8799f44c3256b7109f11222aa0a.jpg

What is doctrine fusion?

In doctrine fusion, you will be using your old unwanted doctrines to create new ones. For example, if you've got a couple of resource doctrines in your inventory but you don't really gather on the world map, then you can use these to create a completely new doctrine. Or, if you've got plenty of rare and uncommon ones just gathering dust, you can use these to create a new one.

But what's important is: the doctrines you create cannot be gained from Treatises.

Must I use doctrines to perform fusions?

We know just how difficult it can be to get doctrines, so we've added a new item type: Doctrine Reagents. If you've got doctrines you don't want to part with, you can use Doctrine Reagents of an equal quality as materials in their place, thereby earning more powerful doctrines.

How do I get fusion materials?

There are plenty of ways to acquire Doctrine Reagents, such as matchmaking battles, Territory War, events, raising your Conqueror's Path rank, and the Fame Treasury. By not making it buyable in the stores, we want to encourage you all to earn it during your daily battles and conquests.

We're really excited about this new system, though, we're also worried that there's something we've missed or not thought of. We'll keep an eye on community feedback and continue to iterate on doctrine fusion going forward to ensure an as great experience as possible. Oh, and don't be shy with your feedback!

What's more, considering that some of you may not have kept either treatises or doctrines so that you can't try out the new feature when it drops, we've prepared a gift awaiting you all in the new season: simply login on enough days once the season hits to earn 50 treatises, and join the event that reduces the consumption of Doctrine Water. Keep an eye on future notices for more detailed information.

notes.title: Nov 10 Unit Balance Changes
notes.content:
Great variety on the battlefield is an integral part of the Conqueror's Blade experience, and it is toward that goal that we continue to change units, heroes and maps. Following our latest changes to polearm and calvary units, we've noticed that the Iron Reapers and Modao Battalion have grown weaker as a result. Community feedback has also made us aware that you're unsatisfied with their current state. But without further ado, let's take a deep dive into the changes.

Iron Reapers

As a classic damage soaker, the Iron Reapers are often tasked with making up the front lines or breaking through the enemy's defenses. Yet, in their current state they pose too little of a threat and have too low survivability if sent into the enemy's ranks. So, we've decided to focus on this aspect, and by dealing higher armor penetration and defenses damages, they'll gain both increased tankiness and better roles in the team.

1. New Effect added to [Shock] : Their flail charge will inflict [Sunder] to enemy shield infantry. Sunder greatly reduces the armor penetration and defenses of that unit for a short time, thereby bolstering the Iron Reapers' survivability when in the heat of battle.

2. Flair [Shock] always break the enemy's block and knock enemies down (previously sent them flying). Also dazes enemy heroes, making it easier to land more [Shock] attacks.

3. Flair [Shock] now hits twice, with the first being the collision for blunt damage and then they strike for extra blunt damage.

4. They now form into a tighter [Column] formation to easier to use [Shock].


Modao Battalion

As it stands, the Modao Battalion are fairly squishy when up against enemy cavalry, meaning that they in turn have a hard time thinning their ranks. This time around, we're upping their defenses so that they take reduced damage from cavalry and can more easily mount successful counterattacks.

1. [Imperative Orders] Changed To:

Takes 60% less melee damage from calvary while in [Modao Defense] (this includes calvary charges).

2. [Modao Defense] and [Modao March] both increase piercing defense and slashing defense by 100 for 3 seconds with each hit, stacking up to 15 times.


The above changes will take effect with the update on Nov 10. Oh, and keep that feedback coming!

notes.title: [CONQUEROR'S BLADE] CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7c5ace35437e8e75945fa1397f70b258996d1f36.jpg

ABOUT THE PROGRAM

What is Conqueror's Blade's content creator program? (CBCCP)

CBCCP is available each season to content creators wishing to cooperate with us. CBCCP is aimed at all who love Conqueror's Blade and for us to support those who create related content, and naturally, express our undying gratitude.

Whether you're a live streamer, a video creator, a strategy-guide writer, a painter or a musician, we cordially invite you to join us and help further Conqueror's Blade's community.

CBCCP SUPPORT

We'll be providing holistic support to help our content creators create more and better content.

EXTRA BONUSES

Our content creators will be able to stream or play the latest content before it hits the live servers, such as season previews, PTR testing, and more.

FREE PROMOTION

We believe that high-quality content should reach as big of an audience as possible. Once we've verified that your content upholds that standard, we will help you promote it for free and might even share it in-game, on Steam, our website, social media or Discord.

VIP CHANNELS

We believe that content creators are more likely to encounter a variety of issues than your average player, and therefore need better channels of communication with the devs.

TWITCH DROPS SUPPORT

We'll enable Twitch Drops events for your Twitch channel. At certain times, we'll enable rewards for those who watch your live stream to give back to the audience.

HOW TO APPLY

We'll be accepting new content creator applications once the new season has been live for a month. This means that our cooperation for last season has come to an end and a new one begins. Submit your info and sign up via the link below, and we'll be publishing a list with this season's content creators once it's finalized.

Signup Link: https://forms.gle/7fM6U6y4PnrSw5yc7
（2022.10.27-2022.11.10）

SIGN-UP REQUIREMENTS

We want as many of you as possible to be part of CBCCP, but to keep the quality as high as possible, you must meet the following requirements:
- You must be at least 16 years old.
- You must have over 200 followers.
- Apart from Twitch/YouTube, have a social media account that you are active on daily (Twitter/Instagram/Facebook).

CONTENT CREATOR REQUIREMENTS

Video Creators

Create at least 10 original videos related to Conqueror's Blade each season
Have 200+ followers on the platform
Have above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video

Streamers

Stream at least 45 hours per season
Have 200+ followers on the platform
Have above 30 viewers on each Conqueror's Blade stream

If you feel that you are unable to meet the above requirements, you still have a chance to become part of the program!
- Create content for Conqueror's Blade at least once per week (strategy guide, painting, music, novel, etc.).
- Conqueror's Blade must make up at least 20% of your creative content.

* Content creators bring us closer to our players, therefore it is important that you actively engage in publicity events that we hold (we'll issue notifications regarding these).

Code of Conduct

As a content creator of Conqueror's Blade, the content you produce will be seen and reposted by many of our players. As such, we need you to adhere to the following conduct so as to help maintain a friendly community:

- Follow the rules and regulations of your platform.
- Your contents must be original creations. We hold zero tolerance toward plagiarism and all sources must be elicited.
- Your content may not contain nudity or overly exposed skin.
- Your content may not involve religious beliefs, discriminate against a region or nation, and may not be discriminatory against others based on these.
- You may not abuse your influence to vilify others or otherwise incite conflicts.
- You may not use third-party software or use game loopholes to gain an edge. In essence, you must adhere to our rules and regulations.
- You may not divulge game content or related information before it is released without our explicit consent.
Be frank with us and do not falsify any data.

VIOLATIONS

We will deal with those who violate the Code of Conduct in the following ways:
- Issue a warning via email. 
- Revoke your identity as a Conqueror's Blade content creator.
- Revoke your identity as a Conqueror's Blade content creator and withhold any rewards.

INCENTIVE

Basic Rewards

Meet the related requirements for your type of content.
2800 Sovereigns
30-Day Premium Account

Advanced Rewards

Meet the requirements of the Basic Rewards, and have at least 3 of your works be published by us on our website, Steam or social media (Be sure to @ us so that we can find your creations!).
5000 Sovereigns
30-Day Premium Account

Supreme Rewards

At the end of a program cycle, all content creators may submit the 1 or 2 works you are the most pleased with/have the best stats. We will then be selecting 5 content creators among these who'll also receive the Supreme Rewards.
$200 Amazon Gift Card
Limited-time Epic Avatar (Issued after each season and remains valid for 3 months)

All fear him, yet, all wish to become him, too! And there's only one way to gain his power: to best him in combat!
No steed dares draw close to him as his body is enveloped in flame and lava. Plus, you do not battle on your lonesome. Use anything at your disposal and best the Pumpkin Knight with your allies to claim his power for your own!

notes.title: We Are Poros!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8165851b3ffc4b9df07d56dfa074a66a9a7d49d5.jpg

Hi, this is Poros :)

We’re honored to announce that from now to the future, Poros will take the torch of publishing Conqueror’s Blade in Latin America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East.

We know you might be a bit confused. That’s fine. We’d like to address the following questions to help you understand:

WILL BOOMING TECH STILL BE THE DEVELOPER OF CONQUEROR’S BLADE?
Booming Tech is the developer of Conqueror’s Blade and they are proud of having you guys in the virtual world of Conqueror's Blade. Poros, as a publisher, will be bridging developers and communities to ensure that Booming Tech will hear the global community and the community will be engaged in the process of completing the fascinating Conqueror's Blade world. 

WILL THE ENTIRE PREVIOUS PUBLISHING TEAM BE CHANGED?
Nah. Take it easy, they are still here. Veterans in our team now have clear goals and will take on various responsibilities in the community and marketing things. Everything will stay exactly the same!

*Violeta: Hey guys! (〃∀〃)

OKAY, SO WHAT CAN WE EXPECT FROM POROS?
Poros is dedicated to creating a more harmonious community to address your needs and help the developer to better serve the community. We look forward to the journey together with each single of you.

A huge thank you to all warlords for your continuous support in the game and for us.

Let’s conquer together on a high note.

Nice meeting you!
All Porosers

notes.title: Contest: Design a Shield for the Myrmillones!
notes.content:
As the latest Unit to enter the fray in Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum, the Myrmillones want to add some flair to their fight. We need YOU to design a new shield for the gladiators, then submit your entry for the Myrmillones Shield Contest via the Contest Discord channel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ab549e88589a2683b9573e49ffa537c0f92c5820.jpg

Check out the rules and prizes below, and make sure you enter before September 28 (15:00 UTC+8)!

Prizes

 The winning Shield will be in with a chance of being added to the game and will net their designer 50,000 Glory, 4,000 Sovereigns, and an exclusive Epic Title: Shieldmaker. 
 Second-place will receive 25,000 Glory, 3,000 Sovereigns, and the exclusive Rare Title: Shieldmaker. 
 Third-place will earn 10,000 Glory, 2,000 Sovereigns, and will also receive the exclusive  Rare Title: Shieldmaker.


How to Enter

 Your entry must follow the template design provided below. You must not exceed the parameters of the template or adjust the outer shape of the shield.
 Entries should be submitted via this Contest Discord Channel #shield-of-myrmillones. Please include your character's name, in-game ID, and server name within your submission post. (We may ask for further evidence to prove that your entry was created by you.)
 Only one of your entries can win, but you can submit multiple entries. This is applicable for multiple versions of the same contest across various regions.
 Entries must be received before September 28, 2022, at 15:00 UTC+8.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4836d9129127db2ae14031d1c6fd16723a09a1c7.png

Click to download the template

The picture below shows an example of a Shield design entry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c41d1575b7e728b8f97ac9a961d5ef678ff5603e.png

Rules

 Your entry cannot feature any pre-existing, copyrighted or third-party material. Only entries featuring original artwork inspired by Conqueror’s Blade will be considered.
 Images should be clearly discernible: Do not include any text, signatures or other elements that could obscure the image, nor any border elements around it.
 Avoid any offensive imagery within your submission. Specifically, no blood, skeletons, dead bodies, or religious iconography (respectfully used or otherwise).
 Images should be attributable to the themes and setting of Conqueror’s Blade: do not include elements such as cars, modern firearms or anything else that would be incongruous with the approximate time period in which the game is set. 
 Entrants found to violate the Terms of Service or break competition rules are subject to disqualification up to and beyond the conclusion of the competition.
 Competition judges reserve the right to disqualify an entry without recourse or explanation - in such instances, we will seek to justify our decision in private if it is appropriate to do so.
 You agree that your entry can be added to the game client of Conqueror's Blade in regional and international versions of the product.

notes.title: Play Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum Today!
notes.content:
Let the Gladiator Games begin in Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum, the new Season now available as a free update! Rise as a champion of the Colosseum in a brand-new 6v6 game mode, fight through the ranks in a new Seasonal Campaign, unlock Units inspired by Roman gladiators, and enjoy special launch events throughout September.

The Colosseum Battle Pass is now available to buy in-game, with the Gladiator Champion Hero Attire granted as an instant unlock.

[previewyoutube=KRcQmtqQhos;full][트레일러 영상][/previewyoutube]

Colosseum Mode

Enter the fray in the brand-new Colosseum mode, inspired by the gladiator battles of Ancient Rome! Fight in ferocious 6v6 battles armed with only two respawns, one piece of artillery, and your own Units. Lead the greatest gladiators in the world to glory in this new arena, and brave the trials and tribulations of combat before a cheering crowd. 

Learn more about the gameplay and design of Colosseum mode, then experience the spectacle for yourself today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5d00a62913e8b919eee47defeaf77843ad6aa921.png


Gladiator Units

Three new Seasonal Units inspired by Ancient Roman gladiators will be available to unlock via Unit Challenges throughout the Season, with each bringing unique tactics and shifting power dynamics to the Colosseum:

 Dimachaeri (3-Star) — Available Now: A staple of the Colosseum’s brutal battles, these gladiators are armed with two blades, which they deftly use to defend and attack.
 Myrmillones (4-Star) — Coming September 12: Trained from a young age, these fighters excel at combat and breaking down enemy defences with their sword and shield combo. Advance with their Myrmillo’s Guard mechanic to usher enemies to their doom and seize the advantage!
 Retiarii (5-Star) — Coming October 3: The undisputed champions of the Colosseum. They wield javelins and tridents, excellent mobility, and a secret curse.
 
Battle Pass: Exclusive Free & Premium Rewards

The Colosseum has opened, and many rewards inspired by the immortal reputation of Ancient Rome are yours to earn in the Battle Pass! Over 100 levels of Free and Premium rewards can be claimed by completing Seasonal Challenges, earning Glory, and levelling up during the season. Equip your new gladiator allies in the Equites Unit Attire, and ride into the Colosseum atop a steed adorned with the Triumphant Leo Mount Set. At Tier 100 sits the ultimate trophy for any true gladiator—-the Centurion Hero Attire.

Gladiator Champion Hero Attire is available as an instant reward when you purchase the Battle Pass in-game for 680 Sovereigns. Conqueror’s Blade is a free-to-play game, and there are many exciting rewards to be earned on the Free Pass too.

Draw Badge of Heroism from the Battle Pass to exchange in the Seasonal Store for weapon skins and revamped cosmetics not seen since Season Tyranny!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/73efc5ad057f670622096d5d7379721246904d41.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/69cddbcdae0f892897a110ad9fec98316405aad0.jpg

Seasonal Campaign: Colosseum

Ruthless conqueror of the city Ghazi II, allied with merchant guilds leader Stefanos is looking to win over the hearts of Continopolis citizens by organizing the legendary bloodsport. Enjoying the moment of his triumph, Ghazi II is unaware of the conspiracy web concealed by the shadows of both hidden and visible enemies. He is yet to discover, that the pain and suffering brought by the Gladiator Games in the Colosseum is just a façade for the event that is going to haunt Continopolis for the foreseeable future…

Fight to survive in a new chapter inspired by Ancient Rome and its gladiators, and complete Challenges to claim rewards from the Battle Pass in the Seasonal Campaign.

Start your journey in either The Borderlands or Bartholia, then fight your way through five stages of the Campaign in Territory Wars every Tuesday and Saturday. The final battle at the end of the Season will be fought in Anliang (Capital of Maoyang).

Territory Wars 

Territory Wars begin on September 3 and will be waged every Tuesday and Saturday throughout Colosseum. Participate in epic server-wide PvP battles which form the lion’s share of endgame content in Conqueror’s Blade. 

Take part in Territory Wars by joining a player-controlled Free House or Alliance, or a Cohort (NPC-controlled House) and expand your empire by fighting alongside your fellow warlords via the ‘Battle’ interface or in the Open World to gain control of fiefs.
Season Launch Sales

Begin your ascent to glory in Colosseum in style, with special launch sales now active in-game. Everything listed below is 30% off, so stock up on everything you’ll need to endure the trials of the greatest combat arena ever known.

Golden Treasure Order Bundle: Grab Golden Treasure Orders by the fistful, and pick up more every day for a week, available until September 8.
Consumable Bundles: Until September 29, you can pick up bundles like Warband Pack, Enemy Strategy Tome, Warden's Training Manual, and more with 30% off!
Useful Items: Until September 21 you can snatch up bargains on Battle Relics, Honour Reset Tokens, Personal Storage Expansion, Horse Trough, Heroic Epic, and more!
Mercenary Supplies: Load up on Bronze, Unit Medals, 10-Battle Unit XP Card, Expansion Permits, and Heroic Era Signaculum Boxes at a 30% discount—permanently!

Quality of Life Changes

We always strive to improve the Conqueror’s Blade experience with every new Season, and Colosseum is no exception, with new improvements to the user interface now available. Read up about every change in the patch notes before you start playing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/437a048a8446237e7bb2b73c5698ea8ed535f902.png

For those who are about to fight, we salute you. Download and play Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum today!

For more information about the new Season, check out the latest patch notes and balance changes. Get the latest Conqueror’s Blade news by connecting with us on Twitch, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Discord.

notes.title: Development Journal | Colosseum Mode
notes.content:
Why choose 6v6?

Conqueror's Blade has always been a game with a focus on teamwork. Be that a hero working with units or heroes working with heroes. We want to emphasize the importance of teamwork, and both Ranked Battles and CBL have reinforced this among the team. However, many players have voiced the opinion that they want to be able to directly affect the battle with greater space for personal performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/02326ee8582d8c32056b18867236a3a23fb87ac8.png

Both Siege and Field battles are epic fights with 30 players, however, within these massive battles, smaller skirmishes have their charm too. Our blood starts to boil when we watch the highlights you Warlords share in the community. We feel that Conqueror's Blade needs more diversified modes so that players have a greater chance to control the battle and show their strength.

Following plenty of internal tests, we believe that a 6v6 mode serves to realize both of these objectives. To this new mode, we've added mechanics from Field Battles and tried to change up the rules a bit for more variety. Hopefully, this will bring you all a brand-new experience!

New Mechanic & Unpredictable Battles

The unpredictability of battle is an important factor in maintaining excitement and freshness. In the traditional Siege battles, the most exciting part is without a doubt when heroes contend over that final flag. For Field battles, it is the constant contention for points and that the winner isn't decided until the very end. For the new Colosseum mode, we want to combine the best parts of these modes and increase the unpredictability, speed, intensity and competitiveness of matches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/11948d48c03f05ec85953866635fd546df217e81.png

Focusing on the performance of each player does not mean throwing teamwork to the wind. We've added three neutral NPC types to the Colosseum mode, and to defeat these, you will need to work with your allies. The three types of gladiators will make battles more unpredictable and more goal-oriented. No matter how each player fares, everyone has the chance to slay the gladiators and turn the tide of battle. As a warrior of the Colosseum, your every contribution to victory is commendable and will be rewarded.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/542a11b98459d7e3b1b393055f60cdead6d61b05.png

If you challenge and defeat the Colosseum champion, you'll win additional unit support and grow your power to hopefully steamroll your enemy. Naturally, beware of enemy ambushes so that they do not snatch the advantage right before your eyes. The team that lags behind must work together to seize the chance to turn the tables.

As the ranged and cavalry gladiators join in the middle of the battle, the fight will grow fiercer and more precarious. Both teams need to keep an eye on these, as they can easily turn the tide of battle.

Naturally, it is important to fight tooth and nail for every resource in the ever-changing Colosseum. There's only a single supply point and a single flag that shrinks with time while points deduct faster and faster. This means that every second matters and affects the final result. With these mechanics, teamfights will be more frequent and the pace quicker. Therefore, each choice and action you take will have a greater overall impact.

Apart from adding neutral NPCs and a capture-the-flag mechanic, we've also added an audience and speaker to add to the atmosphere and immersion based on the season's story, all to bring you a more authentic Colosseum experience. When someone performs well, i.e., kills a hero or earns a medal, the audience will burst out in cheers and shower them with praise—all an integral part of the experience.

We are looking forward to seeing your decision-making in the battles to come as you seize every chance to defeat your enemy, for each player to have a greater impact on the outcome of a battle.

The Future of the Colosseum Mode

We've seen plenty of amazing ideas and feedback in the community. We want to try something new with the Colosseum and deepen the feeling of contention and pursue more possibilities.

We'll be focusing on your feedback as we progress from here and continue to work on the Colosseum mode, be that regarding the rules, NPC types and power, or the flag point... We want to try out a variety of things to give you all more variety. What's more, we'd love for the community to give us all the feedback you have, your feelings and thoughts on the Colosseum mode, and your crazy ideas!

A new season is on the horizon. Let's get ready for battle and sharpen our weapons for this new journey. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Development Journal | UI Optimization
notes.content:
During the more than three years since Conqueror's Blade's launch, we've worked hard to add more and more content, which naturally means that our systems and menus are becoming more complex by the day. The current in-game menus weren't designed for and aren't suitable for the game's current complexity. In turn, this makes them difficult to read and use.

That's why we'll be making a series of UI optimizations to improve the UI's visuals and usage experience, with the first going live with the Colosseum update. This first update will focus on the most frequently used menus: events [O], matchmaking [J] and the weekly season lores.

Event Menu

The new menu will feature a flatter design to cover the whole screen so that each segment has more space. We've also made changes to the layout and interaction logic so that events and news are available in a clearer way.
This also means that information will be loaded faster and the menu will feel better to interact with, making it possible to quickly read the information that warlords need and interact with in-game events.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/97ca2fb1d7ee62c1c53c9ef526ee00d16503b195.png

Matchmaking Menu

As a core system of the game, the original matchmaking menu had a great room to optimize. For that, we've reorganized the game modes with the Colosseum season into clearer types to ensure all warlords can easy to join the battles.
We've added a journal for limited-time events so that warlords can more easily see which events are available for the day or the week. We've added Ranked Battle to its own menu and its rank rules and warlords’ rank will be more readily available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/521734c1660351d58ae1f1ff99a733adaf67e06e.png

Weekly Season Lores

The original design of the weekly challenges menu didn’t meet our expectations and very few warlords have been checking the weekly lores. We'll be changing the main page of the Season menu with the Colosseum season. We're also adding voiced narration and story images, and new challenges each week. This should make it easier to keep up-to-date with the story of war while you're busy with your own crusade!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1fc1c8b20f6c5c8e70114eb42776da7d59bfca0b.png

We want to improve the visuals and experience of the UI with a series of optimizations, and your feedback is incredibly important to us. Feel free to share your ideas about coming UI changes and what other issues the current UI contains. We'll continue to improve the UI design as we go forward.

notes.title: Gameplay Spotlight: Colosseum Mode
notes.content:
Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum launches on September 1 alongside a brand-new game mode: Colosseum! Participate in an Ancient Roman spectacle—the Gladiator Games—and witness battles for the ages in the new Season and beyond. 

[previewyoutube=WxbMu-ggIcA;full]https://youtu.be/WxbMu-ggIcA[/previewyoutube]

COLOSSEUM MODE: THE BASICS

This PvP mode will be available throughout the Season, pitting 6v6 against each other in fierce gladiatorial battles. Fight other players and deploy Units and artillery to drain enemy teams’ points, capture their flags, and win the fight. Along with an announcer, a cheering crowd cries out for entertainment as the realm’s greatest fighters battle for victory over their competitors. 

Here’s the important stuff:

 Colosseum Mode is available to players Level 30 and higher
 Groups of up to three players can participate
 Units brought into battle are not affected by Seasonal Seals
 Cavalry Units cannot be used
 Each player may deploy one piece of artillery
 Each player only has two respawns
 There is a single neutral Supply Point in the centre of the map


RULES OF ENGAGEMENT: HOW TO WIN

Winning in the Colosseum relies on both points and capturing the flag. Secure victory by reading up on the rules of engagement:

 Both teams begin with 500 points
 The team that drops to zero points first loses the match
 Battles last for ten minutes, at which time the team with the highest point score wins (if neither has dropped to zero points)
 Capturing the flag will reduce enemy teams’ points, but the capture zone will shrink as time goes on


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/34b859ff2db9fb734f6beb4e5400d32fdaf7b3cd.png

REINFORCEMENTS

It wouldn’t be a show without a twist! As the Gladiator Games rage on, Gladiator NPCs will spawn to aid or hinder you in your fight to survive and prevail. 

Defeating Gladiators will grant you extra Units which can be immediately summoned, called at the supply point, or available when you respawn. The extra units available are:

 Falconetti Gunners
 Iron Reapers
 Modao Battalion
 Pavise Crossbowmen
 Shieldmaidens


Cut down the Gladiator Champion and the rest of the NPC Gladiators will then join your side. Use them to capture flags and supply points! 

As the melee draws on, Infantry and Cavalry Units will enter the Colosseum. Watch out, as they will deal high amounts of damage and replenish their numbers as they defeat enemies. The extra Units granted for dispatching these foes are:

Infantry

 Imperial Pike Guards
 Grayhair Garrison
 Axe Raiders
 Claymores
 Berserkers

Cavalry

 Liao's Rangers
 Kheshigs
 Winged Hussars


Experience the phenomenon of the Colosseum when the new Season launches on September 1. For those who are about to fight, we salute you!

 The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
 
Items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
   Resources in Resource Piles will be brought.
  Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers CANNOT be brought.
  Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.
 
  Duplicate Names:
 Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.
 7. Extra Info:
 A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.

notes.title: Development Journal | Ranked Battle
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2140c90cfc0bc716352af1970e9a5814d795ec91.png

Essence of Ranked Battle

Ranked Battle is the most competitive of the modes available in Conqueror's Blade. It has always been our goal to have players feel their own growth as they climb the ranks, and for each rank to be seen as a milestone of that growth.

It has been our long-term goal to make Ranked Battle into an experience that revolves around competitiveness and cooperation. We have tried plenty of changes, big and small, in previous seasons, with the biggest changes coming in the Helheim season where we changed the previous scoring mechanic into one using stars. We have received plenty of feedback regarding Ranked Battle throughout the season from the community and customer support among some. This feedback has been a great help for us to realize the true competitive state of the new system, as well as its many shortcomings.

Current System's Shortcomings

We added star protection throughout the ranks of Corporal to General. Looking at the results, this protection did not serve to fully enhance the experience of earlier ranks, but also robbed players of a sense of achievement and competitiveness for ranks prior to General. A completely safe battle with nothing on the line is unfair to those who give each battle their all. While working toward a higher rank, no one wants to be matched with allies who care nothing for the results. Naturally, this new system has made it easier for those who don't care about the results to do just that.

Naturally, this protection has also made it possible for players to reach the rank of Captain-General even though they would not have been able to otherwise. All in all, this has given the ranks of Captain-General and Lord Commander a negative vibe. Those capable of reaching the rank on their own and those who wouldn't otherwise have been, all made it to the rank of Captain-General. As they clash, the former are met with players of much greater power, while the latter gets matched with weak allies. The results of a match are no longer decided by yourself, but are more likely attributable to luck. For most players want to be matched with better allies.

There's also another issue with the Captain-General and Lord Commander ranks: You gain as much from a win as you lose from a loss. And this naturally leads to frustration. And seeing as your stars are protected, players who are at just the right power-level for the ranks fall in a never-ending cycle of win-lose.

The current state of the final rank, Marshal, is closer to what we want to see. However, one shortcoming is that the absolute top players stop caring about winning and only about getting the MVP, so they stop working with teammates and that goes against our idea of Ranked Battle being a cooperative experience.

How to Improve

And so we are making fairly big changes with the Colosseum to try and remedy these shortcomings. We will be making the following changes:

We're Removing Star Protection & Extra Score for Marshal MVP

We have thought long and hard about removing star protection, and we believe that it only serves to make the competitiveness add more pressure overall. So, removing this mechanic is important and we want to make up for this loss of protection in another way. Our goal with the MVP getting extra score was so that each player would give each game their all, and for there to be possible rewards even in defeat. The actual effect this system had was different from our aspirations, and we want to realize our initial goal in another way.

New Rules: Valor Points

First, allow me to introduce the Valor Points system:


 You will be able to earn Valor Points by playing well in Ranked Battles and by raising your ranking. The top 5 players on the winning side and the top 10 players on the losing side will earn Valor Points.
 Valor Points can be used when you lose a match to protect your stars/score. While at max Valor Points, you also get an extra star. Players in the Marshal rank can use Valor Points to protect their score.
 The Valor Points required to protect your stars/gain an extra star differs based on the rank, with the cost going up at higher ranks.

 Our goal with star protection is to improve the overall experience of Ranked Battle, and we'll be using Valor Points to this end. Our first step in ensuring a better experience has been to give Valor Points to the top five of the winning team and ten on the losing team. Players stuck in limbo with win-loss, win-loss in the Captain-General and Lord Commander ranks will accrue Valor Points throughout this which they can use to raise in rank. The MVP will no longer gain extra points in the Marshal rank, but instead the top five on the winning side and ten on the losing side will be rewarded. This will mean that each player will want to strive for the win, as opposed to getting the MVP.

 These changes will speed up your Ranked Battle journey, which is why we've added new stars to some ranks to keep the pacing solid. We've added 1 star to the Sergeant, Vanguard, Warlord, Captain, Cadet-General, General and Captain-General ranks.


We hope that these changes will make it so that more players join Ranked Battle with the intention of fighting tooth and nail and reduce behavior that negatively affects the game, such as AFKing, throwing games, etc.

Idea & Focus of Future Changes

We will continue to iterate on Ranked Battle in the Colosseum season. There might currently be too little incentive to continue your Ranked Battle journey after reaching the rank of Marshal, and we'll keep an eye on feedback and ideas in this regard to ascertain whether this is indeed the case. And if it is, we'll consider adding more incentive to climb the ranks after reaching Marshal, and make changes to previous ranks too if needed.

We'll continue to keep an eye on feedback from our community and customer support. We want to hear your ideas on how to improve Ranked Battle so that we can create a competitive, cooperative and rewarding experience.

notes.title: Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum Opens on September 1!
notes.content:
Let the Gladiator Games begin in Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum, launching as a free update on September 1. This Season features an all-new 6v6 game mode where you can battle while commanding units based on the gladiators of Ancient Rome. Prepare to achieve greatness by preordering the Battle Pass with exclusive bonus content today!

Watch the cinematic trailer below to immerse yourself in the new Roman-inspired era of Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum, and witness the new mode featuring the musical talents of composer Epson Wu (Project X-Traction, Detective Chinatown) and vocals from Omega Sparx.

[previewyoutube=W3hcY3-iVYA;full][/previewyoutube]

SEEK VICTORY IN THE NEW COLOSSEUM MODE

“Gladiator in arena consilium capit”- Seneca the Younger

Rise to glory as a gladiator champion in the brand-new Colosseum mode! Battle in 6v6 combat in the grandest arena of all time while sporting limited lives and one artillery piece per player, with a crowd and announcer crying out for entertainment.

Lead your own units into battle and command additional reinforcements in the form of fearsome gladiators and powerful corps while honing your Hero and their skills in the most challenging theatre ever created.

You can learn more about the mode, including gameplay and map design, on the official website in the coming weeks. Then, experience the spectacle when the season launches on September 1. For those who are about to fight, we salute you!

ENTER THE FRAY WITH NEW UNITS

Even the greatest of champions need strong allies. Fight to survive alongside new Seasonal units inspired by the gladiators and soldiers of Ancient Rome:


 Dimachaeri (3-Star): Warriors fight for their lives in the Colosseum, the Dimachaeri are armed with two siccae swords on the battlefield, and their leaping strikes can’t be blocked. 
 Myrmillones (4-Star): Long-time champions, the Myrmillones were born for greatness. Equipped with swords and shields, they can knock back foes with ease. 
 Retiarii (5-Star): As ruthless in the Gladiator Games as they are in open combat, the Retarii are a different breed of soldier. Their tridents are as dangerous as their mark of death, cursing enemies while they charge with their pilums.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7876b1b809389e1f1cfc433371e2447e700bed55.jpg

RISE AS A CHAMPION IN A NEW SEASONAL CAMPAIGN

Embark on a brand new Seasonal Campaign inspired by the Roman Empire and their legendary Gladiator Games. The Emperor of the Herazlan Empire is losing favor, and his grip on his domain as a mysterious and powerful new faction rises from the shadows in a labyrinthine conspiracy against him. 

Endure the Gladiator Games against a backdrop of political turmoil. Begin your trials in the starting region of the Borderlands or Batholia and play every week to rise to glory in the Colosseum. Battle in twice-weekly Territory Wars with your House, and complete Stages to prepare for the conclusive clash in Anliang at the end of the Season.

PREORDER THE BATTLE PASS FOR GLADIATORIAL SPOILS

Preorder the Colosseum Battle Pass to earn exclusive bonus content immediately, and when Conqueror’s Blade: Colosseum releases. The following instant rewards are only available when you preorder the Battle Pass in-game before September 1:

Colosseum Battle Pass: Active from September 1!

 2x Heroic Epic: Redeem them from September 1 to receive 5,000 Glory per item and boost your Battle Pass level.
 10x Unit Medals: Each Unit Medal grants 5,000 Unit XP to a selected unit.
 50,000 Bronze Coins: In-game currency.
 1x Treatise: This allows the War Scholar to excavate ancient battlefields and collect Doctrines to give your units useful bonuses.

Fight for exclusive rewards throughout the new Season! Rise through the ranks to claim the Centurion Hero Attire at Tier 100, the ultimate apparel for a victor of the Gladiator Games. You’ll also be able to unlock the Gladiator Champion Hero Attire instantly when you activate your Battle Pass on September 1.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/73efc5ad057f670622096d5d7379721246904d41.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/69cddbcdae0f892897a110ad9fec98316405aad0.jpg

PREVIEW LIVE STREAM WITH DEVELOPERS

Morgen and Bread clearly know what’s coming on the way, and they’re ready to dive into the vibe of the Colosseum. On Aug. 26th, tune in to our official Twitch channel to take an early look at the season Colosseum. Whilst the preview livestreaming, feel free to join our Discord on channel #Colosseum to share your views on the new season.

More fresh information about the new season? Follow our Twitter, YouTube, and Facebook to get all you want to know!

Let’s bring the fire to the Colosseum and show your big plays to the opponents!

Death and rebirth, such is the fate of a hero.
The brand-new limited-time mode Clash Frenzy is here! Take part to get Fame and Varangian Spoils of War!
 Press [J] to access the matchmaking menu and choose Clash Frenzy. Make the best of what you're given as you stride into heated battle. Follow your stars and fight for glory!

From Aug 11 (after maintenance) until Aug 18 (until maintenance).

You'll be granted a random unit as you enter the battle, and you'll get a new random unit after each hero death. You'll be unable to get any other units during the battle. notes.title: [Helheim] CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM - Recruiting
notes.content:
The Content Creator Program is aimed at all content creators who make high-quality Conqueror's Blade content. With this program we aim to provide such content creators more support and help for even more content! From this point onward, we will be recruiting new content creators with each new season, and hope that more and more creators join us!

Registration: July 1st to July 10th. 
 

I. Requirements:

1) Video creator:
- Has 200+ followers
- Created at least 10 videos during the previous season
- Has above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video

2) Streamer:
- Has 200+ followers
- Streamed at least 60 hours during the previous season
- Has above 30 viewers on each Conqueror's Blade stream

3) Strategy Pioneer:
- Have created Conqueror's Blade strategy guides or related articles, including those pertaining to units, beginner's guides, etc.

II. Benefits

1.	Communicate Directly with Developer
You will be added to an exclusive Creator chat where you can talk directly with the dev team.
2. Exclusive Gift Code
You can share your own gift code with your fans while you stream or in your videos. Your fans can then claim extra rewards from within the "O" menu.
3. PTR Testing
You will also be eligible to partake in PTR testing for new seasons during the course of our cooperation, so that you can experience our newest content before anyone else!
4. CBL Streaming Qualification
You will be able to earn even more rewards if you partake in CBL as a caster.
5. Twitch Drops Support (only applicable to content creators on Twitch)
If you have more than 200 followers on Twitch, and we have cooperated for more than two months, we will organize Twitch Drops events on your channel. You can then enable Twitch Drops during certain times to help attract an even greater following.

III. Item Rewards

Streamers/Video Creators
Basic Rewards
Stream at least 60 hours per season with each stream having at least 30 viewers, or create 10 original Conqueror's Blade-related videos with more than 150 average views to receive the following at the start of the new season:
Sovereign x2,000
30-Day Premium Account

New Recruitment Rewards
During our cooperation, you will not only be considered an official Conqueror's Blade content creator, but you will also receive a gift code that you can share with your fans. You'll be rewarded should they start playing Conqueror's Blade and use your gift code within the "O" menu.
1) You'll get 50 Sovereigns as a reward for every 1 of your viewers that start playing using your gift code and reach level 50.
2) We'll add in another 50 Sovereigns for each of your viewers that also reach level 100.

*You may earn up to 10,000 Sovereigns from recruiting new players each season.
*Gift codes are only available for streamers and video creators.
*Gift codes can only be entered by characters below level 30 that were created after Dec. 21st.

Strategy Guide Creators
High-quality Guide Rewards
1. If you create high-quality guides that are selected to be used by us, we will reward you with 800-2,000 Sovereigns (depending on quality) per guide.
2. We will provide you with extra Sovereigns and/or other item rewards if you create a series of guides, articles, or create a site for guides.

IV. Content Creator Responsibilities

Apart from publishing enough content on a regular basis as per the above requirements, we also ask that you help with the following:
1.	Feedback/Bug Feedback: As a content creator, you are in a position where you can represent players and directly provide the development team with feedback or bug reports.
2.	Help guide newer players, be active in the community and help keep it active.

We will terminate our co-operation with you and withhold the proceedings of the month in question should any of the following occur (if the violation is severe, we may refuse to ever cooperate with you again):
1. Should you make improper remarks in-game, in player communities, or in your video/stream that affect the game negatively.
2. Should you play Conqueror's Blade with hacks or otherwise violate our ToS.
3. Should you abuse loopholes and these actions affect the game negatively.
4. Should you create a series of new accounts to raise your following and/or to have such accounts use your gift code.

Feel free to fill in the following form if you have carefully read the above information and are willing to join our Content Creator Program:
https://forms.gle/kqwksvTujeEo23zJ9

Should you have any other questions whatsoever, feel free to contact us on:
Discord（violeta#4335）
