notes.title: CBL 2022 Summer Tourney Rules — MENA Division
notes.content:
1. Schedule & Rewards
1.1. Schedule

1.1.1. Daily Schedule

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/416c5ee642d2f76fb17fac5a760b441b903d897a.jpg

1.1.2. Schedule Info

The exact time schedule may change depending on the number of registered squads. But, we will try our best to plan all matches on weekends or in the evening on workdays.

1.2. Rewards

1.2.1. Champion Squad Rewards

 Exclusive 2022 Summer Tourney Champion Title x1
 Exclusive 2022 Summer Tourney Champion Avatar x1
 Champion Frame (Limited-time) x1
 Exclusive Champion Attire x1
 Sovereign x10,000
 Golden Treasure Order x50
 Badge of Heroism x1,000
 Season Weapon Attire Selection Box x1


1.2.2. Runner-up Squad Rewards

 Sovereign x3,000
 Silver Treasure Order x35
 Badge of Heroism x800
 Season Weapon Attire Selection Box x1


1.2.3. Top 3 Squad Rewards

 Sovereign x2,000
 Golden Treasure Order x20
 Badge of Heroism x500
 Season Weapon Attire Selection Box x1


1.2.4. House Squad Rewards
A house squad (a squad where all members belong to the same house on the same server at the time of signup) that makes it into the top 4, will be able to have their house name displayed in a different color in the House List (for a limited time).

1.2.5. Things to Note on Rewards


 1.2.5.1. Seasonal Rewards

Items that change based on the season, such as Weapon Attire Selection Boxes and Golden Treasure Orders, will be issued based on what season is running when the finals conclude. I.e., if the finals were to take place in the Highlanders season, a Highlanders Weapon Attire Selection Box would be rewarded. This does not affect the Champion squad's rewards.


 1.2.5.2. Limited-time Rewards

Limited-time rewards such as frames and color changes for house names will remain valid until the Thursday of the week prior to the next tournament.


 1.2.5.3. Special Rewards

Should your squad win an Amazon gift card, we will contact your captain and confirm how to issue it. We will issue the card to the captain, who may then distribute it among the squad's members. If we for some reason are unable to issue Amazon gift cards, we will instead issue other rewards of an equal value.
Squads shall bear taxes for all special rewards earned during the tournament.


 1.2.5.4. Issuance of In-game Rewards

In-game rewards will by default be issued to the character you signed up with. We will be collecting information before issuing rewards, during which time you may choose to have these rewards sent to another character on the same account as the character you signed up for the tournament with.

2. Qualification

2.1. Successful Signup
Your squad must have at least 15 and no more than 20 members that meet the requirements.
A squad with members that do not meet the requirements may still partake in the tournament as long as they have between 15-20 qualified members. However, the players that do not meet the requirements may not partake in the tournament.
Your squad must have a name that follows the naming conventions. Check 5.2 for naming conventions.


2.2. Disqualification
A squad or squad member may not be allowed to participate or have their participation qualification revoked should any of the following occur:

2.2.1. Squads
The squad does not meet the signup requirements.
The captain fails to click the Sign Up button before the signups conclude.
A squad is found to have used a name that is in any form derogatory (after verification or being reported at a later stage).
If a squad's member(s) make improper remarks, they will be penalized based on the severity of the violation, and may have tournament rewards deducted, their participation qualification revoked, or they may be banned from partaking in further tournaments or their accounts banned.
If any member of a squad is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their entire squad will have their tournament participation qualification revoked.
A squad will be unable to participate if a member has their qualification revoked (for any reason) and this leads to the squad having less than 15 qualified members.


2.2.2. Players
The player does not meet the signup requirements.
If a player is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their tournament participation qualification will be revoked and their account will be banned. Their squad will also have their participation qualification revoked.
If a player makes improper remarks on the tournament server or other tournament channels during the course of the tournament, they may have their participation qualification revoked.
If a player's account receives a ban during the course of the tournament, their participation qualification will be revoked. However, their squad may still continue the tournament.
CBL reserves the right to revoke the participation qualification of any player found to have entered the tournament on more than one character.


3. General Rules
General rules apply to all tournament matches, including Siege Battles and Field Battles.

3.1. Tournament Accounts
The accounts of all contestants will have the same equipment and unit configurations.
No unit will be able to use doctrines during the tournament.
Heroes may not use runes during the tournament.
Contestants may only use artilleries of rare quality, and there will be a limit to the number of artilleries each player may use depending on the mode being played.


3.2. Match Modes
3.2.1. Siege Battles
15 players on each squad. (10 each on Linwu Fortress and 12 each on Quinn Ruins).
Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Victory Conditions
The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.


3.2.2. Field Battles (Capture the Flag)
15 players on each side.
Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Victory Conditions:
Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.



3.3. Game Version
The live version will be used.
Balance changes made during the tournament will also apply to tournament matches.
The game's content will continue to be updated during the tournament.
New units added to the game during the course of the tournament will not be available for use right away.
We might make new units available for use in the tournament after they have been available on the live servers for more than 6 weeks. We will issue a notice if a new unit becomes available in the tournament.
With 'during the course of the tournament' we mean from the tournament's first match until after the finals.
New maps added to the game during the course of the tournament will not be available for use right away.
We might make new maps available for use in the tournament after they have been available on the live servers for more than 6 weeks. We will issue a notice if a new map becomes available in the tournament.


4. Knockout Stage

4.1. Rules


 4.1.1. The tournament will be played as a double round robin, meaning that each squad will meet each other squad two times.
 4.1.2. Squads are first ranked based on the number of matches won. If multiple times have won the same number of matches, they are ranked based on the number of games won. If that is also the same, they are ranked based on game win rate. If they are still tied at this point, an extra match will be played to decide their rank.
 4.1.3. Games will be played as Best of 3. The first 2 matches will be played as Siege Battles. Should the two squads be tied after these 2 matches an extra Field Battle will be played. Should that match also end in a tie, more extra matches will be played on the same Field Battle map until one squad wins.
 4.1.4. Map Selection & Attack/Defend Order
 The two squads' captains roll before the match, with the one rolling the highest attacking first.
The two squads must ban and pick within the allotted time frame. If a squad fails to do so in time, the other squad gets to decide on both map and attack/defend order. If both squads fail to do so in time, CBL will randomize both.
 -Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the winner of the roll attacks first. The sides are then switched for match two.
 -Map Picking:
 After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map. The two squads choose at the same time.
 Maps: Hidden City, Augolia, Sun City, Riverlands Castle, Grassland Assault (for extra matches).
We will be contacting the two squad captains one day prior to the match for map selection and dice roll (to decide attack order).


5. Additional Info

5.1. Violations

5.1.1. Players on Live Servers
If a tournament contestant violates any of the game's regulations on the live servers and that violation leads to their account being banned, they will have their tournament participation qualification revoked. If a squad still has 15 qualified members after this, the contestant's squad may still participate.

5.1.2. Players During Tournament

 5.1.2.1. Cheating
Any contestant found to have in any way used improper methods (including but not limited to: malicious use of bugs and third-party software) to gain an unfair advantage will be considered to lose that match, and their squad will have their participation qualification for the tournament revoked.
 5.1.2.2. Other Violations
A contestant found to, including but not limited to, verbally abuse others or behave in an uncivilized manner during the tournament may have their participation qualification revoked or have points deducted from their squad based on the circumstances.


5.1.3. Squads During Tournament


 5.1.3.1. Punctuality
 Squads should be available for matches on time. If a squad is late, CBL reserves the right to penalize the squad based on the situation.
 5.1.3.2. Obstructive Conduct
Intentionally avoiding to attack or other actions aimed at delaying time. Judges have the right to deem a match over and disqualify a squad should such actions occur, as well as exact additional penalties.


5.1.4. Dealing with Violations
Squads or players that are found to have been cheating will have their tournament participation qualification revoked and will not receive any tournament rewards.

5.2. Naming Conventions

5.2.1. Squads
Choose a squad name containing between 4-32 English characters.
Choose a squad abbreviation of no more than 4 English characters.
Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If so, the squad will have their participation qualification revoked.
CBL reserves the right to alter the name or abbreviation of a squad if needed.


5.2.2. Players
Your name in the tournament will be identical to the name of the character you signed up with. There are no restrictions apart from the following: Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If it does, the player will have their participation qualification revoked.
CBL reserves the right to alter the name of a player if needed.


5.3. House Squads

A squad will be considered a house squad if all members on their roster are from the same house on the same server. These squads will receive House Squad rewards.
Whether a squad is a house squad is based on its roster when the signups conclude. Roster changes after the signups conclude won't affect this.


5.4. The roster cannot be changed in any way after the signups conclude. I.e., the roster as it stands when the signups conclude will be that squad's tournament roster.

5.5. Server Transfers

Transferring servers during the tournament will not affect your participation or the issuance of tournament rewards.

5.6. Tournament Live-streams

5.7.1. Tournament Broadcasting

We allow the CBL tournament to be broadcasted. We will also take requests for tournament streaming during the Knockout Stage.

5.7.2. Live Streams by Contestants
Contestants may stream their own matches. However, we recommend adding a delay to your stream so that your opponents cannot use this against you.

6. Final Interpretation Rights

The final interpretation right of Conqueror's Blade League belongs to Booming Tech.

notes.title: Making Music: Interview with Composer Epson & Sound Designer Zhiyu HAO
notes.content:
This is the last episode of Helheim music interviews. We’re happy to have composer Epson and sound designer Zhiyu HAO in the talk. They’re gonna be sharing stories of seasonal music-making. Let’s dive into the conversation with White.

Check the previous interviews with Colm and Julie here:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3342247086757790190
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3342247720909226550

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e01a78499507667710b68a6f4368a39e78ad7360.png

White: First, thank you so much both of you for joining us!

Zhiyu HAO: Hello to all you Conqueror's Blade out there! My name is Zhiyu HAO, I'm a film sound designer.

Epson: Hello all Conqueror's Bladers, I'm Epson! Those of you from Bilibili will know me as "Composer Epson". I make videos and do compositions for films and video games. Happy to meet you all!

White: Is this your first time working together?

Epson: Zhiyu HAO and I know each other well. Last time around we worked together on a boxing film directed by Li Yang. There was some friction between us initially. But now that we've worked together more we understand each other better and work well as a team.

Zhiyu HAO: As Epson said, we didn't know each other well at first and we were both used to our own way. And as we've worked together more, we've grown closer in terms of music; that's a process I really enjoy.

White: What do you think about when I mention the Vikings?

Epson: My thoughts may not be all that conventional. I've said before that I wanted to become a rocker, and I first learned about Vikings from metal music. So when learning about them, their most unique feature for me has been their hair. Then I learned more about their life habits in the film How to Train Your Dragon, including Viking symbols and characteristics. To me, what is most representative of Vikings are black metal, their clothes, and dragons. I guess that's a somewhat fantasy-esque depiction.

Zhiyu HAO: My first superficial knowledge about the Vikings came from books. I thought the Viking culture was an open seafaring one, a culture with elements of nature and primality.

White: Then how do you use sounds to represent what the Vikings mean to you?

Epson: I think that the best annotation for the Viking culture in music is the call of the wild. So during the creation process, apart from making the music feel a bit more modern, I also add plenty of tribal and primal elements, oh and that of the ocean. I will integrate these elements into the synthesizer with many layers.

Zhiyu HAO: I focus more on the clashing of armor and weapons, on representing the heat of battle.

White: This is the third time we're working with you, Epson. Could you share your thoughts on the difference in style for the three season's theme songs?

Epson: That's easier said than done. Each season focuses on its own civilization, meaning that I have to immerse myself in that civilization; I'm more or less learning as I'm going forward. But while the civilizations may differ, their music does fuse together at times. The most challenging was the music for the Highlanders season. By the time of the Paragons season, I had found similarities between folk music all over the world; not only in the simpler things like mode and harmony but also in the language. For example, the bagpipes of the Highlanders season are very unlike modern musical instruments that tend to conventionally keep to the 12-tone equal-temperament scale, and they don't follow the standard 440 Hz either. The difficulty was in making as great a performance as possible with a limited range and then adding orchestral music.

White: Zhiyu HAO, you've been the audio lead on several films before. What do you think differs between working on game music, as opposed to your previous films?

Zhiyu HAO: I honestly thought it would be huge. But Epson showed me the trailers of previous seasons and seeing that I honestly felt it was fairly similar. Especially this time around, it felt very film-like. The composition, changing scenes, and camerawork were all very cinematic, so it felt like home.

White: This is the first season where we've added lyrics to a seasonal theme. In previous seasons, we've relied on instruments and vocals to create the atmosphere. Do you think there is any difference between songs with and without lyrics in terms of composition and sound effects?

Epson: Of course there is a difference. We call music with lyrics songs and those without instrumental music. Instrumental music can be considered a more traditional way of expression. It is complex and has a prelude and sometimes a concerto. Songs are music where singing makes up the main part, and so, for this composition we had to focus on the singing.

White: So, Epson, what was the biggest challenge with this composition?

Epson: There were two, with the first being the music. Mainly because I wasn't familiar with this type of music. The traditional way of composing music wasn't a good match for what we wanted to convey, mainly because synthetic language wasn't suitable as it tends to focus on creating changing rhythms. I believe the first difficulty was how to control the music's emotion through these changes in rhythm for a more primal feeling. The second difficulty was that of the language: with the vocals being the focus of the piece, the song's writing would suffer if we'd been unable to cut sentences properly. So, we spared no effort in understanding Ancient Norse.

White: You two have both created music for many films. In your opinion, how do music and sound effects help progress the story? What role do they play in the story of our game or films?

Epson: Whether films or video games, there are generally two aspects we talk about. One being emotional expression and the other functionality. So, in the film industry, especially in Hollywood, the focus of compositions is always on two words: musicality and functionality. From the point of musicality, music serves as a symbol of sound, or rather an artistic emotional symbol that can leave a deep impression on players or the audience. For example, if you hear the theme song again after having played Conqueror's Blade, the gameplay will show itself in your mind. Or when you reach a critical point, the music will give you a sense of ritual or goal. All in all, music has a symbolic value and heightens the experience. And that's what we call musicality.

Functionality on the other hand is more straightforward. I think that music serves as a catalyst. Whether in films or games, music is more about making the product more complete as music is probably the easiest medium with which to convey emotions. For example, considering a heartbreaking scene: while the imagery and story itself affect you, a sudden change of music may leave you unable to hold back your tears.

White: Finally, is there anything you want to tell your fans or Conqueror's Blade players?

Epson: Conqueror's Blade is a truly amazing game. I can't fully experience all of its splendor since I'm fairly bad at it and always get crushed by others. However, in terms of culture, whether those creating the music and sound effects, the producers, design leads, and the entire team, everyone work hard to dig out the cultural stories behind each season. I believe that Conqueror's Blade is great in terms of culture and art. If you're an enthusiast of either, I strongly recommend you give it a try. And finally, I would like to thank all my fans! And sorry, I'll try to get time to upload more videos!

Zhiyu HAO: Thank you for having me too. It's been a pleasure to take part in the creation of the new season's trailer, and I hope that everyone gives Conqueror's Blade a try, especially the new season!

notes.title: Development Journal: Intercontinental Matchmaking
notes.content:
We've always wanted Conqueror's Blade to have massive battles with players from all across the globe. For players from even more countries and regions to compete on the same stage. And the intercontinental matchmaking is our first attempt at this: a cross-continental CBL tournament where players from different servers and combat styles compete. The positive feedback from our community and the success of our first attempt has deepened our resolve.

Since we launched Conqueror's Blade, we've successfully overcome three connection hurdles: matchmaking on a single server, cross-server matchmaking, and now intercontinental matchmaking. This has enabled more players to queue up together, fight together, and show their mettle. We reached yet another milestone during the Paragons season—matchmaking between our North and South American servers. In the Americas mode, players from both continents can now matchmake and play together.

It is with pride that we share this with you: we'll be launching a matchmaking mode connecting Europe, North America, and South America. A mode where players from these three continents can compete against one another.

What will intercontinental matchmaking bring?

Let's return to the most important topic: Cross-continental matchmaking sounds cool and all, but what will it bring to the table?

As a very unique PvP game, Conqueror's Blade with its 15v15 battles is sure to bring plenty of excitement. However, the sheer number of players required for each game is a challenge in and of itself. Following the launch of our intercontinental matchmaking, more players will be joined together in a single matchmaking pool, which will improve matchmaking in at least the following ways:

 Reduce waiting times.
 Reduce the skill disparity for matchmaking games.
 Extend the duration of limited-time events so that you can take part in events with less stress.
 Players from different regions and of different playstyles will clash in battle.


What are the difficulties?
Technological Difficulties

We are currently working on technology that will enable intercontinental matchmaking for all game modes. And it's possible that it will be ready in a few weeks.

There are plenty of difficulties with intercontinental matchmaking. First, the most direct is latency. Even under the most perfect of circumstances, there will be latency between servers on different continents. Second, connectivity is affected by different countries, regions, and their service providers, and this might lead to package losses and high latency.

To solve these issues, we're planning on making optimizations on multiple aspects:
Network node selection: We will compare and analyze the network nodes of the major cloud server providers and choose servers with low latency, high throughput, and high network redundancy for different areas.
Matchmaking optimization: Matchmaking will first search your area before expanding to cross-continental search. Our algorithm will be set up so that you are more likely to match against players from near where you are connected, which will lead to lower latency, quicker matchmaking, and more enjoyable battles.
Network usage optimization: We will do our best to reduce the amount of data required to be sent and received during battles. We will reduce the number of times network info is sent; some things that previously required ten or a dozen of send and receive requests will now only require one to two. This reduces the possibility of package losses.
We will do our best to use dedicated connections to reduce the impact that connections from different countries, regions, and Internet service providers have on connectivity.
We will keep a close eye on how this pans out. Oh, and be sure to tell us if you run into any server issues so that we may help you resolve these.

Time Differences & Events

South America, North America, and Europe span multiple time zones. As players from all of these continents will be playing together and as peak times differ based on the region, we must make changes to events as well. Setting these up in a reasonable manner is important to us.

We will prioritize launching intercontinental matchmaking for game modes that are always available. Once we've ensured that the experience is stable, we will gradually make it available for limited-time events too.

As for limited-time events, we'll prioritize ensuring that the usual weekly events remain unchanged while extending the duration of events somewhat to cover the different time zones.
Unified Gameplay Experience

There are however differences in terms of in-game content between the servers on the three continents, and that's a big obstacle to our goal of creating a unified matchmaking system. We will rack our brains for how to deal with this and bring an as fair gameplay experience as possible.

The biggest hurdle in this regard as it stands now is the Epic Leadership Doctrine. This doctrine is available on the South American servers, but not on the North American and European servers. A unit with it equipped will require 16% less leadership.

For players on all of these continents to have an as equal experience as possible, and considering the time players have already invested, we have decided to make the Epic Leadership Doctrine attainable from Excavate on the North American and European servers. This will naturally bring with it a series of changes to unit compositions on the servers of these two regions, and make for a new experience.

We also want to take advantage of these few weeks before we launch intercontinental matchmaking to ask you all for your opinions regarding this doctrine and the unified matchmaking. We will take into consideration all your feedback for an as good gameplay experience as possible.

What's Next

Considering latency and time zone differences, we will launch Intercontinental as follows:
South and North American Servers:

 Intercontinental matchmaking will replace single-server and cross-server matchmaking for all permanently available game modes.
 Single-server and cross-server matchmaking will remain in place for Ranked Battle and limited-time events for the time being. These will be replaced with intercontinental matchmaking later on, however.
 European Servers:
 Intercontinental matchmaking will replace single-server and cross-server matchmaking for all permanently available game modes.
 Single-server and cross-server matchmaking will remain in place for Ranked Battle and limited-time events for the time being. These will be replaced with intercontinental matchmaking later on, however.
 We will keep one extra cross-server matchmaking entrance for Siege Battle which players on the European servers can use. These game servers are located in Europe and will be better in terms of latency for these players.
 Players on the European servers may choose whether to use Intercontinental matchmaking or cross-server matchmaking in Europe based on their latency and preferences.

We will work hard on developing the intercontinental matchmaking system so that the server nodes with low delay are dynamically chosen for each player based on their network. We want every player to have a matchmaking experience where the servers closest to them with the lowest latency are selected.

This dynamic node system is fairly complex, however. We estimate that we will need a few weeks or even months to develop this and do enough tests before we can launch it.

Intercontinental matchmaking is an important step for Conqueror's Blade. And we're incredibly happy for all the hurdles we've overcome to get to where we are today. We are eager to hear what you all think about this new feature too! Feel free to leave your comments in our social media! Let us hear your voice!

notes.content:
1. Schedule & Rewards

1.1. Schedule

1.1.1. Daily Schedule

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/13bd410f450c57d3bd65513bdd54b549975b104a.jpg

1.2 Rewards

1.2.1. Champion Rewards

 $1,000 Amazon Gift Card

 Exclusive Champion Attire x1

1.2.2. Runner Up Rewards

 $500 Amazon Gift Card

 Silver Treasure Order x35

1.2.3. Third Place Rewards

 Exclusive 2022 Summer Tourney Third Place Title x1
 Top 3 Frame (Limited-time) x1
 Sovereign x2,000
 Golden Treasure Order x20
 Badge of Heroism x500
 Season Weapon Attire Selection Box x1

1.2.4. House Squad Rewards

A house squad (a squad where all members belong to the same house on the same server at the time of signup) that makes it into the top 4, will be able to have their house name displayed in a different color in the House List (for a limited time).

1.2.5. Things to Note on Rewards

1.2.5.1. Seasonal Rewards

Items that change based on the season, such as Weapon Attire Selection Boxes and Golden Treasure Orders, will be issued based on what season is running when the finals conclude. I.e., if the finals were to take place in the Highlanders season, a Highlanders Weapon Attire Selection Box would be rewarded. This does not affect the Champion squad's rewards.

1.2.5.2. Limited-time Rewards

Limited-time rewards such as frames and color changes for house names will remain valid until the Thursday of the week prior to the next tournament.

1.2.5.3. Special Rewards

Should your squad win an Amazon gift card, we will contact your captain and confirm how to issue it. We will issue the card to the captain, who may then distribute it among the squad's members. If we for some reason are unable to issue Amazon gift cards, we will instead issue other rewards of an equal value.

Squads shall bear taxes for all special rewards earned during the tournament.

1.2.5.4. Issuance of In-game Rewards

In-game rewards will by default be issued to the character you signed up with. We will be collecting information before issuing rewards, during which time you may choose to have these rewards sent to another character on the same account as the character you signed up for the tournament with.

2. Qualification

2.1. Successful Signup

 Your squad must have at least 15 and no more than 20 members that meet the requirements.
 A squad with members that do not meet the requirements may still partake in the tournament as long as they have between 15-20 qualified members. However, the players that do not meet the requirements may not partake in the tournament.
 Your squad must have a name that follows the naming conventions. Check 5.4 for naming conventions.

2.2. Disqualification

A squad or squad member may not be allowed to participate or have their participation qualification revoked should any of the following occur:

2.2.1. Squads

 The squad does not meet the signup requirements.
 The captain fails to click the “Sign Up” button before the signups conclude.
 A squad is found to have used a name that is in any form derogatory (after verification or being reported at a later stage).
 If a squad's member(s) make improper remarks, they will be penalized based on the severity of the violation, and may have tournament rewards deducted, their participation qualification revoked, or they may be banned from partaking in further tournaments or their accounts banned.
 If any member of a squad is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their entire squad will have their tournament participation qualification revoked.
 A squad will be unable to participate if a member has their qualification revoked (for any reason) and this leads to the squad having less than 15 qualified members.

2.2.2. Players

 The player does not meet the signup requirements.
 If a player is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their tournament participation qualification will be revoked and their account will be banned. Their squad will also have their participation qualification revoked.
 If a player makes improper remarks on the tournament server or other tournament channels during the course of the tournament, they may have their participation qualification revoked.
 If a player's account receives a ban during the course of the tournament, their participation qualification will be revoked. However, their squad may still continue the tournament.
 CBL reserves the right to revoke the participation qualification of any player found to have entered the tournament on more than one character.

3. General Rules

General rules apply to all tournament matches, including Siege Battles and Field Battles.

3.1. Tournament Accounts

 The accounts of all contestants will have the same equipment and unit configurations.
 No unit will be able to use doctrines during the tournament.
 Heroes may not use runes during the tournament.
 Contestants may only use artilleries of rare quality, and there will be a limit to the number of artilleries each player may use depending on the mode being played.

3.2. Match Modes

3.2.1. Siege Battles

 15 players on each squad. (10 each on Linwu Fortress and 12 each on Quinn Ruins).
 Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
 Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
 Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
 Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
 Victory Conditions
 The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
 The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.

3.2.2. Field Battles (Capture the Flag)

 15 players on each side.
 Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
 Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
 Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
 Victory Conditions:
 Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
 Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
 Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
 Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.

3.3. Game Version

 The live version will be used.
 Balance changes made during the tournament will also apply to tournament matches.
 The game's content will continue to be updated during the tournament.
 New units added to the game during the course of the tournament will not be available for use right away.
 We might make new units available for use in the tournament after they have been available on the live servers for more than 6 weeks. We will issue a notice if a new unit will become available in the tournament.
 With 'during the course of the tournament' we mean from the tournament's first match until after the finals.
 New maps added to the game during the course of the tournament will not be available for use right away.
 We might make new maps available for use in the tournament after they have been available on the live servers for more than 6 weeks. We will issue a notice if a new map will become available in the tournament.

4. Knockout Stage

4.1. Rules

4.1.1 The tournament will be played as a double round robin, meaning that each squad will meet each other squad two times.

Squads will be divided into three groups based on the draws. The three squads in each group will play a double round robin, after which the top squad is promoted. The three promoted squads will then play another double round robin to decide the top three.

4.1.2 Squads are first ranked based on the number of matches won. If multiple times have won the same number of matches, they are ranked based on the number of games won. If that is also the same, they are ranked based on game win rate. If they are still tied at this point, an extra match will be played to decide their rank.

4.1.3 Games will be played as Best of 3. The first 2 matches will be played as Siege Battles. Should the two squads be tied after these 2 matches an extra Field Battle will be played. Should that match also end in a tie, more extra matches will be played on the same Field Battle map until one squad wins.

4.1.4. Map Selection & Attack/Defend Order

 The two squads' captains roll before the match, with the one rolling the highest attacking first.
 The two squads must ban and pick within the allotted time frame. If a squad fails to do so in time, the other squad gets to decide on both map and attack/defend order. If both squads fail to do so in time, CBL will randomize both.

Attacker/Defender Rules: 

For the first match, the winner of the roll attacks first. The sides are then switched for match two.

Map Picking:

 After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map. The two squads choose at the same time.
 Maps: Hidden City, Augolia, Sun City, Riverlands Castle, Grassland Assault (for extra matches).
 We will be contacting the two squad captains one day prior to the match for map selection and dice roll (to decide attack order).

5. Additional Info

5.1. Squad's Server

A squad will belong to the server of its captain's character. Other members must have a character on that same server to be able to join the squad. Only players on the Espada Forest (EF) servers may participate in the South America Division.

5.2. Cross-server Squads

If you wish to join the squad of another server, you must create a character (level doesn't matter) on that server.

5.3. Violations

5.3.1. Players on Live Servers

 If a tournament contestant violates any of the game's regulations on the live servers and that violation leads to their account being banned, they will have their tournament participation qualification revoked. If a squad still has 15 qualified members after this, the contestant's squad may still participate.

5.3.2. Players During Tournament

5.3.2.1. Cheating

Any contestant found to have in any way used improper methods (including but not limited to: malicious use of bugs and third-party software) to gain an unfair advantage will be considered to lose that match, and their squad will have their participation qualification for the tournament revoked.

5.3.2.2. Other Violations

A contestant found to, including but not limited to, verbally abuse others or behave in an uncivilized manner during the tournament may have their participation qualification revoked based on the severity.

5.3.3. Squads During Tournament

5.3.3.1. Punctuality

Squads should be available for matches on time. If a squad is late, CBL reserves the right to penalize the squad based on the situation.

5.3.3.2. Obstructive Conduct

Intentionally avoiding to attack or other actions aimed at delaying time. Judges have the right to deem a match over and disqualify a squad should such actions occur, as well as exact additional penalties.

5.3.4. Dealing with Violations

Squads or players that are found to have been cheating will have their tournament participation qualification revoked and will not receive any tournament rewards.

5.4. Naming Conventions

5.4.1. Squads

 Choose a squad name containing between 4-32 English characters.
 Choose a squad abbreviation of no more than 4 English characters.
 Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If so, the squad will have their participation qualification revoked.
 CBL reserves the right to alter the name or abbreviation of a squad if needed.

5.4.2 Players

 Your name in the tournament will be identical to the name of the character you signed up with. There are no restrictions apart from the following: Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If it does, the player will have their participation qualification revoked.
 CBL reserves the right to alter the name of a player if needed.

5.5 House Squads

 A squad will be considered a house squad if all members on their roster are from the same house on the same server. These squads will receive House Squad rewards.
 Whether a squad is a house squad is based on its roster when the signups conclude. Roster changes after the signups conclude won't affect this.

5.6 The roster cannot be changed in any way after the signups conclude. I.e., the roster as it stands when the signups conclude will be that squad's tournament roster.

5.7. Server Transfers

Transferring servers during the tournament will not affect your participation or the issuance of tournament rewards.

5.8. Tournament Live-streams

5.8.1. Tournament Broadcasting

We allow the CBL tournament to be broadcasted. We will also take requests for tournament streaming during the Knockout Stage.

5.8.2. Live Streams by Contestants

Contestants may stream their own matches. However, we recommend adding a delay to your stream so that your opponents cannot use this against you.

6. Final Interpretation Rights

The final interpretation right of Conqueror's Blade League belongs to Booming Tech.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade June 16 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello, Warlords! 

We will update the game during our maintenance on June 16th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly. 

The update will contain the following:

I. EVENT NOTICES

[Northmen: Wolves of Ragnarök] Season Discount Event starting! Payoffs are 50% off for the season's unit quests during this time! Oh, and there are great unit bundles and unit training supplies to be had as well! 

[Wolves of Ragnarök: Fenrir & Berserker Attire Pack]
(This bundle cannot be bought after purchasing the [Wolves of Ragnarök: Shied & Spear Attire Pack])

 Fenrir's Pack Unlock Order x2 (Starts unlocking from your first incomplete challenge stage)
 Odin's Berserkers Unlock Order x3
 Unit Medal x50
 Training Summary x2


[Wolves of Ragnarök: Shied & Spear Attire Pack]
(This bundle cannot be bought after purchasing the [Wolves of Ragnarök: Fenrir & Berserker Attire Pack])

 Fenrir's Pack Unlock Order x4 (Starts unlocking from your first incomplete challenge stage)
 Odin's Berserkers Unlock Order x5
 Sigrun's Shieldmaidens Unlock Order x7
 Unit Medal x100


[Armament Treasure Chest]

 Bronze Coin Chest (10,000) x5
 Magistrate's Memoirs (500 Skill Points) x5
 Rare Equipment/Weapon Schematics Selection Box x5
 Purchase Limit: 5
 Price: 680 Sovereigns


[Golden Era Training Chest]

 Advanced Unit XP Card x10
 Unit Medal x100
 Bronze Coin Chest (50,000) x5
 Price: 600 Sovereigns


Runs from June 16 (after maintenance) through July 21 (until maintenance).

2. The Norse's Raids

Beware, for the seafaring raiders have set foot on solid ground. They cast coveting gazes toward the treasures of the south as they plunder any land, they come across in the name of the King of Ocelsi. They are hellbent on ushering forth a new era of bloodshed and chaos.

We mustn't let them have their way!

Go forth, Warlords! Band together and embark toward the harbors of Ungverija and Bartholia. Massacre the blood-crazed barbarians and revel in glory!

[New enemies are now available for war rallies—Longboat Raiders. They amass at harbors to launch their invasion. Warlords must band together and prevent them from causing more harm on the World Map.]

II. Balance Adjustments

Fenrir's Pack

1. Reduced leadership to 175 (was 180).
2. Reduced [Time to Hunt] cooldown to 23 secs (was 30 secs).
3. Reduced [Worg Sprint] cooldown to 18 secs (was 30 secs).
4. Adjusted the AI for auto-attack and [Time to Hunt]. Now Fenrir's Pack's attack will be fiercer and more intensive.
5. Each attack from Fenrir's Pack will reduce 60 points of all types of defenses of their enemies when activating [Time to Hunt], which can be stacked up 10 times. Following their attack, Fenrir's Pack will reduce 12% of damage taken within 1 sec.

Odin's Berserkers

1. Increases the rate of rage increase by 50% when taking damage
2. Damage reduction effect of each level of [Warpath] increased to 6% (was 5%)
3. Changed the effect of [Brute Charge] to “Reduced the damage taken from enemy troops” (was “Reduced the damage taken from Charge skills”). Improved the skill AI to avoid rapid attrition due to dense formation. Previously, Berserkers were not good at dealing with the intensive attack.
4. Reduced [Whirlwind] cooldown to 3 secs (was 5 secs), and Berserkers will gain 4 stacks of [Warpath] as soon as they use [Whirlwind]. Improved the skill AI to hit multiple enemies in an easier way.
5. The negative effect of damage increase in [Berserker’s Rage] state is reduced to 35% (was 50%).

Sigrun's Shieldmaidens

1. Adjusted [Shield Smash] from 3 stages attack to 1 stage. Increased its damage dealt by 25% and reduced its cooldown to 8 secs (was 25 secs).
2. Reduced Switch Weapons cooldown to 3 secs (was 6 secs).
3. Shieldmaidens now can switch their weapons with quicker speed (40% increased) in any state.
4. Shieldmaidens can increase 150 points of all types of defenses in 4 secs after dealing damage with spears; switching weapon to the sword in that state, Shieldmaidens can increase 300 points of Slashing Armor Penetration in 4 secs.
5. Shieldmaidens can increase 15% damage in 4 secs after dealing damage with swords; switching weapons to spears in that state, Shieldmaidens will recover 8% of their maximum life.

Unit Leadership Changes

 Men-at-Arms now requires 220 (was 240) 
 Expedition Knight now requires 245 (was 255)
 Tseregs now requires 235 (was 240)
 Ironcap Spearmen now requires 155 (was 175)
 Imperial Spear Guards now requires 230 (was 245)
 Spear Sergeants now requires 220 (was 250)
 Loyal Guard now requires 240 (was 260)
 Cudgel Monks now requires 160 (was 190)



III. IMPROVEMENTS

 Changes to level requirements to unlock content in the [O] menu:
 Event sign-ins, exchanges, and drops will now become available at level 15.
 Total spendings and pack sales will now become available at level 20.
 Limited-time level-up events will now become available at level 30.
 This Week's Exciting Event previews will now become available at level 40.
 Community events will now become available at level 35.
 The levels at which the permanently available sign-in and beginner level-up events become available remain unchanged.


OTHER IMPROVEMENTS:

 The donation & fame menus will now become available at level 35.
 Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
 Removed the 'Remove Unit' button from the Warband Builds, Pre-deployment, and Open World units. You can now simply right-click a unit to remove it.
 Added a prompt that the fief cannot be upgraded for fiefs in safe zones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f7dd76dd4f9bc36779a6de80ce07cde161202a1e.png

 Improved the prompt when obtaining an Attire Treasure Key. You will now longer need to click OK to close the prompt.
 Improved the display logic for artillery during Pre-deployment and for Supply Points. Artillery will now be ordered based on quality and type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/82bde9a25bb58f3584013d80b71bfd4ae2ce9150.png

 Improved the text descriptions for [Wolf's Fang] and [Giant's Mallet], the last two nodes of the [Huskarls]. These should now be easier to understand.
 Replaced the Requisition Order reward from the No Quarter quest with a random limited-time doctrine.
 Added the ability to claim rewards from all mail on the current page to the [Mail (Y)]. You can now quickly claim all rewards on a single page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c7a628ac2c46df5c813ab504e3ac0bea7476c003.png

 Having pressed ctrl to command your units, you can now simply press ctrl again to exit this state.
 Tutorial stages will now count toward quests even when only completed ones, meaning that you do not have to complete these repeatedly.
 Improved the visuals of the [Gorgon Siren's Embrace] male cape.
 Improved the visuals of the [Gorgon Siren's Embrace] male cape.
 Improved the animation of the [Varangian Guards] Unit Challenge menu.
 Improved the sound prompts for new player quests.
 Improved the video of the [Loptr's Hide] attire in the Conqueror's Path preview video.
 Improved the display quality of some attires when choosing to hide your cape.
 Improved the quality of the character-selection screen's BGM.
 Improved the Conqueror's City's BGM.
 [Attire Scraps] in your inventory and private warehouse will be converted into an equal number of [Treasure Fragments].
 We're removing [[Valley Fortress] from the Ranked Battle map pool.


IV. BUG FIXES

 Fixed an issue where [Maul] heroes could use [Up from Hel] and [Maelstrom] even when they didn't have enough stamina.
 Fixed an issue where unit type icons kept flashing for new players when selecting units in the Deploy menu.
 The [Prefecture Pikemen] and [Black Dragon Pikemen]'s [Assault] and [Push of Pike] skills have been merged into a single skill: [Pike Assault]. The Prefecture Pikemen will no longer be prevented from charging due to changing skills.
 While no in Column formation, [Pike Assault] deals damage equal to the former [Assault] skill.
 While in a fully formed Column formation, [Pike Assault]'s damage is greatly increased and deals damage equal to the former [Push of Pike] skill.
 Fixed an issue where the [Movement Speed] attribute was displayed incorrectly for the [Varangian Guards] in the Unit Details menu.
 Fixed an issue where [Glaive] heroes could block while airborne after jumping.
 Fixed an issue where one could get stuck while jumping near the wall by the Horse Seller in Conqueror's City.
 If the attackers occupy C without having occupied B or any extra point on [Heilung Fjord], the attackers will now get a respawn point near the front lines.
 Changed the descriptions of some runes to make them more accurate.
 Helmet Runes:

notes.title: Development Journal: Hero's Path Changes
notes.content:
Hello Warlords,

We've seen plenty of new Conqueror's Blade players say that they like the game, but don't really know how to play or how to catch up to more veteran players. Similarly, many veterans complain that it's too difficult to play with new players.

We've gotten plenty of feedback saying the same, and we feel it too. Conqueror's Blade truly is a game that requires you to be familiar with plenty of content and is highly skill-based. It does indeed take time to learn the ropes. And that's the basis for our Hero's Path changes: we want to help new players grow and better understand the game, and thereby make the game better as a whole.

We want Hero's Path to be an enjoyment for new players, a fun way in which to learn what to do, where to do it, and how to do it. And that each completed quest will grant plenty of rewards that will help the player grow.

There have been many iterations of Hero's Path so far, but there are still issues with it:

The quest-pacing is too quick:

Some quests are completed too quickly, especially the mid to late chapter ones. This means that players rush through them without really getting an understanding of what is going on and how to play certain modes.

Mismatch between quest content and rewards:

The rewards and acquisition speed of these from Hero's Path and main quests don't fully match the knowledge a player has at that time. This means that newer players get new things too early that they don't understand. Either receiving too plentiful or too few rewards may affect the learning curve.

And so, we will be making the following changes with the Helheim season:

Quest pacing: We will be changing the level required for some features as well as quest order and difficulty for Hero's Path. This should make quests have a more suitable difficulty and pace. Some Hero's Path chapter quests will have their difficulty increased, especially the mid to later ones.
Rewards: Following the change, rewards should better fit quest and character progress, as well as a new player's knowledge of the game at that time. We will be reducing the rewards gained from completing the main quests related to Hero's Path chapters while increasing the rewards gained for main quests related to Hero's Path phases.
Check the Appendix for detailed changes.

For this round of changes, we promise that:

The number of rewards from Hero's Path main quests will remain unchanged.
Hero's Path quests can be completed as they are now until the Helheim goes live. Meaning that you can still receive all the rewards if you are quick enough.
Your Hero's Path progress will not be reset when the new version goes live.

We will continue to make changes to tutorial content and its rewards in the future and will give advance notice before we do so. We want players to be able to play at their own pace. Hopefully, our changes will improve the experience for new players and help the game as a whole.

We've come to realize that there's been plenty of unreasonable quests in previous seasons, where some require too big of a time commitment and others can only be completed in specific modes. So we're rolling out a series of changes to the quest we feel don't work as well as we intended. We're also changing slightly how rewards work:

We've reduced the number of weekly quests to 6 (down from 8).

Random doctrine rewards will be replaced by Glory. Every three weekly challenges completed grants you extra 5,000 Glory, with a weekly cap of 2. Progress for these resets on Mondays at 00:00.

Adjusted the number of Glory you can earn from Weekly Challenge; remain the number of Glory from Gifts (Page's Gift& Squire's Gift& Knight's Gift& Marshal's Gift); and reduced the rewards of Glory from quests.

All weekly challenges will now be completable in matchmaking.

Weekly challenges will no longer be reset.

Conqueror's Path Changes

We're throwing in a greater mix of rewards and with better rewards in the early and middle stages of Conqueror’s Path.

Seasonal Store

Starting from the Helheim season, attires from the Northmen season will be returning to the Seasonal Store, where they will be available at a 20% [Badges of Heroism] discount.
The following items will have their Badge of Heroism cost reverted to their original price:


  Iron Fist Uniform (Sealed) will now cost 2,500 instead of 2,000.    
  Lord of Wrath Regalia (Sealed) will now cost 5,000 instead of 4,000.   


The following attires will no longer be available in the Seasonal Store:

 Weapon attires from the Dynasty season returning.


Other Changes

Customization: Show/Hide Mask or Cape


 You will now be able to choose whether to show or hide the mask and cape of some hero attires from the Customization menu.
 We hope that more and more Warlords try out more varied attire setups to create their own unique styles!
 Check the appendix for which attires are being changed.

notes.title: [Helheim] QoL Update Preview
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/152b02275b00a6860a7f3944d28c4a8b31bc89bd.jpg

"It's been almost three years since Conqueror's Blade launched. Together we have had many glorious victories and shed many tears of defeat. And we all wish to further improve Conqueror's Blade!

This period before the next season begins is the perfect time to contemplate the good and the bad."

Memories ≠ Burdens

Each season's battle pass is a cornerstone with which we convey the season's theme and the uniqueness of each civilization. We want all of you to have lasting memories of the various civilizations, not only in the form of units but also with attires and titles.

We've received plenty of feedback on Conqueror's Path and we've contemplated its reward distribution and the design of weekly challenges. All in all, neither fully meets our expectations.

We believe there's no better time than now to rework and improve these. We want each Battle Pass to be a treasury of rewards rather than a burden to bear.

Improved Ranked Battle Mechanic

Ranked Battle is one of Conqueror's Blade's most unique game modes: a competitive platform with its own scoring. It is the big stage where Warlords must hone their skills to perfect and grow stronger if they wish to reign supreme.

However, as it stands now in Ranked Battle, unreasonable mechanics has led to high pressure, overall negatively affecting the experience. And that's not something we're happy with.

To remedy this, we're introducing a new star-tier mechanic with the Helheim season. Hopefully, this will improve the situation and truly make Ranked Battle into the big stage it should be.

Each tier has a specific number of battle stars required to rank up. Earn enough stars, and you will promote to the next rank. Stars are earned for winning ranked battles and are deducted, scaling with your ranked tier on a battle loss.

If you lose a battle with 0 stars for your current tier, you will not de-rank to the previous tier unless you are currently on the Lord Commander or Marshal ranks. After achieving the rank of Marshal, you will start receiving Ranked Battle Score. Your rank is then based on your score.

For example, a player with the rank of Corporal, Sergeant, or Vanguard would need 2 Stars to be promoted, would receive 1 Star for a win, and no loss penalties or de-ranks.

Clearer Beginner Tutorial

We want Hero's Path to serve as a guide for newer players as they learn the ropes and a means with which to close the gap to more veteran players. It's an important system that enables players to quickly gain more freedom in the game. However, the current quest and reward design don't attain this effect. Instead, it makes it more difficult for newer players to learn the game and prevents them from gaining power as quickly as otherwise possible.

And so, we've reworked these to better suit our new players. Naturally, these changes won't affect your current quest progress. However, if you want to clear the quests available in Hero's Path right now, we advise you do so before the update hits. (Check the coming notice for the exact changes)

Norsemen on the Warpath

"The brave Norse has taken the fight to Helheim, and there they prepare for war!"

And with the war, other Norse units awaken too: Fenrir's Pack, Odin's Berserkers, and Sigrun's Shieldmaidens! These three units will all receive balance changes.

All three units have deep Norse characteristics and bring their unique charm to Conqueror's Blade. However, these characteristics make it difficult for them to perform well in the current meta.

We'll be focusing further on their unique features and combat styles. These once glorious Norsemen return in pomp and flair on June 16. (Check the coming notice for the exact changes)

Apart from all of this, we'll also continue to improve the other systems currently in the game and keep an eye on how weapons perform, such as the Nodachi, Pike, and Poleaxe. (Check the coming Complete Helheim Update Log for more info)


We must strive together if we are to make Conqueror's Blade even greater! Please continue to make your voice heard and share your feedback with us, as we continue to flesh out the game, brick by brick!

notes.title: Campaign Update Info | Developer Notice
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

 Today we’re here to share with you what changes are coming to the Campaign with the Helheim season.

Fresh Experience > Limitations

A hot topic among the team has always been how to continue to provide a fresh experience. In previous seasons, we've tried to gradually unseal units of the Heroic and Golden Eras, so that different units will be available during the various phases. We also design goals and quests for each phase of each season's Campaign to put some spice into Territory War.

These phases will bring change throughout a season, though, we feel as if we haven't quite hit the mark in terms of keeping gameplay fresh and goal-oriented. We've also received plenty of well-thought-out feedback from the community. That's why we're bringing new changes to the Campaign: it will contain more features and gameplay so that each phase will feel unique.

But with every change means taking a risk. We sincerely hope that you will continue to provide us with feedback and ideas. It is incredibly important to us in improving the game. Let's make Conqueror's Blade better together!

The new Campaign's main focus isn't on limitations but rather to provide a fresh experience:

Unit restrictions will be in place during the beginning of the season, meaning that heroes will have a greater impact. We hope that Warlords will choose their weapons carefully during this phase, and do their utmost in battle.
As the unit restrictions are removed, you will also be granted extra leadership. This is to encourage everyone to try out new units and create their own unique lineup.
As the season progresses, you will get access to even more leadership, meaning that you have even more freedom when setting up your strategy.
As you gain these leadership bonuses, you will also get access to more and more auxiliary unit points to further expand what options are available to you. This is especially true for those of you who are still working on unlocking your units.

As the season progresses, you will get access to better units, extra leadership and auxiliary points.

What's more, areas on the map will gradually become available as the Campaign progresses, unlocking more fiefs to contend for in Territory War.

* Ranked Battle is the most competitive game mode of Conqueror's Blade. Therefore, it will not be affected by the Campaign changes.

All-new Campaign

So, what changes can you expect?

Allow me to share with you our full update plan.

Phase One: Rise of the Norse
"The Norsemen's warbands plunder at their leaders' behest. Their naval raids are swift and fierce, leaving their enemies at a loss for how to defend. A name spoken of only in whispers is said to be the one leading them—Haroldr the Butcher."

Time: 6/9-6/19 (server time)

 Usable units: 3-stars and lower
 Set attributes: inactive
 Extra attributes: inactive
 Auxiliary units: 3-stars and lower
 Auxiliary points: 300


Territory War: Warlords may contend in the Borderlands and Ungverija.

Phase Two: Raiding the South
"The Norsemen are on the warpath and they have supporters within every nation. As their advance progresses, these fierce invaders point their weapons toward Herazlan's new land—Bartholia."

Time: 6/20-7/10 (server time)

 Usable units: 4-stars and lower
 Extra leadership: 20
 Set attributes: active
 Extra attributes: inactive
 Auxiliary units: 4-stars and lower
 Auxiliary points: 400


Territory War: Warlords may contend in Bartholia.

Phase Three: War & Plunder
"The war intensifies and the Norsemen are growing more ambitious by the day. They and their followers are no longer simply plundering, but waging an all-out war."

Time: 7/11-7/24 (server time)

 Usable units: 5-stars and lower
 Extra leadership: 40
 Set attributes: active
 Extra attributes: active
 Auxiliary units: 5-stars and lower
 Auxiliary points: 500


Territory War: No changes for this phase

Phase Four: Overthrowing a Nation
"Four years ago, Ungverija's armies surrounded a Norse warband led by Guthorm Red Eyes and betrayed Ulvar Isberg. Haroldr the Butcher has vowed to make Ungverija pay for their transgressions and has returned with a huge force of Norsemen."

Time: 7/25-8/7 (server time)

 Usable units: 5-stars and lower
 Extra leadership: 60
 Set attributes: active
 Extra attributes: active
 Auxiliary units: 5-stars and lower
 Auxiliary points: 600


Territory War: Turul Város is available for contention.

Phase Five: The Supreme Ruler

"Six years ago, the Herazlans invaded Continopolis, toppling the Barcyan empire. Six years ago, the nations of the west still fought against the Herazlans, yet none dared to launch a full-out attack.

None save for Haroldr the Butcher. He readied his forces and issued a call to arms to all heroes in the world, asking for their aid in assaulting Herazlan's capital."

Time: 8/8-8/21 (server time)

 Usable units: 5-stars and lower
 Extra leadership: 100
 Set attributes: active
 Extra attributes: active
 Auxiliary units: 5-stars and lower
 Auxiliary points: 600


Territory War: Continopolis and Turul Város are available for contention.

The above numbers are for reference only and we may adjust some of these in the future. Check our latest notices for the most up-to-date info.

Last But Not Least

These changes to the Campaign are for us an important attempt in improving the game. We hope to flesh out each phase even further in the seasons to come, both in terms of how battles play out and the rules. We want to add more features to the Campaign so that each phase is an enjoyable experience with greater variety.

Conqueror's Blade belongs to all of your Warlords. We wish to continue to make it better together. We've had the honor to receive plenty of feedback in the past. And for the future, we will strive to improve communication on our end and gather feedback more effectively. We sincerely hope that this round of changes will make the Campaign overall more enjoyable!

As always, thank you for your support! And see you on the battlefield!

The land

notes.title: [Season Preview] 5-Star Unit: Varangian Guards
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade's new season, Helheim, begins on June 9! From among the raging Norsemen, two new units will be joining the ever-growing roster available, and the second of these will be the Varangian Guards!

The Norse era truly is a legendary one, during which the Varangian Guards left their mark on history.

[previewyoutube=E-pYFWjXYpc;leftthumb]https://youtu.be/E-pYFWjXYpc[/previewyoutube]

Star Level: ★★★★★

Background Info:

This imperial heavy infantry troop of Barcyan comprises Norse mercenaries who have traveled wide and far. They swore upon their weapons that they would help maintain stability to the best of their ability: to serve as a moat for those wishing to harm their masters.
While the Varangian Guards were more akin to a group of mercenaries than a full-fledged legion, they stayed true to their promises and aided Barcyan where it was needed. In turn, Barcyan Empire bestowed upon them high-quality weapons and good pay.
The young Haroldr joined the Varangian Guards during his travels around the world. Owing to his military experience, he soon became their captain. Here he honed his skills in battle further, learning from both the Varangians and the Barcyan army. This knowledge later enabled him to summon his former subordinates upon his return to the north after Barcyan Empire's fall—effectively recreating the Varangian Guards anew.
These ferocious professional warriors ended up being what ultimately enabled Haroldr the Butcher to conquer Ocelsi.

Unit Characteristics:

While in shield stance, they have fairly high defense and gain rage when taking damage or killing enemy heroes.
They deal high damage while wielding their massive two-handed axes and can expend rage to unleash skills for high burst and sustained damage.

Remember, never anger a Varangian in battle. For should their rage reach boiling point, they become nigh unstoppable machines of war!

notes.title: Paragons Server Transfer Info
notes.content:
The Paragons season is about to end and a new season begin.

And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

Server Transfer Time

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on June 2nd, Thursday, after maintenance, and run through June 8th, Wednesday, 23:59 (UTC+8).
Character transfers will be performed during the new season's maintenance.

Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
2. Players may transfer without restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Quotas


 Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
 Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
 Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
 Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
 Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
 Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
 Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
 Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
 Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
 Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
 Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
 Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
 Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
 Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
 Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
 Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
 Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
 Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
 Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
 Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.

Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

How to Transfer

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred following the new season's maintenance.

*Important:

1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before June 8th, 23:59 (UTC+8). Upon canceling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon canceling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.

3. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.

4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.

5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
2) Resources in Resource Piles will be brought.
3) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers CANNOT be brought.
4) Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.

6. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

7. Extra Info:
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.

notes.content:
Hello, Warlords! 

We will update the game during our maintenance on May 26th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance, we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly. 

The update will contain the following:

I. EVENTS

[Wyrmbane Armor] Attire Treasure returns for a limited time.

All things change with the passing of time. The [Sun Emperor] Attire Treasure event is coming to an end and the [Wyrmbane Armor] Attire Treasure is returning for a limited time! Press [G] to access Attire Treasures and get your exclusive attires!

Runs from May 26 (after maintenance) through June 23 (until maintenance). 

[Extra Leadership Mode] Available Now

Warlords now have extra 100 leadership – go master your units!

Runs from May 26 (after maintenance) through June 9 (view details on This Week’s  Exciting Events)

Preorders begin for the Helheim season's 4-star unit. Get your hand on these fearsome soldiers as quickly as possible!

You can preorder the Huskarls by purchasing any of the following bundles:

[Huskarls Basic Preorder Bundle]
Contains:

Huskarls Unlock Order x3 (enough to complete three parts of their season challenges)

Price: 1,680 Sovereigns

[Huskarls Deluxe Preorder Bundle]

Huskarls Unlock Order x5 (enough to complete five parts of their season challenges)

Price: 2,800 Sovereigns

Available between May 26 (after maintenance) through June 9, 0:00.

II. IMPROVEMENTS


 Improved the UI prompt when near interactable artillery, enabling you to see the reload progress of allies' artillery.
 Improved Premium Account Gold Pack's icon.


III. HERO CHANGES


 You can now use [Sprint Attack] even if you don't have enough stamina, but doing so expands all remaining stamina. This affects the following weapons: Pike, Spear, Glaive, Poleaxe, Dual Blades, Nodachi, Maul, Shortsword & Shield, and Longsword & Shield.
 [Sprint Attack]'s stamina cost increased to 250 (was 185) for all weapons.


IV. BUG FIXES


 Fixed an issue where no [Health Drain] was gained when a Nodachi hero's skill was interrupted too quickly.
 Right-click attack while mounted previously consumed 600 stamina. Now, hold down to ready your weapon at the cost of 300 stamina per second and an extra 500 when you release to attack. You can still attack even if your stamina drops below 500.
 Fixed an issue where the attack would fail if you fully charged up the Spear's right-click attack while mounted and ran out of stamina.
 Fixed an issue where the attack would fail if you fully charged up the Pike's right-click attack while mounted and ran out of stamina.
 Fixed an issue where the units available for [Shoreline Conquest (Clash)]'s Alternating Tactics unit ruleset differed from the ruleset's description:
 The 3-star units [Fenrir's Pack] and [Halberdiers] are not available for this ruleset.
 The 4-star unit [Halberdier Sergeants] is available for this ruleset.
 Fixed an issue where the attackers didn't receive any text or voice prompts when the defenders recaptured C on [Shoreline Conquest (Clash)].
 Fixed an issue where heroes could get stuck at some places on [La Grande Gloire].
 Fixed an issue where forging icons would disappear if you entered the Forge menu repeatedly.
 Fixed an issue where the color of team members was displayed incorrectly on the map (tab).
 Fixed an issue where the icons for flag and supply points were too big when having the minimap set to 'Nearby'.
 Fixed an issue where the fog would disappear when switching between some camera settings.
 Added Epilepsy warnings when loading videos in the game.

notes.title: [Season Preview] 4-Star Unit: Huskarls
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade's new season, Helheim, begins on June 9! From among the raging Norsemen, two new units will be joining the ever-growing roster available, and the first of these will be the Huskarls!

The Norse are known in history for their fierce loyalty and their courage in battle, especially the Huskarls(húskarl). They were well-trained and served to protect their lord.

[previewyoutube=yIzOCMzsfvE;full]https://youtu.be/yIzOCMzsfvE[/previewyoutube]

In this season, Haroldr the Butcher will take assume command over the Huskarls as his own personal guard. Known as the mightiest warriors of the north, these Huskarls will buff those Norse warriors who fight alongside them.

Star Level: ★★★★☆

Background Info:

These warriors served as Haroldr the Butcher's personal guard during his conquest of the seas. Most are veteran Norse warriors from the frigid north. They followed him through many a battle before he assumed the throne.

From the early days when Haroldr conquered the other Norse tribes, to the later blood-filled battles to unite Ocelsi and expand his territory, they could always be seen at his side. As if silently proclaiming the Butcher's brutality and unwavering resolve.

After he assumed the throne in Ocelsi, the first act he did was to forge this set of armor for his brave warriors. Now armed with superior armor and hand axes, he bestowed upon them a new name: Huskarls.

Unit Characteristics:

They wear shields and are fairly strong at blocking and can follow in their commander's heels.

The Huskarls can raise their weapons and chant a war song of old, bolstering the movement speed, slashing armor penetration, and blunt armor penetration of their Norse companions, as well as reducing the damage they take. The song's effect increases the longer they chant.

Preorders for the Huskarls become available in-game after the May 26 update!

Preorders available between May 26 (after maintenance) through June 9, 0:00 (UTC+8).

[Huskarls Basic Preorder Bundle]

Contains:
Huskarls Unlock Order x3 (enough to complete three parts of their season challenges)
Price: 1,680 Sovereigns

[Huskarls Deluxe Preorder Bundle]

Huskarls Unlock Order x5 (enough to complete five parts of their season challenges)
Price: 2,800 Sovereigns

Respond to the Norsemen's call to war!

You will be able to unlock the Huskarls by completing their Season Challenges after the Helheim season goes live on June 9.

notes.title: Conqueror’s Blade: Helheim Coming June 9!

[previewyoutube=UEObcs_uo7w;full]https://youtu.be/UEObcs_uo7w

The brand-new Seasonal Campaign is inspired by sea-faring Norse raiders. The Northmen seek to re-establish their empire on new and distant shores—heed the battle call in the starting region of the Borderlands or Ungverija and play every week to see their saga unfold. You’ll initially have access to 3-Star Units across Siege, Field, and Territory Wars battles, and your power will only grow as the Season progresses.

[Quinn Ruins] will be available on June 9, with the raiders making appearances on new maps as the Season progresses.

PREORDER THE SEASON PASS FOR LEGENDARY TREASURES

Preorder the Helheim Season Pass to earn exclusive bonus content straight away and when Conqueror’s Blade: Helheim launches. The following instant rewards are only available when you pre-order the Season Pass in-game before June 9:

Plunder and pillage for exclusive rewards throughout the new Season! At Tier 100 lies the most formidable armor a true Northman could wear—[Bringer of Thunder], inspired by Thor himself.
