notes.title: Changes to Attire Treasures
notes.content:
Ever since the launch of [Attire Treasures (G)], we've received much feedback from players saying that the system is overly complex. As such, we'll be rolling out the following improvements to it with the Mar. 24 update. This should make the system easier to understand and use.

1. All event-related attire treasures will be opened with the new item [Treasure Order]. It'll always be available under [Store - Consumables].
2. All your unopened event-related attire treasures will be converted into an equal number of Treasure Orders. I.e., if you have 5 unopened Jaden Attire Treasures and 10 Tiger General Attire Treasures prior to the update, these will be converted into 15 Treasure Orders at the time of the update. Following the update, you can check your Treasure Orders within the [Attire Treasures (G)] menu, from which you can unlock Attire Treasures as they come on rotation.

Before Change:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9185eee631a64bb68d956ff71514cb3a8e5106be.png
   
After Change:
 	 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3a35a4e3fa9f93dffcace2eab7f48801ebbc4a95.png

3. Already launched attire treasures will be available on rotation in the new Attire Treasure menu. Stay tuned for future notices for the times and content of each rotation.
	The following attire treasures will be converted:

 Mercenary Attire Treasure
 Thousand Spire Attire Treasure
 Jaden Attire Treasure
 Wyrmbane Armor Attire Treasure
 Shadowlight Attire Treasure


If you own any of the above attire treasures, head into the Attire Treasure menu and open these before the March 24 update.
	Note: Artisan's Attire Treasures will not be converted at this time. Instead, we are currently working on upgrading these! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Mar. 19 Temporary Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord:

We will be performing temporary maintenance tomorrow (Mar. 19) between 2:00 and 6:30 (UTC+8). This affects the LA, DI, JC, EF and SG servers. During this maintenance, we deal with those who requested server transfers that experienced issues and return those who canceled their transfer requests but were transferred anyway. We estimated this maintenance will last 4.5 hours. You will be unable to log in to the game during this time. Thank you for your continued support and trust.

Compensation for Everyone:

 Bronze Coin x18,000
 Honor x600
 Unit Medal x30
 Treatise x1


We will also grant extra compensation to those affected.

Extra Compensation:

 Treatise x3 
 Bronze Coin x50,000 
 5,000 Paragons Glory x2 
 30-Day Premium Account x1


While Awaiting Transfer:

1. You can still play on your character as per usual on your original server. 
2. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. (If you do not leave your house, alliance/Imperial Restorationists before the transfer, you will be displayed as offline there but will not be automatically removed.)
3. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer: 

 1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought. 
 2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, nor can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything. 
 
Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server. 

4. Duplicate Names: 
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name. 
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1. 
5. Extra Info: 
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.
We are sorry for any inconvenience caused. And thank you for your understanding. Oh, and may your victories be plenty!

notes.title: [Paragons] Launch Notice
notes.content:
A new era has arrived! 

Conqueror’s Blade: Paragons is now available as a free update! Discover everything the prosperous and proud Falois has to offer, including a new Seasonal Campaign, units, a Siege Map, and quality of life updates. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3b115b6a12c3a138591d69ca6c6b0edbc8f947af.jpg

[New Units]

Complete the Paragons season's unit challenges to unlock brand-new units! Two of which come with never-before-seen mechanics!

  Alchemists (3 Star): Available Now
 The Alchemists are the second all-female unit in Conqueror's Blade and will provide their allies with healing. Yet, they will also use their knowledge of alchemy to create smoke as cover.
  Banner Guards (4 Star): Available on March 28
 These veteran soldiers bear a banner and excel in all manner of weapons. With their banner, they can inspire their allies to boost their attack and defense.
  Chevaliers (5 Star) Available on April 18
 A lavishly equipped cavalry force, fitted with a ‘retinue’ mechanic that allows them to command units of their own.


[previewyoutube=xN-OcosNbNE;full]https://youtu.be/xN-OcosNbNE[/previewyoutube]

[New Season Journey]

March with the armies of light and unlock plenty of Season Pass rewards!

  Territory War will be available on Tuesdays and Saturdays starting from Mar. 19, after which the houses will fight for contention during the five phases. The war begins in the Borderlands and will escalate into Ungverija and Ostaria. The final battle of the season will unfold on May 16 where our Warlords will contend for the ultimate victory in Augolia.
  The new season's Ranked Battles will begin on Mar. 18.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d29d4eac82582a82e73a234447cc1279e82c569e.jpg

Check out our latest update log for more information on Territory War, the new map, Battle Pass rewards, and more!
Oh, and follow us on Twitch, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube and Discord to keep up to date with the latest Conqueror's Blade news!

notes.title: Development Journal | Balance Changes
notes.content:
To all Conqueror's Blade players: 
We received plenty of player feedback regarding balance in the Highlanders season, and so we've decided to make some changes in the new season. 

I. Analysis of the Underlying Issue 

Based on player feedback, we've learned that the current state of combat and our development speed aren't fully aligned. Previously, our strategy with outdated inferior units has been to remake them with new mechanics, however, the speed at which we push out these remakes just won't keep up with the game's updates. Instead of the gap growing closer, the difference between units has been increasing. Thus, we've decided to roll out smaller but quicker changes to remedy balance issues. 

II. Ideas on Changes 

[olist]
  Increase in Scope: Balance change will cover more heroes, units and runes. 
  Increase in Frequency: We will increase the rate at which we roll out these balance changes, making them part of general updates. 
  Control Scope: Our balance changes will be targeting the stats of units and the damage of hero skills. We won't change the mechanics of heroes and units, but instead work toward greater balance by slight number adjustments. 
 Iterated Changes: We will analyze and reference the results of each balance chance, and from there continue to improve our strategy of combating imbalance.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] VIOLATION PENALTIES
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade upholds the value of faireness as we work hard on creating a fair and just game environment. We have zero-tolerance toward those that break our regulations and will crack down upon any such behavior to maintain a good game environment.
Common violations mainly include, but are not limited to, the following:

CHAT VIOLATIONS				
						
1. 72-hour mute——Minor chat violations (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services), abusive language, spam, etc.
2. 720-hour mute	——Multiple minor chat violations (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), or if a single player violates this on multiple characters.
3. 30-day soft ban——Severe chat violations (including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
4. Permanent ban——Multiple severe chat violations (including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services). This includes violations of the same player on multiple characters.		
			
NICKNAME VIOLATIONS		
							
1. Forced name change——Nicknames that violate our regulations (minor naming violations: those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
2. Permanent ban——Nicknames that severely violate our regulations (including those containing racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.)

THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE USAGE	

1. Permanent ban——Having been found to use or have used third-party software, including but not limited to, cheats, automatic scripts, and modifiers.				

Using unallowed third-party software to perform in-game actions——These include but are not limited to cheats, automatic scripts, and modifiers. Actions such as these are harmful to the game at large and seriously affect the fairness of gameplay. Using such hacks/software adversely affects the client and servers' stability, and may lead to you having your account stolen.
We will crack down on and severely punish anyone using third-party software that violates our regulations and anyone using any type of hacks.


OBSTRUCTIVE CONDUCT

Obstructive conduct includes but not limited to Negative behaviors, deliberate friendly fire, quit battles before ends, AFK, etc.

1. (Minor) suspension time: Restricted from playing matched battles for 2 hours——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 1-5 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
2. (Medium) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an A+ or better ranking ——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 5-10 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
3. (Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 10-15 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
4. 7-day soft ban——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 15-50 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
5. 30-day soft ban——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 50+ recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).	
6. Permanent ban——Those found to have been penalized for obstructive conduct multiple times due to, including but not limited to, using multiple alternate characters, scrips, or multi-clienting.

House (Territory War) Violations

1.Using third-party software to gain an advantage in Territory War——Houses found to have been using third-party software in Territory War will be penalized depending on the situation. If a house is found to have done so purposefully, their prestige will be set to 0 whether or not their actions garnered them any benefits. All fiefs in their possession will also be returned to their rightful lords.

IMPROPER TRADING

1.  Topping up using any non-official channel, or obtaining sovereigns in any way that violates our regulations.
2.  Be suspect of fraudulent trading.
Those deemed responsible for any of the above may have their accounts banned, purchased items revoked and will be required to top-up to make up for the disparity.

Malicious Abuse of Loopholes 

1. To, in a game or otherwise, maliciously abuse unintended bugs to disrupt the game order, game fairness, or severely affect the gameplay experience of others. Offenders will have their accounts banned for 7-30 days based on the severity of the offense. 
2. Maliciously abusing loopholes or third-party software to perform actions that violate our regulations, severely affect the game, affect the fairness of the game, or to get unjustified gains (including virtual items & property). We may perform rollbacks based on each different situation, and those found to have been maliciously abusing loopholes will have their accounts banned (permanently for severe enough cases). 
We will not under any circumstance compensate offenders for any loss of earnings or limited items missed during the course of their account ban. We implore that everyone works to maintain a fair gaming environment that everyone can thrive in. 
[Ranked Battle] Negative Behavior Violation Penalties 
1. Accounts found out to have been throwing games or resorted to severely negative behavior (including but not limited to intentionally leaving mid-game, AFKing, intentionally attacking allies) may be subject to the following penalties: 
- First offenders: Characters on that account will be unable to partake in Ranked Battle for 7 days. 
- If a character is found to violate the aforementioned two times, it will be banned for 1 month. 
- Throwing games multiple times will lead to a permanent ban. 
2. Penalties of the first article may be incurred at the same time as other penalties of the same type, including chat violations, usage of third-party programs, and other actions that severely affect the gameplay experience of other players. In special cases, the offending character may have part or all of their Ranked Score removed based on the severity of the violation. 
Note: Offenders will be unable to partake in Ranked Battle on their account during its ban. We implore that everyone works to maintain a fair gaming environment that everyone can thrive in. 

PENALTY INFORMATION	
•Mute——Being unable to send chat messages.	
•Soft ban——While a soft ban is in effect on someone's account, their qualification to partake in tournaments they are currently partaking in is also revoked. 
•Forced name change——They will be forced to change their character's name.
• (Minor) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in most game modes for the duration of the penalty and need to remain online to reduce their penalty time.
• (Medium) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in other modes, and must first complete xx Training Camp (AI) games with a rating of A+.
• (Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete xx Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating.
(In special situations, we reserve the right to adjust violation regulations and to apply stricter penalties when we deem required)


Our game's ecology and fair gameplay have and always will be a cornerstone of Conqueror's Blade. It is something we continue to work towards.
We will work together with the community to monitor and crack down upon the violations elicited above. For serious offenses, we reserve the right to pursue criminal responsibility through legal means.
Should you encounter anyone violating any of the above while playing the game, kindly Report them or contact us via our communities in a timely manner. We will deal with any kind of violation most severely.
Once again, thank you everyone so much for your support. We believe that to create a healthy game environment, we must work hard to solve these issues together!

notes.title: [Season Preview] All-new Map——La Grande Gloire
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=8Hc23bUmVNk;full]https://youtu.be/8Hc23bUmVNk[/previewyoutube]

Esteemed Warlord,
We rolled out one new map with both the Dynasty and Highlanders seasons (Linwu Fortress & Quinn Ruins), and now with the Paragons season comes La Grande Gloire. So, let's delve deeper into what awaits in the western capital of Falois—Arelicka!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c758b3af0a3526d39f7a8b93d66aabc865c5051e.jpg

Background Info
Arelicka is a famous city located at the bank of the Teutatis River. It was named after an ancient emperor. Arelicka became the turning point for the Paragons War between Falois and Wealand.
The Wealish army took advantage of their superior numbers and besieged Arelicka for months. Yet, the defenders held fast. With the long bridge and artillery fire they defended the city day after day.
The Wealish attacked with its relentless artillery and raids. Yet, the loyal soldiers of Falois defend the nation, refusing to surrender. Who will decide the city's fate? Will the majestic lion rise atop the city walls, or will the iris prevail?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e244817f514a025e092d0413d86624e9345e1eee.png

Strategic Highlights
La Grande Gloire is situated atop the Teutatis River and connects directly to Arelicka over a river islet. The Wealish forces were unable to breach the bastion at the bridgehead. The Faloisian defenders erected defensive structures with the resources they had pooled up inside the city to fortify the natural moat the La Grande Gloire and the Teutatis River make up. They also issued reinforcements from nearby monasteries. Furthermore, their unique artillery made it all but impossible for the Wealish to advance further. Upon this axis where the tranquil river meets roaring cannon fire, where the billowing waves crash onto the tower bridge, how will the war end?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0f7a90ba5304400a0e1fad5fdf87e110e080b9d6.png

A is right at the center of the defensive fortification. The supply point behind the fortification on the second floor enables the defenders to quickly send reinforcements. The Faloisians set up a supply point and artillery stand at the monastery close enough to A that both points can aid one another. If the Wealish forces rushed forward, they can bombard them with artillery fire from the second floor of the monastery. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/55ffdfe858897053ba6216a08b3561064eee7871.png

But the Wealish offense wasn't all for naught. The fortress walls had been built in haste and weren't strong enough. There are two points in the wall that can be breached. One can either breach the defensive fortification from the front or cut off the support to the bridgehead and claim the area before the defenders can make a comeback. It is also possible to harass the supply point from the left of the fortification and time this with a massive assault on A. Naturally, the attackers may also opt for claiming the monastery and turn the defenders' own artillery against them as they launch a fierce frontal attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/038d43670d0c737f802edec52a247826a8ffe3ce.png

B is located atop the bridge between the bridgehead and the central island. While defending B, the defenders must also aim to maintain control over the strategic points over the patches of shoal while keeping a watchful eye on the occupied artillery. The attackers can use the temporary roads on the sides of the main bridge to harass or cut off the defenders' support. For the best effect, they must strike together with their main force at the opportune moment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/35823a2238601244b653249fdb656c16a1453e15.png

The Faloisians have set up strategic points and supply points on the patches of shoal and must defend these to ensure they can receive enough reinforcements. Should the attackers claim this area, they will gain increased time on their assault and gain access to siege ejectors leading directly to B. Or they might strike at the supply point in the center island to cut off the defenders' supplies. Should the defenders lose any of the extra points in the area, they can choose to break down the bridge to stem the attack on the central island or use siege ejectors to counterattack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/13b248595ec546dd1b32d269ed83ef8e58c59a8e.png

The base flag is situated in the church square at the center island. The attackers will come from the bridge and meet the defenders as they fight by the surrounding buildings. Both attackers and defenders must vie for control over the areas on the central island via the multitude of routes available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ce32f7dc1b5c537fc0d1cc2a167c37f4f2129437.png

Map Mechanics

The map features plenty of bridge facilities that can be destroyed or rebuilt. Both sides may choose whether to destroy or rebuild the bridge based on their tactics and the current outlook of the battle. Having been destroyed, players can interact with nearby repair stations to rebuild it over time. The bridge can be repaired and destroyed any number of times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/285d1a8eee668848113bae81cd771c8609dadcfa.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/78193a3503a5e905f05818a6a141abb478c758a7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/70c6a2c4fd1e7c1ceb9421449d4676478dc2a649.png

Additionally, both sides will have access to plenty of respawnable artillery. By using these, they can defeat enemies or destroy strong points. If one can occupy and assume control over the enemy's artillery, these can be used to get an edge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7c77129fe862f98c41aa3d81b6a66e9b77a6f366.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/25cd47208e45f03058e0dbdebbc3552700818653.png


Launch Date

The La Grande Gloire map is estimated to launch on March 24 in the form of an event. Stay tuned for more info!

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] Update to Ranked Battle Violation Penalties
notes.content:
Ranked Battle has always been one of Conqueror's Blade's most important game modes, and each Warlord's Ranked Battle score is the proof of their skill. Our initial intent with this mode was for Warlords to give Ranked Battle matches their all while cooperating with their allies to attain victory. However, we have recently received negative feedback from players: that some players take actions that negatively affect gameplay balance to help their friends boost their score (hereinafter referred to as 'Throwing Games'). Such actions severely affect the gameplay experience of others. As such, we will be penalizing Warlords who above such actions in Ranked Battles.

	What actions does 'Throwing Games' refer to?

Those that throw games take a role similar to that of a spy. They join the enemy and attempt to throw games in different ways to help their friends gain score. While the other players in their team strive for victory, these players purposefully damage their teammates, allow the enemy to kill them, AFK or verbally abuse their teammates. Actions such as these severely affect the experience of Ranked Battles.

	How do these players ensure they end up fighting their friends?

Our Ranked Battle matchmaking algorithm attempts to match Warlords of a similar score. Those throwing games have found a way to abuse part of this algorithm to be matched in the same game as their friend. Once they ensure they are in the same game, they will start to throw the game to help their friend gain score.

	What penalties await those who throw games?

Accounts found out to have been throwing games may be subject to the following penalties:

  First offenders: Characters on that account will be unable to partake in Ranked Battle for 7 days. 
  Second offenders: Characters on that account will be unable to partake in Ranked Battle for 30 days. 
  Third+ offenders: These accounts will be banned for 30 days. Severe offenders may be permanently banned.


	How to report those that throw games?

Should you encounter someone throwing games while playing Ranked Battles, please do not hesitate to send us screenshots or recordings of such players by email to cb_support@boomingtech.com or to our community managers. Detailed proof help us deal with these offenders quicker.

Our game's ecology and fair gameplay have and always will be a cornerstone of Conqueror's Blade. It is something we continue to work towards. All our regulations and penalties are there to encourage everyone to give each battle their all. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Development Journal | Feb. 24 Unit Balance Changes
notes.content:
I. Kheshigs

[Statistics]

  Avg. Hero Kills: 0.88 (No.1 - 35% higher than No.2)
  Avg. Unit Kills 20.68 (No.2 - only 0.86% lower than No.1)


The Kheshigs' win rate is the highest on all servers and by a big margin. On some servers, it is as high as 55%+ (units with 53% can be defined as powerful).
By analyzing the unit, we've realized that the Kheshigs are powerful because they have strong attacks with which to counter infantry and as they can take down heroes very quickly, giving an enemy hero little chance to strike back or flee. Their high damage and mobility make them a threat to both units and heroes, and this makes them perform better than other units. Furthermore, their bleed effects have too long durations, preventing heroes hit from using Bandage to heal up. All in all, this has had a somewhat negative effect on the overall gameplay experience.

Changes


  [Frenzied Onslaught] No longer dazes heroes.
  [Kheshigs]' bleed effects no longer work on heroes.



 Following the changes to [Kheshigs], we will issue a Kheshigs Doctrine Removal Token to all Warlords who created the unit before Feb. 24.


II. Pavise Crossbowmen

[Statistics]


  Win Rate: 48.74%
  Avg. Unit Kills: 10.05
 (Both of these equal to around No.30, meaning they are fairly weak overall)

Cavalry units are fairly strong in the current meta, with Kheshigs, Cataphract Lancers and Tundra Yeomen having a win rate exceeding 52%. Our design goal with the Pavise Crossbowmen has been for them to somewhat counter cavalry. Unfortunately, they aren't performing as well as expected and have been dropping steadily in usage rate for the past few seasons. We want to increase their power against cavalry units to bring more varied tactical choices.

Changes


  We are increasing the damage [Pavise Crossbowmen] deal to 4-star and above cavalry by 15%.


III. Javelin Infantry

[Statistics]


  Top Avg. Hero Kills: 0.42 (60% of what 5-star ranged units have)


Javelin units previously excelled at killing enemy heroes, however, this is no longer the case when compared to 5-star units following the release of the Houndsmen and the buffs to the Kheshigs and Tercio. We want for more Warlords to try using javelins and increase the gains and sense of achievement when landing hits. With this, we hope to strengthen their unique role in battle and improve the experience of using them.

Changes

- Initial Ammo:

 [Imperial Javelineers] 60 >> 90
 [Javelin Sergeants] 96 >> 120
 [Javelin Militia] 56 >> 84
 [Demesne Javelineers] 70 >> 94
 [Black Dragon Javelineers] 60 >> 90

- Skill Damage Multipliers

 [Imperial Javelineers] Piercing Armor Penetration: 200% >> 250% | Piercing Damage: 220% >> 280%
 [Javelin Sergeants] Piercing Damage: 320% >> 350%
 [Javelin Militia] Piercing Armor Penetration: 150% >> 220%
 [Demesne Javelineers] Piercing Armor Penetration: 150% >> 220%
 [Black Dragon Javelineers] Piercing Damage: 220% >> 260%

notes.title: [Training Yard] Twitch Drops Event Notice
notes.content:
Dear Warlord,

To help newer players take part in the heated siege battles of Conqueror's Blade, we will be holding a Twitch Drops event from Feb. 18th 20:00 until Feb 20th 23:00 (UTC+8). During this time, our content creators will, together with new players, explore how to play and strategize for Siege battles, how to best use units, and share plenty of tips and tricks.

Tune in to any of the streams below to learn and discuss, while earning rewards all in one go:

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GJt3aY29C87CuCovNahfS4xTTwmVKDVW-fWG4jSTOBM/edit#gid=85629852

Event runs from Feb. 18th 20:00 (UTC+8) until Feb. 20th 23:00 (UTC+8)

Watch the stream to earn the following rewards based on your time watched:


 30 min: Chest of Resources x3
 1 hour: Unit Medal x15
 1.5 hours: Powdered Silver x15
 2 hours: 10-Battle Advanced Hero XP Card x1
 3 hours: 10-Battle Advanced Unit XP Card x1
 4 hours: Random Epic Artillery Chest x1

 
Twitch Drops Reward FAQ: 

1. How long does it take for Twitch Drops rewards to reach my account on the official website after claiming? 

This generally takes 3-5 hours. Claiming the rewards on your official account will add them to your in-game account. 
 
2. What do the [MY] and [BOOMING] prefixes refer to in the Twitch Drops event title? 

[MY]
- An event issued by MY.GAMES. These events are only applicable to players playing on the Europe, North America, and Russia servers.
[BOOMING]
- An event issued by BOOMINGTECH. These events are only applicable to players playing on the LA, DI, JC, EF, and SG servers.
 
1) What if the event title doesn't have a prefix? 
If that's the case, players of all servers may participate and claim rewards.
 
2) What does BOOMINGTECH mean in the reward icon? 
This is there to elicit that only players of the LA, DI, JC, EF, and SG servers may claim the rewards. If the icon doesn't contain 'BOOMINGTECH', then check whether the event title has a prefix or our announcements to see whether or not you are eligible for the rewards. 

3. Why can't I claim my Twitch Drops rewards? 

1) Conqueror's Blade account isn't properly linked to the Twitch account.
Log in to the Conqueror's Blade homepage using your Conqueror's Blade account (www.conquerorsblade.com/activity/twitch). If you play via Steam or other third-party platforms, use the Third-Party Log In button, and then navigate to Twitch Account under the Activity menu.
If you fail to link, and receive notification that your Twitch account is already linked with another Conqueror's Blade account, then you need to unlink these on both websites before you can link to this account. 
 
2) Rewards have been claimed on another Twitch account. 
You may only claim rewards for one Twitch event once per Conqueror's Blade account. For example: If you've already claimed rewards from Twitch account A, you will not be able to claim the rewards again by re-linking to Twitch account B. 
 
3) Event rewards can only be claimed on MY.GAMES website. 
Twitch Drops events run by MY.GAMES (our EU/US publisher) cannot be claimed to BOOMING’s website (www.conquerorsblade.com/activity/twitch).
 
4) Progress failure of rewards claiming on Twitch Drops.
Either contact Twitch's customer support or send us your Twitch account, the Stream you watch and the time you encountered such issue to cb_support@boomingtech.com, and we will do our best to help you forward the issue.

Feel free to send us a message at cb_support@boomingtech.com if you have any other inquiries.

notes.title: Highlanders Server Transfer Info
notes.content:
The Highlanders season is about to end and a new season begins. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

	Server Transfer Time:

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on February 17th, Thursday, after maintenance, and run through March 13th, Sunday, 23:59 (UTC+8).
2、Servers will be taken down for maintenance on March 17th, Thursday, 00:00 (UTC+8) during which server transfers will be done.

	Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

	Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

	Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
2. Players may transfer without restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest servers.

	Transfer Quotas

Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.
Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

	How to Transfer:

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred following the March 17th maintenance.

	Important:


 1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before March 13th, 23:59 (UTC+8). Upon canceling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon canceling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.
 2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.
 3. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.
 4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.
 5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
 2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, nor can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
3） Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.
 6. Duplicate Names:
 Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
 On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.
 7. Extra Info:
A character may be unable to log in to the target server if that server has login restrictions. Please ensure that you can log in to a server before transferring a character.

  - Continopolis and Augolia grant better rewards than other fiefs. Occupying either grants Empire Coin x150, Treatise x3, and Epic Artillery Selection Box x3.
  - Turul Város grants better rewards than other fiefs. Occupying it grants Empire Coin x200, Treatise x5, Epic Barding Schematic Crate x2, and Epic Artillery Selection Box x5. Should the Imperial Restorationists succeed in the defense of Turul Város, all Imperial Restorationists with a title will receive the aforementioned rewards.
- A single Warlord may gain a maximum of 1,000 Empire Coins from fief rewards.

Title Rewards:

- The titles of all lieges for this season will be confirmed on Feb. 26th, 22:30, 2022.
- Additional Empire Coin rewards will also be granted according to each Warlord's Free House/Imperial Restorationists title.

 Empire Coin rewards for titled Free House members are as follows:


 Hegemon: Empire Coin x600.
 Monarch: Empire Coin x550.
 Chamberlain: Empire Coin x500.
 Chief Justiciar and General: Empire Coin x400.
 High Councilor, Judge, and Commander: Empire Coin x350.
 Minister, High Sheriff, and Captain: Empire Coin x300.
 Elector, Magistrate, and Constable: Empire Coin x200.
 Alderman, Bailiff, and Castellan: Empire Coin x100.
 Burgess, Freeholder, and Shieldbearer: Empire Coin x50.


Empire Coin rewards for Imperial Restorationists are based on whether they manage to defend Turul Város:


 Supreme Commander/Hand of Kingdom: Gains Empire Coin x600 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x300 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Marshal/Hand of Lords: Gains Empire Coin x550 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x270 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Deputy Marshal/Hand of Commons: Gains Empire Coin x500 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x240 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Admiral, Lieutenant General, and Major General: Gains Empire Coin x400 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x200 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Colonel, Lieutenant Colonel, and Major: Gains Empire Coin x350 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x160 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Captain, Lieutenant, and Second Lieutenant: Gains Empire Coin x300 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x100 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Aquilifer/Sergeant and Legionary/Sergeant Major: Gains Empire Coin x200 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x50 should the Free House occupy Turul Város.
 Venator/Thousands, Munifex/Hundreds, and Veles/Tens: Gains Empire Coin x100 should Turul Város remain unoccupied. Will not be granted any Empire Coins should the Free House occupy Turul Város.

- Empire Coin rewards from titles are not affected by the reward cap of fiefs.

Empire Coin Exchange Event:

- Empire Coins can be redeemed for various resources within the "Empire's Treasury" menu accessed via the O key. Including Epic Hero Schematic Crates, Epic Barding Schematic Crates, Treatises, Powdered Silver, Rare Equipment Schematics, Unit Medals, Hero XP Cards, and Unit XP Cards.
  - The Empire's Treasury will be available for the foreseeable future. However, its content will be renewed at the end of each season.
  - Empire Coins will carry over between seasons.

Headwear & Title Rewards:

- Free Houses:
  - A crown will be issued in accordance with your title and can be used until the end of the next season.
  - Proprietors of the Hegemon and Monarch titles will also receive an exclusive attire.
  - All members of the alliance that in the end occupies Turul Város will gain the rare Highlanders Destiny title.

- Imperial Restorationists Rewards
  - Second Lieutenants and above will receive a headwear befitting of their station which lasts until the end of the next season.
  - Warlords with titles below Second Lieutenant will instead receive 20,000 Bronze Coins.
  - Those of the Imperial Restorationists who take part in the battle for Augolia, Continopolis or Turul Város will gain the uncommon permanent title of Highlanders Volunteer.
  - Those of the Imperial Restorationists who take part in the defense of and successfully defend Augolia or Continopolis will gain the rare permanent title of Highlanders Royal Guard. Those who take part in the defense of Turul Város but fail to defend it, will gain the rare title Highlanders Royal Guard should no Warlord of the Free Houses assume the Hegemon title. (Those that meet both conditions will only receive the Highlanders Royal Guard title)
  - Should the Imperial Restorationists succeed in defending Turul Város, all who took part in the defense of Turul Város will gain the epic title Highlanders Legion. (Those that meet all three conditions will only receive the Highlanders Legion title)
- To successfully defend Continopolis, Augolia, and Turul Város, the fiefs must be under their respective region's NPC rulership on March 3rd, 12:00, 2022.

Between-season Territory War Schedule & Territory Reset:

 After the Campaigns results have been tallied, Military Exercises and Territory War will be available until the next season begins.
  - No Territory War-related activities will be held on March 1st, 2022, and they will instead be replaced by Free Battles.
  - Territory War will run as normal on every Tuesday and Saturday after March 3rd, 2022.
    - Neither Continopolis, Augolia, nor Turul Város can be attacked during this time.
    - Fiefs occupied in Territory War during this time will not count toward your Empire Coin rewards.
- Territories will be fully reset when the next season begins.

Ranked Battle Results

- This season's Ranked Battle will be closed after the maintenance on Mar. 3rd, 2022 (Ranked Battles will be replaced by Free Battles). We will then be issuing the rewards according to each players' Ranked Battle score.

  All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 800 will receive the following:
    - Unit Medal x60
    - Powdered Silver x20
    - Honor x10,000
    - Treatise x3

   All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,200 will receive the following:
    - Unit Medal x60
    - Epic Barding Schematic Crate x1
    - Gold Dust x30
    - Treatise x7

  All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,500 will receive the following:

    - The permanent honorary title: Claymore's Might.
    - Ranked Battle Custom Unit Attire Selection Box x1
  - All of the aforementioned rewards stack, so a Warlord whose Ranked Battle score exceeds 1,500 will be granted all of the rewards.
- To further reward Warlords who have excelled in Ranked Battle, the top 25 will receive the following:
  - The special mount banner attire: Great Eagle Banner.
  - The Great Eagle Banner will be usable until the end of the next season.
  - The banner will be sent by mail, so keep an eye out for it should you meet the requirements.

[Territory War] Player Report Reward Updates

We will be testing rewards for Player Reports for the Territory Wars on March 5th and 8th (2022). Your performance as noted down in the player reports will directly affect your Territory War rating and the rewards you gain.

You will be rated based on your performance and contribution in every fief battle. The rewards are as follows:

Rating	Reward
1,000+	45 Empire Coins + 60,000 Bronze Coins
800-999	40 Empire Coins + 50,000 Bronze Coins
600-799	35 Empire Coins + 40,000 Bronze Coins
400-599	30 Empire Coins + 30,000 Bronze Coins
200-399	25 Empire Coins + 20,000 Bronze Coins
0-199	20 Empire Coins + 10,000 Bronze Coins

Important:

- Personal Empire Coin rewards from Territory War reports are not affected by the reward cap of fiefs.
- These rewards will not be issued for Military Exercises.

We estimated that Territory War report rewards will go live with the next season. We will keep a close eye on data during these tests and will read all feedback sent our way. We will continue to iterate on rewards and rules as we go forward.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade January 27 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on January 27th, which will last for 4 hours and run between 12:30-16:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 12,000 Bronze Coins, 400 Honor, and 20 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

The Year of the Ox is now behind us as we welcome the Year of the Tiger. The [Tiger's Vigor] event is now coming with tons of rewards: [Tiger General] Attire Chest, Treatises, and random daily packs including New Year Lucky Bags and Red Envelopes! With these handsome rewards and great events, we wish you a great new year and plenty of victories! Please check the [Tiger's Vigor] event notice for more info.

I. SPRING FESTIVAL EVENT QUEST

After the Tyrant's invasion, there are some strange folks wandering near the walls of Conqueror's City. They come from Yan, and they claim that the Yanhua gate in Jining city has been destroyed in war and must be repaired. But as was created a long, long time ago, they do not know what technique was used to create the bricks. Among their ranks are a general of Yan and a rich nobleman dressed in fancy clothes. Why don't you ask them why they have come?

II. WORLD MAP CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS

We are making the following improvements to Fief Quests:

 	Now, when you earn artillery and luxury goods from fief quests, these will be placed into your Wagon if there is enough space. Otherwise, the rewards will be temporarily stored in the city's resource pile.
 	Added information to the Fief Quest menu that clearly elicits the bonus rewards and reward multipliers of quests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/521b5fdd5f6642d413070c1ae553d3f2308dfb56.png

 	Improved the items required for some fief quests. Tradeable artillery can now be submitted to [Fief Construction IV] quests requiring epic artillery.
 	Fixed an issue with the completion times and star levels of [Growing Tribute IV] quests requiring kits.
 	Added a lock icon in the upper right corner of non-tradeable artillery to the Fief Quests - Submission menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/439bdb6f97b012cadf582923a9c3be9dfbaf2797.png

 	Improved the food bar display when marching on the World Map to increase clarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0c88a332ea35b60ce93618a1fe35f33cfdb2d4f7.png

 	Now, resources from all regions can be refined in Conqueror's City.
 	Fixed an issue where fiefs belonging to Rosswild of the Borderlands would still belong to Kingdom of Rosswild after the Imperial Restorationists reclaimed them.


III. EXCAVATION CHANGES

	Added New Doctrines in the Carrion Bird's Banquet:
No Quarter: Reduced damage taken from cavalry by 30% while using Brace.
Advancing Bastion: Damage taken is reduced by 30% while charging.
	Added New Doctrines in the Field of Broken Lances:
Rider's Folly: Deal 20% increased damage to cavalry units. Deal 20% reduced damage to ranged and melee infantry units.

IV. UPGRADED RANKED BATTLE REWARDS

We are adjusting the weekly win and rank rewards of [Ranked Battle] to award those Warlords who perform well.
	Following this change, Warlords will be able to re-claim rewards based on their rank.
	New rewards:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/646aa4c8cfb02e140d810074c572e75a0c476ec7.png

V. BALANCE CHANGES

[Shield of the Capital] Territory War Map Improvements:
Improved the Territory War stages using the [Shield of the Capital] map. Added a respawn point closer to the front after the attacker occupies the center of the map. This means that the attackers' reinforcements can reach the battle quicker.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fc6e7e01e3fc64fc1da879affbf1c666628b22c7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c8d61a443c40af4a51ab123e176b71568deae8ab.png
 
 VI. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	Reduced the eagle-eye perspective's (Z) cooldown to 1 second.
 	[Harbour City]: Slightly adjusted the location of the city's supply point, fixing the issue where units would get stuck outside the wall.
 	Fixed an issue where the [Dual Blades] hero’s [Bandage] wouldn’t be interrupted by jumping after equipping the [Tiger's Fangs] rune.
 	Fixed an issue where right-clicking with the bow wouldn't cancel the animation after shooting.
 	Fixed an issue where the Rattan Pikemen's later nodes in the [Unit Tree] that boosted Weakened time wouldn't take effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/762ea520b64d2b301e21a44993e0262525d67e91.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/60ef5ee82f2f86f6a04cf0aa784741b436223cda.png

 	Fixed an issue where the [Houndsmen]'s [Sprint] skill would lose its effect if they interacted with a supply point.
 	Fixed an issue where deploying artillery on a slope would enable you to pass walls by using said artillery.
 	Fixed an issue where multiple duplicate messages would appear on the City list on the right side of the World Map when an allied city was declared war on by multiple houses.
 	Fixed an issue with the information displayed regarding volume for the epic Hwacha Launcher.
 	Fixed an issue where Narfan didn't have a display of which fiefs it could be processed in.
 	Improved the quest text of the initial story quests.
 	Corrected the Golden Rocks badge's quality from iron to silver.
 	Corrected the quest description of the Houndsmen Season Challenges' second stage to attain Hat-Trick or A Deadly Century badges, instead of only the Hat-Trick badge.
 	Fixed an issue where the [Iron Reapers]'s Prerequisites and Progress overlapped in the UI.
 	Fixed an issue where the head part of the [Archons' Sons (Sealed)] clashed when worn by the 3 [Highlanders] season units.
 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.


VII. Hero Balance Changes

	[Pike Hero]
	After checking player feedback and analyzing data, the pike hero's [Wandering Dragon] invulnerability window exceeds our expectations. It currently performs too well and is too difficult to play against. So, we have decided to make the following changes:
[Wandering Dragon] Reduced the invulnerability window of all stages to 0.3 seconds (was 0.5 seconds). 
[Sky Dragon]: Adjusted the damage of the second phase to 150% base blunt damage + 1,433 points of blunt damage (was 175% and 1,183 points).
	[Sky Dragon]: Adjusted the damage of the third phase to 170% base blunt damage + 2,218 points of blunt damage (was 200% and +1,868 points).
	We will continue to keep an eye on the performance of the various professions and continue to improve the game. We will also work on displaying CC immunity and similar effects with visual and other effects in future versions.

notes.title: Development Journal | Jan. 27 Balance Changes
notes.content:
To further improve the state of Conqueror's Blade, we have been looking over recent data and feedback and will be making a series of balance changes to heroes and units with this week's update (Jan. 27).


I. PIKE HERO BALANCE CHANGES: 

[Statistics]

- Usage Rate: 21.5% (Most used hero, with Spear being the second at 11%)
The Pike is the most used profession and its statistics are overall high, especially its ability to survive and escape in chaotic battles, which is superior to other medium armor heroes. So, we're making changes to the [Wandering Dragon] skill to slightly reduce the Pike hero's extreme burst potential, and enable other weapons to stand against them.

- Changes:

[Wandering Dragon]
Reduced the invulnerability window of all stages to 0.3 seconds (was 0.5 seconds). 
[Sky Dragon]
Adjusted the damage of the second phase to 150% base blunt damage + 1,433 points of blunt damage (was 175% and 1,183 points). 
Adjusted the damage of the third phase to 170% base blunt damage + 2,218 points of blunt damage (was 200% and 1,868 points).

II. UNIT BALANCE CHANGES 

1.	Imperial Spear Guards

[Statistics]

- Usage Rate Rank: 40
- Win Rate Rank: 60
- Average Damage: 370.8k (rank 10)
The Imperial Spear Guards is a defensive 4-star tower-shield unit. But they cannot properly make use of their defensive ability in the current meta. So, we've decided to rework their design and boost some of their skills, giving them an increase in both defense and how they are used.

- Changes:

[olist]
 Shield hitbox’s width increased by 13% while in formation, reducing the chance of arrows to pass through their defense.
 Replaced the [Advance] skill by [Shield Advance]: The Imperial Spear Guards gathers in formation and advances forward. They become immune to CC after finishing formation and will knock back enemies they hit with their advance.
 Empowered [Cover Commander]. While using Cover Commander, they become immune to CC for 2 seconds and gain 30% increase to all types of damage and defense for every 3 hits they take.
 [Front Defense] characteristic changed to [Front Barrier]: When in formation, they will raise their empowered shields once every 20 seconds, knocking back the next enemy that gets close.
[/olist]

2.	Spahks Cavalry

[Statistics]

- Usage Rate Rank: Second to last of all units
The Spahks Cavalry is greatly underpowered, whether it be their burst potential, sustained damage, or ability to withstand damage. Their CC skills are not enough to ameliorate this weakness. So, we've decided to improve their CC ability based on their characteristics.

- Changes:

[olist]
 [Burst] changed to [Assault]: Grants an extra 15% movement speed. [Trample] can be used while [Assault] is active.
 [Trample]: Trample nearby enemies. Enemies that have been hit by [Assault] within the last 3 seconds are stunned for 4.5 seconds and take increased damage from Spahks Cavalry.
Using [Battle Stomp] grants CC immunity for 1 second, and increases all defenses by 20% for 3 seconds.
[/olist]

3.	Tercio Arquebusiers

[Statistics]

- Usage Rate: 1.1% (Far beneath the 30% usage rate of Shenji Grenadiers)
The damage of all Arquebusiers infantry has increased following the previous changes to Arquebusiers units, but some Arquebusiers infantry are still unable to perform well in the current meta. Currently, the Shenji Grenadiers is the most used one. We believe that this is because Arquebusiers have too few skills, that the characteristics of those units aren't strong enough, and don't feel good to use. So, we're planning on increasing the ability of various firearm infantry based on their weapon characteristics to make battles more varied and interesting.
This time we are focusing on the Tercio Arquebusiers. We have decided to boost their ranged and melee active skills, thereby increasing their playability.

- Changes:

1. Added a new ranged skill [Bullet Barrage]: The Tercio Arquebusiers load extra bullets and fire at a faster rate. Bullet Barrage consumes plenty of ammo but has impressive firepower. Following the barrage, their barrels need to cool down and they will switch to melee stance.
2. Added a new melee skill [Brave Advance]: The Tercio Arquebusiers raise their blades and charge forward, striking twice in quick succession.

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] Violation List & Anti-Hacking Policy Notice
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord: 
Some players have recently been using cheating software which has greatly affected the balance, along with the gameplay experience of others. We continue to iterate on and update our anti-cheat system with every update. We have zero-tolerance for such behavior and will crack down on and punish any usage of hacks.
Apart from monitoring and checking currently existing hacks, we have completed a new series of improvements to our systems:

1. We have collected and devised protections for cheats of different types, and these include the attack speed of ranged units, unlimited ammunition, no skill CDs, and damage changes.
2. Monitoring the effectiveness of hero damage multiplier decreases and increases.
3. Monitoring the damage caps of various damage sources for heroes/units each battle.
4. Restore battle recordings from the database to verify cheats.

The battle against hacks is an ever-lasting one. But we will continue to strike back at those who create and use them. We also hope that you help us in this endeavor, be that by reporting those you find hacking or by providing us information on those that create hacks. Your help makes it much easier for us to battle the cheaters.
Thank you all for your help! And thank you for your continued support and love of Conqueror's Blade!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade January 20 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on January 20th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. ADJUSTMENT PREVIEW ON MOUNT GEAR FORGING

We are planning on making changes to mount gear forging with the Feb. 17th update. Forging saddles, chanfrons, leg guards or bardings with Rare/Epic Mount Armor Schematics will grant one or several extra attributes, including piercing defense, slashing defense, and blunt defense. Ride into battle and face your foe at your best!
We'll explain our design idea in more detail in the coming days, so keep an eye out for future notices to learn more. Thank you for your continued support!

II. WORLD MAP CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS

We are making rather big adjustments and improvements to fief quests with this update.

1. We're adding Kit Quests to the list of fief quests.
In Kit Quests, you can hand in kits in return for honor, city construction, or exchange kits for other kits that you need, or even for treasures to aid in your conquest of the world.
- Kit Quests will be available in town and fort fiefs.
- Kit Quests will require kits of a certain era. (Read on further down for more info)

notes.title: LONG-TERM CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM RECRUITMENT MANUAL
notes.content:
The Content Creator Program is aimed at all content creators that make high-quality Conqueror's Blade content. With this program we aim to provide such content creators more support and help for even more content! From this point onward, recruitment of new content creators will be available with no end in mind. Read on for detailed info on how to sign up and the rewards. We hope that more and more creators join our growing roster!

I. CONTENT CREATOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Game Advertisement
After becoming an affiliated content creator, we will be creating an exclusive host code for your use. Note, the code is only applicable to newly registered users. A player using your code will receive a series of beginner rewards. Naturally, you will also be issued rewards based on the number of new users that use your code.
*Host codes are only available for streamers and video creators.

Content Creators
1. Video Creators
• Create at least 10 original videos related to Conqueror's Blade each season
• Have 200+ followers on the platform
• Have above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video
2. Streamers
• Stream at least 60 hours per season
• Have 200+ followers on the platform
• Have above 30 viewers on each Conqueror's Blade stream
3. Strategy Guide Writers
• Create at least 2 strategy guides per season (video or written), and publish them on your social media account and @ our official account (including Bilibili, YouTube, Twitter).

Community Mods
• Guide new players to learn more about the game.
• Be active in the Conqueror's Blade community and help keep the community active.

What's more, we hope you join in on even more content, such as providing commentary for season tournaments, draft war reports, video re-creation, etc. Naturally, such extra content will net you even greater rewards.

II. CREATOR INCENTIVE

During our cooperation we will be rating and issuing rewards, as well as base future co-operation plans, based on your output, following, recruitment results, among some.
Rewards will be issued on a per-month season, with rewards for one season being issued the following.
You can find information about each month's set rewards below (rewards stack, meaning that the more criteria you fulfill the more rewards you get).

1) Video Creators/Streamers Creator Incentive
Basic Rewards
Stream at least 60 hours per season with each stream having at least 30 viewers, or create 10 original Conqueror's Blade-related videos with more than 150 average views.
Sovereign x2,000
30-Day Premium Account

New Recruitment Rewards
During our cooperation, you will not only be considered an official Conqueror's Blade content creator, but you will also receive a host code that you can share with your fans. Then you'll be rewarded should they take a liking to Conqueror's Blade and start playing too:
1) You'll get 50 Sovereigns as a reward for every 1 of your viewers that start playing using your host code and reach level 50.
2) We'll add in another 50 Sovereigns for each of your viewers that also reach level 100.
3) You may receive up to 10,000 Sovereigns per season from recruiting new players. For seasons where you do exceptionally well—or if you are highly cooperative—we will also reward you with extra in-game items!

Twitch Drops Support
If you have more than 200 followers on Twitch, and we have cooperated for more than one season, we will organize Twitch Drops events on your channel. You can then enable Twitch Drops during certain times to help attract an even greater following.

2) Strategy Guide Creator Rewards
High-quality Guide Rewards
1. If you create high-quality guides that are selected to be used by us, we will reward you with 800-2,000 Sovereigns (depending on quality) per guide.
2. We will provide you with extra Sovereigns and/or other item rewards if you create a series of guides, articles, or create a site for guides.

III. NOTES

1. Mind your language while streaming, in your videos and when posting.
2. You should publish enough content on a regular basis as per the above requirements.
3. We will terminate our co-operation with you should any of the following occur (or if verified after you have been reported):
(1) Should you make improper remarks in-game, in player communities, or in your video/stream that negatively effects the game;
(2) Should you severely violate any of the game's rules, including but not limited to speech violations, negative behavior, usage of third-party programs;
(3) Create a series of new accounts to raise your following and/or to have such accounts use your gift code;
(4) Should you fail to publish enough content on a regular basis and fail to meet the content quota.


IV. CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM QA

Q: How do players use my host code?
A: They can access the gift code menu by pressing Q, and in there enter your host code. In doing so they receive exclusive rewards (an exclusive "Super Fan" title, a 2-star Signaculum, Premium Account, XP Boosters, Artillery Chests, Treatises, and Battle Relics).

Q: When are earnings tallied each season?
A: We will tally your statistics and issue rewards to your in-game mailbox at season end.

Q: For how long will the Content Creator Program run?
A: We will be evaluating the results of the program after each season and decide whether to continue with the program or to find new ways in which to cooperate with you all.

Q: Is there something else of note?
A: Only players that have not played Conqueror's Blade before may use these host codes. Should we find that someone has abused their host code in any way or form simply to garner more revenue, we will terminate our cooperation with them, and withhold the proceeds for that month.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade January 13 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on January 13th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. EVENTS


 	The [Collect Owl Feathers to get rewards] event is ending.
 	The [Snow-capped Land Login Rewards] event is ending, and Christmas decorations will be taken down until next year. The bag of the [Baelsink] attire will also be back to normal.


II. WORLD MAP CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	We have improved some issues with how information is displayed to make it easier to enact your strategies. Now, war declaration info will be in a set order, making it easier to find fiefs you have declared war against.
 	Artillery that cannot be traded will have a lock icon in the upper right corner to reflect this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/29646ecec6ceeaf078b01b2da827d119b308a38e.jpg
 
 	The frontlines are stretched thin, and so the Market is raising the maximum suggested price for [Rebel Trophies]. See the appendix for detailed information on the changes.



III. MAP BALANCE CHANGES

	[Kurak Castle]:
We have moved the battering ram and siege towers forward some distance, making it quicker to push them to the gate and walls.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5bed874f48cade139c761c2f657789a14deb440b.png

IV. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	Fixed an issue where some refinable materials had the wrong regions in their tooltip.
 	Fixed an issue where Conqueror's Gate was erroneously displayed as a fief type for material refinement.
	Fixd an issue with the display image of the Field Camp menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c9b1d0a978dd2614aa93b46935496d2c0ff734cf.png

 	Fixed an issue where fief battles for war rallies could exceed 15 non-player participants in some circumstances for war rallies.
 	Fixed an issue where the World Map - Yatti Royal Plaque erroneously had the option to 'Start Battle'. 
 	Fixed an issue where the Bagpipers couldn't equip common-quality doctrines.
 	Fixed an issue where the Musket hero's caltrops didn't work in some areas.
 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
 	Fixed an issue where Ranked Battles didn't give progress for Siege/Field Battle quests.
 	Added the option to turn off limited doctrine acquisition prompts under settings. You can toggle this on and off by hitting Esc and navigating to Settings. When turned off, newly acquired limited doctrines won't have an exclamation-mark prompt.
 	We have changed the quest order for Hero's Path (F4). This does not affect completed quests, overall progress, or rewards. You might encounter quests you have already completed before after the change. This is because of the change and is working as intended.
 	Fixed an issue where using auxiliary units or Silver Era or later units didn't count toward a quest progress in Hero's Path of [Hero's Path].
 	Fixed an issue where kills or assists didn't count toward a quest progress in Path of Bravery of [Hero's Path].
 	Fixed an issue where creating and unlocking units didn't count toward a quest progress in Path of Faith of [Hero's Path].
	Fixed an issue where matched battle wins didn't count toward a quest progress in Path of Bravery of [Hero's Path].
 	Fixed an issue where one couldn't stencil equipment with Sovereign Notes.

 	Fixed an issue where no prompt was given upon acquiring new appearances.

notes.title: Notice on Adjustments to SA Servers Matchmaking
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord,
We've received plenty of feedback since the matchmaking adjustments took effect on Dec. 23 on the South America servers. Owing to this feedback and data we've collected, we will be improving matchmaking in SA further with this week's update (Jan. 13):

1. Bots will be turned off for players at level 100 and above in Siege battles.
2. Bots will instead be available in the new Siege Battle (Bot Training) matchmaking mode.

This change will fully remove bots from high-level Siege battles and improve the overall gameplay experience. However, with zero bots, queue times will inevitably be longer than before. We will continue to monitor the feedback and data we collect and make further changes if we believe it necessary. Should you have any feedback regarding these new changes, feel free to send us an email or get in touch with one of our community managers.

Thank you for supporting Conqueror's Blade!

Hello there, Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on January 6th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. HERO, UNIT AND RUNE BALANCE CHANGES


 With this update, we're making a series of balance changes to heroes, units and runes. Check the Jan. 6 Balance Changes notice in-game for detailed information.
 We will also issue the following compensation when the balance changes go live. 
	1) We will issue the items required to remove all doctrines equipped to units receiving nerfs (to players that own said units). 
	2) All players will also receive 25 Doctrine Water. 
3) All players will also receive 3 Treatises. 


II. WORLD MAP CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS

We are making the following changes to Fief Quests:

 	Doubled the amount of honor that can be gained from Fief Quests.
