notes.title: Development Journal | Jan. 6 Balance Changes
notes.content:
Last week we shared our thoughts on and the direction we are going with balance changes in the previous Development Journal. And we are now rolling out a series of changes to some of the units, weapons, and runes in need of changes. This first batch will be going live on Jan. 6, 2022.

Jan. 6 Planned Balance Changes

I. Unit Changes

- Changes This Time

1. Axe Raiders
[Stats]
-Average damage taken: 531,100 (Ranked 1st among all units. 23.4% higher than the 2nd unit)
-Average damage dealt: 273,200 (Ranked 1st among all units. 15.7% higher than the 2nd unit)
-Picked Rate : 6.8% (Ranked 3rd among all units.)
The Axe Raiders currently has the most average damage taken and unit kills among all units, which far exceeds our intentions. That's why we are making changes to it while retaining the unit's unique design intact.
  - Control effects (dazed, stun, knockback, knockdown, send flying) can now affect the Axe Raiders and they will no longer immediately recover from such effects.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d8f9be26fe9f0f497fb07ab75446a840c53d41c.gif

  - Currently when the Axe Raiders' Deadly Resolve is triggered, it is incredibly difficult for any hero or unit to retaliate during its 8-second duration, greatly reducing the effectiveness and value of other units. So, the Axe Raiders will now take 30% increased damage within 1 second of being affected by control effects (dazed, stun, knockback, knockdown, send flying). This should serve to tune down their currently overpowered passive defensive capabilities.

2. Modao Battalion
[Stats]
-Average damage taken: 395,200 (Ranked 4th among all units.)
-Average damage dealt: 157,800 (Ranked 9th among all units.)
-Picked Rate : 9.1% (Ranked 1st among all units.)
The Modao Battalion is a unit capable of standing against cavalry while in formation, but their damage reduction is overpowered while in [Battalion] formation. This had led to them being great at dealing with all types of units, and therefore an almost must-have unit at your disposal.
  - Change:
 We are replacing the 20% damage reduction against all types of damage while in [Battalion] formation with a [33% damage reduction against cavalry, and 8% damage reduction against Infantry].

3.  Northern Lance Cavalry
[Stats]
-Average damage dealt: 163,100 (Ranked 7th among all units.)
-Picked Rate : 0.2% (Ranked 62nd among all units.)
-Accuracy while charging: around 15% at 20m.
While being a highly unique cavalry unit, the Northern Lance Cavalry is fairly weak and not as useful as we would like. We hope to take them up a notch with a series of improvements to their mechanics.
  - Changes:
1) Increasing the number of bullets shot and accuracy rate of their fire lances while charging, addressing the issue that they hardly ever hit enemies while charging.
2) Adjusting the damage hitbox of [Valour] so that the unit can hit enemies more accurately, reducing misses by 60%.
3) Increasing the buff the Northern Lance Cavalry gains from movement speed. They will now gain a boost to attack while moving: their damage increases with more movement speed, capping out at 15% extra damage.

4. Firearm Infantry
[Stats]
-Picked Rate : (Take Tercio Arquebusiers as an example)
1.9% (Ranked 14th) in Season Dynasty. 0.7%(Ranked 29th) in Season Tyranny. 
-Accuracy and damage decay range: Around 20m. A range close enough to get dished out by Axe Raiders and cavalry.
As the damage and accuracy of firearm infantry declines at farther distances, they have a difficult time dealing burst damage in battles. This has led to some defensive-oriented units being hard to counter, and to less variety in unit usage.
  - Changes:
1) Reducing the damage decay based on the range for firearm units. [20m] damage decay reduces to a maximum of 10% (down from 20%); [20-40m] reduces to a maximum of 18% (down from 30%); maximum decay range increases to 56m (up from 48m), leading to a minimum of 65% damage.
2) Increasing the overall accuracy of firearm units. Attacking enemies at around 30m has the highest increase of 15% accuracy.
3) Fixing an issue with incorrect sound effects for the shots of some firearm infantry.

5. Cataphract Lancers
[Stats]
-Picked Rate : 1.1% (Ranked 24th among all units.) 
-Average damage dealt: 222,500 (Ranked 5th among all units.)
According to players' feedback, the Cataphract Lancers still don't work as well as expected after a series of changes, and their Follow Charge's damage is fairly limited. So, we're improving their Follow Charge again.
  - We have changed the underlying AI of Cataphract Lancers and the skill should now feel better to use. When the Cataphract Lancers is near the commanding hero, the unit will slightly speed up while getting closer to the target.

6. Fortebraccio Pikemen
[Stats]
-Picked Rate : 0.2% (Ranked 62nd among all units.) 
In Season Tyranny, there are 5 cavalry units in the top 10 highest-damage units. To form up a more reasonable relations between units, performance of units that can counter cavalry should be improved. To address this, we have increase Modao Battalion's ability when agaisnt cavalry. Meanwhile, as the unit with the longest melee weapon, the Fortebraccio Pikemen should be able to counter cavalry to a great extent, but that is currently not the case.
  - Changes:
1) Increased the Fortebraccio Pikemen's damage to cavalry while using Brace by 15%.
2) Increased the damage of Brace based on enemy movement speed by up to 15%. Using Brace against charging cavalry will reach this number.

- Preview For the Future

Imperial Spear Guards
    Right now, the heavy shield infantry units are at a confusing position in battlefields. They can neither take nor dish out enough damage. And It is rather difficult to utilize them well in battles; all in all, they can't really affect the outcome of battle to a satisfying degree. While we have started looking at how to change units of this category, these changes might require a bit of extra time for power and stability tests. We estimate that the Imperial Spear Guards' changes will be available on Jan. 27. We also hope they'll become a liked wall of shields!

II. Hero/Weapon Changes

- Hero/Weapon Buffs
    We have noticed that some weapons are less used and have a lower win rate than the average. Our focus this time has been to make adjustments to these two lackluster weapons. We will naturally continue to make adjustments to other weapons where balance changes are required in the future.

1. Longsword & Shield
[Stats]
-Used Rate: 5.5% (Ranked 10th among all weapons.) 
-Win Rate: 50.11%（Ranked 8th among all weapons.)
The Longsword & Shield is the only weapon that can heal, but its healing is currently too low to truly make an impact. It is often the case that you're killed before you can get healed up, and the weapon lacks in both offense and defense.
  - Changes:
Triggering Mercy of Heaven will grant a 15% reduction to melee damage taken for 3 seconds. Also heals you for 5% of your health every 3 seconds during its duration.

2. Short Bow
[Stats]
-Used Rate: 5.8% (Ranked 8th among all weapons.) 
-Win Rate: 49.84%（Ranked 9th among all weapons.)
The Short Bow is a highly mobile weapon, but some of its skills have too long of a cooldown, detracting from the experience. We want the Short Bow to be able to better combo together its skills and basic attacks.
  - Changes:
1) Poison Arrow's cooldown reduces to 7 seconds (was 8).
2) Angry Hornets' cooldown reduces to 48 seconds (was 50).
3) Parting Shot's cooldown reduces to 25/23/20 seconds (was 30/28/25).
4) Wrath of Artemis' cooldown reduces to 48 seconds (was 50).

III. Seasonal Runes

We also analyzed the power of runes and their usage during the last season.  To increase the diversity of picked runes, we are improving weapon runes whose picked-rate is below 10%, and nerfing those above 60%.

- Common Runes
  - We are changing the effect of [Camel's Saddle] to "[Bandage]'s cooldown reduced by 50% and duration by 40%] (it previously reduced both cooldown and duration by 50%). This means it can now be used more times to make it more effective. 
  - Increasing the effect of [Camel's Stomp] to "Crit rate increased by 32" (was 24), and increasing its cost to 2 points (was 1 point).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tortoise's Resolve] to "While in a flag area, damage taken is reduced by 12%" (was 10%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tortoise's Shell] to "Fall damage is reduced by 60%" (was 30%).
  - Boosting the effect of [Tortoise's Calm] to "[Bandage] removes poisons and bleeds, and grants immunity to poison and bleed for 10 seconds" (previously granted immunity to poison and bleed for 5 seconds).
  - Increasing the effect of [Ursa's Bravery] to "While in a flag area, stamina recovery rate is increased by 35%" (was 20%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Ursa's Ferocity] to "Each 1 enemy hero you kill increases damage dealt by 12% for 15 seconds" (was 10% for 10 seconds).
  - Increasing the effect of [Ursa's Bloodthirst] to "Each 3 enemy soldiers you kill increases damage dealt by 10% for 15 seconds" (was 10% for 10 seconds for each 5 soldiers killed).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tiger's Ward] to "While in a flag area, damage dealt is increased by 12%" (was 10%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tiger's Wrath] to "Movement speed is increased by 8% while at below 40% health" (previously triggered while below 30%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tiger's Tail] to "Armor penetration increased by 45" (was 40).

- Weapon Runes
1. Longsword & Shield
  - Increasing the effect of [Rapid Action] to "All damage increased by 100 while at above 70% health" (was 70). We have also fixed an issue where the bonus damage didn't trigger in some situations.
2. Shortsword & Shield 
  - Altering the effect of [Wargod Wings] to "All damage is increased by 10% while above 50% health, and damage taken is reduced by 8% while below 50%" (previously increased damage by 12% and granted 8% to all defenses).
  - Increasing the duration of [Wargod Beak] to "For every 1 hero kill or assist, nearby allies have their damage increased by 10% and damage taken reduced by 10% for 12 seconds" (was 8 seconds).
3. Musket
  - Increasing the effect of [Blazing Glory] to "Using [Fine Gunpowder] reduces the cooldowns of [Scatter Shot] and [Five Rounds Rapid] by 2 seconds" (previously reduced cooldowns by 1.5 seconds).
4. Bow
  - Fixed a bug where the damage bonus of Hail of Arrows didn't match.
  - Fixed a bug where the damage bonus of [Bone Piercer] didn't match.
5. Short Bow
  - Increasing the effect of [Spectre's Hatred] to "The damage of poison is increased by 120% and its duration is decreased by 50%" (damage was previously increased by 100%).
  - Altering the effect of [General's Fury] to "On every 3rd [Basic Attack], fire 3 arrows at 50% power" (was 40% power). The three arrows fired might not all hit their intended targets making the damage increase less obvious. So, we are increasing the damage of each arrow, making this rune more potent on medium distances.
6. Dual Blades
  - Increasing the effect of [Mithras' Light] to "Restore 15% health for every 1 hero kill or assist" (was 8%).

notes.title: Development Journal | New Year's Letter — About Balance
notes.content:
To all Conqueror's Blade players: 

It has always been our goal to make Conqueror's Blade a game that constantly evolves and becomes better. Now that the game has been up and running for a few seasons, we have collected tons of feedback and have also learned that our game has  lots of room for improvement. 

2022 year is just around the corner, marking a new beginning. We'd like to take this chance to share our plans with you all.


Current State of Balance 

We have to admit there are shortcomings in Conqueror's Blade when it comes to design and maintenance concerning balance, and we have failed to address issues quickly enough when they arise. For this, we are truly sorry. 

One of the biggest balance issues has been the Axe Raiders that came in the Tyranny season. We have thought much and have come up with the two following reasons: 

1) The dev team has pooled too much resources into creating new content for new seasons, and thereby overlooked the balance of current units. 
2) Due to controversies about Fire Lance Cavalry adjustments, we have been too conservative in changing popular units. It is the team's wish to give each unit its own place in the game via systematic changes, rather than crudely altering the numbers of certain problematic units. Naturally, this has led to us not being able to address certain issues in time, and in turn, to a more negative reception. 

The game's balance is of utmost importance and an issue we must face head-on. We will immediately start rolling out a series of balance changes based on the following train of thought: 

Ideas on Adjustments 

According to the data, the 10 most used units make up a total of 46.8% of all units used. This is three times as high as during the Northmen season and the number is still rising. This means that the other 80+ units don't see much usage. This situation is in stark contrast to the diversified battles we have in mind. We are planning to make public data regarding several units’ performance, and roll out a series of changes to make battles more varied and balanced. 

A goal we have always had is for more units to have their own unique roles in the complex battlefield of Conqueror's Blade. We have also made attempts since the Northmen season. For example, changes for Ironcap Swordsmen and Iron Reapers have made them usable once more. Conqueror's Blade is made up of almost one hundred units, and in the future, we want to increase the speed and quality with which we change units that need changing. All in all, we want our players to enjoy more units in battles.

Adjustments Preview 

1. Axe Raiders 

The Axe Raiders are strong in several ways. They are tankier and deal more damage than average units of their leadership cost, leading to high usage and win rate. Based on their characteristics, we have decided to tune down their survivability to better fit into their category as squishy light infantry. These changes will make them weaker when affected by other units.

2. Modao Battalion 

The Modao Battalion has always been a highly used unit. Data shows that they are exceedingly tanky and deal high damage. Their tight formation and easy-to-use skills have led to them being overly powerful in organized group battles. While we don't want to change their characteristics, we will be nerfing a reasonable degree of their damage dealt to other infantry, especially infantry using shields. 

There are many aspects affecting balance, including Heroes’ weapons, runes, maps, and so on. We will continue to monitor balance and roll out grounded and systematic changes. In the near future, we will also be changing some underused units based on data and community feedback, such as firearm and heavy shield infantry.

Please check out the announcement on balance changes we will be publishing in the near future for more concrete information. 

We estimate that this round of changes will hit the servers on Jan. 6, 2022. With the changes, we will also issue compensation to all players as a form of apology. 

1) We will issue the items required to remove all doctrines equipped to units receiving nerfs. 
2) All players will receive an extra 25 Doctrine Water so that you may change your doctrines after the update. 
3) All players will also receive 3 Treatises. 

Player Community

We also wish to strengthen communication with our players and provide timely responses to your feedback. Please tell us if you have any thoughts or ideas about these balance changes or other improvements! 

Feel free to contact us via any of our communities or send your feedback directly to [cb_support@boomingtech.com]. Your feedback is the best motivator for us to keep growing. 

Future of Conqueror's Blade

Diversity and balance are integral topics to Conqueror's Blade. We want to shorten the time required to roll out balance changes based on communicating with our players. 

During the past seasons, we have continued to launch new heroes, units, maps, and other content, all to bring you a more diverse gameplay experience. In doing so, we have overlooked the importance of what's already there, for example, the aforementioned balance issues. This has instead made it difficult for players to wage war the way they want to. Going forward, our focus will be on creating a more balanced, transparent, and varied Conqueror's Blade. 

Once again, thank you for all your feedback and encouragement. Conqueror's Blade is only here because of you. And we hope to create an even better world in Conqueror's Blade with your help. 

Finally, we have herein prepared for you a few gifts in celebration of the new year.
1) Treatise x2
2) [Shadowlight] Attire Treasure x1
3) Dancing Dragon x1 (Epic)
4) Thunderstar x1 (Epic)

Wish you all a happy new year! And see you next time! 

The Conqueror's Blade Team 
December 31, 2021

notes.title: [Highlanders] CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM
notes.content:
The CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM is aimed at all content creators that make high-quality Conqueror's Blade content. With this program we aim to provide such content creators more support and help for even more content! From this point onward, we will be recruiting new content creators with each new season, and hope that more and more creators join us!

Registration:23/12/2021 – 06/01/2022

I、	If you are a:

1) Video creator:
- 200+ followers
- Created at least 1 video per week and no less than 10 videos between August and October

2) Streamer:
- 200+ followers
- Streamed at least 1 time per week and no less than 45 hours between August and October

3) Strategy guide creator:
- Create Conqueror's Blade strategy guides or related articles, including those pertaining to units, beginner's guides, Territory War reports, etc.

II、	If you wish to join the CREATOR INCENTIVE PROGRAM

Feel free to fill in the following form if you meet any one of the above criterions:
https://forms.gle/3CcsjWt3av4usQBY7
Should you have any other questions whatsoever, feel free to contact us on QQ, Discord, or via email cb_event@boominggames.com.

III、	By joining the CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM you will receive the following:

1.	Exclusive Promotion Channels
You will be added to an exclusive Creator chat where you can talk directly with the dev team, you will also be able to post your videos and articles on exclusive channels.

2. In-game Item Support
If you meet your monthly quota during our co-operation, you will receive Sovereigns and other item rewards!

3. Exclusive Gift Code
You can share your own gift code with your fans while you stream or in your videos. Your fans can then claim extra rewards from within the "O" menu.

4. PTR Testing
You will also be eligible to partake in PTR testing for new seasons during the course of our co-operation, so that you can experience our newest content before anyone else!

IV、	We need you to,

Video Creators
-	Create at least 4 videos related to Conqueror's Blade each month
-	Have above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video

Streamers
-	Stream at least one time per week with an average length of at least 4 hours per stream
-	Have above 30 viewers on average

What's more, as a participant of the CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM, we hope you join in on even more content, such as providing commentary for the season tournaments, draft war reports, video re-creation, etc. Naturally, such extra content will net you even greater rewards.

V、	Important Notes

1. Mind your language while streaming, in your videos and when sending posts.
2. You should publish enough content on a regular basis as per the above requirements.
3. We will terminate our co-operation with you should any of the following occur:

 Should you make improper remarks in-game, in player communities, or in your video/stream that negatively effects the game.
 Playing Conqueror's Blade with hacks or otherwise violate our ToS.
 Create a series of new accounts to raise your following and/or to have such accounts use your gift code.
 Should you fail to publish enough content on a regular basis and fail to meet the content quota.

In the Highlanders season, we're introducing a new 4-star unit, the Claymores. And these are now available for preorder: get the [Claymores Basic Preorder Bundle] or [Claymores Deluxe Preorder Bundle] to be one of the first to try out the Claymores when the new season launches.

Unit Description:
  
Star Level: ★★★★
 Background Info: 
       
Celtland is famed for its spirits, ballads, and warriors. And the Claymores are considered the mightiest of their warriors. These stalwart fighters carry two-handed blades crafted by renowned swordsmiths and wield them with deadly ferocity. These Claymores are most known for the Battle of Gallows Hill. At the time, the leader of the Celtlish revolt, Rupert, was being chased by Wealish soldiers as he hurried northward to request the aid of the tribes there. But the Wealish cavalry was hot on his heels and the situation was dire. A group of Claymores tasked with escorting Rupert volunteered to stay behind and buy him time enough to escape. They held the Wealish soldiers at bay for a whole hour, which was enough for Rupert to flee and request aid. When the reinforcements arrived, they were met with a nightmarish scene: the corpses of all the thirty Claymores, along with dead foes many times their numbers. Henceforth, the Claymores' bravery and loyalty became known throughout Celtland and Wealand, the former hailing them as mighty warriors whereas the latter talked about them only in hushed whispers. 

Unit Characteristics: 

  They do best when fighting together with other units and can buff allies and themselves.
  To get the most out of them you must use their skills differently depending on the situation. 
  Some of their skills greatly increase their survivability and damage, but also come with side effects.

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT JOURNAL | ASSIST POINTS
notes.content:
We will be introducing a feature called [Assist Points] with the coming Highlanders season. You will gain these by contributing to your team, and therefrom earn a reasonable increase in rating and rewards.

Why are we introducing Assist Points?

The short answer: to give players more freedom of choice in battle, and more strategic options. In previous iterations, our battle rating system has favored those who wreck the most carnage 
upon their foes, while leaving behind Warlords who take on a bigger support role. E.g., the Imperial Pike Guards' Advance skill is a great option to crowd-control the Modao Battalion, giving your allies a better chance at taking them out. While they didn't take down the enemy themselves, they obviously contributed greatly to the battle. Some more examples would include a longsword & shield hero who can heal allies or crowd-control enemy heroes and units; the glaive hero who can buff the damage of allies for a short period; the shortsword & shield hero which can use the Thunderstruck skill to break the enemy's formation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/758c8f850e37b85e2ae2c7d3ae14b4b807243f78.gif

While all of the above examples greatly affect the outcome of a battle, they give near-to-no battle scores whatsoever. Warlords bring support-type units to aid their allies, but aren't rewarded for it. This has led to a decline in the willingness of players to use support units, making battles less diversified. So, we're introducing [Assist Points] to re-balance the value gained from supportive actions, which hopefully will lead to greater diversity in terms of strategic choices.
       To reiterate, you will in the new version gain Assist Points by supporting your allies, be it with your hero or units, and in doing so gain better scores than previous rating system.

Which actions count as Assist Points? And how do they affect your Assist Points?


 Buffing the attack and defense of allies.
  Healing allies.
  Crowd-controlling enemies to create an opening for greater damage to be dealt.
 Tanking and sustaining damage for your allies.

Of the aforementioned four scenarios, only [Damage Taken] currently grants a bonus to your battle score. Meaning that the other three new additions will contribute more to the Assist Points in this update. However, there are naturally protentional problems with this, one of them being: a player spam-buffing just to farm score. That's why we've gone a step further, by introducing Valid Assist Actions (VAA). 
  
      As you can imagine, VAAs are actions that actually end up being beneficial to the battle's outcome. If we take the new Highlanders unit Bagpipers as an example: They can buff the attack and defense of allied heroes and units. If they choose to buff attack, and those buffed by them do not deal any damage whatsoever, then the buff obviously didn't play any part in the battle's outcome, thus, it won't grant Assist Points. This further means that how, and when, you use your supportive buffs and skills will play an integral part in the score you earn.

                                            {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c36cb761666b58b31420fc3a48b2249b7dc4f0dd.jpg

      Similarly, only heals that actually restore health or skills that end up crowd-controlling enemies grant Assist Points.
      Owing to these changes, Warlords who use for example the Imperial Pike Guards, Sigrun's Shieldmaidens, or the new season's Bagpipers, to help their allies in battle can receive a high battle score, even if they do not end up damaging or killing enemy heroes or units.

And Finally—A New Start

Conqueror's Blade strives to provide a realistic medieval combat experience, and the truth is that real battles are complex, an amalgamation of different elements. This naturally means that a great variety of units are required. We sincerely hope that this new Assist Points feature will bring about more joy with more varied gameplay and that it will make playing a more supportive style viable.
But each new feature or change that is introduced, is bound to create ripples in one way or another. We are fully prepared for that, and this update will serve as a new start on our journey for a better game. We will continue to work hard to resolve your gripes with the game, continue to optimize it, bring about better balance, and more varied gameplay.
Finally, once again thank you for your comments and encouragement. We would love for you to continue sharing any issues or feedback you encounter while playing, so that we may improve Conqueror's Blade even further, creating a fairer and more fun experience.

notes.title: [SEASON PREVIEW] ALL-NEW MAP——QUINN RUINS
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_wuqEca5PfU;full]https://youtu.be/_wuqEca5PfU[/previewyoutube]

Esteemed Warlord,

We rolled out one new map during both the Northmen and Dynasty season (Heilung Fjord & Linwu Fortress), and now with the Highlanders season comes Quinn Ruins. I am sure many of you are curious to see what it looks like and that's what we'll be exploring next, this sacred land of the Celtlish!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0addf12f2327dc1d03bcd79dde828785df3ac415.jpg

Background Info

       The Quinn Ruins is a sacred place for the Celtlish. Legends say that the first settlers were so captivated by the view that they settled down here. However, it was destroyed during the invasion and their relic was stolen—the Stone of Destiny. The Celtlish have banded together now that the flames of war ravage the Highlands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b74f1a282dde87d1f2f6315224ad1cfe82d2e1c2.jpg

Strategic Highlights

      Quinn Ruins is made up of a village and a lakeside area to the east. The ground rises higher the further east you go until it ends in a cliff. Having occupied the ruins, the Wealish army made camp within the castle ruins and used the village's resources to erect defenses, artilleries, and traps. Even so, the Celtlish were familiar with the lay of the land and found many directions from which to attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a66ce44375098da4336c5f7eb6cfc8a7606e70fd.jpg

      One point of attack is from the village's southernmost point. There isn't much in terms of obstacles, but tar traps that set units ablaze. Tread carefully to avoid suffering heavy losses from the traps. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3344bf5827e6a2ec22dfc0d657810b146ac7b9d3.jpg

       A is located in the square surrounded by dwellings. The attacker can use these as cover and avoid being attacked from the sentry post. A can also be reached from a narrow passageway to the eastern side, which can also be used to harass the defenders' supply points. Naturally, by attacking from the west it becomes easier to claim the sentry post and gain the height advantage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/95f2cd64a316b3a40032f8d212c8728354742479.jpg

       There is a special point within the sentry post where the defenders can use Incendiary Catapult to harass the attacker or to create flaming traps. By claiming this point, the attacker extends the map time and makes it easier to assume control of this area. In doing so, they will also gain access to the Incendiary Catapult with which they can pelt the defenders. Though, the entrance of the sentry post is narrow and is surrounded by wooden walls and palisades, making it easy to defend while very difficult to attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/34574e558f4ff03f9344fb17480d4cf34b404565.jpg

       B is located between the village and the castle, meaning that the defenders must defend B and supply point by the narrow mountain path at the same time. They must also remain vigilant to defend the sentry posts and the catapult. Naturally, the attackers can use the narrow paths to assault B and use the Incendiary Catapult if they captured the sentry post.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/67c6f648f32e3f0bdbf319a4872897450c84e647.jpg

      Finally, the final camp is located in an empty space of the castle ruins directly beside the cliffs. The attackers can attack via two passageways and should attempt to attack from multiple directions within the ruins as the terrain is complex.

Map Mechanics

Incendiary Catapult

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f03a2058243532db552b27dff8f73474efc5ef05.jpg

      There is an Incendiary Catapult at the sentry post with which one can hurl combustible canisters that deal continuous damage to forces in an area. Interact with the nearby artillery toggle to deploy it.

Tar Traps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/23b36a8a71b336934a3be585cc258e65e0789b7d.jpg

      Tar traps are spread out in the open space at the village entrance. These traps can be set ablaze with fire attacks to deal damage over time to heroes and units in the area.


Launch Date

The season is estimated to launch on December 21st, 2021. Keep an eye out for our event notices.

To celebrate the coming of Christmas, we will release a series of Christmas exclusive attires on Dec. 21st. You can have a glimpse of these whole new attires in Content Creators’ streams happening this weekend. For more information of the event, please see to our Notice on Dec. 20th.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/888e2a0c891abccff8124806fd5c7a91e406404a.gif

notes.title: [Season Preview] 5-STAR UNIT: HOUNDSMEN
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord,

The Highlanders season comes with a 5-star unit featuring all-new mechanics—Houndsmen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f37ac775f988a38eb00eb901e8c14e0bbbeced64.jpg

Units Info:

Star Level: ★★★★★

Background Info:

Many are the legends about the deep northern forests of Celtland. One of the most well-known is one where Wealish soldiers vanished without a trace. Before the revolt had begun, the Wealish often terrorized villages near the forests, and some made the mistake of entering. Those that did, were never seen again.
A Wealish search party was sent to follow their tracks. And found something they did: the bloodied, mangled bodies of their former comrades. Their chests were riddled with arrows, and they had bite marks everywhere. The Celtlish who believed in Druidism claimed the Wealish had been punished by the spirits of the forest. Naturally, the Wealish didn't believe in such nonsense and scoured the forest for many an hour—finding nothing of note. Following this incident, the Wealish forbade their men from setting foot within the forest.
What transpired there remained in mystery until the war began. Bows at their backs, a group of hunters and their fierce hounds emerged from the forest hinterlands and joined the army against Wealish invaders. They were master marksmen who fought alongside their well-trained canine friends. They came to bring the Wealish nothing but pain and death.
Following the war, the historians later wrote about their exploits when recording down the events that transpired, and named them the Houndsmen.

[previewyoutube=k6JY-baNuuc;full]https://youtu.be/k6JY-baNuuc[/previewyoutube]

Unit Characteristics:

- High rate of Shooting for big damage and a short bleed.
- Their agile hounds interrupt the enemy and slow them down.
- When hunters and their hounds attack together they deal greater damage.
  
  Joint Attack: Makes the enemy take more damage.
    Hamstring: Makes it difficult for the enemy to move.

notes.title: CONQUEROR'S BLADE DECEMBER 16TH UPDATE LOG
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on December 16th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. NEW SEASON PREVIEW

Highlanders Season available on Dec. 21

The horns of war are sounding once more! Let us witness the legend of the Celtland warriors together!

That sound... The Highlanders are piping on their bagpipes!
The Highlanders season is coming to Conqueror's Blade on Dec. 21st as a free update.

UNITE THE CLANS: 3 NEW UNITS

Freedom is calling. Recruit warriors from the far reaches of the Highlands and unlock three new Seasonal Units comprised of the bravest and best the realm has to offer. Band together with your kinsmen and draft the following Highlanders throughout Season Highlanders.

• Bagpipers (3-Star): The first unit of its kind, a morale-boosting band whose musical weapon of choice buffs their allies with rousing melodies.
• Claymores (4-Star): These sword-wielding heroes from the Battle of Gallows Hill brandish prized greatswords, gaining more defence as they attack.
• Houndsmen (5-Star): The first animal unit to join the fray in Conqueror’s Blade, this hunting company will heed the call alongside their fiercely loyal dogs of war.


DEFEND THE HIGHLANDS: NEW MAP

Order your new fighters to defend or attack Quinn Ruins, the historic site of the first Highlander settlement and a place held sacred by its people. The Wealish have invaded this precious homeland and ignited the will of the Highlanders, daring them to reclaim their consecrated land. This new Siege Map invites two teams of 12 players to battle for ownership, while avoiding being decimated by tar traps and incendiary catapults. 

PREORDER THE NEW BATTLE PASS

The Season Battle Pass is now available to pre-purchase in-game. With over 100 levels of Premium rewards to unlock, your quest for liberty will reward you with everything from new Hero and Unit Attire, to Emotes, Weapon Skins, and so much more. Conqueror’s Blade is, of course, a free-to-play game, so there are plenty of rewards to be found on the Free Pass too.

PREPARE FOR SEASON HIGHLANDERS!

Prepare to make history in Season Highlanders with pre-season prep events!

II. EVENT NOTICE

[Collect Cornucopia to get rewards.]
[Thanksgiving Login Rewards]
2. [Conqueror's City - Counterattack] is being added to the matchmaking pool of siege battles.

Esteemed Warlord,

The Highlanders season comes with an all-new 4-star melee unit—Claymores.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/893e1cfa2e4a8b5a221793b87659ef25c95be9b1.jpg

Unit Description:

Star Level: ★★★★

Background Info:

       Celtland is famed for its spirits, ballads, and warriors. And the Claymores are considered the mightiest of their warriors. These stalwart fighters carry two-handed blades crafted by renowned swordsmiths and wield them with deadly ferocity.
These Claymores are most known for the Battle of Gallows Hill. At the time, the leader of the Celtlish revolt, Rupert, was being chased by Wealish soldiers as he hurried northward to request the aid of the tribes there. But the Wealish cavalry was hot on his heels and the situation was dire. A group of Claymores tasked with escorting Rupert volunteered to stay behind and buy him time enough to escape.
They held the Wealish soldiers at bay for a whole hour, which was enough for Rupert to flee and request aid. When the reinforcements arrived, they were met with a nightmarish scene: the corpses of all the thirty Claymores, along with dead foes many times their numbers.
Henceforth, the Claymores' bravery and loyalty became known throughout Celtland and Wealand, the former hailing them as mighty warriors whereas the latter talked about them only in hushed whispers.

notes.title: [SEASON PREVIEW] QOL IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord,

We are happy to announce a round of QoL improvements with the Highlanders season!
Let's get right into it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c6c5f011234379a508005dc946d0388920893867.png

Inventory Improvements

We are improving Inventory management and you can now filter items with the All, Hero, Consumables, and Materials tabs.
We are improving Wagon inventory management and you can now filter items with the Collected Materials, Artilleries, and Others tabs.

Specializations

[Special Mastery Points] will be going away in the [Highlanders] season, and will be converted into [Skill Points] at a certain ratio.

Character Creation

We have reworked the character creation process and it should now feel better than before.
With the Highlanders season, we are also adding a few facial tattoos. Naturally, existing characters can find these in the Customization menu.

World Map & Territory War Changes We will be rolling out a series of changes to Territory War during the Highlanders season, including changes to the duration of fief battle, fief construction, fief quests, and World Map march speed. 

Customization

Hairstyles, hair color, facial tattoos, and scars can now be chosen directly from the Customization menu and won't require paid items. These will also be available for free when creating a character.

Score Calculation Changes

Assist Points

We are adding [Assist Points], which you gain depending on your assistance in any given battle. Ways in which to gain Assist Points are: healing allied heroes or units and buffing their attack or defense; crowd-controlling enemy heroes or units; debuffing the attack or defense of enemy heroes or units. Your Assist Points also affect your final battle score.

Mount Care


 	We are removing Health for horses. 
 	The Horse Seller will no longer be selling Hay. 
 	After the Tyranny season concludes, all Hay you own will be converted into Bronze Coins at a ratio of 1:500.





Keep an eye out for the Season Patch Notes for more information on coming changes!

notes.title: TYRANNY SERVER TRANSFER INFO
notes.content:
The Tyranny season is about to end and a new season begin. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

	Server Transfer Time:

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on December 9th, Thursday, after maintenance, and run through December 16th, Thursday, after the maintenance (UTC+8).

2、Servers will be taken down for maintenance on December 21st, Tuesday, 00:00 (UTC+8) during which server transfers will be done.

	Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

	Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

	Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:

2. There are no additional transfer restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers. There is no limit for character to transfer out from Jaderock Creek. Only characters created after December 21st, 0:00, 2020 are eligible for transfer to Jaderock Creek.

	Transfer Quotas

Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.
Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

	How to Transfer:

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred following the December 21st maintenance.

	Important:

1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before December 20th, 23:59 (UTC+8). Upon cancelling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon cancelling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.

3. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.

4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Your character will be removed from your House, Alliance/Imperial Restorationists. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.

5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, nor can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.

6. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

notes.title: TYRANNY RESULTS ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Season Results 

•	The season will be concluding with the December 9th maintenance, 2021. 
•	You will not be able to gain Glory from Battles, Expedition, Free Battles, Territory War or by leveling up following the Dec. 9, 2021, maintenance until the next season begins. 
•	Glory can still be earned via Weekly Challenges, Weekly Quest Gifts, Blood-stained Intel, and Missives of Command. 
•	The Seasonal Store will also be available until the new season begins. 
Campaigns Results 
•	We will begin tallying the results of this season's Campaigns on Dec. 6th, 12:00, 2021. 
•	The final results will be available after the maintenance on Dec. 9th, 2021. 
Fief Rewards: 
•	After tallying the Campaigns' rewards, we will be issuing Empire Coins to all Warlords in accordance with the number, type, and level of fiefs their Alliance/Legions occupy. 

 	The number of fiefs an Alliance/Legion possesses will be counted as it stands when the Dec. 9th (2021) maintenance begins. 
 	Fief level 1-5 cities: Empire Coin x30. 
 	Fief level 6-15 cities: Empire Coin x50. 
 	Fief level 1-5 forts: Empire Coin x30. 
 	Fief level 6-15 forts: Empire Coin x50. 
 	Fief level 1-5 villages: Empire Coin x15. 
 	Fief level 6-15 villages: Empire Coin x30. 
 	Anliang and Augolia grant better rewards than other fiefs. Occupying either grants Empire Coin x100, Treatise x3, and Epic Artillery Selection Box x3. 
 	Conqueror's City grants better rewards than other fiefs. Occupying it grants Empire Coin x150, Treatise x5, Epic Barding Schematic Crate x2, and Epic Artillery Selection Box x5. Should the Imperial Restorationists successfully defend the Conqueror's City, all titled Imperial Restorationists will gain the above rewards.

•	A single Warlord may gain a maximum of 1,000 Empire Coins from fief rewards. 
Title Rewards: 
•	The titles of all lieges for this season will be confirmed on Dec. 4th, 22:30, 2021. 
•	Additional Empire Coin rewards will also be granted according to each Warlord's Free House/Imperial Restorationists title. 
•	Free House titles grant the following rewards: 
Hegemon: Empire Coin x600. 
Monarch: Empire Coin x550. 
Chamberlain: Empire Coin x500. 
Chief Justiciar and General: Empire Coin x400. 
High Councilor, Judge, and Commander: Empire Coin x350. 
Minister, High Sheriff, and Captain: Empire Coin x300. 
Elector, Magistrate, and Constable: Empire Coin x200. 
Alderman, Bailiff, and Castellan: Empire Coin x100. 
Burgess, Freeholder, and Shieldbearer: Empire Coin x50. 
•	Additional Empire Coin rewards will also be granted to each Warlord according to their Imperial Restorationists' titles, as well as whether or not they manage to defend Conqueror's City and stop the Free Houses from attaining the title of Hegemon. 
Supreme Commander/Hand of Kingdom: Gains Empire Coin x600 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x400 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x300 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Marshal/Hand of Lords: Gains Empire Coin x550 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x350 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x270 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Deputy Marshal/Hand of Commons: Gains Empire Coin x500 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x300 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x240 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Admiral, Lieutenant General, and Major General: Gains Empire Coin x400 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x240 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x200 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Colonel, Lieutenant Colonel, and Major: Gains Empire Coin x350 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x180 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x160 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Captain, Lieutenant, and Second Lieutenant: Gains Empire Coin x300 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x120 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x100 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Aquilifer/Sergeant and Legionary/Sergeant Major: Gains Empire Coin x200 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x80 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x50 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
Venator/Thousands, Munifex/Hundreds, and Veles/Tens: Gains Empire Coin x100 should Conqueror's City remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x30 should Conqueror's City be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Will not be granted any Empire Coins should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title. 
•	Empire Coin rewards from titles are not affected by the reward cap of fiefs. 

Empire Coin Exchange Event: 

•	Empire Coins can be redeemed for various resources within the “Empire's Treasury" menu accessed via the O key. Including Epic Hero Schematic Crates, Epic Barding Schematic Crates, Treatises, Powdered Silver, Rare Equipment Schematics, Unit Medals, Hero XP Cards, and Unit XP Cards. 
	Rewards can be redeemed from Dec. 9th, 2021, (after maintenance) until Jan 20th, 24:00, 2022. 
Headwear & Title Rewards: 

•	Free Houses 

 	A crown will be issued according to each warlord’s title, and can be used until the end of the next season. 
 	Proprietors of the Hegemon and Monarch titles will also receive an exclusive attire. 
 	All members of the alliance that in the end occupies Conqueror's City will gain the Tyranny Destiny title. 


•	Imperial Restorationists 

 	Second Lieutenants and above will receive a headwear befitting of their station which lasts until the end of the next season. 
 	Warlords with titles below Second Lieutenant will instead receive 20,000 Bronze Coins. 

•	Those of the Imperial Restorationists who take part in the battle for Anliang, Augolia, or Conqueror's City will gain the permanent title of [Tyranny Volunteer]. Should they manage to defend Anliang or Augolia, or should they fail to defend Conqueror's City while still preventing the Free Houses from earning the title of Hegemon, they will be granted with the permanent title of [Tyranny Royal Guard] instead. Should they manage to defend Conqueror's City, all Imperial Restorationists who partook in its defense will receive the permanent title of [Tyranny Legion] instead. To successfully defend Anliang, Augolia, and Conqueror's City, the fiefs must be under their respective region's NPC rulership on December 6th, 12:00, 2021.
Between-season Territory War Schedule & Territory Reset: 
•	[Booming] After the Campaigns results have been tallied, Military Exercises and Territory War will be available until the next season begins. 

	No Territory War-related activities will be held on Dec. 7th, 2021, and they will instead be replaced by Free Battles. 

•	Territory War will run as normal every Tuesday and Saturday after Dec. 9th, 2021. 

 	Neither Anliang, Augolia, nor Conqueror's City can be attacked during this time. 
 	Fiefs occupied in Territory War during this time will not count toward your Empire Coin rewards. 

•	Territories will be fully reset when the next season begins. 
Ranked Battle Results 
•	This season's Ranked Battle will be closed after the maintenance on Dec. 9th, 2021 (Ranked Battles will be replaced by Free Battles). We will then be issuing the rewards according to each players' Ranked Battle score. 

All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 800 will receive the following: 
	Unit Medal x60 
	Powdered Silver x20 
	Honour x10,000 
	Treatise x3 

	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,200 will receive the following: 
	Unit Medal x60 
	Epic Barding Schematic Crate x1 
	Gold Dust x30 
	Treatise x7 

	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,500 will receive the following: 
	The Permanent Honorary Title: Tyrant Slayer
	Ranked Battle Custom Unit Attire Selection Box x1 
	All of the aforementioned rewards stacks, so a Warlord whose Ranked Battle score exceeds 1,500 will be granted all of the rewards. 
	To further reward Warlords who have excelled in Ranked Battles, the top 25 will receive the following: 

 	The special mount banner attire: Great Eagle Banner. 
 	The Great Eagle Banner will be usable until the end of the next season. 
 	The banner will be sent by mail, so keep an eye out for it should you meet the requirements.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League Rules
notes.content:
Tournament Version & Client

	Tournament Version: Official Version
	Client: Steam/Official Website Client
	Server: Tournament Servers

1)	Players on the Lotus Ash Sea (LA)/Dragonrise Island (DI)/Jaderock Creek (JC) servers play on the CBL Asia Server.
2)	Players on the Espada Forest (EF) server play on the CBL SA Server.
3)	Players on the Sandstorm Gorge (SG) server play on the CBL MENA Server.
Note: Only players with a character of level 100+ on the LA, DI, JC, SG, and EF servers may enter the tournament servers.

	Tournament Accounts

	Fairness Measures
The accounts of all contestants will have the same equipment and unit configurations.

	Doctrines Are Disabled
No unit will be able to use doctrines during the tournament.

	Runes Are Disabled
Heroes may not use runes during the tournament.

	Artillery Restrictions
Contestants may only use artilleries of rare quality, and there will be a limit to the number of artilleries each player may use depending on the mode being played.

	Match Modes

	Siege Battles

1)	Map Pool: Harbour City, Linwu Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
2)	Attack/Defend Order: Refer to Ban & Pick under the 'Ruleset' further on in the document.
3)	Siege Battle Rules:
i.	15 players on each squad. (10 each on Linwu Fortress)
ii.	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
iii.	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
iv.	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
v.	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
4)	Victory Conditions:
i.	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
ii.	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.

	Field Battle, Capture the Flag

1)	Map Pool: Grassland Assault
2)	Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
3)	Field Battle Rules:
i.	15 players on each side.
ii.	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
iii.	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
iv.	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.

4)	Victory Conditions:
i.	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
ii.	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
iii.	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
iv.	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
5)	Draw & Extra Match Rules:
i.	Played on Grassland Assault.
ii.	The two squads switch sides.
iii.	Victory conditions remain unchanged.
iv.	Should the extra match result in a draw, further extra matches will be played until one side wins.


	Ruleset

	Division & Cross-Division Matches

Ruleset: Best of 3
The two squads' captains roll.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
i.	The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
ii.	And then the other squad bans one map.
iii.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.

	Division Final

Ruleset: Best of 7
Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
-	The squad from the Winner's Bracket starts with 1 point, meaning that the score starts at 1:0 when the finals begin.
-  Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick
-  The first two matches are played on Linwu Fortress.
-  For the third and fourth matches, the pool is as follows.
- Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, 	Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
i.	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
ii.	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
iii.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
-  For the fifth and sixth matches:
i.	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
ii.	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
iii.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads play Siege Battles against each other in accordance with the attack/defend order on the maps selected.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 4 points win.

	Code of Conduct

	Forfeit Regulations

Forfeit Rulings

1）	If, after 24 hours have passed after the drawing ceremony, we are unable to contact you and confirm your squad's participation, your squad will be considered to have forfeited participation.

2）	If we have been unable to contact your squad before 10 minutes of match start, you will be considered to have forfeited participation.

3) Squads who ahead of time contact a referee and forfeit of their own volition will be considered to have forfeited participation.

	Dealing with Forfeits

1) Should a squad forfeit, no other squad will take their place, and their opponent will be considered victorious and therefore promoted.

	Rematches & Pauses:

1)	Participants are responsible for their own network connections during the tournament. The referees will confirm with both teams whether they are ready. A match is considered as having begun once the countdown timer has begun. There will be no rematches for disconnects or lag once a match has begun.

2)	Disconnecting and reconnecting during a match will count as one death.

3) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants (10 on Linwu Fortress) per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a match within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the match, giving the win to the other squad.

4) No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.

	Tournament Prohibitions:

1)	Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loopholes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament. Their account on the official server will also be banned.

2)	Players whose accounts are banned on the live servers may not sign up for the tournament. Players whose accounts are for any reason whatsoever banned on the live servers during the course of the tournament will have their participation qualification revoked.

3)	Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.

4)	Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions appear, and if so, their opponent will immediately be victorious.

5)	Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

6)	Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of, and we may prosecute for related responsibility.

7)	Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.
The CBL Tournament is made up of five divisions: Asia, South America, MENA, EU/US, and NetEase China. A player partaking in more than one will be violating our rule for 'duplicate signups', and if discovered by us, or if a player reports them with relevant proof, they will have their participation qualification revoked.

8) Should a squad or member of a squad violate any tournament regulation, referees have the authority to rule them as being violated, and to disqualify said squad or member.

	The final interpretation right of CBL belongs to Booming Technology (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd.
	Should you have any inquiries whatsoever, feel free to join:
	Conqueror's Blade Discord: https://discord.gg/2xuVpZErgb and contact violeta#4335
	CBL Communication Group: 788262212 (QQ), contact 战意小c弟

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 25th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on November 25th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. EVENT NOTICE

The [Thanksgiving Spendings Return] event is starting.
The [Reckless Demons] event featuring the new Cataphract Lancers changes hit the live servers.
Following their changes, the Cataphract Lancers will require 50 less leadership on all servers for a total leadership of 260.
There'll also be exclusive quests and discount packs for the newly changed unit!

II. TERRITORY WAR CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	There's now a button on the Open World to set your primary unit. Selecting a unit and clicking this button will set that unit as your primary unit. The previous Remove Unit button has been removed from the menu. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/174bcee92fbc34c8a1a95d9c71ea3ad5cc9ac121.jpg
 
 	Hovering your pointer over the World Map - Units menu will now mark it with a white frame.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/955c8e48c5ae698b35475b0d287a374a73a44bd4.jpg

 	Imperial Restorationists already on the map won't receive summons from regional lords issuing a war rally.


III. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	Resolved an issue with respawn timers for artilleries after the attackers occupied the artillery point on the [Conqueror's City - Counterattack] map.
 [Cannons] respawn in 30 seconds.
 [Mortars] respawn in 40 seconds.
 [Catapults] respawn in 50 seconds.
 [War Rockets] respawn in 60 seconds.
 	Resolved an issue where some fiefs in the Borderlands didn't have an option for forging uncommon-quality artilleries.
 	Added guiding lines and circles to the tutorial.
 	Improved upon the matchmaking algorithm for attackers/defenders. You should now be less likely to be repeatedly assigned to the same side.
 	Imperial Restorationists that haven't partaken in Territory War will no longer receive Territory War reports.
 Resolved an issue where acclaim would sometimes be displayed incorrectly in Territory War reports.
 	Increased the font size of the fief information menu.
 	Adjusted the visuals of the fief and resource site interaction menus on the World Map.
 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
 	Resolved an issue where some units had identical identifiers in the English, Spanish, and Portuguese versions.

notes.title: A LETTER FROM THE EAGLE'S TALON
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7027cf0e5982d5f31b14f7bac3575054f0b9db55.jpg

Hailed Warlord!

Well met!

Winter is nearing once more. Tell me, friend, do you miss the koumiss at the Eagle's Talon, my tavern? I still remember that terrible cold...the seemingly endless winter where you and the other heroes stood firm against the Scourge of Winter and expelled the Norse. After which you went forth to Longting where you once again earned greatness.
It has been many moons since the two of us met. Alas, how time flies!
But that's all in the past... Ungverija's royal family is currently seeking far and wide for writers with great literary talent to pen down heroic epics! The first thing I did upon receiving this news, was to write you this letter in the hopes that you too participate!
The royal documents elicit the following as the Heroic Epic Council's recruitment procedure:

First Recruitment Wave: 19/11/2021-26/11/2021
Second Recruitment Wave: 29/11/2021-6/12/2021

Submission Requirements:

No less than 300 words. Any content. Must be a fairly complete original creation of solid and fluent writing.

The monarch of Ungveria is providing a grant of 400 Sovereigns to all participants.

Council Ceremony: 16/12/2021

Should your heroic epic be one of those the royal family selects, you will also receive an exclusive Thanksgiving attire and the rare title Minstrel.

You have survived many a near encounter in these troubling times. Each experience has left an imprint on memory: Sharing a common hatred and fighting side-by-side, you are bound to arise and stand against the wicked during times of great strife, making your fame resound far and wide... We mustn't let your stories become history, to be taken by the river of time into oblivion.
You and I have corresponded via mail for many a year, and I know full well that your pen is as mighty as your sword! This is simply an opportunity too good to miss.
Alice the Bard has recently returned from the Borderlands. I trust that tales of her travels will provide you with food for thought.

Before you head to the recruitment, would you perchance come by the Eagle's Talon for drink and food?


                                                     Eagle's Talon, Turul Város 
                                                              Bachan

Please Note:

1.	You can earn both the Council Ceremony and the participation rewards.
2.	Participation rewards will only be granted to those whose submissions meet the requirement.
3.	You may only receive one participation reward, no matter how many works you submit during the recruitment waves.
4.	Works must be related to Conqueror's Blade and be submitted as a word document via our official submission channels. Each participant may submit multiple pieces (but the participation reward is only granted once).
5.	All of the aforementioned rewards will be sent via in-game mail after the event has concluded.
6.	The final interpretation right of this event belongs to Booming Technology.

notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on November 18th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. EVENT NOTICE

New [Tyranny] season map—[Conqueror's City - Counterattack]

The war against the Sarazhan empire is nearing the final phase. It is time to reclaim Conqueror's City and bring judgment upon Cambyses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/eda0bf38b4d773254cf10a9cb952d64ef1a8018e.png
 
Check [This Week’s Exciting Events] for when it is available.

 	[Bloodmoon] limited-time attire challenge event has ended. Rewards can be claimed (or paid off) until November 25th (before maintenance). Do so before it is too late.
 	The [Cataphract Lancers] changes will take effect on November 25th. Stay tuned!
 Whether towns or villages, whether forests or mountains, the Cataphract Lancers never fail to valiantly charge at their enemy head-on. They're known as the ‘Reckless Demons'.


II. TERRITORY WAR CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	To improve the overall smoothness of World Map battles, there will be no Pre-deployment phase for battles on the World Map except fief sieges and battles of stationed rallies. When starting battles including [pursuits, bandits and rebels, and marching war rallies] on the World Map, the battle will begin loading immediately.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6af0860ea9acdb57946dfaf98776bccfdbec64c3.gif

 	You may select your primary unit from within the Open World menu. You can alter this at any time from within the World Map - Units menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/68767cba1efef85c82a8316e29008370e768cbfe.jpg

 	Removed the Change Unit button from the Open World menu.
 	Now, when a house leaves or is removed from an alliance, the alliance will be set on a 7-day cooldown during which no new houses may join it. The 7-day cooldown restarts with each house that leaves or is removed during this period.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0bad0723604ce454a5c544ac95a07b923243834a.jpg

 	Improved upon how Imperial Restorationists get promoted. Apart from the Supreme Commander, Marshal, and Deputy Marshal titles, there will no longer be a limit to the number of players that can hold a title.
 	Regional lords will now upgrade their fiefs when they have enough resources to do so.
 	Adjusted how Prosperity is lost for fiefs that are degraded. A fief that is degraded will now have its Prosperity reset to 100. If a fief loses more than is required for the downgrade, the remaining penalty will be deduced starting from 100. E.g.: If a fief has 30 Prosperity and loses 60 Prosperity during a battle, it will be downgraded by one level and its Prosperity will be reduced from 100 to 70.
 	Added detailed records for fief upgrades/downgrades and Prosperity changes to the Fiefs Chronicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a991fb8a7a30a0f422124a15be110cc6470b465b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e0fad74343c707961ff00384f7a75d936548a3e4.jpg


 

III. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	Resolved an issue where the [Shenji Grenadiers: Reserve] doctrine didn't take effect if only a few units were remaining.
 	Adjusted the [Shenji Grenadiers]'s portrait in the unit menu.
 	Adjusted the [Shenji Grenadiers]'s [Throw Grenades] skill description to make it easier to understand how it actually works.
 	Throw grenades using a method depending on the target area, dealing area damage, and knocking down enemy units hit. This skill has its own ammo cost. Following this, the unit will gain an increased rate of fire and accuracy, enabling them to pressure the target area for 10 seconds. Giving them another command will interrupt this effect.
 	Resolved an issue where the [Black Dragon Archers] showed the wrong type in the Unit menu.
 	Resolved an issue where the [Janissaries Hackbuteers] unit's final node didn't have the description of identification.
	Resolved an issue where Prefecture Guards’ skill [Prefecture Drill] would not take effect after using [Cover Commander].
 	Slightly increased the duration of the [Feline Swiftness] rune's movement speed increase, so that a single [Evade] will no longer cover its entire duration.
 	Resolved an issue where some players couldn't use 'Remember account' with some game versions.
 	Resolved an issue where units would consume the wrong amount of food when changing units while leaving a city.
 	Resolved an issue where players that didn't belong to the Free Houses or the Imperial Restorationists would see the tyrant's war rally lines in green.
 	Added a second confirmation window when alliances remove a house from their roster. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/adf17f77a98bb2493ab246f78c8057c049e78b2d.jpg

 	Added a control guide to the World Map - Units and World Map - Open World menus. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/48cef96b2f4fc0f73872b952975142f19e568267.jpg

 	Resolved an issue where an error code would be displayed in some menus.
 	Resolved an issue where the camera wouldn't follow on the World Map after clicking the the ruling house prompt.
 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
 	Resolved an issue with the Throwing Axes III quest description.
 	Resolved an issue with the quest counter for the 'Use bows or crossbows to kill 100 enemy soldiers' weekly Valour quest.
 	Adjusted how artillery components drop from Siege, Field, and Pursuit battles. Destroying uncommon, rare, and epic artilleries has a high chance of dropping artillery components of an equal level, with a low chance of dropping components one level higher. Destroying legendary artilleries has a high chance of dropping legendary components.

notes.title: CBL: Tyranny Tournament Guide
notes.content:
1. How to partake in the tournament?

	Access the relevant tournament server from within the Server list, and have your squad captain create a house which your members then join.

Asia Division Ranked Battle Signups:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/3063004884089451719
Asia Division Play-in Signups:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/3063004884089143191
South America Division Signups: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/3063004884090227676
MENA Division Signups:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/3063004884092360368

2. CBL Tournament  Servers

CBL's tournament servers are servers we have prepared especially for the tournament. These servers are used as a place for tournament participants to train with one another, and for the tournament's matches. Those who are not participating in the tournament and haven't signed up to it should instead log in to our life servers, i.e., Lotus Ash Sea, Jaderock Creek, and Dragonrise Island for Asia; Espada Forest for South America; Sandstorm Gorge for the Middle East.


 Asia Division Play-in: CBL Asia Play-in Server
 South American Tournament Server: CBL SA Server
 MENA Tournament Server: CBL MENA Server
 Asia Tournament Server: CBL Asia Server

The 4 above servers are used by players to signup, practice, and play the tournament.

3. If I play from Asia, can I sign up for both the Play-in and Ranked Battle?

Yes. You can sign up for both, thereby increasing your chance of getting a spot in the tournament. If you get promoted from the Play-in, you will be removed from the Ranked Battle score, and the one below you in score will take your place.
If you fail to get promoted from the Play-in, you may still have a chance at entering the tournament by having a high Ranked Battle score.

4. What is the difference between the CBL Asia Play-in and the CBL Asia servers?

	The CBL Asia Play-in Server is exclusive to the Asia Division Play-ins.
Here you can sign up and train for the Asia Division Play-in.

	The actual Asia Division tournament will be held on the CBL Asia Server.
This server is used for the Asia Division Ranked Battle scoring signups and for the CBL Knockout Stage.

	In this season, we're adding the Play-in, giving Warlords with relatively lower Ranked Battle scores a chance to be promoted to the CBL Knockout Stage. To partake in the Play-in, you should sign up via the CBL Asia Play-in Server. 8 of the 64 squads partaking in the Play-in will be promoted to the CBL Knockout Stage. Check the following link for more information: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/3063004884089143191

You can also sign up using Ranked Battle score rankings as per usual. To sign up with Ranked Battle score, access the CBL Asia Server to do so. Check the following link for more information: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3063004884089451720

Your squad may sign up for both the Play-in and the Ranked Battle scoring. If you do, and you are promoted from the Play-in, your squad will not be counted for the Ranked Battle scoring. However, if you fail to qualify in the Play-in, your squad may still be promoted from Ranked Battle scoring. Sign-up rewards from the Play-in and Ranked Battle scoring are not mutually exclusive.



5. How many squads can take part in the tournament?

	CBL Knockout Stage: 28 squads will partake in the Asia Division (Lotus Ash Sea, Jaderock Creek, Dragonrise Island), with 4 of these being seeded squads.

a.	Play-in: A total of 64 squads may partake in the Asia Play-in, with 8 of these being promoted to CBL knock-out stage. If more than 64 squads sign up, the 64 squads with the most total Season Level will be invited.
b.	A total of 16 squads will be chosen depending on their Ranked Battle score.

 	15 squads will partake in the South America Division (Espada Forest), with 1 of these being a seeded squad.
 4 squads will partake in the MENA Division (Sandstorm Gorge), with 1 of these being a seeded squad.


6. How do I get promoted?

	The Asia Play-in Tournament is played as Best of 3 eliminations, with 8 squads being promoted.
	The matches in all divisions (except the finals) will be played as Best of 3 eliminations.

7. From where can I watch CBL?
We will be streaming the CBL Knockout Stage in both Chinese and English. Simply tune in to the corresponding stream:
English: https://www.twitch.tv/conquerorsbladedevs
Chinese: https://live.bilibili.com/22798299
Or, you can always tune in to one of our affiliate streams during the tournament.

You can press F7 in-game or follow us on social media to learn more about the tournament.

8. Feel free to contact us should you have any further questions:

Discord: violeta#4335
