notes.title: INFO ON IMPORTANT TERRITORY WAR FIEFS
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord,
	We've made quite large changes to Territory War in the Tyranny season to help you all to better achieve your war goals. We've therefore prepared some information about the new and updated rules.


Influence from main fiefs:


 	Conqueror's City grants 3,900 Influence.
 	Conqueror's Gate grants 1,300 Influence.
 	Region Capitals grant 3,000 Influence.


Requirements for declaring war on Conqueror's City (must fulfill all of them)


 	Your house or alliance must have at least 6,000 Influence.
 	Occupy any of the Conqueror's Gates.
 	Your house or alliance must be occupying at least one fief in the Borderlands (not including Conqueror's City/Conqueror's Gate).
 	If you are in an alliance, only the main house may declare war on Conqueror's City.
 	Should an attacker or defender lose their qualification to declare war, their alliance/house members will no longer be able to take part in the battle for Conqueror's City. Warlords that have already started a battle may complete said battle.


Requirements for declaring war on Conqueror's Gate (must fulfill all of them)


 	Your house or alliance must have at least 6,000 Influence.
 	Your house or alliance must own at least one fief in the Borderlands (not including Conqueror's City/Conqueror's Gate).
 	If you are in an alliance, only the main house may declare war on Conqueror's City.
 	Should an attacker or defender lose their qualification to declare war, their alliance/house members will no longer be able to take part in the battle for Conqueror's Gate. Warlords that have already started a battle may complete said battle.


Requirements for declaring war on Anliang or Augolia (region capitals) (must fulfill all of them)


 	Your house or alliance must have at least 3,000 Influence in that capital's region. (E.g., declaring war on Anliang requires an Influence of at least 3,000 in Maoyang)
 	Should an attacker or defender lose their qualification to declare war, their alliance/house members will no longer be able to take part in the battle for that region's capital. Warlords that have already started a battle may complete said battle.


Attack Order

The order determining the ruling house to assault Conqueror's City and Conqueror's Gate follows a strict order. Houses or alliances will be ordered depending on their Total Influence.


 	Once the Territory War preparation concludes, houses or alliances that declare war against the Conqueror's City / Conqueror's Gate will be ordered from high to low depending on their Total Influence. Following this order ruling house will be determined to contend for Conqueror's City or Conqueror's Gate.
 The main house of the alliance with the highest Total Influence will be the ruling house to do the first round of attack.
 	Should two or more alliances have equal Influence, they will be ordered depending on the time when they declared war.
 	Once the preparation has ended and the order has been set, the order determining the ruling house to contend for the Conqueror's City / Conqueror's Gate will remain unchanged. This holds true even if there are further fluctuations in Influence while Territory War is in progress.
 	Should the ruling house fail to successfully occupy Conqueror's City or Conqueror's Gate, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
 	If a house that meets the requirements declare war against Conqueror's City or Conqueror's Gate while Territory War is in progress, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
 	Should a house for some reason be removed from the attack order, they will be placed at the bottom should they rejoin.
 	Should a house withdraw from the battle of Conqueror's City or Conqueror's Gate, they will not be able to declare war against it during this Territory War.
 	The order determining the ruling house to assault Anliang and Augolia follows a strict order. Houses will be ordered depending on their Influence in the corresponding region.
 	Once the Territory War preparation concludes, alliances that declare war against Anliang / Augolia will be ordered from high to low depending on their Region Influence. Following this order, ruling house will be determined to contend for the region's capital.
 	The main house of the alliance with the highest Region Influence will be the ruling house to do the first round of attack.
 	Should two or more alliances have equal Influence, they will be ordered depending on the time when they declared war.
 	Once the preparation has ended and the order has been set, the order determining the ruling house to contend for Anliang / Augolia will remain unchanged. This holds true even if there are further fluctuations in Influence while Territory War is in progress.
 	Should the ruling house fail to successfully occupy the region capital, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
 	If a house that meets the requirements declares war against a regional capital while Territory War is in progress, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
 	Should a house for some reason be removed from the attack order, they will be placed at the bottom should they rejoin.
 	Should a house withdraw from the battle of a region capital, they will not be able to declare war against it during this Territory War.
 


Defense of Elite Imperial Restorationists


 	Imperial Restorationists with a position of at least Decanos or Second Lieutenant may protect Conqueror's City, Conqueror's Gate, and region capitals.
 	Kits are not consumed for Imperial Restorationists when defending Conqueror's City, Conqueror's Gate, or a region capital.
	Should the Imperial Restorationists lose Conqueror's City, Conqueror's Gate, or a region capital, they will not be able to reclaim that city during this season.

Squads
1.	A squad fails to sign up according to the requirements.

5.	If any member of a squad is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their entire squad will have their tournament participation qualification revoked.
Players
1.	A player fails to sign up according to the requirements.
2.	If a player is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their tournament participation qualification will be revoked and their account will be banned. Their squad will also have their participation qualification revoked.
3.	If a player's life server character receives a ban during the course of the tournament, their participation qualification will be revoked. However, their squad may still continue the tournament.

Signup Requirements

1．	Create a house on the Tournament Server with a name that is in line with the naming conventions, and add the required information to the House Announcement.
2．	The house should have between 15-20 members.
3．	A squad with members that do not meet the player requirements may still partake in the tournament as long as they have between 15-20 qualified members. However, the players that do not meet the player requirements may not partake in the tournament.
4．	House and member names on the tournament server should follow our naming conventions.

Naming Conventions
	Squad (House)
1.	The name of the house the captain creates on the Tournament Server will be used as their squad's name. This name may only contain English characters.
2.	Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If so, the squad will have their participation qualification revoked.
	Players (Character)
1.	Character on the Tournament Server should be named as [Squad Abbreviation_Nickname]. You may choose any nickname you like as long as it conforms to our conventions.
2.	Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If so, the squad will have their participation qualification revoked.

Drafting Rules:

	Middle East Division: Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East)
	Based on results when the signups conclude, squads will gain a score based on the total season level of their top 15 Warlords.
	Squads that meet the requirements will be ranked based on their season level, with the top 3 being able to partake in the tournament.
	We will draft a total of 3 squads based on squad score from Sandstorm Gorge. The champion squad of the Dynasty season's CBL will be invited as a seeded squad, for a total of 4 squads.

Drafting Rules:

	All members of the squad must have a character on the Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East) server that meets the requirements.
	Please Note:
	Squads must have a member count of between 15 and 20 to sign up successfully. Exceeding the member count of 20 will result in the squad's signup being annulled.
	Duplicate signups are forbidden. Should we at the time of tallying score, find that a player has several characters on the tournament server and be part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament. Squads they are part of also may not invite a new member to take their place.
	Squads may only contain members from the Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East) server. Squads with members without required characters will have their signup annulled, and may not invite new players to remedy this after verification.
	No squad may alter their member roster once the signups have concluded.
	Should a squad not leave any contact information (Discord/QQ) and we fail to get in contact with their squad, their signup will be annulled.
	Only house squads may receive the reward of having their house name appear in a different color in the House List. 'House squads' refer to squads where all members are from the same house.
	The total season level of house squads will be tallied according to players' levels as of November 21st.
	The season level of all participants will be made public.
	Training Battles
	We will extract a list of squads that meet the requirements every day at 7:00 (UTC+3) while the signups are in progress (squads with 15-20 members, that meet all naming regulations, and that have made available their contact information). At 12:00 (UTC+3), we will grant the captains of these squads the ability to create rooms. Room creation passwords will be available on the Tournament Server Announcements.

	What is CBL?

CBL stands for Conqueror's Blade League, and is a global tournament hosted by the Conqueror's Blade team. By partaking in and being promoted from a division, squads are qualified to partake in CBL and fight for the championship as well as handsome rewards. In short, CBL is a tournament where everyone fights on even ground, and where the best of the best battle it out.

	How does CBL work?

CBL is made up of five divisions: Asia Pacific, China Mainland, South America, MENA, and Europe/America. A champion squad will arise from each of these.

	When is CBL generally held?

CBL is held four times each year, each time corresponding to a new Conqueror's Blade season. Generally this will be in March, June, September, and December. For the actual times check the official announcements.

	Confirming Tournament Roster
1.	Once the Play-in signup ends, no squad may adjust their roster in any way.
2.	If your squad gets promoted from the Play-in, your squad may not change your roster for the next stage of CBL for any reason whatsoever.

Play-in Training

Starting from November 8, we will collect a squad whitelist every day at 13:00 (UTC+8) comprised of eligible squads. We will then grant privileges to these squads' captains to create training rooms at 17:00 (UTC+8).
	Squads (houses) must have a member count of 15-20.
	House and member names must meet the naming conventions.
	House Announcement should contain the following info: Squad Abbreviation (must be within 4 English letters), Captain Name, Captain Contact Info (Discord\QQ).

Asia Play-in Info

	The following rules will be in place for the CBL: Tyranny Asia Play-in.
	Structure
Single elimination with random matchups. As we do not know how many squads will sign up, some squads may random to a bye.
	Mode: Siege Battle
	Map: Wall Fort
	Rules:
	Two Siege battles will be played per match.
	Attacker/defender is randomized for match one, with the two squads switching sides for match two.

Victory Conditions:
（1）	A squad wins if they win both of the Siege Battles.
（2）	If each squad wins one Siege Battle each, an extra match will be played as a Field Battle.

Extra Match Rules

	Mode: Field Battle (Deathmatch)
	Map: Emerald River
	Sides: Random
	Rules:
	Each player may respawn one time, and dying for the second time is final.
	Players of either side may deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
	Flag Captures:
	Should both sides have players within the flag's range it will be contended, and neither will gain progress. Progress can only be gained by removing all enemies from the flag's radius.
	The map contains 3 flag points, A, B, and C. Once you occupy two, your enemy's base can be occupied.
	If you manage to assume control of all three flag points, the enemy's base will begin losing health. Losing a flag point will stop the enemy's base from losing health.
	Victory Conditions:
	Reduce the health of your enemy's base to 0% within the allotted time. You can do this by either capturing all three flag points or by capturing two and attacking their base.
	Should the time run out while none of the bases have dropped to 0% health, the side whose base has the most health remaining win.
	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side that has captured and held the most flag points win.
	Draw Rule
	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have captured and held an equal amount of flag points, the match is a draw.
	Draw & Extra Match Rules
	If the Field Battle is a draw, another Field Battle will be played.
	Extra Matches are all played on the Emerald River map.
	Extra matches continue with the same ruleset.
	Extra matches continue until one side wins.
	Asia Play-in Rewards
	Signup Rewards
If your squad successfully signs up for the CBL: Tyranny Asia Play-in, you will receive the following rewards:
Random Rare Artillery Chest x2
10-Battle Unit XP Card x1
10-Battle Hero XP Card x1
Bronze Coins x20,000
	Participation Rewards
If your squad successfully signs up and partakes in the tournament (i.e., showing up when scheduled), you will receive the following rewards:
Random Epic Artillery Chest x1
Treatise x2
Bronze Coins x20,000
	Promotion Rewards
For each match your squad wins in the Play-in, you will receive the following rewards:
Random Epic Artillery Chest x1
Treatise x1
Badge of Heroism x30


Tournament Standards

	Rematches & Pauses:
	Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament, and there will be no rematches once a game has begun.
	No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.
	Tournament Prohibitions:
	Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament. And it is strictly prohibited to use bugs or other loopholes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
	Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a squad has violated this (including but not limited to going AFK and remaining at the spawn point), their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
	Punctuality: All participants must listen to and cooperate with the referees, and be ready at the appointed time. If a squad fails to invite enough members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
	Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be composed of English letters. Players should also name their characters according to the tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions, and if so, their opponent will immediately be victorious.
	Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.
	Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify the squad of which the player is part of.
	Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad per tournament, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. A player found to have done so will have their participation qualification revoked, and will be banned from all future tournaments.
The CBL Tournament is made up of five divisions: Asia, South America, MENA, EU/US, and NetEase China. A player partaking in more than one will be violating our rule for 'duplicate signups', and if discovered, they will have their participation qualification revoked.

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] VIOLATION PENALTIES
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade upholds the value of faireness as we work hard on creating a fair and just game environment. We have zero-tolerance toward those that break our regulations and will crack down upon any such behavior to maintain a good game environment.
Common violations mainly include, but are not limited to, the following:

CHAT VIOLATIONS	
									
[olist]
 72-hour mute——Minor chat violations (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services), abusive language, spam, etc.
 720-hour mute	——Multiple minor chat violations (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), or if a single player violates this on multiple characters.
 30-day soft ban——Severe chat violations (including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
 Permanent ban——Multiple severe chat violations (including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services). This includes violations of the same player on multiple characters.
[/olist]
					
NICKNAME VIOLATIONS		
							
[olist]
  Forced name change——Nicknames that violate our regulations (minor naming violations: those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
  Permanent ban——Nicknames that severely violate our regulations (including those containing racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.)
[/olist]

THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE USAGE	

1. Permanent ban——Having been found to use or have used third-party software, including but not limited to, cheats, automatic scripts, and modifiers.				

Using unallowed third-party software to perform in-game actions——These include but are not limited to cheats, automatic scripts, and modifiers. Actions such as these are harmful to the game at large and seriously affect the fairness of gameplay. Using such hacks/software adversely affects the client and servers' stability, and may lead to you having your account stolen.
We will crack down on and severely punish anyone using third-party software that violates our regulations and anyone using any type of hacks.


OBSTRUCTIVE CONDUCT

Obstructive conduct includes but not limited to Negative behaviors, deliberate friendly fire, quit battles before ends, AFK, etc.

[olist]
  (Minor) suspension time: Restricted from playing matched battles for 2 hours——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 1-5 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
  (Medium) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an A+ or better ranking ——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 5-10 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
  (Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 10-15 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
  7-day soft ban——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 15-50 recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).
  30-day soft ban——Being detected of or reported for obstructive conduct in 50+ recent battles (includes PvE and PVP).	
  Permanent ban——Those found to have been penalized for obstructive conduct multiple times due to, including but not limited to, using multiple alternate characters, scrips, or multi-clienting.
[/olist]

House (Territory War) Violations

1.Using third-party software to gain an advantage in Territory War——Houses found to have been using third-party software in Territory War will be penalized depending on the situation. If a house is found to have done so purposefully, their prestige will be set to 0 whether or not their actions garnered them any benefits. All fiefs in their possession will also be returned to their rightful lords.

IMPROPER TRADING

[olist]
   Topping up using any non-official channel, or obtaining sovereigns in any way that violates our regulations.
   Be suspect of fraudulent trading.
[/olist]
Those deemed responsible for any of the above may have their accounts banned, purchased items revoked and will be required to top-up to make up for the disparity.

PENALTY INFORMATION
	
•Mute——Being unable to send chat messages.	
•Soft ban——While a soft ban is in effect on someone's account, their qualification to partake in tournaments they are currently partaking in is also revoked. 
•Forced name change——They will be forced to change their character's name.
• (Minor) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in most game modes for the duration of the penalty and need to remain online to reduce their penalty time.
• (Medium) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in other modes, and must first complete xx Training Camp (AI) games with a rating of A+.
• (Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete xx Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating.
(In special situations, we reserve the right to adjust violation regulations and to apply stricter penalties when we deem required)


Our game's ecology and fair gameplay have and always will be a cornerstone of Conqueror's Blade. It is something we continue to work towards.
We will work together with the community to monitor and crack down upon the violations elicited above. For serious offenses, we reserve the right to pursue criminal responsibility through legal means.
Should you encounter anyone violating any of the above while playing the game, kindly Report them or contact us via our communities in a timely manner. We will deal with any kind of violation most severely.
Once again, thank you everyone so much for your support. We believe that to create a healthy game environment, we must work hard to solve these issues together!
			
The following is the list of penalties:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_NQmgHz4vx9en7z_klDKQKUBFFK1GWb5IezPSoFwNiQ/edit#gid=863170658

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 4th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on November 4th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:


I. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	Resolved a bug where Grayhair Garrison will gain extra recovery on blocking.
 	Resolved an issue where the Axe Raiders would remain in melee even after regaining their ammo. 
 	Resolved an issue where the Axe Raiders would trigger a [Deadly Resolve] when dropping below 65% health.
 	Adjusted the location of the airwalls near the supply points on either side of A on the [Turul Város] siege map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/75e11737b84f82a40c37bbcd4542508650d731c1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/aa85583538ca0793f41d3d9aad03dcd4c0966fc6.png
 
 	Resolved an issue where the respawn point didn't display properly on the Frontier Camp map.
 	Reduced the respawn and capture time on the beginner’s Augolia map for the tutorial Siege Battle.
 	Added records of Prestige reduction caused by fiefs being degraded to house reports in the Territory War Report.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5b1b7a56b92c11bdbfe960dc8fba1b3757ddaa7d.png

 	Added warpaths that run between rallies and their destinations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6e980084aa5d70995361efffa7af88d1f2b15c8.png
 
 	To avoid confusion, a war declaration that doesn't result in a Prestige loss will instead have its prestige change displayed with '--' in the Prestige details menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c2903cf419e93652deb9eeb4d949aee87949a652.png
 
 	Improved the visuals of texts in some menus.
 	Bandits of Sarazhan invaded and the common people struggled for survival. Fortunately, you Warlords beat back the threat and restored peace. With their rascals gone, local markets in places like Zadeni are once again open for business.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/05c01641fac08d06ffdfd5401bcf5b32a18cd8e2.png

 	Resolved an issue with wrong icons on artilleries in use by others.
 	Resolved an issue where the background may display wrongly in the Seasonal Unit Challenges menu when changing seasons.
 	Resolved an issue where only one yellow notification would appear (players had to close the first one to trigger the following one) after earning multiple weapon attires at the same time.
 	Resolved an issue where the UI sometimes wouldn't display correctly after joining a rally.
 	Resolved an issue where it was sometimes only possible to see rallies in the current region.
 	Upgraded the report-player menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/46ddb225048e8cad01bb6015f13fb7f299e59386.png

 	Improved the visuals of the menu when interacting with fiefs on the world map.
 	Prestige requirements have been removed from declaring war against Conqueror's City and Conqueror's Gate.
 	Resolved an issue where the chat bubble atop the tyrant's rallies would be empty.
 	Resolved an issue where some weekly packs couldn't be obtained when one's inventory was full.
 	Resolved an issue where the Sanguine Tide mount attire appeared with two reins.
 	Resolved an issue where banner unlock conditions couldn't be seen in the Unit Customization menu.
 	Resolved an issue where the hems of the [Cloudfrost] and [Daylight Rainbow] sets were too big and clashed.
 	Resolved a localization issue where [Free Battles] and [Open Battles] weren't differentiated in some languages.


II. HERO BALANCE CHANGES

	[Spear]:

	[Dismounting Strike]:
Base piercing damage caused has been reduced to 180% (was 260%)

	[Nodachi]:

	[Bloodcraze]:
The buff [Bloodcraze] will no longer end when casting [Monstrous Blade] or [Dragon's Leap].
	[Samurai's March]:
Increased the second strike's block break.
	[Blood Oath III]:
Now grants 2 stacks of [Health Drain] (previously refreshed the duration of Bloodcraze).
	[Basic Attack]:
Adjusted the attack interval between the three stages of basic attacks, making it possible to chain attacks.
	[Sprint Attack]:
Adjusted Sprint Attack's attack animation.

	[Poleaxe]:

	[Push Back]:
The attack distance of [Push Back] has been increased to 4.2m (was 2.8).
	[The Old Billhook III]:
Cooldown has been increased to 8 seconds (was 7).
Enemies hit will be slowed by 40% for 8 seconds (was 6).
	[Weapon Dance]:
Added a new extra effect: Each enemy hit will grant 5% damage reduction to all types of damage for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
	[Bec de Corbin]:
Adjusted its extra effect. Each enemy hit will now increase damage by 5% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Previously it reduced the armor of hit enemies.
	[Grim Harvest]:
Added a new extra effect: Enemies hit will have all of their defenses reduced by 20% for 5 seconds.
	[Halberdier's Thrust]:
Adjusted its extra effect. The first strike deals 300 Bleed damage per second for 3 seconds, and the second strike deals 600 Bleed damage per second for 5 seconds. Previously only the second strike dealt Bleed damage.
	[Combat Dismount]:
Increased block break.

notes.title: KHESHIGS: LET SPEED AND BLADES DO THE TALKING!
notes.content:
"Warlords, Halloween is around the corner. And we're pretty sure that Kheshigs is sort of ready for the festival- yep, we made some adjustments to this very unit. Hope you all can have great fight and enjoyment with Kheshigs on Halloween! 

Our initial idea for Kheshigs was for them to display the ferocity of the Mongolian cavalry, a mounted force highly dangerous to infantry. What we wanted them to embody was: 'charge into the enemies' ranks and slice in all directions, leaving nothing but carnage in their wake.

However, owing to later changes and continued iterations with the season, the Kheshigs gradually lost their superiority against infantry. Their active skill, [Heroic Charge], was not enough as it only allowed them to attack but never retreat. It became easy to lose plenty of troops while only being able to launch one dangerous assault, which made them weak in the current meta. Thus, we've decided to make a series of changes to them."

[previewyoutube=RSvA3OQ8W7Y;full]https://youtu.be/RSvA3OQ8W7Y[/previewyoutube]
Kheshigs Changes

1. Improved the [Heroic Charge] skill.

This is now a two-phase Charge, where the first phase is [Heroic Charge] and the second is [Returning Charge].
[Heroic Charge]
▪ Works identically to the previous [Heroic Charge].
[Returning Charge]
▪ Active: Perform a [Returning Charge] towards the hero's location. Slashing damage is increased by 20% during [Returning Charge]'s duration.
▪ Only useable after [Heroic Charge].

2. A new skill [Frenzied Onslaught]

 Passive: The Kheshigs launch a series of attacks, wounding and lacerating enemies hit.
 Active: The Kheshigs attack without restraint for 5 seconds, while also taking reduced ranged damage as they lower their bodies. They will attack with reduced speed for 10 seconds after their Frenzied Assault.

"The changes mainly serve to increase the Kheshigs' burst potential so that they can once again pressure infantry. Naturally, making [Heroic Charge] a two-phase ability enables them to enter and exit combat for greater flexibility. This also better suits their image as a cold-blooded melee cavalry."

We have also adjusted some numerical errors in the skill's description texts (the skill's actual effects remain unchanged).

  [Heroic Charge]'s initial charge reduces damage taken by 20% (was 30%).
  [Heroic Charge]'s second charge increases slashing damage by 20% (was 30%). 
  [Heroic Charge]'s initial charge lasts 10 seconds.

"Another thing that has been talked about is their weak survivability. While the argument can be made, we believe that their survivability is in line with our expectations. They are clad in light armor to attain greater mobility, and with their dual blades they can deal tremendous damage, while also inflicting bleed.

We hope that these changes will make the Khan's soldiers instill fear into the world once more! We would also ask you all to take a moment and think how these mounted warriors can be used in battle for the greatest effect."

Event: Kheshigs Masters!

We hereby invite you all to try them out and then share with us what you believe to be the greatest strategy. Kindly keep submissions short and concise.
You can submit a guide in either of the following formats (kindly only submit one): 
[olist]
 A strategy guide of 100-200 words.
 A video guide of 30-90 seconds.
[/olist]
After the submission period ends, we'll be selecting a few among them for everyone to vote! What's more, the top 3 with the most votes among each of the strategy guide formats will receive a grand reward! 

Run time: October 30th, 00:00 to November 7th, 12:00 (UTC+8) 

Rewards: 
Top 3: Halloween Unit Attire x1
Participation: Treatise x1, Random Rare Artillery Chest x1.
Tip: You can earn both of the above. 

How to Submit: 
Discord's Event Channel: https://discord.gg/mpz63ucHp5
Email: cb_support@boomingtech.com
(When submitting your guide, be sure to include your character's numerical ID and which server you play on. For non-video submissions, kindly also note your language)

Community Stream: The Kheshigs Ride Forth on Halloween!

Bread will be showing off the Kheshigs and our Halloween map at Twitch on October 30th, 13:00 (UTC+8). The stream will naturally feature a Twitch Drops event! So prepare for that and make sure you won't miss it XD

notes.title: Oct. 28 UPDATE LOG
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on October 28th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. EVENT NOTICE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3af96d5c8096e9cdb39bd9afccbd3494119a97cb.jpg

The Halloween event Blood Wasteland begins.

II. TERRITORY WAR CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS

    After having monitored Territory War and receiving feedback from you Warlords, we will be making the following changes:


 	To ensure that the Ruler's Flag remains relevant during all stages of a season for the contention of the ruling house, it will now grant a 10% (up to a maximum of 1,500) of the house current Prestige within the area. It previously granted 200.
 	We have come to believe that prosperity currently is not working as we wanted it to, so we are making the following changes: A fief with 30 prosperity or greater won't have its prosperity changed when upgraded. If it has less than 30, it will be raised to 30 after the upgrade. A fief that is demoted will have its prosperity set to 20.
 	We're also changing the effect Territory War has on a fief's prosperity so that players are more inclined to defend the center part of a fief. For each time the center is occupied, the fief's prosperity will drop by 15. If the attackers claim the defenders' base, the fief's prosperity will drop by 50.
 	Added Prestige details to the Noble Houses' house menu. Here you can see records and reasons of house's recent prestige changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c25a753c2dcb090b81b45a6a26e267bb4fcb3b6b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ac4a917864050bd2bbfb4927b676b3c23d6cb497.png

 	Imperial Restorationists can check time remaining till next war rally during Territory War.
 	Improved the visual experience when opening Territory War reports.
 	Improved the artillery deploy UI marker in Territory War so that it is easier to see.


III. HERO BALANCE CHANGES


 	Shorten the skill delay time of [Marked for Death] and [Rough Justice] for Dual Blades and Poleaxe heroes.
 	Based on feedback and analyzing game data, we've decided on making changes to the Spear hero's [Combat Dismount] skill, as well as other balancing changes to the Poleaxe and Nodachi heroes.



IV. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS


 	Resolved an issue where the animation would joggle when changing to a melee weapon with the Shenji Grenadiers at follow. 
 	Resolved an issue where the attack animation of the Iron Reapers (sword) was missing. 
 	Using an unlock order for a unit challenge will automatically claim applicable rewards.
 The character will now check their new outfit after equipping a new attire in the Customization menu.
 	Improved upon camps on the World Map, making them clearer and more real.
 	Resolved an issue where hitting a wall with artilleries would sometimes restore its health instead of dealing damages.
 	Resolved an issue where fall damage didn't properly register in some cases.
 	Resolved an issue where the [Serfs] unit couldn't equip Sword & Shield Charge doctrines.
 	Resolved an issue where weapon attires couldn't be unequipped from the Customization menu if it is not your current weapon type.
 	Resolved an issue where some parts of the Black Feather Dance attire didn't display as intended.
 	Resolved an issue where Death Info would sometimes be displayed incorrectly.
 	Resolved an issue where kits couldn't be forged in Blackwater Castle and Liangshan Castle.
 	Resolved an issue where one sometimes couldn't check rally info in other regions.
 	Resolved an issue Ostaria didn't show up as a choice when selecting a region filter when trading materials.
 	Resolved an issue where calvary units could scale the walls in the unit-training map.
 	Added visual guidance to the weapon-training map.
 	Added a sound effect for the gate's destruction to the Frontier Camp map.
 	After unlocking any of season 8's units, their story quests can be accepted from any capital. Completing these will grant a unit-exclusive doctrine.
 	Added an extra spawn point for the attackers on the [Valley Fortress] siege map to give more offensive options.



V. UNIT BALANCE CHANGES

	Kheshigs Changes:

	1. Improved the [Heroic Charge] skill.

	This is now a two-part Charge, where the first part is [Heroic Charge] and the second is [Returning Charge].
	The active attack works identically to the previous [Heroic Charge].
	Revised the description of [Heroic Charge] skill
The first part of [Heroic Charge] will reduce the taken damage by 20%
The second part of [Heroic Charge] will increase the slashing damage by 20%
The first part of [Heroic Charge] will last for 10 seconds.

	2. A new skill [Returning Charge]:

	Active: Perform a [Returning Charge] towards the hero's location. Slashing damage dealt is increased by 20% during [Returning Charge]'s duration.
	Only useable after [Heroic Charge].

	3. A new skill [Frenzied Onslaught]:

	Passive: The Kheshigs launch a series of attacks, wounding and lacerating enemies hit.
	Active: The Kheshigs attack fiercely for 5 seconds, while also taking reduced ranged damage as they lower their bodies. They will attack with reduced speed for 10 seconds after their frenzied assault.

notes.title: CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM MANUAL
notes.content:
I. Content Creator Responsibilities

Game Advertisement

After becoming an affiliated content creator, we will be creating an exclusive host code for your use. Note, the code is only applicable to newly registered users. A player using your code will receive a series of beginner rewards. Naturally, you will also be issued rewards based on the number of new users that use your code.
*Host codes are only available for streamers and video creators.

Content Creators

Video Creators
-	Create at least 4 original videos related to Conqueror's Blade each month
-	Have above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video

Streamers
-	Stream at least 20 hours per month
-	Have above 30 viewers on each Conqueror's Blade stream

Strategy Guide Writers
-	Capable of creating Conqueror's Blade-related strategy guides, including those pertaining to units, beginner's guides, Territory War reports, etc.

Community Mods
-	Guide new players to learn more about the game.
-	Be active in the Conqueror's Blade community and help keep the community active.

What's more, we hope you join in on even more content, such as providing commentary for season tournaments, draft war reports, video re-creation, etc. Naturally, such extra content will net you even greater rewards.

II. CREATOR INCENTIVE

During our cooperation we will be rating and issuing rewards, as well as base future co-operation plans, based on your output, following, recruitment results, among some.
Rewards will be issued on a per-month basis, with rewards for one month being issued on the 10th of the following month.
You can find information about each month's set rewards below (rewards stack, meaning that the more criteria you fulfill the more rewards you get).

1) Video Creators/Streamers Creator Incentive

Basic Rewards

Stream at least 20 hours per month with each stream having at least 30 viewers, or create 4 original Conqueror's Blade-related videos with more than 150 average views.
Sovereign x1,000
14-Day Premium Account

New Recruitment Rewards

During our cooperation, you will not only be considered an official Conqueror's Blade content creator, but you will also receive a host code that you can share with your fans. Then you'll be rewarded should they take a liking to Conqueror's Blade and start playing too: 
[olist]
  You'll get 500 Sovereigns as a reward for every 10 of your viewers that start playing using your host code and reach level 50.
  We'll add in another 500 Sovereigns for every 10 of them that also reaches level 100.
  You may receive up to 5,000 Sovereigns per month from recruiting new players. For months where you do exceptionally well, we will also reward you with extra in-game items!
[/olist]

Long-term Cooperation Rewards

If you remain with the Content Creator Program for more than 2 months while meeting the monthly quota each month, we will grant you even more rewards:
- Gift Code+
Your fans will receive even greater rewards!
- Twitch Drops Support
You may enable Twitch Drops during certain times to help attract an even greater following.

2) Strategy Guide Creator Rewards

High-quality Guide Rewards
1. If you create high-quality guides that are received well by our design team and the playerbase we will reward you with 500 Sovereigns per guide.
2. We will provide you with extra Sovereigns and/or other item rewards if you create a series of guides, articles, or create a site for guides.

III. Notes

1. Mind your language while streaming, in your videos and when sending posts.
2. You should publish enough content on a regular basis as per the above requirements.
3. We will terminate our co-operation with you should any of the following occur:

  Should you make improper remarks in-game, in player communities, or in your video/stream that negatively effects the game.
 Create a series of new accounts to raise your following and/or to have such accounts use your gift code.
 Should you fail to publish enough content on a regular basis and fail to meet the content quota.


IV. CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM QA

Q: How do players use my host code?
A: They can access the gift code menu by pressing Q, and in there enter your host code. In doing so they receive exclusive rewards (an exclusive "Super Fan" title, a 2-star Signaculum, Premium Account, XP Boosters, Artillery Chests, Treatises, and Battle Relics).

Q: When are earnings tallied each month?
A: The rewards from one month are sent on the 10th of the following month. Make sure to cooperate with our team and upload screenshots of data from related videos/streams.

Q: For how long will the [Tyranny] Content Creator Program run?
A: We will be evaluating each content creator at the end of the Tyranny season and decide whether to continue with the program or to find new ways in which to cooperate with you all. We will open registration for content creators again at the start of the next season. We sincerely hope that you all continue to work with and support us!

Q: Is there something else of note?
A: Only players that have not played Conqueror's Blade before may use these host codes. Should we find that someone has abused their host code in any way or form simply to garner more revenue, we will terminate our cooperation with them, and withhold the proceeds from that month.

notes.title: Territory War Info
notes.content:
Outline

Noble Houses that meet the requirements to declare war (both prestige and house level), can have their liege or seneschals declare war on a fief, and then attack it during Territory War. If multiple houses declare war on a single fief, the house with the most prestige will be able to attack first. They will become the Ruling House for that attack, and gain the authority to command who can join the battle.
If the Ruling House manages to occupy the fief, they'll be temporarily removed from the Ruling House selection list and the house with the second-most prestige can attack. If they lose, they will lose prestige, and the next house can attack.

How to Earn Prestige

	Means in which to gain Prestige: house quests, occupying fiefs, and upgrading fiefs.
	Completing house quests is a great way in which to earn Prestige. Completing one phase of a quest will activate the next phase.

Declaring War & Inappropriate War Declarations

To declare war against a fief, your house must be of a level exceeding that required of the fief and have Prestige exceeding the required amount for that fief. The requirements to declare war against a fief will increase with its level and is also affected by its type.
Unreasonable declarations of war will lead to your house gaining a bad reputation, leading to a loss of Prestige. Such actions include: Abrupt war declarations; excess of territory; assaulting weak fiefs, and declaring too many wars.

	Abrupt War Declarations:

A house declaring war against a fief within 24 hours before Territory War begins: failed attacks will result in a 1.25x Prestige loss. If a house declares war against a fief during Territory War, failed attacks will result in a 2x Prestige loss.

	Excess of Territory:

War declarations for houses with 3-4 fiefs will cost 200 Prestige. If a house has 5 or more, war declarations will cost 500 Prestige.

	Assaulting Weak Fiefs:

For houses with 2-4 towns and forts, declaring war against a village will cost 100 Prestige. If a house has 5-6, war declarations against villages will cost 200 Prestige. If a house has 7 or more, war declarations against villages will cost 300 Prestige.

	Declaring Too Many Wars:

Houses may at most declare war against 10 fiefs during a single Territory War. Each war declaration after the 4th one will deduct Prestige.
The following table elicits Prestige loss per attack.
Fiefs Targeted	Prestige Lost at War Declaration

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7cd6b7aa24c5cfdc3f168ac8cbe6da282353a772.png

Becoming the Ruling House
When a house declares war on a fief, they have the chance to become the Ruling House for the battle of that fief in the Territory War. Once a battle is imminent for a fief, the house in the list with the most Prestige will become the Ruling House, commanding the attack. If multiple houses have equal Prestige to the house with the most Prestige, then the house who declares first will assume command.
Upon declaring war against a fief, the house will join that fief's declare war list. You will not be able to see the Prestige of other houses before the Territory War.
However, when Territory War begins, the Prestige of all houses will be displayed in descending order. And the house ranks the fist in the list will become the Ruling House first.
Once the Ruling House has been decided, the list order will stop changing. If the Ruling House doesn't start a battle within three minutes, they will lose 1,000 Prestige and the other houses in the list will once again be ordered based on Prestige to see who will command the battle.
Victory & Defeat
If the Ruling House fails to occupy the fief (whether the defenders successfully defend it or if another house (including other houses in their alliance) manages to occupy it), they will lose a certain percent of Prestige. A minimum of 100 Prestige is lost against towns, 80 against forts, and 50 against villages. Actual percentages depend on fief type and level.
	See the follow table for prestige losses:
Fief Level	Prestige Loss/Defeat (Town)	Prestige Loss/Defeat (Fort)	Prestige Loss/Defeat (Village)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4c80962dac396f6b751a2507fa010f422283d921.png

If the Ruling House fails to occupy the fief, they will lose Prestige but remain within the declare war list. Houses will then once again be ordered based on Prestige, and if they still have the most Prestige, they will command the next battle as well.
The Ruling House has full control over the battle, and members of that house with the authority to do so may change the settings regarding whether members from other houses may partake, or remove any Warlord from the battle.

Withdrawing
	If there is a change in strategic objectives after declaring war against a fief, or if a house knows they'll stand no chance, they have the option to Withdraw from the battle.
Withdrawing from a battle will deduct Prestige. A house that is not the Ruling House will lose 200 Prestige upon withdrawing. However, should the Ruling House withdraw, they will suffer a bigger hit to their Prestige. If they retreat before the battle has begun, they will lose 400 Prestige, plus another 15% prestige deduction of their remaining Prestige. Upon doing so, a new Ruling House will immediately be selected. This fief will however still count toward that house's war declarations for this Territory War and might lead to further Prestige losses. The Ruling House cannot withdraw from a battle that has already begun.
Houses may also not declare war against fiefs they withdraw from during that Territory War.

Territory War Fiefs & Prestige
A house that loses a fief during Territory War will lose a large amount of Prestige (based on its type and level):
Fief Level	Prestige Loss/Lost Town (Incl. Capitals & Conqueror's City)	Prestige Loss/Lost Fort (Incl. Conqueror's Gate)	Prestige Loss/Lost Village


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dfc5c536437c314d5afd55ec4bc2d236c8b08183.png

If the house that occupies it then loses it, they will lose a small amount of Prestige (based on its type and level).
Fief Level	Prestige Loss/Lost Town (Incl. Capitals & Conqueror's City)	Prestige Loss/Lost Fort (Incl. Conqueror's Gate)	Prestige Loss/Lost Village

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fe233dfb43242d387f1d92f4267d1252dc7b9082.png

If a house defends a fief during the course of an entire Territory War, they will gain a small amount of Prestige for that fief (based on its type and level).
Fief Level	Prestige Gain/Defended Town (Incl. Capitals & Conqueror's City)	Prestige Gain/Defended Fort (Incl. Conqueror's Gate)	Prestige Gain/Defended Village
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/76b84f1d37da56cc9ec4c89efc43b9d989e0ab7f.png

A house that manages to occupy a fief will earn even more Prestige (based on its type and level).
Fief Level	Prestige Gain/Occupied Town (Incl. Capitals & Conqueror's City)	Prestige Gain/Occupied Fort (Incl. Conqueror's Gate)	Prestige Gain/Occupied Village
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6dd8c733d480dfa2540f5f211467853583ac3f55.png

Field Camps
It costs house coins to build field camps. The cost depends on what type of camp is being built.
    There is a cap to the number of different field camps that can exist within a region.
Players who joined the Imperial Restorationists or those not in a house cannot build field camps.
Buying artilleries (siege towers, siege machines, battering rams) at field camps costs house coins.
The Ruler's Flag will grant 200 Prestige for contending for the Ruling House in that area. This prestige is lost upon its destruction. There may only be one Ruler's Flag in a fief area.
Fief Levels
When a fief owned by a house is upgraded, they will gain Prestige (based on its type and level) to reflect this.
Whether a fief can be upgraded depends in its building materials. Completing quests in a fief grants it materials. When a fief's material quantity reaches level-up requirements, the liege of its occupant house may upgrade it.
Fief Level Change	Prestige Gain/Upgraded Town (Incl. Conqueror's City)	Prestige Gain/Upgraded Fort	Prestige Gain/Upgraded Village

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4bd51502c0f03f773e8ce18c12568d8b7fbb31f3.png

Whether a fief gets demoted is related to its prosperity. Some materials will be used every Monday at midnight for maintenance. If you have sufficient building materials in your fief warehouse, a small number of building materials are deducted and your fief's Prosperity value increases by 30. If you have insufficient building materials in your fief warehouse, building materials are not deducted and your fief's Prosperity value decreases by 50.
If the center of a fief is captured during Territory War, it will lose 15 Prosperity. If the defenders' camp is lost, it will lose 50 Prosperity.
When a fief owned by a house is degraded, they will lose Prestige (based on its type and level) to reflect this. If a fief is degraded as it switches owners, the original owners will lose the corresponding Prestige.
Fief Level Change	Prestige Loss/Demoted Town (Incl. Conqueror's City)	Prestige Loss/Demoted Fort (Incl. Conqueror's Gate)	Prestige Loss/Demoted Village

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9de02cbb6c6a37ada95d2389d7e3cd1821301468.png

Info on Future Changes
We will continue keeping an eye on Territory War and make adjustments to related numbers and rules when required. We will elicit any such changes in our weekly update logs.

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] Oct. 21th Notice on Hacks
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!

Recently, there have been players using hacks in Conqueror’s Blade, which affects the environment of entire Conqueror's Blade community and players’ gaming experience. To address this, we have been continuingly upgrading and improving our anti-hack system. Our team will be unwavering in our fight against hack or farm bot.

Regarding those new hacks, we have done the following improvements:

[olist]
 Monitoring Unit/ Hero skills
 Monitoring the Battle scores
 Monitoring the abnormal damage numbers
[/olist]

We are fighting against hacks by tracking its makers and users. And it surely will take some time to root it out. Your patience will be appreciated. Warlords are also welcome to report any game violations and relevant thread to us. As long as we work together, we can surely create a friendly and stable gaming environment.
Thanks for your support of the Conqueror's Blade. We will do our best to ensure you the pure joy of our game.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2996562204135651693

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. 

Therefore, we'd like to take this chance to remind you all: we have recently noticed a big increase in accounts being flagged for using hacks, as well as websites selling accounts and phishing software. Do not try to use any of these simply due to curiosity, as doing so may lead to financial losses, and is highly likely to compromise your account's security. Any usage of cheating software will lead to your account being banned.

List of negative combat penalties:

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_NQmgHz4vx9en7z_klDKQKUBFFK1GWb5IezPSoFwNiQ/edit#gid=488139714

Hack banned list：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0e7075e43aa0c0bb3cab6474c300739c8e3b3fe8.jpg


We will continue to monitor the gaming status of the above players, and if the same violations occur again, they will be subject to more severe penalties.

In order to create a healthy environment for the community, and better everyone's gaming experience, the Conqueror's Blade Operations Team will be unwavering in our fight against hack or farm bot. We won't let slide any uncivilized language in any channel. Warlords are welcome to report any of the above game violations to us. As long as we work together, we can surely create a friendly and stable gaming environment. Thanks for your support of the Conqueror's Blade.

Meanwhile, some issues or exceptions in game might be caused by bugs or an unstable network. If you are uncertain if someone is cheating, you can send us a message to our report e-mail. Once we've verified the situation, we'll deal with them appropriately, and punish them severely should they be using hacks.

Please report to this Email: cb_support@boomingtech.com

If you have any questions about the results of our process or need to make a complaint, please also contact us at the above email address.

Conqueror's Blade Operations Team

notes.content:

The update will contain the following:

I. Event Notice


 	The [Golden Wind] Ancient Knife Coin exchange event will be ending. Be sure to redeem the rewards you want while you can.

 	Resolved an issue where the second shot couldn't be triggered for the Javelin Sergeants even with the Double Shot doctrine equipped.

 	Added videos for Ostaria and Maoyang during region selection.
 	Resolved an issue where the male [Archon Plate (Sealed)]'s skirt-part would disappear.
 	Resolved an issue where the male [Undefeated Hero Blade Mail]'s cape would overlap.
 	Adjusted the firing angle for short bow heroes when using [Steel-tipped Arrow] and [Poison Arrow]. The arrow trajectories of these skills are now closer to that of basic attacks and other skills.
 	Adjusted the [Deploy Artillery]'s tooltip icon model as well as its size on the minimap in [Territory War]:

 Original icon:

New icon:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08ea89d70ef5931a800ddcec586bbd4c8032247e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/737a1525acc3b54d0f3f80465502cf3d1a01c521.png

 	Resolved an issue with unit kill count for the Axe Raiders challenge quests when using the Axe Throw skill.
 	Resolved an issue where the number of defensive forces for regional lords didn't display correctly.
 	Resolved an issue with missing text from the description when war rallies are resting.
 	Resolved an issue where when Noble Houses lost against a war rally, they didn't become wounded after the battle.
 	Added a timer for quick station in War Rally's station battles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e748256b72ea1ddb5bcfae1adf5734dbde74d7cb.png

 	Resolved an issue where searches for Ruins on the world map would sometimes end up empty.
 	Resolved an issue where bandits sometimes couldn't be attacked on the world map.
 	Resolved an issue where a fief's owner could still withdraw their army after having occupied a fief.
 	Resolved an issue where a timer to re-select the battle commander of a fief would begin even when none had declared war against it.
 	Improved upon the description when declaring war against fiefs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/01d0f1a590905ff765d8fe05bfc177eaf3018063.png

 	Added explanations for Campaign (F5) sub-stages for the various regions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/aed2e6919b2cc142b6048ea4ca71d3cca8cdeb57.png

 	Improved how to interact with War Rally and Territory War Reports. Now, simply clicking a related notice or its hotkey will take you to it.
 	Resolved an issue where Prestige wouldn't sometimes be displayed in House Reports.
 	Resolved an issue where Most Artillery Destroyed would sometimes be displayed as 0 in House Reports.
 	Resolved an issue where house member's season level wouldn't display correctly when conferring titles.
 	Resolved an issue where the same bot could be chosen multiple times for war rallies.
 	Resolved an issue where house members without the authority to withdraw the house's army could still see the 'Withdraw' button.

 	Territory War Preparation time has been changed to 19:45-20:00.

After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 400 Honour, and Unit Medal x12 as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

Ⅰ. Bug Fixes & Improvements


 	Resolved a bug where our anti-cheat system led to the skills of some units having a chance to miss.
 	Resolved an issue where the male Archon Plate·Sealed's skirt-part would disappear.

 	Resolved an issue with sounds not playing for some parts of the UI.

 	Resolved an issue where the promotion challenges menu couldn't be displayed properly on some resolutions.
 	Resolved an issue where withdrawing from a battle or sudden war declarations that led to a change in the ruling house wouldn't reset the ruling house selection timer.
 	Resolved some localization issues.
 	Resolved an issue where some [hero] and [unit attires] couldn't be equipped or displayed in the Customization menu even when owned.
 	Resolved an issue where using [Skill Page Bundle] wouldn't give skill pages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/47fe279ea446c9d53db9f7037f4f18e0e261e191.png

 	Resolved an issue where Imperial Restorationists in fiefs didn't receive notifications of NPC rallies.
 	Resolved an issue where pursuits couldn't be initiated during some circumstances.
 	Resolved an issue where there was no BGM in rally pursuit maps.
 	Tower-shield and spearman units in the [Weekly Challenges] have both been changed to heavy shield units.
 	Improved the weapon trial map. You can now summon your warhorse within it.
 	The final stage of the Slay The Rebels weekly quest now requires you to complete 5 Surround the Bandits.
 	‘Pikeman units' in quests have been changed to ‘poleman infantry' (to conform to unit descriptions).
 	The Lord of Destruction badge requirement has been changed to ‘destroy two large-size siege artilleries in a single battle'.
 	Improved the location of some supply points in Territory War maps, such as for Qingtai in Longting and Nordtal in Ostaria.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f561adaf1d9f8ce6d85e76c1a596d9e26b1c6765.png

II. Prestige Changes

We have noticed that pursuits in Territory War have been focused more on realizing the house's strategy than to uphold its honor. And when pursuits directly affect a house's Prestige, the original strategic elements become less important, which is contrary to our design philosophy for how to improve Territory War. In the future, pursuits in allied and enemy areas during Territory War will no longer increase Prestige.

notes.title: [Season Preview] Dev Journal
notes.content:
- Prestige

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/010a70bbd8368b31c4e9f9249a430fe665d12d49.png

Being one of Conqueror's Blade's core game modes, Territory War has already been running for 8 seasons. Here, dozens of Warlords may lead units totaling over 1,000 to wage battle in teams, to take turns in attacking and defending objectives. In the sandbox world outside of the matched battles, Warlords may devise strategies to lay claim to land and gradually expand their domain or strike against their enemies.

While Territory War gives rise to frantic and exciting battles, it isn't completely without widely criticized flaws. During our work in improving it, we are planning on gradually melding it with our Ruling House and Area Influence systems. Hopefully, this change should make Territory War easier to grasp, as well as make the objectives each house strives to achieve clearer.

However, we are fully aware that we cannot solve the core issues with simple patches. That is why we've decided to bring about a new evolution of Territory War with the start of this season, and gradually do away with its shortcomings. After much thought and discussion, we've decided to reconstruct the current Prestige system.

Since times of old, the word 'Prestige' has represented the achievements of one person or a group of people. In the short term, prestige is representative of a power's ability to influence and its attractiveness to others. Whereas in the long term, it reflects the objective evaluation of this power's place in history. In Conqueror's Blade, 'Prestige' will no longer be currency houses can exchange for actions, but instead an evaluation, a rating, of that house's growth. It is our goal to have this revamped Prestige system play a crucial role in Territory War so that the two systems can grow together more holistically. All so that the ups and downs, waxing and waning of various powers are represented throughout Conqueror's Blade's history.

Area Influence will no longer feature in the reformed Territory War. Instead, the right of command will be bestowed upon houses that have declared war based on their Prestige. The act of declaring war is serious and should be done with prudence, and this should be reflected in Conqueror's Blade—the true Territory War is a platform where houses battle with their honour on the line. A house with high Prestige will therefore gain the authority to command forces in battle. Whereas a house acting as the Ruling House, the commander of the forces, will see their Prestige take a hit if the war ends in defeat, they throw the war, or if they simply escape to save their own hides.

Our goal is to gradually deepen the effect Prestige has over the various actions in the game so that it becomes a natural part of Conqueror's Blade's ecology. Actions that increase a house's Prestige will include: preparing your forces for war, expanding your territory, build buildings and cities, and maintaining stability in your land. Actions that reduce a house's Prestige will include: fleeing with the wind when the enemy is at your gates, launching assaults but ultimately withdrawing, unrest within your fiefs, or losing your fiefs. Declaring legitimate wars will no longer reduce your Prestige, however, excess declaration of wars and unrestrained expansion will.

We will continue working hard and improving upon Territory War through the iterations so that it may reflect the changes of current events as hundreds of houses vie for power in Conqueror's Blade. We are looking forward to seeing hundreds of powers sprouting up upon the land. We are also looking forward to common dreams coming into fruition as comrades-in-arms strife to make their mark in the world of Conqueror's Blade. Together, we will embark upon a path to see dreams come true!

(Typesetting reference: Italics: Citations; Normal font: heighten atmosphere & storytelling; Small characters: game mechanics)

- War Rallies

As the flames of war recede, mighty powers still struck the frontier. Waging war for thirty years across a vast span of land.

One disaster after another; in the wake of war and flame insatiable desires spread. The contention of power has given rise to countless conflicts and wars. Yet, the rich and affluent stand aloof, unable to see the common people's plight.

	The time has come to make a stand. Our land has been wrought by hardships for many a year. We must protect it, and reclaim safety!

At the frontier of Nonetal Guard, above the Ivan Hills, on the steppes of Falonde and the lands of Imperialis Occis, more than 20 factions have returned amidst the chaos. They hail from different nations, from different towns. While they fight for different forces and have returned for their own reasons, at this moment, they are all preparing for war. They have vowed to defend their homeland, mobilize as an army, and issue war rallies.

Brave Warlord, no matter where your allegiance lie, whether you belong to the Qian Army, Anliang Legion, or Augolian Legion, follow your own moral beliefs and ride with your commander to war. Aid your allies and strike against the invaders! Protect the people and the land!

During Territory War, the leading force of each region will battle within their zone of command: attack enemies nearing their fiefs, to protect their territory or seek expansion. They will also ally with nearby friendly forces. Warlords of the Imperial Restorationists may send their own forces to bolster their allies to take out their foes' fiefs or strike against the Noble Houses to show their might. If the war rally is successful, the leading force of that alliance's army will command the next fief battle and lead tens of thousands of forces in an assault!

Once a war rally begins, the leading force will request aid from the Imperial Restorationists. Leading forces will issue war rallies against nearby fiefs within their zone of command, and once Warlords of the Imperial Restorationists or those thirsty for war join in, the war rally's target is set. After a period of time, the allied army will march toward the fief. Naturally, the Noble Houses are bound to respond upon seeing such a vast army on the march. They might come from any direction to strike at or prevent the allied army from advancing. Once the army reaches the fief, it will begin erecting simple siege camps, prepare artilleries, and get ready for battle. Should the Noble Houses fail to prevent the army from finishing their preparations, the leading force commanding the army will become the commander of the next siege battle of this fief. They will thus shoulder the power and glory of that region's people.

Warlords, raise high your weapons!

—Like the stones that appear with the melting of snow, the god of destiny's ending for the great civilizations is gradually coming to light...

—New conflicts are brewing! Those coveting expansions have set their eyes upon the center of the land.

—The Borderlands. A land where wars run strife and warlords fight against each other. Leaders yearning for greatness and glory grow bold with ambition now that the great disaster has created a vacuum of power in the land.

—The winds herald change! The hero Cambyses arose and established Sarazhan Empire within Conqueror's City. In just a few years he became the third person in history to assume command of the Borderlands.

—Thunder roars aloud! An exodus of merchants and refugees stride toward the civilized world to share terrible news: Cambyses, a tyrant like none the world has ever seen, has arisen!

—Many a city is on the brink of destruction, and their people face imminent danger!

You must remain vigilant! As you dispatch your army, perhaps lords, mortal enemies, or noble houses in other corners of the land that seek to change the world set their eyes upon you. As may he, the one born of chaos and strife, and his army... His army of merciless, bloodthirsty beasts! He is like the devil incarnate, inciting war and strife wherever he goes. The Borderlands is far from enough to satiate his ambition. No, he aims to conquer the entire world.

Set aside your disputes and save people in the Borderlands'! 

Will you respond with inaction or rise to fight? Will you act in blind rage or devise a masterful plan? Will you prepare to wage war or defend your land? Your choices will affect the outcome. What will the world come to be?

What will be your choice?!

notes.title: [Season Preview]: Tyranny Season HUGE Update/Changes Notice
notes.content:
Reporting in! I've got a secret report from afar!

We're launching a huge update with plenty of changes on September 28th when the Tyranny season launches! Be sure to read all about it for the latest information and get a head start on your coming journey!

[Hero Specializations], [Unit Tree], [Crafting & Schematics], [Season Shop] 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/888c225fdb4a2cb129b1ebc9a4e56798b33179f2.png

I. [Hero Specializations]

We will be making changes to the [Hero Specialization] system with the [Tyranny] season.
[Skill Pages] will no longer be required to unlock and upgrade [Victory Skills]. Instead, you can unlock and upgrade them with [Mastery Points].
Regarding [Skill Pages]. As [Skill Pages] will no longer be needed to unlock skills, we will be returning all [Skill Pages] you have spent on unlocking victory skills during previous seasons and run a [Skill Page] exchange event. Check under [Activities (O key)] for what items you can exchange [Skill Pages] for. 

During the Skill Page Exchange Event, players can change all previously spent and all currently owned Skill Pages to following: 


 	Attire Chests
 	Mastery Points
 	Bronze Coins
 	Unit Medals 
 	Honour


Unused [Skill Pages] will be converted into [Skill Points] once the event ends. In modes where you can earn [Skill Pages], such as [Deathmatch], you will instead earn [Mastery Points]. [Skill Pages] will no longer be obtainable.

II. [Honour] & [Unit Tree] 

During previous seasons, gaining [Honour] has been one of the greatest goals for many a Warlord: accumulate [Honour] and spend it on unlocking powerful units in the [Unit Tree]. To aid you all in creating your own elite army, we will be making a range of adjustments to [Honour] and the [Unit Tree]. 
[olist]
  We will be adjusting the order of [Unit Tree] nodes: by moving attribute bonus nodes further down the line, you will be able to acquire and use units earlier than before. 
  We will return [Honour Reset Tokens] to you based on your character level. 
[/olist]

III. [Forging] & [Schematics] 

To reduce the difficulty of forging equipment, we will be merging [Schematic types] into new items with the start of the [Tyranny] season. All [Uncommon/Rare] weapon schematics will be merged into a single schematic, and the same goes for armours. Previous schematics in your bag will be changed to the corresponding replacements, which will be sent to your Mail. 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14fHmghia329O6vRE58a_y2HiL8qdmM1z2-s2-rsh5OI/edit?usp=sharing


IV. [Personal History] & [Unit Training Plans] 
Starting from the [Tyranny] season, [Personal History] and [Unit Training Plans] will be merged into a new item. Resetting hero attributes and unit nodes will require the new item [Secret Training Missive]. [Personal History] and [Unit Training Plans] in your inventory will be converted into an equal number of [Secret Training Missives], with the new items being sent to your Mail. 

We hope that these changes will remove some unnecessary obstacles on your path to greatness, and bring you greater freedom in choosing weapons and units. Hopefully, you will now be able to experience a better warfare gameplay than ever in Conqueror's Blade! 

V. [Unit Changes] 

1. Unit Leadership Changes 

Currently, most 5-star units have fairly high leadership requirements, which is somewhat limiting possible strategies. And so, we will be reducing the leadership requirements of 5-star and some 4-star units in the new season to bring an all-around more diversified strategic experience. 
Most changes will be in the ballpark of 5-30 leadership. 

2. Unit Balance Changes 

Some 5-star cavalry units are having a hard time in the current meta, and we will gradually be making changes to this. We will during the season be improving the Kheshigs and Cataphract Lancers in their Charges and Follow Charges. 

You can get the latest news by following Conqueror‘s Blade on Conqueror's Blade devs Twitch, Facebook, Twitter and Discord.
