notes.title: [Season Preview] Seasonal Attires - Art of War
notes.content:
Thirst For Battle Blade Mail

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2f3f04ae282867b963ca9de87bba0d05a212a9e8.jpg

History is written by the victor. The side that remains standing will claim any and all spoils they can carry. They will pick out the items of the highest quality to hand over to craftsmen who reforge their armours to be used in the next battle.

The Thirst For Battle blade mail once belonged to an undefeated warrior. Countless mighty foes had fallen before him until this armour came to be. The craftsmen themselves couldn't even tell where its parts hailed from. Instead, all they could do was to utilize all their knowledge and make it as sturdy as possible. Yet, an armour forged after hundreds of battles will similarly be lost after a single defeat. The Thirst For Battle armour now rests upon the armour rack of the one who defeated its original wearer, awaiting its next battle.

Tyrant's Command Plate Mail

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1f1b61c09a24d7e3c6a36f527426a3420226cce7.jpg

Innumerable followers gather beneath Cambyses' banner and storming one ancient city after another like a swarm of ravaging locusts. They breached all treasuries they found and cleaned them of all valuables. What was worse still, was their immense cruelty—they spared no quarter and amassed riches as they strode atop a path of bones. At last, they became Cambyses' most trusted followers.

The Tyrant's Command plate mail was forged from plundered armours. Cambyses himself chose the most exquisite among the spoils and commanded captured craftsmen to adorn them with a veritable forest of spikes and bladed. Works of art truly befitting of his unique taste and disposition. He then bestowed these armours upon his most fervent followers, creating a diabolic force.

As his henchmen fell one after another, these armours fell into the hands of others.

And now, these are seen as symbols of the tyrant's defeat and fall.

You can get the latest news by following Conqueror‘s Blade on Conqueror's Blade devs Twitch, Facebook, Twitter and Discord.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade Account Safety Notice
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord, it has come to our attention that some individuals have been stealing Steam login information via the following means: leveling services, hack advertisements, or via users' browsers or trojans, hacks, scripts, etc. Such behavior is difficult to prevent and leads to account safety issues.
We would therefore like to remind everyone by increasing account protection awareness:
[olist]
Do not share your account with anyone else in any way or form, and do not trust hack or leveling services advertisements. 
 Some software may record your account and password, and not all computers on net bars are 100% safe. Therefore, we advise all Steam users to link their Steam account to a mobile device and activate mobile authentication. You can do so by following these steps: 

[/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/promotion/twofactor?l

------------------------Anti-Information Theft----------------------

1.	We advise all Steam players to link their Steam account to a mobile device and activate mobile authentication. This will prevent others from stealing your account information, especially for users that frequent net bars where others may install software to record your account details and to avoid trojans from stealing your account information. 

2.	Using Third-party Software (Add-ons): 

The main way in which accounts are stolen is when users install third-party add-ons from unknown sources. Most of these add-ons include automatic login, which requires you to enter your account and password. In doing so you will invertedly be giving your account information away to this add-on's creators.

Many of those that create illegal add-ons do so with ulterior motives. They will in their programs often implement trojans and/or viruses, that install programs on their users' computers that record account and password information. Some among these will even wait for you to level up before they take over your account and rid it of all wealth. Do not use any third-party software (add-ons) from untrusted or unknown sources.

3.	Leveling/Farming Services: 

Leveling services require you to share your account with others, requiring you to share important information. Those providing you with such services may at their leisure use this information to steal your account without much trace. Be sure to protect all information you provide during account registration and do not divulge it to anyone else.

Do not trust any leveling service claims, as doing so will compromise your account's security. Those providing leveling services will use illegal tools and software to provide their services. As these are illegal, your account may be banned, suspended, or penalized depending on the severity.

4.	Logging in to unknown websites: Do not login to any other website using your game account and password! 

Do not log in to unknown websites, or websites pertaining to scrips or hacks, and do not use any hacks. Such software often has a backdoor embedded so that they may acquire your account and password.
Websites pertaining to Silver Coin trading may contain trojans aimed at stealing your account information.

5.	Account Sharing: 

Do not share your game account with anyone else as doing so will compromise the security of your account. You cannot ensure that others will fully protect your information, or that they will not steal your account at some point. ② If you notice that someone else has logged on to your account, be sure to change your password at once. We recommend you use a complex password, and preferably one including special characters. Naturally, it is important that you can remember your password. You also shouldn't divulge any information you provided during the creation of your account. ③ Not only are you at risk when sharing your own account but also when accessing the accounts of others. When you log into another person's account, they can easily find out the IP address you logged in from, which they can then use to steal your account information.

notes.title: Server Transfer Rules
notes.content:
The Dynasty season is about to end and a new season will begin. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

	Server Transfer Time:

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on September 16th, Thursday, after maintenance, and run through September 26th , Tuesday, 24:00 (UTC+8).
2、Servers will be taken down for maintenance on September 28rd, Thursday,during which server transfers and weekly maintenance will be done.

	Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

	Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

	Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
2. There are no additional transfer restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers. There is no limit to character transfers from Jaderock Creek. Only characters created after December 21st, 0:00, 2020 are eligible for transfer.

	Transfer Quotas

Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 240.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 400.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 240.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 300.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 160.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 160.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 160.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 160.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 100.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 100.

Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

	How to Transfer:

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred during the September 23rd maintenance.

	Please Notice:

1. After having submitted a server transfer application, you may cancel it at any time before September 21st, 24:00 (UTC+8). Upon cancelling a transfer, your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable for this server transfer period). Though, having cancelled a transfer, you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.

3. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.

4. Leave the Imperial Restorationists or your house before applying for a server transfer. You may not join either while a server transfer is pending.

5. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Your character will be removed from your House, Alliance/Imperial Restorationists. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.

6. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
[olist]
  Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
  You cannot bring resources in Resource Piles, so make sure to claim these beforehand so as to not lose them. Items listed at the Market will be removed from the Market and mailed to your character.
 Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.
[/olist]

7. Duplicate Names:

Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

notes.title: CBL: Dynasty Tournament Guide
notes.content:
1. How to partake in the tournament?

	Access the relevant tournament server from within the Server list, and have your squad captain create a house which your members then join.

Asia Division Signups:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418481287260
South America Division Signups: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418488523817
MENA Division Signups:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418488667860

2. CBL Tournament  Servers

CBL's tournament servers are servers we have prepared especially for the tournament. These servers are used as a place for tournament participants to train with one another, and for the tournament's matches. Those who are not participating in the tournament and haven't signed up to it should instead log in to our life servers, i.e., Lotus Ash Sea, Jaderock Creek, and Dragonrise Island for Asia; Espada Forest for South America; Sandstorm Gorge for the Middle East.
Asia Division Play-in: CBL Asia Play-in Server
South American Tournament Server: CBL SA Server
MENA Tournament Server: CBL MENA Server
Asia Tournament Server: CBL Asia Server
The 4 above servers are used by players to signup, practice, and play the tournament.

3. If I play from Asia, can I sign up for both the Play-in and Ranked Battle?

Yes. You can sign up for both, thereby increasing your chance of getting a spot in the tournament. If you get promoted from the Play-in, you will be removed from the Ranked Battle score, and the one below you in score will take your place.
If you fail to get promoted from the Play-in, you may still have a chance at entering the tournament by having a high Ranked Battle score.

4. What is the difference between the CBL Asia Play-in and the CBL Asia servers?

	The CBL Asia Play-in Server is exclusive to the Asia Division Play-ins.
Here you can sign up and train for the Asia Division Play-in.
The 8 squads that are promoted from the Play-in will be able to join the actual tournament server on September 7th, 12:00 (UTC+8) to create their house and characters.

	The actual Asia Division tournament will be held on the CBL Asia Server.
This server is used for the Asia Division Ranked Battle scoring signups and for the CBL Knockout Stage.

	In this season, we're adding the Play-in, giving Warlords with relatively lower Ranked Battle scores a chance to be promoted to the CBL Knockout Stage. To partake in the Play-in, you should sign up via the CBL Asia Play-in Server. 8 of the 64 squads partaking in the Play-in will be promoted to the CBL Knockout Stage. Check the following link for more information: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418476750702

	You can also sign up using Ranked Battle score rankings as per usual. To sign up with Ranked Battle score, access the CBL Asia Server to do so. Check the following link for more information: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418481287260

	Your squad may sign up for both the Play-in and the Ranked Battle scoring. If you do, and you are promoted from the Play-in, your squad will not be counted for the Ranked Battle scoring. However, if you fail to qualify in the Play-in, your squad may still be promoted from Ranked Battle scoring. Sign-up rewards from the Play-in and Ranked Battle scoring are not mutually exclusive.

5. How many squads can take part in the tournament?

	CBL Knockout Stage: 28 squads will partake in the Asia Division (Lotus Ash Sea, Jaderock Creek, Dragonrise Island), with 4 of these being seeded squads.

a.	Play-in: A total of 64 squads may partake in the Asia Play-in, with 8 of these being promoted to CBL knock-out stage. If more than 64 squads sign up, the 64 squads with the most total Season Level will be invited.

b.	A total of 16 squads will be chosen depending on their Ranked Battle score.
	15 squads will partake in the South America Division (Espada Forest), with 1 of these being a seeded squad.
	4 squads will partake in the MENA Division (Sandstorm Gorge), with 1 of these being a seeded squad.

6. How do I get promoted?

	The Asia Play-in Tournament is played as Best of 3 eliminations, with 8 squads being promoted.
	The matches in all divisions (except the finals) will be played as Best of 3 eliminations.
Access the following link to learn more about how to get promoted:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418476750702
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2944778418481287260

7. From where can I watch CBL?

We will be streaming the CBL Knockout Stage in both Chinese and English. Simply tune in to the corresponding stream:
English: https://www.twitch.tv/conquerorsbladedevs
Chinese: https://live.bilibili.com/22798299
Or, you can always tune in to our cooperating streamer's channel during the tournament.

You can always press F7 in-game or follow us on social media to learn more about the tournament.

8. Feel free to contact us should you have any further questions:

QQ: 1284689934 (战意小A)
Discord: violeta#4335

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League Rules
notes.content:
Tournament Version & Client

	Tournament Version: Official Version
	Client: Steam/Official Website Client
	Server: Tournament Servers

1)	Players on the Lotus Ash Sea (LA)/Dragonrise Island (DI)/Jaderock Creek (JC) servers play on the CBL Asia Server.
2)	Players on the Espada Forest (EF) server play on the CBL SA Server.
3)	Players on the Sandstorm Gorge (SG) server play on the CBL MENA Server.
Note: Only players with a character of level 100+ on the LA, DI, JC, SG, and EF servers may enter the tournament servers.

	Tournament Accounts

	Fairness Measures
The accounts of all contestants will have the same equipment and unit configurations.

	Doctrines Are Disabled
No unit will be able to use doctrines during the tournament.

	Runes Are Disabled
Heroes may not use runes during the tournament.

	Artillery Restrictions
Contestants may only use artilleries of rare quality, and there will be a limit to the number of artilleries each player may use depending on the mode being played.

	Match Modes

	Siege Battles

1)	Map Pool: Harbour City, Linwu Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
2)	Attack/Defend Order: Refer to Ban & Pick under the 'Ruleset' further on in the document.
3)	Siege Battle Rules:
i.	15 players on each squad. (10 each on Linwu Fortress)
ii.	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
iii.	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
iv.	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
v.	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
4)	Victory Conditions:
i.	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
ii.	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.

	Field Battle, Capture the Flag

1)	Map Pool: Grassland Assault
2)	Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
3)	Field Battle Rules:
i.	15 players on each side.
ii.	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
iii.	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
iv.	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.

4)	Victory Conditions:
i.	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
ii.	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
iii.	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
iv.	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
5)	Draw & Extra Match Rules:
i.	Played on Grassland Assault.
ii.	The two squads switch sides.
iii.	Victory conditions remain unchanged.
iv.	Should the extra match result in a draw, further extra matches will be played until one side wins.


	Ruleset

	Division & Cross-Division Matches

Ruleset: Best of 3
The two squads' captains roll.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
i.	The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
ii.	And then the other squad bans one map.
iii.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.

	Division Final

Ruleset: Best of 7
Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
-	The squad from the Winner's Bracket starts with 1 point, meaning that the score starts at 1:0 when the finals begin.
-  Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick
-  The first two matches are played on Linwu Fortress.
-  For the third and fourth matches, the pool is as follows.
- Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, 	Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
i.	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
ii.	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
iii.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
-  For the fifth and sixth matches:
i.	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
ii.	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
iii.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads play Siege Battles against each other in accordance with the attack/defend order on the maps selected.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 4 points win.

	Code of Conduct

	Forfeit Regulations

Forfeit Rulings

1）	If, after 24 hours have passed after the drawing ceremony, we are unable to contact you and confirm your squad's participation, your squad will be considered to have forfeited participation.

2）	If we have been unable to contact your squad before 10 minutes of match start, you will be considered to have forfeited participation.

3) Squads who ahead of time contact a referee and forfeit of their own volition will be considered to have forfeited participation.

	Dealing with Forfeits

1) Should a squad forfeit, no other squad will take their place, and their opponent will be considered victorious and therefore promoted.

	Rematches & Pauses:

1)	Participants are responsible for their own network connections during the tournament. The referees will confirm with both teams whether they are ready. A match is considered as having begun once the countdown timer has begun. There will be no rematches for disconnects or lag once a match has begun.

2)	Disconnecting and reconnecting during a match will count as one death.

3) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants (10 on Linwu Fortress) per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a match within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the match, giving the win to the other squad.

4) No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.

	Tournament Prohibitions:

1)	Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loopholes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament. Their account on the official server will also be banned.

2)	Players whose accounts are banned on the live servers may not sign up for the tournament. Players whose accounts are for any reason whatsoever banned on the live servers during the course of the tournament will have their participation qualification revoked.

3)	Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.

4)	Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions appear, and if so, their opponent will immediately be victorious.

5)	Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

6)	Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of, and we may prosecute for related responsibility.

7)	Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.
The CBL Tournament is made up of five divisions: Asia, South America, MENA, EU/US, and NetEase China. A player partaking in more than one will be violating our rule for 'duplicate signups', and if discovered by us, or if a player reports them with relevant proof, they will have their participation qualification revoked.

8) Should a squad or member of a squad violate any tournament regulation, referees have the authority to rule them as being violated, and to disqualify said squad or member.

	The final interpretation right of CBL belongs to Booming Technology (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd.
	Should you have any inquiries whatsoever, feel free to join:
	Conqueror's Blade Discord: https://discord.gg/2xuVpZErgb and contact violeta#4335
	CBL Communication Group: 788262212 (QQ), contact 战意小c弟

notes.title: Dynasty Results Announcement
notes.content:
Season Results


 	This season will be concluding with the September 23rd maintenance, 2021. 
 	You will not be able to gain Glory from Battles, Expedition, Free Battles, Territory War or by leveling up following the September 23rd maintenance until the next season begins. 
 	Glory can still be earned via Weekly Challenges, Frontier Missives, and Urgent Messages. 
 	The Seasonal Store will be available until the new season begins. 


Campaigns Results

	We will begin tallying the results of this season's Campaigns on September 20th, 12:00 (UTC+8), 2021. 
The final results will be available after the maintenance on September 23rd, 2021. 

Fief Rewards:

	After tallying the Campaigns' rewards, we will be issuing Empire Coins to all Warlords in accordance with the number, type, and level of fiefs their Alliance/Legions occupy. 


 	The number of fiefs an Alliance/Legion possesses will be counted as it stands when the September 23rd (2021) maintenance begins. 
 	Fief level 1-5 cities: Empire Coin x30. 
 	Fief level 6-15 cities: Empire Coin x50. 
 	Fief level 1-5 forts: Empire Coin x30. 
 	Fief level 6-15 forts: Empire Coin x50. 
 	Fief level 1-5 villages: Empire Coin x15. 
 	Fief level 6-15 villages: Empire Coin x30. 
 	Daicheng grants better rewards than other fiefs. Occupying it grants Empire Coin x100, Treatise x3, and Epic Artillery Selection Box x3. 
 	Anliang grants better rewards than other fiefs. Occupying it grants Empire Coin x150, Treatise x5, Epic Barding Schematic Crate x2, and Epic Artillery Selection Box x5. 


	Every Warlord may gain a maximum of 1,000 Empire Coins from fief rewards. 

Title Rewards:

	The titles of all lieges for this season will be confirmed on September 18th, 22:30 (UTC+8), 2021. 
	Additional Empire Coin rewards will also be granted according to each Warlord's Noble House/Imperial Restorationists title. 

Noble House titles grant the following rewards: 

Hegemon: Empire Coin x600.
Monarch: Empire Coin x550.
Chamberlain: Empire Coin x500.
Chief Justiciar and General: Empire Coin x400.
High Councilor, Judge, and Commander: Empire Coin x350.
Minister, High Sheriff, and Captain: Empire Coin x300.
Elector, Magistrate, and Constable: Empire Coin x200.
Alderman, Bailiff, and Castellan: Empire Coin x100.
Burgess, Freeholder, and Shieldbearer: Empire Coin x50.

Additional Empire Coin rewards will also be granted to each Warlord according to their Imperial Restorationists' titles, as well as whether or not they manage to defend Anliang and stop the Noble Houses from attaining the title of Hegemon. 

Supreme Commander/Hand of Kingdom: Gains Empire Coin x600 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x400 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x300 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Marshal/Hand of Lords: Gains Empire Coin x550 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x350 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x270 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Deputy Marshal/Hand of Commons: Gains Empire Coin x500 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x300 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x240 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Admiral, Lieutenant General, and Major General: Gains Empire Coin x400 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x240 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x200 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Colonel, Lieutenant Colonel, and Major: Gains Empire Coin x350 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x180 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x160 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Captain. Lieutenant. and Second Lieutenant: Gains Empire Coin x300 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x120 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x100 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Aquilifer/Sergeant and Legionary/Sergeant Major: Gains Empire Coin x200 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x80 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Gains Empire Coin x50 should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

Venator/Thousands, Munifex/Hundreds, and Veles/Tens: Gains Empire Coin x100 should Anliang remain unoccupied. Gains Empire Coin x30 should Anliang be occupied but no Warlord assumes the Hegemon title. Will not be granted any Empire Coins should a Warlord assume the Hegemon title.

	Empire Coin rewards from titles are not affected by the reward cap of fiefs. 

Empire Coin Exchange Event:

	Empire Coins can be redeemed for various resources within the "Empire's Treasury" menu accessed via the O key. Including Epic Hero Schematic Crates, Epic Barding Schematic Crates, Treatises, Powdered Silver, Rare Equipment Schematics, Unit Medals, Hero XP Cards, and Unit XP Cards. 

	Rewards can be redeemed from September 23rd, 2021, (after maintenance) until November 11th, 24:00 (UTC+8). 

Headwear & Title Rewards:

	Noble Houses 


 A crown will be issued according to your title, and can be used until the end of the next season. 
 	Proprietors of the Hegemon and Monarch titles will also receive an exclusive attire. 
 	All members of the alliance that in the end occupies Anliang will gain the Dynasty Destiny title. 


	Imperial Restorationists 


 	Second Lieutenants and above will receive a headwear befitting of their station which lasts until the end of the next season. 
 	Warlords with titles below Second Lieutenant will instead receive 20,000 Bronze Coins. 
 	Those of the Imperial Restorationists who take part in the battle for Daicheng or Anliang will gain the permanent title of Dynasty Volunteer. The permanent title of Dynasty Royal Guard will be granted to Imperial Restorationists should they manage to defend Daicheng, or should they fail to defend Anliang while still preventing the Noble Houses from earning the title of Hegemon. Should they manage to defend Anliang, all Imperial Restorationists who partook in its defense will receive the permanent title of Dynasty Legion. To successfully defend Daicheng and Anliang, the fiefs must be under their respective region's NPC rulership on September 20th, 12:00 (UTC+8), 2021. 


Between-season Territory War Schedule & Territory Reset:

After the Campaigns results have been tallied, Military Exercises and Territory War will be available until the next season begins. 

No Territory War-related activities will be held on September 21st, 2021, and they will instead be replaced by Free Battles. 

	Territory War will run as normal every Tuesday and Saturday after September 23rd, 2021. 

Neither Daicheng nor Anliang can be attacked during this time. 

Fiefs occupied in Territory War during this time will not count toward your Empire Coin rewards. 

	Territories will be fully reset when the next season begins. 

Ranked Battle Results

This season's Ranked Battle will be closed after the maintenance on September 23rd, 2021 (Ranked Battles will be replaced by Free Battles). We will then be issuing the rewards according to each players' Ranked Battle score. 

	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 800 will receive the following: 

 	Unit Medal x60 
 	Powdered Silver x20 
 	Honour x10,000 
 	Treatise x3 


	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,200 will receive the following: 

 	Unit Medal x60 
 	Epic Barding Schematic Crate x1 
 	Gold Dust x30 
 	Treatise x7 


	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,500 will receive the following: 

	The Permanent Honorary Title: Dynasty Watcher 
	Ranked Battle Custom Unit Attire Selection Box x1 
	All of the aforementioned rewards stacks, so a Warlord whose Ranked Battle score exceeds 1,500 will be granted all of the rewards. 
	To further reward Warlords who have excelled in Ranked Battle, those of the top 25 with at least 2,100 Score and that have reached Marshal will receive the following: 


 	The special mount banner attire: Dragon Totem Banner. 
 	The Great Eagle Banner will be usable until the end of the next season. 
 The banner will be sent by mail, so keep an eye out for it should you meet the requirements.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade Celebration Event: Viva La Fantasy
notes.content:
Great tidings have come from the front. The imperial family of Qian cannot wait to announce the victory and show their prestige in a display of amazing martial arts. In light of these achievements, they are holding a series of grand celebrations where literati from all over can partake and write legends. Qian has naturally also prepared plentiful rewards for those who fair well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/014703fd90b9e440716fbf9c98503d6457fc22e4.png

The celebration is divided into two parts: Well Wishes & Great Celebration. We're certain that you Warlords can write legendary stories for the warriors on the frontlines!


September 1 to 12: Collection & Display
September 12 to 14: Rating & Selection
September 14 to 19: Voting
September 20: Announcing Results

Ode to the Qian

As the celebrations begin, everyone from highborn to lowborn will send their well wishes to the warriors on the front. Those whose works receive praise and accolades for their creations will be handsomely rewarded indeed. The splendor of Qian shall shine bright!

Event 1: Draaaaw it!

Info:

Is the pen mightier than the sword? With pen in hand, create a doujin artwork to send your well wishes to the frontlines. You may do so in any style you wish. You may choose to paint a portrait of your favorite hero or unit, create an avatar, or make cutesy emotes!

Collection: September 1 to 12
Grading + Voting: September 13 to 19

How to Participate: Submit your work via the Discord（https://discord.gg/5rGn4Sb）, or to our submission mailbox（cb_event@bomingtech.com）. Be sure to add your game ID + nickname + server. Once the collection concludes, our art team will choose 10 great submissions which will be eligible for voting on by players from all across the world. The top 3 ones with the most votes will receive extra rewards!

Rewards

Participation: All submissions that meet the requirements will receive [Wyrmbane Armour] Attire Chest x3.

TOP 3 Votes
1st: 250 USD Amazon Gift Card  + Merchandize
2nd: 200 USD Amazon Gift Card+ Merchandize
3rd: 150 USD Amazon Gift Card+ Merchandize

Event 2: Dream it, Be it

Info:

Don your armour, grab hold of your weapon, and set your imagination to work! Dress yourself up and cosplay as the Qian Dynasty hero you love! Cosplay as your favorite unit or hero! We accept any submission as long as you are imaginative!


Collection: September 1 to September 12
Grading + Voting: September 13 to 19

How to Participate: Submit your work via theDiscord（https://discord.gg/5rGn4Sb）, or to our submission mailbox（cb_event@bomingtech.com）. Be sure to add your game ID + nickname + server. Once the collection concludes, we will choose 10 great submissions which will be eligible for voting on by players from all across the world. The top 3 ones with the most votes will receive extra rewards!

Rewards

Participation: All submissions that meet the requirements will receive [Wyrmbane Armour] Attire Chest x3.
TOP 3 Votes
1st: 250 USD Amazon Gift Card + Merchandize
2nd: 200 USD Amazon Gift Card + Merchandize
3rd: 150 USD Amazon Gift Card + Merchandize


The Grand Ceremony

Having won the battle on the frontlines, the soldiers are returning home in triumph and the celebrations enter a climax!


Event 3: See Me Dripped Out!

Info:

The celebrations are at their height and everyone has been invited to receive the commoners' blessings. A celebration such as this naturally requires you to dress the part! Don the attire of your favorite hero or unit and screenshot away! Let us see who the most striking Warlord is!
Collection: September 5 to 12
Grading + Voting: September 13 to 19

How to Participate: Submit your work via theDiscord（https://discord.gg/5rGn4Sb）, or to our submission mailbox（cb_event@bomingtech.com）. Be sure to add your game ID + nickname + server. The top 5 ones with the most votes will receive extra rewards!


Rewards

TOP 5 Votes:
Exclusive Screenshot Action + 50 USD Amazon Gift Card

Such a grand celebration naturally cannot be without music! The Dynasty Season's OST album is now out! The album contains six original pieces of music that Conqueror's Blade's music team has created.

notes.title: September 2 Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on September 2nd, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and Unit Medal x12 as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

1.	Event Notice 


 	Fish Charms for the [Treasure Hunt] event has stopped dropping. After the update, you can exchanged 1 Fish Charm for 2 Core of Warfare Fragments. This exchange can be done up to 40 times. 
 	Limited-time Warden quests have ended. 
 	The limited-time Summer Joy [Celebration Doctrine Pool] event has been extended to September 9th. Be sure to use your Secret Treatises wisely! 


2.	Bug Fixes & Improvements 


 	Resolved an issue where after learning the bottom line's Regeneration, the skill wouldn't display for the [Iron Reapers]. 
 	Resolved an issue where [Urgent Messages] bought in the store didn't stack in the Inventory. 
 	Resolved an issue where the after-battle [Unit Kill Details] didn't display correctly in the Personal Info & Team Info menus. 
 	Resolved an issue where damage taken by heroes would count toward 'damage taken by heavy shield units' in Weekly Quests. 
 	Resolved an issue with the location of the left image in [Conqueror's Journey Battlefield]. 
 	Resolved an issue with the shield model of the [longsword & shield] weapon attire [Impassable Bastion]. 
 	Resolved an issue with the [Lone Waverider] hero attire. 
 	Resolved an issue where the unit menu would display the wrong special effects after removing a [doctrine]. 
 	Adjusted the respawn point for the attackers on the [Allenburg] siege map, by adding an extra respawn point outside the walls. 
 	Resolved an issue where heroes could get stuck by a fence on the [Dasuo Fort] siege map. 
 	Resolved an issue where heroes could get stuck on some boards outside on the [Wall Fort] siege map after destroying the walls at A. 
 	Resolved an issue where heroes could easily get stuck on the cliff to the side of the steps between B and C on the [Wall Fort] siege map. 
 	Resolved an issue where a destroyable wall was displayed at the top of the minimap on the [White Elk Fort] siege map. 
 	Resolved an issue where the Refining Resources menu was missing from [Mingyu] in the Liangyun region. 
 	Resolved an issue where the correct image wasn't displaying for the [Turul Város] map under [Siege Battles] in the Matchmaking menu. 
 	Resolved an issue where Collections didn't update quickly enough between weeks in the [Units] -> [Technology] menu. 
 	Improved the Share button in the Groups menu.

notes.title: Infinite World Battlefield Test Changes Notice
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlord, as the testing on August 26th has been cancelled, the PTR Server will be coming online earlier on the 27th at 16:00 (GMT+8). Select the PTR Server in the list, create a character, and log in when the Infinite World Battlefield test is running.

Participation Reward: Those taking part will receive Bronze Coin x100,000, Treatise x1, and Honour x1,000 on their highest leveled character.

Rewards will be sent to your character with the highest level.

1. Check World Map functionality during Territory War.
2. Territory War Siege battles.
3. World Map multiplayer instances (rebel camps) and wandering rebels.
4. World Map Pursuit battles.

III. Test Schedule

August 27:
19:00-19:30 (UTC+8): Wandering rebels and World Map pursuit + World Map multiplayer instances (rebel camps)
19:30-21:00 (UTC+8): Territory War begins + Territory War Siege battle + World Map pursuit + World Map multiplayer instances (rebel camps)

1. Check whether the World Map functions as intended during Territory War.
2. Check whether Territory War works as intended.
3. Check whether World Map multiplayer instances (rebel camps) and wandering rebels work as intended.
4. Check whether World Map pursuit battles work as intended.

1. Must have a character of above level 20 in your account.
2. If you encounter bugs or wish to provide feedback, please contact our community to do so.
3. Once the testing finishes, kindly take the time to fill out our survey to help us collect feedback and recommendations.

notes.title: CBL: Dynasty MENA Division Signups
notes.content:
● Signup Time:

Signups start on August 25th, 15:00 (UTC+3)
Signups end on September 6th, 7:00 (UTC+3)

 Requirements:

Player Requirements:

(1) Having a level 100+ character on Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East).
(2) Playing on an account that has not been banned (for any reason).

Squad Requirements:

（1） 15-20 members that meet the signup requirements.
（2） Sign up by following the notice we'll be publishing later on.
（3） All members of the squad must have a character on the Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East) server that meets the requirements.

How to Sign Up:

     How to Sign Up:

（1） Navigate to the server login menu and login to the CBL MENA Server.
（2） Then, create a character on that server starting with your squad's abbreviation followed by your nickname (AAAA_BBBB). Squad abbreviations should be within 4 English characters. Read on below for naming details.
（3） The captain should create a house with the squad's full name on the server. Squad names may only contain English characters. The captain should also add the following information in this format to their House Announcement:
Squad Abbreviation (must be within 4 English characters)
Squad Name
Squad contact info (Discord)
（4） All of the squad's members should join their house on the new server.

   Please Note:

    Participation qualifications of each character and squad will be gauged based on data as of September 6, 7:00 (UTC+3).
    If any of the following should arise, you will not be eligible to partake in the tournament.

     Squads

1. A squad fails to sign up according to the requirements.
2. A squad is found to not have between 15-20 members.
3. A squad is found to have used a name that is in any form derogatory (after verification or being reported at a later stage).
4. If a squad's member(s) make improper remarks, they will be penalized based on the severity of the violation, and may have tournament rewards deducted, their participation qualification revoked, or they may be banned from partaking in further tournaments or their accounts banned.
5. If any member of a squad is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their entire squad will have their tournament participation qualification revoked.

   Players

1. A player fails to sign up according to the requirements.
2. If a player is found to be, including but not limited to, using hacks or maliciously abusing game loopholes, their tournament participation qualification will be revoked and their account will be banned. Their squad will also have their participation qualification revoked.
3. If a player's account receives a ban during the course of the tournament, their participation qualification will be revoked. However, their squad may still continue the tournament.

     Signup Requirements

1． Create a house on the Tournament Server with a name that is in line with the naming conventions, and add the required information to the House Announcement.
2． The house should have between 15-20 members.
3． A squad with members that do not meet the requirements may still partake in the tournament as long as they have between 15-20 qualified members. However, the players that do not meet the requirements may not partake in the tournament.
4． House and member names on the tournament server should follow our naming conventions.

     Naming Conventions

     Squad (House)

1. The name of the house the captain creates on the Tournament Server will be used as their squad's name. This name may only contain English characters.
2. Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If so, the squad will have their participation qualification revoked.

    Players (Character)

1. Your character on the Tournament Server should be named as [Squad Abbreviation_Nickname]. You may choose any nickname you like as long as it conforms to our conventions.
2. Names may not contain derogatory or insulting content. If so, the squad will have their participation qualification revoked.

 Drafting Rules:

     Middle East Division: Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East)
     Based on results when the signups conclude, squads will gain a score based on the total season level of their top 15 Warlords.
    Squads that meet the requirements will be ranked based on their ranked level, with the top 3 being able to partake in the tournament.
     We will draft a total of 3 squads based on squad score from Sandstorm Gorge. The champion squad of the Northmen season's CBL will be invited as a seeded squad, for a total of 4 squads.

 Drafting Rules:

     All members of the squad must have a character on the Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East) server that meets the requirements.

     Please Note:

     
Squads must have a member count of between 15 and 20 to sign up successfully. Exceeding the member count of 20 will result in the squad's signup being annulled.
Duplicate signups are forbidden. Should we at the time of tallying score, find that a player has several characters on the tournament server and be part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament. Squads they are part of also may not invite a new member to take their place.
Squads may only contain members from the Sandstorm Gorge (Middle East) server. Squads with members from other servers will have their signup annulled, and may not invite new players to remedy this after verification.
No squad may alter their member roster once the signups have concluded.
Should a squad not leave any contact information (Discord/QQ) and we fail to get in contact with their squad, their signup will be annulled.
Only house squads may receive the reward of having their house name appear in a different color in the House List. 'House squads' refer to squads where all members are from the same house.
The total season level of house squads will be tallied according to players' levels as of September 6th.
The season level of all participants will be made public.


 Training Battles

    We will extract a list of squads that meet the requirements every day at 7:00 (UTC+3) while the signups are in progress (squads with 15-20 members, that meet all naming regulations, and that have made available their contact information). At 12:00 (UTC+3), we will grant the captains of these squads the ability to create rooms. Room creation passwords will be available in the Tournament Server Announcements.

notes.title: [Dynasty] War Theater System Test Notice
notes.content:
We constantly work on improving and iterating our server technology, be that making possible cross-server matching on a per-platform basis or holding the cross-region Conqueror's Blade League tournament. Step by step we expand our technology to allow for a more inclusive, interactive, and immersive gameplay experience. While developing the [Dynasty] season, we simultaneously worked on a holistic upgrade to our underlying World Map technology, the War Theater System (WTS). We have reworked our sharding system to dynamically manage and balance the backend load depending on the real state of the World Map, making it possible to accommodate all players on the same map and server. This makes it possible for Warlords to see and interact with one another in real-time.

We have during the past few tests discovered and remedied some of the WTS's issues. Thank you for your support and feedback! To enable you all to have a more stable gameplay experience, we will be starting a PTR server and continue expanding upon the new system there. Feel free to jump in and help us test this and see it before everyone else! Partaking in this and giving us feedback will be of great help to us. Besides, any Warlord participating and providing us helpful feedback will receive rewards in return! Once again, thank you for your support and help of Conqueror's Blade. With your help, we will be able to create a truly massive Conqueror's Blade.

 2 times, and defeating wandering rebels 2 times: Treatise x1.

CBL Q&A

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1f89203866e30e9dc0865cfc98d6fc09af06c2ab.jpg

	What is CBL?

CBL stands for Conqueror's Blade League, and is a global tournament hosted by the Conqueror's Blade team. By partaking in and being promoted from a division, squads are qualified to partake in CBL and fight for the championship as well as handsome rewards. In short, CBL is a tournament where everyone fights on even ground, and where the best of the best battle it out.

	How does CBL work?

CBL is made up of five divisions: Asia Pacific, China Mainland, South America, MENA, and Europe/America. A champion squad will arise from each of these.

	When is CBL generally held?

CBL is held four times each year, each time corresponding to a new Conqueror's Blade season. Generally this will be in March, June, September, and December. For the actual times check the official announcements.

	How to participate in CBL?

You must create a squad of 15-20 members and sign up for the tournament. For the Asia Division, you may enter the tournament by fighting for a place in the Selections, or by signing up based on your squad's Ranked Battle score. Your squad may join the official tournament's roster by doing either.

notes.title: Development Journal | Ranked Battle Matching & Scoring Mechanics
notes.content:
Our goal is to provide players with a reasonable and high-quality matchmaking experience. And I am sure that many of our players are curious as to how our matchmaking mechanics work. Today, we will be going through how our base matchmaking logic works from two points:

1. Ranked Battle Matching Mechanics

Our goal with matchmaking is to pair every Warlord with team members and enemies of a similar skill level to themselves. Naturally, the matchmaking algorithms work differently for solo and team matching:
Putting it simply, when you match as a solo player, our goal is to match you with team members and enemies of a similar skill level.
Things become quite a bit more complex when we're dealing with matchmaking as a team. During such matchmakings, we prioritize distributing teams of equal strength into either side to make the match more even. To ensure a great gameplay experience for solo players, matching as a team will generally pair you against stronger foes (as premades tend to have better communication and cooperation). The foes you meet will be stronger when you have more team members to match up with.

Naturally, I am sure you are all wondering how we define the 'strength/skill' of each Warlord.
Each Warlord's Ranked Battle score plays an integral part in calculating their skill, but it is far from the only factor. The algorithm also takes into consideration each Warlord's ELO score (a hidden skill score used to gauge players' relative skill). A Warlord winning several games in a row is likely more skilled than what their current rank score elicits. As they continue to win, their ELO score increases, making them more likely to be paired against stronger enemies. This serves to ensure an overall fairer gameplay experience.
In essence, the goal of our Ranked Battle matchmaking algorithms is to ensure that all Warlords in a game are matched against opponents with a similar Ranked Battle score and secondly against opponents of a similar ELO score.

I am sure that many of you have noticed that it sometimes takes a rather long time when queuing for Ranked Battles to find a match. First, this is because each Conqueror's Blade requires a fair number of participants. Our algorithms must find enough players within an acceptable time frame to start a game. And the 15v15 game modes require more participants than other matchmaking game modes. Second, our first goal is to match Warlords with team members and foes of a similar skill level. If no such players are found after a certain time, the matchmaking algorithm will expand the scope of its search. This is the reason why you are sometimes pitted against foes that are either much stronger or weaker than yourself. In essence, it is due to finding a middle ground between pairing you with foes of a similar skill level without letting you wait for too long. We will continue to improve our matchmaking algorithms and search for the sweet spot that will bring most of you the best experience possible.

2. Ranked Battle Scoring

Right, let's talk a bit about Ranked Battle scoring. Generally speaking, when a match concludes, players gain and lose score based on the following aspects:

1) Players' own Ranked Battle score

To give each player the best experience possible, our goal is for players to be matched against other players around their skill level without having to wait too long.
Thus, winning in lower ranks will net more score. But as you climb up into higher ranks, the score is increased at a slower and slower pace. This also helps to more quickly rank up high-level players that are creating new accounts to pubstomp, creating an overall more balanced ecology.

2) The average Ranked Battle score of other participants

As we mentioned before, our first goal with matchmaking is to pair players against other players of a similar Ranked Battle score. This naturally makes it so that some players of a game will have a Ranked Battle score lower than that of the game's average. However, when a player with a below-average score wins, they will earn a bigger score increase; should they lose, they will lose less score. Similarly, a player with an above-average score will gain less score from winning, and lose more from a defeat.

3) Personal performance

Each players' performance is mainly measured via Battle Rating. Players earning a higher rating score will gain a bigger Ranked Battle score upon winning a game, and lose less if they suffer defeat. This mechanic is in place to ensure there is a connection between Ranked Battle score and one's actual performance.

The above is just a bit of how Ranked Battle matchmaking works. Our algorithms for Standard Battles are quite different though. It is our goal going forward to be more transparent when it comes to matchmaking. Feel free to provide us feedback and suggestions, so that we together can improve the overall gameplay experience and create an even better Conqueror's Blade!

	Players of either side may deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.

	Flag Captures:

	Should both sides have players within the flag's range it will be contended, and neither will gain progress. Progress can only be gained by removing all enemies from the flag's radius.
	The map contains 3 flag points, A, B, and C. Once you occupy two, your enemy's base can be occupied.
	If you manage to assume control of all three flag points, the enemy's base will begin losing health. Losing a flag point will stop the enemy's base from losing health.

	Victory Conditions:

	Reduce the health of your enemy's base to 0% within the allotted time. You can do this by either capturing all three flag points or by capturing two and attacking their base.
	Should the time run out while none of the bases have dropped to 0% health, the side whose base has the most health remaining win.
	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side that has captured and held the most flag points win.

	Draw Rule

	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have captured and held an equal amount of flag points, the match is a draw.
	Draw & Extra Match Rules
	If the Field Battle is a draw, another Field Battle will be played.
	Extra Matches are all played on the Emerald River map.
	Extra matches continue with the same ruleset.
	Extra matches continue until one side wins.

 
[SECTION THREE] - Asia Play-in Rewards

Signup Rewards

If your squad successfully signs up for the CBL: Dynasty Asia Selections, you will receive the following:
Random Rare Artillery Chest x2
10-Battle Unit XP Card x1
10-Battle Hero XP Card x1
Bronze Coins x20,000

Participation Rewards

If your squad successfully signs up and partakes in the tournament (i.e., showing up when scheduled), you will receive the following:
Random Epic Artillery Chest x1
Treatise x1
Bronze Coins x20,000

Promotion Rewards

For each match your squad wins in the Play-in, you will receive the following rewards:
Random Epic Artillery Chest x1
Treatise x1
Badge of Heroism x30

	Tournament Standards

	Rematches & Pauses:
	Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament, and there will be no rematches once a game has begun.
	No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.

 
[SECTION FOUR] - Tournament Prohibitions

	Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited to use bugs or other loopholes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.

	Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a squad has violated this (including but not limited to going AFK and remaining at the spawn point), their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.

	Punctuality: All participants must listen to and cooperate with the referees, and be ready at the appointed time. If a squad fails to invite enough members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.

	Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be composed of English letters. Players should also name their characters according to the tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions, and if so, their opponent will immediately be victorious.

	Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

	Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify the squad of which the player is part of.

Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad per tournament, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. A player found to have done so will have his/her participation qualification revoked, and will be banned from all future tournaments.

The CBL Tournament is made up of five divisions: Asia, South America, MENA, EU/US, and NetEase China. A player partaking in more than one will be violating our rule for 'duplicate signups', and if discovered, he/ she will have their participation qualification revoked.

Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on August 12th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins and 300 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.

 	Resolved an issue where equipping the [Deft Fingers] Musket rune made it impossible to chain [basic attack] after using [Fine Gunpowder].
 	Resolved an issue where some roof models collided on the [Linwu Fortress] Siege map.
 Resolved an issue where one of the attackers' supply points on the [Linwu Fortress] Siege map was displayed at an incorrect position.
 	Resolved a BGM trigger issue for the defenders on the [Linwu Fortress] Siege map.
 	Resolved an issue where heroes and units could enter siege towers when pushing them forward on the [Shield of the Capital] Siege map.
 	Resolved an issue where heroes and units could enter siege ejectors when pushing them forward on the [Conqueror's City] Siege map.
 	Resolved an issue where mounted heroes would immediately be dismounted when riding near the back of a moving battering ram on the [Harbour City] Siege map.
 	Resolved an issue where the attackers had a chance to drop through the ground when spawning at the [Anliang] Territory War map.
 	The beginner main quest [In The Field]'s completion requirement has been changed to include the gathering on any resource site. Warlords who have already completed the quest may once again undertake it.
 	Resolved an issue where cross-region pathfinding didn't work properly during unit story quests.
 	Resolved an issue where the Modao Battalion would stack too densely.


II.	Changes & Improvements


 	Cross-region Migration Token may now be used to migrate to Maoyang.
 	The Town Crier NPC is now available in the Trade Colonies.
 	Made adjustments to the UI in capitals. The UI above player heads may now be blocked by models.
 	Added a change member info label to the House menu.
 	Added a feature to join a team by clicking the link on the World Channel.

	A new World Map system will be taken online with this update on the Dragonrise Island server.

notes.title: The First Auctioneers Cup
notes.content:
During the heat of summer, we're bringing you something fresh and new! The Auctioneers Cup! Be sure to tune in to our Conqueror's Blade stream on August 4th, 20:00 (UTC+8) for some Conqueror's Blade sports!

Streaming Platforms:

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/conquerorsbladedevs
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/ConquerorsBlade
Bilibili: https: //live.bilibili.com/22798299 
Douyu: https: //www.douyu.com/9574763 

Participating Squads

The contest will be played by two squads and a total of 16 contestants, including members of the Conqueror's Blade devs, as well as players.
Two squads will be pitted against one another.

Chinese Squad

A squad of 8 led by 大聪明(Biggy-smart).

English Squad

A squad of 8 led by YOYO.

Rewards:

Participation: A mount attire worth 1,580 Sovereigns.
Squad Victory: A hero attire worth 1,980 Sovereigns.
Solo Top 5: Choose one of the following attires: Black Feather Dance, Legionary, or Dead of Night.
If you already own these attires you may instead choose to receive Sovereigns or an attire of equal value.

Match:

Squad Vs. Squad

1.	Shooting
Rules:
Two contestants from each squad will compete 1 vs. 1 for two rounds.
Each player has a set amount of ammo, with the squad destroying the most artilleries winning.

2.	Horse Race
Rules:
3 contestants from each squad.
Contestants will race along a pre-defined route, and each player earns points based on their final rank.

3.	Bowling
Rules:
Four contestants from each squad will compete 4 vs. 4 for one round. The top four will gain points based on units killed.

Contestants will shoot at identical targets, gaining rank and points depending on units killed with their trebuchets.

4.	Relay Race
Rules:
Six contestants from each squad. The relay race will be played as maul heroes with the baton being an NPC. The first squad to cross the finish line wins.

Solo: Iron-man Triathlon
Rules:

1. The first to reach the destination wins.
2. Riding, climbing ladders, running.
Riding phase: Bracing units will be set up along the course.
Climbing phase: After climbing all the way up, the contestant must hit a designated target with a crossbow before progressing.
Running phase: Caltrops and speed buffs will spawn on the route every once in a while.
The first to cross the finish line wins!

Be sure to tune in to the Conqueror's Blade stream on August 4th, 20:00 (UTC+8)!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade July 22nd Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on July 22nd, which will last for 3 hours and run between 10:00-13:00 (UTC+8). (Maintenance times will be extended somewhat as we have expanded upon Siege Battles with the Dynasty season. We will be starting up the servers again as soon as the maintenance is completed.) After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins and 300 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:
 
1、	Bug Fixes & Improvements
 

 	Resolved an issue where using CC voice chat would sometimes display one's name in duplicate.
 	Resolved an issue with warpaths when a house had many members online at the same time.
 	Improved event exchange menu: a list of remaining exchangeable items will now be displayed.
 	House administrators now have a 5-minute cooldown for sending join requests to other players, stopping them from continuously sending requests to the same player.
 	When receiving multiple team-up requests from the same player, you may now choose to ignore them for a time.
 	Added the 'Only show product for this fief' option to the Market.
 	Added more interactable NPCs to Longting.
 	Resolved issues with NPC models and kit forging in Longting's Trade Colonies.
 	Added a display for remaining resources to the event menu.

 
2、	Hero Animation & Effect Changes

Pike Hero

 	Improved the animation of the pike hero skill [Soaring Cloud]'s final phase. When hitting an enemy, the attack animations full length has been reduced to 2 seconds (down from 2.6 seconds).
 	Improved the animation for [left-click] attacks when [blocking] with the pike hero.
 	Improved the special effect when gaining the [Unshakeable] buff after [Wandering Dragon]'s first retreat with the pike hero.

 
3、	Equipment Changes
 
Lowered level requirements to equip weapons/armors and for forging equipment.
	To ensure that newer Warlords can complete forging quests and equip the gear they create, we are lowering the level requirements for some weapons/armors and for having the [Smith] forge weapons/armors.
 
4、	World Map Adjustments

	A new World Map system will be taken online with this update on the Jaderock Creek server.
    Warlords in the same region but on different channels can see and interact with each other.
    To ensure that this feature's launch is as stable as possible, we will be implementing this on a single server to start with. We will be making it available to all servers once stable. Check future notices for more info.

notes.title: CBL Cross-Division Duel: Grayhair Garrison Foretaste
notes.content:
The Dynasty's glory melts the freezing snows.
CBL: Wolves of Ragnarök has been raging on, and we now have a champion for each division. With the coming of the Dynasty season, we have invited these five champion squads to partake in a CBL International Friendly Tournament. Warlords from all around the globe will be competing against one another on July 18th, 2021. For this tournament, they will be able to use the new season's units and runes!

Participating Squads
We have invited the champion squads of five divisions: South East Asia, China Mainland, South America, Middle East and, North Africa, and MY.GAMES.
Squad roster:
SEA: Crusaders(CNC)
CM: DDSH 
SA: GreyWardens(GWS)
MENA: ArabKnight(AK)
MY.GAMES: Endgegner(ED)

Time & Schedule
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/118fc5f80e9fe56845a38884da6dd77e8911f6bf.jpg

Matches are played back-to-back, and if the previous match is prolonged due to extra matches, the following match will be delayed as well.

Siege Battle

Attack/Defend Order

Randomized for match one, with the two squads switching sides for match two.

Map Rules

1.	Respawns
Each player may respawn two times per game, and dying for the third time is final.
2.	Artilleries
Only artilleries of rare quality may be used.
Each attacker may deploy two artilleries, and each defender may deploy one each.
3.	 Other Info
All hero runes of the Dynasty season may be used.
Doctrines may not be used.
Unit attires may not be used.
Every member on each team must take at least 1 Dynasty season unit into battle (Cudgel Monks or Grayhair Garrisons).

 Matches 1 & 2

Map: Heilung Fjord (Silver Era)
Special Rules
Only units from the Silver Era (3★) or lower may be used.

 Matches 3 & 4

Map: Wall Fort (Hero Duel)
Special Rules
Only units from the Heroic Era (4★) or lower may be used.

Code of Conduct
1. Rematches & Pauses:
(1) Participants are responsible for their own network connections during the tournament. The referees will confirm with both teams whether they are ready before a match begins. A match is considered as having begun once the countdown timer has begun.
(2) No pauses will be allowed after a match has begun.
(3) If 50% (round up) of a squad's members disconnect while a match is in progress, the referee will inspect the server after the match has concluded to verify whether or not a rematch is required. Both squads will be notified of the results via Discord/QQ. Only one rematch may occur for each squad due to disconnects during the same match.

2. Tournament Prohibitions:
(1) Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loopholes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
(2) Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
(3) Punctuality: All participants must listen to and cooperate with the referees, and be ready at the appointed time. If a squad fails to invite enough members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game.
(4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions appear.
(5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade July 15th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on July 15th, which will last for 3 hours (Maintenance times will be extended somewhat as we have expanded upon Siege Battles with the Dynasty season. We will be starting up the servers again as soon as the maintenance is completed) and run between 10:00-13:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
What's more, on July 19th, 12:00, equipment set attributes will be removed, as will the seasonal seals on Heroic Era units and the Grayhair Garrison unit.

The update will contain the following:

1.	Bug Fixes & Improvements


 We have resolved the issue where some Lost Chinaware couldn't be redeemed as per intended in the Glorious Gift Exchange event.

 Resolved an issue where the Nodachi hero's [Blood Oath] skill didn't reset the cooldown of [Samurai's March].

 Resolved an issue with the Nodachi hero's [Black Sun Anchorite] 2-set piece description:
It previously read 'Increases Blood Oath's damage bonus by 30%.' whereas it now reads '[Blood Oath]'s skill damage has been increased to 30% (up from 20%).'

 Resolved an issue with the third hit of poleaxe hero's [Lochaber Strike] not registering.

 Resolved an issue where the shared cooldown of the shortsword & shield hero's [Thunderstruck] and [Centurion's Battle Drill] skills differed from other skills. Their shared cooldowns are now 0.5 seconds.

 Resolved an issue where the pike hero's [basic attacks] would trigger multiple daze animations when hitting during its second phase.

 Resolved an issue where the character wouldn't turn with the camera when holding right-click with the pike hero to parry.

 Resolved an issue with the spear hero skill [Procris's Gift]'s description:
It previously read 'Extra Effect: Removes "Dazed" effect.', whereas it now reads 'Removes daze and knock down effects.

 Resolved an issue where some seasonal runes from the Northmen season were retained into this season.

 Resolved an issue where the pike rune [Weakness Insight] led to [Stormrend] being unable to chain with the 4th phase of non-victory skills.

 Resolved an issue with the cooldown reduction on the musket rune [Contraption Mastery].

 Resolved an issue where buying [Powdered Silver] from the Apothecary would similarly reduce purchasable [Powdered Silver] quantity from the Fame Treasury. We have reset the purchase limit of [Powdered Silver] to 50 at the Fame Treasury.

 Resolved an issue where the pike hero's non-victory skills shared cooldown was incorrect.

 Resolved an issue where completing 5 seasonal challenge quests in the Path of Justice of Hero's Path wouldn't count toward maul and pike hero challenges.

 Resolved an issue where Death Info couldn't be accessed on some maps.

 Resolved an issue where clicking on the selection list of multiple objects or characters on the world map at the same time would sometimes lead to the Pursuit menu showing unknown characters.

 Resolved an issue where clicking on the selection list of multiple objects or characters on the world map at the same time, and then scrolling would sometimes change the camera. 

 Resolved an issue where the video sound and BGM would overlap within the Battle Pass menu.

 Resolved an issue where mouse sensitivity couldn't be properly adjusted for the pike hero.

 Resolved an issue with mounted skills in the pike weapon tutorial.

 Resolved an issue where the regions weren't displayed for some players.

 Equipping avatars and titles now have clearer prompts.	

 Adjusted the crafting formulae for kits and artilleries in Jadylra and Wuyang within the Longting region.

 Resolved an issue where the Longting region wasn't present in the Market, and removed filters for regions that are currently closed.

 A house occupying a fort fief may now adjust resource collection privileges from within the fief Overview menu.

 Descriptions featuring 'ranged resist' have now been changed to 'reduce ranged damage taken'.

 Resolved an issue where the soundtrack wouldn't play when interacting with Haojing from the world map in the English version.

 Resolved an issue with the actions of some NPCs of Haojing.

 Resolved an issue where using the Cudgel Monks Contract would grant the unit at level 0. Warlords who have been affected by this will receive a 3-day contract as compensation with the update.


2.	Balance Changes

The glaive rune [Lethal Strikes] has had its [basic attack] damage increased to 12% (up from 10%).
Glaive rune [Great Resilience] change:

Using [God of Battles] or [Heat of Battle] reduces damage taken by 12% for 10 seconds, stacking up to 2 times.

The dual blades rune [Widen Poison]'s poison cloud effect may now only trigger 1 time every 10 seconds.

Pike Hero Balance Changes:
     
    [Right-click] attacks while mounted now do an extra 258 blunt damage.

         Adjusted the timing for chaining [Combat Dismount] with other skills.

         [Combat Dismount]'s damage has been increased to 200% basic blunt damage plus 460 points of blunt damage (up from the previous 200% basic blunt damage).

         The first leap backward of [Wandering Dragon] also grants 30% damage reduction for 3 seconds.

         The final strike of the [Wandering Dragon]'s final phase now sends enemy units flying and knocks back enemy heroes, whereas it previously only knocked back enemies hit.

         Increased the buff duration of [Gentle Steps] and [Shock Attack] by 1 second.

         Launching the final phase of a skill will no longer apply a 3-second cooldown to base skills.

         Increases the minimum shared damage coefficient when hitting multiple enemies with the same attack has been increased to 40% (up from 25%).


3.	Score Calculation Changes

Added [Unit Kill Score]. This score is affected by unit star level and squad size and affects the final score.

Added [Unit Kill Score] to the scoring menu.

4.	Donation Changes
[Enameled Leather] and [Superior Steel] can be donated to the Frontier Soldier for 1 donation value each.

5.	New CBL Champion Avatar

Added a new Northmen CBL avatar reward.
