notes.title: Season Dynasty Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/370056f53c8afa499b15265ba846d9a9867649b4.jpg
Seasonal Hero

New Weapon: Pike

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be3a83755aac5282e333cb0aa918758db0f05017.pngPike Info:

An all-new weapon will make its entrance with the new season: the pike.

Being an all-new weapon with its unique battle style and mechanics, we are sure that the pike will bring greater diversity to gameplay.

Skills:

Wandering Dragon: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9193492ec4ee6b1366d76bbcb7d544b078b3fd71.png
Press once: Roll backward 5 meters and strike forward, dealing 40% of base slashing damage plus 557 points of slashing damage knocking back any units hit. Removes daze effects.

Press twice: Swirl and retreat 6 meters and strike forward, dealing 2 times 60% of base slashing damage plus 685 points of slashing damage, while also knocking back any units hit. Removes daze effects, and increases all damage and armor penetration by 15% for 5 seconds.

Press thrice: Take hold tail of pike and leap backward, retreating 8 meters. Removes daze, knockdown, and stun effects, and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

Using skill after Victory skill: Swirl pike and attack all nearby enemies. Striking an enemy with the tip of pike deals 80% of base slashing damage plus 776 points of slashing damage, whereas the shaft deals 60% of blunt damage plus 952 points of blunt damage. Hit enemies a total of 3 times, and knock them backward.

This skill shares cooldown with other skills and can be weaved together with the phases of other skills.

Hidden Dragon: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fddb2684873fc311d4a1da150f64bca998dfed19.png
Press once: Charge forward 3 meters, stopping upon coming into contact with an enemy, dealing 80% of base piercing damage plus 428 points of piercing damage.

Press twice: Charge forward another 5 meters, stopping upon coming into contact with an enemy, dealing 105% of base piercing damage plus 539 points of piercing damage.

Press thrice: Perform 3 swift jabs, then thrust spear forward once, each attack dealing52% of base piercing damage plus 758 points of piercing damage. The final thrust deals double damage and sends enemy units flying.

Using skill after Victory skill: Charge forward 6 meters without stopping, dealing 147% of base piercing damage plus 1848 points of piercing damage. Sends enemies units flying and knocks back enemy heroes.

This skill shares cooldown with other skills, and can be weaved together with the phases of other skills.

Soaring Cloud: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c4d8c5a89982cae58ff2f2d8d59e8be48a3ded22.png
Press once: Perform a leaping attack, and when striking an enemy with the tip of pike, you deal 140% of base slashing damage plus 972 points of slashing damage, whereas the shaft deals 130% of base blunt damage plus 1051 points of blunt damage.

Press twice: Leap and strike your spear in a downward arc, dealing 175% of base blunt damage plus 1183 points of blunt damage.

Press thrice: Pound pike heavily downward, dealing 200% of base blunt damage plus 1868 points of blunt damage. Knocks back any heroes hit and knocks down any units hit.

Using skill after Victory skill: Raise pike and stab forward. If an enemy is hit, they will be lifted up and slammed down, dealing 180% of base piercing damage plus 1740 points of piercing damage.

This skill shares cooldown with other skills, and can be weaved together with the phases of other skills.

Victory Skill - Cold Dragon: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/aa216b87168fe5e3f345fe0ccc2d6b0e21bebf17.png
When used: Brandish pike and charge forward (protects against arrows aimed at front).
Press again or after charging 15 meters: Stop charging.
Deal damage a total of 6 times, each attack dealing 61% of base slashing damage plus 770 points of slashing damage.

Extra Effect: Removes daze and knock-down effects.
Extra Effect 2: Send enemy units flying and knock back enemy heroes.

Once the charge ends, press once more to use the final stage of other skills.

Victory Skill - Stormrend: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7083156932e45122080eec7939919e0c8d556635.png
Charging up drains your stamina until you release.

When released: Charge forward and pierce enemies, rushing without stopping.
- Less than 0.5 seconds charge up: Charge forward 4 meters, dealing 146% of base piercing damage plus 1848 points of piercing damage.
- More than 0.5 seconds charge up: Charge forward 6 meters, dealing 183% of base piercing damage plus 2310 points of piercing damage.
- More than one second charge up: Charge forward 8 meters, dealing 293% of base piercing damage plus 3697 points of piercing damage.

Extra Effect: Removes daze and knock down effects.

While charging, press once more to use the final phase of other skills.

Unique Mechanics

Chaining Skills:

Skills can at their various phases be chained with other skills for a certain time.

Victory Power:

Having used a Victory skill, able to release the ultimate phase of other skills for a certain time.
Hero Balance Changes

We will in this season also roll out a series of hero changes. Hopefully, these will improve upon the overall gameplay experience.

Musket:

Liquid Fire:
[Liquid Fire]'s hitbox radius has been changed to 2.5 meters (up from 2 meters).

Dual Blades:

Great Thunderbolt:
When casting [Great Thunderbolt], you now have to hold down the button while moving, with the skill being used as you release the button. Previously you had to hold down while moving and use the left mouse button to use it.

Basic Attack:
Each basic attack phase has had its damage multiplier reduced by 20%.

Glaive:

Basic Attack:
Block break of [Basic Attack] has been increased.

Arc of Steel:
Block break of [Arc of Steel] has been increased, and reduced cooldown from 20s to 16s.
Poleaxe:
Weapon Dance:
[Weapon Dance]'s hitbox has been changed to 3 meters (up from 2 meters).

Maul:

Forge of War:
[Forge of War]’s first wave(including Ground Smash I and Ground Smash II) has been adjusted to 50% of base blunt plus 428 points.
 
Season Units

Season units can be unlocked by completing their corresponding [Challenges]. Seasonal bonuses are in effect for those.

Seasonal Bonuses:

 Resupply cost is reduced by 50%.

Unit Changes

We will be changing the Ironcap Bowriders and Prefecture Pikemen units at the start of the season. During the season we will continue to change other units, including some high-tier ones.

Ironcap Bowriders:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/12926a0b872de7023989286c4321097dc49d36e5.png
1.	A new skill [Rapid March]: Greatly increases movement speed.
2.	A new skill [Double Shot]: Increases rate of fire, enabling you to shoot tons of arrows in a short amount of time.

Prefecture Pikemen:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa81574532a30358e23f35d404a9d9b882fb4984.png

2.	A new passive [Close Quarters]: Boosted their charge, and will now launch a series of attacks together following a charge. 

 
Season Map

Linwu Fortress 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/2959410043895615846
Launch Date:
Stay tuned for our official announcements as to when the Linwu Fortress goes live.

 
Level Improvements

We have reduced the chance for the smaller Lesser Greenpeak, Frontier Camp, and The Storehouse Siege Battle maps from being chosen when matchmaking.
	
Level Fixes & Improvements

1.	Resolved some known issues of the tutorial level to improve the overall experience. Changes mainly involve the following:
[olist]
 Resolved an issue where some skill cooldowns were incorrect when battling against Rupert in the weapon tutorial.
 Resolved an issue where Rupert was erroneously prompted to have died upon leaving the gates in the weapon tutorial.
 Resolved an issue where some unit change help prompts were missing from the inner-city supply point on the Augolia tutorial level.
[/olist]

2.	Improved some significant engines (including Battering Ram and Siege Tower) in certain levels. Now the moving siege engines are abale to block and knock back heroes and units – heroes will fall if they are riding.
 
Score Calculation Changes

We have noticed that not all contributions in battle are reflected in each Warlord's final score. This is why we're making the following changes to the scoring algorithm, giving an altogether better rating of performance:

1.	Increased the maximum score that can be gained for 'Damage taken' in Standard Battles. As a Warlord takes more damage in a battle, the rate at which their score is reduced is also decreased.
2.	We've also changed the MVP algorithm. MVP will now better reflect the Warlord's overall performance.

Death Info
Being unable to see how one died has been a thorn in the side for many a Warlord for some time. Fear not, this will no longer be an issue after the new season.
After dying, you may now press [T] to view your Death Info and see what killed you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e00a4fca7744b424564a5b5e763d424e722aac30.png

Equipment Crafting Changes

Attribute Changes

To improve the overall gameplay experience, we're changing attributes for crafted armors (helmets, armors, braces, and boots) in the following way:

Increased the chance of gaining multiple attributes when crafting. It will now be easier to craft equipment with crit rate, anti-crit rate, and leadership.

Hero Material Changes

In the current iteration of crafting, there are too many types of materials, and how to obtain these are too unclear and undirect. This has led to an artificial increase in difficulty for crafting equipment. So, to make the entire system easier to understand and use, smiths have further honed their craft. With the new season, Steel Plates and Steel Bars will be merged into a single item: Superior Steel. Furthermore, Paint & Lacquer, Wire & Thread, and Metal Rings will be also merged into a single item: Enameled Leather. Changes to Battle Pass System and Doctrines
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/2959410043877394576

 
Campaign Info
For this season, Campaign will be taking place in Longting, Liangyun, Maoyang, and The Borderlands. The season's core region is Maoyang. By occupying Daicheng, the region capital of Liangyun, you have a chance at attaining the title of Monarch. By occupying Anliang, the region capital of Maoyang, you have a chance at attaining the title of Hegemon. (A single player cannot earn both of these titles.)

Owing to the Qian Dynasty's forces in Longting, in that its capital, Haojing, cannot be contended for during this season.

Great Ambitions (7/8-7/25):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cf5dd61001bf890c4737e6f17e254b046797a11a.png
Available regions: Longting and Liangyun.
Longting can be chosen from the get-go, with Liangyun being accessible via border posts.

Rising in Flames (7/26-8/8):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/22ca1c9aae94b5a8f577885ea264e3a7b8fdf3c1.png
Available regions: Longting, Liangyun, and Maoyang.
Border posts between Liangyun and Maoyang, and Longting and Maoyang will open on July 26th, 12:00 (Available to get open-up information via tips at Border posts on the World Map).

The Burning Lands (8/9-8/22):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/91cd4effeb8f0ab24c090e0a346d70c3f817252c.png
Available regions: Longting, Liangyun, Maoyang, and The Borderlands.
Border posts between Liangyun and The Borderlands, and Maoyang and The Borderlands will open on August 9th, 12:00 (Available to get open-up information via tips at Border posts on the World Map).

Ode to the Chaos (8/23-9/5):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3064335a8de368a815057ca158c62a1e1eee9887.png
Available regions: Longting, Liangyun, Maoyang, and The Borderlands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0738f33e3e0a4c5fc7f1cd51b9c9f668fa854d75.png
Available regions: Longting, Liangyun, Maoyang, and The Borderlands.
Anliang (the capital of Maoyang) can be contended for.

Imperial Restorationists Changes

Auto-declaring War Against AI Fiefs:

Now, when the fiefs of AI factions are captured by Noble Houses, Imperial Restorationists of that region will automatically declare war against them.

Imperial Restorationists Time Display:

We have added a time display for when the Imperial Restorationists become available within the Imperial Restorationists menu, making it easier to see.

Penalties For Houses Leaving Alliances

Houses that leave or are kicked from an alliance will be unable to join or create another alliance for 72 hours.
 
World Map Changes

Border Posts:

1．	Removed the operation needed to enter border posts. Passing border posts can now be done from the menu.
2．	You may now check when border posts are available from its tooltip or by interacting with its menu.

Cross-region Migration Tokens:

Cross-region Migration Tokens regions will gradually become available as the season progresses. I.e., in this season's initial stages Cross-region Migration Token may be used to migrate to Liangyun and Longting. Once border posts to Maoyang open up, one can also migrate to Maoyang.

Improvements for Interaction with Stacked Units:

When interacting with units that are stacked in a tight bunch, you will open a menu where you may choose with which unit to interact.

Strategic World Map Warpaths

We will be adding strategic warpaths which should serve to somewhat alleviate the amount of communication within alliances.

These warpaths will be shown as connecting lines on the World Map, leading from alliance members to target fiefs. By watching these it will be possible to deduct the movements of other alliance members.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/06db1da83a6e35a197c8f39c682569999e40f338.png

All in all, these warpaths should make it simpler to coordinate your conquest of the land!
 
Seasonal Runes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e0e0bf33d0a43af2fde5c1c9e1e0070b125ab2cc.png
Info:

Runes are mysterious signs containing the wisdom of the gods which Viking shamans use to empower their warriors. Yet, merchants and traveling scholars soon discovered that as the people of the far east studied heaven and earth, they gained knowledge of the laws of the universe from which they garnered arcane understanding. The underlying principle of their newfound knowledge was very similar to that of the seemingly unorganized Viking runes.
They discovered the Heavenly Stems used to record the cycle of life and death, and the Earthly Branches used to record the passing of time. These they summarized into 'laws' that governed all things of heaven and earth and recorded in the forms of texts and images. Using these they could discern the reality of that which had come to pass, and of that which yet had to. They used this divination knowledge to avoid disaster and seek fortune and riches.

Today, Warlords may use this arcane knowledge to gain greater power during battle.

Runes may now also be equipped onto two new equipment slots: Hands and Boots.
All-new runes that are unlocked by ranking up your season level.
Weapon rune energy was previously capped at 6 and has been reduced to 5.
Armour rune energy was previously capped at 6 and has been reduced to 3.
 
Pike Hero Challenges

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/03d43e6fd14a6c79ae6f3081db4e1988f4a505fe.png

New Hero Challenges

1.	Pike Hero Challenges (Complete 8 out of 10 quests of each stage):
[olist]
 The first stage unlocks the Pike hero (includes 3 basic and 1 victory skill).
 The second stage unlocks its second victory skill.
 The third stage awards the weapon attire: Fatal Lotus.
 The fourth stage unlocks the hero attire: Daylight Rainbow.
 The fifth stage unlocks the Pike Hero Cartoon Avatar.
[/olist]

Pike Hero Trial

We have added a new trial map where you may try out the pike hero.
How to access: Pike Hero Challenge menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/03d43e6fd14a6c79ae6f3081db4e1988f4a505fe.png

Or: Pike Hero Specialization menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2849c27712b33d7fa2d26d36188679e7800a0112.png

Seasonal Unit Challenges

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b1601abd3c6d45ef25cb4fd2ccabe6aa36bc835b.png

New Unit Challenges

1.	Cudgel Monks (Complete 8 out of 10 quests of each stage):
[olist]
 The first stage unlocks a 3-days trial.
 The second stage unlocks the unit itself.
 The third stage unlocks a unit-exclusive rare doctrine.
 The fourth stage unlocks a chibi avatar.
[/olist]

2.	Grayhair Garrison (Complete 8 of the 10 quests of each stage):
[olist]
 The first stage unlocks a 3-days trial.
 The second stage rewards Unit Medal x120.
 The third stage unlocks the unit itself.
 The fourth stage unlocks a unit-exclusive epic doctrine.
 The fifth stage unlocks a chibi avatar.
[/olist]

3.	Modao Battalion (Complete 8 of the 10 quests of each stage):
[olist]
 The first stage unlocks a 3-days trial.
 The second stage rewards Unit Medal x120.
 The third stage unlocks the unit itself.
 The fourth stage unlocks a unit-exclusive epic doctrine.
 The fifth stage unlocks a chibi avatar.
[/olist]

Unit Challenge Improvements

1.	All season's unit challenges will have their stage completion requirements unified. You now only need to complete some of the challenges of each stage (e.g., 6 out of 8, or 8 out of 10). This removes the requirement of completing all challenges.

2.	Unit challenges for the new season will have their difficulty reduced for a limited time, and will feature two completion requirements to choose from. Yet rest assured, should you be unable to complete these in time, you will still be able to complete these quests.

3.	The reward for each stage will be increased in the new season, granting you more unit medals. This should make it easier to level up your new units.

4.	We have also improved upon how to change between different seasonal challenges. You will no longer need to access the new season's menu to check this. Having selected a season, you may activate challenges for that season within the Season Challenges menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f55f25953c020a260fd5b823a4842a829f3f96a4.png

5.	Unlocking the new units will also unlock their specific quests, which you can accept by talking to the Watchman. Cudgel Monks the Restless Mind quest, Grayhair Garrison the A Heart Divided quest, and Modao Battalion the National Loyalty. Completing their respective quests will reward you with an exclusive doctrine for that unit.


Fame System

Fame Treasury

Having earned the Fame of Qian Dynasty, you may talk to the [Frontier Soldier] NPC available in the various region capitals to access the Fame Treasury and browse its wares. (Items have fame requirements to purchase)

We've added a new series of Link equipment, with each piece having 8 leadership.
Frost Steel equipment will be removed from the Fame Treasury.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3e4354676c08253dd600f32c763f8aeb7bd0b707.png
Acquiring Fame
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/756068783ae45f591632917592724a987311cc94.png

You may earn the Fame of Qian Dynasty via the following ways:

1.	Talk to the [Frontier Soldier] NPC in any capital and provide resource support. You may do so 6 times per week.

2.	Playing Surround the Bandits (accessed via J).

Material Aid

Matchmaking and PvE battles will in the new season have a chance of rewarding [Cloth Armour Plate], [Scale Armour Plate], and [Light Armour Plate] during the season. These can be handed in to the [Frontier Soldier] in return for Qian Dynasty Fame.

Mercenary Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0a4656ec08135b5e1c867bf991a2b16fcc957709.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4b1db45c09f194402680faa531355afd64854e2f.png

During previous versions, auxiliary units were a weekly bonus that provided some manner of strength in battle. Naturally, as you gained more and more power, their relative value and use decreased. That is why we will be upgrading this feature in the new season. Our goal is to make them relevant for Warlords of all levels.

New Mercenary Mechanics:

1. Auxiliary units will have fixed levels depending on the unit's star level. 3-star units will be of level 8, 4-star of level 12, and 5-star of level 15. Once recruited, auxiliary units cannot be leveled up and all experience they gained will be added to your Shared XP Pool.

2. Auxiliary units will have pre-set doctrines and these cannot be socketed, removed, or upgraded.

3. Auxiliary units will also have pre-set veteran points and these cannot be altered.

4. All Warlords will have 600 initial auxiliary points (this is increased by 100 for premium accounts). 3-star units cost 200 points, 4-star units cost 300, and 5-star units cost 400.

5. Seven auxiliary units will be refreshed every week, including 3 3-star units, 4 2-star units, and 2 5-star units. You will be able to recruit any auxiliary unit whether you have unlocked them.

6. Seasonal units from previous seasons will also be part of the auxiliary unit rotation.

7. Auxiliary units you recruit will disappear when the following week's rotation becomes available. They will no longer be sealed like previously.

8. The requirements of hero levels for recruiting different star-rated Auxiliary units have been significantly reduced.

Sealed Auxiliary Units:

Once we roll out the new changes, Warlords with sealed auxiliary units will have these dismissed. We will be issuing compensation in the form of unit XP for this with the new season.
 
System Settings Changes

1. Added an option to shrink tooltips. You may now adjust the size of the tooltip window.
2. Added a Volumetric cloud setting under Graphics Settings.

notes.title: Dynasty Season Changes
notes.content:
The newest season, Dynasty, is soon upon us. To bring you all the best experience possible, we will be rolling out a round of optimizations and changes to various game features and units with the new season. Read on for a preview of some of these changes.

1.	Changes to Earning Doctrines

We have changed the drop rates for some doctrines to aid you all in being able to bring more powerful units into battle. With the season update, the Epic Leadership, and Epic Mobility Doctrines can now be gained from Treatises (drop chance is equal to other doctrines of the same quality).

2.	Seasonal Store:

(1) To make the following items easier to acquire, we've moved them from the Seasonal Store to Conqueror's Path (they are now obtained for free).

Choice of Weapon Schematics, Battle Relics, Gold Dust, Honour Reset Tokens, Personal History, and Unit Medals.

Starting from the Dynasty season you will now be able to obtain the aforementioned items by simply ranking up your Battle Pass. That way you will be able to spend your Badges of Heroism on seasonal attires instead.

（2）Badges of Heroism are permanent but have an upper cap of 10,000.

（3）Returning Attires

With the start of the Dynasty season, the Shaman's Ceremonial Attire Set (Sealed), Ortoq Guard's Attire (Sealed), Snow Tigers Unit Attire (Sealed), and Khanate Guard Unit Attire (Sealed) will no longer be available within the Seasonal Store.

Attires from the Blood of the Empire era will be returning to the Seasonal Store, where they will be available at a 20% [Badges of Heroism] discount. The Soldiers of Fortune season weapon attires will be taken off the shelves, while the hero and unit attires will be returned to their original prices.

3.	Equipment Crafting Changes

Attribute Changes

To improve the overall gameplay experience, we're changing attributes for crafted equipment (helmets, breastplates, gloves, and boots) in the Dynasty season in the following way:

Increased the chance of gaining multiple attributes when crafting. It will now be easier to craft equipment with crit rate, anti-crit rate, and leadership.

4.	Unit Changes

During the last few seasons, we've been rolling out a variety of unit changes, and the first two on the list during the Dynasty season are Prefecture Pikemen and Ironcap Bowriders. The Prefecture Pikemen's charge will receive a buff, while the Ironcap Bowriders will have their mobility and ability to harass buffed, along with more burst damage.

Warlords, may your battles be plenty and triumphant during the Dynasty season!
Godspeed!

notes.title: [Season Preview] A Hero is Born—Cometh the Pike
notes.content:
During the early days of the Qian Dynasty there were rumors of a famous generals who, not long after his appointment to the post, cut his hair and hid within a Buddhist monastery to throw away his pursuers.

There within he studied their mantras and practiced martials arts. He melded their quarterstaff techniques with real warfare, creating a unique spear style. Sometime later he returned to military life, earning great achievements with his skill in the pike.

[previewyoutube=rn8grRt_XOE;full][/previewyoutube]

SkillsMedium Armour

Wandering Dragon

Press once: Roll backward 5 meters and strike before you, knocking back any units hit. Removes daze, knockdown, and stun effects.

Press twice: Swirl and retreat 6 meters and strike before you, knocking back any units hit. Removes daze and knockdown effects, and increase all damage and armour penetration for a few seconds.

Press thrice: Take hold of your pike-butt and leap backward, retreating 8 meters. Clears daze, knockdown and
stun effects, and increases movement speed for a few seconds.

Using skill after Victory skill: Swirl your pike and attack all nearby enemies, knocking back any enemy hit.

This skill shares cooldown with other skills, and can be weaved together with the phases of other skills. 

Hidden Dragon

Press once: Charge forward 3 meters, stopping upon coming into contact with an enemy.

Press twice: Charge forward another 5 meters, stopping upon coming into contact with an enemy. 

Press thrice: Perform 3 swift jabs, then thrust your spear forward 1 time. The final thrust deals double damage and sends enemy units flying. 

Using skill after Victory skill: Charge forward 6 meters without stopping, knocking enemy heroes back, and sending enemy units flying.

 This skill shares cooldown with other skills, and can be weaved together with the phases of other skills. 

Soaring Cloud

Press once: Perform a leaping attack and knock back any enemy hit. 

Press twice: Leap and strike your spear in a downward arc, knocking back any enemy hit. 

Press thrice: Pound your spear heavily downward, knocking back any heroes hit, and knocking down any units hit. 

Using skill after Victory skill: Stab forward, and if you pierce an enemy, lift them up and throw them away.

This skill shares cooldown with other skills, and can be weaved together with the phases of other skills. 

Victory Skill   Cold Dragon

When used: Brandish your pike and charge forward.

Press again or after charging 15 meters: Stop charging.

Extra Effect: Removes daze and knock down effects.

Extra Effect 2: Send enemy units flying and knock back enemy heroes.

Once the charge ends, press once more to use the final stage of another skill. 

Victory Skill   Stormrend 

Charging up drains your stamina until you release: 

Charge forward and pierce enemies, rushing without stopping. 

Less than 1 second charge up: Charge forward 4 meters, dealing damage to any enemy caught in your path.

More than 1 second charge: Charge forward 6 meters, dealing damage to any enemy caught in your path.

More than 2 seconds charge: Charge forward 8 meters, dealing damage to any enemy caught in your path.

Extra Effect: Removes daze and knock down effects. 

Extra Effect 2: Send enemy units flying. 

While charging, press once more to use the final stage of another skill. 

Pike hero preorders will become available with the season preorder. Press C in game and navigate to Preorder Packs in the store to learn more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bb7c25e6a1622db45ba3cb5588401e8edbd46683.jpg

There will be two different hero preorders available for this version. The Pike Preorder Bundle for 1,280 Sovereigns, and the Deluxe Pike Preorder Bundle for 2,880 Sovereigns.

Note: Having purchased the Pike Preorder Bundle you may not purchase the Deluxe Pike Preorder Bundle. Similarly, having purchased the Deluxe Pike Preorder Bundle, you may not purchase the Pike Preorder Bundle.

Pike Preorder Bundle: Grants items to directly receive the item rewards of the first two stages of the Pike Hero Challenges (usable during the Dynasty season). Head to the challenge menu to claim your rewards: three basic and two victory skills.

Deluxe Pike Preorder Bundle: Grants items to directly receive the item rewards of all Pike Hero Challenges (usable during the Dynasty season). Head to the challenge menu to claim your rewards: three basic and two victory skills, as well as a weapon attire, hero attire, and a cartoon avatar.

notes.title: [Season Preview] The Forge Flames Run Red Hot!
notes.content:
The Dynasty season's outfit prototypes were handmade by famous Chinese caster. We also had the honour of inviting master Wen Chenhua to give an introduction to the two outfit sets of the season:

The Lord of Wrath Regalia is a colorful hauberk made by closely connected plates, which have been coated with black lacquer to prevent corrosion. For the design's borders, I took inspiration from the five colors associated with the Song Dynasty. The color contrast used here featuring red, green, and cyan was often used during the Song Dynasty for the great armours. I used a leather hardening technique for painted leather on the beast near the abdomen, creating an ornament that is both lightweight and resistant against blunt attacks. This capturing of deals within the carving is one of the treasures of traditional craft.

The Iron Fist Uniform prototype was created based on an armour donned by officers of the Song Dynasty, much like a half-plate armour. The outer parts are cloud-like and create a whole, the plates themselves polished for a silver shine. The lining is reinforced to provide better blunt protection, creating a complex structure offering great protection.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/af2f89d6229be3e07c3959d918c398b0cef2d9f4.jpg

Iron Fist Uniform

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/599ab2591e09c89b8b476e4a5da2568769aaf94d.jpg

The Iron Fist Uniform is a heavy armor created for an elite squad of infantry. While being able to shrug off blows from sharp weapons, it can also withstand the impact of heavier weaponry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6337bbb6fc0ffd1bebd040392a863768995cac91.jpg

The top of the hood features red tassels, and upon the shoulders are tigers their mouths bared open. The chestplate is further reinforced to provide greater protection than otherwise possible. Above the abdomen the face of a beast is fastened in place with leopard hide.
This heavy armor is made of solid metal and is therefore highly expensive to manufacture. Thus, only when the Qian Dynasty is prosperous will their artisans be asked to manufacture large quantities of it for their armies.

Lord of Wrath Regalia

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6a00a71eb7389ca75c23a2cdf2b2fbd42713f4c8.jpg

It is claimed that the Qian Dynasty fought the Taureans amidst the deserts of Maoyang. The two sides where at an impasse. Suddenly, a northwestern wind rolled across the land, bringing with it sand and rocks. Upon seeing this, the Qian's chief commander raises his arms high and roared: "The Heavens watch over and bless our cause, victory is at hand!" Their forces came upon the Taureans with the wind at their backs. Upon seeing their swift advance the Taureans fled in all directions, terror gripping them tight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/704d04470e7c2abf7c2873ab896f87176a2209bb.jpg

The good news spread to Haojing, and the emperor was overjoyed to say the least. He thus ordered the Warforge to create the Lord of Wrath Regalia in the image of the mythological ruler of Heaven, decorating it with priceless gold and silk. It was forged using a unique technique, endowing it with greater flexibility and protection. A golden belt passes through the beast's mouth stabilizing it, and instilling fear into the enemy.
Once finished, one set was delivered to each of Qian's armies, to be donned by their commander should war break out. Those that follow in its wake are said to howl like the storms.

notes.title: Server Transfer Rules
notes.content:
The Northmen: Wolves of Ragnarök season is coming to end and a new season is approaching. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, 
Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest.

Server Transfer Time:

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on June 24th, Thursday, 12,00 (UTC+8), and run through June 29th, Tuesday, 12:00 (UTC+8).

2、Servers will be taken down for maintenance on July 1st, Thursday, 1:00-14:00 (UTC+8) during which server transfers and weekly maintenance will be done.

Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Jaderock Creek, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:

2. There are no additional transfer restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, Sandstorm Gorge, and Espada Forest servers. There is no limit to character transfers from Jaderock Creek. Only characters created after December 21st, 0:00, 2020 are eligible for transfer.

Transfer Quotas

Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 200.
Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 200.
Lotus Ash Sea to Espada Forest: 120.
Lotus Ash Sea to Sandstorm Gorge: 80.
Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 200.
Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 200.
Dragonrise Island to Espada Forest: 120.
Dragonrise Island to Sandstorm Gorge: 80.
Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 150.
Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 150.
Jaderock Creek to Espada Forest: 80.
Jaderock Creek to Sandstorm Gorge: 50.
Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 80.
Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 80.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 80.
Espada Forest to Sandstorm Gorge: 50.
Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 50.
Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 50.
Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 50.
Sandstorm Gorge to Espada Forest: 50.
Once a server's quota has been used up, no further transfers will be available, so be sure to register your transfer as soon as possible if you wish to undergo one.

How to Transfer:

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred during the July 1st maintenance.

Important:

1. After having submitted a server transfer application, you may cancel it at any time before June 29th, 12:00 (UTC+8). Upon cancelling a transfer, your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable for this server transfer event). Though, having cancelled a transfer, you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.

2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.

3. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.

4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Your character will be removed from your House, Alliance/Imperial Restorationists. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.

5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:

1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, neither can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.

6. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

notes.title: [PREVIEW] SEASON DYNASTY RELEASING JULY 8TH!
notes.content:
The Qian Dynasty has been in power close to 500 years: it's capital, Haojing, is the starting anchor point for the Golden Road, the lifeblood of many a country and their people. The [Dynasty] season launches on July 8th!

Warlord, a golden age awaits you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/855af542c02d4f09dc5a40e3b683bf8d2083aa7a.jpg

3 ALL-NEW UNITS

The Qian Dynasty's rise and fall. As it rose to prosperity the bordering Taurean empire looked at it with coveting eyes, their decades of invasions slowly but surely eroding the desert fortresses. Yet, faced with this desperate outlook the soldiers fought bravely for their emperor and country! A slew of eastern units will make their entrance during the [Dynasty] season! Unlock these four new units by completing their challenges and lead them through the rise and fall of the Qian Dynasty!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a2e694a8dc34b649375d6699a47645ed4199d853.jpg


ALL-NEW HERO - PIKE

A new hero will become available during the Dynasty featuring unique combat mechanics. The Pike hero can be unlocked by completing season challenges.

ALL-NEW SIEGE MAP

A golden road slithers forth from Haojing, cutting through the Borderlands. Many a valuable ware is transported upon it. To ensure the safety of merchants traveling upon it, the Qian Dynasty constructed fortresses in the image of the stars above. This unique design gave their troops garrisoned there the ability to withstand bandit attack, even should they receive no further support. With the [Dynasty] season also comes an all-new Siege Battle map!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/914cf82cd071fb0c2e67577aaad85f53a4e85f8c.jpg

ALL-NEW REGION

The Longting region is situated in Guanzhong, and connects to Liangyun in the south, the Central Plains in the east, and Maoyang in the west. It is surrounded by hills and mountains, creation natural borders; while the inner terrain is as complex and intricate as a mansion; with Guanzhong being a flat land, much like the main hall. This flat area is house to the cities of Haojing, Nonetal, Qingtai, Eidolan, and Karenweil. A whole new region for you to explore becomes available with the [Dynasty] season!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/144dbe9bf6f43c0955de06fe7d3529a2243bf382.jpg
Please refer to the actual effect in the game

RUNE SYSTEM

Runes are mysterious signs containing the wisdom of the gods which Viking shamans use to empower their warriors. Yet, merchants and traveling scholars soon discovered that as the people of the far east studied heaven and earth, they gained knowledge of the laws of the universe from which they garnered arcane understanding. The underlying principle of their newfound knowledge was very similar to that of the seemingly unorganized Viking runes.
They discovered the Heavenly Stems used to record the cycle of life and death, and the Earthly Branches used to record the passing of time. These they summarized into 'laws' that governed all things of heaven and earth, and recorded in the forms of texts and images. Using these they could discern the reality of that which had come to pass, and of that which yet had to. They used this divination knowledge to avoid disaster, and seek fortune and riches.
Today, Warlords may use this arcane knowledge to gain greater power during battle.

notes.title: CBL Cross-Division Duel Rules
notes.content:
Time

June 20th, 20:00 (UTC +8).

Participants:

The Asia Division's champion and runner up squads.
The Snowstorm CBL champion and runner up squads.

Rules
Match Modes:

The Asia Division champion and runner up squads fight as one, and are up against the Snowstorm CBL champion and runner up squads. Should one squad win, both of that side's squads win (does not include forfeited battles).

Info & Victory Conditions

Each victory grants one point, and zero points are gained for draws. The first to get four points, or the side with the most points after the tournament wins.

Grouping

After the champion and runner up are crowned on June 20th, lots will be drawn to decide the schedule.
The battle is divided into Groups A and B

Group A

（a）	Match 1: Deathmatch
（b）	Matches 3 & 4: Siege Battle
（c）	Match 7: Free Battle

Group B

（a）	Match 2: Free Battle
（b）	Matches 5 & 6: Siege Battle

Matches: Further Info
Match 1

（1）	Mode: Deathmatch
（2）	Map: Cliff Duel
（3）	Win Conditions:
（a）	The first squad to 40 kills wins.
（b）	If the time runs out, the squad with the most kills wins.
（4）	Draw Condition: If both squads have an equal number of kills once the time runs out.

Match 2

（1）	Mode: Field Battle
（2）	Map: Emerald River
（3）	Sides: Randomized
（4）	Win Conditions:
（a）	Reduce the enemy's base to 0.00% health.
（b）	If the time runs out, the squad whose base has the most health remaining wins.
（c）	If the time runs out and if both bases have an equal amount of health remaining, the squad with most flags captured wins.
（5）	Draw Condition:
（a）	The two sides' bases have an equal amount of health remaining, and they've both captured an equal number of flags.

Matches 3 & 4

（1）	Mode: Siege Battle
（2）	Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
（3）	Sides & BP
（a）	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the third match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match four.
（b）	Map Ban & Pick:
The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
And then the other squad bans one map.
After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
（4）	Win Conditions: The squad that captures the enemy's flag, and manages to defend their flag for the remainder of the time wins.

Matches 5 & 6

（1）	Mode: Siege Battle
（2）	Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
（3）	Sides & BP
(a)	-Attacker/Defender Rules: For the fifth match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match six.
(b)	Map Ban & Pick:
The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
And then the other squad bans one map.
After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
（4）	Win Conditions: The squad that captures the enemy's flag, and manages to defend their flag for the remainder of the time wins.

Match 7

（1）	Mode: Field Battle
（2）	Map: Grassland Assault
（3）	Sides: Randomized
（4）	Win Conditions:
（a）	Reduce the enemy's base to 0.00% health.
（b）	If the time runs out, the squad whose base has the most health remaining wins.
（c）	If the time runs out and if both bases have an equal amount of health remaining, the squad with most flags captured wins.
（5）	Draw Condition:
（a）	The two sides' bases have an equal amount of health remaining, and they've both captured an equal number of flags.
(5) Final Victory: Should the two sides have the same score after the seventh match, an extra match will be played on Grassland Assault. Should that too end in a draw, more extra matches will be played until one side wings.


Reserve Rules

Should any of the following occur, reserve rules will be used.

Should both squads on the same side forfeit or otherwise be unable to participate:
The other two squads will immediately win.

Should one squad forfeit or otherwise be unable to participate, but their allied squad may participate:

Both sides will send one squad to participate, but the forfeiting party will not receive any rewards. Both squads on the other side will.

On the side that has not forfeited, the champion squad will be playing, but both squads are eligible for rewards.

The ruleset will instead be changed to Best of 5.

And the following rules will take effect:

Scoring: Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 3 points win. No points are awarded for draws. 

Match Rules:

- Sides & Map Ban & Pick:
- Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis

Matches 1 & 2:

For the first roll, the roll winner chooses whether to attack or defend first during match one. The sides are then switched for match two.

a. The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
b. And then the roll winner bans one map.
c. After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.

Matches 3 & 4:

For the first roll, the roll winner chooses whether to attack or defend first during match three. The sides are then switched for match four.

a. The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
b. And then the roll winner bans one map.
c. After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.

Match 5:

 Field Battle on Grassland Assault with sides being randomized. If it ends in a draw, extra matches will be played on Grassland Assault until one side wins.

Code of Conduct
Forfeit Regulations
Forfeit Rulings

1) If we are unable to contact you and confirm your squad's participation before four hours prior to the tournament, your squad will be considered to have forfeited participation.

2) If we have been unable to contact your squad before 10 minutes of match start, you will be considered to have forfeited participation.

3) Squads who ahead of time contact a referee and forfeit of their own volition will be considered to have forfeited participation.

Dealing with Forfeits

1）	A squad that forfeits before or during the tournament (i.e., the tournament has not concluded) are not eligible for any rewards, even should their side win.

2）	Should no squad forfeit their participation before the tournament begins, it will be played as Best of 7. Once it has begun, should a squad forfeit during the tournament, the tournament will still continue as Best of 7.

Pauses & Rematches

1) Participants are responsible for their own network connections during the tournament. The referees will confirm with both teams whether they are ready. A match is considered as having begun once the countdown timer has begun. There will be no rematches for disconnects or lag once a match has begun.

2) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a match within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the match, giving the win to the other squad.

3) No pauses will be allowed while a match is underway.

Tournament Prohibitions:

1) Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament. Their account on the official server will also be banned.

2) Players whose accounts are banned on the live servers may not participate in the tournament while their ban is still active.

3) Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby crowning the other squad the winner.

4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions appear, and if so, their opponent will immediately be victorious.

5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

6) Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.

7) Should a squad or member of a squad violate any regulation under 'Match Modes' or 'Ruleset', referees have the authority to rule them as being violated, and to disqualify said squad or member.

We will update the game during our maintenance on June 17th, which will last for 4 hours and run between 12:00-16:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I.	Ranked Battle Results

1.	This season's Ranked Battle concludes after the maintenance on June 17th, 2021. We will then be issuing rewards according to each players' Ranked Battle score.

	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 800 will receive the following:

 	Unit Medal x60
 	Powdered Silver x20
 	Honour x10,000
 	Treatise x3


	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,200 will receive the following:

 	Unit Medal x60
 	Epic Barding Schematic Crate x1
 	Gold Dust x30
 	Treatise x7


	All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,500 will receive the following:

 Permanent Honorary Title: Tamer of Seas
 	Ranked Battle Custom Unit Attire Selection Box x1


All of the aforementioned rewards stack, so a Warlord whose Ranked Battle score exceed 1,500 will be granted all of the rewards.

To further reward Warlords who have excelled in Ranked Battle, those of the top 25 with at least 2,100 Score and that have reached Marshal will receive the following:

The special mount banner attire: Dragon Totem Banner.
The Great Eagle Banner will be usable until the end of the next season.
The banner will be sent by mail, so keep an eye out for it should you meet the requirements.

II.	Empire's Treasury Now Available

1.	Access the Empire's Treasury menu via the O key to redeem various resources. Including Epic Hero Schematic Crates, Epic Barding Schematic Crates, Treatises, Powdered Silver, Rare Equipment Schematics, Unit Medals, Hero XP Cards, and Unit XP Cards.

The Treasury is available from June 17th, 2021, (after maintenance) until August 5th, 24:00.


III.	[Turul Város] Special Forging Bonus

1.	With this update, members of the alliance occupying Turul Város may create any unit kit and most artilleries of epic quality and lower.

IV.	Bug Fixes & Improvements

1.	Resolved an issue on Heilung Fjord where the attackers could reach the outer edge of the supply point near the defenders' base.

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade 10/6/2021
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!

There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community.

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profit from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list:

1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
5) It contains statements that violate any law.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade June 10th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Candied Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on June 10th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I.	[Dragon Boat Event] Available for a Limited Time

1.	A brand-new attire challenge: the Arbour Hermit attire challenge available for a limited time, containing the following rewards: Hero Attire: Arbour Hermit Attire Set, Unit Attire: Sylvan Murmur, Limited-time Banner: Child of Nature, and the Exclusive Hero Action: Nature's Blessing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1366c2ab3255041620b991f27365fe55e750a7a2.png

2.	A limited-time total sign-in event running from June 10th (UTC+8) through July 1st (UTC+8). Sign in during this time to receive Silver Zongzi, Gold Zongzi, Powdered Silver, Unit Medals, and more!
       Gold Zongzi——Grants random rewards among the following: Bronze Coins, Silver Coins, Treatises, Rare Artillery Components, Epic Artillery Components, Unit or Hero XP Cards, Selectable Weapon Schematics, and Random Rare Equipment Schematics.
       Silver Zongzi——Grants random rewards among the following: Bronze Coins, Silver Coins, Treatises, Uncommon/Rare/Epic Artillery Components, Scholarly Texts, Selectable Weapon Schematics, and Random Rare Equipment Schematics.
        Red Bean Zongzi——Eat this to get 100 Honour, 50 Skill Points, and 10000 Hero XP.
        Meat Zongzi——Eat this to get the following buffs lasting 3 battles: Hero XP +100% and Unit XP +100%. This effect stacks with other XP boosts.
        Candied Zongzi——Eat this to get 30,000 Shared Unit XP.

3.	Mercenary Attire Chest——The valuable Onibi Attire Chest will be for sale following the update on June 10th (UTC+8), 2021, until July 1st, 8:00 (UTC+8), 2021.

4.	The Dragon Boat Total Spendings Event will run from June 10th (UTC+8), 2021, through June 24th, 8:00 (UTC+8), 2021, during which you may spend Sovereign and earn extra rewards. You can find more details on these reward from within the [Activity] menu in-game.

5.	New bundles and military supplies in the shop are discounted for a limited time.

6.	The Northmen season also brings with it a slew of free rewards! Starting from June 10th, there will be a Permanent Kit Event running on Saturdays and Sundays. There'll also be tons of PvP and PvE content available on rotation. For more info check [Activities] -> [Weekly Activities] in-game.

II.	Bug Fixes & Improvements

1.	Resolved an issue where the capture radius of A differed on [Harbour City] between tournaments and Ranked Battle mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/37992ea98cb43c5d12e7a1c541d0bb6bf63e7863.png
 
2.	Resolved an issue where the attackers' berserker reinforcements would get stuck on the Siege Ejector on the [Heilung Fjord] map.

3.	Equipment can no longer be changed after there is only 3 seconds remaining on the matching countdown.

4.	Resolved an issue with the left-side of the Achievements menu when scrolling.

III. New Avatar
1. The new Northern Lance Cavalry Cartoon Avatar——To apologize for our recent sudden change to the Northern Lance Cavalry, we will create a new Northern Lance Cavalry Cartoon Avatar before the June 10th update, which we will be gifting to all Warlords above level 20.
(This avatar will be added as a reward for the Northern Lance Cavalry challenges at the start of season 7)

notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on June 3rd, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I.	Events & Tournament

1.	[Dragon Boat Event Preview!] We are on June 10th starting a Dragon Boat event, and sends you our well wishes! A brand-new attire challenge is also available for a limited-time. Warlord, may the winds of war favor you!

2.	[The Mightiest Warlords Gather!] The CBL is finally upon us and many an exciting battle will ensue! Hit F7 in-game to check out the latest information and new updates.

II.	Bug Fixes & Improvements

1.	Resolved an issue where players could get stuck in a specific place on the [Hidden City] map.

notes.title: [Conqueror's Blade] Violation Penalties
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade is run for the sake of players, and we work hard on creating a fair and just game environment. We have zero-tolerance toward those that break our regulations and will crack down upon any such behavior to maintain a healthy game environment!

Common violations mainly include, but are not limited to, the following:

Chat Violations
		
Minor Violations
								

 24-hour mute——For a first minor chat violation (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), abusive language, spam, etc.
 72-hour mute——For a second minor chat violation (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), abusive language, spam, etc.
 7-day mute——For a third minor chat violation (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), abusive language, spam, etc.
 30-day mute——Multiple minor chat violations (those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.), or if a single player violates this on multiple characters.


Severe Violations


 7-day ban	——For a first severe chat violation (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
 30-day ban——For a second severe chat violation (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.). This includes violations of the same player on multiple characters.	
 10-year ban——For multiple severe chat violations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.). This includes violations of the same player on multiple characters.	
	
						

Nickname Violations

Minor Violations	
							
Forced name change——Nicknames that violate our regulations (minor naming violations: those not including racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services.).

Severe Violations


 7-day ban and forced name change——The first nickname of that player that severely violates our regulations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
 30-day ban and forced name change——The second nickname of that player that severely violates our regulations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).
 10-year ban and forced name change——Multiple nicknames of that player that severely violate our regulations (racial discrimination, improper remarks related to nations, improper sales, comments on hacks, leveling services).

									
Using Hacks		
							
[olist]
 30-day soft ban	——Having been found to have used hacks 1 time.

 Permanent ban——Having been found to have used hacks 2 times or more, or to have caused adverse effects.	
[/olist]			
						
						
Obstructive Conduct											
[olist]
(Minor) suspension time: Restricted from playing matched battles for 2 hours——Being reported several times within 30 days and being deemed responsible of obstructive conduct for the first time.

(Medium) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an A+ rating——Being reported several times within 30 days and being deemed responsible of obstructive conduct 2 times.

(Serious) suspension time: Character will be unable to partake in other modes, and must first complete 10 Training Camp (AI) matches with an S rating——Being reported several times within 30 days and being deemed responsible of obstructive conduct 3 times.

7-day soft ban	——Being deemed responsible of obstructive conduct 4 times within a 45-day period.
	
 30-day soft ban——Being deemed responsible of obstructive conduct 5 times within a 60-day period.
[/olist]	

Improper Trading
[olist]
  Topping up using any non-official channel, or obtaining sovereigns in any way that violates our regulations.
  Being suspect of fraudulent trading.
[/olist]
Those deemed responsible for any of the above may have their accounts banned and will be required to top-up to make up for the disparity.

	

Penalty	Information			
Mute——Being unable to send chat messages.	
			
Soft ban	——While a soft ban is in effect on someone's account, their qualification to partake in tournaments is also revoked. 

Forced name change——	The character will be forced to change their name.	

(Minor) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in most game modes and must remain online for their penalty to degrade.	
	
(Medium) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in most game modes and must complete a certain number of Training Camp (AI) games with a rating of A+.

(Serious) suspension time——The character will not be able to partake in most game modes and must complete a certain number of Training Camp (AI) games with a rating of S.	

(In special situation, we reserve the right to adjust violation regulations and to apply stricter penalties when we deem required)
      
   We will work together with the community to monitor and crack down upon the violations elicited above. For serious offenses, we reserve the right to pursue criminal responsibility through legal means.
Should you encounter anyone violating any of the above while playing the game, kindly Report them or contact us via our communities in a timely manner so that we may deal with any violation as soon as possible.

Once again, thank you everyone so much for your support. We believe we can create a healthy game environment if we work hard to solve these issues together!

notes.title: CBL: Wolves of Ragnarök South America Division Qualifying Roster Updated
notes.content:
Conqueror's Blade League (CBL) is currently the largest Conqueror's Blade tournament being held and is followed by many a Warlord. We are incredibly thankful for all of your support, and we want to provide the best tournament experience we can. The tournament is very important to us, which is why, upon receiving signup feedback from the South America Division, we started a discussion among ourselves. We have realized a few issues and would like to explain them to everyone. We apologize deeply for the problems these issues have caused.

Signup Info

Seeing as the game environment and ecology differs among the divisions, we adopted different signup standards for the Asia, South America, and the MENA divisions. For Asia, squads are ordered and qualified based on their Ranked Battle score, whereas qualifications on South America and MENA are based on Season Level (you can find the exact rules in the related announcements). While the signup qualification standards may differ, all other signup rules remain the same for all divisions.

So, why do we require all squad names to be in only English letters?

The reason for this is because CBL is an international tournament. The audience comes from all across the globe, and naturally speak a variety of languages, and the same goes for many of the contestants. So we adopted an international practice of e-sports, to have English as the official CBL tournament language, and thusly request that all squads have English names. In addition, English is also the main language of all official tournament streams so that it may be enjoyed by a wider audience, so that as many as possible may watch and enjoy CBL, and so that they may learn about the squads partaking.
Though at the same time, we also wish for squads and contestants to be able to express a wide variety of cultures in the tournament. Which is why we for this tournament are planning on having interviews with squads. Interviews in which they can express their unique culture of their squads and let the whole world know more about them.

Mistakes we have made while organizing the tournament

During the South America Division signups, we made the following mistakes:
[olist]
 We granted training rights to squads that did not fully meet the signup requirements.

 We received squad name change requests prior to the signups concluding, and failed to respond in a timely manner.

 While announcing the tournament roster, a mistake on our part led to illegible squads being added to the roster.
[/olist]

We are truly sorry for any inconvenience our mistakes have caused all of the involved squads. For the sake of tournament fairness, and to adhere to the signup rules, we will handle this time's signup in the following way:


 Squad SKÖL did not use a name wholly of English letters and their signup is thus invalid.

 Squad DEATH did not provide the required contact information and their signup is thus invalid.

 We sent an in-game mail to all tournament contestants, including squad captains, at 19:35 (UTC+8) May 26th reminding everyone to verify whether their squad name meet the requirements. Following our notification, the squad MISERÁVEIS sent a request to our customer service email at 20:39 (UTC+8) on the same day, requesting that we change their name to MISERABLE. As MISERÁVEIS made this request prior to the signups concluding, their registration remains valid and will be joining the South America Division as MISERABLE.

What we can do is to carry out the tournament to the best of our ability, to continue optimizing tournament rules and the tournament at large, to do our best to avoid anything similar from happening in the future. Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/conquerorsbladedevs 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/ConquerorsBlade

General Tournament Rules
-Preheat Match
-Map: Cliff Duel
-Map Rules:
1.	Mode: Deathmatch
2.	Attack/Defend Order: Random
3.	Contestants: 15 per squad
4.	Victory Conditions:
(1) The first squad to 40 kills win.
(2) Should no squad reach 40 kills before the time runs out, the squad with most kills win.
(3) Should both squads have an equal number of kills when the time runs out, the match is a tie.

-Siege Battle
-Attack/Defend Order
-If a squad wins the Deathmatch
The winner chooses whether they start as the attackers or defenders for the first match, and the two squads change sides for each subsequent match.
-If the Deathmatch ends in a tie
Who starts at the attackers in the first match is random, and the two squads change sides for each subsequent match.

-Map Rules:
-Artilleries
Only artilleries of rare quality may be used.
Each attacker may deploy two artilleries, and each defender may deploy one each.
-Matches 1 & 2
Map: Wall Fort (Hero Duel)
-Special Rules
Only units from the Heroic Era (T4) or lower may be used.
-Matches 3 & 4
Map: Augolia
-No special rules.

Important Update: Palace Guards Changes

1. Shield Charge has had its cooldown reduced to 45 seconds (down from 60).

2. A new skill: [Hold Position].

The Palace Guards squat down and assume defensive position, reducing the charge damage they take from the front, and becoming immune to crowd control effects for 5 seconds.
Their attacks while in defensive position increase the damage enemies take from the Palace Guards' other skills.

While in defensive position the Palace Guards gain access to the [Shield Advance] skill: The Palace Guards gain a quick boost to their movement speed and they move toward the enemy and knocking them back with their shields.

FAQ:

What is CBL?
CBL stands for Conqueror's Blade League, and is a global tournament hosted by the Conqueror's Blade team. By partaking in and being promoted from a division squads are qualified to partake in CBL and fight for the championship as well as handsome rewards. In short, CBL is a tournament where everyone fights on even ground, and where the best of the best battle it out.

How does CBL work?
CBL is made up of five divisions: Asia Pacific, China Mainland, South America, MENA, and Europe/America. Among these, the champion and runner up squads of Asia Pacific and China Mainland will contend in for the cross-division championship. The champion squads of all divisions will in the end content for the greatest glory in the Global Tournament.

When is CBL generally held?
CBL is held four times each year, each time corresponding to a new Conqueror's Blade season. Generally this will be in March, June, September, and December. For the actual times check the official announcements.

notes.title: Developer's Log - Ongoing adjustments regarding the Units
notes.content:
Dear Warlord,

We of the Conqueror's Blade's operation team receive tons of valuable feedback and suggestions from you, our players! For example, balance issues, and the fact that there are currently too few viable units, etc.

First, there have been a core issue which has had wide-spread consequences: Units that are currently underperforming haven't been able to find a role on the field of battle that fits their niche, and have thus not really worked very well.

This in turn has led to a series of issues, for example:

1.	While there are a whole range of units to choose from, only a handful are actually used.
2.	When faced with huge armies of cavalry there has been nothing for it but to follow suit.
3.	Beginners find themselves hard pressed to stand toe to toe with old-time players.

Starting with this season, we have resolved ourself to slowly but surely make changes to the near 50 weak units with outdated mechanics and an unclear role on the field of battle. This will in essence serve to resolve some balance issues, and will create a more varied and fun gameplay experience.

Naturally, having said as much I'm sure you're all dying to know about the first unit to receive such changes. Though, I'd also wager that some of you have felt some of the changes already.

Spot on, the first one on the design table have been the Ironcap Swordsmen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/39380afb230749b54bdeda473e95aecfae0af07f.jpg

This unit felt great to use and had quite excellent damage during the game's early stages, but as the game developed this low-star unit has lost much of its charm and enjoyment. What awaited them when standing against 4 and 5-star units was nothing more than avoiding the butcher's cleaver. Even if they struck from the perfect angle at the perfect moment, the outcome would certainly end in certain death.    
 
Either way, it has been our goal for the unit to be able to find its place in any type of battle. Naturally, this posed an issue for us.

Would it suffice to simply increase their armour penetration and damage?

The answer is of course, no. Doing so would simply break the balance when they would be pitted against other low-star units.

And so we instead began thinking more in line of their AoE charge. By instead increasing the damage capabilities of their AOE charge, we can emphasis how the soldiers cooperate with one another, a feature for this unit. Having seen to that their damage was more in line with what is expected, we continued by granting them Iron Recall, a new skill enabling them to quickly return to the hero, ensuring that they felt better to use. In essence, one can now use them in a better sequence: charge-recall-charge, a more streamlined experience in all.

Oh, and I'll give you a small tip! Its power really shines if you say have three to five full troops of Ironcap Swordsmen charging as one.

Though, there is also another issue in the current iteration of the game, and that is that the combined charges of units such as the Ironcap Swordsmen are overly potent against heroes. Leading to that some professions having fairly low survivability over all. But worry not, we will be resolving this issue before long.

We believe your enjoyment in game and the gameplay at large to be incredibly important, and so adjusting weak units is for us a long-term project. We will continue improving upon the underpowered units in different areas, including pure stats, AI, feel of using them, skills, unique features, etc. We will also be making minor adjustments for some issues in our weekly updates. Oh, and I'll let you in on another secret: the new unit to be changed will be highlighted in the May 27th update. Warlord, do you think you can guess which unit that'll be?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a749d608622f49a232ae03453e99cbe5f4cb10fb.jpg

We have also noticed a lot of discussion and feedback from our warlords about the recent adjustments to the Northern Lance Cavalry, and we will continue to collect these comments and make adjustments in conjunction with the data.

Finally, we sincerely invite and welcome all of you Warlords out there to provide us with more valuable feedback and suggestions. If you wish to share your thoughts simply send us an email to: cb_support@boomingtech.com     

We're looking forward to hearing from you, and once again, thank you so much for your continued support of Conqueror's Blade!




                                                  Conqueror's Blade Dev Team
