notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League Rules
notes.content:
Tournament Version & Client
Tournament Version: Official Version
Client: Steam/Official Website Client
Server: Tournament Servers
1)	Players of Lotus Ash Sea (LA)/Dragonrise Island (DI)/Jaderock Creek (JC) should join the AP Tournament Server to create your character and house.
2)	Espada Forest (EF): Please enter the SA Tournament Server to create your character and house.
3)	Sandstorm Gorge (SG): Please enter the MN Tournament Server to create your character and house.
Note: Players with a character of level 100+ on the LA, DI, JC, SG, and EF servers may enter the tournament servers.

Tournament Accounts
Fairness Measures, Doctrines Are Disabled, Runes Are Disabled, Artillery Restrictions

 The accounts of all contestants will have the same equipment and unit configurations.
 No unit will be able to use doctrines during the tournament.
 Heroes may not use runes during the tournament.
 Contestants may only use artilleries of rare quality, and there will be a limit to the number of artilleries each player may use depending on the mode being played.

Match Modes
Siege Battles
1)	Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, 	Heilung Fjord, Augolia, Continopolis
2)	Attack/Defend Order: Refer to Ban & Pick under the 'Ruleset' further on in the document.
3)	Siege Battle Rules:
[olist]
 15 players on each squad.
 Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
 Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
 Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
 Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
[/olist]
4)	Victory Conditions:
[olist]
 The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
 The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.
[/olist]
Field Battle, Capture the Flag
1)	Map Pool: Grassland Assault
2)	Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
3)	Field Battle Rules:
[olist]
 15 players on each side.
 Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
 Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
 Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
[/olist]

4)	Victory Conditions:
[olist]
 Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
 Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
 Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
 Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
[/olist]
5)	Draw & Extra Match Rules:
[olist]
 Played on Grassland Assault.
 The two squads switch side.
 Victory conditions remain unchanged.
 Should the extra match result in a draw, further extra matches will be played until one side wins.
[/olist]


Ruleset
Division & Cross-Division Matches
Ruleset: Best of 3
The two squads' captains roll.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
[olist]
 The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
 And then the other squad bans one map.
 After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
[/olist]
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.

Division Finals & Cross-Division Finals
Ruleset: Best of 7
Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort, Heilung Fjord, Augolia, White Elk Fort
-	The squad from the Winner's Bracket starts with 1 point, meaning that the score starts at 1:0 when the finals begin.
-  Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick
-  The first two matches are played on Heilung Fjord.
-  For the third and fourth matches, the pool is as follows.
Map Pool: Harbour City, Valley Fortress, Wall Fort,	Heilung Fjord, Augolia, White Elk Fort
[olist]
 The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
 Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
 After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
[/olist]
-  For the fifth and sixth matches:
[olist]
 The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
 Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
 After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
[/olist]
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads play Siege Battles against each other in accordance to the attack/defend order on the maps selected.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 4 points win.

Code of Conduct
Forfeit Regulations
Forfeit Rulings
1）	If, after 24 hours has passed after the drawing ceremony, we are unable to contact you and confirm your squad's participation, your squad will be considered to have forfeited participation.

2）	If we have been unable to contact your squad before 10 minutes of match start, you will be considered to have forfeited participation.

3) Squads who ahead of time contact a referee and forfeit of their own volition will be considered to have forfeited participation.

Dealing with Forfeits
1) Should a squad forfeit, no other squad will take their place, and their opponent will be considered victorious and therefore promoted.

Rematches & Pauses:
1)	Participants are responsible for their own network connections during the tournament. The referees will confirm with both teams whether they are ready. A match is considered as having begun once the countdown timer has begun. There will be no rematches for disconnects or lag once a match has begun.

2)	Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a match within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.

3)	No pauses will be allowed while a match is underway.

Tournament Prohibitions:
1)	Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament. Their account on the official server will also be banned.

2)	Players whose accounts are banned on the live servers may not participate in the tournament while their ban is still active.

3)	Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.

4)	Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Referees may declare a loss for any squad in which a name that violates the conventions appear, and if so, their opponent will immediately be victorious.

5)	Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

6)	Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of, and we may prosecute for related responsibly.

7)	Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.

8) Should a squad or member of a squad violate any regulation under 'Match Modes' or 'Ruleset', referees have the authority to rule them as being violated, and to disqualify said squad or member.

The Fire Lance Cavalry were too strong in their current iteration, especially their high burst damage with Valour. This burst damage made it incredibly difficult for most units to face them. To remedy this we've slightly reduced the burst damage capabilities of their skills, and to offset this change, we've increased the damage somewhat.
We've reduced the target cap of the Northern Lance Cavalry's Landslide and Valour skills, and increased the blunt armour penetration of Landslide by 15% and blunt damage by 10%.
As we make adjustments to units we will also be issuing doctrine removal items so that you may easily adjust your units accordingly. 

VI. Bug Fixes & Improvements
1. Resolved an issue where the Block wouldn't be counted first when the Condottieri Guards were attacked after having used Charge.

2. Resolved an issue where Fenrir's Pack moved oddly having been summoned at a supply point.

3. Resolved an issue where the skill positioning of Ironcap Swordsmen would change after interacting with a supply point.

4. Improved upon the logic of the Ironcap Swordsmen's Iron Recall, making them quickly respond to orders under certain situations.

5. Ironcap Swordsmen's Iron Recall will grant them increased movement speed until they return to the hero.

6.	Resolved an issue where Market orders (or resource piles from cancelled sales) had a chance to not belong to a city.

7.	Resolved an issue where the exchange menu accessed by right-clicking some items would be blank.

8.	Resolved an issue where when a player leaving a group from the World Map, they were still shown as being in the group in the Group Search menu.

9.	Resolved an issue where Field Camps built by Legions didn't have a Legion emblem.

10.	 Resolved an issue where a map search would sometimes display two cities with the same name.

11.	Resolved an issue where, after completing unit challenges of previous seasons, unclaimed rewards could sometimes not be claimed once a new season had begun as the difficulty had increased.

12.	Resolved an issue where opening the Message Board of a city would sometimes lead to actions not being registered by the game.

13.	Improved upon the usage logic of the Shared Unit XP Pool.

14.	Resolved an issue with the number of fiefs the Imperial Restorationists declared war against.

15.	We have noticed that the attackers have a difficult time in Siege Battles to push siege towers to the defenders' walls. To time and again push your towers toward the walls detract from the overall gameplay experience, and makes it less fun to act as the attackers. As such, we have increased the health of all Siege Towers to 111,500 (up from 82,500).

16.	We resolved the issue with Sigrun's Shieldmaidens increasing defence while in basic formation in a fix on April 29th.

17.	Resolved an issue where negative digits would sometimes appear in the countdown for [Hold the Line] in Expedition.

CBL Q&A

In short, CBL is a tournament where everyone fights on even ground, and where the best of the best battle it out.
How does CBL work?
CBL is made up of five divisions: Asia Pacific, China Mainland, South America, MENA, and Europe/America. Among these, the champion and runner up squads of Asia Pacific and China Mainland will contend in for the cross-division championship. The champion squads of all divisions will in the end content for the greatest glory in the Global Tournament.
When is CBL generally held?

Lotus Ash Sea (LA)/Dragonrise Island (DI)/Jaderock Creek (JC): Please enter the AP Tournament Server to create your character and house.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade 13th May Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on May 13th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I、	Unit Balance Changes & Improvements
1.	Fenrir's Pack:
(1) No longer deals damage to [artilleries].
(2) After using [Wolf Leap], they now take 80% reduced damage as they leave the ground.
2.	Ironcap Swordsmen:
The Ironcap Swordsmen's specialty has not felt very prominent and they have been lacking in ability against heavily armored units, and so we have adjusted their skills somewhat to remedy this. We will also continue making changes to units that are currently too weak.

(1) [Charge] has been replaced with [Force Charge], and every 3rd unit of Ironcap Swordsmen that hits an enemy during their charge deal a large amount of extra armour penetration damage.

(2) Added a new skill: [Iron Recall]. The Ironcap Swordsmen immediately returns to the hero, and gain increased movement speed for 5 seconds if far away.

II、	Event Map Fixes & Improvements
1.	Resolved an issue where it was possible to jump onto the roof of some buildings on the [Heilung Fjord] and [Hold the Line] maps.

2.	Adjusted the flag position of A on Harbour City, so that it is now more or less in the middle of the wall.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e350300a06bad4cb98a87cf1598125fdc9563a1e.png 

III、	System Improvements
1.	Previous event materials (War Intel, Striped Candy Cane, Festival Token, Kite, Smith Hammer, Glutinous Rice, Summer Medal, Hero Souldust, Golden Era Badge, Mooncake Mold, Feather Cotton, War Report, Festival Window Decoration, Sword Fragment) will be converted into Bronze Coins, the resulting currency being sent by mail.

IV、	Bug Fixes
1.	Resolved an issue where units couldn't be healed in Dreiwaelder while on the world map.

2.	Resolved an issue where points on unit nodes would sometimes disappear.

3.	Resolved an issue with the prompt when sending a house invite request to offline players.

notes.title: Recruiting Conqueror's Blade Historians/Diplomats
notes.content:
Warlords, we of Conqueror's Blade are on our official platforms establishing a War Council and Diplomatic Quarter! Are you eager to share tips and tricks with your fellow players? Or do you wish to grant your house more exposure? Do you wish to receive a boatload of freebies...err, draft articles and earn sovereigns and unique titles? If so, join the War Council or Diplomatic Quarter and work together with Biggy-smart. We are currently recruiting historians for Territory War and house diplomats! The rewards are handsome indeed. The number of posts is limited, so first come first served!


Recruiting Territory War Historians

While Territory War only takes place two times per week, just thinking about the battles makes my blood boil! What's more, after each one, both houses and alliances emerge and fall, and territories change hands. Some of you are bound to ask the question: what actually happens in each Territory War? Fret not! Starting now, we are officially establishing a War Council and are currently recruiting historians! Bring you brush and your ink, and join Conqueror's Blade!

Available Positions:
We are looking for 5 Territory War historians: one each for the DI, LA, JC, EF, and SG servers.

Requirements:
1、Veteran Territory War player. Having previously written Territory War reports is a plus.
2、We currently only accept entries in English.
3. Each report should cover Territory War on the whole server and include game analysis.
4. Reports should not include the country of a house but instead use only their house name. Reports should also be objective and not contain discriminatory language.
5. Draft one to two reports per week containing a mixture of images and text. Reports should contain information on the various factions. Reports will be published on the next day on our official platforms.

Historian Remuneration:
1. To be sent in increments which increase with the number of submitted reports.
Each article that pass screening will be rewarded with 300-500 Sovereigns.
2. Will upon having established a long-term cooperation be awarded a unique in-game title.

How to Sign Up:
Send submission to our email: cb_event@boominggames.com

When registering, kindly include a screenshot of your in-game ID and level + past creations + contact method (including Discord ID).





Recruiting Alliance Diplomats

Is your house a force to be reckoned with, yet unknown to many? Is it your house's ambition to rise above the rest, yet you have no place to express your will? Fret not! We are on our official platforms establishing the Diplomatic Quarter, a place where houses from all servers may meet up! The Diplomatic Quarter are currently inviting Warlords to draft a diplomatic notice for your house!

Requirements:
1. Each house may publish a notice of up to 280 characters, and may include Territory War recruitment, declarations of war, announcements, recruitment, and more.
2. One to two times per week, 5-10 diplomatic notices of different languages and content will be selected and published on our official platforms.
3. Notices may not include insulting, discriminatory, nor provocative content.
4. Diplomatic notices directly represents a house's image and reputation, so be sure to screen what the content.

Diplomat Remuneration:
1. Diplomats will be rewarded with in-game items at a monthly basis. Should there be any change kindly contact a chat group admin.
2. Houses whose content is selected multiple times in a month may receive a gift code for 10 players.

How to Sign Up:
Sign up by sending us an email to: cb_event@boominggames.com

When signing up, kindly include your house name + liege contact information + related house information.

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on April 4, 2021
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community.

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profit from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list:

1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;

notes.title: Claiming Twitch Drops Rewards & Unlinking Accounts
notes.content:
We are incredibly happy to see that you have been enjoying Twitch Drops. But it has also come to our attention that some of you have linked accounts to the wrong Twitch or Conqueror's Blade account (if you are playing via Steam you must use quick login to be able to link with the correct character). This has led to some issues with claiming Drops rewards. We are terribly sorry for any inconvenience caused.
To avoid such issues we have added the ability to unlink your Twitch account our website accessed via the Twitch Connection menu. Should you need to, navigate to URL[https://www.conquerorsblade.com/activity/twitch] after reading this guide to unlink accounts.

1. Claiming Private Warehouse Rewards
To avoid Warlords claiming Twitch Drops to the wrong Private Warehouse, we have to the warehouse added a new step to claim items.

You can claim them at [https://www.conquerorsblade.com/account/depot/]

 First, head on to Twitch and press Claim to get your rewards, then head to your Private Warehouse 

and press Get Rewards.
Doing so will transfer your claimed Twitch rewards to your Private Warehouse. This action is final and rewards you have claimed to your Private Warehouse cannot be transferred. So please ensure that your Twitch account is linked with your character of choice before claiming any rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ebe4531c5c3f22aad2b9727c28bdbb663a66a6ed.png
*Once you have ascertained that the linked accounts are correct, you can tick in the 'Auto-claim Rewards' options. After which future rewards you claim on your Twitch account will be automatically sent to your Private Warehouse within 5-10 min after claiming them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/97b9e6ba537bfd1f706c13ec8add34ccf8686467.png
2. Unlinking Accounts
   If you have linked the wrong Twitch or Conqueror's Blade account, follow these steps to unlink them:

 Log in on our website
Be sure to choose the same method of logging in as you commonly use. I.e., if you play on Steam, log in with Steam quick login.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/925a221902c00617141b55803d4b72c037a0cb41.png

 Choose Twitch in the account menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fc46ab0d2b57a1ea8fc35c2be2b63d877b0a3e9d.png

 Unlink your Twitch account.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7f1ec3fedb509b42dede76721b7065e23e284a28.png

 Head on over to Twitch and unlink.
Do so by navigating to Twitch Settings -> Connections -> Other connections, and unlink Conqueror's Blade.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2f9a6ca79273f2e4ff4d148d879d46e457ed5a0a.png

3. Linking Accounts
You can link your accounts on [https://www.conquerorsblade.com/activity/twitch]

After this update you might encounter the following problems when linking accounts:

 Failure to link, with a prompt saying that the Twitch account is already link with another Conqueror's Blade account.
Check the 'Unlinking Accounts' part for how to do so.

 Failing to link, with a prompt eliciting another problem.
If so, please provide us with as much information as possible and contact us on cb_support@boomingtech.com, or contact Soldier Melon, a customer support in our official Discord channel. Kindly provide us with your Twitch account, Conqueror's Blade account, SteamID, a screenshot of the error message, and any other information you deem relevant, and our customer support will do their best to help you.

Thank you Warlords for your continued support. We will continue working hard on bringing you even better Twitch Drops events in the future!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade 29th April Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on April 29th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. Please note, there will be no maintenance on May 6th.
The update will contain the following: 

I、	Holiday Revelry!! May Day Bonus Event
1.	"Heaven leads us true, charge!"——Winged Hussars Attire on limited-time sale!
 Warlord, you may buy the attire pack from within the event menu or from the Store.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/58cb9a0b010135163bbaa13a8cf45a3a9ff771ff.png 
2.	Daily sign-in bonuses aplenty!
Log in daily between May 1st and May 14th for special May Day bonuses, including Treatises, Rare Equipment/Weapon Schematics Selection Boxes, and more free gifts!

3.	Tons of Daily Rewards: May Day Quests
Talk to the Warden and receive daily and weekly quests, which when completed grant Bronze Coins, Honour, Warden's Caissons and more.

4.	May Day Event Item Drop Event
Play Siege/Field/Free Battles during the event for a chance to get Sword Fragments and Simple Preparation Packs. Sword Fragments can be redeemed for Rare Equipment/Weapon Schematics Selection Boxes, Treatises, and Unit Medals. Simple Preparation Packs contain Bronze Coin, Silver Coins and have a chance to grant rare/epic artillery components and more.

5.	May 1st Gifts + Permanent Kit Event

 A Permanent Kit Event will run from May 1st, 0:00 through May 5th, 24:00.
 Log in on May 1st for tons of holiday rewards, including Bronze Coin x10,000, Treatise x1, Rare Artillery Selection Box x1, and Sword Fragment x3.


II、	Hero Skill Fixes
1.	Resolved an issue with the nodachi hero skill [Monstrous Blade]'s description:
[Monstrous Blade II]: "Each hit on an enemy transfers 10% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health" (was 5%).
[Monstrous Blade III]: "Each hit on an enemy transfers 15% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health" (was 5%).

2.	Resolved an issue where the bola held in short bow heroes' hands would sometimes disappear when using the [Throw Bola] skill.

III、	Unit Fixes & Improvements
1.	Resolved an issue where Northern Lance Cavalry would stop attacking after using the Valour skill in close quarters.

2.	Bows and firearms no longer deal damage to [artilleries] and [breakable walls].

IV、	Event Map Fixes & Improvements
1.	Improved the layout around B on the Grassland Assault map by reducing the coverage of artillery fire to raise the survivability of those at the red respawn point.

V、	System Improvements
1.	To resolve the issue of having to hoard tokens of previous seasons (Conquest Tokens, Attire Tokens, Fangs, Blood of the Empire Coin Of Conqueror, Legacy of Fire Coin Of Conqueror, Legacy of Fire Sealed Conquest Token, and Snowstorm Coin Of Conqueror) will be converted into Bronze Coins, the resulting currency being sent by mail.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade April 22th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on April 22nd, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following:

I、	Hero Skill Fixes
1.	Resolved an issue where the [Monstrous Blade] skill of nodachi heroes deal extra piercing armour penetration and slashing armour penetration.

II、	Event Map Fixes & Improvements
1.	Resolved an issue where attires weren't displayed on the deathmatch [Cliff Duel] map.
2.	Adjusted the location where the attackers may withdraw to on the [Heilung Fjord] map. The pathing attackers take as they withdraw will be more rational.

III、	System Improvements
1.	While an event is active, right-click on an event item enables you to quickly access the exchange menu.
2.	Added a page displaying the runes of players viewable when spectating a game. Each player's runes can be view from their tooltip.
3.	It is now possible to check the number of players in preparation for Territory War and their loading statuses. This can be viewed at the top of the map, in Strategist mode, and when preparing.

IV、	Bug Fixes
1.	Resolved an issue where models in the Unit Challenges menu would sometimes remain.
2.	Resolved an issue where expired Auxiliary Units could still be taken into your army by talking to the Watchman. (Though, they wouldn't actually be taken into battle)
3.	Resolved an issue where some text didn't fit within the borders.
4.	Resolved an issue where the display effects of maul heroes' combo strikes would disappear.

10.	Resolved an issue where the sound would disappear when in the Fenrir's Pack menu.

V、Unit Changes
Sigrun's Shieldmaidens Adjustments
1.Adjusted the timing of the buff acquired when using Defensive Measure while the Shieldmaidens wield their spears. They will now buff allies when they are close enough and will no longer be forced to raise their shields.
2.Improved the AI of Odin's Bulwark while the Shieldmaiders wield their spears. Sigrun's Shieldmaidens will now battle more actively when near the hero, and will use Shield Bash more often.
3.Boosted their Last Stand. Now, when Sigrun's Shieldmaidens are in spear-formation they will no longer be knocked down by cavalry shield charges. Yet, cavalry units can still attack them from behind to break their formation.
4.Sigrun's Shieldmaidens may now use Sprint while Odin's Bulwark is active

notes.title: [War Council - 02] Friendly clash on Viking paradise that is Heilung Fjord
notes.content:
Well met, Warlord! Biggy-smart of the War Council here!

Last time we reviewed the friendly match between Pond Guard, the mysterious visitors from North America, and Crusaders, the ever-victorious Asia champions. Right, last time we focused on assaulting Heilung Fjord, and those of you that tuned in are bound to be wondering how to defend on it, no?

I am Conqueror's Blade's Biggy-smart, a club member of the War Council famed for being a real loafer. Anyway, time to get on with another lazily ma... Err, super high-effort recap focusing on a squad playing as the defenders on Heilung Fjord, yeah.

I'm sure some of you'll be thinking that I'll be favoring one particular side over the other, me being a superfan of Crusaders and all. (Warlord, yeah you, you with the sword. Sit down and relax!)

Warlords, fret not, I'm a smartie with principles. I'm simply here to share with you a recap of the friendly match between Crusaders, the eternal gods of war (Woop, woop!), and TYH, the great bodyguards of South America (a squad evolved from two squads of the South America Division).

Right, well I'll just skip introducing the map. Just check the previous recap for that info.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/2983046332357402979
(You sure are the most cumbersome Warlords I've ever hosted for!)
*Coughs* Let the friendly drums of war sound once again!
Parties Included: TYH (Attackers) and Crusaders (Defenders)
Occurrence Date: 3/20/2021
Occurrence Reason: CBL International Friendly Tournament
Occurrence Location: Heilung Fjord
Occurrence Result: The ever-victorious champions doing what they do best.
Biggy-smart's comment: Friendship 1st, contention 2nd!

Full match video:[previewyoutube=myCd78Kk_A4;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d19136208bfab051760914145d407cda9d5a025b.png
Score Board

Let's get straight to the point! Crusaders are known as the Masters of Cavalry, and not just in name. Just look at all that cavalry they've brought! Using cavalry is Crusaders forte for sure, and I'm sure you know the pros and cons from our last recap. (Warlord, yeah you with sword: Easy boy, I'm the one teachin' here.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/295621fa56cb8a3fa04da2dd40dfe2dd844e5d2d.png

Crusaders Cavalry: Assemble

Shotomate!! That positioning sure looks familiar, could they be?
Warlord With the Sword: Last time around they lost A due to their cavalry. They can't be ballsy enough to do the same twice, right?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/48f86f05dd1286110fa42706116b5f55c1f5e245.png
Crusaders Cavalry Ride Forth

Calm down, Warlord. See? Their cavalry might've been dragging their feet, but here they are!
The last time Crusaders stormed out from B with 11 cavalries, leaving only 4 troops defending A. Pond Guard took advantage of that and got their hands on both A and C.

And my, Crusaders sure learnt their lesson! If rushing out from B makes it difficult to defend, then they'll just rush out from A instead!
(No talk, charging is all the rage!)
5 infantry troops defend B, and 10 cavalry troops charge them!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c566638f76998ea0d9a479ced15dd258adf1b000.png

TYH's Anti-Cavalry Units

	TYH being a squad made up of the two strongest squads in South America, all CBL veterans, naturally are fully aware of Crusaders' strategies and they were ready all along.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/59299a6f44c56be8f2f595b33febb8f2855c018e.png
Crusaders' Cavalry Test the Waters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1b5a369dc241a916ce799bd3ba3693361d0058d2.png

Crusaders' Cavalry Retreats

  TYH was ready in formation on the other end all along, and they even had cover by cavalry and artilleries. Had they charged right out, Crusaders would've been minced meat. Either way, they've returned to base.
(CRUSADERS! WATCH OUT, THEY GOT AWPs THERE!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/731696c7be97df619f7047072a57ae67fa9f20f2.png
Crusaders' Hussars Lose Their Heads

Wuzz goin' on? Someone's got their heads in the cloud!
All of their allies have withdrawn; so why's one troop of cavalry riding out to die?
What's going on here? Is it moral decay or a complete loss of reason?
Hoy! Warlord, let's sort this out with words, yeah? Put that sword down! (Recovers his posture)
Gimme that sword, you just sit down, relax, and listen to me!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9661948fd1b9e4512558391f42c9825adb300831.png

Crusaders' Hussars Bite the Dust

(the Winged Hussars cry with their faces covered: they're outnumbered two to one!)
TYH are readying their battering rams and artilleries to destroy those walls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d6976039048da5e145aff8e3df23d283dcf8f125.png
TYH Bombards the Walls
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7b45ef1a4a53aedffb92fb60c247c3d039bbc238.png

Crusaders Set Up Artilleries

Naturally, Crusaders can't just sit back and let TYH have it their way, and are also setting up artilleries on the walls near A and B to retaliate! Artilleries up on both sides trading blows like there's no tomorrow.
Right, I feel like I simply have to emphasis on the importance of using artilleries and counter-artilleries properly.

 Your battle formation is far from the only important strategic element in Conqueror's Blade: using your artilleries properly is vital, too. Especially if the match has entered a stalemate, as it enables you to create new ventures of attack! (*Raps the blackboard!*)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5eddbb1c7d7775bcb20cbfcddbb31811b80ae146.png
The Walls Crumble

The walls on both sides have fallen to the power of mortars. TYH's troops are rushing the breaches and are assembling by the gates: their pincer attack is obvious at this point.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a01ab82486404debf4e83bddc9816ffae8ee7671.png
Blocked Cavalry

*Raps the blackboard!* Cavalry can't cross wall breaches! (Get your pen and notebook ready! Write that down 100 times over!)
Crusaders were fully prepared for their assault, and their heavy infantry are ready to defend either side.

Oh my, the sheer co-operation Crusaders got going brings tears to my eyes: just look at that fluid defense, their flawless communication! Am I envious or what? 
My teammates usually just hide in the back with their archers waiting for the fighting to end!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3a8ea6bcace0ad119668182e026d103e10d05725.png
Crusaders Defend the Breach

TYH's vanguard halts their offense and instead sets their eyes on working together to create a pincer attack with their allies by A.

Their allies on A make a stand and they begin pushing hard to attract Crusaders' full attention, so as to reduce the pressure on their allies by the main gates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/706a93b26103732bbe95671b12f74724ce7db57a.png

TYH Attack on Multiple Fronts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/10ac2a00ac0e5643cc69b7b88092c47505d39a5d.png
TYH Goes Full on Assault

Crusaders' forces on A are stretched thin after TYH's pincer attack and only 3 remain standing. They've now taken to guerrilla tactics to buy time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/eeba71b8a3e9438f47d151c6b4aec43c64850920.png
Crusaders Defend to the Death

3 of their members defend A till their death, but Crusaders' reinforcements make their sacrifice worthwhile and their Fire Lancers have come with intent to kill. TYH who has just finished their attack on A didn't get time to react before they were completely surrounded.
What a sight! What a play! Just look at them go! Beautiful!

If that'd be me out there, my corpse would've gone cold long before my allies even thought of coming to my aid T_T.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d32bf6ed9e3c95d496fe5d7e2ae65f59d4850763.png
TYH's Attack Fails

I must admit, both teams co-operated masterfully during the attack. Yet, upon the field of battle nothing is ever certain for long. TYH's first attack failed at the very end and they were beat back.

What's more, there's only 2 minutes and 4 seconds remaining, not a lot of time for TYH to make a comeback. Ladies and gentlemen, we'll have a winner in 2 minutes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e754e710be353b8629f4463e3ffd6fdb1243d7ff.png
The Final Fray

Crusaders naturally know full well that what comes next is highly important, and so they are gathering their cavalry!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/272e60cb399be5d0277cb7fc5d5bfe762c630577.png
Defenders in Position

In true e-sports spirit, TYH charges for all what they're worth; it's now or never!
Their trebuchet and artilleries are creating mayhem, stopping the cavalry from making their entry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/90628b1234810cf1664254018925bcd38334229d.png
TYH's Artillery Fail

Unfortunately TYH's trebuchet fires blanks a few times in a row. The perfect time for Crusaders to meet the attackers head-on!
Cavalry, charge as one!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/50717822a7d4cdbe9b29577994c0ca273cd38dbe.png
Crusaders Cavalry Goes to Town

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b53726fbf2729eb6fd6f41cfd6bd86edafb45d96.png
The Defenders Win

A mass of cavalry makes minced meat, or ninja fruit, of the attackers!
TYH's remaining forces are not enough to withstand their assault and they're pushed back to the supply point outside A.

But will Crusaders stop there? Of course not! Their Fire Lancers charges right out the gates and goes ham right there at TYH's supply point!

Ladies and gentlemen, we have a clear winner!

I'm sure that you've also realized that the key to this battle was how Crusaders' three members stood their ground while taking heavy losses. Even so they did not retreat. They kept assault A keeping TYH from capping it, and did their best to buy time for the reinforcements to arrive.

When the enemy attacked, they retreated; when the enemy retreated, they attacked; when the enemy overwhelmed them, they hid. They wore down the enemy one bite at a time.

In all honesty, if they had retreated fully instead A would be square in TYH's pockets. That would have extended the match timer and we'll, who knows what would've happened?

All in all, their sacrifice is what won them the battle!

Warlord, who would've thought that a friendly match would be so nerve-wrecking, eh?
What?! You want more?!

Gosh, I never would've thought!

    Heh, but I did prepare some for you either way: check the links above for more amazing matches. But I'm out, I'm sure itching to play a siege battle or three myself!

notes.title: [Northmen] CREATOR INCENTIVE PROGRAM Recruitment Announcement
notes.content:
The CREATOR INCENTIVE PROGRAM is aimed at all content creators that make high-quality Conqueror's Blade content. With this program we aim to provide such content creators more support and help for even more content! From this point onward, we will be recruiting new content creators with each new season, and hope that more and more creators join us!

Registration: April 21st to April 26th, 24:00 (UTC+8).

I、	If you are a:
1) Video creator:
- 200+ followers
- Created at least 1 video per week and no less than 10 videos between February and April
2) Streamer:
- 200+ followers
- Streamed at least 1 time per week and no less than 45 hours between February and April
3) Strategy guide creator:
- Create Conqueror's Blade strategy guides or related articles, including those pertaining to units, beginner's guides, Territory War reports, etc.

II、	If you wish to join the CREATOR INCENTIVE PROGRAM
Feel free to fill in the following form if you meet any one of the above criterions:
https://forms.gle/FKJ3fByM9iXvupLX7
Should you have any other questions whatsoever, feel free to contact us on QQ, Discord, or via email cb_event@boominggames.com.

III、	By joining the CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM you will receive the following:
1.	Exclusive Promotion Channels
You will be added to an exclusive Creator chat where you can talk directly with the dev team, you will also be able to post your videos and articles on exclusive channels.
2. In-game Item Support
If you meet your monthly quota during our co-operation, you will receive Sovereigns and other item rewards!
3. Exclusive Gift Code
You can share your own gift code with your fans while you stream or in your videos. Your fans can then claim extra rewards from within the "O" menu.
4. PTR Testing
You will also be eligible to partake in PTR testing for new seasons during the course of our co-operation, so that you can experience our newest content before anyone else!

-	Have above 150 views on average for each Conqueror's Blade-related video
Streamers

What's more, as a participant of the CREATOR INCENTIVE PROGRAM, we hope you join in on even more content, such as providing commentary for the season tournaments, draft war reports, video re-creation, etc. Naturally, such extra content will net you even greater rewards.

1. Mind your language while streaming, in your videos and when sending posts.

(1) Should you make improper remarks in-game, in player communities, or in your video/stream that negatively effects the game.

(3) Create a series of new accounts to raise your following and/or to have such accounts use your gift code.
(4) Should you fail to publish enough content on a regular basis and fail to meet the content quota.

notes.title: Recent Network Issues Clarification
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
    We have as of late received feedback regarding network issues, and we are truly sorry for the effect these have had upon your gameplay. These network issues have led to Warlords experiencing the following issues:
[olist]
 Being unable to enter battle after successful matchmaking.

 Being unable to enter the game after logging in to the character menu.

 Getting sudden disconnects during gameplay.
[/olist]
We began looking into the issues as soon as our technical team got wind of them, and we have resolved the currently known issues.
Read on below for a more in-depth clarification of the above issues:
    The 3 issues mentioned above are all client to server network issues.
    Issue 1 and 2 are issues where the client cannot establish a proper connection to the server, resulting in the inability to access the game. Issue 3 is due to a Warlord's own network being unstable, leading to the client being unable to properly transmit data to the servers, resulting in serious package loss and forced disconnects.    
    Server connectivity is a well-known hurdle for MMOs. While playing online games, one will every so often have issues with disconnects, high latency and unstable connections. A large source of these issues is the complexity of network communication itself. Warlords from every corner of the globe play Conqueror's Blade at a regular basis and the network access of many areas is quite complex indeed. Especially for a game like Conqueror's Blade featuring thousands of units being displayed at the same time, and combats being played in real-time to boot. To realize all of this, tons of data is being synchronized between the client and the server each second, leading to high network and connectivity requirements.
Apart from this, MMOs are certainly complex enough in their own right. There are also many external factors that greatly affect server stability, such as:
1) The stability of our cloud server providers' database centers.
More or less all of Conqueror's Blade's servers are situated in the machine rooms of large-scale cloud server providers, and cloud servers themselves do not run smoothly 100% of the time, something which also affects stability. E.g.: The disconnection wave on April 4th was caused by internal server issues of our cloud server provider in Hong Kong.

2) Network operation routing issues.
For example, the reason why our Japanese-based players experienced unstable connectivity for a period of time previously was due to an issue with our operator's submarine cables. The reason why some other players have been experiencing delay has been due to network issues with a Hong Kong-based operator's backbone network.

3) Large numbers of cyber attacks.
    Ever since we first launched Conqueror's Blade we've been the frequent target of DDoS attacks. While we prevent most of these, some abnormal traffic does enter our servers which also affects connectivity.
    While it is almost impossible for us to fully resolve the above issues, we are constantly working on creating solutions, for example: we will pick out more reliable cloud server providers to ensure the stability of our servers, and to use servers with better hardware. We will also increase our outgoing bandwidth, and communicate with providers to add more edge network nodes.
     We will furthermore communicate with our network operators and discuss how to best optimize the client-to-server network route. And also check up on the possibility of adding network relay measures in certain areas where the network structure is especially complex. That way players can connect to our servers via our relay lines for an overall more stable gameplay experience.

    We are also continuously working on optimizing our server network for more fluid gameplay, such as:
[olist]
 Adding different network protocols to switch between, so as to avoid the network flow being restricted or blocked if any one protocol is unavailable.
 To change to other server addresses and reconnect when the connection times out. So that the connection does not rely on a single connection.
 Provide a better network diagnostics tool so that our players can quickly rule out common network issues.
 Optimize the data synchronization that goes on during battle, to reduce the amount of data required and reduce network requirements. Naturally, this is on the basis that the gameplay experience remains unaffected.
[/olist]

Our servers are situated all across the world, and owing to the aforementioned constraints, it is unfortunately impossible for us to enable all Warlords to play without connection issues at all times.
We are truly sorry for the inconvenience caused by the recent network issues. Thank you for your long-lasting love and support of Conqueror's Blade, and we hope you understand that we are doing our best to resolve these issues as soon as they arise. We'll also continue to work hard on improving our services.
We have naturally prepared a compensation for those Warlords affected by these issues, which you will find in your mail. 
Lastly, may you lead your soldiers to many a victory!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade April 8th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on April 8th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following:

1）	Map Rotation/Balance Changes & Improvements
1.	Made it possible to break the stone houses on both sides of A on the siege map [Border Fort].
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/16d6a3b7100e13baaf1fcf8012071e62ae9dd8af.png
2.	The siege map [Border Fort] is once again available in the map pool.

[Border Fort] Description:
The Border Fort's western front is of great strategic importance and a frontier to the north of Maoyang. Sand-filled winds batter its walls year around and its defenders have withstood the nomadic tribes for many a year.
Its enclosed city gate is its most unique feature, making it possible to strike back against attackers from several sides at once. The battlements atop the walls are set up in such a way that archers may fire volleys from atop with ease.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6b5315eebf3b9b9051f68493b15b42ceefc5f396.png 
Its front is fairly easy to defend. Attackers may come from the front with battering rams and siege towers, or attempt to make their way inside using ladders. The defenders can use the encampment-style layout to strike at attackers from their left flank and from atop the walls. Simply put, to strike at attackers from several directions at once.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3be3a287316cd43501566b49511ec232674be616.png

Having made it to the inner parts and after taking the supply point within, the attackers may advance further with the support of trebuchet fire and their allies, until they capture it fully. The defenders, however, may set up defensive lines where best suitable to hamper the attackers from claiming their base. Though, they must also beware of trebuchet fire.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/230b746db6a5d9a3f0b3f129a13254d8ee22ce01.png 
2）	Early Game Improvements
1.	Replaced the default skills of the weapon tutorial for skills more unique to each profession.
2.	Improved the text of the weapon tutorial's first riding tutorial.
3.	Added a new respawn point on the Augolia tutorial map available after breaking through the walls.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1941b8958cdb9676053eb357619ad8d016e1f6ad.png
3）	Tutorial Skill Changes
1.	[Shortsword & Shield]'s Barricade I replaced with Centurion's Battle Drill I.
2.	[Longsword & Shield]'s Shield Bash I replaced with Sally Forth I.
3.	[Glaive]'s Charge I replaced with Hail of Blades I.
4.	[Poleaxe]'s Weapon Dance I replaced with Lochaber Strike I.
5.	[Spear]'s Return of Jangar I replaced with Heaven's Fury I.
6.	[Nodachi]'s Samurai's March I replaced with Avalanche I.
7.	[Musket]'s Fine Gunpowder I replaced with Blackpowder Grenade I.
8.	[Dual Blades]' Bo-Shurikens I replaced with Marked for Death I.
9.	[Bow]'s Bodkin-Tipped I replaced with Exploding Arrow I.
10.	[Short Bow]'s Parting Shot I replaced with Angry Hornets I.

4）	Rune Effect Changes
1.	The defense granted by [Stalwart Shields] (Spear) reduced to 80 (down from 100).
2.	[Hugin's Lament] (Musket) no longer reduces the cooldown of [Blackpowder Grenade] by 2 seconds.
3.	[Echoes of the Dead] (Shortsword & Shield)'s special effect is now only played once.
4.	[Deathly Howl] and [Deathly Sorrow]'s special effects are now only played once.

5）Season Challenge Improvements
1.	Improved upon the [Snowstorm] season's Tundra Yeomen challenge. The first phase's "In Expedition, take the Tundra Yeomen unit into battle 8 times" has been replaced with "In Expedition, take cavalry units into battle 8 times."

6）	Bug Fixes & Improvements
1.	Resolved an issue where special effects could still be seen while a Dual Blades user was stealthed.
2.	Resolved an issue where the number off usable outfits for Northmen season units would be displayed incorrectly.
3.	Resolved an issue where there was no BGM playing when entering a Royal Capital from within the Character menu.
4.	Resolved an issue where there were no tooltips displayed when obtaining 3 items from an attire chest.
5.	Resolved an issue where it was impossible to complete challenge quests if one had used a unit as an auxiliary unit before unlocking it with a Signaculum.
6.	Added Avatars to the battle results menu.
7.	When trying to add the same Warlord multiple times, a prompt telling you that you have already sent a request to that play will now be shown.

notes.title: [War Council - 01] Witnessed! Friendly Clash in Heilung Fjord! - Episode 01
notes.content:
Well met, Warlord! Mr.Biggy-smart aka “99-Smart” of the War Council here! (Make some NOISE!)ːsteamhappyː

Conqueror's Blade League (CBL) has finished for now, and following it, the new [Northmen: Wolves of Ragnarök] season is here! It’s been a crazy March for Conqueror's Blade fans, and April will be too! The Vikings' battle horns shall sound as the Fenrir's Pack, Odin's Berserkers, and Sigrun's Shieldmaidens await the call to arms. Conquer, plunder, ravage and claim what is yours in this season of wildness!

On this joyful April Fools' Day, me, Biggy-smart, would like to share a few wise words about the friendly match between Pond Guard, the “Mysterious Visitors” from North America, and Crusaders, the “All-time Winner of Asia”. (Theme song playin’: "Galgard")

	Full match video: [previewyoutube=mWmp6GjHwwc;full][/previewyoutube]

Got A Date at Heilung Fjord

They say that after having been defeated, Guthorm scoured the land for a place to settle and finally found a perfect harbor on Vajk's Lake in Ungverija. There he constructed walls and created for his warriors a castle upon the water. A place for them to rest and train. The Yatti royals send their armies upward along the Sadi River as the snows began to melt. They launched a counter attack against the foreign invaders who had ensconced themselves upon the land. 

Full story: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/835570/view/5499430983891771279

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/216f546d0b8278c71a6c95b616eaa5b63186aef9.png
Heilung Fjord (“Biggy-smart: Kiddin’ me ya fightin' in Viking paradise? Idiots!”)

Map Style: 

 A Viking-style siege battle catering toward infantry, most of the fighting is in the harbor and so cavalry doesn't fare so well.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c748117b1013d5f99fbe607402f5670c9b998411.jpg
Geographical Features:

Layout

 The walls by A and B break fairly easily, and it's easy for the defenders to get sandwiched when all hell breaks loose. Besides, support takes long time to reach A for the defenders. All in all, the difficulty of defending these two points is probably an 8 out of 10.
 While there's a fair amount of distance between C and D, they're decently close to supply points. Defense difficulty of these is more like a 7.
 The base's terrain is quite unique and favor the defenders.
 In a word, Heilung Fjord is easy to attack during the early game, and easy to defend during the late game. (“KNOCK-KNCOK” with serious face)


Let’s Put on a Show!


 Parties Included: Pond Guard/NA (Attackers) and Crusaders/CH (Defenders)
 Occurrence Date: 3/20/2021
 Occurrence Reason: CBL International Friendly Tournament
 Occurrence Location: Heilung Fjord
 Occurrence Result: the “All-time Winner” lick their wounds.

“Biggy-smart's comment: Tough!”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4c0a542d919846c8c3df3f429f7c3d56ae355daf.jpg
Aha! Look at these faces XD

	I must say that Crusaders, the often called “Equestrian Masters, Defenders of Harbour City, Upholder of the Asia Servers' Honour, the former and current champions of CBL”, are my eternal idols! Warlords of the Asia Servers hold deep respect for them, honestly speaking, they know how to put up a fight! But if I'd start talking about Pond Guard, I'm sure that you'll agree that adhering to the good ol' rule of "silence is golden" would be for the best. But their story is a glorious one, but anyway, no one likes a lengthy story! (tl;dr XD) Anyway (Fails to keep on pretending), in a word, they're the mysterious visitors from North America!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7e42daab06e378dc76daec8fa83720d8de77f7e2.png
Score Board

Looking at the score, Crusaders have the upper hand with 1,382 units, while Pond Guard is down to 1,292! Oh my, a full corps of 5-star cavalry units! Crusaders are looking to bring home victory, and that quickly!

Sh-shotomate! Are they running their classical cavalry rush?!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/17979588a2343913a21e22b0b98d8c47b64aaf6e.png

Hah, I knew it! Crusaders ride out from B with 11 bands of cavalry units, leaving 4 infantry bands to defend A. Crusaders will be giving Pond Guard one hell of a greeting! Wa-Crusada forever!

Right, let's calm ourselves down with a conundrum:
- Warlord, pretend you're placed on a deserted island for a survival game. Before it starts, you have 700 credits and can buy the following foods: A meal of roast meat for 320 credits; a beef burger for 240, a chicken burger for 180, a sandwich for 110, and a pack of Oreos for 50. So, what'd taste the best? Err, wait, what'd be best for survival?
A: I'd spend all of it on Oreos and ration it out for ages!
B: Two meals of roast meat for sure; nothing can beat that!
Biggy-smart: The supermarket is risky; it needs to be prudent. c:

Those of you Warlords as clever as Biggy-smart here will have noticed the great risk Crusaders are taking with their strategy. While they have the upper hand on paper, they've quite a few 1-star units too. Frankly speaking, the pros and cons of cavalry rushes are fairly obvious on any map. You've a ton of firepower, but if you lose momentum, you're hard pressed getting back up again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3b2996580274128a21795abab806c38251942970.png

Pond Guard are well aware of this fact, and just look at them go! Full charge toward A! A perfect curve ball! When faced with a cavalry rush, your best bet's to avoid full-on confrontation and head straight for strategic points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/435d98b41d36df36094faa9432172e160f97ab45.png

Actually, as the walls near both A and B can be broken, if you play this map in a more conventional style without running a horse rush, the attackers can break through the walls and send in infantry from either side (cavalry cannot enter), and then you'll have the defenders' units on A right between the hammer and the anvil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d66bd13162f5fbfeafa8a0ae00f72821daec0d10.png

Just as Biggy-smart said before, A and B are close, and if you lose A, you'll be hard pressed defending B. But look at that, Pond Guard have put their thinking caps on! Having taken A, they're going straight for C!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e91036577458c0f12a4c00578aea9dd17f9efb25.png

There're three entries to C. A narrow pass and two stairs. Owing to the map design, cavalry units can't enter either one. Pond Guard are taking full advantage of this and are heading for C at full speed.

The key here is C. Pond Guard is using the unique layout of Heilung Fjord perfectly to strike a fatal blow to their opponents!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/208a231cfa43ceeb6a7c94ac850a407da9d8b412.png

Wonderful tactic indeed! Having taken C, Point Guard is using the elevation difference between C and Crusaders' base, and are sending troops to the docks, as well as to B, which at this point is nothing short of a full-on Christmas Sale!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3634087825c452ce72902edf4e41b83fe814b5e3.png
Siege Ejector

Having taking the docks, they're using the Siege Ejectors to head straight into Crusaders' base! Pond Guard with two supply points in the bag must be roaring with laughter at this point! Well played!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b249db8c3df9e2d4c01ac292243435f4c2aea0a6.png

The base on Heilung Fjord is fully exposed to trebuchet fire, and with three supporting pathways its advantageous to the attacker! Though, they mustn't let their guard down. The defenders' supply point is just behind them and they can reach the base from two different paths. All in all, the area is highly defendable! But Pond Guard are still going strong and they've got it all under control. Heh, apart from the path from C and that of the Siege Ejector. It's fully viable to launch a cavalry rush from B, on the left-hand side, and crush the enemy forces from two sides by timing an assault from the base on the right-hand side!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ba5d4051760b1c483b67e75c7f48f44bb043c5f5.png
Left base entry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0fc997cd9569d9567f1b5ca932db750368a60a31.png
Right Siege Ejector base entry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2b45c87935c79cae73377d39bf469861186d6d75.png

Looking at the map, it's obvious where the defensive lines are. And Pond Guard have set up artilleries by the Siege Ejectors on the right-hand side of the base. They're clearing the field of enemies and putting pressure on the enemy's support lines with trebuchet fire. What an attack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/68c74f255db6b6e141b3b73ceca4c91b78e6c37f.png

And now Odin's Berserkers are on the move! Pond Guard's berserkers are faced with Crusaders' remaining low-tier units. Look at them go as they carve their path to victory! Such bloodshed!

What a wonderful match full of ups and downs! Show some RESPECT!

Phew, I'm tired from all the commentating! See you at the next [War Council]!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
Dear Warlord, 

It fills our hearts with joy that you, Warlord, have stuck with us through thick, and thin, that you have witnessed the growth of Conqueror's Blade.

Gaming is a unique form of art. Conqueror's Blade is for us a spiritual bridge, a story belonging to you, and to us alike. We launched our Early Access version on Steam on July 11th, 2019. The follow year, we launched the full version of Conqueror's Blade, on April 6th. During that one year, the four seasons came and went in the game, and as we grew, so did it. We saw the rise of many a house, players from all across the globe fought against each other in tournaments, and we continued to improve upon the game. All which served as inspiration for Warlords to fight to their hearts' content. Your support is what gives meaning to what we do! We at Booming Games will always work hard on creating a healthy and harmonic gaming environment so that each and every one of you may enjoy the game to its fullest!

While July 11th is the anniversary for our early access version, Conqueror's Blade's real anniversary is that of April 6th when we first launched the full version on Steam!

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on April 4, 2021

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League: Ragnarok Cometh - The Final Clash
notes.content:
We're nearing the final phase of CBL's International Friendly Tournament, and we're switching up the maps and rules for this week. We're waiting with bated breath for the battles to come! And by the way, tune in to Twitch for a change to receive a Heroic Era Signaculum Box and other valuable rewards!

The rules of the last phase are as follows:

A. Format: Best of 3.

B. The first two matches will be played on Wall Fort (tournament map).
- Attacker/defender is randomized for match one, with the two squads switching sides for match two.
- Golden Era units (T5) cannot be used.
- 15 players on each squad.
- Only artilleries of rare quality may be used. The attackers may bring two each, while the defenders may bring one each.
- Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.

C. If the Best of 3 is a tie, an extra Field Battle will be played on Dune Hold.
- Random sides.
- 10 players on each side.
- Only artilleries of rare quality may be used. 

Schedule:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bd356bd25e1f5d8b4e49e71232a9b6dddbf05b18.jpg

Twitch Drops Info: 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3007814862795146751

Tournament Order:

1. Rematches & Pauses:

- (1) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament. No rematches will be held for disconnects.
- (2) No pauses will be allowed while a match is running.

2. Code of Conduct:

- (1) Cheating is Prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this rule, the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban that player from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
- (2) Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
- (3) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming conventions. Squad names should be in English and names with political and/or cultural ambiguity are strictly prohibited. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Player names with political and/or cultural ambiguity are similarly strictly prohibited. Anyone found to be in violating of the above will be removed from the tournament. Squads with inappropriate names should change their name posthaste, and will be removed from the tournament if they do not cooperate.
- (4) Chat Rules: The referee may issue a warning for any comment made that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify contestants.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade March 25th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on March 25th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following:

1)	New Ready For War Reward Event
1.	Full Upgrade to Sign Ins: Better Daily Rewards
To welcome the new season, you may claim more free rewards for daily sign-ins between March 26th, 0:00 to April 21st, 0:00 (Accessed via "O" -> "Rewards"). Rewards include a variety of Artillery Chests, High-level Honour Medals, Bronze Coin Chests, and Training Summaries.
2.	[Pre-New Season] Free 4-Star Unit!
The epic quest: New Journey - Proof of Bravery unlocks at March 29th, 12:00, which upon completion grants a 4-Star unit Signaculum to bolster your unit roster.
3.	Free Military Supplies: Limited-time Store Purchases
New limited-time discount packs hit the shelves at March 29th, 12:00.
Mercenary Supplies. Contains Large Chest of Bronze x3, Heroic Era Signaculum Box , Unit Medal x60, Expansion Permit x1, 10-Battle Unit XP Card x3.
Enemy Strategy Tome. Purchase grants Unit Medal x60 and Training Summary x8, as well as Unit Medal x10 and Advanced Unit XP Card x5 each day logged in for 7 days.
4.	Limited-time Purchase Packs Reset
The three limited-time packs, Warband Pack, Warden's Training Manual, Warden's Expansion Permit, will have their purchase limit reset. Warlords that buy the current ones before the update may buy them once again after the update.

2)	Better Snowstorm Ranked Battle Rewards
Warlords that have claimed and used their [Ranked Bounty: Divine Deliverance] unit attire chest will receive a [Ranked Bounty: Divine Deliverance Steed] unit attire in their Mail. If you have claimed it yet not used it, simply use it to receive the complete unit attire.

3)	Avatars & Fame
1.	Added a maul hero avatar. Complete the achievement: "Slay 800 heroes in with your maul" to get it.

Slow effect reduced to 45% (down from 60%).

7)	Rune Effect Changes
1.	[Munin's Change] now enables one to use [Bandage] while walking or running.
2.	[Munin's Change] changed to: [Bandage] can be used while moving at 25% of normal movement speed. It no longer has the negative "[Bandage]'s cooldown is increased by 30%" effect.

8)	Other Bug Fixes & Improvements
1.	Resolved an issue where the banner animations on Heilung Fjord (Siege) would stop playing.
2.	Resolved an issue where [Palace Guards] would sometimes not be able to use Shield Bash when attacking at very close distances.

5.	Resolved an issue where [Tercio Arquebusiers] wouldn't respond to formation commands quickly enough when reloading.
6.	Resolved an issue where the Shield Charge of [Sword & Shield] units wouldn't block melee attacks.
7.	Resolved an issue where the [Fenrir's Pack]'s Time to Hunt skill could be used even after the hero had fallen.
8.	Resolved an issue where the Wyvern and Hydra nodes of [Dragon's Roar] for Spear heroes wouldn't work.
9.	Resolved an issue where [Paladin] of longsword & shield heroes wouldn't correctly reduce the defence of enemies hit.
10.	Resolved an issue where the [Frost Giant's Skull] (Poleaxe) rune granted maximum health instead of actual health.
11.	Resolved an issue where the [Munin's Right Eye] (Bow) rune wouldn't take effect in some situations.
12.	Resolved an issue where the [Hugin's Remains] (Maul) rune wouldn't take effect in some situations.
13.	Resolved an issue where runes wouldn't take effect during duels.
14.	Resolved an issue where it was possible to change weapon, runes, and skills during duels.
15.	Resolved an issue where the prompt animation of the Rune Tutorial quest line for unlocking runes wouldn't have any sound.
16.	Resolved an issue where the matching timer wouldn't be played while in the Season or Character menus.
17.	Resolved an issue where there were visible seams at the neck of the Fenrir's Leather Armour's female version.
18.	Resolved an issue where the leather straps and cloth of the Fenrir's Leather Armour's male version was displayed incorrectly.
19.	Resolved an issue where the volume to the Fenrir's Leather Armour's sound was too high.
20.	Resolved an issue where the All-Father's Armour's cape wouldn't flutter naturally.
21.	Improved the sparks effect of unit models within the Season Challenges menu.
22.	Replaced the previous song of the Season Challenges main and submenus to the new season's.
23.	Resolved an issue where Augolia level was incorrect. The correct level should be 4.
24.	Resolved an issue where some title descriptions were incorrect.
25.	Resolved an issue where the Taurus's description was incorrect.
26.	Resolved an issue where defeating rebel camps in the [Plundered Fiefs] game mode wouldn't count toward quest progress.
27.	Resolved an issue where the menu would flash too frequently when using Pay Off for units.
28.	Adjusted the conclusion time of Guthorm Fame daily quests. They now conclude at together with the season's epic quests.
29.	Resolved an issue with the item rewards for the first stage of the [Fenrir's Pack] unit challenges.
30.	Added two new maps to Siege Battle matching: [Continopolis] and [Hidden City].
