notes.title: Update Announcement – Northmen Season
notes.content:
Season Map
Heilung Fjord
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/76d70b123295e7f2c4d1cf547c471d688ee6199a.jpg
	
Guthorm found a perfect harbor on Vajk's Lake in Ungverija. There he erected walls and created for his warriors a castle upon the water. A place for them to rest and train. The Yatti royals send their armies upward along the Sadi River as the snows began to melt. They launched a counter attack against the foreign invaders who had ensconced themselves upon the land.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/5499430983891771280

Map Balance Changes

Augolia Siege
	The attackers currently have a difficult time on Augolia as it is difficult to maintain offense, leading to them having a rather low win rate. Thus, we have added a supply point for the defenders which can be occupied, enabling the attackers to spawn nearby and increase their reinforcements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/310e375faab3283dd7379548d71718c034df1203.jpg

Sun City Siege

	The terrain of Sun City is incredibly open and the two sides spawn quite far away from each other. This has led to the attackers having much ground to play with, making it easy to use mobility as an advantage. This has made it difficult for the defenders to attain victory, and the attackers' win rate has remained consistently high. Thus, we have adjusted the reward times for capturing A and B for the attacker down to 2 minutes (was 3). High mobility is still encouraged, but with this change the tolerance for error is smaller.

Level Improvements

Siege Battle Levels

To improve the gameplay experience of the attacking side during matchmaking siege battles, we have added a safe spawn point near the attackers' base during each stage. Players may opt to spawn here, however, we have not made any changes to the default spawn points at the front lines.
Tutorial Levels
Resolved some known bugs of the tutorial map to improve the overall experience. Changes mainly involve the following:
1. Added voice over to the NPC Rupert in the weapon tutorial.
2. A weapons guide will now be displayed for the weapon you are using when battling against the NPC Rupert in the weapon tutorial.
3. Reduced the number of Dummies during the cavalry tutorial and adjusted their placements. This should make it easier for the various weapons.
4. Improved the UI info display of the weapon tutorial. Overhead NPC info will no longer be shown through walls, and the minimap menu has been closed.
5. Resolved an issue where the player could interact with the Weapon Rack while mounted.
6. Resolved an issue where the Sprint button would sometimes be displayed incorrectly.
7. Resolved an issue where mounting the walls on the Augolia tutorial map from a Siege Tower would sometimes make it impossible to destroy the walls.
8. Improved the supply point inside the walls on the Augolia tutorial map.
9. Added a new [Practice Makes Perfect] quest to the tutorial which asks you to complete Training Camp matches.

Stage Bug Fixes & Improvements
1. Resolved an issue where it was possible to mount near some of the walls in the tavern of [Turul Város].
2. Resolved an issue where no sound was played when pushing Battering Rams on the [Lesser Greenpeak] and [The Storehouse] maps.
3. The loading screens of all maps have been replaced with a non-snow filled version related to the season.
 
Season Units
3 new units will be available this season and they can be unlocked by completing their corresponding [Challenges]. Seasonal bonuses are in effect for these units but they are only allowed to don specially customized attires.
Seasonal Bonuses: 

 Requires 10 less Leadership


 Resupply cost is reduced by 50%


Fenrir's Pack

Star Level: 3
The Fenrir's Pack are highly nimble and mobile, enabling them to quickly traverse the field of battle to launch deadly attacks against the enemy's ranged troops. Though, they have fairly low armor and should when possible avoid lengthy contact with enemy forces.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3016821427445194490

Odin's Berserkers

Star Level: 4
Odin's Berserkers may wield their bear-like strength to crush the enemy's defensive lines. They gain rage by killing enemies, and as it peaks, they become fearless in the face of death. They also tap into that rage to crush all in their path. 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3015694891905957640

Sigrun's Shieldmaidens
 
Star Level: 5
Sigrun's Shieldmaidens carry spears, longswords, and round shields and undergo harsh training day in and day out. This has enabled them to quickly switch between offense and defense in the heat of battle. With their solid shield formation they defend against the enemy's attacks.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3015694891902611367

Seasonal Epic Quests

We have added four new main quests in this season, and these are: Rune Mysteries (unlocks at level 15), Fenrir's Pack [Wolf Trail] (unlocks at level 30 and after having completed Rune Mysteries II), Odin's Berserkers [Norse Grizzly] (unlocks at March 29th, 12:00, and after having completed Wolf Trail II), and Sigrun's Shieldmaidens [God's Emissary] (unlocks at April 5th, 12:00, and after having completing Wolf Trail II).

Rune System

Description:

After seeing the Viking warriors do fierce battle, people have noticed the power of the runes that they worship. It appears as if these mysterious words bestow them with endless power.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/5499430983888404583
Unlocking Runes
After reaching level 15, head to the [War Scholar] and complete the "Rune Mysteries" quest to unlock runes.
Socketing Runes
Tap the [Runes] button within the Character menu and [left click] on equipment with rune slots to access the socketing menu:

Socketing Menu:
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa6a1ab33c9666a0606fe9b4dd0758527f63f130.png

Seasonal Runes

Seasonal runes are unlocked in each season in the [Seasonal Runes] menu. These will become invalid at season end.

Seasonal Runes Menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2af2b2b6520949be510e6ee4ffacbb06099ab9c0.png

Hero Balance Changes & Improvements:

Shortsword & Shield
Ideas for Changes:
Based on player feedback and gameplay data, the Shortsword & Shield skill [Ironsides] is currently performing better than expected. As such we are adjusting it, giving it a better balance of risk and profit.
	
Changes:	
. [Ironsides]: Once its defense buff runs out, you will be weakened for 4 seconds, reducing the hero's defence by 15%.
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.

Longsword & Shield
Ideas for Changes:
The Longsword & Shield currently has too low damage output and so we are raising the damage its skills deal.
Changes:
. [With Valour]: Increase each attacks' base damage by 10%.
. [Paladin]: Replaced its slow effect. Enemies hit instead have their defence reduced by 15% for 6 seconds.
. [Shield Bash]: Increase each attacks' block break by 150.
. [Sally Forth]: The final attack knocks enemies back in a small range.
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.

Glaive
Ideas for Changes:
Glaive is currently a fairly well-rounded profession and is highly versatile. However, its damage against units is slightly worse than what we would like, and so we are doing the following changes.
	
Changes:	
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.
. Increase the area of its attack and the number of units it may hit. This serves to increase its overall AoE damage.

Poleaxe
Ideas for Changes:
Increase damage against units to better reflect the power that comes with wielding a 2-handed weapon.
	
Changes:	
. Greatly increase the block break of basic attacks and skills.
. [The Old Billhook]: Slow raised to 40% (up from 20%).
. Added a new dismount skill [Power Cleave]: Roll of your mount and launch a Power Cleave, dealing 200% of your base slashing damage, while also knocking enemies down.

Maul
Ideas for Changes:
The Maul is currently too strong when it comes to breaking the enemy's formation. But it also requires the player to master the usage of Stamina. And so we are making adjustments to this.
Changes:	
. [Fast Forward]: Increase the stamina cost when running. Can no longer run once stamina has been depleted.
. [Combat Grapple]: Increase the stamina cost of running after having grappled an enemy.

. Reduce the block break of some basic attacks and skills:
. Reduce the block break of the first and second hits of [Maelstrom I/II/III].
. Reduce the block break of the first and second hits of [Up from Hel I/II/III].
. Increase stamina recovery speed by 10%.

Spear
Ideas for Changes:
Based on player feedback and gameplay data, we have learned that the Spear's burst damage exceeds our expectations, and so we are making the following adjustments.	
Changes:	
. [Full Tilt Charge]: Can no longer maintain charge once the mount's endurance has been depleted.
. [Dismounting Strike]: The skill's hit box has been changed to better conform to the visual effect, as seen from the images below:
Hit box before change:
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/41abc0de4cc9a9a677b5249d57b97ef4a6a12423.jpg

Hit box after change:
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/06d5e0b44bcd864b2b3ea5580df3ae4bfaa884b7.jpg

. [Procris's Gift]: Block break reduced to 500 (down from 1,000).
. [Dragon's Roar I]: Reduce the base damage bonus to 350% (down from 367%), and its set damage to 4,183 (down from 4,783).
. [Dragon's Roar II]: Reduce the base damage bonus to 350% (down from 367%), and its set damage to 5,119 (down from 5,719).
. [Dragon's Roar III]: Reduce the base damage bonus to 350% (down from 367%), and its set damage to 6,055 (down from 6,655).
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.

Nodachi

Ideas for Changes:
Our goal is for Nodachi heroes to attempt to chain mechanics together, a profession of both high gain and high risk. And so we're thinking of making adjustments along the lines of Health Drain, Bloodcraze, and survivability.	
Changes:	
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.
. [Bloodcraze]: Grants 20% health steal, reduces damage taken by 15%, and increases movement speed by 10% during its duration.
. [Monstrous Blade I]: Each hit on an enemy transfer 5% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health for 12 seconds. [Health Drain] and [Bloodcraze] effects are also consumed. Each stack of [Health Drain] grants an extra 5% health steal, and [Bloodcraze] grants an extra 30% health steal. Bloodcraze caps out at 45% health steal.
Extra Effect: Consumes [Health Drain]/[Bloodcraze] effects and converts them into health. Recover 200 health per second for each stack of [Health Drain] and 1200 health per second for [Bloodcraze]. The healing lasts for 4 seconds, and caps out at 1800 health per second.

Each stack of [Health Drain] grants an extra 5% health steal, and [Bloodcraze] grants an extra 30% health steal. Bloodcraze caps out at 45% health steal.
Extra Effect: Consumes [Health Drain]/[Bloodcraze] effects and converts them into health. Recover 200 health per second for each stack of [Health Drain] and 1200 health per second for [Bloodcraze]. The healing lasts for 4 seconds, and caps out at 1800 health per second.
. [Monstrous Blade III]: Each hit on an enemy transfer 15% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health for 12 seconds. [Health Drain] and [Bloodcraze] effects are also consumed. Each stack of [Health Drain] grants an extra 5% health steal, and [Bloodcraze] grants an extra 30% health steal. Bloodcraze caps out at 45% health steal.

. [Dragon's Leap]'s damage is dealt faster, and its range has been adjusted as below:
Hit box before change:

notes.title: Developers’ logbook - Season Northmen
notes.content:
Esteemed Warlords: 
Hello! I'm Jiaozi, a game designer working on Conqueror's Blade. I'm here today to talk to you all about the [Northmen] season: Its backstory, new game features, and balance changes.

Background & Story:

The [Northmen] season's backstory is based on the Vikings, and that is one of the themes we've been thinking about for a long time. These savage warriors lived for battle and glory, and their unique civilization is liked by friends all over the globe. Including us, of course! We're looking forward to seeing this warring civilization make its entrance into the world of Conqueror's Blade!
Frankly, we drafted the general background and story while creating the [Snowstorm] season. And those of you that follow the story are sure to have noticed that the Scourge invading Ostaria during the [Snowstorm] season were Vikings in disguise. And where else would these Vikings go after their leader was defeated at Eisschloss?
The [Snowstorm] season has served as a catalyst for the [Northmen] season, a season telling the story of the bloodthirsty savage and glorious Vikings.

Battlefield Changes:

We will for the [Northmen] season launch a huge update to a core feature of the game—battles. Two of the most prominent changes can be attributed to Runes as well as balance changes, but we're also adding a couple of new features. I'd like to take this opportunity to share with you our thoughts on our future plans, and how we're going to realize them.

Rune System

Runes where something we had designed and thought about a lot even before Conqueror's Blade first launched, but we haven't really had a chance to add them to the game. However, these mysterious signs tie perfectly together with the Viking theme of the [Northmen] season.
By drawing runes on weapons and equipment, we can improve our abilities, changing greatly the way in which we fight (e.g., the Musket's base attack can be changed to a Grape Shot; or we can enable Bandage to be used while moving at the cost of a higher cooldown). These new Runes will greatly diversify the previously fairly one-sided heroes. It is our hope that Warlords can create diverse builds in each different season by altering their rune setup, instead of simply relying on the same old tactic. Once runes go live, we'll be sure to adjust rune powers as necessary.
What's more, while most runes will be reclaimed come season-end, runes have very low unlock requirements. To unlock a season's runes, all you need to do is raise your Season Rank. Our goal with this that each season's runes will lead to an entirely new experience, enabling us to continue to improve and adjust runes as needed to ensure that they are well balanced.

Balance Changes:

I'm sure that many of you grinded out matched battles during the [Snowstorm] season to farm Ranked Battle score and rank, that you are somewhat displeased with the current staleness of combat, and the weapons and units that are underpowered. We are also aware about balance issues in the current game iteration: some units, such as Pavise Crossbowmen, Winged Hussars, and Fire Lance Cavalry are performing too well, and that many other units are too weak, leading to them being more or less unused. This has led to combat being fairly monotone and uninteresting: which maps call for cavalry and which calls for a tight-nit defense of Pavise Crossbowmen are already set in stone.
I'm sure that most of you wouldn't want this to be the case for another season, and so we're making quite large adjustments to a variety of units with the launch of the [Northmen] season.

 We are strengthening almost all infantry units, especially poleaxe units' ability to deal with cavalry.


 We've similarly nerfed a few of the previously overpowered units.

Once the new season has gone live, we'll continue to monitor battle data and feedback, and continue to make balance changes and improvements.

Avatar System

I'm sure you're no strangers to Avatars in games, and honestly speaking, we've been wanting to add this for a long long time. Now we'll finally get the chance to add the image of our top employee, Lucky, into the game!! Hah! Anyway, to get back on topic, we're releasing Avatars so as to give you all the ability to create more personalized accounts. Previously, when I was defeated in battle, all I could see was that a Dual Blades hero killed me, or perhaps a Poleaxe one. Now with avatars, I'll be able to see clearly: Yep! Sure as day, it was that darned maul-wielding Lucky who sent me flying off the wall!
We're aiming to create a whole range of unique and funny avatars so that each of you have the ability to express yourselves!

All in all, we've got a lot of things planned for the future, and we are working to bring more new game modes during the coming years and in future seasons, simply put, to make the game better. Warlords, I implore you, don't hold back your criticism and recommendations! We will continue work hard on pushing out more new content and improving what is already there, and your feedback is invaluable. Finally, I would like to thank you all for your continued support and love of Conqueror's Blade! We'll continue doing our best!
Warlord, may the winds of war favor you!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade Servers Transfer
notes.content:
The Snowstorm season is soon coming to an end, and soon after a new season will begin. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, and Jaderock Creek. Outgoing server transfers will also be available for Warlords on the Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest servers.

Server Transfer Time:

1. We estimate that registration for server transfers will begin on March 10th, Wednesday, 0,00 (UTC+8), and run through March 15th, Monday, 12:00 (UTC+8).
2、Servers will be taken down for maintenance on March 16th, Tuesday, 1:00-12:00 (UTC+8) during which server transfers will be done.

Server Scope

Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, and Jaderock Creek servers.
Outgoing server transfers will be available for the Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest servers.

Transfer Cost

It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.

Transfer Restrictions

1. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred to and from the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
2. Check the following info for transfer quotas:
      Lotus Ash Sea to Dragonrise Island: 150.
     Lotus Ash Sea to Jaderock Creek: 150.
     Dragonrise Island to Lotus Ash Sea: 150.
     Dragonrise Island to Jaderock Creek: 150.
     Jaderock Creek to Lotus Ash Sea: 75.
     Jaderock Creek to Dragonrise Island: 75.
     Sandstorm Gorge to Lotus Ash Sea: 15.
     Sandstorm Gorge to Dragonrise Island: 15.
     Sandstorm Gorge to Jaderock Creek: 15.
     Espada Forest to Lotus Ash Sea: 25.
     Espada Forest to Dragonrise Island: 25.
Espada Forest to Jaderock Creek: 25.
     
3. There are no additional transfer restrictions between the Lotus Ash Sea and Dragonrise Island servers. There is no limit for character transfers from Jaderock Creek. Only characters created after December 21st, 0:00, are eligible for transfer. Warlords on Sandstorm Gorge and Espada Forest may transfer to Lotus Ash Sea, Dragonrise Island, or Jaderock Creek, but it is not possible to transfer to Sandstorm Gorge or Espada Forest.

How to Transfer:

Log in to the character you wish to transfer, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer to access the Character Transfer menu. Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged with 'Pending Transfer'. Your character will then be transferred during the March 16th maintenance.

Important:

1. After having submitted a server transfer application, you may cancel it at any time before March 15th, 12:00. Upon cancelling a transfer, your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable for this server transfer event). Though, having cancelled a transfer, you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.
2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.
3. You can still play on your character as per usual while a transfer is pending.
4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friends list and blacklist will be cleared. Your character will be removed from your House, Alliance/Imperial Restorationists. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.
5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, neither can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as not to lose anything.
Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.
6. Duplicate Names:
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

The Thane of Scourge was defeated at Eisschloss in the winter of 1064, yet the lands of Ostaria were still in chaos. Wolves of the north attacked, ravaging their borders. Come nightfall, the wolves howled ceaselessly, striking fear into the refugees that had just returned to their homes. Terror has once again gripped the land. Cold steel clashes to the howling of wolves.
Northmen: Wolves of Ragnarok releases on March 18th!

All-new Siege Map

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on February 25, 2021
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profit from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list:

1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
5) It contains statements that violate any law.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade: Anti-Hacking Policy Notice
notes.content:
Hello Warlords,
A group of players have recently been found to be using hacks while playing Conqueror's Blade, hacks which have greatly affected gameplay. We are truly sorry that we have previously not dealt with hacks quickly enough. Neither have we been able to immediately deal with the hacks themselves. This has led to much harm to our players, and for this we are sorry.
Their behavior has opened our eyes. And so we promise you, our faithful players, to crack down hard upon hackers. We believe in zero-tolerance against hacks! That all players may play Conqueror's Blade on a level playfield.
During the past two weeks we have taken the following measures:

 1.We have cracked up our speed detection systems, and they are now capable of detecting even minute alterations in speed.


 2.We are monitoring the firing rate and ammo capacity of artilleries to avoid modifications.


 3.We are recording player positioning and actions that violate the game rules, and use these to determine whether a player is using third-party software.


 4.Should a player be found to be using hacks while in a battle, they will be automatically blocked from generating damage, movement, flag captures, among some, so that they do not affect other players.


 5.We will record and generate cheat logs for suspicious behavior that is not dealt with immediately. We then analyze this and check whether or not the player should be punished.


 6.Our backend continues to analyze heaps of action log data. We then utilize AI algorithms to ascertain whether a player has cheated. Those found violating the rules will be punished accordingly.


 7.We will prioritize the processing and analysis of players that are being reported.

What's more, it has come to our attention that some houses use temporary characters and cheat on a large-scale during Territory War. We will further focus our efforts on these and analyze relevant data. If found to have been using hacks, their entire house and alliance may be removed from Territory War altogether, and not just the cheating accounts. Related house and alliance members also run the risk of being permanently banned. We implore you not to underestimate our resolve in cracking down on any and all cheaters.
    The fight against hacking is a long-term commitment. As a game developer, we will do our utmost to strike at those who cheat. But we also hope that you, our players, will help us. Together we shall stand in the battle against hackers.
Reporting cheaters or providing us with clues that lead us to the hacking software they use are both great ways to help us deal with the issue. We are sincerely thankful for your help in battling them!
Finally, thank you all for your love and support of Conqueror's Blade. We will do our utmost to protect the world of Conqueror's Blade from those doing it harm.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade February 4th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on February 4th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) [Oxen Might] Challenges

The end of the Lunar year approaches, and so we have prepared new Spring Festival-themed actions and appearances to herald the new year. After the version maintenance, the [Oxen Might] challenges will be available within the Season Challenges menu.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3c2daaf8d09677e20c3150a1a719d50115b28b2c.png

First Challenge: Reaching Season Level 8 grants the Action [New Year].
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c99e10c2d301828bbfedb987ff402c39c0546bf7.png

Second Challenge: Reaching Season Level 25 grants the Unit Banner [Oxen Might].
Third Challenge: Reaching Season Level 45 grants the Hero Attire [Noyan's Wolfskin].
Fourth Challenge: Reaching Season Level 66 grants the Action [Shaky Shake].
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a0dc132d4082f531b1b764128fe19db93ae962e2.jpg

Fifth Challenge: Reaching Season Level 88 grants the permanent fireworks item [Oxen Might].

These challenges will run for 4 weeks, from February 4th (after maintenance), 2021, through March 4th (before maintenance), 2021. Enjoy them while they're available!

2) Fire Lancer Officer's Attire Quests

Your old friend the War Scholar once again has valuable information. From what he can tell, the Artisan has taken a deep interest in the Fire Lance Cavalry's armor. Why don't you check with the War Scholar? (The new quests become available after completion of the [Knights of Flame (Part IV)] quest)
Acquire 100 [Battered Armour Scraps] while on the quest to obtain the Northern Lance Cavalry exclusive attire [Fire Lancer Officer's Attire]. This unit attire is composed of the Fire Lancer Officer's Helm, Fire Lancer Officer's Armour, and Northern Cavalry Set (mount).
After this week's maintenance until March 4th, 00:00, [Battered Armour Scraps] can be obtained via matchmaking. What's more, after completing the [Fire Lancer Officer (I)] quest, you will be able to complete the [Fire Lancer Officer Daily Battle] quest each day. The daily quest is completed by playing 2 [Siege or Field] battles and grants 3 [Battered Armour Scraps].

3) Doctrines Pool Changes

Removed Doctrines:
1. Barber-Surgeon
2. Rare Melee Cavalry
3. Epic Arquebus

New Doctrines:
1. The Carrion Bird's Banquet:
- Initiative: Increases damage dealt to cavalry by 120. [Pikeman/Shortsword & Shield Units]
- Stalwart: Increases piercing defence and slashing defence by 80. [Shortsword & Shield Units]

2. The Bowman's Wrath: 
- Perfect Aim: Increases damage dealt to ranged units by 350. [Ranged Units]

3. The Field of Broken Lances: 
- Harden: Reduces arrow damage taken by 100 and increases damage dealt to ranged units by 100. [Melee/Cavalry Units]

4) Artillery Balance Changes & Improvements

[Siege Ballista]:
1. The damage [Siege Ballista] deals against Siege Towers, Gates, Battering Ram (or other destructible objects) is reduced by 50%.
2. The [Epic Siege Ballista]'s health has reduced to 8,500 (was previously 12,938).

5) General Improvements

1. Harbors will no longer count toward House/Alliance ranking.

6) Map Improvements

1. Adjusted the supply point distribution on the [Kurak Castle] map so as to prevent units from getting stuck in narrow passages.

7) Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where the [Northern Lance Cavalry]'s Valour skill wouldn't deal damage as intended.
2. Resolved an issue with actions when performed by male poleaxe heroes.
3. Resolved an issue where mounts could be used in Ungverijan taverns.

8) Drop Changes

1. Added a new drop for Clearing Ruins and Suppressing the Bandits—[Battle Reports].
2. Drop removed from Clearing Ruins and Suppressing the Bandits—[Royal Letters].

9) Military Exercise Schedule

Military Exercises will be available on February 13th (Saturday), and February 16th (Tuesday).

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter]
notes.content:
Winter is upon us, and the spirit of battle blazes on. Conqueror's Blade League has returned once again. We're looking forward to seeing your amazing performances, Warlords! Players from the MENA server Sandstorm Gorge (SG) will have a chance to form a squad and contend to become the champion! The champion and runner-up of the MENA Division will get to represent MENA in the cross-region tournament to come.

1) Tournament Run Time

Sign Up Time: 1/31/2021, 19:00 - 2/28/2021 18:59 (UTC+3)
Roster & Schedule Announcement: 3/1/2021 (UTC+3)
MENA Division Tournament: 3/13/2021, 12:00-13:30 (UTC+3)

2) Tournament Rules

1. Tournament Version & Client:
(1) Tournament Version: Same as the version of the official servers.
(2) Client: Steam/Official Website Client
(3) Server: MN Tournament Server
Note: Warlords on the server Sandstorm Gorge (SG) below level 100 cannot join the MN Tournament Server.
2. Match Modes:
(1) Siege Battles
Map Pool: Augolia, Continopolis, Valley Fortress, Kurak Castle, Wall Fort, and Harbour City.
Siege Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
-	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Victory Conditions:
-	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
-	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.

(2) Field Battle, Capture the Flag
Map Pool: Grassland Assault
Field Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
Victory Conditions:
-	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
-	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
Draw & Extra Match Rules:
-	Played on Grassland Assault.
-	The two squads switch side.
-	Victory conditions remain unchanged.

3) Tournament Mode:

Ruleset: Best of 3
Match Rules: The two squads' captains roll.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
a.	The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
b.	And then the other squad bans one map.
c.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.

4) Participation Requirements

1. Requirements:
- How to Sign Up:
The tournament servers will be available from January 31st, 19:00 to February 28th, 18:59 (UTC+3). To participate, simply log in to the game as usual and select the MN Tournament Server from the server list. Then create a squad by following these steps:
1. Create a new character on the Tournament Server. The character's name should be in the following format: [Squad Abbreviation_Original Character's Name]. For example: CBL_Snowstorm.
* The squad abbreviation must not exceed three English characters.
* Should the new character's name exceed the name-length cap, kindly RETAIN the abbreviation and simply adjust the original character's name accordingly. 
2. Create a house on the Tournament Server. The house name should be identical to your squad's name and must be in English. For example: CBhouse.
3. Leave the squad captain's contact information in the House Announcement (Discord).
4. Once you have created a house, make sure that all squad members create characters on the Tournament Server and join said house (they should be from the same server as you).
5. And a final note: To complete the sign up, ensure that your squad between 15 and 20 members when the Sign Ups conclude, and that's it!
What's more, all squads that sign up will receive a small gift as a token of our gratitude!

- Drafting Rules:
1. Characters created on the MN Tournament Server will automatically be linked with all other characters on Sandstorm Gorge (SG). This helps us calculate the season level of each player.
2. If a squad member has multiple characters Sandstorm Gorge (SG), their character with the highest season level will be counted toward the squad's score.
3. A squad's score is equal to the combined level of its 15 members with the highest level.
4. The 2 squads with the highest score will be eligible to take part.

- Notes: 
1. Please note, squads must have a member count of between 15 and 20 to sign up successfully.
2. Duplicate signups are forbidden. Should we at the time of tallying score, find that a player has several characters on the tournament server and be part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament.
3. Signups conclude on 2/28/2021, 18:59, UTC+3. After which no squad may alter their member roster.
4. Should you not to leave any contact information (Discord) and we fail to get in contact with your squad, your signup will be annulled.
5. The champion and runner up houses of the MENA Division will also receive an extra reward: a differently-colored name in the House List. 'House squads' refer to squads where all members are from the same house.
6. The total season level of house squads will be tallied according to players' levels as of 2/28/2021, 18:59 (UTC+3).
7. The season level of all participants will be made public.

5) Code of Conduct

1. Rematches & Pauses:
(1) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament, and there will be no rematches once a game has begun.
(2) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
(3) No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.
2. Tournament Prohibitions
(1) Cheating is prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this, then the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
(2) Obstructive Conducts: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
(3) Punctuality: All participants must listen to and cooperate with the referees, and to be ready at the appointed time. If a squad fails to invite enough members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
(4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Should a name violate these conventions, referees may rule that that player's squad lose the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
(5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.
(6) Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of.
(7) Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.

6) Rewards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/30cd69a9991617941db05288d562a1d62adfb423.png

7) Tournament Inquiries

Should you have any questions whatsoever regarding the Conqueror's Blade League, feel free to send us an email to cb_support@boominggames.com. You may also reach us on Discord, as well as Steam Community. Wish you the best of luck!
The final interpretation rights of this event's rules belong to the Conqueror's Blade team.

-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, the winner of the roll chooses whether to attack or defend first. The sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
a.	The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
b.	And then the other squad bans one map.
c.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.

(2) Division Final
Ruleset: Best of 5
Match Rules:  
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: 
Match 1: The squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether they attack or defend first.
Match 2: The two squads switch sides.
Match 3: The squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether they attack or defend first.
Match 4: The two squads switch sides.
Match 5 (if needed): Field Battle, Capture the Flag, randomized attack/defend 
-	Map Ban & Pick:
a．	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
b．	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
c．	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
-	Maps:
a.	Round One: Augolia
b.	Round Two: Decided by the two squads' Ban & Pick outcome.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads play Siege Battles against each other in accordance to the attack/defend order on the maps selected.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 3 points win.
-	Should the first four matches result in each squad gaining 2 points, then the fifth match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and an extra match is played. Only one squad may receive a point from the extra match.
3) Participation Requirements
1. Requirements:
(1) Seeded Squads:
The following squads have been seeded to participate in the Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter CBL tournament.
Crusaders, TakeOver, ChristmasSale, and BROTHERHOOD.
After receiving the invitation, the lieges of these houses should create a squad following the [Squad Requirements] further down in this document. Once done, notify the tournament team with your squad information to partake.
    
(2) Squad Signups
- How to Sign Up:
The tournament servers will be available from February 1st to February 28th, 23:59 (UTC+8). To participate, simply log in to the game as usual and select the Tournament Server from the server list. Then create a squad by following these steps:
1. Create a new character on the Tournament Server. The character's name should be in the following format: [Squad Abbreviation_Original Character's Name]. For example: CBL_Snowstorm.
* The squad abbreviation must not exceed three English characters.
* Should the new character's name exceed the name-length cap, kindly RETAIN the abbreviation and simply adjust the original character's name accordingly. 
2. Create a house on the Tournament Server. The house name should be identical to your squad's name and must be in English. For example: CBhouse.
3. Leave the squad captain's contact information in the House Announcement (Discord/QQ).
4. Once you have created a house, make sure that all squad members create characters on the Tournament Server and join said house (they should be from the same server as you).
5. And a final note: To complete the sign up, ensure that your squad between 15 and 20 members when the Sign Ups conclude, and that's it!
What's more, all squads that sign up will receive a small gift as a token of our gratitude!

- Drafting Rules:
1. Characters created on the Tournament Server will automatically be linked with all other characters on that account. This helps us calculate the Ranked Battle score of each player.
2. If the squad captain has characters on several servers or several characters on the same server, their character with the highest Ranked Battle score will be used. Their squad will also be considered as being from that server.
3. If a squad member has characters on several servers or several characters on the same server, their character with the highest Ranked Battle score on the Squad Captain's server will be selected.
4. A squad's score is equal to the combined Ranked Battle score of the 15 members with the highest score.
5. The number of squads we draft from each of the LA, DI and JC servers depend on the number of signed-up squads on these servers with a squad score of at least 15,000. Owing that the JC server launched in the Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter season, at least 2 squads from JC will be drafted into Conqueror's Blade League.
6. The squads of these servers with the highest score will be eligible to take part.
7. Apart from the seeded squads, we will be inviting 24 squads.

- Notes: 
1. Please note, squads must have a member count of between 15 and 20 to sign up successfully.
2. Duplicate signups are forbidden. Should we at the time of tallying score, find that a player has several characters on the tournament server and be part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament.
3. The same squad may not have members from different servers. Which server a squad belongs to depends on the squad captain's character with the highest Ranked Battle score.
4. Signups conclude on 2/28/2021, 23:59, UTC+8. After which no squad may alter their member roster.
5. Should you not to leave any contact information (Discord/QQ) and we fail to get in contact with your squad, your signup will be annulled.
6. Asia Pacific Division's top four house squads will also receive an extra reward: a differently-colored name in the House List. 'House squads' refer to squads where all members are from the same house.
7. The total Ranked Battle score of house squads will be tallied according to players' score as of 2/28/2021, 23:59 (UTC+8).
8. The Ranked Battle score of all participants will be made public.

4) Code of Conduct

1. Rematches & Pauses:
(1) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament, and there will be no rematches once a game has begun.
(2) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
(3) No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.
2. Tournament Prohibitions
(1) Cheating is prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this, then the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
(2) Obstructive Conducts: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
(3) Punctuality: All participants must listen to and cooperate with the referees, and to be ready at the appointed time. If a squad fails to invite enough members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
(4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violates either convention is prohibited. Should a name violate these conventions, referees may rule that that player's squad lose the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
(5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.
(6) Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of.
(7) Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.

5) Rewards

6) Tournament Inquiries

Should you have any questions whatsoever regarding the Conqueror's Blade League, feel free to send us an email to cb_support@boominggames.com. You may also reach us on the Tieba forums, Discord, as well as Steam Community. Wish you the best of luck!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade January 28th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on January 28th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Now Live: Beginnings & Journeys — Warlord Story Collection

We've learned that you Warlords are busy creating a plethora of videos for the video collection event Beginnings & Journeys. Video themes are ranging from 'House/Personal Stories', 'New Year Greetings', 'Beginner/Gameplay Guides', to 'Tactics With Commentary', and more. Out of all videos, the 12 top videos and the 5 videos with the highest popularity will be granted rewards including limited-time titles, tons of Sovereigns, and Spring Festival-themed hero and unit attires. Top videos will be sponsored on our official homepage, and the creators of the best videos will also have a chance to be signed as official Conqueror's Blade streamers. For more information check in-game via [Activities] Check details. We're looking forward to even more outstanding submissions!

2) [Northern Lance Cavalry] Balance Changes

After releasing the [Northern Lance Cavalry] unit we began collecting battle and player feedback. And so we are making the following changes: 
1. Adjusted movement and attack for the [Landslide] skill.
2. Reworked the [Flame Assault] skill: A direction is no longer required to cast the [Flame Assault] skill, and it now shoots three salvoes of Grape Shot. The number of bullets fired and the area affected has been increased, while the damage and accuracy of each bullet has been reduced.

3) Baelsink Appearance Change Notice

Baelsink's sack is just about out of presents. One week from now, the sack on the Baelsink's attire's back will shrink. Heroes wearing it once it has shrunk will drop candy as they run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3ff12da5e358b760453c3772af9a705ec0b84db9.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a0658a93ad188f5ce44bd0afb3ae10caa4a0c7e6.gif

4) New Video Output Feature

Following the maintenance on January 28th, you may now alter the video output device from within the Settings menu.
Should the system detect a change in video output device (this normally happens when you connect a new video output device), the game's settings will now automatically switch to the new one.

5) Drop Changes

1. Added a new drop for Clearing Ruins and Suppressing the Bandits—[Cellars].
2. Drop removed from Clearing Ruins and Suppressing the Bandits—[Letters].

6) Improvements & Changes

1. Improved the camera animation when beginning a battle on [Dune Hold].
2. Improved the sound effect when a supply point is occupied on the [Dune Hold] map.
3. Added Territory War timers for when it is in preparation and under progress to the World Map.
4. Improved upon how information is displayed above fiefs on the World Map.
5. You can now directly cross Border Posts.
6. Improved the effect descriptions weather and terrain has on units. These descriptions can be found by hovering over the weather icons within the deployment menu.

7) Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where the [Northern Lance Cavalry] unit would sometimes stop when attacking freely.
2. Resolved an issue where the [Expedition Knight] unit's [Piety & Glory] skill wouldn't heal friendly units.
3. Resolved an issue where the [Ironcap Bowriders] unit would still be able to use ranged skills after switching to their blades.
4. Resolved an issue where the [Imperial Archers] unit wouldn't attack by themselves after switching to melee combat.
5. Resolved an issue where the item type was incorrect for items in some Ungverijan trade posts.
6. Resolved an issue where Imperial Restorationists Warlords would sometimes get the wrong amount of Acclaim from small fiefs in Territory War.
7. Resolved an issue where the Acclaim Ranking and Ennoblement Rankings of the Legacy of Fire season displayed incorrect statistics.
8. Resolved an issue making it impossible to switch page when searching for a house or alliance.
9. Resolved an issue where the background music didn't change on the World Map when day turned to night or vice versa.
10. Resolved an issue where units had a chance to stop when interacting with supply points.

notes.title: Adjustment for Third-Party Software Processing Notice
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, we have received a massive amount of information regarding third-party programs during the past few days. We have always and will continue to work hard on improving our anti-cheating technology and iterative detection systems, but fully eliminating all types of hacks is an incredibly difficult and time-consuming task. Even so, we will do our best. It is our goal to prevent as much cheating as possible, something we take very seriously, in order to create an as just game environment as possible.

For those found to have been cheating, we will take the following punitive actions (actions we will also continue to work on improving):
1.	After verifying that a player has indeed violated the rule, first time offenders will receive a 30-day ban. Should someone be found to use hacks a second time, they will be permanently banned.
2.	These new regulations will take effect on any player banned starting from January 21st. We will also adjust punitive actions against players taken from January 21st and adjust these according to the new regulations.
3.	Should anyone disagree with the handling of any report, send us the details to our e-mail, cbf_steam_support@boominggames.com. We will handle all related reports in a just and open manner. Any change in the results of a report will be published together with how the violation has been handled. All results as published by us shall prevail.
4.	Each user is responsible for any action taken on their account. Should someone use hacks on an account, even if these hacks were not used by the account’s owner, the account will still be banned.

All rights of final interpretation reserved by Conqueror’s Blade.

Herein follows a list of users that we have recently found to be using third-party software, as well as the punitive actions taken:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/151406709e00c18abfb8fdd5a85f73a9b75b0f87.png

Hacks have an incredibly adverse effect on a game as a whole. As such we will continue to work hard on preventing cheats. We take cheating seriously and aim to crack down on cheaters as much as we can to improve the game. We are deeply sorry that our handling of hackers has not always been the best, and for any bad gaming experience you have had to endure because of this. Please allow us, the Conqueror's Blade's team, to express our sincerest apologies to all of you Warlords out there.
On a last note, we'd also like to thank you for your love and continued support. It is your support that motivates us. As we together watch toward the future, we hope that Conqueror's Blade can continue to bring you joy and happiness!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League
notes.content:
The flames of war rage on as heroes stride upon the battlefield. With the beginning of a new year, we of the Conqueror's Blade League are inviting the Legacy of Fire division champions to test their skill against each other using the brand-new Snowstorm seasonal units amidst howling snowstorms! Crusaders from the Asia Pacific Division and HypaHypa from the South America Division will on January 10, 2021, battle it out in the first ever cross-continent match!

1) Tournament Run Time

[January 10, 11:00 AM, 2021 (UTC +8)] [January 9, 23:00 PM, 2021 (GMT -4)]

2) Tournament Rules

1. Tournament Version & Client:
(1) Tournament Version: Same as the version of the official servers.
(2) Client:  Steam/Official Website Client
(3) Server:  Kindly follow our guidance and replace your local files accordingly, then restart the game client to access the Cross Division Server and create a character.
2. Match Modes:
(1) Siege Battles
Map Pool: 
Continopolis, Valley Fortress, Kurak Castle, Wall Fort, Harbour City, and Dasuo Fort (battles will take place on snow-themed variants).
	Siege Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
-	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
	Victory Conditions:
-	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
-	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.

(2) Field Battle, Capture the Flag
Map Pool: Grassland (snow-themed variant)
Field Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
Victory Conditions:
-	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
-	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
Draw Rules:
-	Extra matches will be played on Grassland with the two squads switching sides until a winner has been decided.

（3) Tournament Mode:

Participants: The reigning champions from the Asia Pacific and South America Divisions.
Having been invited by us, the two squad captains should each create a team with up to 20 members and submit their roster in the form of an excel document.
Ruleset: Best of 3
Match Rules: 
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, who attacks and who defends is decided via a roll in the tournament channel, the winner can choose the sides and the sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
a.	The squad who lost the roll bans the first map.
b.	Then the winner bans the second map.
c.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, an extra match is played. Only one squad may receive a point from the extra match.

3) Match Order

1. Rematches & Pauses:
	(1) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament.
	(2) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
	(3) Each squad is responsible for their members' Internet connection. And the match will not be restarted should anyone disconnect after it has begun. 
	(4) No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.
2. Code of Conduct:
	(1) Cheating is prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this, then the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
	(2) Obstructive Conducts: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, they referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
	(3) Punctuality: Participants must at all times cooperate with and follow the referees' guidance and should partake in the contest according to the schedule.
	(4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violates the conventions is prohibited. Should a name violate these conventions, referees may rule that that player's squad lose the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
	(5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.
	(6) Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of.

4) Rewards

Participating Squads	Sealed Flame Emblem x500
Ungverijan Message x10
Snowstorm Weapon Attire Selection Box x1

5) Tournament Inquiries

	Should you have any questions whatsoever regarding the Conqueror's Blade League, feel free to contact us on cb_support@boominggames.com. You may also reach us on the Tieba forums, Discord, as well as Steam Community. Wish you the best of luck!
	The final interpretation rights of this event's rules belong to the Conqueror's Blade team.

5.  Resolved an issue where the Declare War list couldn't be scrolled through when too many fiefs had been declared war against.


 Stage & Unit Bug Fixes:

5.  Resolved an issue where a group of ladders on the right wall couldn't be raised in the [Augolia] Siege Battle.
6.  Resolved an issue where some of the Yeomen's unit tree nodes wouldn't work for the Tundra Yeomen unit.
7.  Resolved an issue where, when using the Alp Halberdiers' Power Charge skill against a narrow opening, the units would clump together.
8.  Resolved an issue where the Inner Growth data of Yeomen would carry over to Tundra Yeomen after promotion.


 General Bug Fixes:

9.  - Resolved an issue where some mount attributes would be displayed erroneously.
10.  Resolved an issue where characters on the same account did not share progress on weekly sign-in quests.
11.  Resolved an issue where the Open World would be reset upon exiting to the character selection screen.
12.  Resolved an issue where some hero actions couldn't be salvaged at the Artisan.
13.  Adjusted the Bronze Coin price of some limited-time attires.


 Scene & Effect Bug Fixes

14.  Resolved an issue where liquid wouldn't flow properly when Tavern NPCs were drinking.
15.  Resolved an issue where the Byzantine Hegemon attire's cape would get stuck in front of the character.
16.  Resolved an issue where sounds wouldn't keep up when using multiple Unit Medals in a row.
17.  Resolved an issue where the sound of flowing water couldn't be heard while near rivers in the Trade Colonies.
18.  Resolved an issue where the cape and gloves of the female fame attire would sometimes clash.
19.  Resolved an issue where it was possible to mount near some of the tavern's walls.

2) Improvements

1. Improved how units retreat after the hero dies. Warlords may now actively command units to retreat. Units will now also automatically begin retreating 5 seconds before the hero respawns (was 10 seconds after the hero dies).
2.  Added a new feature to Settings allowing players to turn off Territory War broadcasts.
3.  Information regarding the occupying House and Alliance will now be displayed for fiefs, resource points, ports, and trade ports on the World Map.
4.  Added a new drop for Clearing Ruins and Suppressing the Bandits—[Journals].
5.  When fighting against bandits in fiefs, a character without units will no longer be force-kicked from the battle upon dying.
6. Item information shared in the chat window will now change to reflect the user's client language.
7.  Battle effects have been added for resource sites when an assault upon them is initiated.
8.  Added the ability to use multiple Unit Medals at once. We will continue working on enabling this for other items as well when we see a need for it.
9. Adjusted the refresh time of bandit ruins in Ostaria. The refresh interval between each round of bandit attacks have been changed to 1-1.5 hours.
10. Added Donation value to items that can be donated. When accessing the Collect Resources menu, the tips window of donatable items will now display that item's Donation value.
11. Added an option to show more detailed tooltip information on the World Map when placing the pointer over certain places.
12. During Territory War, information has now been added to the interact menu of resource sites, trade ports, and trade posts regarding which house is occupying it.

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on December 24, 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community.

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profited from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list:

1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
5) It contains statements that violate any law.

The following is a list of players who have penalized this time:

Two Punishment mechanism for Negative Attitude:

2)Matchmaking Bans - In duration time, only Standard Battles-Training Camp is available, banned players are not able to join other matched games. And the time of bans duration only reduced when character is online.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade December 24th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on December 24th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Improvements to Resource Donations

Now that is has been available for a time, we have received feedback from the community regarding the donation of resources. And it is our goal to further improve upon this feature in future versions.
And so, in this week's update we have done the following changes: 
1. Added additional information to the Collect Resources info. You can now see the 6 weekly donation requirements: 500, 1,000, 1,600, 2,100, 2,800, and 3,600.
2. We've also adjusted the amount of Ostarian Royalty fame you get upon completing a donation. It is no longer subject to any randomization, and for each of the 6 donations you will get the following Ostarian Royalty fame: 55, 110, 175, 240, 310, and 440, for a total of 1,330 fame.
For future versions:
- In coming versions, we will be adjusting the donation requirements depending on the situation in Ostaria, so be sure to check the donation requirements each week.
What's more, you needn't worry that it will be too difficult to acquire [Ostarian Royalty Fame]. Once available later on, fame can also be gained from the following game modes: [Clearing Ruins], [Suppressing Bandits], and [Rebuilding Ruins].

2) Quest Improvements

1. Adjusted the completion requirements of the quest [Multi-faceted Alliance]. Warlords with a donation value exceeding 0 will now be able to complete it directly upon accepting it.
2. Adjusted the completion requirements of the quest [Forward Grain]. Previously you had to collect 10,000 Food on the World Map, this has now been changed to acquire 10,000 Food (viable sources: World Map collection, buying from the Market or defeating bandits).
3. Adjusted the completion requirements of the weekly quest [Fields of Glory]. You may now complete it by playing a certain number of Field Battles whereas you previously had to attain a certain number of wins.
4. Reduced the difficulty of the weekly quest [Heroic Exploits]. The number of units to be killed has been reduced to 300 down from 500.
5. Reduced the difficulty of the weekly quest [Valour]. The number of heroes to be killed has been reduced to 2 down from 4.
6. Reduced the difficulty of the weekly quest [Bombardier]. The number of units to kill with artilleries has been reduced to 80 down from 120.

3) Market Suggested Price Changes

1. Equipment without attributes will have their suggested price limited on the Market. Such a restriction is not in place for equipment rare equipment or better with attributes.
2. As [luxury goods] have a rather high donation value, we have increased their suggested price cap in the Market to 10,000 Silver Coins.

4) Improvements

1. Map improvements:
- Added icons to show exhausted resource sites, as well as a timer.
- Added a view mode enabling you to hide all city icons.
2. Added a button to switch between near and far views on the World Map, and a Browse mode.
3. Improved the cutscene, as well as the sounds, music, and NPC speech when first entering Turul Város and Ostaria.
4. Made the circle around flags when capturing them clearer so as to be more easily discernable in snowy weather.
5. Resolved an issue where the water flowed too quickly in rivers of the Trade Colonies.
6. Added snowy season effects to the F5 and P menus.
7. Added a sound effect when using Unit Medals (including General Unit Medals).
8. Added a Battle Pass image to the O menu. Clicking the image will take you to the Season menu.

5) Graphic Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where the tavern NPC [Drunkard Dario]'s cup model would clash.
2. Resolved an issue where the shoulder guards' spikes on the male Frost Steel Armour attire wouldn't be attached to the shoulder guards.
3. Resolved an issue where Influence would only display with 4 digits on the Imperial Restorationists map.
4. Resolved an issue where the 'Follow Leader' icons would overlap.
5. Resolved an issue where Influence for Augolia was not displayed on the map.
6. Resolved an issue where the Knight-Errant mask and icon didn't match.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/faee2f948f26cf329a48636b57c0642235bbf965.jpg

6) Sound Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where the hero action animations and 3d sound effects did not match.
2. Resolved an issue where there would be no sound when collecting from resource sites on the World Map.
3. Resolved an issue with reverberation sounds when hearing sounds outside the tavern while being inside it.
4. Resolved an issue where tavern sounds where unaffected by sound settings.
5. Resolved an issue where the sound of some actions wouldn't be played when adding markers to the World Map.
6. Resolved an issue where the enter and exit icons on the World Map didn't have any sound effects.
7. Resolved an issue where, in the English version, players couldn't set the video when entering Ungverija to English.
8. Resolved an issue where there would be no sound when interacting with certain maps.

7) Stage Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where Demesne Arbalists had a rather high chance of not launching any ranged attack in PvE stages.
2. Resolved an issue where the clothing style of AI heroes didn't match in the Augolia tutorial stage.
3. Resolved an issue where, in the weapon tutorial, players that selected the same weapon in phase 2 as they had in phase 1 couldn't continue to the next phase.
4. Resolved an issue where, when attacks from some artilleries hit enemies and applied debuffs (such as burn), such kills would not count toward weekly challenges progress for units killed with artilleries.
5. Resolved an issue with the smoke effects outside of the city on the [Augolia (Siege Battle)] map.

8) General Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where players could access the season menu via Promotion before the feature was available.
2. Resolved an issue with the counter of the weekly quest [Heroic Exploits].
3. Resolved an issue with the counter of the weekly quest [Field Officer].
4. Resolved an issue with the counter of the weekly quest [Booming Delight].
5. Resolved an issue where some parts of the weekly challenge quests would appear blank.
6. Resolved an issue where the bonus Ostaria Influence from Ungverija and Continopolis were incorrect. It has now been changed to 1,000.
7. Resolved an issue where players that completed the Barcyan Wildflame season challenge's fourth phase couldn't claim the final reward.
8. Resolved an issue where after the Military Exercise, the World Map did not switch to Territory War so ongoing battles did not show.
