notes.title: “Jaderock Creek”Server Launch Celebration
Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter Update Log
notes.content:
Winter in Ostaria

Following the Eternal City's fall, the land was wrought with snowstorms and blizzards, a period which would later become known as the Little Ice Age. Ostaria had seen peace for several years and no one was prepared for the land being covered entirely in snow.
Terrible weather not seen in a thousand years and rumors of the Scourge are on everyone's minds. The people of Ostaria flood to Ungverija, spreading news of the disasters that plague their land. The Ungverijan royals are preparing to act. And while they are faced with the powerful Terrakoz Empire to the south, their eyes are set on Ostaria.
Ostaria is wrought by internal strife as well as ravaged by invaders. But what will the final fate of Ostaria be?

Dynamic Weather System

Snow on the World Map is no longer only for decoration, but Warlords that traverse snowy regions will have their movement speed reduced. And areas with snow will no longer be able to supply itself with food rations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5c576a3fc8f3828ad1fe0c7d678398cac6bcfd3f.png

   We have improved upon how weather works in the Scourge of Winter season, with weather playing a greater role than ever before. We have given each region a climate befitting of its geographic location. Different weather effects will have a greater or smaller chance to appear depending on the climate and whether or not it is spring, summer, fall, or winter. For example, winters in Ostaria tend to be white, whereas those in Bartholia are likely to be quite pleasant with much rainfall.
What's more, weather will affect fiefs (including in Territory War), and so different strategies will have to be adopted depending on the weather conditions.
Fiefs' weather can be checked via the World Map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/94b187a85422a502f2c03da14df2f01c1a1008a6.png


 Ostaria: Hot and humid during the summer; cold and arid during the winter. Affected by the Little Ice Age, the entire land of Ostaria is overcome with snow.


 Ungverija: The northern parts are affected by the Little Ice Age, and is wrought with snow. Summers in the south are hot and arid, winters temperate and rainy.


 Bartholia: The northern parts are hot and arid in the summer, and temperate and rainy in the winter. The southern part, the desert, is arid all year round.


 The Borderlands: The northern parts border on Ostaria and are also affected by the Little Ice Age. Much of the south lie on a higher altitude and have complex weather.


Winter in Ungverija

Ungverija is also suffering from a harsh winter, but the effects are comparatively small seeing as it is far south. What's more, Ungverija is defending their border posts tooth and nail, and have not been assaulted by the Scourge.
While the people of Ungverija gather in the warm cozy taverns, the people of Ostaria shiver in the winter winds. Ungverija was defeated in their previous war against Ostaria and was forced to give up land and sign a peace treaty. But now the Ungverijans have a chance to exact revenge. Ungverija's monarch is sizing up the different nations and wish to use this chance to their advantage, and claim as much of Ostaria's land as possible for himself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c86de28bb6621da91ac46174bbee8d4c28c88cff.png

Tavern Talk

Warlord, winter has come. How about a mug of wine to warm yourself? An all-new tavern in Turul Város is now open for business! A tavern you can enter and peruse to your liking. Bachan the Tavernkeep is ready to welcome Warlords from near and far to sit by his warm hearth. Oh? Seeking information? How about a mug first?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b81403f3ca78e5a3ef22c994718980db5e18ab8c.png

Expedition Information

Dark forces surge from the north. And so, our Warlords join in on the expedition to quell them. We have added a new challenge quest series which when completed grants handsome rewards, and each challenge unveils more information about the Scourge of Winter.

Reclaiming Ostaria

Campaign
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a253ef428cd4c5e1aeaf3b74bd5ac0695a19e88c.png

	The harsh weather does not stem the warriors' fighting spirit and the flames of war still burn high in Ungverija.
	Territory War is flaring out in Ungverija during this phase.
	More Campaign content will become available as more and more of the Scourge's secrets are unveiled.
At the very beginning of this season, warlords can only choose Ungverija as the expedition target. As the season processes, the rest of regions will be opened gradually.

Clearing Ruins

Ostaria having frozen over, many fiefs were assaulted by the Scourge becoming nothing but ruins.
And so, the Ostarian Royalty requests the aid of the Auctioneers and the rulers of each region. Mercenary warlords naturally also join this epic-scale counterattack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/31a9de9ffd84bb1c92fa3841d86d47e8623e2cb0.png

During the beginning of the season many of the ruins will be taken by bandits. Head to Ostaria via the available border posts and organize groups to take out bandits in such ruins. (Recommend to form groups)
Clearing a ruins of the bandits camped within grant handsome rewards and Ostarian Royalty fame. Gaining fame unlocks more rewards in the Fame Shop. (Up to 3 rewards can be gained per week)
As the road is long and arduous, the Auctioneers have prepared quick travel routes there from the various capitals. Once a Warlord reaches 1,000 fame, he can talk to [Quartermaster] in Turul Város for a quick travel to [Kiefernburg].

Aiding the Royalty

The Ostarian Royalty will continue to organize assaults against these bandits, which may be joined via the Matchmaking interface [J] – [Field Battle] - [Join Battle] to take part in. Upon joining you will be pitted against bandits of a random difficulty. Clearing them out grants Ostarian Royalty fame and random item rewards. Up to 5 rewards can be gained per week.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d9f02269038e545ac1f9ab93be394503a2303c52.png

Rebuild Ruins

After much hard work from the various factions and our Warlords, peace has gradually returned to Ostaria come week three of the season. And so, the time has come to rebuild the land. Head to Ostaria and donate resources to ruins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/121ae589ae4e8827c841a8f4626a0ef9f3cdbbea.png

Completing construction quests grant Ostarian Royalty fame, as well as Contribution for your house (cohort). Once a fief has been rebuilt, its ownership will fall to the house that tops the ranking for that fief (or the NPC faction if the rank one is a cohort).
What's more, the top five houses in contribution will receive permanent Area Influence lasting throughout the season.

Donating in Capitals

[Quartermaster] can be found in each capital, and they are collecting resources to help support and rebuild Ostaria.
Talk to a Quartermaster and donate the required weapons, schematics, kits, or luxury goods to gain Ostarian Royalty fame as well as random rewards. Each Warlord may donate up to 6 batches of resources per week.

Fame Shop

The Ostarian Royalty provides handsome rewards to Warlords who help them quell the bandits. Items in the Fame Shop require a certain amount of fame to be purchased.
Ostarian Royalty fame can be gained via the aforementioned game modes (Clear Ruins, Suppress Bandits, Rebuild Ruins and Donate Resources).
A plethora of items from previous seasons will be on sale in the shop, including hero actions, epic attire sets, epic mounts, epic attire set schematics, different colours for this season's attires, and more!

Regional Capital Contention Information (Starts on week 7)

We launched regional capitals in the Legacy of Fire season, as well as the contention for Daicheng (Liangyun), Turul Város (Ungverija), and Continopolis (Bartholia).
Unless otherwise stated by an announcement, regional capitals will be present in Territory War for future seasons. The contention of which will decide the season's Hegemon and Monarch.


 Region Capitals

A region's capital is that region's most important city.
The various region capitals will be available on different times depending on a season's Campaign progress.


 Core Region

The game's core region will change depending on each season's theme.
Core regions will be contended for according to the same rules as other regions.
Fiefs in core regions grant 1.3 times the Influence of a similar fief of another region.
The Hegemon title is gained by claiming the core region's capital.


 Region Influence

Region Influence is equal to the total influence of all land the alliance or house owns within that region. Influence is a display of an alliance's power in said region.
Capitals of non-core region capitals will grant an extra 1000 Influence in the core region.


 Declaring War Region Capitals

An alliance must have a region influence of at least 3000 in order for its houses to declare war against that region's capital.
To declare war against the core region's capital, an alliance's ruling house must have a region influence of at least 4000.
Should an attacking or defending alliance lose their qualification to declare war, their members will no longer be able to take part in battles of that region capital. Warlords that have already started a battle may complete said battle.


 Attack Order

The order in which alliances may assault a region capital follows a strict order. Houses will be ordered depending on Region Influence.
	Once the Territory War preparation concludes, alliances that declare war against the city will be ordered from high to low depending on their Region Influence. Following this order alliances may contend for the region's capital.
	The ruling house of the alliance with the highest Region Influence will be placed first in the attack order.
	Should two or more alliances have equal Influence, they will be ordered depending on the time when they declared war.
Once the preparation has ended and the order has been set, the order in which the alliances my contend for a city will remain unchanged. This holds true even if there are further fluctuations in Influence while Territory War is in progress.
Should an alliance fail to launch an attack for 3 minutes after gaining the ability to do so, they will instead be placed at the end of the attack order.
Should an alliance fail to successfully occupy the city, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
If a house that meet the requirements declare war against the city while Territory War is in progress, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
Should a house for some reason be removed from the attack order, they will be placed at the bottom should they rejoin.


 Defense & Assault of Elite Imperial Restorationists

Imperial Restorationists with a position of at least Decanos or Second Lieutenant may protect region capitals.
Kits are not consumed for Imperial Restorationists when defending a region capital.
Should the Imperial Restorationists lose a region capital, they will not be able to reclaim that city during this season.


 Region Capital Permissions & Rewards

The owner of a region capital may not upgrade fiefs or adjust fief permissions in such a way that it would affect the normal gameplay of other Warlords.
	Region capitals will not be degraded when assaulted.
The owner of a region capital will receive tribute from fiefs.
The liege of the ruling house of an alliance that occupies a region capital has a chance at attaining the title of Hegemon or Monarch.
	Attaining the title of Hegemon
	 Be part of the alliance that successfully occupies the core region's capital.
	 Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.
	 The alliance must have a Total Influence of at least 8,000 (Total Influence refers to Influence from all fiefs, and extra Influence gained from occupying other region capitals does not count toward this).
A Warlord that attains the title of Hegemon will receive an exclusive attire when the season concludes.
If the liege of the alliance's ruling house receives the title of Hegemon, the lieges of that alliance's other houses will receive the title of Chamberlain.
A player that receives the title of Hegemon will not also be granted the title of Monarch.


 Attaining the title of Monarch


Be part of an alliance that successfully occupies a region capital.
	Should an alliance occupy the core region's capital but not have a Total influence exceeding 8000, i.e., not meeting the requirements for the Hegemon title, they will instead gain the title of Monarch should they meet the requirements.
	Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.

 The XP Pool has a cap of 1,000,000 XP, after which no further XP can be added to it.


 XP in the XP Pool can be used to level up units. You can level up units in level increments up to their maximum level.


 Signaculum cannot be used to directly add XP. Instead, they can be salvaged for XP granting items.

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on December 17, 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community.

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profited from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list:

1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
5) It contains statements that violate any law.

The following is a list of players who have penalized this time:

1.	[Hack Users]Permanent Banned:
2.	[Inappropriate Speech] Muted for 7 days.

CO*****
单*****
Ch*****
Ah*****

3.	[Negative Attitude]
Two Punishment mechanism for Negative Attitude:

1)Make Amends - Earn a specific rating in Standard Battles-Training Camp for several times. The rating requirement and times settings are based on the severity of negative attitude

2)Matchmaking Bans - In duration time, only Standard Battles-Training Camp is available, banned players are not able to join other matched games. And the time of bans duration only reduced when character is online.

Here is the list of warlords punished for negative attitude:

叛*****5 Standard Battles-Training Camp games + Matchmaking bans for 5 hours
火箭*****5 Standard Battles-Training Camp games + Matchmaking bans for 5 hours

4.	The following players were reported by other Warlords and have been found to violate the rules. We have verified their actions and have taken punitive measures against them.

魔喵*****5 Standard Battles-Training Camp games + Matchmaking bans for 5 hours
神圣*****20 Standard Battles-Training Camp games + Account bans for 72 hours
翼骑*****20 Standard Battles-Training Camp games + Account bans for 72 hours

We will continue to monitor the gaming status of the above players, and if the same violations occur again, they will be subject to more severe penalties.

In order to create a healthy environment for the community, and better everyone's gaming experience, the Conqueror's Blade Operations Team will be unwavering in our fight against hack or farm bot. We won't let slide any uncivilized language in any channel. Warlords are welcome to report any of the above game violations to us. As long as we work together, we can surely create a friendly and stable gaming environment. Thanks for your support of the Conqueror's Blade.

Please report to this Email: cbf_steam_support@boominggames.com

If you have any questions about the results of our process or need to make a complaint, please also contact us at the above email address.

Conqueror's Blade Operations Team
December 17, 2020

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade December 17th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on December 17th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:00-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins and 300 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Limited-time Doctrine Changes

We have adjusted the acquisition of limited-time doctrines so as to improve upon the experience. End of season results will no longer affect the acquisition or validity length of limited-time doctrines.

2) Event Changes

As the Conqueror's Blade League's finals will be held on December 19th (Saturday), Territory War will be canceled for the day. A Deathmatch event stage will be available in its place.

3) Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue where the mailbox icon would appear as if there were new mails when there weren't.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League — Expedition Season
notes.content:
The flames of war rage on as heroes stride upon the battlefield. The Legacy of Fire season is nearing its end, and another Conqueror's Blade League is about to begin. Squads from the Asia Pacific Division as well as China Mainland Division will be fighting it out and contend for the glory of becoming the ultimate champion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/caee4e21abd6078a27c97edcaecc777a9ea82229.png

1) Tournament Run Time

    December 19, 2020, 19:00-22:00
    December 20, 2020, 19:00-22:00 

2) Tournament Rules

1. Tournament Version & Client:
(1) Tournament Version: Same as the version of the official servers.
(2) Client:
-	Asia Pacific: Steam/Official Website Client
-	China Mainland: NetEase Client
(3) Server:
-	Asia Pacific: Tournament Server
-	China Mainland: Conqueror's Blade Tournament Server
2. Match Modes:
(1) Siege Battles
Map Pool: Continopolis, Valley Fortress, Kurak Castle, Wall Fort, Harbour City, and Dasuo Fort.
	Siege Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
-	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
	Victory Conditions:
-	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
-	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.

(2) Field Battle, Capture the Flag
Map Pool: Grassland Assault
Field Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
Victory Conditions:
-	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
-	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
Draw & Extra Match Rules:
-	Played on Grassland Assault.
-	The two squads switch side.
-	Victory conditions remain unchanged.

3) Tournament Mode:

(1) Cross-Server Top 4
Participants: The runner-up and champion squads from both the Asia Pacific and Mainland China divisions.
Ruleset: Best of 3
	Match Rules: The two squads' captains play a shield sword bow guessing game (much like rock paper scissors). For more info about the rules see the 'Shield Sword Bow' section further down.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, who attacks and who defends is decided via a Shield Sword Bow guessing game, and the sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
a.	The squad who lost the Shield Sword Bow bans the first map.
b.	And then the other squad bans one map.
c.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and an extra match is played. Only one squad may receive a point from the extra match.

(2) Cross-Server Final
Ruleset: Best of 5
Match Rules: 
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: 
Match 1: The squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether they attack or defend first.
Match 2: The two squads switch sides.
Match 3: The squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether they attack or defend first.
Match 4: The two squads switch sides.
Match 5 (if needed): Field Battle, Capture the Flag, randomized attack/defend 
-	Map Ban & Pick:
a．	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
b．	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
c．	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
-	Map:
a.	Round One: Continopolis
b.	Round Two: Decided by the two squads' Ban & Pick outcome.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads play Siege Battles against each other in accordance to the attack/defend order on the maps selected.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 3 points win.
-	Should the first four matches result in each squad gaining 2 points, then the fifth match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and an extra match is played. Only one squad may receive a point from the extra match.

	(3) Shield Sword Bow Rules
Shield beats Bow, Bow beats Sword, Sword beats Shield.
3) Match Order
1. Rematches & Pauses:
	(1) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament.
	(2) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
	(3) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during matches. The match will be restarted should anyone disconnected within one minute of the match starting. Each squad will only get one chance for a restart. Should anyone disconnected when the match has run for one minute the match will continue.
   No squad will be able to change their heroes, units, etc. even should the match need to be restarted, or the referee may rule that they forfeit the match. These will once again be used as per the referee's notes.
   Should the attacking/defending side have been randomized, both squads will assume the previous side during a restart.
	(4) There will be no rematch if anyone from either squad disconnects or lags after the match has run for 1 minute.
	(5) No pauses will be allowed while a match is running.
2. Code of Conduct:
	(1) Cheating is prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this, then the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
	(2) Obstructive Conduct: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, they referee may rule that the squad loses the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.

Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violate the conventions is prohibited. Should a name violate these conventions, referees may rule that that player's squad lose the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
	(5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.

Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade December 10th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on December 10th, which will last for 4 hours and run between 12:00-16:00 (UTC +8). After the maintenance we will give all players 10,000 Bronze Coins and 400 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1）Season Rewards

The Legacy of Fire season is near its conclusion, and you will be able to claim your rewards for this season via the following means:
1、	Territory War: Claim by pressing F5 -> Expedition.
2、	Ranked Battle: Claim by pressing J -> Ranked Battle
3、	Seasonal Store: Press O and access the exchange menu, and from there you can trade in Empire Coins for the items you want.

2) [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] Battle Pass Pack Preorder

Preorders for the [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] Battle Pass Pack become available after the maintenance on December 10th, and you may preorder it in the store, accessed via the C key. Sold for 680 Sovereigns. Contains Basic [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] Season Pass x1, Treatise x1, Season XP Items, Unit Medal x10, and Bronze Coin x50,000.
Season Pass Preorder Time: From December 10th (after maintenance) to December 20th, 24:00.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1d458de0c8d47a9156aaa37cc8098eccf98b06d6.png

3) Character Transfers

The Legacy of Fire season is about to end and a new season begin. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea and Dragonrise Island.
Server Transfer Info: 
1. We estimate that server transfers will be possible from December 10th until December 16th, 22:00.
2. Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, and Dragonrise Island servers.
3. It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.
4. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred from and to the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
The Lotus Ash Sea and Dragonrise Island servers both have a character transfer cap at 300, this goes for both ingoing and outgoing transfers.
5. Characters that were created after April 6th are eligible for server transfer.

How to Transfer:
Select the character you wish to transfer and start the game. While logged in, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer. Simply click it to access the menu: Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged as 'Pending Transfer'. After the maintenance on December 17th, we will be transferring your character to the target server.

Important:
1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before December 16th, 22:00. Upon cancelling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon cancelling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.
2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.
3. You can still play on your character as per usual even though it is pending transfer.
4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friend and blacklists will be cleared. Your character will be removed from your House, Alliance/Imperial Restorationists. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.
5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, neither can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as to not lose anything.
Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.
6. Duplicate Names: 
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

4) Daicheng (Siege Battle) Balance Changes

- The battle has had its initial length extended to 13 minutes, and capturing A will extend the time by 4 minutes.
- Added 2 Supply Points to the attacking side. They have been placed on the left and right sides near the front line.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1481af3f6eccbff3560708dc49355e058684de32.jpg

5) Bug Fixes

- Resolved an issue where the description text 'Our swords mark our journey.' of Expedition Knight's Piety node was displayed in green.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League — Expedition Season Sandstorm Gorge Division
notes.content:
The flames of war rage on as heroes stride upon the battlefield. The Legacy of Fire season is nearing its end, and another Conqueror's Blade League (CBL) is about to begin. Players from Sandstorm Gorge will have a chance to form a squad and contend to become the champion! 

1) Tournament Run Time

Sign Up Time: 23TH Nov-30th Nov 11:59 pm ( UTC+3)
Schedule announcement and practice times: 1st Dec -5th Dec
	Tournament: 5TH Dec 3:00-6:00 pm.( UTC+3) 

2) Tournament Rules

1. Tournament Version & Client:
    (1) Tournament Version: Same as the version of the official servers.
    (2) Client: Steam/Official Website Client
    (3) Server: MENA Tournament Server
2. Match Modes:
(1) Siege Battles
Map Pool: Continopolis, Valley Fortress, Kurak Castle, Wall Fort, Harbour City, and Dasuo Fort.
	Siege Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
-	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
	Victory Conditions:
-	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
-	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.
(2) Field Battle, Capture the Flag
Map Pool: Grassland Assault
Field Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
Victory Conditions:
-	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
-	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
Draw & Extra Match Rules:
-	Played on Grassland Assault.
-	The two squads switch side.
-	Victory conditions remain unchanged.

3) Tournament Mode:

Ruleset: Best of 3
	Match Rules: The two squads' captains play a shield sword bow guessing game (much like rock paper scissors). For more info about the rules see the 'Shield Sword Bow' section further down.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, who attacks and who defends is decided via a Shield Sword Bow guessing game, and the sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
a.	The squad who lost the Shield Sword Bow bans the first map.
b.	And then the other squad bans one map.
c.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.

3) Participation Requirements

1. Requirements:
    - How to Sign Up:
	Once you as the squad captain has gotten your roster in order, head on over to https://forms.gle/mqYTZwEdQpjr3dvH7 to signup by uploading it.
	- Selections: 
	The 15 members with the highest season level will be counted toward the squad's score. Finally, the 4 squads with the most scores may partake. Squads' score will be tallied up as according to everyone's score on 30th Nov, 23:59 (UTC +3).

4) Code of Conduct

1. Rematches & Pauses:
	(1) Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament.
	(2) Siege Battles and Capture the Flag Field Battles require at least 12 participants per squad. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that the squad is disqualified from the tournament, giving the win to the other squad.
	(3) If a contestant disconnects while loading or is unable to enter the game, the referee may choose to re-start the game.
	(4) There will be no rematch if anyone from either squad disconnects or lags after the match has run for 1 minute.
	(5) No pauses will be allowed while a match is running.
2. Tournament Prohibitions
	(1) Cheating is prohibited: Any third-party program that alters the game content is strictly prohibited during the tournament, and it is strictly prohibited using bugs or other loop holes in your favor. If a contestant is found to have violated against this, then the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.
	(2) Obstructive Conducts: Any and all obstructive conduct is strictly prohibited during the tournament. Should a referee rule that a participant has violated this, their squad will receive a warning. For serious violations, the referee may rule that the squad is disqualified from the tournament, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
	(3) Punctuality: All participants must listen to and cooperate with the referees, and to be ready at the appointed time. If a squad fails to invite enough members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule that they have forfeited the game, giving the win to the other squad.
	(4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violate either convention is prohibited. Should a name violate these conventions, referees may rule that that player's squad is disqualified from the tournament, thereby directly promoting the other squad.
	(5) Chat Rules: Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify the squad.
	(6) Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of.
	(7) Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad.

5) Rewards

Champion	
Mercenary Attire Chest x3
Epic Barding Schematic Crate x2
Random Epic Artillery Chest (Bound) x3
Legacy of Fire Weapon Attire Selection Box x1
Participating Squads	Mercenary Attire Chest x2
Random Epic Artillery Chest (Bound) x1
Legacy of Fire Weapon Attire Selection Box x1

6) Tournament Inquiries

	Should you have any questions whatsoever regarding the Conqueror's Blade League, feel free to send us an email to cb_support@boominggames.com. You may also reach us on Discord, as well as Steam Community. Wish you the best of luck!
	The final interpretation rights of this event's rules belong to the Conqueror's Blade team.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 19th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on November 19th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

Stage Bug Fixes & Improvements

1. Adjusted the location of a Supply Point for the attackers within the [Augolia (Siege Battle)] map so that it no longer obstructs cannon fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5022c3d50fb6634dbaeb59aeb030b2c5b7924b04.png

2. Resolved an issue, where when attackers used the cannon outside B on the [Sun City (Siege Battle)] map, they would often drop beneath the platform.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/29fc8bcfb736da44097bfd6fb9a91efac8649061.png

3. Resolved an issue where the position of the Watchman of the two Bartholian Border Posts [Imre Kastély] and [Segnia] where reversed.
4. Resolved an issue where the battering ram's position deviated on [Turul Város] (Territory War).
5. Resolved an issue where interacting with a Supply Point would make some unit's skill icons disappear.
6. Resolved an issue where pathfinding would get interrupted on [Daicheng] (Territory War).
7. Resolved an issue where the searoute from [Verathia] to [Mazeri] were too close to land.
8. Resolved an issue where, after fast travelling from the Border Posts Segnia and Imre Kastély, players would end up in the wrong location.
9. Resolved an issue with pathfinding near the walls of the defender's camp in Daicheng.
10. Resolved an issue where ladders sometimes couldn't be interacted with in Bartholian fort fiefs.
11. Resolved an issue with the colours of the attackers' flag in Bartholian fort fiefs.
12. Resolved an issue where defenders could interact with the attackers' artillery foundations in Bartholian city fiefs.
13. Resolved an issue where the attackers wouldn't see any ladder icons on the map in Bartholian city fiefs.
14. Balance changes for Bartholian city and fort fiefs:
- Added more possible spawn points for attackers. Attackers joining a battle may now choose to join the battle at a point closer to the front lines.
- If the attackers have occupied the most central flag, players joining the battle may instead choose to join the battle near the city gates.

General Bug Fixes

Improvements

1. Increased the chance of a [Secret Vault] appearing upon completing a matchmaking battle.
2. Added quality-displays for hero actions to the Character menu.

4. Added a restriction for players who has their camp set up within a region capital. When attacking the region capital where their camp is located, they may only select units that are not within the city itself.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League — Expedition Season Asia Pacific Division
notes.content:
The flames of war rage on as heroes stride upon the battlefield. The Legacy of Fire season is nearing its end, and another Conqueror's Blade League (CBL) is about to begin. Players from Dragonrise Island (DI) and Lotus Ash Sea (LA) will have a chance to form a squad and contend to become the champion! The champion and runner-up of the Asia Pacific Division will get to represent Asia Pacific in the cross-region tournament to come.

1) Tournament Run Time

Sign Up Time: 10/30/2020, 12:00 - 11/22/2020, 23:59
	Roster & Schedule Announcement: 11/26/2020
	Asia Pacific Division: 11/29/2020 - 12/13/2020

2) Tournament Rules

1. Tournament Version & Client:
    (1) Tournament Version: Same as the version of the official servers.
    (2) Client: Steam/Official Website Client
    (3) Server: Tournament Server
2. Match Modes:
(1) Siege Battles
Map Pool: Continopolis, Valley Fortress, Kurak Castle, Wall Fort, Harbour City, and Dasuo Fort.
	Siege Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Each player on the attacking side may bring and deploy 2 pieces of rare-quality artillery.
-	Each player on the defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
	Victory Conditions:
-	The attacker must occupy certain flags before the time runs out.
-	The defender must defend their flags until the time runs out.
(2) Field Battle, Capture the Flag
Map Pool: Grassland Assault
Field Battle Rules:
-	15 players on each side.
-	Each player may respawn two times, and dying for the third time is final.
-	Players from both the attacking and defending side may bring and deploy 1 piece of rare-quality artillery.
-	Doctrines and unit attires will be banned during the tournament.
Attack/Defend Order Rules: Randomized
Victory Conditions:
-	Fully capturing the flag within the enemy's base.
-	Should the time run out before either side has captured their enemy's base flag, the side whose base has the most health remaining wins.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health, the side who has managed to occupy the most neutral points win.
-	Should the time run out while both bases are at 100% health and both sides have occupied an equal number of neutral points, the match is a draw and an extra match will be played.
Draw & Extra Match Rules:
-	Played on Grassland Assault.
-	The two squads switch side.
-	Victory conditions remain unchanged.

3) Tournament Mode:

(1) Division Matches
Ruleset: Best of 3
	Match Rules: The two squads' captains play a shield sword bow guessing game (much like rock paper scissors). For more info about the rules see the 'Shield Sword Bow' section further down.
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: For the first match, who attacks and who defends is decided via a Shield Sword Bow guessing game, and the sides are then switched for match two.
-	Map Ban & Pick: 
a.	The squad who lost the Shield Sword Bow bans the first map.
b.	And then the other squad bans one map.
c.	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads then play Siege Battle on each of these two maps.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 2 points win.
-	Should the first two matches result in each squad gaining 1 point, then the third match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and extra matches are played until one squad gains a point.
(2) Division Final
    Ruleset: Best of 5
Match Rules: 
-	Attacker/Defender Rules: 
Match 1: The squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether they attack or defend first.
Match 2: The two squads switch sides.
Match 3: The squad from the Winner's Bracket chooses whether they attack or defend first.
Match 4: The two squads switch sides.
Match 5 (if needed): Field Battle, Capture the Flag, randomized attack/defend 
-	Map Ban & Pick:
a．	The squad from the Loser's Bracket chooses the first map to ban.
b．	Then the squad from the Winner's Bracket bans a map.
c．	After this, each squad chooses which map they will act as the attacker on. Both squads may choose the same map.
-	Map:
a.	Round One: Continopolis
b.	Round Two: Decided by the two squads' Ban & Pick outcome.
Victory Conditions:
-	The two squads play Siege Battles against each other in accordance to the attack/defend order on the maps selected.
-	Each win grants 1 point, and the first squad to achieve 3 points win.
-	Should the first four matches result in each squad gaining 2 points, then the fifth match will be played as a Field Battle capture the flag. Should this also result in a draw, neither squad gains a point, and an extra match is played. Only one squad may receive a point from the extra match.
	(3) Shield Sword Bow Rules
Shield beats Bow, Bow beats Sword, Sword beats Shield.

3) Participation Requirements

1. Requirements:
    (1) Seeded Squads:
The following squads have been seeded to participate in the Legacy of Fire CBL tournament.
	VLR, Zeon, Ever, CMS
	After receiving the invitation, the lieges of these houses should create a squad following the [Squad Requirements] further down in this document. Once done, notify the tournament team with squad information to partake.
    (2) Squad Signups
- How to Sign Up:
The tournament servers will be available from November 2nd to November 22th. To participate, simply login to the game as usual and select the Tournament Server from the server list. Then create a squad by following these steps:
1.	Create a new character on the Tournament Server. The character's name should be in the following format: [Squad Abbreviation_Original Character's Name]. For example: BGM_Xiaoz
* The squad abbreviation must not exceed three English characters.
* Should the new name exceed the name-length cap, kindly RETAIN the abbreviation and simply adjust the original character's name accordingly. 
2.  Create a house on the Tournament Server. The house name should be identical to your squad's name and must be in English. For example: CBhouse
3.  Leave the squad captain's contact information in the House Announcement (Discord/QQ).
4.  Once you have created a house, make sure that all squad members create characters on the Tournament Server and join said house (they should be from the same server as you).
5.  And a final note: To complete the sign up, ensure that your squad between 15 and 20 members when the Sign Ups conclude, and that's it!
What's more, all squads that sign up will receive a small gift as a token of our gratitude!

- Drafting Rules:
Characters created on the Tournament Server will automatically be linked with all other characters on that account. This helps us calculate the Ranked Battle score of each player.
1.	If the squad captain has characters on several servers or several characters on the same server, their character with the highest Ranked Battle score will be used. Their squad will also be considered as being from that server.
2.	If a squad member has characters on several servers or several characters on the same server, their character with the highest Ranked Battle score on the Squad Captain's server will be selected.
3.	A squad's score is equal to the combined Ranked Battle score of the 15 members with the highest score.
4.	The number of squads we draft from each of the LA and DI servers depend on the number of signed-up squads on these servers with a squad score of at least 15000. In the end, we will draft a total of 24 squads from these two servers.

- Notes: 
1.	Please note, squads must have a member count of between 15 and 20 to sign up successfully.
2.	Duplicate signups are forbidden. Should we at the time of tallying score, find that a player has several characters on the tournament server and be part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament.
3.	The same squad may not have members from both Dragonrise Island and Lotus Ash Sea. Whether a squad belongs to the former or the latter depends on the squad captain's character with the highest Ranked Battle score.
4.  Signups conclude on 11/22/2020, 23:59. After which no squad may alter their member roster.
5.	Should you not to leave any contact information (Discord/QQ) and we fail to get in contact with your squad, your signup will be annulled.
6.	Asia Pacific Division's top four house squads will also receive an extra reward: a differently-colored name in the House List. 'House squads' refer to squads where all members are from the same house.

2. Tournament Prohibitions

If a contestant is found to have violated against this, then the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.

	(4) Naming Rules: Each squad should name themselves according to the tournament naming convention, and the name should be in English. Players should also name their characters in according to tournament convention. Any name that violate either convention is prohibited. Should a name violate these conventions, referees may rule that that player's squad lose the match, thereby directly promoting the other squad.

	(6) Tournament Broadcast Rules: While the tournament is running, it is strictly prohibited to, in any way or form, stream or broadcast the tournament on any platform that we have not explicitly stated as official tournament platforms. Should a participant be found to have violated against this rule, the referees may disqualify the squad in which the player is part of.
	(7) Duplicate Signups: Each player may only be part of one squad, and may not create multiple characters with which to join multiple squads. In doing so you will be disqualified from the tournament.

5) Rewards

Members of squads that complete the signup process will receive a Participation Pack including Vault Key x2 and Bronze Coin x20,000.

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on November 12, 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community.

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profited from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list:

1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
5) It contains statements that violate any law.

The following is a list of players who have penalized this time:

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 12th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on November 12th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Bug Fixes

1. Resolved an issue with the neck of the Loyal Guards' model;
2. Resolved an issue where some mount armour attires would remove the Fire Lance Cavalry's weapon within the U menu;
3. Resolved an issue where the attackers could enter the defender's camp and protection area when attacking Bartholian villages in Territory War.

2) Improvements

1. Improved the overall sound effects of maul wielders, adding more detailed sound effects for an increase in overall sound quality.
2. Added a feature to the Social menu, showing when players last went offline.
3. Improved how the quality of hero actions is displayed. The quality of actions can now be seen in the Action menu.
4. Improved how the [New House Identity Document] works. Lieges of houses with a purple name may now also use it to change their house's name. Doing so does not change the colour.
5. Improved the rewards granted from the Path of Strategy of Hero's Path. The reward for killing 500 soldiers has been changed from [Scribal Service] to [Rare Artillery Chest] x2. Warlords that have previously completed this quest will receive compensation in the days to come.
6. For House/Cohort quests, where the quests previously required Warlords to team up with members of their House/Cohort, these quests can now instead be completed by teaming up with Alliance/Legion members, making it easier to find groups.
7. Added more information to the House/Cohort and Friends lists. You will now be able to see when members of these or friends were last online.
8. Added the [Plentiful Soldiers] and [Arduous Training] side quest chains. Completing these will grant plenty of rewards.
9. Added info to the Seafaring interface regarding various costs.

We have made balance changes to the follow Bartholian city fiefs in Territory War: Thesadonia, Taragosa, Areaktol, Eraphytus, Ancreta, Karenzia, Deralus, Ankhopolis, Yarvisberg, Waleya, Berkamut, Mazeri, Verathia, Teralkia, and Raedrys. The changes include the following:

notes.title: First Ever I'm the King Phase — Special Territory War Rules
notes.content:
Dear Warlord, 
On November 9th (on Monday) until November 22nd, the Legacy of Fire season will be entering the I'm the King phase. This is the first time Daicheng and Turul Város, the region capitals of Liangyun and Ungverija, are up for contention.
To make it easier to fully understand the contention over regional capitals and to get a lay of the land, and naturally to ensure that all issues are ironed out in this brand-new game mode, we will be hosting the first contention over regional capitals on November 10th (this Tuesday). During this Territory War, the following special rules will be in place:

1) Special Territory War Rules (November 11th)

1.  Special rules will be in place on region capitals and surrounding villages, and while they can be attacked, they cannot actually be occupied.
Region Capitals:
Daicheng (Liangyun) and Turul Város (Ungverija).
Surrounding Villages:
Mari (Liangyun), Luxing (Liangyun), Halasto (Ungverija), and Rézhegy (Ungverija).
After the Territory War on November 10th, the aforementioned fiefs will once again belong to Liangyun and Ungverija, and will not be occupied by a house.
2.  Apart from the above region capitals and surrounding villages , all other fiefs of Liangyun, Ungverija, and The Borderlands will be available for contention as per usual on November 10th. Occupying one of these will make you their owner. So be sure to set up your defenses accordingly! Territory War will not be available in Bartholia during this phase.
Territory War will work as per usual for the region capitals and aforementioned villages in Territory War on November 14th, 17th, and 21st, and occupying either one will grant you ownership.
    3. During Territory War this time, occupying a region capital or surrounding villages will not grant tribute. What's more, should house occupy a region capital or surrounding villages, the ability to pursuit is not available within their area.
     4.  For more details on how to declare war on and assault region capitals and surrounding villages, please find the announcement in-game by pressing F5 -> Legacy of Fire -> I'm the King. A Region Influence of 3,000 is required to declare war against a region capital. Alliances are ordered according to Region Influence, with those with higher attacking first.

2) November 10th Special Drill Reward:

    1. Participation Reward
    Once Territory War ends, all who have participated in the contention of the region capitals will receive the following rewards:
Epic Artillery Selection Box x1
Bronze Coin x60000
2. Occupation Reward
Warlords of alliances or legions that manage to occupy a region capital will get the following rewards:
Treatise x2
Epic Artillery Selection Box x2
3. Fame Refund
    Prestige spent on declaring war against region capitals or surrounding villages, and prestige spent to build field camps within their area will be refunded later on.
These rewards will be sent by mail within 3 working days.

3) Regional Monarch Attires

The contention over the regional capitals begins for real on 11/14/2020 (next Saturday). Should an alliance successfully occupy a region capital before Territory War ends on November 21st, the ruling house's liege will have a shot at getting the Monarch title and exclusive attire.
Monarch of Liangyun:
Brocaded Shu Armor
A cloth armor which may only be donned by the Monarch of Liangyun and his retinue. The outer lining is created via a special weaving technique, using a silk unique to Liangyun. The dense structure created with this technique is capable of entangling arrows and spears that pierce the material. The inner linen is inlaid with finely crafted armor plates, granting a perfect combination of lightness and defense.
Legends claim this craftsmanship has been passed down from the ancient Shu people. Their monarchs would take to wearing it as a symbol of their stature. What's more, on more than a few occasions, it has been what saved their life as they waded through mortal danger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/315209b6ca7e8f9366af9b4ed43541087ba26f7b.jpg

Monarch of Ungverija:
Ungverijan Warplate
A magnificent battle armor fit for a king. The crown is fashioned using a technique allowing for the usage of golden threads. By then hollowing it out, and adorning it with gems unique to The Borderlands, it is as splendid as it is regal. The armor section is crafted with both chain and scale mail techniques, enabling it to deflect attacks from any angle. The silk and satin used are said to have been woven in the far east. Even master craftsmen gawk in astonishment when they lay eyes upon the flourishing patterns. 
It was created during the height of Ungverija. The monarch employed the best artisans the land had to offer, tasking them with this their greatest of masterpieces. Time has passed and the king has grown old and the situation in the empire is unstable. And so he as he became unable to don it, he sealed it away. But there will come a day when someone worthy of this armor arises. Then it will once again bring glory on the field of battle.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 5th Update Log

After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Hero Balance Changes

notes.title: Continopolis & Regional Capital Contention Information
notes.content:
In the Legacy of Fire season we have recounted the tale of how Arkasius, the emperor of Barcyan, incite all citizens to march against Bartholia. And so, now that the story is reaching its climax, the main part of the battle will take place right there in Bartholia.
The world has been thrown into chaos and turmoil and the contention for Bartholia's fiefs is in full flare. The alliances who during this time manage to expand their influence will further cement their hold for the battle's final phase.
When the battle reaches the 'I'm the King' phase, all fiefs of Bartholia will be placed under protection, during which they cannot be contended. Following this, Territory War will be available in Liangyun and Ungverija, beginning the contention for Daicheng and Turul Város. The occupant of which will be granted extra Influence within Bartholia. Which ultimately puts them in a more favorable position for the final phase: the Battle of Continopolis.
When the battle reaches the 'War for the Throne' phase, Daicheng and Turul Város can no longer be contended for. Influence from Bartholia will also increase by 50%, and the Battle of Continopolis will begin. What's more, this battle decides who ultimately claims the throne this season.
We have set up the following rules to ensure that the battles for core fiefs are splendid yet orderly:

Region Influence

	This season we have introduced Region Influence, something with which to gauge the most powerful alliances in each region.
	Region Influence is equal to the total influence of all land the alliance or house owns within that region.

Declaring War on Continopolis

	If an alliance has the required Region Influence in Bartholia, its ruling house may declare war against Continopolis.
	Requires a Region Influence of at least 3,000 in Bartholia.
	Should an attacking or defending alliance lose their qualification to declare war, their members will no longer be able to take part in battles of Continopolis. Players that have already started a battle may complete said battle.

Declaring War on Daicheng and Turul Város (Region Capitals)

	A region's capital is that region's most important city.
	Daicheng is the capital of Liangyun.
	Turul Város is the capital of Ungverija.
	Occupying a region capital will in this season grant the alliance an extra 3,000 Region Influence in Bartholia.
	The alliance's ruling house must meet the conditions for other houses in that alliance to declare war against a region's capital.
	To declare war against a region's capital, the alliance must have a Region Influence of at least 3,000 in that region.
	Should an attacking or defending alliance lose their qualification to declare war, their members will no longer be able to take part in battles of that region's capital. Players that have already started a battle may complete said battle.

Orderly Contention

	The order in which alliances may command troops for battles of Daicheng, Turul Város, and Continopolis follows a strict order. Houses will be ordered depending on Region Influence.
	Once the Territory War preparation concludes, alliances that declare war against the city will be ordered from high to low depending on their Region Influence. Following this order alliances may contend for the region's capital.
	The ruling house of the alliance with the highest Region Influence will be placed first in the attack order.
	Should two or more alliances have equal Influence, they will be ordered depending on the time when they declared war.
	Once the preparation has ended and the order has been set, the order in which the alliances my contend for a city will remain unchanged. This holds true even if there are further fluctuations in Influence while Territory War is in progress.
	Should an alliance fail to successfully occupy the city, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
	If a house that meet the requirements declare war against the city while Territory War is in progress, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
	Should a house for some reason be removed from the attack order, they will be placed at the bottom should they rejoin.

Post-Continopolis/Region Capital Permissions & Rewards

	The owner of Continopolis or a region capital may not upgrade fiefs or adjust fief permissions in such a way that it would affect the normal gameplay of other Warlords.
	Continopolis and region capitals will not be degraded when assaulted.
	The owner of Continopolis or a region capital will receive tribute from fiefs.
	An alliance that occupies a region capital will receive 3,000 Region Influence in Bartholia, thereby enabling them to directly declare war on Continopolis.
	The liege of the ruling house of an alliance that occupies a region capital has a chance at attaining the title of Monarch.
	Attaining the title of Monarch.
	Be part of an alliance that successfully occupies the region's capital.
	Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.
	The alliance must have a Region Influence of at least 5,000 in that region.
	A player that attains the title of Monarch will receive an exclusive attire when the season concludes.
	If the liege of the alliance's ruling house receives the title of Monarch, the lieges of that alliance's other houses will receive the title of Chief Justiciar.
	The ruling house liege of the alliance that owns Continopolis has a chance to gain the special title of either Monarch or Hegemon.
	Attaining the title of Hegemon.
	Be part of the alliance that successfully occupies Continopolis.
	Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.
	The alliance must have a Total Influence of at least 8,000 (Total Influence refers to Influence from all fiefs, and extra Influence gained from occupying other region capitals does not count toward this).
	The player that attains the title of Hegemon will receive an exclusive attire.
	If the liege of the alliance's ruling house receives the title of Hegemon, the lieges of that alliance's other houses will receive the title of Chamberlain.

	Attaining the title of Monarch.
	Be part of the alliance that successfully occupies Continopolis.
	Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.
	The alliance must have a Region Influence of at least 5,000 in Bartholia.
	Attaining the title of Monarch in Bartholia does not come with an exclusive attire reward.
	If the liege of the alliance's ruling house receives the title of Monarch, the lieges of that alliance's other houses will receive the title of Chief Justiciar.
	A player that receives the title of Hegemon will not also be granted the title of Monarch.

Defense & Assault of Elite Imperial Restorationists

	Imperial Restorationists with a position of at least Decanos or Second Lieutenant may protect region capitals.
	Kits are not consumed for Imperial Restorationists when defending a region capital.
	Should the Imperial Restorationists lose a region capital, they will not be able to reclaim that city during this season.

Noble Houses & Imperial Restorationists Season Rewards

	Any player with title from the Noble Houses will receive a similar royal attire. The attire will be valid for one season, and expires at the end of the following season.
	Imperial Restorationists with a rank of at least Decanos or Second Lieutenant will receive a title according to their rank. This title is also valid for one season, and expires at the end of the following season.
	What's more, should they succeed in protecting Continopolis or a region capital from those wishing to bereft it of its riches, all Imperial Restorationists in that region will receive extra rewards.
	Should a House occupy a region capital without having the Influence required to be crowned Monarch, all Imperial Restorationists will receive plentiful rewards at the end of the season. These rewards include:
	A unique limited-time title (valid for one season, and expires at the end of the following season)
	Treatise x3
	Should the Imperial Restorationists successfully defend a region capital, all Imperial Restorationists of that region will receive plentiful rewards at the end of the season. As well as the following:
	A unique limited-time title (valid for one season, and expires at the end of the following season)
	Treatise x5
	Should a House occupy Continopolis without having the Influence required to be crowned Hegemon, all Imperial Restorationists will receive plentiful rewards at the end of the season. These rewards include:
	A unique limited-time title (valid for one season, and expires at the end of the following season)
	Mercenary Attire Chest x3
	Treatise x3
	Random Epic Artillery Chest x1
	Should the Imperial Restorationists successfully defend Continopolis, all Imperial Restorationists will receive plentiful rewards at the end of the season. As well as the following:
	A unique limited-time title (valid for one season, and expires at the end of the following season)
	Mercenary Attire Chest x5
	Treatise x5
	Random Epic Artillery Chest x3
	Aside from the aforementioned rewards, members of Noble Houses and the Imperial Restorationists will receive rewards according to their number of occupied fiefs in Territory War. We will be announcing more details about these rewards at a later date!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade League — Expedition Season South America Sign-up Rules
notes.content:
Hello there Warlord! 
A while has passed since the tournament of Season 3 ended. The dust of war has settled and the champions have donned and flaunted their exclusive attires. But a question yet remains: will the king be able to defend his throne? Or will a new challenger assume the crown? Fear not, a new Conqueror's Blade League awaits in the future!  
For this tournament we will be choosing 7 squads from Espada Forest (EF) to fight for the glory of South America along with the champion of Season 3!

Sign Up Time: 

Starts on November 2nd , 00:00 (GMT -4)
Ends on November 22nd , 23:59 (GMT -4)

Squads:

	The tournament will be made up of 8 squads, including 1 seeded and 7 other squads which we select.
-	Seeded Squads:
We will be inviting ReaperS, the reigning champion, to join the tournament as a seeded squad. 
-	Drafted Squads:
	Once the sign ups have concluded, the 7 squads with the highest squad level will be eligible to partake. (Each squad's level is equal to the combined Season Level of the 15 members with highest level)

How to Sign Up:

The tournament servers will be going live on October 30th, 12:00 (GMT -4). To sign up to the tournament, simply login to the game as usual and select the SA Tournament Server from the server list. Then perform the following steps:
1.	Create a new character on the Tournament Server. The character's name should be in the following format: [Squad Abbreviation_Original Character's Name]. For example: BGM_Xiaoz
* The squad abbreviation must not exceed three English characters.
* Should the new name exceed the name-length cap, kindly RETAIN the abbreviation and simply adjust the original character's name accordingly. 
2.   Create a house on the Tournament Server. The house name should be identical to your squad's name and must be in English. For example: CBhouse
3.   Leave the squad captain's contact information in the House Announcement (Discord).
4.   Once you have created a house, make sure that all squad members create characters on the Tournament Server and join said house (they should be from the same server as you).
5.   And a final note: To complete the sign up, ensure that your squad between 15 and 20 members when the Sign Ups conclude, and that's it!
What's more, all squads that sign up will receive a small gift as a token of our gratitude! We're looking forward to see you in the tournament!

Drafting Rules:

Characters created on the Tournament Server will automatically be linked with all characters on the EF server available on that account. This helps us calculate the season level of each player.
1.	If a squad member has multiple characters on EF, their character with the highest season level will be selected.
2.	A squad's level is equal to the combined Season Level of the 15 members with highest level.

Important: 

1.	Please note, squads must have a member count of between 15 and 20 to sign up successfully.
2.	Duplicate signups are forbidden. Should we at the time of tallying score, find that a player has several characters on the tournament server and be part of multiple squads, this player will be removed from the tournament.
3.	Should you not to leave any contact information (Discord) and we fail to get in contact with your squad, your signup will be annulled.

We will at a later date issue an announcement with the selected squads, as well as more detailed info on the tournament. So don't forget to check our announcements! Should you have any questions whatsoever regarding the Conqueror's Blade League, feel free to send us an email to cb_support@boominggames.com or contact us via our social media accounts (Tieba forums, Discord or Steam).

Finally, we're looking forward seeing you upon the battlefield in the Conqueror's Blade League! May you reign supreme!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade October 13th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlord: 
    We will update the game during our maintenance on October 13th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Brand-new Region: Bartholia

Legacy of Fire will be entering the Court in Danger phase on October 12. Whereupon you may access the new region Bartholia via Border Posts in Ungverija and The Borderlands. Warlords in Liangyun must make their way to The Borderlands to access the new region.
Upon this region new game modes will be available, featuring naval transportation, trade, and Conquest. 
During this phase, a special Military Exercise will be available within Bartholia. Should certain fiefs be captured during this exercise, they will fall into the command of those that occupied them.
What's more, Bartholia comes with a whole new range of business opportunities: Trade Posts will emerge in Ungverija and Liangyun to facilitate the transportation of goods.

2) Improvements

1.  Battle-wide Broadcasts
     We've made improvements to combat broadcasts: they will now be displayed differently depending on the difficulty and honor in meeting their requirements.
2. Titles
     Currently, the way title rarity is displayed in crowded areas isn't very optimal, and titles of different rarities aren't different enough. Which is why we've set about rolling out a new round of improvements for how titles are displayed. 
3. Improved the user experiences when interacting with units and Supply Points by increasing the range at which it is possible to do so.

3) Bug Fixes
1.  Resolved an issue where the reward for unit challenges of Season 2: Wrath of the Nomads instead granted Season Tokens for the Blood of the Empire: The Fall and The Rise season. Originally the reward contained 30 Blood of the Empire: The Fall and The Rise Season Tokens, and it now instead rewards 10 General Unit Medals;

3.  Resolved an issue where No-Man's Town's location was wrong;
4.  Resolved an issue where the ability graph of Rattan Rangers, Fire Lance Cavalry, and Cataphract Lancers wouldn't be displayed correctly;
5. Resolved an issue where the [Strong Bay Mare] granted from Hero's Path had rather low attributes;
6. Resolved errors with the construction of artilleries of some cities in the Liangyun and Ungverija regions: 
  Liangyun
    Gaoda: Added Well-Made Ballista and Optimal Hwacha Launcher
    Louge: Added Optimal Grapeshot Cannon
 Ungverija

    Gyoma: Added Well-Made Scorpio
    Kiralyfalva: Added Optimal Culverin
    Méhkerék: Added Well-Made Mortar
    Hévíz: Added Well-Made Mortar
7.Resolved an issue with the item description of the reward granted from the first promotion challenge of the Spear Sergeants and Men-at-Arms units: Remains unchanged in the English version (General Unit Medal).
8.Text errors that have been changed: There was an issue with the text of the third promotion challenge of Spear Sergeants: 'Ranked top 8'; it has now been corrected to 'Ranked top 5'. There was an issue with the text of the third promotion challenge of Barcyan Wildflame: 'kill 240 soldiers in the same game'; it has now been corrected to 'kill 8 heroes in the same game'.
