notes.title: Expedition: Legacy of Fire Season Update Log
notes.content:
1) Season Units

4 new units will be available this season and they can be unlocked by completing their corresponding [Challenges]. Seasonal bonuses are in effect for these units.
Seasonal Bonuses: 
Requires 10 less Leadership
Resupply cost is reduced by 50%

1. Barcyan Wildflame
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1b6b9384de359821ce7f199ff234cb36f08c0160.png

Tier: 3
Background Info:
The Barcyan Empire had plentiful fuel resources, and they soon learned that fire could be wielded with terrible results upon the battlefield. Around that time, the army fitted their troops with kerosene canisters to be used when the need arose.
Those that took to using these held no fear toward death——even with this as their only weapon. Having drawn near their enemy, they would set ablaze Narfan and toss it toward them. Where it landed the ground turned into a wild inferno, and when it landed upon a person it would seep beneath their armor and begin burning ferociously.
Enemies set ablaze would howl and howl, yet with the ground and their armor burning too, their howls continued until nothing remained of them but ashes and dust. Having seen such terror, even the bravest of warriors fled at the sight of these Narfan-throwing soldiers.
Unit Characteristics:
The Barcyan Wildflame is a unit where timing is everything, to at the right time deal damage against a certain area from mid-range. As they pose little to no threat in melee combat, carry a rather low supply of ammo, and are weak defensively, they required to constantly be on the move and to resupply. However, their kerosene canisters are powerful and deal massive damage against light-armored units that are weak against fire.

2. Barcyan Narfan Guard
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d3555853f116bf46cf770d431cc4302633c433c2.png

Tier: 5
Background Info:
Narfan, a very special type of fuel, and one of the Barcyan Empire's greatest secrets. Its formula is known only to the craftsmen who are the most loyal and fervent supporters of the royal family. Should Narfan be set aflame, it will continue to burn bright as day even when it meets water: so potent is it, that it may burn on the very sea itself. Narfan is also the reason for the Barcyan navy's dominance in Bartholia.
Within the annals of history, a famed general attempted to overthrow the throne. Yet, as the rebels stormed the palace in an attempt to claim victory, the imperial craftsmen and their apprentices stopped them dead in their tracks. In their hands they held strange devices capable of spewing out lethal Narfan flames: turning the courtyard into a veritable inferno. Nothing remained of the rebels and the great pool that once existed turned into a smoldering pile of rock.
The rebellion having ended, the imperial family was now short of craftsmen, but had gained a legendary troop called the Narfan Guard.
Unit Characteristics:
The Narfan Guard carry devices capable of spewing out Narfan flames, and they are unaffected by both wind and rain. Narfan flames can set ablaze enemies and continues to burn where it lands, creating a more or less impassable wall of fire. Their attack range is limited, so they must be used careful to avoid both enemies with greater range, or to be attacked in melee.

3. Loyal Guards
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bd2a873def173644fc6fb01ec15c6c6ae37cde69.png

Tier: 4
Background Info:
     The Loyal Guards where initially comprised of descendants from low and mid-ranked houses. They were trained in the military arts since a young age, which resulted in them having a firmer faith and greater skill in combat than the Spear Sergeants.
      During the beginning of the Expedition, the Monastic Knights were hard pressed keeping the powerful nomadic tribes in check. Yet, with the Loyal Guards at their side the tides of war changed: Compared to the ordinary Spear Sergeants, they could withstand greater assaults from the enemy while also striking home with precise counter attacks. They landed deadly strike after deadly strike on any enemy that dared charge their formation.
    The Loyal Guards wield their shield and spear with great skill and are lethal upon the battlefield. While retaining their formation, they are capable of quickly pushing the enemy backward, driving them before their spear tips. Faced with this veritable walking hedgehog, the nomadic tribes proud of their archers and light cavalry were at a loss. Instead of advancing, they were forced on the defensive.
   As the Great Campaign continued, these Loyal Guards began teaching the other troops. The Loyal Guards increased in size as they trained more troops and honed their skill in battle, their fame spreading throughout all Bartholia.
Unit Characteristics:
The Loyal Guards wield shields and spears and traverse the battlefield as a tight group. They are quick to change formation and excel at using brace to resist charges from other units. 
Their shields and their steady advance make them great units in close combat.

4. Expedition Knights
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4996c0a82dcdb5bd167efe0acefc0e3249bc7ca8.png

Tier: 4
Background Info:
They were the first knights to join the expedition. They honed their skills through endless battles and over time they grew mighty and powerful. While not just better equipped than the other knights, they had also honed their skill with the sword to perfection, gaining expertise far above that of your average warriors.
Their focus is on the union of offense and defense: with their kite shields they deflect enemy attacks, and while doing so, they stab their enemies' weak points with their swords. A lethal combination attack indeed. Enemies often find them incredibly difficult to deal with and their enemies tend to suffer much greater losses than they as a result.
Unit Characteristics:
These steadfast shieldbearers are still capable of dealing enough damage to fearlessly face any foe in melee combat. However, they are somewhat vulnerable from behind and have a hard time dealing with strong charges that diminish the usage of shields. 
Their strong faith enables them to quickly recover from wounds in battle to continue fighting.

2) Hero Balance Changes & Improvements

1. Bow Combat Mechanic Changes:
Idea Behind Changes:
	Bow heroes have the following issues in the current version:
Insufficient Stamina to really work well: It requires Stamina to draw ones bow, and the bow requires much more Stamina than other types of weapons. What's more, seeing as the bow is a ranged weapon one is required to constantly roll and sprint to dodge melee attacks, all of which requires even more Stamina. These two aspects combined leads to a conundrum: you only have Stamina to either run or fight.
To remedy this, we've decided to add a feature enabling bow users to replenish Stamina upon hitting an enemy. Hopefully this will aid in making those that take to the bow be able to stand toe to toe with their foes.
When aiming with the bow your entire focus is on actually hitting your shots, which means that it is more difficult to keep an eye on the Stamina bar at the bottom. This then makes it so that one often fails to notice the Stamina bar depleting fully.
To make it easier to keep an eye on your Stamina in battle we've added a Stamina bar to the right of the crosshair, hopefully you will find it useful.
Marksman skill: In the current version, the Marksman skill grants you a piercing damage and armour penetration buff for a certain time when used. All in all, it has felt somewhat lackluster, so we've decided to rework it. Our aim has been to make it a more fun and impactful skill to use, simply than just being a buff.
The skill will now instead affect your next non-charged up shot within 15 seconds (including half-charged ones), and boost its power to that of a fully charged shot. This will be elicited via a UI prompt.
Changes:
Bow attacks that hit an enemy will restore a certain amount of Stamina, with headshots restoring a greater amount.
When aiming with the bow, a Stamina bar will be displayed to the right of the crosshair.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d83522995d4fe8df3631cfb5383f4ff3b2f56b24.png

Reworked the Marksman skill: Enter a state of focus becoming one with your bow. The next non-charged up shot within 15 seconds will gain the effect of having been fully charged up. This effect will be displayed with an UI prompt while aiming.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4fafaffd8dc82c5ef5c93188bd48af7b3478276d.png

Improved hit checks.

2. Short Bow Combat Mechanic Changes:
Idea Behind Changes:
The short bow in the current version has a few shortcomings:
- Normal shots feels rather lackluster: While wielding a short bow you can more or less continue to shoot without end, but as there are no differences between the shots it feels rather monotone to use. Which is why we've opted for changing it up.
Normal shots will now instead be fired in sets of three. I.e. every third shot will have increased power, and the third shot's damage, trajectory and animation have been improved.
Dodging with the short bow comes with a unique aspect: that dodges add a stacking Armour Piercing buff which increases piercing damage and armour penetration, stacking up to 3 times. Each skill usage then consumes one stack to deal increased damage and armour penetration. As this buff can currently be stacked up simply by using dodge, players tend to dodge even when not in melee combat simply to gain stacks.
Which is we've made the following changes: The third shot of the new short bow will also grant one stack of Armour Piercing.
- Shoort Bow heroes has had an overtuned blunt damage multiplier for their melee basic attacks, and this led to them dealing more damage than expected at higher levels. This led to them being overly powerful in melee while being ranged, which is why we're making the following changes: 
We've reduced the blunt damage multiplier for melee basic attacks but added some bonus blunt damage. This will allow short bows to have more or less unchanged damage on lower levels, but keeps their damage on higher level to a number more in line with our design expectations.

Changes:
Each third short bow shot will be more powerful, dealing increase piercing damage and having a more stable trajectory. Hitting a target will also grant a stack of Armour Piercing.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/72699d9875c55489b3255278720a0aedba61f940.png

Improved the UI, adding a UI display for the number of stacks you currently have.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dbab810bb55fbda4c90907c421bc0eb308b59952.png

Improved the roll animation for male characters wielding a short bow.
Reduced the blunt damage multiplier for melee basic attacks and added some bonus blunt damage.

3. Other Balance Changes:
Improved the animation for when heroes are downed.
Resolved a bug where the shortsword & shield skill Shielded Charge would knock enemies back when it shouldn't.
Resolved a bug where the warhammer skill Combat Grapple where enemy heroes could still be grappled while behind enemy soldiers.

3) Unit Changes

1. Adjusted the damage range of spear-type units while in Brace formation:
In ancient warfare each weapon where of a particular length based on the use, which made the spear somewhat weak when in too close range. So, the Brace formation of spear units have a minimum distance required equal to the size of two persons, and they may no longer attack and deal damage within this range;
Affected units:
Village Watchmen;
Demesne Pikemen;
Pike Militia;
Imperial Pike Guards;
Fortebraccio Pikemen; 

2. Fire and Burn Mechanics
Idea Behind Changes:
Currently, fire and burn debuffs are only applied by certain fire skills, and can only be offset by having fire-resistant units. Fire and burn effects currently have no effect on fire-resistant units, and heroes can simply roll to reduce the duration of burn effects. In the end, this makes it rather easy to deal with. Seeing as the new seasonal units are fire related, we've decided to redesign how fire and burn works. Hopefully these changes should make it more interesting.
Changes:
Burn debuffs will no longer be simply "burning or not burning" but it can be stacked to increase potency:
If a unit or hero is attacked by a fire attack, they will take minor fire damage as well as damage over time.
Once they have been the target of repeated fire attacks, the damage over time effect will intensify, dealing massive damage as they are set ablaze.
The previous [Fireproof] will be changed to [Fire Resistant], and fire-resistant units will be capable of withstanding a greater amount of fire attacks before being set ablaze.
Naturally, after a hero is set ablaze, they can roll to reduce the burn DoT's duration.
It will be more difficult for normal fire damage to set ablaze enemies while it is raining.

4) Stage Improvements
Supply Point Hotkey Interaction:
We've added a hotkey for interacting with Supply Points. You can now interact with Supply Points you have occupied by pressing the CTRL key. This will enable players to resupply units quicker than before.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c9d478ce76d9d089a946bc8770c5b41beb4d0138.png

Minimap Level Segment Display:
While underground on the Continopolis map, the minimap will change to reflect the underground segment of the map, making it more interactive and easier to navigate.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6c19ab3b96ebf7d748afeee3fc98892cbfcce4e4.jpg

5) New Region—Bartholia
Conqueror's Blade: The frontlines of battle have remained more or less unchanged for over a year, but now we are for the first time opening up a new region—Bartholia.
Bartholia is situated to the south of Ungverija, part of it bordering The Borderlands. Once made available, you may access it from Border Posts in either Ungverija or The Borderlands.
Upon this region new game modes will be available, featuring naval transportation, trade, and Territory War. At the end of the season, you can gather up with your fellow Warlords and contend for Continopolis—the throne of Barcyan, and to claim victory in the season.
What's more, we will in this season be closing off the Ostaria and Maoyang regions, as well as the northern half of The Borderlands. You may select to start this season's journey in either Liangyun or Ungverija.
Harbors
The region of Bartholia is divided by a vast ocean and many areas are difficult to reach by land. However, you can cross the ocean by visiting the many harbors to quickly reach your destination.
Harbors are unique fiefs on the World Map, and the routes available to and from each harbor differs. To use these, you simply have to pay the fee in Bronze Coin, and then select your destination. There are three parts to the fee: seafaring, docking, and transport. The seafaring and docking fees depend on the harbors you sail from and sail to, whereas the transport fee depends on the amount of resources and units you bring as well as the length of the journey.
There are currently two types of harbors: 
Trade Ports:
Trade ports are mainly used for trading and large-scale transport. Traveling from one of these enables you to avoid many of the dangers at sea, and you therefore will not lose any resources or units on the journey. Trade ports also have an abundance of routes to choose from, making it easier to reach the destination you want to go to.
Each trade port belongs to a specific city, and will belong to the house that currently occupies that city. The occupying house may adjust the ports settings, method and resource collection fees for seafaring and docking. Part of these fees will be added to the city's dividends. What's more, the house may also choose whether or not non-house members can use the port.
Fishing Ports:
Fishing Ports are small ports mainly used for smuggling. They tend to have few destinations available, and embarking from a fishing port comes at a risk. You may lose resources and units may die on the journey.
However, Fishing Ports cannot be occupied by players and will always remain neutral, available for all to use.
Trade Posts
Sea trade and transport is highly developed in Bartholia, which has given rise to a unique type of fief: Trade Posts.
Trade posts tend to appear near and around cities in Bartholia. While at one of these, you can spend Silver Coins to procure extremely rare commodities available only in limited quantities: exotic trade goods, rare kits, and valuable artilleries from other regions among some.
Owing to how trade works, each trade post will host its own unique stock of commodities, and should the same commodity appear in different trade posts the price is likely to differ. There is also a great difference in the time it takes for different trade posts to restock their goods.
New Season Maps
Within the new region of Barcyan, the towns, forts, and villages will be of a difference style from previous regions;
Towns: 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e928dada922fce04673c168ad1bc1e03041fabe6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a2f444b5a4ba857b15c998f69c6b9fd6cbe0f918.png
 
Forts: 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8d1524771e2a28dc02e54cf39fbc9a206d3ddb1a.png 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/02773b648f0a7998ec1bffc6fde957214952693a.png

Villages: 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ac821a04cf7b8c9e9a1892833a4d0b66fc464845.png 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e9a15005bed50e11ca9471a0c9f496e1dd9fc83b.png

6) Territory War Changes

1. New Territory War Availability
Following the opening of the new region Bartholia, things are changing in how battles within regions work, which is why we have made the following changes to Territory War:
Territory War in this season is made up of six phases:
The Barons' War: 
    The Barons' War will run through October 3rd 12:00 to October 12th 12:00. During this time, Military Exercises will be running as normal and Territory War will be available in Liangyun and Ungverija, but not in Bartholia or The Borderlands.   
Court in Danger:
Court in Danger will run through October 12th 12:00 to October 26th 12:00. During this time, normal Territory War battles will be available in Liangyun, Ungverija, and The Borderlands, whereas a special Eclipse Exercise will be available in Bartholia at a certain time.
*During the Eclipse Exercise, all fiefs of the region will be available, and if players occupy certain fiefs during this time, they will occupy it once the exercise end, with the other fiefs once again falling into the hands of NPCs.
World in Chaos: 
    World in Chaos will run through October 26th 12:00 to November 9th 12:00. During this time, normal Territory War battles will be available in all regions.
I'm the King:
I'm the King will run through November 9th 12:00 to November 23rd 12:00. During this time, battles for safe zones in Liangyun and Ungverija will be available, and Territory War will be temporarily unavailable in Bartholia.
War for the Throne:
War for the Throne will run through November 23rd 12:00 to December 7th 12:00. During this time, Territory War will once again be available in Bartholia, and during this phase, Alliances that meet the criterions may assault and occupy Continopolis.

2. Battles for Safe Zones
During this season there will be battles to claim safe zones. During the [I'm the King] phase, alliances that meet the criterions may declare war against safe zones. At the end of the season, should an alliance have captured a safe zone, if they meet the criterions, the liege of the ruling house will be granted the title of King and receive attire rewards. Alliances that manage to capture a safe zone, may during the [War for the Throne] phase declare war against Continopolis.

3. Battle of Continopolis
With a new region, the means with which to attain eternal glory changes: To receive the title of Hegemon one must no longer occupy Conqueror's City, but occupy the everlasting bastion of Continopolis. The battle for Conqueror's City will be unavailable during this season, and it will instead focus on the Battle of Continopolis.
Much like Conqueror's City, declaring war against Continopolis requires you to meet a few criterions: You must occupy a certain number of fiefs within Bartholia or be in possession of a safe zone. At the end of the season, should they meet the criterions, the liege of the ruling house of alliances who have occupied Continopolis will be granted the title of Hegemon and receive a special Hegemon attire. 

4. Commanding House Promotion Improvements
During previous seasons, stalemates on the various fronts have detracted from the Territory War experience at large. Part of the reason is because of something we had overseen in how commanding houses worked, which is why we've made the following changes:
By declaring war against and capturing small fiefs or camps, houses may gain Influence in that area. The house with the highest Influence will become the house in command. If two houses in the area have an equal amount of Influence, the house which first declared war will command the battle.
Area Influence can be gained in the following ways:
	Creating a Ruler's Flag or Field Camp
Creating a Ruler's Flag grants tons of Influence, and you can only create one per area.
Field Camps grants a small amount of Area Influence, and no matter how many camps a house builds in an area, they may only gain the influence of one.
	Occupying Small Fiefs
Refers to functional fiefs within the area, and mainly include Resource Sites, Trade Posts and harbor;
Fiefs grant a different amount of area Influence depending on their size;
The types and quantity of small fiefs also differ for towns, forts, and villages.
The battles for small fiefs follow the same rules as those of Field Camps: 15v15 battles with one battle front.
During Territory War, the ownership of small fiefs is set apart from fiefs: capturing a fief will not grant you ownership of small fiefs in that area.	
Once Territory War has ended, the ownership of small fiefs will fall to the house that owns that fief.
Should a house's camp be destroyed or small fief be captured in the area, a corresponding amount of Influence will be deducted.
What's more, when your camp (Ruler's Flag/Field Camp) is occupied by anyone who did not construct it, it will be destroyed.
What's more, there is half an hour of preparation time before Territory War begins (between 19:30 and 20:00. During this time only small fiefs and camps can be contested for. Cities, forts, and villages cannot be contested for during this time.
	Commanding House Duration:
Once the war preparation is over, the house with the highest Influence in the area take command over the first Territory War fief battle.
Thereinafter, the house with the highest Influence in the area after each battle will assume command in the following battle.

5. Improved the Territory War maps of the Ostaria and Ungverija regions. 
We've added a destroyable wall to the Town and Fort Territory War maps of Ostaria and Ungverija. Attackers may now also choose to launch assaults toward these new walls to gain the upper hand;
Territory War Town Map: 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2e6fa0990e8779f1e993ad2ae17c5e7a88af31e9.png

Territory War Fort Map: 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9844fbff553bb58fa823e8143133e1550c26e8ce.png

7) Tutorial Improvements
Tutorial Stages & Quest Resets
With the new season we've also reworked the tutorial by simplifying it in its entirety, and giving more focus on combat.
What's more, we've reworked the main quest line and better differentiated the tutorial quests. This makes it easier for new players to work toward their goals, and makes it easier to understand new functions and game modes.
Hero's Path
   So as to aid novice Warlords in familiarizing themselves with the game and to grow at a more rapid pace, we're making Hero's Path available in the new season.
    New Warlords will be required to pass four trials: [Bravery], [Faith], [Justice], and [Strategy]. Once these have been completed, new corresponding challenges will become available.
During the challenges, each Warlord will gradually get access to the various functions and game modes within the game. What's more, Warlords will also get heroes, units and more to grow at a more rapid place so that they too can place among the elite one day.
    Naturally, old seasoned veterans may also walk upon the Hero's Path and complete the challenges to reap the rewards.

8) Seasonal Doctrine Changes
It has come to our attention that the acquisition and usage of seasonal doctrines wasn't well received during the Blood of Empire season. Which is why we have decided to improve upon seasonal doctrines starting from the Legacy of Fire season.
New Additions
The way in which seasonal doctrines' take effect is now similar to permanent doctrines.
Should a unit not have a permanent doctrine with the same ability as the seasonal doctrine, the following will take effect: Seasonal doctrine and permanent doctrines with the same effects have the same requirements.
Should a unit have a permanent doctrine with the same ability as the seasonal doctrine, yet with a weaker effect, the following will take effect: Equipping this doctrine will grant the same bonus as is given when equipping the seasonal doctrine (even without equipping the seasonal doctrine). This increased effect will last for as long as the seasonal doctrine is valid.
Should a unit have a permanent doctrine with the same ability, and of an equal or greater effect than that of the seasonal doctrine, the following will take effect: Equipping this doctrine will grant the bonus effect of the doctrine's next level (even without equipping the seasonal doctrine). This increased effect will last for as long as the seasonal doctrine is valid.
New Seasonal Doctrines
For the Legacy of Fire season, we've also improved upon seasonal doctrines, making them more akin to an improvement of existing doctrines. We've also added unique doctrine abilities for some units. As we continue to improve the game, we will doing our best to further improve seasonal doctrines, but some of these you might have to find out yourself.
Seasonal Doctrine Drop Changes
During the Legacy of Fire season, seasonal doctrines can now be obtained from some daily quests, weekly quests, war point gifts, season challenge progress rewards, weekly Ranked Battle win rewards, and weekly title rewards. We'll be keeping an eye on seasonal doctrine drops to ensure that it works as intended and that it feels enjoyable.

9) Legacy of Fire Challenges
Promotion Challenges
	Legion Promotion Challenges
Promotion challenges will be coming together with the season. Promoting a unit will require them to undergo arduous training, by in doing so they gain increased abilities;
Completing a unit challenge unlocks the ability to promote that unit;
Promotions are all final and promoted units cannot be reverted back;
After a promotion, the unit will retain its level, career data, doctrine pool, and all spent Veterancy Points;
Promoted units will gain a new appearance and new a new training tree;
In this season, Warlords will be able to complete challenges to promote [Men-at-Arms] to [Expedition Knights], and [Spear Sergeants] to [Loyal Guards].
	Four new seasonal challenges will be added in this season, two of these being unit challenges and two being promotion challenges for seasonal units.
Barcyan Wildflame (Chivalric Era Unit)
Loyal Guard (Unit Promotion Challenge)
Expedition Knight (Unit Promotion Challenge)
Barcyan Narfan Guard (Heroic Era Unit)
Challenges
10 weeks' worth of weekly challenges will be available in Season 4, with each fully completed week granting additional rewards.

10) Titles and Title Rarities
In the new season, we've made changes to how titles work, and improved how they are displayed. We've also added rarities to titles, with their appearance changing depending on the rarity. 
What's more, we've also added descriptions where titles may be obtained, making it easier to go after the ones you're missing.


11) Battle-wide Broadcasts
When a Warlord performs a feat of strength upon the battlefield, this will be displayed in text, and a sound effect will be broadcasted for all the players in the game. For example, should a Warlord manage to slay three enemy heroes without dying, a broadcast announcing their [triple kill] will be broadcasted. Be sure to complete as many feats of strengths as you can and let others bask in your glory!

notes.title: Legacy of Fire Conquest Info
notes.content:
During this season, the brand new region of Bartholia will be available but the following will be temporarily unavailable: Ostaria and Maoyang regions, as well as the northern half of The Borderlands. So as to reflect these changes we have made a few changes to Conquest as a whole.

Conquest in the Legacy of Fire season is made up of five phases:

The Barons' War: 
The seemingly peaceful world seethes, and the mysterious Bartholia has yet to make itself known. However, soldiers with a thirst for conquest are amassing in Liangyun and Ungverija where they prepare to launch an expedition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4aa979121dfa04767309b71bf4e48215a6345466.png

Court in Danger:
A request for reinforcements has been received from Continopolis. Ah, I wonder what effect Arkasius' plans will have? Those that have received the call for help are assembling their armies and make way for Bartholia. There they go, their eyes set on the abundant rewards they will be showered in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b638bc89e4ae3f726195afdfd8431c2fbd24e143.png

World in Chaos: 
Barcyan lost control over Bartholia in the end, and all we can hope for now is that Continopolis does not fall too. The lords that remain in Bartholia are scrambling to claim pieces of lands for themselves, lands that belong to the Empire. It would seem that a new empire shall be rising soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0fbeeb82b173e7c84e5fecf53fe0520d88d6f8f6.png

I'm the King:
It would seem as if Continopolis is next on the chopping block. But what has me surprised is the calm with which the lords they face it. However, in order to avoid unnecessary bloodshed before the city falls, they reached an agreement—a temporary truce in Bartholia, and that rulers of other legions could join them. And so the war swept over Liangyun and Ungverija.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6bc81f06832bfd8ee3d0c35ed7cf3e2b4982f0c5.png

War for the Throne:
The war reached Bartholia in the end. Will Arkasius be able to create another miracle now that he's truly cornered? I wonder, who will sit atop the throne of Continopolis once all of this is over? This "great" expedition is finally about to reach conclusion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7822ba93eef3be0b1130afe58474deb81e666212.png

notes.title: Violation notice of the Conqueror's Blade on September 24, 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community.

2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
5) It contains statements that violate any law.

The following is a list of players who have penalized this time:

1.	[Hack Users]Permanent Banned:

쌉가능

XU*****
ba*****
ju*****
ju*****

3.	[Negative Attitude]
Two Punishment mechanism for Negative Attitude:

1)Make Amends - Earn a specific rating in Standard Battles-Training Camp for several times. The rating requirement and times settings are based on the severity of negative attitude

2)Matchmaking Bans - In duration time, only Standard Battles-Training Camp is available, banned players are not able to join other matched games. And the time of bans duration only reduced when character is online.

小呀*****5 Standard Battles-Training Camp games + Matchmaking bans for 5 hours

We won't let slide any uncivilized language in any channel. Warlords are welcome to report any of the above game violations to us. As long as we work together, we can surely create a friendly and stable gaming environment. Thanks for your support of the Conqueror's Blade.

Please report to this Email: cbf_steam_support@boominggames.com

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade September 17th Update Log
notes.content:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on September 17th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:00-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

1) Season Results

The season will be concluding at 24:00, September 17th;
	You will not be able to gain Glory from Battles, Alliance Quests, Free Battles, Conquest or by leveling up starting from September 17th until the next season begins.
	Glory can still be earned via Weekly Challenges, Battle Disciplines, and Janissaries Rules;
	The Seasonal Store will also be available until the new season begins.

2) Ranked Battle Results

This season's Ranked Battle concludes on September 17th, and will be issuing the following rewards according to each players' Ranked Battle score:
1. All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 600 will receive the following:
- Unit Medal x60
- Powdered Silver x20
- Bronze Coin x50,000
- Treatise x3
2. All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,200 will receive the following:
- Unit Medal x50
- Powdered Silver x30
- Rare Equipment Schematic Selection Box x1
- Treatise x7
3. All Warlords with a Ranked Battle score exceeding 1,500 will receive the following:
- Permanent Honorary Title: City in Flames x1
- Unit Attire Selection Box x1
All of the aforementioned rewards stack, so a Warlord whose Ranked Battle score exceed 1,500 will be granted all of the rewards.

3) General Improvements

- We have added a prompt for remaining Trebuchet uses and the cooldown to the top of the screen in the OB menu.

4) Bug Fixes

- Resolved an issue where the Pavise Crossbowmen's rate of fire didn't work as intended sometimes when using the Shield Wall formation;
- Resolved an issue where, after Incendiary Archers used the doctrine skill Arrow Rain on a certain area, the Flaming Arrow would not take effect;
- Resolved an issue where, when the Sipahi Cavalry killed an enemy hero whilst in formation, using form up would trigger multiple tramples;
- Resolved an issue where flaming pitch wouldn't deal damage or have an animation on the Conqueror's City map;
- Resolved an issue where the map would move as you scrolled downward while having the map enlarged within the Results - Post-Battle Analysis interface.

CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM
notes.content:
The CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM is aimed at any of our players who wish to contribute to the growing Conqueror's Blade community. We'd love for you to join our new initiative. While having streamed or created Conqueror's Blade related videos previously is a merit, the most important is that you're interested and motivated! To thank you for your contribution, we'll also share with you some of the proceeds from in-game Packs, along with other daily bonuses!

We want you to take part in making Conqueror's Blade greater!

1) Applying to Become a Content Creator

You only have to meet one of the following criterions
1.  Streamer: Stream Conqueror's Blade at least once per week.
2.  Video Creator (YouTube, Facebook, etc.) : Create at least one video related to Conqueror's Blade each month.
3. Active player in any of Conqueror's Blade's official social media groups.

Feel free to fill in the following form if you meet any one of the above criterions and would like to join our CONTENT CREATOR PROGRAM: 
https://forms.gle/JoGWytACC5dn38y3A

Should you have any other questions whatsoever, feel free to contact us on Discord or via email cb_event@boominggames.com

2) Cooperation

1.  You'll be given a gift code which you can share with your fans. Then you'll be rewarded should they take a liking to Conqueror's Blade and starting playing too: 
(1) You'll get 10 USD as a reward for every 10 of your viewers that start playing using your gift code and reach level 30;
(2) We'll add in another 10 USD for every 10 of them that also reaches level 60;
(3) Should anyone use your gift code and purchase the Growth Pack, you will also get 25% of the revenue (in USD);
(4) The above gains will be calculated on the 10th of each month;
(5) Only players that have not played Conqueror's Blade before may use these gift code. Should we find that someone has abused their gift code in any way or form simply to garner more revenue, we will terminate our cooperation with them.
(6) Growth Pack: Viewable to all but can only be purchased once for each character.

2. We'll provide all our content creators with a website containing statistics so it will be easy to see how well your promotions are going.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade S3 - House Tournament - South America Bracket Announcement
notes.content:
The flames of war rage on as heroes stride upon the battlefield. Season 3 of Conqueror's Blade is ending soon, thus we summon all elite houses of the various regions to take part in the Tournament's SA Bracket. Muster your forces and bring glory to your house!

1) Introduction

The S3 House Invitation Tournament is a tournament hosted for the most elite houses out there. We will be inviting 8 outstanding houses from the South America server to play in the SA Bracket, and to in the end crown a winner.

2) Schedule (the following times are according to UTC +8)

1.  August 28 - September 5: House Invitations
    This tournament will be played out by elite houses which we will be inviting. On August 28, we will be sending invites to eight houses, which houses depends on Influence as per the results of Season 2.

2.  On September 6, we will publish the participants as well as the tournament schedule. Squads can now join the tournament server to practice and join in on interviews.
    The SA tournament's participant list will be published together with the Asia Pacific list. We will also be contacting squads to formally invite them to the official tournament Discord and the tournament server. We implore you squad captains out there to keep an eye on your mail.
Starting from September 6, we will be helping participants initiate training matches, and in creating their Houses on the tournament server. Kindly cooperate with us and join the tournament with flare!

3.  September 12-13
   The 8 SA Bracket squads will fight against each other in matches played as Best of 3.

3) Rules

1. Tournament Version & Client:
	The version will be the same as the one used on the official servers.
The tournament will take place on our tournament server, so contestants should simply log on to the SA tournament server.
Houses that are invited should organize their participating members to take part in each game.
Third party programs are strictly prohibited during the tournament and anyone found violating this may be disqualified along with their squad.	

2. Tournament Mode:
All matches played will be Siege Battles, and the map pool contains the following maps: Riverlands Castle, Harbour City, Sun City, Kurak Castle, Augolia, and Continopolis;
Extra Matches are played as Field Battle on the Emerald River map;
If the Field Battle is a tie, the winner will be decided via a Deathmatch (10v10);
Deathmatches: Deathmatches are played on the Cliff Duel map. 10 members of each squad will take part. The squad that first kills 15 enemies, or the squad with the most kills after 5 minutes, will win;
	Each Warlord may revive up to two times per Deathmatch.

3. Equipment Rules: 
There are no limitations on hero, unit, or weapon usage, but units may not use doctrines. The attacker may bring two artilleries, while the defender may bring one (artilleries are of rare quality).

4. Format:
(1) Training Matches:
Training matches will be running from September 6 to September 11. Beginning from September 6, squads may play training battles by talking to the Warden near the training area on the tournament server. We will be giving all captains the authority to create rooms, so feel free to test the mettle of your opponents before the actual tournament begins!

 (2) S3 SA House Invitation Tournament:
	The SA House Invitation Tournament will run from September 12 to September 13, and games will be played as Best of 3. Bototh squads can ban a map, and then two captains will do a roll: The winner of this is able to pick a side first, and the attacker chooses a map out of three maps. The first squad to win two matches will be promoted. If each squad both has a win after two matches, the third match will be a Field Battle (Emerald River), the winner of which will be promoted to the next round. Whereas the losing squad will be eliminated. If the battle is a tie, the winner will be decided via a Deathmatch (10v10).
    The Finals is played on Continopolis, and the attack/defend order is decided by a roll between the two captains on Discord: The winner of which may choose whether to first attack or defend. The first squad to win two matches will be promoted. If each squad both has a win after two matches, the third match will be a Field Battle (Emerald River), the winner of which take home the tournament!

4) Participation Requirements

1.  Squad Size												
When signing up, the house liege must choose at least 20 players, including 15 official squad members and 5 replacements. Each Warlord may only be a member of one squad. Once the participants list has been published, lieges should create their House on the tournament server and invite the players on their squad list to that house.
Siege Battles and Field Battles require at least 12 participants. If a squad fails to invite that many members to a game within 3 minutes of it starting, the referee may rule as they forfeiting the game, giving the win to the other squad.
												
2. Squad Names
Squads may choose their own names; however, the squad captain should create a House on the tournament server with the same House Name as per their original server, and set up the same Arms, and invite all squad members to that House. Squad names should be in English, and should not contain any words or characters that violate the game rules.

3. Rematches & Pauses
Participants are responsible for their own network connection during the tournament. If a contestant disconnects while loading or is unable to enter the game, the referee may choose to re-start the game. There will be no rematch if anyone disconnects or lags after the game has run for 1 minute. No pauses will be allowed while a game is running.

4. Rulings & Extra Matches
The first squad to win two matches out of a Best of 3 will be promoted. If each squad wins one match each, the winner of the Extra Match will be promoted.

5. Cheating & Punishments
Third party programs are strictly prohibited during the tournament, including those that modify in-game content, game interfaces, sounds, character skills, to name a few. If a contestant is found to have violated against this rule, they the referee may disqualify that contestant's entire squad, and permanently ban him from ever participating in any future Conqueror's Blade tournament.

6. Tournament Rules
Squads may be punished for any comment made by their members that is offensive in nature, including comments that are personal attacks, violate national regulations, contain racial discrimination, etc. For serious cases, the referee has the authority to disqualify squads.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade Season 3 - House Invitation Contest - Announcement
notes.content:
Contest Information

The S3 House Invitation Contest is a contest which we of the Asia Pacific operations team host for the most elite houses out there. Any House on the Asia-Pacific Server may sign up. After the Qualifiers and a tournament, 4 squads from each of Asia Pacific and China Mainland will be promoted to a final contest. In which they will represent the honour of their house and division, and contend for the glory of becoming the Champion of S3! The winning house will receive exclusive champion attires, titles and will be shown on the in-game loading screen.

How to Sign Up

1.	Sign Up Time: August 27 - September 4, 23:59.

2.	Sign Up Requirements:  Lieges of Free Houses and Legions on the Asia Pacific and Asia Nova servers that meet the following requirements may sign up via the in-game menu. While there, simply fill in the online questionnaire to sign up.
a)	When signing up, please be sure to leave a valid method of contact (mobile number/email/discord). Should we be unable to contact you, you will be considered as having forfeited your participation;
b)	A squad must consist of 20 House members, including 15 core members and 5 reserves;
c)	Only one squad may partake from any one House/Legion, and each Warlord may only be part of one squad;
d)	Only houses created before August 26 are eligible to enter;

3.	Members in squads that meet the requirements and sign up to participate will all receive a mystery reward.

4.	Selections: 
Once the sign ups end on September 4 23:59, we will calculate the score of each squad (squad score = total Ranked Battle score of the 15 members with the highest score). The 24 squads with the highest score will be qualified to enter the Qualifiers.

To ensure that every Warlord has enough time to accrue Ranked Battle score, starting from August 27 Ranked Battle will have its availability extended until the sign ups have ended. Ranked Battle will on Wednesdays and Fridays be extended to 24:00, and will be available between 22:00 and 24:00 on Saturdays, and between 21:30 and 24:00 on Sundays. We're looking forward to your participation!
The house that claims the first spot in the S2 House Invitation Contest and three other mystery squads will be directly qualified to enter the contest. We will be issuing invitations to the contest via in-game mail, so be sure to keep your eyes peeled.

Contest Schedule

1.	Training Battles: 
After sign ups end on September 4, we will tally up everyone's Ranked Battle score and publish the participants list on September 6, as well as relevant schedules. We will also be contacting squad captains to formally invite and assist them in initiating training matches and creation their houses on the contest servers.

2.	Qualifiers: 
Between September 7-9, the 24 squads that make it into the Qualifiers will fight it out in a single elimination tournament where matches are played as Best of Threes. Out of these 24, 12 will be promoted.

3.	Asia Pacific Division: 
Between September 10-13, the 12 squads promoted from the Qualifiers as well as 4 squads invited specifically by us will fill it ought in a single elimination tournament where matches are played as Best of Threes. During these days they will be fighting for four places in the cross-server contest.

4.	Cross-server Contest & Finals: 
Four squads from Asia Pacific will enter a double elimination tournament along with four squads from China Mainland, and fight to become the ultimate champion!

Warlords, we have already prepared an abundance of rewards for you, now it is up to you to organize your members and show your mettle on the battlefield!

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade August 6th Update Log
Development Journal: MENA Server Information
notes.content:
Hello everyone: 
Welcome to the world of Conqueror's Blade, a world where steel meets steel and where the civilizations of the world clash in heated combat. Our new MENA server launches on August 3rd, 09:00 (UTC +3). Let us introduce the MENA servers season and event rules, so that you can all get started as quickly as possible.

Season Rules

Since Conqueror's Blade's inception in 2019, we've already gone through three seasons, and the fourth is about to begin: [Blood of the Empire: The Fall and The Rise]. In this season we will return to the annals of history and relive the Battle of Constantinople.

In order for you all to be able to experience the season to its fullest, we've made the following adjustments to the time schedule of the season and of [Campaigns]: 

1、At server launch, week 1-5's season quest challenges will be immediately available, as will the unit challenges of Janissaries Hackbuteers, Royal Janissaries, and Empire Iron Pagodas;

2、The [Blood of the Empire: The Fall and The Rise] season will continue on the MENA server even after it has ended on other servers. Its time will be extended until the beginning of the following season. While available, players can continue to gain season experience, complete season challenges and peruse the season shop.

3、As season 3 is currently running, the Ostaria and Ungverija regions will be unavailable on the MENA server for the time being, and neither will The Borderlands or Border Posts. Which is why [Campaign] progress will not count while the season is running. However, you will be able to battle it out in the two available regions. Come next season, this content will become available as well.

Weekly Event Rules

1、Conquest/Military Exercise
While Conquest us running, warlords may create or join houses and embark upon expeditions and assault territories. This is without a doubt one of the most intense game modes of Conqueror's Blade. The Military Exercise serves as a qualifier for Conquest. 
Availability: Tuesdays and Saturdays 20:00-21:30 (UTC +3)
(Conquest will not be available on August 4th. Military Exercise will run on August 8th and 11th. The actual Territory War begins on August 15th)

2、Blood of the Empire Season Event Stages
During the [Blood of the Empire: The Fall And The Rise] season, two seasonal event stages will be available: The siege battle of [Continopolis] and the open-field battle of [Jinji Bay] will be available at set times each day. As the season progresses, the seasonal event stages will continue to be upgraded.
Availability: Every day between 15:00-16:30 and 20:00-21:30 (UTC +3)
(Only available between 15:00-16:30 on Tuesdays and Saturdays)

3、Free Battle
Each warlord may deploy up to five units in Free Battle, irrespective of Leadership, and at no kit cost.
Availability: Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays, and Saturdays between 17:00-18:30 (UTC +3)

4、Deathmatch
Only heroes may be brought into Deathmatch, a place where you can experience the thrill of fighting side-by-side.
Availability: Tuesdays, Thursdays, Sundays between 17:00-18:30 (UTC +3)

Considering the fact that this is a new server and that everything will be focused on amassing strength, Ranked Battle will not be available during this season. 

You can check more detailed information regarding each week's event by pressing the O key in-game to access the Event menu. Feel free to contact us via the contact methods at the bottom if you have any feedback regarding event times or otherwise. We will consider all feedback and adjust accordingly. Looking forward to hearing from you! 

Anyway, I hope that all of you warlords out there have a great time in the game. If you have any feedback or questions, feel free to contact us via any of the following means: 

Customer Support: cb_support@boominggames.com
Official Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/KaDs3xk
MENA Server Facebook: 
https://www.facebook.com/ConquerorsBladeME/?view_public_for=106158144526453

notes.title: 【Ranked Battle】——The New Play Mode of Conqueror's Blade
notes.content:
It has now been a year since the official release of the Conqueror's Blade. As you gain more experience on the battlefield, do you want to verify your skills and find many worthy opponents? 

Now we are introducing a brand-new game mode in the Conqueror's Blade——Ranked Battle. You can test your strength by taking on challenges in this mode. 

Unlike the usual random matches, the Ranked Battle will use a ranking point system. You will gain or lose points based on your performance on the battlefield, which will affect your ranking. At the end of the season, rewards will be settled based on your rank points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0db8732b46eeabfdc5a541a02ce70dfa5108b23e.jpg
 
Rules

1.Opening Hours:
-From 20:00-21：30 on every Wednesday
-From 20:00-21：30 on every Friday
-From 12:00-20:00 on every Saturday and Sunday

2.Access Threshold:
-The only Warlord whose characters have reached level 100 can participate in battles in this mode.

3.Team Up Limitation:
To avoid any disparity of strength, we only allow groups of three or less to join in the fight. Players above the Cadet-General can only team up with players who are one rank title apart from themselves.

4.Enjoy the fight:
In this mode, all kit consumption would be sponsored by the Market. Accordingly, there are no rewards to be gained on the battlefield, only pursuing pure victory.

5.Balancing:
It includes battlefields spread across the regions as follows:
Battlefield	Type	Players
Hidden City	Multistage Siege Battle	15VS15
Border Fort	Multistage Siege Battle	15VS15
Harbour City	Multistage Siege Battle	15VS15
Wall Fort Pass	Multistage Siege Battle	15VS15
Arena	Conquest	8VS8
Westwood	Conquest	8VS8
Desert Fortress	Conquest	8VS8
Marauder Settlement	Conquest	8VS8

6.Artillery Limitation:
In order to provide a better gaming environment, to fully demonstrate the Warlords' tactical strategies, command and coordination, as well as to ensure the battle experience of the attackers and defenders, we have balanced the types of equipment on every battlefield as follows:

The Attackers can only set up 2 Artilleries;
The Defenders can only set up 1 Artillery.

7.Weekly Rewards:
The Market will reward the Warlords for their excellent performance in battle with different rewards depending on the number of fights they win.
Claiming Location: J Screen —— Ranked Battle
1）Rewards of Battle Activity Chest Ⅰ
-Conditions of access: Win 2 games per week in Ranked Battle mode;
-Rewards: Bronze Coins*10,000; Honour*500

2) Rewards of battle Activity Chest Ⅱ
-Conditions of access: Win 5 games per week in Ranked Battle mode;
-Rewards: Bronze Coins*15,000; Honour*600; Random Doctrine Ability*2

8.Penalty:
In order to protect the experience of all players, we will deduct points or even ban players who intentionally quit the game for a day!

Limited Unit Attire

At the end of the season, Warlords, who have reached a certain level, will also receive a Limited Unit Attire! Each season, we'll provide a Limited Unit Attire rewards pool. Warlords who meet the criteria can choose one of them as a season settlement reward for the Ranked Battle!

The Attires confirmed for inclusion in the Limited Unit Attire rewards pool for this season's Ranked Battle are Fortebraccio Pikemen, Martellatore, Pavise Crossbowmen, and Serfs. 
Here's an image preview of these rewards:

notes.title: Maintenance and updates —— July 16th, 2020
A letter to dear warlords
notes.content:
Dear Warlords:
 
11th July, 2019 is a remarkable day for all of us: Conqueror’s Blade was officially released on Steam. It has been a whole year since then. Standing upon the anniversary milestone, our feeling is complicated. A year ago, as a R&D centric team, Booming was a green-hand in operation and service. We, however, did not retreat from the difficulties, and we are glad to see improvements and appreciation from our global community. Taking this chance, we’d like to share our thoughts, and extend our sincere gratitude to all of you.

1. Recovery
When the first territory war began, we were extremely excited to see so many players starting their journeys in the world of Conqueror’s Blade. However, we received many negative reviews due to the immature gameplay designs during S0. To resolve the unexpected crisis, we worked through holidays day and night for improvement. S1 is the first formal season after the major adjustment. We finally established the seasonal update mechanism - the territory resets over seasons along with new historical experience.

2. Globalization
It was extremely difficult for the S2 season due to Covid-19. Inspired by supports from our global community, we persisted in developing with our original goals and insured an on-time S2 experience. We keep introducing players from countries all over the world, and peak online players of Asia Pacific server kept breaking its own record. On 3rd July, S3 season was officially released which illustrates the fallen of Continopolis. Thanks to our continous efforts of globalization, we now provide 14 languages support. Moreover, we started a close cooperation with ImbaTV on Esports and successfully held the S2 House Invitational Tournament.

3. Vision
Booming Games strives to provide top-tier online medieval war game for global players, and we shall maintain the aspiration along the way. We will keep developing unique gameplay/contents, and fixing existing issues according to players’ feedback to provide the most realistic and immersive game experience. Furthermore, we will also work on providing considerate and tailored service to global players while expanding our global coverage. Our journey have just begun, and we are confident to provide the most immersive and unique gaming experience with the help and appreciation from all of you.

Thank you all again for being with us.
Let’s make Conqueror’s Blade the best massive online medieval war game in the world!

Conqueror’s Blade Operation Team
Booming Games
11/07/2020

notes.title: World Map Pursuit Battle and Field Camps Gameplay Dev Diary
notes.content:
Dear Warlords:
Hello everyone!
I am C, the designer of Conqueror’s Blade. At the beginning of this season, we planned to launch new game mechanic of Player-build Fief and Pursuit Battle to enrich the strategy game experience of Territory battles and to solve the historical Territory battle line issue.
After we finished the new mechanic’s development, we organized a whole team to do test, and the result is not satisfying. After many updates and discussions, we think the new design is not as ideal as expected, and the players’ interactions are not up to our standard. Eventually, we make this hard call: Player-build Fief and Pursuit Battle gameplay mechanics are going to be re-developed. On behalf of the Conqueror’s Blade team, I’d like to apologize to all of you! From the bottom of my heart.
As the designer of these two new gameplay mechanics, I want to share the whole development experience with you, to let you know why did we make such a decision to re-develop the mechanics.

Why did we want to remake the Pursuit Battle and Player-build Fief mechanics?

Historical and annoying Battle line “Strategy”: For a long time, the territory war is always obstructed by some “clever” players who intentionally join the battle line and stay idle to help another alliance defend the fief. Although we updated the new ruler house system, this issue was not fundamentally solved. And this issue became our big concern. 

Unending Waiting: With the previous gameplay mechanic, whether players are appointed to defend empty fief or to begin an unending queuing outside the battlefield, players cannot enjoy the most basic pleasure of joining territory wars. Not to mention those players who are not qualified to join the fight. This is not what we want. 

Brainless Pursuit: As for previous pursuit battle design, players can just crudely pick up a fight to slow enemies down. And the long loading time and capturing time did disrupt the game rhythm, making the pursuit battles deviating from its original intention. And the pursuit battle itself is not as enjoyable and exciting as we expected.

What’s our new design? And how’s the true situation?

Pursuit Area Control, consolidate step by step
To make field camps become more interesting, we want to make filed camps and fiefs more worthy to be captured. As the result, we came up with an idea - “Area Control”. When a pursuit battle begins at an area, the adjacent 8 areas will be involved in the pursuit battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4f2aade3b5548ad73125069b65c8f51e35f2296f.jpg
 
When enemies or allies enter the involved area, they might be involved in the pursuit battle. If they choose to escape, they might suffer some losses. So, the pursuit battle will become a “barricade” of marching. When several “barricades” are adjacent to each other, there will be a large strictly controlled area, interrupting the marching.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/184d9e05230e7681e9cb99091ab90b94df55de3b.jpg
 
Simulation of the true battles, which means chaos
Before players enter the battlefield, they can click the two sides who are fighting against each other and then choose to enter the battle forwardly. In this condition, the player can choose deployment point based on the real-time situation to launch a surprise attack or to assist allies. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0425a563c5c982952dfe2c9328f538a90925c180.jpg
 
After entered the war area, players might be involved into the battles but can choose to fight or try to escape from battlefield. Of course, even if you choose to escape, there is still a chance that you get yourself involved.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08c9b7d59d921f7980fbc12ad5d33fb6bcc46755.jpg
         
We adjust the previous mechanic of pursuit battles: Pursuit is no longer a two-team fight. Now the system will automatically create two sides for pursuit battles based on the houses/alliances, in a single pursuit battle, there can be up to 30 teams fighting against enemy forces. We redesigned the deployment points, and players can enter the battle from 8 positions/directions depends on the direction which is chosen by player on world map “war area”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0a61d9dc8637e1d97e9fe8c94e1513d2bde3f021.jpg
         
Unique Ruler's Flag decides the ruling house
We hope to provide an equal chance for all players to fight for becoming ruling house, that’s why we designed Ruler’s Flag. In a fief’s area, there will only be one ruler’s flag, the house who owns the flag is the ruling house. And only when ruler’s flag exists, the fiefs in this area can be captured.
         
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/19898034a47612cc623f0bd0927ebb6ad2083bc7.jpg     
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6060536e1245190cd6335d4bbb2747e7bfafa1b0.jpg

Manpower Competition, structure construction/demolition speeds up
We hope players can be freed from battle lines so we canceled field camps’ battle lines and levels. Instead, we design new construction/demolition mechanic. Every player can bring units to construct or demolish the field camps, when the field camp’s HP become 0, the field camp is totally destroyed.
  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/045ce5f52b68b428b4b84d1115487bcac3c69f23.jpg       

Why aren’t the new mechanics as expected? What are the difficulties? 

In the new pursuit battles, the chaos makes player confused about the goal.
The disordered engaging mode and multi-party battle make the new pursuit battles much more interesting while them make the winning condition and guide information confusing. Players cannot judge the right target or make decisions.

Waiting, still too much waiting
During the tests, we found that the new mechanics didn’t solve the waiting issue: The construction/demolition controls are tricky, players need to spend too much time waiting. And there are also too many meaningless restrictions on players’ actions.

The core of territory war is ignored - fight, endlessly fight!
In the original design, we mainly focused on solving battle line issue and we did ignore the core of territory war: fight. We hope the battles during territory wars can be equal and bloody. But the two new mechanics keep players away from the endless battles. Many players need to be idle around the field camps. So, the result is not acceptable.

Significantly Affect Legion Players Game Experience
We found that with new mechanics, it is much harder for Legion players to capture fiefs. Because only houses who own the ruler’s flag can capture fiefs, Legion players need to march to designed position and then do the preparations. However, Legion itself is a loosely organized group, asking Legion to organize such united activities is unrealistic. So the Legion’s territory war experience is definitely affected. 

Future Plan

New field camp and pursuit battle gameplay can actually provide some novel experience. But there are still many design issues troubling us, we need more time to polish the new design, and we might invite players to take part in the test;

We will focus on the core experience to provide higher combat experience quality;

In the future designs, we will give consideration to various scale houses which have different goals. We will also pay attention to Legion players’ sense of purpose and game experience. In a word, we will let all players enjoy the territory war.

Conqueror’s Blade Team
7th July, 2020

notes.title: Maintenance and updates —— July. 9th, 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords：
We will be doing server maintenance and game update on 12:00-14:00(UTC+8) July. 9th. The estimated period will be about two hours. After that, you'll receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation. Please be prepared, and here is the specific updates are as follows:

1. The launch of the new Pursuit System and Player-build Fiefs will delay

Why is it delayed?

During our preparation for the 3rd season, we realized that to provide a better Territory War experience, we had to solve the problem of blocking the battle lines by those "spy." Therefore, we are preparing to launch the new Pursuit System and Player- build Fiefs to optimize the gameplay. Because of the excessive number of modified elements, we found that there were still many problems with the new content when we tested it. 

As a result, the new Pursuit System and Player-built Fiefs will not be released this season but will be taken back to redesign and rebuild. The original Pursuit and Player-build Fiefs will be released after the maintenance and updates of July 16th. The first Territory War will officially begin on July 18th.

For this cancellation of the new Pursuit System and Player-built Fiefs, we offer our sincerest apologies. We'll be following up with a Developers Log detailing the problems we encountered during the development process.

Rescheduling of events:
1) Rescheduling of Territory War
On July 11th and July 14th, we will only release the Military Exercise in the Big World. The Territory War will be released on July 18th.

2) Delay in joining the Legion
Because of the delay in rescheduling the Territory War, we decided to postpone when players can join the Legion. It's expected to open on July 16th.

Subsequent optimization plans:

We will continue to improve Pursuit and Player-build Fiefs in Season 3 to address the previous legacy issues and provide a better experience for players.

2.Rescheduling of Campaigns:

1) Players can enter the Crossing Frontiers phase on August 3rd;
2) Players can join the Heart of the World phase on August 10th.

3.Seasonal Title rewards:
After the end of Gilded Age: Commerce and Mercenary, we've received a lot of feedback from players that they want the same Title rewards that they got at the end of the first season. While we don't have such a reward program, we do understand that this title carries a season's worth of effort and glory for players. 

Now we will be rewarding the Warlords who worked hard during the Gilded Age with such a title, and we hope you will cherish this and remember the memories forever.

In Gilded Age: Commerce and Mercenary, the Alliance members, which capture the Conqueror's City, will receive the title "Conqueror's Companion." 

Legionnaires who participate in defense of Conqueror's City will be permanently awarded the title of "Loyal Legionary." These titles represent your glorious achievements during the Gilded Age and will be remembered forever and wish you all the best for the next season!
