notes.title: S3 Patch Note Blood of the Empire: The Fall and The Rise (Part 2)
notes.content:
VI. The Depth Upgrade of Territory War

To enrich the Territory War gameplay so that it will be no longer just a tournament within a fief but an area control game with depth, we have further optimized the player-build fief and Pursuit gameplay.

1. Player-build fief

1) Construction and occupation of new player-build fiefs
Now most of the player-build fiefs will have their unique construction and occupation rules
-Players can mouse-click on a self-built stronghold and choose to repair or destroy it, repairing or reducing the life of the player-build fiefs based on the player's Leadership of the troops they bring with them;
-The player-build fief under construction is also allowed to be accelerated or destroyed;
-Wounded characters cannot participate in military operations against the player-build fiefs.

2) New types of the player-build fief
A. Battle Flag
-Battle Flag is for players to occupy a player-build fief;
-Only with Battle Flag, you can capture a player-build fief when you breach it. Otherwise, you can only loot it;
-Only one Battle Flag is allowed to exist in a region. When a Battle Flag under construction, no other battle flag can be built.

B. Artillery Construction Base
-Members within the player-build fief's House or Alliance can purchase Artillery and large siege equipment in limited quantities at the Artillery Construction Base;
-Those large siege equipment purchased in the Artillery Construction Base will deploy directly into the battlefield.

C. Medical Tents
-Members within the player-build fief's House or Alliance can heal their troops in the Medical Tents;
-If there is a medical tent in an area, the duration of the wounding effect on your troops will be reduced by 50% if the nearby fief has an aid station. It is only valid for fighters wounded in that area, not for entering the place from other regions. Each House can only build one Medical Tent in a field.

3) Adjustments to the declaration of war
-Only after declaring war on a city can you build a player-build fief within that city's jurisdiction.

4) The Territory War now has a preparation period
-30 minutes before the start of a power battle is considered the preparation period;
-Players are allowed to build player-built fiefs during preparation (The war has been declared);
-During the preparation, the player-built fiefs can be attacked, but not town, village, or forts.

2.Improvements in Pursuit 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5c51c866e601eb93777d22e86cdb4bf0095356cc.jpg

To make the terrain on the big world really work, to allow players to use human wall tactics to limit their opponents, and also to make every piece of land on the edge of the fief valuable, we've improved the Pursuit, moving from just troop blocking to tactical blocking with the terrain.
 
1) Bring in Local Battlefield
All the Pursuits in the same area will be on the same battlefield.
-When you enter a Pursuit, a Local Battlefield will be automatically formed within a specific area centered on the encounter point;
-Players will have a probability of entering the activate Local Battlefield by stepping into the field;
-The further you are from the center of a Local Battlefield, the lower the probability of entering that battle;
-When the player triggers the event to enter the battlefield, they are presented with two options, "enter the battlefield" and "turn around". If you select "enter the battlefield", you will join the battle. If you select "turn around," you will not enter the battlefield, but you will be wounded.

2) Pursuit Rules Adjustment
We've changed the Pursuit from a two-way confrontation to a scramble that allows multiple forces to enter.
-Pursuit allows various forces to join in, with a maximum of 15 players per force that can bring, but no limit to the number of different powers;
-Only the force that captures the flag in the center of the map will be the winner;
-The force that eventually captures the flag will get all the loot for this Pursuit;
-Players who voluntarily join the local battlefield can choose their spawn position, and players who mistakenly enter the battlefield will be randomly assigned a spawn point.

To more realistically recreate the immediacy of the Pursuit, we've removed the deployment and settlement phases.

VII. Personalized Action for Hero and Tactic Wheel

In the new season, we will increase the performance of Hero to show your personality and express your feelings;
At the same time, we enrich and optimize the contents of the tactic wheel to make communication more convenient in the battlefield.
In the main city, only Action Wheel is displayed by default; in the battlefield, Tactic Wheel is displayed by default and can be switched to Action Wheel.

1. Personalized Action
Players can show their personalized actions in the battlefield or in the city to express themselves.
You can select the action you want to assemble in the role [P] interface - Personality - Action, and right-click to preset the action, as shown:
In the battlefield, press and hold the middle mouse button (MMB) or Y key, and right-click or click TAB key to switch to the Action Wheel to trigger and release the action;

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2703dfaa5db49e8bb7f4c1c80f10e59f38633841.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a8051402ac31513cd840bb58bf2976b2ef0053f6.jpg
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/353793d8283604a45b765de21e5aa1eedf3bc428.jpg

Default Unlocking Actions: bowing, clapping, greeting, goodbye, laughing, crying.

2. Tactic Wheel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/009040baf5107cc630c7a2ab33a7cb207491aa17.jpg

Players can preset the required tactical instructions on the Tactic Wheel so that they can send tactical instructions in the battlefield to communicate with their teammates quickly and conveniently.
You can select the tactics you want to assemble in the character [P] interface - Personality - Tactics, and right-click to preset the tactics, as shown:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0e911c73250676a567c9ee56b44064bff1bdcccc.jpg
 
In the battlefield, press and hold the middle mouse button or Y key to trigger Tactic Wheel and send the tactical command;

VIII. Season Challenge for Units

1. Challenge content optimization

We have optimized some of the challenges that are difficult to complete and poor experience this season:

A. Bi-condition set for some tasks
For example, there was a task that allowed players to destroy many large siege equipment, which made it difficult for players to complete the task when they were in line with the attackers. We changed the conditions for this type of mission to destroy large siege equipment or gain 50 Capture Points.

B. Add some tasks that can accumulate progress with team members
For example, you can team up with other players, and all members accumulate the task of killing Heroes.

2. Season 3 Unit Challenge

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c3507439b1fc0cfde6f1aad2268117d613650da4.jpg
 
There are four new units in this season, which can be obtained in the challenge task:
Janissaries Hackbuteers (Chivalric Era unit)
Empire Iron Pagodas (Heroic Era unit)
Spahks Cavalry (Heroic Era unit)
Royal Janissaries (Golden Era unit)

3. Previous Season Unit Challenge
In the new season, you can still carry on the previous season unit challenge and Hero challenge.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/296e928483f5e4c41463d554b7ba7a0b40dd6f91.jpg

Changes of Challenge Rule:
-To complete the challenge of each stage, you need to complete all tasks of the stage;
-During the challenge, the extra reward for each completed task is canceled.
Challenge Switch:
-In the new season, you can switch to the previous season challenge in the options at the season challenge interface;
-You can only challenge in one season each time.

Changes of Maul Hero Challenge Rule 
-Players who have not activated Maul Hero challenge can switch to Season 2 Challenge interface once it begins.

IX. Other Season Challenge

1. Weekly Challenge 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b8195ec000d39b5bf60ed3647cf7ae4a51ca6f46.jpg
 
Season 3 will provide 10 weeks of Weekly Challenges, and players will receive additional rewards after completing a weekly task.
As time goes on, players will learn more about this world changing siege story from the inserted video and text of the weekly challenge of the season.

2.  Growth Challenge

In order to help new players integrate quickly into the vast world of war, in the new season, we have increased the challenge of season growth. The entrance of the season Growth Challenge is located in the season interface - Season Challenge.

Season Growth Challenge is divided into two parts: Janissaries Courage Training and Spark Loyalty Test.

Janissaries Courage Training includes rewards of Unit Medal, Doctrine and Signaculum to help units grow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5d32680467af256810f5ed2bab3cd43531a72ecb.jpg
 
Spark Loyalty Test includes Mastery Points, Scholarly Text, Equipment Schematics and other rewards to help Hero grow.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/aee2ee8210524f20ec2907e2d06eb4eca51d9919.jpg

Janissaries Courage Training and Spark Loyalty Test have four stages, each stage has eight tasks:
If you complete 6 tasks, you can get all the rewards in this stage and enter the next one. The reward value increases as the stage progresses.

X. House System Optimization

At present, the house system is relatively weak and lacks house gameplay and rewards. In this regard, we have added some systems to improve the game experience in this season:

1. House Funds and House Supplement system

Members of Noble Houses can use house funds to resupply their units.
Players can use house funds instead of war currency to resupply their units by choosing [Spend house Funds First] at the Resupply interface.
Each player can use a certain amount of house funds, which can be set by the house leader.
house Funds can be obtained by house members completing [House Reward] and [House Challenge]. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0a3aa60436e65996b8d0ac53aac783a3e32053fd.jpg
 
2. House Reward System and House Challenge System 

The new House Reward System entrance is at the [N House / Camp] interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e86dc758fda83624f51cbc66f9b790f413b0b56c.jpg
 
At 0 o'clock every Monday, Noble Houses will refresh a series of house challenges.
-These challenges require the cooperation of all house members to complete and accumulate the challenge progress together.
-After completing the House Challenge, the house will receive large house funds and all house members will receive a challenge reward.
Meanwhile, members of the Noble Houses and members of the Legion Camp will receive a number of House Reward missions.
-The reward task is for individual members. Different from common tasks, when playing games with members of the same house / camp, they can accumulate the task progress together,
-In addition, some tasks need to be done in teams with members of the same house / camp.
-After completing the House Reward task, players who complete the reward can get rich rewards and gain house funds for the house.

XI. Alliance Mission Optimization

1. Optimize the pace of some levels, reduce the overall duration of levels, and adjust the difficulty of the level appropriately

Optimize the Alliance Mission level of Desert Fortress Defense PvE (Moderate)  and Westwood (Moderate): optimize the pace and shorten the duration of the level;

Optimize the Alliance Mission level of Desert Fortress Defence PvE (Hard) and Westwood (Hard): optimize the pace and shorten the duration of the level; appropriately increase the difficulty for a greater challenge;

2.  Expanded Content for Alliance Mission (Hard) PVE Level  
After adjusting the difficulty of some easy alliance missions, they will be used as the new Alliance Mission (Hard) PVE level
Baisha Siege (Hard);
Liberate the Village (Hard)

XII. Battle Optimization of Territorial Stronghold

Adjust the number of ladders in the siege of territorial strongholds
Increase the number of ladders in each group (adjusted to 4-5 ladders / group according to the actual situation) and reduce the difficulty to attack the city walls of the strongholds for attackers.

XIII. Regular System Optimization and Bug Fix

Optimize the rules of Military Rank display, and wholly reduce the tier requirement for promoting Military Rank;

notes.title: S3 Patch Note Blood of the Empire: The Fall and The Rise (Part 1)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/134e72e18ea35c601b6038c5f61c6cf3bfc6de1d.jpg

Season 3 starts on 3rd July
Server maintenance from 3rd July 12:00 to 14:00 （UTC+8）

Before the prairie tribe becoming the Prairie Khanate, the Adrian Empire was already one of the most powerful empires on the entire continent. Half a century earlier, the Great Lord "Thunder" had swept away the western lords and occupied most of the land south of Ungverija. When Thunder was leading his army sieging the Millennium City Continopolis, the Prairie Khanate suddenly invaded the Thunder's land. Under extreme passivity, he was forced to retreat from the Continopolis and turn around to fight the Prairie Khanate. Unfortunately, he was defeated in the battle, captured by the enemy, and the entire empire was plunged into decades of chaos. This period is referred to as "Lack of Leadership."

It was during these chaotic decades that the Prairie Khanate was short-lived and split into several tribes. A mysterious businessman gathered other powerful merchants to set up a Commerce, using the power of economics to revitalize the land and open up a new "Gilded Age." The rise of Commerce and mercenaries had filled the whole continent with opportunities, especially in the vital transportations. Just to the south, across the sea from Ungverija, the formerly besieged Continopolis was reborn in the Gilded Age. Although it has gradually declined from an empire with many territories to a Mega-City, with the wealth brought by mercenaries and taxes, the Continopolis was still a vital hub for merchants traveling to and from the continent by its excellent location. Gold stuffed the city treasury, and scholars and merchants went back and forth between East and West by ship in there. At that time, it was the most prosperous city in the world. 

But even beneath the cover of prosperity, the darkness grows. As the people of the city drank and sang their praises, they failed to notice that the empire, which had fallen into chaos, was gradually restoring order and making preparations to regain its former glory. 

The collapse of Prairie Khanate allowed them to recover from decades of civil war. Ghazi I defeated all of his brothers and reunited the empire. He then swept away a few remnants of the surrounding forces. He didn't stop and aimed his gaze back at the Continopolis that his ancestors had failed to conquer. 

However, even the unstoppable Ghazi I was at a loss under the towering walls of the Continopolis. The city had faced dozens of sieges over the millennia. When the incoming enemy saw the towering walls, they could only watch and sigh. The high walls guaranteed the continuation of the city for a thousand years. Although Ghazi I was adept at leading armies, after months of siege, he had no choice but to sign a peace treaty with the ruler of the Continopolis. Let them pay tribute to the Empire regularly. 

Then Ghazi I died, and Ghazi II took his place. The young Lord was anxious to demonstrate his strength to silence the nobles and various officials who had caused trouble in the early days of his reign. The conquest of the Millennium City had adopted as his primary strategy for making a stand, and two years had spent in preparation. He built up a large navy, blockaded the adjacent seas to isolate the Continopolis, and purchased a factory from the Ungverija to produce heavy artillery. He also built a fortress on the coast and closed the bridge to the north, preventing any reinforcements from reaching the Continopolis. When everything was in place, he mobilized the massive army and began the siege of the Continopolis.

It was a day remembered by all scholars. Beyond the city walls, the massive army from the Adrian Empire had set up a camp that spread for dozens of miles, like an ocean that could not be reached at a glance. The enemies in the camp were dressed in magnificent exotic costumes, with swords at their waists and equipped with the most advanced firearms.

The army attacked the towering walls like a tidal wave but was repulsed again and again by the defenders, led by Rania mercenaries. The battle was bloody and brutal.

After a long and fruitless attack, the attackers began digging tunnels that led to the city's interior. And one of the engineers in the king's city realized that, and the fight then began under the grand city. The defenders managed to drive the enemy out of the city - the underground made no exceptions. 

The Empire then used the terrifying weapon of that era, the Great Bombard, which was a 5-meter-long, 17-ton-weight cannon built-in bronze. The granite shells it used weighed 680 kilograms. It was a weapon beyond its time. The granite shells it used weighed 680 kilograms. It was a weapon beyond its time. When the Great Bombard fired, the earth within a kilometer radius shook mightily. There were also dozens of artilleries of varying sizes fired along with the giant Great Bombard.  After the smoke and dust had cleared away, it was found that the city wall had blown through a significant breach. To the surprise of the attackers, however, when a hole was blown on the wall, the defenders used mud, brick dust, bags full of wool, and even expensive tapestries to fill the gaps on the walls. By the time the giant The Great Bombard cannon had been refilled, the imperial forces found that the once-blown-down walls had been repaired. And the new fence was much more pliable, and it resistant to shells. 

The army cut down the nearby forest, made chutes out of flattened wood and animal fat, and transported the soldiers to the enemy's rear in dozens of small ships. The assault held some of the defenders, and a gap gradually appeared in the front line. The two sides persisted in this seesawing for a whole month, and their energy and morale slowly ran out. 
One night during a lunar eclipse, the nobles of the city believed the eclipse to be an ill omen and knelt to pray. But what they waited for was news of the city's fall.

The frontal attack was ineffective, and the tunneling tactics were neutralized by the defenders, leaving the army's morale in the doldrums. Ghazi II came to the moment of make or break.

The heavily armored soldiers rushed the walls with the cover of firearm and artillery behind them. The heavily armored soldiers rushed the walls with the covers of firearm and artillery behind them. The battlefield became so tumultuous that one of the defenders described it: "The air seemed to be torn, and it looked like hell outside the walls." 

Ghazi II ordered the palace guards, who had been out of the fight, to enter the battle. They charge into the city through a gap that had just been blown open. The guards' addition was the last straw that broke the camel's back, and the defense finally collapsed completely.

Losing the walls as a barrier, the city's defenders could only keep retreating into the city. Despite fighting to the death in the city's alleyways, there was still no way to change the outcome.

The Continopolis Lord in purple robes refused to retreat, drew his sword, and charged at the imperial force. It wasn't until Ghazi II entered the city and stopped the slaughter that some of the city's nobles could save their own lives. 

Just as every vast empire will eventually become the cornerstone of an enormous empire, the eastern Lord birthed his brand-new empire by destroying the city last a thousand years that would become the heart of the new empire. 

The Gilded Age is over, and a whole new era has arrived.

I. Units for Season 3
 4 brand-new units will join in this Season. You can unlock them by Unit Challenge and they will enjoy season bonus. 
Season Bonus:
-Leadership requirements reduced by 5
-Unit kits supply reduced by 50%

1. Janissaries Hackbuteers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/30b567eead632608d028290f363d6ae8bd2e5896.jpg
 
Unit Level: 3 stars

Background:
There was a country rose in the southern desert of the Borderlands. It started plundering the territories around the so-called Eternal Empire that last for thousands of years, which had already weakened. They want to unite the western powers, then strike the east as they did two hundred years ago. But that eastern expedition two hundred years ago did not succeed, and only resulted in corpses and starvation. The leaders of the western powers no longer had any ambition for such an expedition, but only expected to profit from the war. To avoid an East-West war on this continent, the Eternal Empire leader decided to unite the southern country by marriage. The leader's daughter, which was a beautiful princess, married to the South. There were many skilled craftsmen alongside with her. Therefore, the technology for making gunpowder and matchlock made its way to the South. 

The southern country refined the gunpowder and improved gunsmithing skills, and then they started to train soldiers as Janissaries Hackbuteers, who’d scare the hell out of the enemy in the next decade. Most of these soldiers were the princes and nobles' children and received the most rigorous training at the palace. Dressed in colorful traditional costumes, they looked less like soldiers but more like dancers. The large-caliber muskets needed to set up before they could fire. 

Those matchlocks have a slow fire rate, but their power and accuracy are outstanding on the battlefield. The musket technology originated in the Eternal Empire, but it played a considerable role in the war that burying the Eternal Empire.

Unit Specialties:
This unit, not good at moving around frequently in battlefields, needs a specific location to fire. Once the musket is set up with a gun rack, it has relatively high firing rate and accuracy. Equipped with the large Lead bullets ammunition, it can cause Freeze and bypass enemy shields when attacking at the vital part.

2. Empire Iron Pagodas

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/00022c617baeea2babcea4cf094a8a643f926a49.jpg
 
Unit Level: 4 stars

Background:
They wore armor made of the best steel and held scimitars that glittered and shields with magnificent patterns. They are the servants of Death, the embodiment of Calamity.  The Empire Iron pagodas are coming from the south country, but they bring death to the Western. Despite their heavy armor, the scimitar they wielded was swift and deadly. Their good defense allows them to take down enemy attacks easily and quickly fight back.

Unit Specialties:
Good at dealing with melee units and low armor units due to its special crooked Falchion with a heavy end.
Good at fighting back in block and giving out a hit streak against enemies which causes a high damage in close combat.

3. Spahks Cavalry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cc3aa62be08cbf42228fb3cc64ffa0af4dadf114.jpg
 
Unit Level: 4 stars

Background:
Men who come from noble families have inherited the discipline and bravery of their ancestors made the Spahks Cavalry. Their wealthy families provided them with the most excellent weapons and armor, and even their mounts were covered in a layer of chain armor. They were like the king of the cavalry. Although their charging ability was a little weaker than the traditional heavy cavalry, once they encounter the enemy, their mighty spears and hammers will become incredibly efficient meat grinder.

Unit Specialties:
Good at fighting hand-to-hand and riding a horse to assault enemies at close range and cause chaos. 
By spurring the horses to smash into the enemy and trod them under foot, this unit can cause range damage and Thrown effect to break enemy ranks. 

4. Royal Janissaries

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2e146944a9c6b78642558f4c4383c01d3988907f.jpg
 
Unit level： 5 stars

Background:
Rulers need not thugs, but guards with authority and dignity. They acknowledged in books and well trained. The Crown provided them with the best weapons and armor. On the battlefield, they were the most reliable soldiers and the best war machines.

Unit Specialties:
They are powerful units in close combats, which can attack enemy in various ways with its Tomahawk. 
Tomahawk Sweep can cause lots of range damage. While the Hero Guard skill forms a protective circle, he can use Tomahawk to push and repulse the enemy attacks. Combined with the Sweep, players can easily fight their way out. 

II. New Map for Season 3 

1. Continopolis (Siege Battle)

Map Background
the magnificent city, located at the intersection of land and sea in the west, has been standing for thousands of years. The ancient culture has been spread and blended here, and great epics have been staged here. Although after several wars, Continopolis still stands tall, waiting for the beginning of the next millennium.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/31b42e88e8e85df4edea042b6110286b9d76685d.jpg
 
Gameplay Introduction:
Continopolis is located at the end of the peninsula. It faces the sea on three sides and has a city wall for defense. The only side facing the land has a wide and open terrain. A three-dimensional defense system composed of moat and compound city walls runs across it. It guards the city behind the high wall of deep ditch, which has never been lost for thousands of years.
An ancient palace complex is located in the corner of the city near the bay. It is located on the top of a hill, overlooking the whole bay. Under the palace, a fortress guards the only way to get in and out of the palace and the gate at the foot of the mountain. Under the coordination of the fortress and the wall garrison, the conventional means of attacking the city by the enemy are not worth mentioning. Only when the engineering technology and on-the-spot tactics are exerted to the extreme can the enemy win the war of the century.

2. Golden Poleaxe Bay (field battle)

Background map:
Located at the mouth of the Bay in the north of Continopolis, the huge bay encircles the land, and the iron cables stand horizontally in the Bay, blocking all the attacks from the sea. For thousands of years, countless people have been buried here, separated by a river from Continopolis, but thousands of miles away from glory and wealth. Gold and blood have flowed here, and the land will never be short of visitors with iron armor.

Gameplay Introduction:
Golden Poleaxe Bay has a continuous forest, covering the entire Gulf peninsula. With the siege of the magnificent city in a state of anxiety, and the huge chain in the bay of Golden Poleaxe Bay separated the warship from the city. The attackers tried to launch a new round of attack from the inland side of the bay of Golden Poleaxe Bay, trying to push the warship to the blocked bay in the way of "boating on land" and attack the weak wall on the flank of the city. The city garrison with information sent troops to carry out the attack interdiction, the two launched a fierce battle in the Golden Poleaxe Bay inland.

III. The Doctrine Abilities

We've brought the Doctrine Abilities into the game, which will let those units have their Doctrine Ability Pool, and allow players to consume Doctrine to activate the unit's Doctrine Skills. You can mix and match as many as you like based on your usage habits and tactical strategy. 

1. Equipped Doctrine Display

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0c82ece5cbf1d93e2581dec933e6024eff614586.jpg
 
2. Exclusive Unit Doctrine Pool

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d55d16404fa68e4494bfc63b4cd1ded3a4df5035.jpg
 
Each unit has a given pool of abilities. At first, the capabilities are all locked. When you expend the corresponding Doctrine in your inventory, you can activate the Doctrine Ability in that ability pool.

3. Doctrine Activation and Equipment

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3bea81b3e42f2d023c2d4f624452bbd1eb40bea5.jpg
 
Click the locked Doctrine in the Pool to check whether it can be activated currently. If there is the activated Doctrine, it can be consumed to activate Doctrine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6638b66ee8cdaa1961364ebfc2f9c42d30314ac0.jpg
 
Put the activated Doctrine into the central slot to assemble. When put into the assembled slot, the original Doctrine will automatically be unloaded.

4.Season Limited Doctrine Optimization
Season limited doctrines will appear in related units' doctrine pool when acquired. Like other activated doctrines, warlords can freely try new doctrine builds. Season limited doctrine will disappear when it expire.

IV. The balancing of Heroes

1. Heroes damage

Goal: 
We noted that in extreme cases, the stacking of the Hero's damage buff could have an overly exaggerated effect, so we made some adjustments.

Adjustment
The Hero's attack increases by up to 2.5x.

2.Poleaxe Heroes

Goal:
The Weapon Dance of Poleaxe Heroes used by few due to its low power and long cooling time. So we have to buff it as follows:
After Adjustment: 
Weapon Dance with
-Increased attack range
-After the skill hits, the target will be facing the attacker.
-Effect: When Weapon Dance hits an enemy, the "Attack Power Reduced" debuff will last for 2 more seconds. 
-Shorter cooling time with
Low-Grade: 24 seconds
Mid-Grade: 20 seconds
High-Grade: 16 seconds

3.Bow Heroes

Goal:
Because they have long-range and high attack power. Melee Heroes are having trouble catching up to them and posing a sufficient threat. They are always in a passive situation when facing Bow Heroes.
Therefore, we decided to reduce the burst power of their skills and make ranged attacks require a Charge before release. Besides, the Charging will also consume HP the same as escaping. The specific adjustments are as follows:

1.Shooting requires a Charge for maximum attack power, similar to a normal attack.
 The changing of Charge:
-It will consume HP.
-It takes longer than before to release a Half-Charged arrow.
2) The Rain of Arrows, Flaming Arrow, Bodkin-tipped, Lightning Bolt and Explosive Arrow, will become:
The longer the Charge, the straighter the trajectory, and the more powerful it is.
3) The damage of skills other than the Explosive Arrow will change with Charge:
No Charge: Deal 50% piercing damage;
Half-Charge: Deal 80% piercing damage;
Full-Charge: Deal 110% piercing damage.
4) Explosive Arrow's damage is reduced by 50%, but Charge or not does not affect its damage.
5) The piercing ability of Lightning Bolt will be affected by Charge:
No Charge: Cannot pierce;
Half-Charge: Can pierce 2 targets;
Full-Charge: Can pierce 5 targets.

2.Normal Attack Adjustment:
-When your Units prepare your bow and arrow, it won't lower the movement speed.

3.The Bodkin-tipped III Adjustment:
-The Bodkin-tipped III will reduce the enemy's block correctly other than ignoring Defense.

4.Nodachi Heroes 
Goal:
The idea behind the Nodachi Heroes' design is that it is a medium armor unit that relies on their ability to steal HP for continued combat at the front line. But when they are facing heavily armored units, without armor-piercing damage, they wouldn't be able to play their primary role. Low armor-piercing value means low damage. Without enough damage, Nodachi Heroes cannot continuously fight at the front line counting on HP stealing. 
Therefore, we have redesigned the gameplay of them: Players can store their buffs, and activate it at the most appropriate time, allowing them to choose the timing of using their skills actively.

Adjustment:
1) The new design of skills
[Bloodstain]:
Gain 3% HP stealing, can stack up to 5 times, permanently valid, clears buffs upon death.
When [Bloodstain] stack 5 times, it will become [Blood Rage]. If the unit already has [Blood Rage], it will refresh the [Blood Rage].

[Blood Rage]
Gain 25% HP stealing, add more 15% Piercing and Slashing Armor Penetration. It can't be stacked and will last 8 seconds.

[Blood Heal]
Gain 1500 HP healing per second, it can't be stacked and will last 4 seconds.

2) Fearless & Steadfast, Bloodthirsty, and Samurai's March
Removed effect: Gain 4% HP stealing when hit the target, stack it up to 5 times, and last 5 seconds.
Added effect: Gain a [Bloodstain] buff when hitting a target.

3) Monstrous Blade
Added effect: When activating Monstrous Blade, if the unit has [Blood Rage], then consume it and gain [Blood Heal].

4) Blood Oath
Added effect: When activating Blood Oath, if the unit has [Blood Rage], then refresh it.

5) Samurai's March III
Added effect: Increases Block Break

5. Spear Heroes

Analysis and plan:
Skills of Spear Heroes: The secret of Procris's Gift III can ignore enemy's defense to make it retreat and kill it even behind a tower shield array. The units are not able to protect Hero when encountering this skill.
Adjustment:
Skill: The secret of Procris's Gift III
-deleted: ignoring defense 
-added: Attack with large blocking break value

V. Adjustment on Balance and Optimization for Units 

1.Iron Reapers 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f02790903ee559161d8b30b2bd7c6551529f2273.jpg
 
Analysis and plan:
The Iron Reaper is too hard to be defeated for an opponent due to its outstanding ability to endure damages. We will make modification as follow.
Adjustment
-decrease Armor Penetration Defense and Slashing Defense by 10% 
-decrease Movement Speed by 5% and Spinning Speed by 10% to make it less agile.
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320

2.Monastic Knights

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/495a06c4c79082b529794599a6b045f7477ba440.jpg
 
Analysis and plan:
Monastic Knights are capable both in attack and defense, which are able to survive after making damages on opponents. According to the adjustments in other empires during Seasons, we will make modification as follow.
Adjustment
-decrease the normal attack damage in low speed by 15% to inspire them battle like knights. 
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 330

3.Fire Lance Cavalry

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ab55da6844cdf8e23f15e10879f67f003c1d3100.jpg
 
Analysis and plan:
The performance of Fire Lance Cavalry in battles does not come up to expectations. We will modify its Leadership value as follow.
Adjustment
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320 

4.Tercio Arquebusiers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/135fc1ce5eda2646a685a4979e0361ad333a762f.jpg
 
Analysis and plan:
The overall performance of Tercio Arquebusiers seems weak, so we will decrease its Leadership Value to balance it.   
Adjustment
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 310 

5、Rattan Rangers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ac340ea88d47545cffec256544293e2799a61ad7.jpg
 
Analysis and plan:
As Guerrilla units, Rattan Rangers are a big threat for single Hero because they can easily kill a Hero from medium range which has a negative impact on game experience. As rangers, reloading can be a trouble and they should not carry so much ammunition. Thus, we will make adjustment as follow. 
Adjustment:
-rangers have too few powers to penetrate armors, so Armor Penetration is decreased by 15%.
-decrease its accuracy on shooting a fast-moving Hero from medium range. 
-extend its reloading time to 4 seconds and decrease its amount of ammunition by 20%.
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320

6.Pavise Crossbowmen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fc6003f3894b18c4faa2f143a5443155a4ea2619.jpg
 
Analysis and plan:
As a ranged unit, Pavise Crossbowmen are too powerful to stay alive and deal damage in battles. 

Adjustment:
-decrease Armor Penetration Defense and Slashing Defense by 10%, decrease max Health by 10%.
-decrease unit carrying their shields on their backs.
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 325
7.Falconetti Gunners 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/903185cf2f8bd8715f19f5bad8fe258fbf919875.jpg
 
Analysis and Plan:
Falconetti Gunners can make serious and high angle damage with suppressive fire, thus it has made negative impact in all battles. Meanwhile, the Gunners can fire at enemy in the face to reduce the threat from a Hero. 
Adjustment:
-increase HP by 10%, slightly increase the survival chance of Falconetti Gunners 
-increase minimal attacking range from 4 meters to 10 meters, so Falconetti Gunners cannot attack enemy within 10 meters. This aims to increase the threat of Hero when attacking Falconetti Gunners so that players will make more prudent decisions in different battles. 
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 335

8、Cataphract Lancers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ed67f380d33cfb479d8d0881e1583430e014511c.jpg
 
Analysis and Plan:
In last season, we made a new mechanism that Cataphract Lancers would stop if hitting obstacles, but it affected the performance of Cataphract Lancers in some degree. To solve this problem, the Leadership value has been decreased for the moment, and other adjustments may be needed after the new update release. 
Adjustment:
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320

9.Winged Hussars

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/25bff55fda5e39f860a7dda4efd69f2e67e3b30d.jpg
 
Analysis and Plan:
In last season, we made a new mechanism that Hallowed Winged Hussars would stop if hitting obstacles, but it affected the performance of Hallowed Winged Hussars in some degree. To solve this problem, the Leadership value has been decreased for the moment, and other adjustments may be needed after the new update release. 

10.Palermo Bounty Corps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/78f3c8ef5eaa9ff80f6b4192aaf49f4ae046b4ec.jpg

Adjustment:
-decrease Leadership value from 350 to 320
 
Analysis and Plan:
The Sudden Impact skill of Condottieri Guardsman was used a lot in combats as expect. But it could cause serious controls against a Hero, who had no way to fight back but retreat. Meanwhile we got many complaints about it. Thus, we would delete the knock back effect against a Hero, but keep the impact against other units. 
Adjustments:
-Sudden Impact skill cannot knock back a Hero;
-decrease Leadership Value from 185 to 170

notes.title: Battle of Continopolis Chapter 1: Rally!
notes.content:
By the protection of solid walls, the grand Continopolis has been standing still for a thousand years and now is still enjoying the Gilded Age's prosperity. The armies of the Adrian Empire had already assembled, vowing to proclaim their rise by capturing Continopolis. And so began the Battle of Continopolis.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0fdc7b3b62a22461f5e5f1bbfd8a470afffa19c1.png

The Adrian Empire mobilized their best troops to the battlefield. In the early stages of the war, we see the Janissaries Hackbuteers and Empire Iron Pagodas. 

Janissaries Hackbuteers

There was a country rose in the southern desert of the Borderlands. It started plundering the territories around the Eternal Empire, known as the millennium coastal empire, which had already weakened. The rising country wants to unite the western powers, then strike the east as they did two hundred years ago. But that eastern expedition two hundred years ago did not succeed, and only resulted in corpses and starvation. The Western powers' leaders no longer had any ambition for such an expedition, but only expected to profit from the war. To avoid an East-West war on this continent, the Eternal Empire leader decided to unite the southern country by marriage. The leader's daughter, which was a beautiful princess, married to the south. There were many skilled craftsmen alongside with her. Therefore, the technology for making gunpowder and matchlock made its way to the south. 

The southern country refined the gunpowder and improved gunsmithing skills. They then trained soldiers as Janissaries Hackbuteers, who scared the hell out of the enemy in the next decade. Most of these soldiers were the princes and nobles' children and received the most rigorous training at the palace. Dressed in colorful traditional costumes, they looked less like soldiers but more like dancers. 

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/def9987df594d267bad61d0acd0a3151593cc1e9.png

The large-caliber muskets needed to set up before they could fire. Those matchlocks have a slow fire rate, but their power and accuracy are outstanding on the battlefield. They are each equipped with a machete so that they can fight enemies at close range as well. Due to the use of large lead bullets in their shots, if they hit an enemy's body, they will stun the enemy and deal with massive block-breaking damage.

The musket technology originated in the Eternal Empire, but it played a considerable role in the war that burying itself.

Empire Iron Pagodas

When the Southern Empire first rose, no one thought they were expanding to the west because the Eternal Empire was guarding vital land crossings. But those desert warriors still forced their way through the Dardanelles to land on the western. In the last thousand years, only one man has accomplished such a feat, and that was the leader of the Eastern Expeditionary Force. This strait seems to have been born to crown a conqueror. The spearhead force that landed in the coastal area surrounded by powerful enemies and completely took over this area was the mighty Empire Iron Pagodas.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8480cc46fdfe33d75d89f7a4734c66e06f555f04.png

The Empire Iron Pagodas wore armor made of the best steel and held scimitars that glittered and shields with magnificent patterns. They are the servants of Death, the embodiment of Calamity. The Empire Iron Pagodas come from the south but bring death to the west. 

Despite their heavy armor, the scimitar they wielded is swift and deadly. Their good defense allows them to take down enemy attacks easily and quickly fight back.

The Janissaries Hackbuteers are lining up outside the city; the "Behemoth of iron and fire" ——Great Bombard is in position; the Adrian Empire's massive fleet also poured into the Golden Poleaxe Bay. They even made the Iron Pagodas dig a tunnel from outside the city to the inside of Continopolis. This tunnel also had an impact on sieges in other parts of the world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e06c8e8b37337363f14c27b3729b57c6dc004428.png
 
The Continopolis is in danger.

notes.title: Announcement of Conqueror's Blade Houses Invitational Tournament
notes.content:
As the 2nd season comes to a close, we'd like to invite the best from each region to the S2 Houses Invitational to compete for the most influential House title!

youtube：https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCGgwYNPtP2HjC8war4RWHQ/live
twitch：https://www.twitch.tv/conquerorsbladeofficial

1. About the Tournament
This Tournament is an invitational tournament launched by Battlecry's Asia Pacific Operations Team. We comprehensively evaluate the power and influence of the Houses from each region in the AP server and plan to invite 8 Houses from the different areas to join the Tournament. The entire competition is divided into 4 days to determine the most influential House.

2.Tournament Rules
1) Game Meta and Client
The Tournament takes place in the tournament server, and players from the invited teams can participate in it;
2)Competition Content

*Practice
Teams that have already confirmed their participation in the Tournament can enter the Tournament server and go to the Training Officer to start practice mode. Each team leader will be given access to create a room, and Houses from all over the world are welcome to contact each other in advance to get ready for the official competition.

*Official Competition
In Group Stage, we will start a BO1 integral round match. In the Semi-Finals and Grand Finals, we will have a BO3 single elimination match. There is only one game in the integral round match, and the Attackers and Defenders will not swap sides.
In the Semi-Finals and Grand Finals, the leader of both sides have to Ban & Pick maps first, then roll the dice, and the player with the highest number of points can choose to attack or defend first. The second game will still have the team leader to Ban & Pick maps, and then the attackers and defenders will swap positions. If the score comes to 1-1, leaders of both teams will Ban & Pick maps as well. The deciding game will be played Deathmatch(Cliff Duel 10 vs. 10) between the two sides at first. Then, the winner will have the right to pick whether they want to be the Attacker or the Defender.

-Group Stage: Single Round-Robin(BO1)
Number of participants: 8 teams
Eight teams divided into A & B two groups. The A and B teams will play over two days each;
In the single round-robin, two teams will roll dice to determine attack and defense positions for a random siege map. One point is awarded for a victory, and the top two teams from each Group will step into the knockout stage. A total of twelve such games are required. If there are two teams with the same number of points, you will need to refer to the matches' wins and losses against each other.

-Semi-Finals Single Elimination(BO3)
Number of participants: 4 teams
1st of Group A vs. 2nd of Group B
2nd of Group A vs. 1st of Group B
The First Match: Siege Battle(Roll dice to determine attack and defense positions ), leaders Ban & Pick maps;
The Second Match:Siege Battle(swap sides), leaders Ban & Pick maps;
The Third Match: Siege Battle, leaders Ban & Pick maps first, then start a Deathmatch (Cliff Duel 10 vs. 10). The winner will have the right to pick whether they want to be the Attacker or the Defender in the Siege Battle.

-Third-place Match & Grand Finals(BO3)
Number of participants: 2 teams
The First Match: Siege Battle(Roll dice to determine attack and defense positions ), leaders Ban & Pick maps;
The Second Match:Siege Battle(swap sides), leaders Ban & Pick maps;
The Third Match: Siege Battle, leaders Ban & Pick maps first, then start a Deathmatch (Cliff Duel 10 vs. 10). The winner will have the right to pick whether they want to be the Attacker or the Defender in the Siege Battle.

3) Maps
5 maps of Siege Battle: Riverlands Castle, 
Harbour City, Sun City, Kurak Castle, and Augolia;
Map of the final round: Deathmatch (Cliff Duel 10 vs. 10). The first team hit 20 Kills will be the winner.

4) Ban & Pick Rules
Randomly assign attackers and defenders, roll the dice and then Ban and Pick in 1-2-1 order;
You can bring any Heroes, Units, Weapons, and Artillery to the battlefield just like in the Matching Game. But Units will have no Doctrine.

5) Rounds and Win & Lose Relations
In the knockout and final games, if one side wins two consecutive games in a siege, it is the winner of the game;
In the Knockout Stage and Grand Finals, if the score comes to 1-1, leaders of both teams will Ban & Pick maps as well. The deciding game will be played Deathmatch(Cliff Duel 10 vs. 10) between the two sides at first. Then, the winner will have the right to pick whether they want to be the Attacker or the Defender.
In Group Stage's Single Round-Robin, one point will be awarded for a victory. If there are two teams with the same number of points, you will need to refer to the matches' wins and losses against each other.

PS: If three teams have the same score, we will compare the number of Hero kills among the three teams to determine the advancement quota(Only data from battles with each other is counted, matches with eliminated teams are not counted). If the number of Hero Kills is the same, we have to compare their number of Troop Kills; If none of the above methods can precisely determine the winner, a roll of the dice will do. The team with the highest number of dice points wins.

3.Requirements for participation
1) What teams will we invite to the Tournament
The House that captures the Conqueror's City can directly qualify for the competition. We will select the other seven teams based on their territories and influence at the end of the season. 

2) How many players will be in one team
Each team is required to have a total of 20 participants, of which 5 are replacements. The minimum number of participants required for a Siege Battle is 11, and any team that has fewer than 11 participants in the actual battle is considered to have lost. Deathmatch requires a minimum of 8 players, but if the actual number of teams in a match is less than 8, the match is a loss.

3) About the name of those teams
Team names are to be developed by the participants. These names must conform to community norms, and no characters may appear that violate game regulations.

4)Rematch and pause
Each team is responsible for its own network during the game. If a team is dropped during loading and does not enter the game, a rematch may be played after verification by the referee. If a team loses the game due to a player being disconnected during the game, there will be no rematch at all.

5) Judgment and extra rounds
When two teams come to a tie score in the match, it will be determined by the number of wins and kills. If none of the above methods can precisely determine the winner, a roll of the dice will do. The team with the highest number of dice points wins.

6) Cheating and punishment
It is forbidden to use any third-party software to modify the game's internal content, such as the game interface, sound effects, character skills, etc. If any player violates this rule, the whole team will be disqualified, and the individual will be banned from all subsequent tournaments.

7) Tournament Regulations
If the competition involves personal attacks, national politics, racial discrimination, or other offending comments, the team will be penalized depending on the severity of the situation. In the event of serious repercussions, the team may be disqualified.

4. Tournament Prize

Champion's Prize: Mercenary Attire Chest*10, Epic Artillery Chest(Soulbound)*10, Crate of S2 Weapons*1

Second Place's Prize: Mercenary Attire Chest*8, Epic Artillery Chest(Soulbound)*8, Crate of S2 Weapons*1

Third Place's Prize: Mercenary Attire Chest*5, Epic Artillery Chest(Soulbound)*5, Crate of S2 Weapons*1

Fourth to Eighth: Mercenary Attire Chest*3, Epic Artillery Chest(Soulbound)*2, Crate of S2 Weapons*1

5.Contact Details

For questions related to this Invitational Tournament, you can discuss and inquire at the official customer service email: cbf_steam_support@boominggames.com, Baidu Post Bar, Discord community, or steam community. Have a good war!

notes.title: 【The Blood Of The Empire: The Fall And The Rise】Season 3 Preview
notes.content:
After the opening of the prosperous Gilded Age, the rise of Commerce and mercenaries had filled the whole continent with opportunities, especially in the vital transportations. Just to the south, across the sea from Ungverija, the formerly besieged "Eternal City" was reborn in the Gilded Age. Although it has gradually declined from an empire with many territories to a Mega-City, with the wealth brought by mercenaries and taxes, the "Eternal City" was still a vital hub for merchants traveling to and from the continent by its excellent location.  

The city, Continopolis, founded over a thousand years ago, has several layers of strong walls, and the sea is surrounded by iron chains blocking the encompassing area. Elite mercenaries were all over the streets. The city possessed great wealth, and scholars and merchants traveled by ship between the eastern and western continents in there. It was once the most prosperous city in the world. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/832af56dfeb641924bab7e0c1864893ffae67f58.png

But even beneath the cover of prosperity, the darkness grows. As the people of the city drank and sang their praises, they failed to notice that the empire, which had fallen into chaos, was gradually restoring order and making preparations to regain its former glory. 

Before the prairie tribe becoming the Prairie Khanate, the Adrian Empire was already one of the most powerful empires on the entire continent. Half a century earlier, the Great Lord "Thunder" had swept away the western lords and occupied most of the land south of Ungverija. 

Then, Jackie I died, and Jackie II took his place. The young Lord was anxious to demonstrate his strength to silence the nobles and various officials who had caused trouble in the early days of his reign. The conquest of the Millennium City had adopted as his primary strategy for making a stand, and two years had spent in preparation. He built up a large navy, blockaded the adjacent seas to isolate the Continopolis, and purchased a factory from the Ungverija to produce heavy Artillery. He also built a fortress on the coast and closed the bridge to the north, preventing any reinforcements from reaching the Continopolis. When everything was in place, he mobilized the massive army and began the siege of the Continopolis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d2a39622e609889552723303973cc48b026c2cc6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e06c8e8b37337363f14c27b3729b57c6dc004428.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/27b4c4e448abab2f1d86825c0f411273c60eb86b.png

Just as every vast empire would eventually become the cornerstone of an enormous empire, the eastern Lord birthed his brand new empire by destroying the city last a thousand years, which would become the heart of the new empire. 

The Gilded Age is over, and a whole new era has arrived.

It is from this historical moment that Season 3 begins! To guide you to conquer this millennia-old super city, we have upgraded the Territory War system and bring in Doctrines Skills into the game.

The upgraded of Territory War

To enrich the Territory War gameplay so that it will be no longer just a tournament within a fief but an area control game with depth, we have further optimized the player-build fief and Pursuit gameplay.

1.Player-build fief

1) Construction and occupation of new player-build fiefs
Now most of the player-build fiefs will have their unique construction and occupation rules
-Players can mouse-click on a self-built stronghold and choose to repair or destroy it, repairing or reducing the life of the player-build fiefs based on the player's Leadership of the troops they bring with them;
-The player-build fief under construction is also allowed to be accelerated or destroyed;
-Wounded characters can not participate in military operations against the player-build fiefs.

2) New types of the player-build fief
A. Battle Flag
-Battle Flag is for players to occupy a player-build fief;
-Only with Battle Flag, you can capture a player-build fief when you breach it. Otherwise, you can only loot it;
-Only one Battle Flag is allowed to exist in a region. When a Battle Flag under construction, no other battle flag can be built.

B. Artillery Construction Base
-Members within the player-build fief's House or Alliance can purchase Artillery and large siege equipment in limited quantities at the Artillery Construction Base;
-Those large siege equipment purchased in the Artillery Construction Base will deploy directly into the battlefield.

C. Medical Tents
-Members within the player-build fief's House or Alliance can heal their troops in the Medical Tents;
-If there is a medical tent in an area, the duration of the wounding effect on your troops will be reduced by 50% if the nearby fief has an aid station. It is only valid for fighters wounded in that area, not for entering the place from other regions. Each House can only build one Medical Tent in a field.

3) Adjustments to the declaration of war
-Only after declaring war on a city can you build a player-build fief within that city's jurisdiction.

4) The Territory War now has a preparation period
-30 minutes before the start of a power battle is considered the preparation period;
-Players are allowed to build player-built fiefs during preparation(The war has been declared);
-During the preparation, the player-built fiefs can be attacked, but not town, village, or forts.

2.Improvements in Pursuit 
To make the terrain on the big world really work, to allow players to use human wall tactics to limit their opponents, and also to make every piece of land on the edge of the fief valuable, we've improved the Pursuit, moving from just troop blocking to tactical blocking with the terrain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/381dcbc7f8d7f715f0f8b17377476d6f0fdcafd4.png

1) Bring in Local Battlefield
All the Pursuits in the same area will be on the same battlefield.
-When you enter a Pursuit, a Local Battlefield will be automatically formed within a specific area centered on the encounter point;
-Players will have a probability of entering the activate Local Battlefield by stepping into the field;
-The further you are from the center of a Local Battlefield, the lower the probability of entering that battle;
-When the player triggers the event to enter the battlefield, they are presented with two options, "enter the battlefield" and "turn around". If you select "enter the battlefield", you will join the battle. If you select "turn around," you will not enter the battlefield, but you will be wounded.

2) Pursuit Rules Adjustment
We've changed the Pursui from a two-way confrontation to a scramble that allows multiple forces to enter.
-Pursuit allows various forces to join in, with a maximum of 15 players per force that can bring, but no limit to the number of different powers;
-Only the force that captures the flag in the center of the map will be the winner;
-The force that eventually captures the flag will get all the loot for this Pursuit;
-Players who voluntarily join the local battlefield can choose their spawn position, and players who mistakenly enter the battlefield will be randomly assigned a spawn point.

To more realistically recreate the immediacy of the Pursuit, we've removed the deployment and settlement phases.

The Doctrine Abilities

We've brought the Doctrine Abilities into the game, which will let those units have their Doctrine Ability Pool, and allow players to consume Doctrine to activate the unit's Doctrine Skills. You can mix and match as many as you like based on your usage habits and tactical strategy. Each unit has a given pool of abilities. At first, the capabilities are all locked. When you expend the corresponding Doctrine in your inventory, you can activate the Doctrine Ability in that ability pool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b06ecbe41c691b39b29c2f0f7e71cf4a57fecf05.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b0043a64320aa69c9e29bca1d04d0c2750ec19fc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ffa062591dcb24836f4fa6e85403ee9e3efa873c.png

notes.title: The Developer's log：The balancing of Heroes and Units in Season 3
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords:
Gilded Age is coming to an end. The experience of Mercenary must be extraordinary. It's time for us to tweak the ecological balance of the entire battlefield with the season renewal. And we have listened carefully to all of the comments you have made. Such as Bow Heroes or Nodachi Heroes, which beloved but not that consistent late in the season. Some heroes will be made radical changes at the start of Season 3. Many of the other Hero skills have also be adjusted for sure. 

In the meantime, we've found that in the middle season, the Golden Era units and other high-star units will fill the whole battlefield. Because these units are few in number but strong in combat, they are often depleted before the battle is over. The conflict between these units becomes tedious and unstrategic, which affects the players' battlefield experience.

In response to this situation, we plan to adjust some of the required Leadership, status, or even the whole design of the units in the S3 season, to make the battlefield more diverse and varied.

After extensive consultation with Warlords and actual analysis of the current battlefield, we have decided to make some crucial changes for the S3 season, as follows:

The balancing of Heroes

1. Heroes damage
Goal: 
We noted that in extreme cases, the stacking of the Hero's damage buff could have an overly exaggerated effect, so we made some adjustments.

Adjustment:
The Hero's attack increases by up to 2.5x.

2.Poleaxe Heroes
Goal:
The Weapon Dance of Poleaxe Heroes used by few due to its low power and long cooling time. So we have to buff it as follows:

After Adjustment: 
Weapon Dance with
-Increased attack range
-After the skill hits, the target will be facing the attacker.
-Effect: When Weapon Dance hits an enemy, the "Attack Power Reduced" debuff will last for 2 more seconds. 
-Shorter cooling time with
Low-Grade: 24 seconds
Mid-Grade: 20 seconds
High-Grade: 16 seconds

3.Bow Heroes
Goal:
Because they have long-range and high attack power. Melee Heroes are having trouble catching up to them and posing a sufficient threat. They are always in a passive situation when facing Bow Heroes.
Therefore, we decided to reduce the burst power of their skills and make ranged attacks require a Charge before release. Besides, the Charging will also consume HP the same as escaping. The specific adjustments are as follows:
1.	Shooting requires a Charge for maximum attack power, similar to a normal attack.
 The changing of Charge:
-It will consume HP.
-It takes longer than before to release a Half-Charged arrow.
2) The Rain of Arrows, Flaming Arrow, Bodkin-tipped, Lightning Bolt and Explosive Arrow, will become:
The longer the Charge, the straighter the trajectory, and the more powerful it is.
3) The damage of skills other than the Explosive Arrow will change with Charge:
No Charge: Deal 50% piercing damage;
Half-Charge: Deal 80% piercing damage;
Full-Charge: Deal 110% piercing damage.
4) Explosive Arrow's damage is reduced by 50%, but Charge or not does not affect its damage.
5) The piercing ability of Lightning Bolt will be affected by Charge:
No Charge: Can not pierce;
Half-Charge: Can pierce 2 targets;
Full-Charge: Can pierce 5 targets.

2.Normal Attack Adjustment:
-When your Units prepare your bow and arrow, it won't lower the movement speed.

3.The Bodkin-tipped III Adjustment:
-The Bodkin-tipped III will reduce the enemy's block correctly other than ignoring Defence.

4.Nodachi Heroes 
Goal:
The idea behind the Nodachi Heroes' design is that it is a medium armor unit that relies on their ability to steal HP for continued combat at the front line. But when they are facing heavily armored units, without armor-piercing damage, they wouldn't be able to play their primary role. 
Therefore, we have redesigned the gameplay of them: Players can store their buffs, and activate it at the most appropriate time, allowing them to choose the timing of using their skills actively.

Adjustment:
1) The new design of skills
[Bloodstain]:
Gain 3% HP stealing, can stack up to 5 times, permanently valid, clears buffs upon death.
When [Bloodstain] stack 5 times, it will become [Blood Rage]. If the unit already has [Blood Rage], it will refresh the [Blood Rage].

[Blood Rage]
Gain 25% HP stealing, add more 15% P[iercing and Slashing Armour Penetration. It can't be stacked and will last 8 seconds.

[Blood Heal]
Gain 1500 HP healing per second, It can't be stacked and will last 4 seconds.

2) Fearless & Steadfast, Bloodthirsty, and Samurai's March
Removed effect: Gain 4% HP stealing when hit the target, stack it up to 5 times, and last 5 seconds.
Added effect: Gain a [Bloodstain] buff when hitting a target.

3) Monstrous Blade
Added effect: When activating Monstrous Blade, if the unit has [Blood Rage], then consume it and gain [Blood Heal].

4) Blood Oath
Added effect: When activating Blood Oath, if the unit has [Blood Rage], then refresh it.

5) Samurai's March III
Added effect: Increases Block Break

5. Spear Heroes
Analysis and plan:
Skills of Spear Heroes: The secret of Procris's Gift III can ignore enemy's defense to make it retreat and kill it even behind a tower shield array. The units are not able to protect Hero when encountering this skill.
Adjustment:
Skill: The secret of Procris's Gift III
-deleted: ignoring defence 
-added: Attack with large blocking break value

Adjustment on Balance and Optimization for Units 

1、Iron Reapers 
Analysis and plan:
The Iron Reaper is too hard to be defeated for an opponent due to its outstanding ability to endure damages. We will make modification as follow.
Adjustment
-decrease Armour Penetration Defence and Slashing Defence by 10% 
-decrease Movement Speed by 5% to make it less agile.
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320

2、Monastic Knights
Analysis and plan:
Monastic Knights are capable both in attack and defence, which are able to survive after making damages on opponents. According to the adjustments in other empires during Seasons, we will make modification as follow.
Adjustment
-decrease the normal attack damage in low speed by 15% to inspire them battle like knights. 
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 330

3、Fire Lance Cavalry
Analysis and plan:
The performance of Fire Lance Cavalry in battles does not come up to expectations. We will modify its Leadership value as follow.
Adjustment
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320 

4、Tercio Arquebusiers
Analysis and plan:
The overall performance of Tercio Arquebusiers seems weak, so we will decrease its Leadership Value to balance it.   
Adjustment
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 310 

5、Rattan Rangers
Analysis and plan:
As Guerrilla units, Rattan Rangers are a big threat for single Hero because they can easily kill a Hero from medium range which has a negative impact on game experience. As rangers, reloading can be a trouble and they should not carry so much ammunition. Thus we will make adjustment as follow. 
Adjustment:
-rangers have too few powers to penetrate armors, so Armour Penetration is decreased by 15%.
-decrease its accuracy on shooting a fast-moving Hero from medium range. 
-extend its reloading time to 5 seconds and decrease its amount of ammunition by 20%.
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320

6、Pavise Crossbowmen 
Analysis and plan:
As a ranged unit, Pavise Crossbowmen are too powerful to stay alive and deal damage in battles. 

Adjustment:
-decrease Armour Penetration Defence and Slashing Defence by 10%, decrease max Health by 10%.
-decrease unit carrying their shields on their backs.
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 325

7、Falconetti Gunners 
Analysis and Plan:
Falconetti Gunners can make serious and high angle damage with suppressive fire, thus it has made negative impact in all battles. Meanwhile, the Gunners can fire at enemy in the face to reduce the threat from a Hero. 
Adjustment:
-increase HP by 10%, slightly increase the survival chance of Falconetti Gunners 
-increase minimal attacking range from 4 meters to 10 meters, so Falconetti Gunners cannot attack enemy within 10 meters. This aims to increase the threat of Hero when attacking Falconetti Gunners so that players will make more prudent decisions in different battles. 
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 335

8、Cataphract Lancers
Analysis and Plan:
In last season, we made a new mechanism that Cataphract Lancers would stop if hitting obstacles, but it affected the performance of Cataphract Lancers in some degree. To solve this problem, the Leadership value has been decreased for the moment, and other adjustments may be needed after the new update release. 
Adjustment:
-decrease Leadership Value from 350 to 320

9、Winged Hussars
Analysis and Plan:
In last season, we made a new mechanism that Hallowed Winged Hussars would stop if hitting obstacles, but it affected the performance of Hallowed Winged Hussars in some degree. To solve this problem, the Leadership value has been decreased for the moment, and other adjustments may be needed after the new update release. 
Adjustment:
-decrease Leadership value from 350 to 320
 
Analysis and Plan:
The Sudden Impact skill of Condottieri Guardsman was used a lot in combats as expect. But it could cause serious controls against a Hero, who had no way to fight back but retreat. Meanwhile we got many complaints about it. Thus we would delete the knock back effect against a Hero, but keep the impact against other units. 
Adjustments:
-Sudden Impact skill cannot knock back a Hero;
-decrease Leadership Value from 185 to 170
