notes.title: Maintenance and updates on Jun 11th
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords：
We will be doing server maintenance and game update on Jun. 11th, 12:00-14:00(UTC+8). The estimated period will be about two hours. After that, you'll receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation. Please be prepared, and here is the specific updates are as follows:

1.The opening of Asia Nova
A set of the new server called Asia Nova will come to the Conqueror's Blade on Jun. 11th, 14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance and updates, you can choose the Asia Nova server and start your new journey in Conqueror's Blade.

2.The update of Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season
After this update, the contents of the Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season will also renew. It contains:
Uncommon Doctrine:
*Demesne Arbalists' Doctrine III (3 Days)
*Javelin Sergeants' Doctrine I (3 Days)
*Rare Archery Doctrine (3 Days)
Epic Doctrine:
*Demesne Arbalists' Doctrine IV (1 Day)
*Javelin Sergeants' Doctrine II (1 Day)
*Epic Archery Doctrine I (1 Day)
*Rare Arquebus Doctrine II (1 Day)

3.System optimization
1. We've changed the protection level in the Pursuit. All the players under Lv20 will not be able to pursue or be pursued in the big world;
2. Player titles are more concise on the battlefield now;
3. We've changed the qualification of crafting for all the players in Conquerors' City. Now, all the players can craft units kit up to Rare, and Artillery up to Uncommon;
4. We've boosted the speed of Zebra from 11 to 13;
5. In the Seige, the heroes or units will have 3 seconds of protection just after they respawn.

4.Fixed Bugs
1. Now when you bought anything from the Market and choose to take it by yourself, the remaining time will display correctly, which will be 72 hours. 
2. Now in the Karlsbach or Ihlov of the Borderlands, hero equipment crafting, mount equipment crafting, or Artillery Building will display correctly on the list.
3. Now in the phase four challenge, "Destroy 20 Artillery in Standard Battles, Seige Battle, or Field Battle" of Fortebraccio Pikemen, won't be able to complete in Expeditions.
4. Now the 10-Battle Unit XP Card and 10-Battle Hero XP Card will accumulate correctly.
5. Now the Heavy Volts of Pavise Crossbowmen will fit its skill description and successfully stuns enemies.
6. Now you can successfully climb the ladders on the left side corridor of Centro on the battlefield of Conquerors' City.
7. Now the Cavalry in the Westwood quest won't be stuck on any spot around the battlefield.
8. Now the qualified players can do the crafting or building with zero problems.

notes.title: Notice: The new events are on Asia Nova Server in Jun 11th
notes.content:
The new Asia Nova Server is about to open at 14:00(UTC+8) Jun. 11th. We'are going to throw a bunch of exciting events to celebrate that all the players from the AP and SA server will also be able to join.

Event 1: New players incentive plans

Players below level 200 will get 15% additional hero XP, unit XP, Bronze Coins and 50% increase in the weekly honors limit during Jun. 11th to Jul. 2nd.

Event 2: The Newbie Matchmaking is on

We'll add a Newbie Matchmaking Mode into the game on all servers.  You can use any character without level limit but only can use units from the Rustic Era to Chivalric Era. Those units from the Heroic Era or Silver Era won't be able to join the battle. The event will last from Jun. 11th to Jul. 2nd.

Event 3: Awards to hard fighting players

To encourage players who fight hard. We will award the following prizes to all players who have logged into the game when the AN server reaches a certain number of level 30 characters:
-When AN server meets 1000 lv30 characters, you will have: Unit XP Card*3, Bronze Coins*3000, Skill Points*200;
-When AN server meets 3000 lv30 characters, you will have: Box of Uncommon Artillery*2, Bronze Coins*5000, Honor*300;
-When AN server meets 5000 lv30 characters, you will have: Unit Medal*10, Bronze Coins*8000, Skill Points*600;
-When AN server meets 7000 lv30 characters, you will have: Selectable rare quality hero equipment schematic*1, Bronze Coins*10000, Honor*500;
-When AN server meets 10000 lv30 characters, you will have: Treatise*1, Bronze Coins*15000, Honor*1000;
-When AN server meets 20000 lv30 characters, you will have: Treatise*1, Bronze Coins*20000, Honor*1200;
-When AN server meets 50000 lv30 characters, you will have: Treatise*1, Bronze Coins*30000, Honor*1500.

※These rewards are available to everyone and do not conflict with each other. When conditions are met, awards will be sent to all players through email within 3 business days.

Event 4:  Awards to even harder fighting players

We will award the following prizes to all players who have logged into the game when the AN server reaches a certain number of level 60 characters:
When AN server mWeets 1000 lv60 characters, you will have: Rare Artillery Chests*3;
When AN server meets 2000 lv60 characters, you will have: Unit Medal*15;
When AN server meets 4000 lv60 characters, you will have: Treatise*1, Powdered Silver*10;
When AN server meets 8000 lv60 characters, you will have: Treatise*1, Powdered Silver*15;
When AN server meets 15000 lv60 characters, you will have: Treatise*1, Rare Signacula*4.

※These rewards are available to everyone and do not conflict with each other. When conditions are met, awards will be sent to all players through email within 3 business days.

Event 5:  New players invitation & rewards

To energize the entire world and provide new force to the Conqueror's Blade battlefield, we're going to reward any player who introduces a friend to join our battlefield.

1) A new account joined after 4/12 00:00 (PDT) can use the invitation code at the event interface, which can be accessed by pressing O (Rewards - Invitation Code).
2) Each character (including new character created while event period) can generate an invitation code. 
3) Each character has a unique invitation code. The number of invitees and rewards are bound to the inviter.
4) Upon entering a unique invitation code, the new account will be considered an invitee of the player. When an invitee reaches level 30, it will be marked as a valid invitee (there could be a delay in refreshing the number of valid invitees)
5) Rewards will be obtained when you valid invitees reach 1/2/3/6.

Reward Contents
The reward for 1 valid invitee: Battle-ready - Comradeship Pack Contains 1000 Honour.
The reward for 2 valid invitees: Battle-ready - Devotion Pack, Contains 7 days of Premium Account service.
The reward for 3 valid invitees: Battle-ready - Friendship Pack. Open to choose one unit attire from Vadász Corps or Eagle Guard.
The reward for 6 valid invitees: Battle-ready - Uprising Pack. Open to choose one hero attire from Empyrean Order, Eagle Knight, or Solar Order.

The inviter rewards will be sent within three working days after the end of the event by in-game mail.

Event 6: Services & Property Sharing

After the Asia Nova server starts, all the characters will share the Premium Account within the same account. And allow Sovereigns to shift between these characters.

notes.title: Q&A From Boss Lucky, Round 5
notes.content:
Hello, Boss Lucky here

Soldier of Fortune season is coming to an end. The development team is also actively preparing for the mysterious new season. However, as the boss, I have to keep communicating with everyone. Otherwise, people may think we're slacking off.

Here are some of the most significant concerns of players recently:

Q1: Could you tell us more about the upcoming server Asia Nova?

We're working hard to optimize the experience on all of our servers, and we have several plans of AN that we can inform you.

1. All the characters will share the Premium Account within the same account. And allow Sovereigns to shift between these characters.

2. All players under Lv200 will have a boost in various aspects.

3. Considering that there are many new players, we will start a Newbie Matchmaking Mode on the AN and AP servers on Jun. 11th to Jul. 2nd, which only units with or less than 3 stars can be placed in battles. 

4. Because it's near the end of the season, the new server won't be able to trading BP. But players can still take part in different unit challenges after meeting a particular level.

To test if there are any issues with the server transfer feature, we plan to offer players one opportunity to transfer between AP and SA servers for free at the end of this season. That will also solve network latency that many players had previously experienced because their chosen server did not match their network operator.

Q2: There're even more players start to use low-level characters join the opposite team to block their route on the battlefield in Conqueror's Blade. What are you going to do about this?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/edb1aac72f12cd2472f490d1cb3dc22ad7616ec3.png

Now, if anyone is reported having such behavior in the battle, he will have a debuff, which prevents him from joining any fight in a period. We will carefully review your reports and make a decision based on the Alliance relations between the two sides of the battle and the character's performance on the battlefield. The results of the processing will be made public to the players. Please also report with as comprehensive info as possible. For example, when, which fief, which character did what. And preferably alongside with the screenshots of the battle line list and the battlefield. Then, we can uncover those saboteurs in no time!

Please send all your info to this address: cbf_steam_support@boominggames.com

Q3: The current matching mechanism is unbalanced. Will it be further optimized? After I reached Lv60, in Siege Battle, win or lose is entirely determined by which side has the higher level player which with better units rather than command skills.

There is a hidden value system in match mode, an algorithm similar to some MOBA games on the market. Winning or losing will affect your value. The system will try to match players with similar values. After you reached the Lv60, the only influencing factor is the hidden value.

Despite the smaller number of soldiers, we found that the high-level units had a considerable advantage against the low-level units. We're thinking of doing some redesigns in the new season to make the high-level units more balanced.

For now, we hope to bring a Newbie Matchmaking Mode to protect new players from high-level units. We will continue to monitor the experience with this new mode in hopes of alleviating that problem. 

Q4: There're even PvE data in the Hall Of Fame, that's not fair for those PvP players who tried hard to hit high scores.

That is indeed our mistake. We also think it's unreasonable. Since the season is half over, we can't change the rule midway through the season. We'll be removing the PvE stats from future seasons in Hall of Fame, and only keeping the battlefield stats in PVP mode. However, the stats from previous seasons will not be removed.

Q5: After I report someone or something, could you give us any feedback such as an Email to tell me my report has been received?

We appreciate this great advice. We will start developing it immediately and aim to be able to serve you with this feature during next season. You are also welcome to report to our customer service mailbox. We will take the reports of game rules violation in and out of the game by players seriously, and regularly in the community to show you the results of processing.

Q6: We need a display the time when members' most recent offline on the House screen and allows for simple filtering. 

We appreciate this great advice. We've also received such information like this before form House rulers. We will start developing it immediately and aim to be able to serve you with this feature during next season. 

Q7: Is there any recycling plan for unused Seasonal Doctrine at the end of the season? 

We're in the second half of the 2nd second season, and many players still have unused Seasonal Doctrine, which will expire at the end of the season. We understand the frustration our players will have when they watch their remaining Seasonal Doctrine being taking back. 

Here's our solution: we'll give those Seasonal Doctrines an appropriate price for sale, that will ease your loss with some Bronze Coins. 

That's all for today, and see you next time!

notes.title: Maintenance and updates —— Jun. 4th, 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords：
We will be doing server maintenance and game update on Jun. 4th, 12:00-14:00 AM Beijing time (UTC+8). The estimated period will be about two hours. After that, you'll receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation. Please be prepared, and here is the specific updates are as follows:

1. The practice of Conqueror's City is coming

The Conqueror's Crown season is about to go on Jun. 8th. The battle of Conqueror's City and the competition of Emperor title that everyone has been waiting for will also officially kick-off. 

We're going to start the practice of Conqueror's City from 20:00 to 21:30 on Jun. 5th(The AP server's start time is according to UTC+8, and SA is according to GMT-4). I hope you will take your time to familiarize yourself with the battlefield and make a good plan to get a head start in the coming official battle. 

That will be the practice of the Territory Wars. For a specified period, each House, with its legion, is free to raid all the Big World's fief and defend the fief that it occupies. There will be no loss of combat units during this practice. After the battle, those fiefs will be returned to their original owners. The players who won the fight will get Silver Coins as awards. 

Awards of the practice of Conqueror's City:
When the practice is over
1. Houses or players who successfully raid a fief will receive a certain percentage of the remaining silver coins from the fief.
2. Houses or players who successfully defend a fief will carve up all the remaining silver coins from the fief.
PS:
1. When the battle starts, the left front will be the Attackers, and the right front will be the Defenders.
2. Defend your House's fief won't get you any award.
3. Those Warlords without joining a House can't start a battle but can participate one.

2.The Balancing Of Battlefields

Balancing Of The Great Wall(Siege)
Based on the battlefield data and the players' feedback, after the Great Wall(Siege) became a 15 vs. 15 battle, the win rate of the Attackers on the battlefield was a little bit lower than expected. So we will make the following adjustments:

1. The activation range at Point A changes from a 10-meter radius to an 8-meter radius. It will slightly reduce the advantage of the Defenders.

2. To provide the Attackers with a more diverse selection of attacking tactics when capturing Point B and Point C, we added one set of ladders to the wall on the left outside the beacon tower near Point B. Then, we added another set of ladders on each side of the wall near Point C gate tower.
 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/68542bbbf01ceb58f04b0093230b27fd3f0dbc32.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2bcc8e84f2cf2e89e62fb64da64fa1aa17bdbb2f.png

Balancing Of White Elk Fort(Siege)
Based on the battlefield data and the players' feedback, after the White Elk Fort(Siege) became a 15 vs. 15 battle, the win rate of the Attackers on the battlefield was a little bit lower than expected. So we will make the following adjustments:

1.To make the Attackers more threatening to the A point, we moved the position of Point A a small distance towards the city gate. The activation range at Point A changes from an 8-meter radius to a 7-meter radius 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a96101a01525ac314a13f55b89e3db508ffbb9c8.png

2. According to the feedback we received, the Attackers were unable to counter the units carrying ranged weapons, which placed under the roof. So we'll add some barriers under the roof.  
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9c77517c91c4c90e5a702b809eac59c91ca3de5d.png

3.The update of Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season

After this update, the contents of the Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season will also renew. It contains:
Uncommon Doctrine:
*Halberdiers' Doctrine I (3 Days)
*Imperial Pike Guards' Doctrine III (3 Days)
*Rare Polearm Doctrine I (3 Days)

Epic Doctrine:
*Halberdiers' Doctrine II (1 Day)
*Imperial Pike Guards' Doctrine I (1 Day)
*Imperial Pike Guards' Doctrine IV (1 Day)
*Epic Polearm Doctrine II (1 Day)

4.System Optimizing

1)A more rational choice of commanders:
-The Commander will be selected in the order in which the Ruler House declared war earlier.
-Whether the battle is won or lost, after the fight, the Commander will be given to the House next in line.
(This will be only available in the battlefield of Conqueror's City and the Shield of Conqueror's City)

2)We added one more Weekly Challenges due to the delayed start of this season. 

3)In this meta, the food supplies will refill itself automatically when you are entering the safe zone or Trade Colonies. But still, you'd receive info like "Cost 0 Bronze Coins to refill your food supplies." when you refill your food supplies manually. Now you will never be given that info in the future.

4) The Alliance members who occupied the Conqueror's City will be able to craft all Siege Engines up to the rare quality, and all Unit Kits(Legion members can't do the crafting in the Conqueror's City).  Therefore, occupying the Conqueror's City will not only be a symbol of honor but also bring benefits to all Alliance members.

5)  If none of the players could claim the title of Emperor, the Alliance members who occupied the Conqueror's City and all the Legion members will be able to do the crafting in the city.

5.Fixed Bugs

Fixed Heroes Bugs
1. Now your Poison Arrow, Angry Hornets, and Steel-tipped Arrow aren't cast continuously under any circumstances.
2. Now the Break ammo of Pavise Crossbowmen has detailed description:
Equip Pavise Crossbowmen with Heavy Arrows. The Heavy Arrows will knockback enemies and reduce their Defence by 250 when they hit the enemies.
3. Now when the Pavise Crossbowmen is carrying their shields, they can't use Shield Bash.
4. Now the Guild-Quality Arrows of Demesne Arbalists is placed in the right position, which is advanced than the Double-Wound String.

Other Fixed Bugs
5. Now you can deliver your Fief Quests on the Overview screen of the Big World.
6. Now you can receive and deliver the Grand Designs without errors.
7. Now the Conqueror's City only has sunny days.
8. Now in the Salvage screen, there is no Temporary Doctrine shown, and even you have a large number of salvageable Doctrine, it will be displayed correctly.

notes.title: The Planning of the Asia Nova server
notes.content:
Hello everyone：
After a long time discussion and preparation, we'd be thrilled to announce that we're going to open an additional set of servers before the new season begins, which is Asia Nova(AN).

Why are we doing this?
The whole game ecology needs fresh blood coming in. It allows many players able to write their legend in another parallel universe. At the same time, we are also preparing to bring in new gameplays, such as cross-services Territory War. We want to let the Houses from different universes compete for the ultimate glory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/16db3ad1adeee7cc049b8e050dc3ce6677558dfa.png

When will the server be open?
Our current plan is to open the server on June 11th, which is the end of this season. One important thing we've learned from previous operations is not interfering with players' seasonal plans and having enough time to communicate with them. 

Because it's near the end of the season, the new server won't be able to trading BP, nor is there a settlement for ranks and titles. But players can still take part in different unit challenges.

Are we trying to force players to keep invest in new characters？
The answer is NO. We will never do that, and it's our promise to everyone. The ultimate goal of the Conqueror's Blade is to build a grand, globally-connected, sandbox-like world of war step by step. So let players start over, again and again, is against our philosophy. 

Actually, we're planning two things:
1.All new servers in the future, after complete one or two seasons as protection period, we'd like to let players switch to other services at the end of the season. We're still working on the specific rules, and we will ensure that it will be fair.
2.All the characters will share the Premium Account within the same account. And allow Sovereigns to shift between these characters. We want to let everyone choose their server freely and without any additional costs. We will try to complete these features before the new service opens.

Also, we're working on some cross-services gameplays. We've been working on these gameplays for a long time, and we're still polishing up some details. The cross-services matching between server AP and AN will be just the beginning of our incoming new gameplays. The goal is to make it feel like there are no apparent boundaries between servers. We also have many features that we want to develop, such as cross-services grouping, chat, and buddy systems. Our R&D team also hopes to get these features online sooner.

To help new players grow up quickly, we will give rookies on all servers(AP,AN,SA) some boost: players below level 200 will get 15% additional hero XP, unit XP, Bronze Coins, Honour, and weekly Honour limit.

When AN server is reaching a certain number of players, all of our players(in AP,AN,SA) will get rewards. Stay tuned for our news! The details of the event will be announced when the AN server opens.

Why not just develop an exclusive area for new players?
We've considered doing so, but it's a shame that we won't be able to let new players experience a full season cycle and compete in the game's most exciting parts——the Borderlands & the Conqueror's City. It would make the new player's gaming experience extremely poor if we let the new player fight those veterans directly.

At the moment, we can't solve this problem entirely. However, we are already conceiving to open some more significant and more exciting territories. And expect to settle this once and for all. Everyone, please be sure to let us know if you have any good suggestions. If we have new ideas, we will also let you know in the first place.

What if there aren't enough players in the new service？
When the Conqueror's Blade became free on steam, many new players were joining the world every day. These players need a new world to explore and develop. In terms of product strategy, the Conqueror's Blade is a long-running mega-game that has only just begun its global rollout. The promotion in April was just a small test by the R&D team, and we made a lot of mistakes and also learned much. We will take the end of the season as the node and expand the marketing step by step. 

We hope to let new players enjoy the game and make the Conqueror's Blade more exciting. Next season we plan to add several new languages to the client. We are also preparing for a more in-depth promotion of several regions. Conqueror's Blade needs continued research & development and increased market input to become better.

The path of Conqueror's Blade is just beginning. As a brand new game type, a lot of the gameplay design needs to explore continuously by our R&D team and our players. Thank you all for your trust and support, and we look forward to meeting you in the new battlefield. 

Conqueror's Blade Steam Operation Team
May 30th, 2020

notes.title: Maintenance and updates on May 28st
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords：
We will be doing server maintenance, and game update on May 28th, 12:00-14:00 AM Beijing time (UTC+8). The estimated period will be about two hours. After that, you'll receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation. Please be prepared, and here is the specific updates are as follows:

1.Optimized the rules for the battle of the Conqueror's City
1) The following conditions need to be met to attack the gates of the Conqueror's City:
-Your Alliance needs to meet 6000 Influence and have a fief in the Borderlands before your Ruler House declaring war against the city gate.

2) The following conditions need to be met to attack the Conqueror's City:
-After your Alliance captured a city gate, your Alliance's Ruler House will be able to declare war against the Conqueror's City.

3) The rules of defense for the Legion in the Conqueror's City:
-In the battle of the Conqueror's City, the Legion can not declare war against the Conqueror's City.
-Only the members with a Junior Captain or Stalwart or higher rank can participate in a defensive battle. 

4) Adjustments of the attack route:
-The Battlefields Route in both Conqueror's City and the city gate will be changed to one.

5) New rules on Influence:
-After controlling the Conqueror's City, the Ruler House of the Alliance will get 20000 Influence.
-After capturing the city gate of Conqueror's City, the Ruler House of the Alliance will get 1000 Influence.

2.New rules for obtaining titles
1) The following three requirements must be met to earn the title of Emperor:
-Your Alliance has to occupy the Conqueror's City.
-Your Alliance has to meet 25,000 Influence.
-You have to be the Liege of your Alliance's Ruler House.

2) Meet any of the following requirements that can earn the title of Chamberlain:
-Your Alliance has to occupy the Conqueror's City, and you're the Liege of your Alliance's Ruler House. (The Liege who meet these requirements will have an additional title with Regent for the next season)
-Your Alliance has to meet 20,000 Influence.

3) Meet the following requirement that can earn the title of Chief Justiciar:
-Your Alliance has to meet 15,000 Influence.

4) Be promoted to a higher rank:
-If the Liege of your Alliance's Ruler House became an Emperor, every Liege of other Ruler House would have 10,000 points added in his/her rank. But it won't affect the total Influence of the Alliance.

3. This season will be extended.
Due to these massive changes we've made to the game's content this time, we've decided to postpone the start of next Conqueror's Crown season to Jun. 8th for the better experience of all.

4. Activity level open
The new mode is based on the Deathmatch, which changes the number of players to 5V5, and reduces the number of kills required for victory to 18 players.

We have currently selected the two previous maps as the map of the gameplay. On the basis of the original duel gameplay, we added a well-regarded treasure chest gameplay. The treasure chests will be refreshed randomly in the map. After the player opens the treasure chest, they can randomly get bonuses. BUFF or deployable instruments.

Activity time: May 28th-June 4th, 14: 00-16: 00 daily (UTC + 8)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b36e46bb6dfef7211ed621db6f604cc35d04fd70.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7177656ce1ca962ef671312a830114404742ebeb.png

5.Siege Battlefield Balance
This time, we'll adjust the participation of Elk Fort(Seige) to 15 vs. 15.
Considering the profound depth of defense for defending this place, the shape of the city wall is somewhat unusual, and the fierce fight between Attackers and Defenders at Point A. We decided to make the following adjustments after adjusting the number of participants to 15 vs. 15:

1) Relocation of the Attackers' supply point: to allow the Attackers to organize some effective attack more quickly, we have relocated the Attackers' supply points outside the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8cf6be9fa03b49d61c4108b731208f1b150d58b6.png

2) Relocation of the Seige Engine: We'd like to speed up the game tempo, so we moved the two Siege Towers 5 meters forward in the direction of the target.

3) Additional time after capturing the Point A: in order to give the Attackers more time to organize their attack after capturing the point A, the Attackers will have 4 minutes of additional time instead of 3 minutes.

4) More ladders: To allow the attacking side to use the ladders more effectively for sneak attacks, we slightly increased the number of ladders on the battlefield. Increasing the number of ladders in this area from a set of 2 to a set of 3. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2936fee403dae4c04458e8308eadfdf50749573c.png

We will continue to keep an eye on these adjusted battlefield data and hear our players' feedback. Then we will continue to make iterative optimizations in subsequent updates.

6.Battlefield Balance: The Great Wall(Siege) 
Based on the battlefield data and the players' feedback, the win rate of the Attackers on The Great Wall(Siege) was a little bit lower than expected. So we will make the following adjustments:

1) Additional time after capturing the Point A: according to our data and the players' feedback, it often requires a lot of cooperation and time from the Attackers to win the Point A. We'd like to give the Attackers more time to organize their attack after capturing the point A. So we'll provide Attackers with 5 minutes as additional time instead of the previous 4 minutes.

2) Relocated the supply point near the Homebase of Defenders: we moved the supply points near the defender's Homebase a little to give both the Attackers and Defenders a relatively even chance at victory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/acd0e7285e85c886008ab6b2a39908dd5fca32e8.png

7.The update of Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season
After this update, the contents of the Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season will also renew. It contains:
Uncommon Doctrine:
*Rare Crossbow Doctrine (3 Days)
*Demesne Arbalists' Doctrine I (3 Days)
*Demesne Crossbowmen's Doctrine I (3 Days)
Epic Doctrine:

*Epic Crossbow Doctrine I (1 Day)
*Epic Crossbow Doctrine II (1 Day)

8.System optimization
1) Improved experience when searching for a House name. It is now possible to filter for language/country when searching for House names. Also, when creating a House, you can choose the mainly used language in your House. (When creating a family, the current client language will be selected as the default language of your House)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/31111686357ebe39dc5df5916c030c961ff52132.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8c468518c52fd1da5d0b7172b9f70139462b8f71.png

2) Adjusted the position of the toggle season button in the Hall of Fame interface. The Hall of Fame interface is now more aesthetically pleasing.

3) The style of Legion rank icons has been adjusted, and the images are now more expressive and iconic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/73b88321df3b6fa488efd008bebc947777d7c4ad.png

4) In order to protect the sense of resource value for new players, we limited resources and items trade between Liangyun, Ungverija, and Ostaria, and Maoyang at the start of the season. At the moment, we feel that opening up these trades would be convenient for players, so we have made the following adjustments:
-After this update, players will be able to purchase items that are selling in any other area of the market. 

5) Due to the poor equipment attributes acquired by players at the beginning of the game, new players are very vulnerable on the battlefield. Therefore the game experience for them is not good. That's why we've upgraded the award equipment attributes for the rookies so that everyone can have a better combat experience at the beginning of the game.

9.Fixed Bugs

notes.title: Dev Blog：Our thinking and explaining to the adjustments of the Battle
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords:

Last season, we launched the battlefield of Conqueror's City, and we wanted this battle to be the highlight of the entire season, embodying the grandeur of the Battle of Royalty. But unfortunately, our previous designs have not been able to achieve that goal. The whole battle divided into multiple fronts, the rules were too simple, and the fighting was chaos. So, we've been thinking about it for a long time, and then we decided to redesign the whole rules of the battle of Conqueror's City. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5af667c441e28cfb9b8f717919b08c98f777b1f2.png

1. The battle of Conqueror's City should be the showdown of the strongest.
Only the most potent Free Houses Alliances were qualified to compete for the Conqueror's City that symbolized the highest power:

1) The Alliance must occupy a specific size of the territory(Influence meet 6000 and above) and have at least one fief in the Borderlands, then the Alliance's Ruler can be qualified for this challenge. 

2) To challenge the Conqueror's City, you must break through one of the four Shields of the Capital, a guarding pass around the city. 

3) Whenever an alliance disqualified from this challenge, the alliance members may no longer enter the battle corresponding to the Conqueror's City or the guarding pass; players who have already registered will not be affected. 

4) The Warlords who aren't in any House won't be able to join the fight.

2. A more orderly battle
This fight must be taken seriously. So we abandoned the traditional random House commander system for this battle in favor of a strict whoever declares war first has priority to challenge. However, if the Conqueror's City not be taken within the time limit, it will be necessary to clear the way for other Alliances to challenge in turn. To ensure that the battle of the Conqueror's City will be a pinnacle showdown at the highest level and can't rely upon the numerical advantage, we decided to cut some of the battlefronts and make it only one in the battle of the Conqueror's City and the Shield of the Capital. This way, we can ensure that every fight will be a classic one. 

3.The defense and counterattack of the Legion elites.
1) Only a Junior Captain or Stalwart of the Legion can join the protection of Conqueror's City or Shield of the Capital. 

2) During the battle of Conqueror's City or Shield of the Capital, no Unit Kit will be consumed. 

3) During the Territory War, the Legion can't recapture the already occupied Conqueror's City or Shield of the Capital.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/26a3466c47186f2f786d4e36bd3e8a0be6f5af2a.png

4.The adjustments of the Conqueror's City
Last season, there's only one route for Attackers to choose, and the Attackers were unable to select a variety of strategies to play to their full strength. This season, we've balanced the battlefield of the Conqueror's City, enriching the route of attack. And we will open the corresponding stage for our Warlords to experience and plan the battle. The following are specific details:

1) We've reorganized the overall layout of the Conqueror's City, with more route and tactical options at point A and the inner city for the Attackers. （ Here's some pictures）

2) During the battle, we will provide siege engines for Attackers, so you don't need to build and bring it to the battlefield. And more, the siege engines will be produced in a short time after destroyed.  

Starting next Monday, we will release the "Battle of the Conqueror's City" PVP stage for all the Warlords to prepare for the showdown. Specific balance adjustment information will be detailed in the subsequent Notice.

5.Design optimization for obtaining the title as Emperor
Last season, the condition for the House Ruler to become Emperor was that the House occupies the Conqueror's City. Under that rule, efforts to capture other fiefs to expand the territory for the first half-season seem meaningless. As an emperor, he won't only need to occupy the city, but also requires a vast area worthy of this noble title. So we have adjusted the conditions for obtaining the Emperor's title this season. 

Conditions for obtaining the title as Emperor:

1) The Alliances have to occupy the Conqueror's City.
2) Have to be the liege of an Alliances Ruler.
3) The total Influence of all the territory under Alliances' control must meet and above 25000（The Conqueror's City itself has a 20,000 influence, and each of the pass has 1000 influence)

The lieges of the other Houses in the Emperor's Alliance would also receive the title as Chamberlain. If the territory controlled by the Alliance occupying the city is not large enough, it won't be granted the title of Emperor, but only the title of Chamberlain and Regent. This unique title will last an entire season and will be reclaimed at the end of the season. 

6. In the world of the Conqueror's Blade, the Conqueror's City is the most prosperous place representing civilization and wealth, with a unique advantage of wealth and technological superiority. So the Alliance that owns the Conqueror's City can:

1) Craft all the Uncommon and Epic Unit Kits and Seige Engines in the city. 
2) Receive a great reward at the end of the season.

7.Seasonal awards of the Free Houses and the Legion
All players who have the title of the Free Houses will receive an Attire corresponding to their title. Such Attire will be available for the next season. And will be recalled by the system at the end of the season.

The players who have titles as Junior Captain or Stalwart or higher titles will have a unique title corresponding to their rank. It will also last for the whole next season and will be recalled at the end of the season. 

Also, if you stop all the Free Houses that want to be titled as Emperor, everyone in the Legion will be rewarded handsomely. 
1) If a Free House eventually captures the Conqueror's City but is unable to claim the Emperor title because the Influence of total territory controlled doesn't meet the specific value. All members of the Legion will receive a generous reward at the end of the season.

2) If the Legion successfully blocked all incoming enemies from capturing the city, all members of Legion will receive the following honorary rewards besides the seasonal awards. 

a. All members promoted for one rank and settled awards according to their new rank. For example: if the player is currently a Junior Captain, then the player will get the rewards as a Lieutenant at the end of the season. He/she will also get the title as Lieutenant of the Soldier of Fortune, which will be available only in next season. 

b. As Commander of the Legion, if they successfully defend the Conqueror's City, he/she will be promoted as the High Councillor and the corresponding Attire, which will be available for the next season and will be recalled at the end of the season. 

At the end
Since there are many adjustments to this battle of Conqueror's City, to give a pleasant experience, the start of this battle will be delayed. Please pay attention to the relevant Notice. 

The design of the Territory Wars system is a complex process, and we are continually learning and growing, and also continuously optimizes the system. We will try it out little by little, and we welcome feedback and suggestions from all of you. 

Conqueror's Blade Steam Operation Team
May 25th, 2020

notes.title: Early access to the Conqueror's City & Shield of the Capital
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords:
We're now in the 3rd phase of the war, which we called the Heart of the World. Soon, we're going to enter the real heart of this land and fight for the Capital. To help you get acquainted with the geography and architectural layout around the Capital, we will launch the Seige of Conqueror's City & the Seige of Shield of the Capital temporarily in a few days. 

Seige of Conqueror's City & the Seige of Shield of the Capital will be launch at:
AP servers: from May 25th, 12:00-14:00、20:00-21:30（UTC+8）everyday
SA servers: from May 25th, 12:00-14:00、20:00-21:30（GMT-4）everyday
But on Tuesdays and Saturdays, it will be only available from 12:00 to 14:00

Here is an introduction to the stages:

The Conqueror's City

Main features
It is a majestic castle located in the middle of the Heart of the World, consisting of the Conqueror's Castle area and outlying residential area. The castle area is connected to the residential area by a narrow stone bridge. The outer residential area is on lower ground, where the initial phase of the fighting will take place, and the later stage of the battle mainly occurs in the higher battlefield around the Conqueror's Castle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/badbb41966dd58f870650ed77633172b6337df1c.png
Topographical overview of this area
The Conqueror's City is a 15 vs. 15 Seige stage. The Attackers and Defenders will work closely with their teammates by making full use of the terrain and siege equipment to accumulate an advantage until victory is achieved.

The first phase of the battle will be in the residential areas around Conqueror's Castle. The Defenders can choose to clash directly with the Attackers in the residential area or to rely on the high ground of the castle area to defend against the Attackers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1b9cb6aa9a8299ffb49268a27a672ccbe0cdade5.png

After capturing Point A, the Attackers can launch an attack on Point B on the outskirts of the Castle area. The Attackers can use the Siege engines to cross the cliff between the castle area and the residential area to launch a surprise attack on Point B.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c9a72fbdc6f378b31a7d06fc1aa7293cebf493b1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/13765b3981e6589df4b20c1c78253083c3e0a56c.png

After the Siege Engine extends its chains from the residential area then mounted on the edge of the Castle area of the Conqueror's Castle, the Attackers will create a new path to attack Point B in coordination with other units. One must be cautious when fighting in such a narrow passage because one may fall off a cliff. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8faa8e210ef885da50165753dede6517cc408bef.png

The Attackers can also attack from the gate at the front, near the stone bridge, or choose the other side of the area and use the climbing ladder on the flanking path to climb the wall or attack inward along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/745df09637933ba3921136e20c1614e1afdccb8c.png

After approaching the castle area with various methods, the Attackers can launch an attack on point B, which located in the hero statue area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9a067193c45e0917ae549921394fb455b77c0fd5.png

After capturing Point B, the Attackers can launch an attack on the Homebase. The Attackers can choose to strike fearlessly from the front gates, or they can make a surprise raid by climbing the ladder over the front wall. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/640ea19e3c906cf8fea73e2558f216ea2907420f.png

The Attackers also can take the Supply Point on the left first. Then, they will be pushing forward one step at a time from that area. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c49b38932a5736a155119ffee0a1c9e6ffcbdd46.png

Alternatively, the garden on the right side of the area is an available choice for attacking. However, it should be taking care that the terrain here is natural to defend, and taking the garden area will require a concerted effort from the Attackers.		

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7b36a072811ac12cf0e12bd3af5dbe9d7fc6f3da.png
						
Homebase is located behind the front tower. The Defenders can use the walls and structures within the city to defend the city effectively. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/44a1bbf0c9394e14205a9e0288d8ea175e5fd17f.png

The Shield of the Capital
Main features
As the last defense on the outside of the Conqueror's City, the Shield of the Capital stands as the unbreakable shield for protecting the city from invaders. You must first break the Shield of the Capital if you want to capture the Conqueror's City.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f7524b92390f7011e6bcc3376898d3bfd68c281d.png
Topographical overview of this area
The Shield of the Capital a 15 vs. 15 Seige stage. The Attackers and Defenders will work closely with their teammates by making full use of the terrain and siege equipment to accumulate an advantage until victory is achieved.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/21fc9ed819ac4aaaf7436b8057ebc5eefb523b5d.png

In the first phase of the battle, the Attackers can attack the front of the wall with Battering Ram, Siege Towers, and Ladders. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d48f88632d29f869bfa8133b1610275cacbfd3e.png

Point A is located inside the second floor of the central entrance. The Attackers may choose to climb up the wall from either side and attack the Point A.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c12e531761fee5191105597d6627057bec691b9e.png

There is also an option of breaking the front gate and attacking the walls from the inner passages. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fbff7f5431a0bce0b1de041a072726f81700adf3.png

The attack on the Homebase can be launched after capturing Point A. The Attackers may choose to attack the Homebase from either the front or the sideways.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6cf06703aeeef743f1cafc4ee6fe23be0211e009.png

Since this Homebase is in a relatively open area, the Defenders have to be on the lookout for the throwing rocks from Trebuchet at all times while defending.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6dd74d7267c3af975ba3221ffefcd6903bc4ad79.png

notes.title: Maintenance and updates on May 21st
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords：
We will be doing server maintenance, and game update on May 21st, 12:00-14:00 AM Beijing time (UTC+8). The estimated period will be about two hours. After that, you'll receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation. Please be prepared, and here is the specific updates are as follows:

1.The Participation Balancing Of Sieges(Ongoing)
This time, we'll adjust the participation of the Siege Battle at the Great Wall to 15 vs. 15.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/faf42009c2ce477167c0dc7f653b91a39c52d5b1.png

Considering the profound depth of defense for defending this place, and the fierce fight between Attackers and Defenders at various points. We decided to make the following adjustments after adjusting the number of participants to 15 vs 15:

1) More artillery on the battlefield: to increase the offensive firepower of the Attackers against the wall during the fight, we added two Mortar on the west side of the battlefield.

2) Extending Time Limits: in order to give the Attackers more time to organize their attack, we adjusted the battling time from 10 minutes to 11 minutes. 

We will continue to keep an eye on these adjusted battlefield data and hear our players' feedback. Then we will continue to make iterative optimizations in subsequent updates. 

2.The Balancing Of Siege Of Kurak Castle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5214167405e18690fce3c7822b53cbf7c7af0d39.png

Based on the battlefield data and the feedback given by the players, the win rate of the Attackers on the Siege of Kurak Castle was a little bit lower than expected. So we will make the following adjustments:

1) Siege equipment move forward: We'd like to speed up the game tempo, so we moved Siege Towers and Battering Rams 5 meters in the direction of the target. 

2) Adjustments of battling time and additional time after capturing the point: in order to give the Attackers more time to organize their attack, we adjusted the battling time from 10 minutes to 11 minutes. After capturing the point A or B, the Attackers will have 4 minutes of additional time instead of 3 minutes.

3) Faster occupying of the Defenders' supply point: to provide the Attackers with a more diverse selection of attacking tactics, the supply point on the eastern side of the city now is available for occupying as the battle started.

*Rare Sword Doctrine (3 Days)

4.System Optimizing
1) Open World War display optimized:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b7bae2f077dc5fa8812747b44f060cced44b7945.jpg

2) Optimization of the Challenge, Unseal, and Create processes of Pavise Crossbowmen:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d57c8a7dacd6c8c4b2b016825a0479dae7625744.jpg

After finishing the 4th stage of the Pavise Crossbowmen Challenge, the players will be rewarded as 20 Pavise Crossbowmen Signaculum. But this process won't unseal or creat such a unit. The process is complicated and prone to misuse. As a result, we have made the following optimizations:

-The reward for completing the Challenge was changed from 20 Pavise Crossbowmen Signaculum to 5 Pavise Crossbowman Medal, 22 Equipment of Pavise Crossbowmen, and 1 Expansion Permit. If you have claimed your reward before, you'd also have these rewards.

If anyone had a title, then quit the Legion, that title will be temporarily vacant until next Saturday when it will be reassigned based on martial values.

6) Adjusted all the entry-level of matchmaking stage in the Free Battles(Gauntlet of war, Free battles, and Deathmatches) to lv30.

notes.title: Notice of penalties for rules violators of the Conqueror's Blade
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
There have been some dissonant noises and some violations of the game's rules in the game recently. Some players have used hack on the battlefield. Some have used farm bot to level up quickly, and some have spread inappropriate words in the game. It all affects the environment of our entire Conqueror's Blade community. 

We want all generals can enjoy the pure joy that the combat brings and will have the best gaming experience without disturbed by any violation. Therefore, starting today, we have decided to make public the results of the following three violations from time to time, in order to create a healthy environment for the community:

1. Whoever used third-party software to modify game data, which had seriously disturbed the battlefield ecology and the gaming experience of other players, will be on the list.
2. Whoever used third-party software to profited from the battlefield by doing nothing will be on the list. Such behavior had contrary to the principle of fairness.
3. Whoever makes any of the prohibited statements as follows on any channels in the game, will be on the list: 
 1) It contains words or phrases that hatred inciting, politics-bashing, and racial discriminating;
 2) It contains unfriendly words or phrases to insult others;
 3) It contains words or phrases involving pornography, gambling, or drugs;
 4) It contains words or phrases of an advertising nature or the dissemination of unofficial web sites;
 5) It contains statements that violate any law.

notes.title: The Conqueror's Blade Map Rotation of May 2020
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords!
In this month, we will have Harbour City Siege & Siege of Kurak Castle coming into the game. At the same time, the Siege of Dasuo Fort will be closed. The upcoming map will be a 15 vs. 15 battlefield.  

Harbour City
Main features
Harbour City is located in the eastern part of the mainland, with a great geographical location as an excellent harbor for big ships to dock. It is a crucial fort on the coastline and a hub for land and sea trade. With its backdrop of mountains and face a sea, Harbour City is only accessible by a waterway and a landway. On the land access side, a towering wall connected the mountains to the sea, protecting the city and harbor entirely behind it. 

Topographical overview of this area

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4c3609f0c67a3c9811ad3199a244f8f214c7eb34.jpg

The terrain outside the Harbour City is wide open, setting with a large number of cannons and other siege engines. The city wall is high and thick, with a large gate and a small gate on it.The Attackers can take full advantage of those cannons and siege engines outside the Harbour City to put pressure on the Defenders. In the meanwhile, Attackers can choose the appropriate tactics to tear up the defensive formation and break into the A point by ladders. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f6172dbf99d47d71d02f09a776f0128cb2ba52ad.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/efa2c75c70f97fbd6915679a220dd91ca1d41cfa.png

The supply point behind the wall is the lifeblood of the Defenders. The Attackers may try to capture it, then cut off the Defenders of their supply line. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bcdaf42993bd6a15fa58abe3beceb69f02722867.png

Another supply point in the city is located at a junction on the other side of the city. It exposed to enemy cannon fire and easy to be flanked. However, this is the main route for the Defenders to support their base, so it would be the place where the battle would be most intense.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/543b5bbf9c05cd1cf62ea705b392c90767383475.png

The final flag is set at a three-way intersection on the back of the city. There are barricades towards the city gate that can stop the units. An open clearing surrounds the flag, and the road on both wings is spacious. The buildings on both wings provide an excellent place for the Attackers and Defenders to engage. There are still trails for flanking, and only the best teamwork can put it in full use. The battles here are usually fierce. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0a250b3ae1a7c3374a9836ee9381ad4406dfc532.png

Siege of Kurak Castle
Main features
Kurak Castle is located deep in the desert, nourished by several civilizations in which most of the inland trade routes intersect here. For this reason, banditry is rampant here, and the businessman and travelers to and from this place are frightened. In order to maintain the safety of the commercial roads and demonstrate the authority of the king over this desert, the desert nation built their fortress on the sand, which is the "The Pearl of the Desert" or "The Ark in the Desert" as it is called by many. 

Topographical overview of this area

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/91aa2bdbb0e9d5cb8416fc010b1823594c84fcea.jpg

There're many small blocks in this Castle, and the walls are tall and thick. There're many lookout towers scattered around the walls which can provide fire support to the Defenders on the city walls. An additional wall is erected in the inner city, and once the outer city breached, the defenders still had the opportunity to organize a counterattack. Point A is located at the Castle wall above the gate. The cannon fire and the cavalry can't reach it, which means the Attackers have to break through the gate first or use a siege tower to climb up the wall. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/acf842ac6204f1b7518abb5f22562b83fed326a8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6a1031e71484b57dba81841ef601fa41136bc44.png

Point B is placing on the inner side of the city next to the wall. The Attackers can break through the main gate, then raid this place immediately or climb up on the walls then slowly push towards here. In the meanwhile, the Attackers can also try to cut off the Defenders' supply line to cause them troubles. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b78cf25bb36951009100b30bd360ea09cf06d7f8.png

The final flag is located somewhere next to the inner city walls. There are towering walls all around here, so the trebuchets can't hit here directly, which providing excellent protection for the Defenders. But if the Attackers take the inner walls and attack the area from above, the Defenders would lose the initiative. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be4a96aac528ea9d5498a2a825576f947540e8eb.png

notes.title: Announcement of Maintenance and updates on May 14th
notes.content:
Greetings Warlords：
We will be doing maintenance and update on May 14th, 12:00-14:00 AM Beijing time (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is two hours. After the maintenance, you'll receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation.

1.The rotation sieges in May: Harbour City Siege, Siege of Kurak Castle
The Harbour City Siege & Siege of Kurak Castle will be online as this month's rotation sieges(May 2020). The Siege of Dasuo Fort will be offline at the same time. After we finished the update, the Attackers and Defenders players on the battlefield will adjust to 15 vs. 15. According to the feedback we've received from players and the significant change on the battlefield. We decided to optimize some details of the map as follows:

1) The optimizing of the Harbour City Siege
-The scaffolding next to the main doorsteps on either side now is destructible. So the Trebuchet can attack the targets on the steps.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/40e4880c05658550f4cc1670f63dcbcbf63324e8.jpg
-A new Attackers' Supply Point was added to the seaside, thus increasing the route of attack.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ea752a0ed50a4c1836d6ae03045b084a46d4e20e.jpg
-The number of Trebuchet on the Attackers' side risen from 6 to 8.
-Siege Towers and Battering Rams moved 5 meters in the direction of the target.
-After capturing Point A, the adding time increased from 3 minutes to 4 minutes. 
-The number of Siege Ladders increased slightly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/edd00569115140f92435d08681b933f380c284e5.jpg

2) The optimizing of the Siege of Kurak Castle
-Siege Towers and Battering Rams moved 5 meters in the direction of the target.
-The number of Siege Ladders increased slightly.
-The number of Trebuchet on the Attackers' side risen from 6 to 8.

2. Balancing adjustment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/47c7c39eebb543ebbb990e043f6a72d8376be2c1.png

According to the data and feedback, the win rate of the Attackers on the Siege of Augolia was lower than we expected. So we will make the following adjustments:

-Add more siege equipment: add 2 uncovered Mortars outside the Point A to against players who are camping inside Point A.
-Siege equipment move forward: We'd like to speed up the game tempo, so we moved Siege Towers 10 meters in the direction of the target and moved Battering Rams 5 meters forward as well.
-Add more Siege Ladders: on the first level of Point B, we placed Ladders on both sides of the gallery. So the Attackers can choose from sneak attack tactics.

3.The balancing of Heroes: Musket-wielding heroes skills adjustment
Now on the battlefield, the Musket-wielding heroes will be allowed to use Fine Gunpowder to increase their loading speed or attacking power to adapt to the high tempo. We feel that the experience of this skill on the battlefield is excellent at first. But in the recent feedback we've received, we found that with rapidly clicking this skill, the hero can instantly burst of extremely significant damage, which has violated our original intention. So we made the following adjustments:
-We added a casting animation for Fine Gunpowder so that it can't cast immediately like before.

4. The update of Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season
After this update, the contents of the Doctrine Choice Crate in Seasonal Store Season will also renew. It contains:
-Rare Mounted Archery Doctrine (3 days)
-Imperial Archers (3 days)
-Rare Crossbow Doctrine (3 days)

The Epic Doctrine:
-Epic Archery Doctrine III (1 day)
-Epic Archery Doctrine V (1 day)
-Rare Arquebus Doctrine III (1 day)
-Epic Arquebus Doctrine (1 day)

5. System Optimizing
1) In order to avoid when having Auxiliary units, the following received Signaculum will refill its XP automatically. We've changed the way for Auxiliary units to have XP. The Signaculum can't refill it's XP anymore.
2) We've optimized the award after finish the Fourth Stage of Veteran Crossbowmen. You'll skip to units unseal screen after you finish the stage. You can unseal it. Then you'll find and recruit it through Barracks-Ranged Infantry-Veteran Crossbowmen.
3) The optimizing of Alliance Diplomacy: In My Alliance screen, even the lowest ranking member can see the diplomatic situation of the Alliance now.

6.Bug Fixing
Fixed bugs in events:
-In Siege of Dasuo Fort, the barrier of the Defenders' respawning point near the base can not be destroyed now.
-In Siege Battle at the Great Wall, the Attackers' battering ram will not be stuck on the bridge.

Fixed bugs in system:
-Now you can use Cross-region Migration Token after the opening of Border Posts.

Fixed Bugs in units:
-Now the Veteran Crossbowmen and Martellatore will show the correct icon of Season Doctrines
-Now all the Auxiliary units will display correctly on the map. 
-Now Martellatore will not cancel their setting moves while he was executing attack orders.
-Now Selemchid Cavalry, Khorchin, Kheshigs, Ironcap Bowrider, and Fire Lancers can correctly set up Scatter Formation. 
-Now the text in the challenges of Martellatore will show the correct translation. 
-The description of the effect of Kheshigs' Doctrine I in this season is corrected.
-The descriptions of Bullseye's nodal effects of Demesne Arbalists is corrected.
-The correct value of Javelin Sergeants' Doctrine II will be displayed now.

notes.title: The Borderlands is live. Who will bring storm upon all?
notes.content:
The 2nd phase "Iron Conqueror" of season 2 is coming to its end. The 3rd phase War of Chaos is about to start! The opening of The Borderlands and Border Posts at 0:00 on May 11 will make the big battlefield even hotter! Warlords new and old will rise or fall in the coalition!

1. Border Posts of All Regions:
Border Posts of Maoyang and Liangyun: Marukai, Miran, Taku;
Border Posts of Ungverija and Ostaria: Kiefernburg, Obstgarten Schloss, Breite Tal, Seewache;
Border Posts of The Four Big Regions and The Borderlands Bay-Tong, Hedi, Dasuo, Yuanguo, Wolkenburg, Verschollen Kastell, Steilerweg, Tolna, Szigetvár
You will have access to other regions and The Borderlands through the previous border posts and declare war on territories there.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8c336a23d214ec14c0bed280601d70b1150f4a35.jpg

2. How to go to The Borderlands via border posts:
Go to any border post that connects your land to The Borderlands. There are 2 watchmen in each post. Select a watchman, tap "Leave Fief" and he will carry you to The Borderlands.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6b880e4a640ccd3ccbd2958b39c54e7f2141de43.jpg

3. Prosperous yet dangerous. What makes The Borderlands so important?
Sitting at the center of the four regions: Liangyun, Maoyang, Ostaria and Ungverija, The Borderlands works as a thoroughfare. If you are to conquer cities of another region, The Borderlands is the only way. Controlling the thoroughfare is always a good tactic! If your house earns a place in The Borderlands, using it as a springboard, you will have easy access to border post villages of other regions. That is an important step to conquer the whole world!

The Borderlands is a place rich in resources. Most resource points there are blue or purple with higher side resource output! With more than 80 border post villages, its resource output is way higher than that of the four regions. More rare resources, unique materials for forging and lower cost to make unit kits... If you want to become stronger, you should not miss this rich land!

4. Cross-Boarder Conquests, Opportunity and Challenge Coexist Side by Side!
The opening of The Borderlands will throw the world into a state of all-out war! With no posts to hold borders, war will reach every corner! It means challenge but also opportunity! To houses that want to expand their influence and territory, they can really use lands in The Borderlands as a springboard to conquer lands in other regions. To houses that have no fiefs, they can use the opportunity to take some, either in The Borderlands or in those regions.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4878762730f07e9f9857a329e6eb772d02e54486.jpg

You may find like-minded allies from other regions as Maoyang warriors can now fight with Ostaria generals. You may find strong rivals from other regions and enjoy fights one after another. With all factions of all regions getting engaged in the war, the situation of The Borderlands will be more complicated than that of any region! Victory and glory, loyalty and betrayal... Warlords, are you ready to build and consolidate your power?

notes.title: The Developer's log：Our thinking of the Golden Era Units balancing
notes.content:
Greetings Warloads：

After we unsealed the Golden Era Season, we've received a large number of feedback about the ecology in the battlefield and the balancing problems among those units from our Generals. As the developers, we thought it would be a good idea to have an open mind, and then sincerely talk about our plans.

First of all, the core aim of our design is to keep those unique units on the battlefield with high game ability. When this game was just released, there were a lot of issues with the balance due to our inexperience. During the next two seasons after the release, we set one season as a node and did a lot of balance optimizing within the period. Up to now, the balance of Rustic Era to Heroic Era Units are approval by many. But as for the Golden Era, even we've nerfed all the units once before, but it seems that they're still not fit in well in the battlefield. 

The following is our explanation of some of the issues:

Why did everyone feel that the Golden Era Units were a bit too powerful
The top tier units of the Golden Era were mean to be the strongest army in the Conqueror's Blade. They were all dominating the battlefield once and stood tall in history. In the original design, we hope to restore their outstanding performance in history, so that they have relatively better Attributes than 4 Stars units. At the same time, in order not to make them seem too powerful, we set their requirements of Leadership by 350.

The overpower Golden Era Units also causing many problems
We can see that because of the overwhelming power of the 5 Stars units in battlefields, most of our Generals started to choose from double 5 Stars units strategy. This strategy is clearly having a devastating effect on the entire ecology. It makes our battlefield lack vitality and diversity.

How we plan to solve this problem
We are seriously considering reducing the Attributes and Leadership requirements on 5 Stars units. There are two benefits to doing so:
Firstly, give our Generals more strategic combinations to choose from, and let them bring more exciting units to the battlefield with Golden Era Units.
Secondly, weakening the ability of the Golden Era Units in single soldier type combating, making it necessary to synergize with other units on the battlefield. It will liven up the whole battlefield for sure.
We haven't yet decided on a specific adjustment program. But we very much look forward to hearing from our Generals' comments and suggestions.

Why shall we wait until the end of the season to make adjustments
We are now just over a month away from the end of this season. One thing we've learned before is that suddenly changing Attributes in the middle of the season can significantly disrupt our Generals' game plan. Many Generals have spent a lot of time on developing their units. In the interest of fairness, we will adjust the values after full communication and advance notice after the season node.

Some principles for the future units of our design
We will pay particular attention to the characteristics of the units. Like the current Golden Era Units, where it should be strong, it will be reliable enough, but they will have their flaws as well. We want to emphasize the tactical role of the units, rather than the ability to fight alone. 
                                                                                              
It is a complex and dynamic process in balancing the performance of the unit on the battlefield of Conqueror's Blade. So please give us some time and let's get the job done with all our ability. With your support, we can definitely make the battlefield environment better and better. Thank you all for your continued trust and support.

Conqueror's Blade Steam Operation Team
May 8th, 2020

notes.title: Announcement of Game Updates on May 8
notes.content:
Dear warlords,
The game will be taken offline for maintenance for 2hr from 12:00-14:00 UTC+8 on May 8. After that, we will offer Bronze Coins x5000 and Honour x200 as compensation. Plan your time so you don't have to go online in the period. Below are the issues the maintenance will address:

Free Unit Rotation Mechanics Modification
Dear lord, In the current version, Golden Era (5-star) units are playing an important role in intense fights. New players that hadn't unlocked any Golden Era units or had just unlocked one unit of the type might find it hard to come up with good tactics when a battle got ferocious due to their shallow unit pool. That also had a negative impact on veteran players' gaming experience when they were matched up with new players. That's why we did these improvements to the free unit rotation mechanics:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9337ea3a14fc8cf91aae455bba41e2a03caae2c7.png

1. Removed the limit that allowed players to select only 1 unit from an era
2. Units for free unit rotation can now by recruited with "Recruit Points"
2.1 Recruit Points is filled to the cap automatically each Monday
2.2. Recruit Points not used in the previous week won't be saved to the next week or have any effect in the next week.
2.3. The number of Recruit Points required to recruit units is the same as those units' Leadership requirement.
2.4. The current Recruit Point cap is 450.

3. Expanded the unit pool for the free units rotation
3.1 Golden Era (5-star) units are now available on the free rotation list when players reach Lv.80.
3.2. On the weekly unit rotation, there are 1-6 Chivalric Era (3-star) units, 1-4 Heroic Era (4-star) units and 1-2 Golden Era (5-star) units.

4.Warloads can start recruiting the Golden Era Units from May 11th.

Adjusted balance of units
After parsing through combat data we collected from recent games, we made some adjustments to the balance of the following units:

1. Vanguard Archers Balance Changes
Compared with other archers, Vanguard Archer was not a viable pick as it should be since its damage output was lower than archers of the same rank. That's why we made these changes:
- Increased damage, armour penetration, rate of fire and accuracy by 7%

2. Feudal Sword & Shield
Feudal Sword & Shield was not as viable as other 3-star small-shield units since it cannot take or deal high damage. That's why we made these changes:
-Skill: Increased cooldown of Recover from 60s to 50s
-Increased 10% damage and defense
- Slightly increased its desire to attack

3. Yeomen
It was relatively easy to sweep off Yeomen in the previous games as it was quite vulnerable. Also, it didn't deal damage as high as it was designed for. That's why we made these changes:
-Increases standard soldiers of the unit from 16 to 18
-Increased 15% damage and defense

Fixed Bugs

1.Fixed Unit Bugs
-Repaired the bug that caused Javelin Sergeants to continue to throw javelins when they were dead 

2.Fixed System Bugs
- Fixed the bug that prevented some quests from being counted in Martellatore Challenges
- Removed the repeated seasonal unit kits from Fief Quests screen in The Borderlands
- Fixed the bug that prevented kills done by charge skills of some units from being counted in related quests

3.Fixed Level Bugs
-Fixed the cases where heroes collide easily at some points in the map of "Riverlands Castle", "Valley Fortress" and "Siege of Augolia".

Optimized World Channel
- Added functionality to display more languages in World Channel and made it easy to use.
- Optimized the goods display duration in Market by reducing the random time section to 1-3hr.

notes.title: Announcement of Game Updates on April 30
notes.content:
Dear warlords,
The game will be taken offline for maintenance for 2hr from 12:00-14:00 UTC+8 on April 30. After that, we will offer Bronze Coins x5000 and Honour x200 as compensation. Plan your time so you don't have to go online in the period. Below are the issues the maintenance will address:

1. Brand New Deathmatch Map - Navy Shipyard is now live
Today, we are bringing you the brand new Deathmatch map - Navy Shipyard!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d134ec24c1ef30debaa9c90098722b88672c7221.jpg

Sitting in the natural harbor surrounded by several islands, this shipyard is where most ships of the navy are built.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/69f237a11bc11ad5328c9be7db62d997d2d27d18.png

The shipyard region has the shore on one side and the water on the other side. The shore side holds the walled base where officers, workers and soldiers live. The water side contains many specialized cranes, dry docks, slipways, and an extremely large area for the production of the ships. There is also an outer harbor deep enough for big ships to call in at.

Game Mode
Navy Shipyard is the platform for the Deathmatch mode, with 10 warlords on each side fighting for victory. One side launches attack from the vessel on the water side while the other side charges from the inner side of the high walls. The side which gets 40 kills first will win.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6fa2bc2ee907d2942fd2d54c74639f423799a538.png

Special Mechanic
The shipyard has all kinds of people, each has their own secret. The rumor has it that a batch of chests filled with mysterious resources was delivered here by an exotic ship and it is hidden somewhere in the shipyard. As the battle rages on, these chests may be discovered. With the resources in the chest, you may even change the tide of the battle. We are looking forward to the intensive scramble for these resources. Go chase your enemies away from the place!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/2190381723584400807

2. Growth Rush and Legion Durability No Consuming Events
Activity time: After maintenance on April 30 - 24:00 on May 11
- For level 0-100 warlords:

 20% bonus for bronze coins, honor, hero exp and unit exp in battle.
 Increase the weekly honor limit from 20,000 to 30,000.

- For level 101-200 warlords:

 15% bonus for bronze coins, honor, hero exp and unit exp in battle.
 Increase the weekly honor limit from 20,000 to 30,000.

- For over level 201 warlords:

 10% bonus for bronze coins, honor, hero exp and unit exp in battle.
 Increase the weekly honor limit from 20,000 to 30,000.

Hope you could seize this opportunity and recruit your favorite units, practice and train them hard to form a strong fighting force.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/2191508256538584154

3. Balance of Heroes Adjustments
1. Short Bow Adjustments:
We noticed that the performance of Short Bow was not very satisfying as he could hardly hurt units with tough armor. So we made this adjustment:
- Shooting skills of Short Bow heroes consume a layer of buff obtained by rolling for a 15% extra Armour Piercing boost.

2. Dual Blades Adjustments:
We noticed that "Marked for Death" of Dual Blades affected both the caster and the target in a negative way.
- To the target, it's like the skill could control them forever;
- To the caster, it deprived them of the ability to move or use other skills while the skill was active. That could be too risky to Dual Blades whose Defense was relatively low.
We have made some adjustments to Marked for Death. Its duration has been reduced by 1/3, which leads to a reduction in attack times. The total damage dealt remains. Dual Blades now gains control of himself earlier after casting the skill, making it easier to use other skills.

Optimized cooldown of "The Dance of Death" by fixing the bug that prevented the timer from being correctly shown when the skill was tapped repeatedly. The timer of the skill now starts when the skill is cast. Also, we've made a little change to the skill by slightly reducing its cooldown at II and III.
I: Increased cooldown from 60s to 65s
II: Increased cooldown from 55s to 57s
I: Increased cooldown from 45s to 46s

3. Nodachi Hero Adjustments:
We noticed that Nodachi didn't finish units as he was designed to. With melee units gaining more Armour, he could not inflict damage as high as expected. That's why we made these changes:
- The Life Drain buff obtained when Bloodthirsty, Fearless & Steadfast and Samurai's March hit now provides 30 Pierce and Armour Penetration.

4. Bow Adjustments:
We noticed that arrows of Bow were able to stun enemies from so far that damage had already fallen off. To better present the reality and make it less powerful, we changed the attack effects of Bow. When the distance exceeds 60m, arrows can no longer stun targets.

5. Optimized Glaive
