The top ranking Empire Guardian and Freedom Unions in S1 will be highlighted on the history of Conqueror's Blade Frontier forever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c1f11413b3642a8cff6ff5a475e969f3e054219e.png

Season S1 Settlement ends at: March 21 24:00
Season S1 rewards will be offered on: March 24

Rewards for Empire Guardian and Freedom Unions in S1:

1. Rewards for Freedom Unions
1. Freedom Union Fief Reward:

Rewards for fiefs occupied by each House when the season ends: For each fief a House keeps, all members will get a settlement reward for the season. Members of each alliance will receive Bronze Coins when the Houses of the alliance own fiefs.
Rewards are tied to site type and level. Details:

Fiefs:
Lv.1-5 Fiefs: Box of Rare Artillery x2, Box of Random Rare Kit x10
Lv.6 Fiefs and Above: Epic Siege Engine Chest Box x1, Box of Rare Artillery x2, Box of Random Rare Kit x15
Forts:
Lv.1-5 Forts Box of Rare Artillery x1, Box of Random Rare Kit x10
Lv.6 Forts and Above: Epic Siege Engine Chest Box x1, Box of Rare Artillery x2, Box of Random Rare Kit x15
Villages:
Lv.1-5 Villages: Box of Rare Artillery x1, Box of Random Rare Kit x5
Lv.6 Villages and Above: Box of Rare Artillery x1, Box of Random Rare Kit x10

2. Freedom Union Title Reward

All members of the alliances win the final battle in the capital will get the title - "Freedom Warrior" when the season ends.

2. Rewards for Empire Guardian

1. Empire Guardian Ranking Reward

When the season ends, members of Empire Guardian will get rewards based on their ranking by merits. Rules:
No.1-100: Box of Rare Artillery x4, Box of Random Rare Kit x25, Epic Siege Engine Chest Box x1
No.101-200: Box of Rare Artillery x2, Box of Random Rare Kit x15
No.201-300: Box of Rare Artillery x1, Box of Random Rare Kit x5

2. Empire Guardian Title Reward

The Empire Guardian who participated in the decisive battle of the City of heroes will receive a permanent title reward at the end of the season: Wrath of the Nomads Scout
If Empire Guardian guards any gate during settlement, the permanent title will be upgraded to Wrath of the Nomads Paladin
If the City of heroes is held, the permanent title will be upgraded to: Wrath of the Nomads Hero.

3.Empire Guardian Guarding Reward

If the Empire Guardian recaptures any city for the empire in the last battle, all warloads participating in the city recapture battle will receive a corresponding reward.
Fiefs：Box of Rare Artillery x2, Box of Random Rare Kit x10
Forts：Box of Rare Artillery x1, Box of Random Rare Kit x10
Villages：Box of Rare Artillery x1, Box of Random Rare Kit x5

3、After season ends, there are changes Warlords need to pay attention to: 

（1）Match battles and level up characters will no longer gain season exp. 
（2）“Warpoint Gift”from weekly quests will no longer contain “Shaman’s Scroll”
（3）Warlords can continue to complete weekly challenges and fashion challenges until next season starts
（4） Warlords can continue to gain BP experience through the Khan’s Edict and Shaman’s Scroll
（5）Warlords can continue to exchange items from the Seasonal Store until next season. At the beginning of next season, the Fangs will no longer be able to exchange items in Seasonal Store.

4、Additional rules about Unit challenges:

（1） Warlords can continue ongoing unit challenges until new season starts
（2） After the start of next season ,a switching option will be provided to switch to unit challenges in different seasons. 
（3）Switching challenges will have a cooldown time.
（4）Only one seasonal unit challenge can be performed at a time;
（5）After the end of the season , the unit challenge this season , you need to complete all the tasks In each phase to unlock the next phase of the challenge.
（6） After the start of next season, the phase progress bonus for completing the unit challenge will be removed.

notes.title: 12/03/2020　Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,

We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8 am to 10 am, 12th Mar (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after the server maintenance. Here are the patch note:

1.Level Balance Adjustments：City of Heroes (Siege) Adjustments

Based on the data analysis, we know that the attacker win rates of Royal Ramparts shows that this level is too hard for the attackers. The structure of the city make that trebuchets have less impacts and harder to strike at the weakness point of defenders. And, numberless defender artilleries rule the battlefield, and they are harder to be countered because of the structure. So we decide to do more adjustment on the artilleries to reduce the frustration for attackers.
-We adjust the distribution of defenders artilleries, removed couples of unbeatable artilleries, and level down parts of artileries

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6e5e5ff0254fd9934098d96533563cb72d6eea2a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ea46ae49147e835183748f386b15e58229ab0dae.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f66c26e25950a38d2f3d24804c60f3b05a9508d3.jpg

-We adjust the position of some supply points and respawn points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/685e593bbfe2a39feb0facd24fbbe0c2755dfd3f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bc9ec2147a3e69d1d908647d16875b4fa902de20.jpg

2.Level Mechanic Improvement 

Siege Level Balance : Equal Numbers of Players on Both Side
According to our data analysis, the Riverlands Castle will be the next level that we are going to apply this change. We are going to add 1 more players into the defender side to see will that help defender to resist from the attackers. 

Additional, considering the combat situation at final area will be changed, we decide to do adjust to the map itself:
-Move the final supply point to the side area, make that area valuable to be fight around. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/16415ca598c4730b9b402c6b7c3c474155504d41.png

After this patch, there will be 4 different siege maps that are 15 vs. 15 combat: Royal Ramparts, City of Heroes, Sun City, Riverlands Castle.
Again, we are going watch the data change and players’ feedbacks of this new change. And we are definitely going to do more improvement and iteration based on that.

3.System Optimization

【Knighthood】Optimize the knighthood icon displayed in emails with titles.
Influence of the Conqueror's City will separate calculation
【City of Heroes】When the Conqueror's City be occupied the Influence will separate calculation. If the Conqueror's City lost control the Influence of the Conqueror's City will be cleared all.
【City of Heroes】The front will more conspicuous.Friendly forces is blue enemy forces is red.
【City of Heroes】Expanded the silver bonus pool in the Conqueror's City and the gate of rules,the gate of glory,the gate of earth,the gate of heaven.At the same time bouns items have added fine instrument fragments,legend instrument fragments, epic instrument fragments.
【Level】In all 8 VS 8 field battle , we add supply points in the camp area for both side.

4.Bug fixed

【Knighthood】Fixed the problem that the title of the English version is not displayed.
【Level】Fix the opening camera problem of The Storehouse (Siege) and Lesser Greenpeak Camp(Siege)
【Level】Fix the problem of there are one spawn points that are hard to click in the City of Heroes(Siege) Level. 
【Level】Fix the problem of there are one ladder that can’t  be climbed in the City of Heroes(Siege) Level.

notes.title: 05/03/2020 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, 
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8am to 11am, 5th March (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after server maintenance completed. Here are the patch note:

1.Activity Maps: City of Heroes

Center of the Borderlands, heart of the kingdom, symbol of the kingship, conquer it to make you lores be eulogized. The city of Heroes, will lift the mysterious veil as a time-exclusive activity map in the following weeks. 

“City of Heroes”Available time schedule
8th, March to 15th, March, every day from 12:00 to 14:00 and 18:00 to 20:00 (UTC+8). Limited activity.

City of Heroes（Time-Exclusive Preview）
Main Feature
The greatest city among the borderlands, the city of Heroes are composed of two separate parts: the Residential Area and the Inner Castle, connected by a narrow stone bridge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e4dc143c7980be5202c2c72a86adf408935d6091.png

Tactics Preview
City of Heroes is a 15 vs. 15 siege map that provide variety of structure diff advantage and tactics moves. 
As the opening, battle take place at the Residential Area, which is the lowland part of the city.  Attackers and Defenders may have an extremely close combat trying to control stronghold A. Attackers have variety of roads to invade. The defenders may also choose to spawn at the high ground of Inner Castle to prepare for the next phase combat. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1f57092b64c5359f0df06d675540010a2e9842a4.jpg

After the stronghold A, that’s time for the Siege Bridge to be on the stage. That is a chains catapulted siege machine that can help army to cross the gap. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d11b18d6db0714f68afdcb62760185505efd9af5.png

After the set up the siege bridge, attackers can arrange multiline assaults to attack stronghold B. Pay attention to the combat on the bridge, be careful not to fall off the bridge.  
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4cb155ddebf81153b040aad648a5b62f21a7a422.jpg

Attackers can also attacker from the front side, use battering ram to break out the main gate. There are also options to use ladders to climb onto the wall. Multiple options here.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7dbd551260e60dd42b3d40e34ca3ad437f6ae51d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6e636c7a9f57dc3f5cd07a1fcfc4a23c27ff7619.jpg

The combat of Area B is all about the central statue. All strategy should be focus on the main target here.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cc86abd3b7bcbe190e4fa8791aa5492d1af20e07.jpg

After the combat of stronghold B, both side may to be passionate about the final combat in the City of Heroes. The attack to the stronghold C will be a multiple answer question. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/33bf7a22bdd27946312cc4b6acbb340cfe2d9e3c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/56b3d7c10806109b1b705d0f5e508394c6dde508.jpg

The attackers can choose to climb over the city wall in the front side, or choose to sneak attack the side supply area from the side part. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/332afb713353db1aec0cde6a9c5209d358975048.jpg
 
As the defender, minimalize the structure advantage of the city wall, hold your defend land, hold the city to the last second! 

2. Optimization of “wild hunt” mode

1)	Reward optimization
We have decided to improve the experience reward in this mode to normal match making including unit and hero experiences. And we will pay close attention after the change, and keep optimizing and polishing this mode.

2)	Team optimization
Release team restrictions, all the players below Silver rank can team up freely.
While for higher ranks, the restriction is your team member need to 1 rank near yours.

3)	MVP optimization
To encourage players who well played and get MVP but still lose the game, we decided to improve the rewards in this situation.

4)	Siege weapon limitation change
Increase the number of using siege weapon in the battlefield from one to two.

5)Other optimization 
Optimized a few descriptions and icons in wild hunt mode.

In this week, we will keep testing the “wild hunt”mode from : 7th, March（12:00-20:00） to 8th, March（12:00-20:00）.

3. Advance notice about incoming balance changes of season units

Since all the seasonal units released, we keep close attention to their performances on the battlefield which quite not meet our expectation. We will do some balance changes of them very soon. Stay tuned.

4．Level Balance Adjustments: Royal Ramparts Adjustment:

Based on the data analysis, we know that the attacker win rates of Royal Ramparts shows that this level is too hard for the attackers. The structure at stronghold A make there to be an extreme tough spot to be conquered.
So we decide to reinforce the attackers in the front line, we add couples of new siege machine to help the attacker to get over with this shield of the city. 

Catapult Siege Machine
We added 3 Catapults into the attackers side. In order to break through the defense in the stronghold A. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cd3552b12470ec389c8260e0390d9917ce8e8c7c.png

More Ladders
For the same reason, we added more ladders in the front side. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/67b62ccb7e2c1ed3a843ad50384daffb66ea7c1e.png

Game time increased from 13 mins to 14 mins
Slightly adjust the other siege machine and spawn point for both side. 

5.Level Mechanic Improvement 

Siege Level Balance : Equal Numbers of Players on Both Side
While we are considering the level balance, the number of players is always an important factor in our mind. With the development of Tournaments and Rank mode, we are hoping that all players can enjoy and be prepared for the equal numbers players competitions in all mode.
Considering the balance of each level will be slightly different, we are going to apply this change to all level in a longer development cycles, level by level, not change all level at one time. And we are going to keep an eye on the results of these changes in different maps while developing. 
According to our data analysis, the Sun City will be the first level that we are going to apply this change. We are going to add 1 more players into the defender side to see will that help defender to resist from the attackers.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d2108cbe029186176b23f2d9f724680826911827.jpg

Again, we are going watch the data change and players’ feedbacks of this new change. And we are definitely going to do more improvement and iteration based on that.

6.System Optimization

1)City of heroes battle optimization
The city of heroes has a new ability to withdraw out of town. Player can exit the city by clicking on the outer gate of the city of heroes. It has a 5 mins cool down.
2)Optimized the icon arrangement order and style display when entering an abnormal state when marching in the open world.
3)Optimized the icon style display in the barracks interface after marching outside the corps.

7.BUG Fix

1)Fixed a bug that players cannot complete the quest of joining in the siege of gate or city of heroes.
2)Fixed the problem that there is no yellow exclamation mark on the season button after the challenge is completed in the 11th week of the season challenge.
3)Fixed the challenge of “Knowing and Making Friends” cannot be complete if your friend request was approved while you are offline.
4)Fixed the problem of that Wall of Rangifer(Siege) don’t have opening scene.
5)Fixed the problem at Royal Ramparts, which attackers can accidently stop defenders controlling main gates.
6)Fixed the problem of wrong display name of battering ram base in 4 Gates level around the city of heroes on open world. 
7)Fixed a camera bug: camera shifts at certain situation.

notes.title: 27/02/2020 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, 
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8am to 10am, 27th February (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after server maintenance completed. Here are the patch note:

1. Important Updates: Arena Test - The Wild Hunt

Arena test activity is now available! A best platform for Warlords to show your strength and polish your battle skills. All Warlords are welcome to test the Wild Hunt level and share your suggestions with us. Arena mode will be officially released after We making further improvements and optimization according to your feedback.

1）Stage Score Introduction
Warlords can get stage score by taking part in the Arena battles and upgrade your stage accordingly. More detailed info are as follows:
Tenacity Iron：0-199
Staunch Iron：200-399
Tenacity Bronze：400-599
Staunch Bronze：600-799
Struggling Silver：800-999
Glory Silver：1000-1199
Struggling Gold：1200-1399
Glory Gold：1400-1699
Blazing Platinum ：1700-2099
Noble Platinum ：2100+
The Arena Ranking list of your server are available in [Hall of Fame - Arena Ranking ] interface.

2) Participation Rules
A. Only Warlords over level 100 can take part in this test activity. During this mode, each Warlord can only deploy artillery once in every single battle
B. Warlords no longer need to worry about the unit kit losses.Just join in the battle and fight Hard till the end!
C. This mode will not produce any currency-related items, including Bronze Coins, Silver Coins,loot items, etc.Strength always comes first in this mode.
D. Several relatively balanced siege and field maps were added into the map pool of this mode.Battle map will be randomly chosen from the following maps:
Hidden City (Multistage Siege Battle)
Border Fort (Multistage Siege Battle)
Harbour City (Multistage Siege Battle)
Wall Fort (Multistage Siege Battle)
Arena (Field Conquest) 
Westwood (Field Conquest) 
Desert Fortress (Field Conquest) 
Marauder Settlement (Field Conquest) 
Augolia (Field Progression) 
Conquest (Field Progression) 

3) Rewards
In order to make every active Warlords get rewarded, the Auction House has prepared specific rewards for Warlords in different tiers.
When this test activity is over, Warlords ranking Top 10% will be rewarded with a permanent title“Champion of Battlefield”, Flag Selection Box and 30,000 Bronze Coins. Warlords participating this test activity will get 10,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour and “Field Pioneer”title (30 days).

4) Test Time
February 29: 12:00-20:00
March 1: 12:00-22:00
March 7: 12:00-20:00
March 8: 12:00-22:00

2. New Map: Royal Ramparts

A time-limited new map - Royal Ramparts will be available after this update, allowing Warlords to get familiar with the internal layout before conquering the City of Heroes.

As a military drill, Royal Ramparts siege battle enjoy no unit kit losses, and will not produce Bronze Coins. 

The opening time: 
12:00-14:00, 18:00-20:00 from February 27 to March 7. 

Main Features
As the last line of defense, the Royal Ramparts is like a iron shield guarding the city for long. The city of heroes have no threats before the ramparts fall.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3edfd5fdac6f94c2b107728c4b2d6af0def4462a.png

Tactic Introduction
Royal Ramparts is a 15V15 siege map. Both Attackers and Defenders can cooperate closely with their teammates to gain certain battlefield advantages by taking full use of the terrain and various artillery pieces.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2bb921c52c4494482e93c15bac55274e87394594.jpg

After the battle starts, Attackers can use Battering Ram, Siege Tower and ladders to attack the front city wall. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4010fec4c1591b68b38e4743d63bf81e713b7603.jpg

Point A is located inside the second-floor platform of the front tower. Attackers can climb up to the city wall from both sides to conduct a flanking attack.  
Attackers also can make a detour to attack the tower after breaking the main gate.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b55a25563fd8e77beef2dd98719d5a255a55697a.jpg

After taking over Point A, Attackers can choose the front or side path to attack the base camp.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2fa655f0b21d5f54bc2977ee793ab08c685bac94.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/45dde067c4fdde9b52352cf1a7e36aea3191a0d3.jpg
 
While defending the base camp, Defenders should pay attention to enemy’s trebuchets since the base camp is located in a relatively empty area.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/27334112473e247d860f1139615b3ae9076677b2.jpg

3. Level Mechanism Optimization: Ladder Interaction Logic Optimization

As we all know, one of the most exciting moment of the siege battle is the contest of city wall. To breakthrough this defend line, Attackers always use lots of siege ladders to help their soldiers climb up to the city wall quickly.
In order to provide Warlords with a battlefield with more flexibility and various gameplay, we have made lots of improvements by adjusting the interaction logic of siege ladders. Now both Attackers and Defenders can interact to build or kick siege ladders, which means Defenders can quickly get back to the city wall for defending their position, and Attackers also can kick out the ladders after climbing up to the city wall to stop the pursuit forces.

4. Open World Location Optimization 

-Freedom Union
Location of all members inside your house will be displayed on open world map and refreshed every 10 seconds.
-Empire Guardian
Location of all Empire Guardian members will be displayed on open world map and refreshed every 10 seconds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/19c2114a28ab68e6e324d67f49e91537f576d299.png

5. Punishment to the intentional disconnection in Open World

Warlords who intentionally disconnect their cables to avoid being chased in the open world will be punished. Half of the items in their wagon will be dropped automatically and can be picked up by other Warlords within 10 minutes.

6. Newly added Seasonal Challenges

Challenges of Week 11 and Week 12 will be added for this season, allowing Warlords to earn more Seasonal XP. Challenges regarding Arena-The Wild Hunt will be added accordingly. 

7. Guidance Price Adjustment
After reviewing the transaction data, Auction House has made some adjustments to the guidance price of some items, unit kit, schematics, weapons and equipment set. You can check the adjusted price in Auction House.

8. System Optimization

1) Optimization to Empire Guardian: Added a exclamation mark for notification in the Season button in the homepage banner and the campaigns interface when the Empire Guardian completed some Seasonal stage quests.

2) Battle Line Amount Adjustment
Decreased the battle line amount from 3 to 2 for the City of Heroes, Gate of Order, Gate of Earth, Gate of Heaven and Gate of Glory.

3) Artillery Optimization
Artillery running out of ammo would not only block allies’ artillery projectile but also their movements, so we optimized this issue accordingly.
-Deployed Artillery will be destroyed automatically 30 seconds after they running out of ammo.

-Optimized the quality filter in Artillery Workshop, artillery will be divided into four main qualities: “Normal”, “Well-made”, “Optimal”, “Legend”. Warlords no longer need to scroll the item list.
-Optimized the newbie artillery tutorial quest, “build a certain kind of Grapeshot Cannon” was adjusted to “build any artillery”

9. Bug Fixes

1) Winged Hussars’ Formation Bug Fixes
We have noticed that in our previous version, the Dispersed formation of Winged Hussars with 18 soldiers were in line with our design, however this formation becoming more intensive with 16 soldiers. This bug may be deliberately used by some players to effect the battlefield balance. So we made some optimization accordingly: Unified the density of Winged Hussars’ Dispersed Formation. The density would remain unchanged regardless of soldiers amount.
Dispersed Formation with 16 soldiers (Before):
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/92bffb96d7db1804f37ad74e346ac412313e461e.png

Dispersed Formation with 16 soldiers (After):
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d11c2473328dfe70eb800b4631a06ca2dfe7fec.png

2) Miscellaneous Fixes
-Fixed a bug where Warlords could still give orders to their units after death.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b302bdc17a86f0a226564a5be39e1d41c8f67176.png

-Fixed a bug where the trigger of victory counting quest did not take effect in “Wall of Rangifer (Siege)” and “Steppe Wuqing (Field)”level.
-Fixed an incorrect city gate switch mark inside a building of “Siege of Eagle Pass (Expedition)”
-Fixed a bug where house members’ title did not been recycled after they deleting their account.
-Fixed a bug where Warlords couldn’t join in a House once they arrived in a new region by using Cross-region Migration Token, and they would be notified that “This House is based in too distant a land for you to join”.
-Fixed a bug where the path finding did not work correctly in “Ungverija - Mount Care”interface. Warlords would go for the Watchman after choosing Vendor.
-Fixed a bug where Warlords can operate their supply dump in open world after using “Unit Management”

notes.title: 13/02/2020 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, 
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8am to 11am, 13th February (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 8,000 Bronze Coins and 300 Honour after server maintenance completed. Here are the patch note:

1.Virus：The Cure  
Villages have suffered huge losses due to the virus. Commander Adler step forward to recruit  righteous Warlords from different regions and protect local residents away from the epidemic. Please join Commander Adler to fight against the virus and rescue the city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/246b6a12fdc14497b3e95717319c034a8e6c9199.png

This PVE level will be available 12:00-24:00 from February 13 to February 27.

2.Map shifting for this month
“Attack on Wall of Rangifer” and “Valley Fortress” will be added to the map pool of February while “Border Fort” will be removed.

1)Attack on Wall of Rangifer

The Great Wall was built between the Rangifer mountains, creating a natural barrier to prevent the invasion of Northern tribes. The front slope of the Great Wall is narrow and long. The structure rises along with the S-shape terrain. Defenders can use several watchtowers and city walls to hold their position, while attackers can put forward after capturing those watchtowers one by one or conduct an ambush after climbing up to the city wall with the ladders.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b1180b308f9ae74437aecd36756b401df91af129.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fdd8dd8d1e560be8a9ad12075b3f5601a780e8ae.png

Tactic Introduction
The outside slope of the Great Wall is narrow and long, with a multi-level towel located in the middle. Attackers can use the Battering Ram to attack from the front tower or use ladders to climb up to the city wall before an attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0beade4b99d57d9886c66a3ada38fa0d56b06ed6.png

The large-scale tower on the front is an important defensive building, which was built into a three-story structure and equipped with several firearms inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/37153aa33bdabc7353fde978c2b370631c3c0108.png

Defenders can use the firearms inside the tower or attack the flaming pitch nearby the front gate to defend their position. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/29cb5a81dfe396aa6917383a155a75caa7ea1a99.png

Point A is located behind the tower. Attackers can break the front tower or attack from city wall on both sides to capture it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b6f3f3650b2246da71e4e669c7f83af06f581785.png

Point B and C will be available to be captured after Attackers taking over Point A. Attackers can push forward along with the city wall or use ladders to climb up the city wall under Point B. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/69f6a4cbc123200a874d0868e3f06a5f7976a3f6.png

Point B is located inside a large-scale beacon, connecting to the city wall on both sides. However some parts of the beacon can be easily broken by Trebuchets or Artillery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4c66ec93890655c2251e31aa3fd59f1582fdffa6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/91911c4412719002e2df3bca1b8c3126e310707c.png

Point C is on the left of Point B and located inside a small tower. Attackers can push forward along the city wall or directly attack from the ground to capture Point C.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cfa9a864645349cee2ef9b6f0f3756231e29a4f1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c2757ae7616cad3caa3135d34ba4357660b1bc98.png

The base camp is available to be captured after Attackers capturing Pint B or Point C. There is a flat ground between base camp and Point C.Attackers can use the flat ground or push forward along the city wall over Point C to the tower nearby base camp then conduct an attack to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/25d92602792c4f33461dde8009ac03adf5be9ca1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c899cd00bb864539475eeb848736c34f738328f6.png

Warlords can deploy some units nearby the gate of base camp or put some ranged units above the gate to wipe invading enemies. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/645e7e4b0c96783a72be7942c2b34efa5218e84b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5e66d57b170a910d6ec9d528505e78cb840acba1.png

The city wall on the front of base camp can be easily broken by Trebuchets or artillery. Attackers can take advantage of this point to capture the base camp more easily. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8bf2d36063bdd106b900f3f59c44a36ae01b3c6d.png

2)Valley Fortress (readjusted)

The terrain of Valley Fortress is gradually increasing along with the mountains.The internal layout is compact with crisscrossed paths .There is a small castle located on the highest point inside the fortress,which can be used by defenders to protect the base camp after external castle being captured by attackers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7ed583d28d2def81086db649868d02a33ce8de8a.png

Tactic Introduction
Battering Ram, Siege Tower and ladders are available to be used to attack Point A and Point B.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a6d7c7c5156de1de81e6f3e67d0a52a0cf228e6b.png

Point C will be available to be captured after Attackers capturing Point A or Point B. Point C was located at the flat ground outside the inner castle. Attackers can push forward through two gates under Point C or climb up to the city wall through ladders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3c7abb14f2c6f44a9bd962c20f239b4c38626226.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/da97de69218172ff6aad5acc03043518030fbfde.png

Base camp will be available to be captured after Attackers taking over Point C. Attackers can advance to the base camp through gates on both sides or conduct an ambush after climbing up to the city wall of inner castle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/420fd93d0d82cd12ed97ed71a79e2a86e1403583.png

Defenders can deploy some ranged units at the city wall of inner castle and take advantage of the terrain to fight against enemies under the city wall. Besides that,Defenders should pay attention to gates on both sides in case of a surprise attack. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1e9278d798e65f244dfe38aadb0f86896129ec05.png

3.Exclusive Achievements and Badges 
1)Exclusive Achievements of Valley Fortress (Siege) and Attack on Wall of Rangifer (Siege) 
[Battle of Valley Fortress]: win 1 PVP battle in Valley Fortress  (siege)
[Conqueror of  Rangifer]: win 1 PVP battle in Wall of Rangifer  (siege)
[Backwater battle]: earn 1 "Combo Breaker" badge in Valley Fortress  (siege)
[Megatron Octagon]: earn 1 "Headhunter" badge in Wall of Rangifer  (siege)

2)Exclusive Badges of Attack on Wall of Rangifer (Siege)
[Mighty Warriors]: Earn the highest number of hero kills on your team in Wall of Rangifer.
[Brave and fierce]: In Wall of Rangifer Battle, deal 800,000 damage.

4.“The Return of Veteran” Activity is back !
We are now relaunching “The Return of Veteran” activity to provide better game experience during the epidemic. Warlords returning to the battlefield of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier will enjoy various benefits including extra Auxiliary Units, Specific buff and certain Return Gifts. Warlords completing invitation quests will also be rewarded. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0fe0332007661046814314e2aa4c86646d6cfdbf.png

Available: February 13 to February 27

Requirement of Returning Veterans: Warlords who haven’t login from February 1 to February 9

Activity and rewards:
1)Login Activity
Returning Veterans can login the game everyday to get various rewards including Treatises, Honour, Seasonal XP and so on.
2)Specific Buff for Veterans
Auxiliary Unit Buff: Returning Veterans can recruit one more Chivalric Era unit and Silver Era unit
Battle Buff: Returning Veterans will get 7-day premium account as reward
3)Return Challenges for Veterans
Returning Veterans will get one Chivalric Era unit signaculum once they advance to next seasonal level. Each Warlord can get 20 Signaculum at most. (20 Signaculums can be used to unlock one Chivalric Era unit) 
Please note：
-Signaculum reward will be distributed by in-game mail within 3days after activity ended
-This activity is only available for 15 days, and only applicable to returning Warlords over level 60
-The challenge process of different characters under one returning account will be calculated separately.
4)Exclusive Discount Pack
Returning Veterans can buy the exclusive discount pack. Use this item to get login rewards for 7 days in a row, including Bronze coins, Honour, Skill point and Unit Medal and so on.

Invitation Rewards:
-Warlords inviting 1 warlord will get [Battle-ready - Comradeship], including one Treatise
-Warlords inviting 3 Warlords will get[Battle-ready - Devotion], including Treatise *2 and Blue Artillery Box *1
-Warlords inviting 8 Warlords will get [Battle-ready - Friendship], including Treatise*3, Chivalric Era selectable Signaculum *10 and Purple Artillery Box*1
-Warlords inviting 15 Warlords will get [Battle-ready - Uprising], including Treatise*4, Indomitable Lion( permanent) and legendary Artillery Box*1
Above-mentioned rewards will be distributed by in-game mail within 3 days after activity ended.

5.Relevant Adjustments 
we made the following adjustments since the conquering process of all Warlords have been effected due to the ongoing epidemic outbreak. Hope you will understand. 
1）Time Adjustments
-[Heart of the World] will be extended for 11 days and officially ended on February 29
-[Conqueror’s Crown] will be launched on March 1 and ended on March 18

2）Battle schedule adjustments to the City of Heroes
-The first Territory War of the City of Heroes on March 3 has been changed to military exercise
-Territory War will be available after March 7 then there will be no more military exercises

3）The release of [City of Heroes]
City of Heroes will be available to all Warlords after server maintenance on February 27

6.Special Login Activity for this Month
Available: from 11:00, February 13 to 24:00, February 29
Join in this activity (O interface) and get various rewards, including Bronze Coins, Unit Medal and Treatise.

7.Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where the Rebels and Bandit camps in the Borderland did not refresh.
Fixed a bug where some rebels camp in the open world did not take effect correctly. 
Fixed a bug where the privilege fief did not fully displayed in M interface.
Fixed a bug where solo Warlords couldn’t quit their Alliance or take part in other Houses.
Fixed a bug where Warlords could operate items inside their supply dump when they leaving other fiefs without weapons.
Optimized the information synchronization speed of TAB key inside the battlefield.

notes.title: New System (Freedom Union VS Empire Guardian) Announcement
notes.content:
Civilization, conflict, war, the world is never tranquil with the invasion of Khan in the North and the turmoil in the East and West, and the city of hero is in danger…Will the Empire fall into chaos? Perhaps it’s the beginning of a whole brand new evolution.

Throughout various regions of the open world, the imperial land were separated by Houses and Alliances. Under such circumstance, Warlords have to define their own fate. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f518de20ea19ecd9b89148e97376cf21e1cebd97.png

Freedom Union
-Follow the destiny? Take part in other Houses or build your own Houses? 
Crown yourself with the honor and glory while conquering the open world and creating your own destiny. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08dbcb5a6e4d1677d38dac7abbe05b6ee07574b4.png

-Warlords who have already take part in Houses and Alliances will join [Freedom Union] by default. 
-Solo Warlords can choose to join [Freedom Union], existing Houses or create new houses in N interface

Empire Guardian
-Defend the Empire? Vow to guard the dignity of the Imperial Legion and find peace for the open world?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6dc175e9986dfc3b8f4f776e26fe7ab57e270b57.png

-If Solo Warlords choose to take part in [Empire Guardian] of current region in N interface, they will be distributed in one battalion randomly.  
-Warlords who took part in [Empire Guardian] cannot quit within 7 days. 

Introduction to Empire Guardian 

Diplomacy
-Empire Guardian were established to protect the homeland and would not occupy any forts in open world. The Empire Guardian are hostile to all Freedom Union by default
-All Empire Guardian has established friendly relationship between each other
-Empire Guardian has established friendly diplomatic relations with the former imperial forces

Rewards
-Empire Guardian members have the right to collect and craft in imperial territory with 50% tax rate by default
-Warlords will be rewarded accordingly to the quest accomplishments during every territory war
-Empire Guardian will receive bonus profits after regaining fiefs for former imperial forces

Accession and Quit
- Each Empire Guardian battalion can have 100 members at most. However when the upper limit is reached, Warlords can join with some sovereigns. (100 additional position are available for each battalion) 
- Warlords can only take part in the Empire Guardian of current region at the beginning of new season, and they will be randomly distributed in one battalion. However Warlords can pay some sovereigns to choose other battalions in the Empire Guardian of current region
- Empire Guardian of other regions are available for Warlords when the season getting into “Crossing Frontier”
- Warlords who have already took part in Empire Guardian cannot quit within 7 days
- Warlords’ Acclaim gained after took part in Empire Guardian will not be wiped after quit. They can get all Acclaim back once they rejoin in the Empire Guardian.

Battle
- Empire Guardian will make declaration against Freedom Union automatically at one day before Territory War
- All members will receive the battle mission once declaration succeed. 
- Warlords have two free chance to reset the battle mission. Certain silver coins are required to get additional chances
 
Member Promotion
- Each Battalion of Empire Guardian have 1 battalion commander, 2 deputy battalion commanders, 4 military commanders, 2 elite battalion members, 10 battalion veterans and other regular members.
- Battalion commander, deputy battalion commanders and military commanders: if their battalion are designated as commanding battalion, they will have the right to force other members to evacuate from the battlefield, however they can’t exercise this power between each other.
- The promotion depends on the Acclaim Warlords have earned during one week, Warlords with higher Acclaim will get higher position.
- During S1, the position will be adjusted at 22:30 every Saturday according to Warlords’ Acclaim

notes.title: 09/01/2020 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8 am to 10 am, 9th, Jan (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after the server maintenance. Here are the patch note:

1.Important Updates: Freedom Union VS Empire Guardian 
Civilization, conflict, war, the world is never tranquil with the invasion of Khan in the North and the turmoil in the East and West, and the city of hero is in danger…Will the Empire fall into chaos? Perhaps it’s the beginning of a brand new evolution.
Throughout various regions of the open world, the imperial land were separated by Houses and Alliances. Under such circumstance, Warlords have to define their own fate. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f518de20ea19ecd9b89148e97376cf21e1cebd97.png

1) Freedom Union
-Follow the destiny? Take part in other Houses or build your own Houses? 
Crown yourself with the honor and glory while conquering the open world and creating your own destiny. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08dbcb5a6e4d1677d38dac7abbe05b6ee07574b4.png

-Warlords who have already took part in Houses and Alliances will join [Freedom Union] by default. 
-Solo Warlords can choose to join [Freedom Union], existing Houses or create new houses in N interface

2) Empire Guardian 
-Defend the Empire? Vow to guard the dignity of the Imperial Legion and find peace for the open world?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6dc175e9986dfc3b8f4f776e26fe7ab57e270b57.png

-If Solo Warlords choose to take part in [Empire Guardian] of current region in N interface, they will be distributed in one battalion randomly.  
-Warlords who took part in [Empire Guardian] cannot quit within 7 days. 

2.Optimizations to the Nobility Titles of Freedom Union

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/de4018c0d4dc59bd38f082348588339b19ccbab2.png

-optimized the distribution of Nobility Titles reward. The reward will be distributed at midnight every Monday.
-Optimized the distribution rule of Nobility Titles, now the Liege can dub or remove other members’ nobility titles at any time. Each Warlord can only receive nobility titles from Liege once within 24 hours
-The Influence of each House will be calculated at 22:30 pm at every Saturday. Nobility titles of other house members will be removed along with the change of Liege’s nobility titles. 
-New House Liege will directly get the nobility titles of old Liege
-Warlords will be notified by in-game mail when receiving nobility titles

3.Map Balance Adjustments
1)Riverlands Castle (Siege)
Based on the collected feedbacks and battlefield stats, currently the winning ratio of Attackers is much higher than we expected. Defenders are hard to conduct effective defense. Accordingly, we decided to make the following adjustments to rebalance the battlefield:

-Decreased the game duration from 13 minutes to 11 minutes
-Adjusted the location of Siege Tower by moving it backward by 10 meters
-Removed 2 Culverins and 2 Catapults of Attackers. Swapped 1 Ballista on defenders’ city wall with 1 Culverin
-Decreased the total number of siege ladders at left city wall from 10 to 9
-Adjusted the location of defenders’ left supply point by moving it backward and closer to attackers’ ground
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/99171aa963092bb108452e0b157f067b6a09cbc7.jpg

-Added another respawn point for defenders behind point A and point B. This respawn points is binding to Point B, which means it will remain active until defenders lost Points B. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/39a64df5b33a544c721b109df684d3c5346ce196.jpg

-Adjusted the location of defenders’ supply point (as pictured). It is unable to be captured until the base camp being activated. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/86a89d261b64f46e9a61c6868ab7da94f361e473.png

-Adjusted the location of supply point in defenders’ base camp by moving it inside the respawn area
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f34204fb85ef72f073298ac017934141836a6c28.png

-Adjusted the location of defenders’ base camp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9c6e020a5f8658c1202dafc780a28940d2642423.png

2)Territory War Siege Map optimizations
The inner castle structure has been adjusted to optimize the combat experience in the final area.
This adjustment covers all cities using this type of map model, including Sobek, Acheron, Vaja, Burdost.
-Rebuilt wall structure nearby final area to enable passage on top of the wall
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be406972299fed9d17005e428a2a336f20b43f7b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1cf81c3fa1368d5f62f94b3957e65943219561b9.png
-Added a gate at one of the inner castle entrances, which can be destroyed by Warlords. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ba754436dbd0747893e01b45889ad0b5fbce4e3c.png

3)Frontier Camp (Siege) 
Based on the collected feedbacks and battlefield stats, currently the winning ratio of attackers is much lower than we expected. Accordingly, we decided to make the following adjustments to create more advantages for attackers. 
-Increased the game duration from 6 minutes to 7 minutes.
-Decreased the flag-capturing time from 60 seconds to 45 seconds.

At the same time, two new 8V8 siege map are now available---The Storehouse and Lesser Greenpark Camp

4.Unit Formation Optimizations
We made the following optimizations to improve the formation display and fix some operation issues.
1)Optimized the Line formation for the following pikemen units:
Village Watchmen, Pike Militia, Prefecture Pikemen, Imperial Pike Guards, Black Dragon Pikemen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ba14aaac63a96c2b04935d155deeb845a93691be.png
2)	Optimized the Line formation for the following mounted bladesman and lancers units:
Ironcap Scout Cavalry, Prefecture Heavy Cavalry, Dagger-Axe Lancers, Coutiliers, Yeomen, Monastic Knights, Cataphract Lancers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d87ab32e1e3553338a08c5a768911b0bfec6ff35.png
3)Optimized the Wedge and Column formation for the following mounted bladesman and lancer units: 
Prefecture Heavy Cavalry, Yeomen, Fire Lance Cavalry, Rattan Rangers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b705b5cd0db5ddc86306ca6fd9ef8cb79d795ee4.png
4)Optimized the Schiltron formation for the following spearman units:
Ironcap Spearmen, Imperial Spear Guard, Spear Sergeants, Black Dragon Spearmen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/77a55006aed11aac64e8eb3ed84c7f6c1746d5cd.png
5)Optimized the Three Ranks formation for the following crossbowmen and arquebusiers units:
Repeater Crossbowmen, Demesne Arbalists, Demesne Crossbowmen, Imperial Arquebusiers, Ironcap Arquebusiers, Demesne Arquebusiers, Kriegsrat Fusiliers, Sea Stag Deathdealers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a3a1c23463b0813a1927913c268b67af8daf919b.png
6)Optimzied the Block formation for the following crossbowmen units:
Demesne Arbalists, Demesne Crossbowmen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b8ce8696d3aa69395d11ba88455e97fa0cad3bcc.png
7)Optimized the shield formation of Imperial Javelineers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5553bba6398ea1ee328717743e70d4d1090fb47b.png
8)Optimized the hawk formation of Fire Lance Cavalry
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4aef564b6328f7df7cb07880eb44e43d034897e8.png
9)Optimized the schiltron formation of Imperial Pike Guards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7fd317a984bb1d82efa0f1044d94dc30a31391b6.png

5.System Optimizations
1)Battlefield score optimizations
-Warlords will get certain contribution score when they interrupt enemies capturing the flag and supply points in field battles
-When one point under contest, Warlords inside the point trying to stop opponents capturing the flag will get certain contribution score. 
2)Optimizations to Auxiliary units and Mercenary
Auxiliary units and Mercenary have been moved to [Unit] interface (previously [War Scholar] interface) 
3)Supply point interact optimization 
The interact process of supply point has been simplified, now units, weapons and mounts are displayed when Warlords pressing F to open the equipment interface.
4)Auxiliary units display logic optimization
Now expired Auxiliary units will have sealed mark and will be placed after all other units. 
5)Optimized the logic when Warlords right clicking the Signacula to unlock sealed Auxiliary units. Now unlocking process interface will show up instead of unit leveling up interface. 
6)Moved the Bodkin Arrows of Imperial Archer to unit skill area, the function of “5” has been changed to “select weapon”
7)Adjusted the unit price of Rattan Ranger’s Kit in Weapon Smuggler’s Shop to 4,200 silver coins. 
8)Adjusted the Expedition OfficerⅠquest to earn 1 cakewalk badge in Expeditions
9)Optimized the 3D UI of Focused Fire for Arquebusier units
10)Replace the [professional Rivalry]of Prefecture Guards with [Unswerving](increase blunt defence by 6%)

6.Bug Fixes
-Fixed the bug that Auxiliary units would refresh after server maintenance
-Fixed the bug where Auxiliary unit couldn’t be deployed on the battlefield if the unit was sealed in Warlord’s unit tree.
-Fixed the bug where the block damage of shielded units did not count into the battlefield damage taken stats.
- Fixed the bug where cavalry units, equipped with Legendary Melee Cavalry Doctrine Ⅱ, may get blocked by enemies before causing some damages
-Fixed the bug where the trigger of “A Loyal Bannerman” did not work properly, gaining reputation didn’t count into progress
-Fixed the bug where the trigger of several seasonal week challenges and unit challenges did not work correctly in Deathmatches and training camp
-Fixed a bug where Warlords can complete some field and siege quests in training camp (AI) mode

7.Veterancy Point Description Optimizations
1)	Battle Technique
Before: Higher chance of inflicting extra effects.
After: Higher chance of inflicting extra effects when arrows hit enemies. (Poison them)
2)	To the Bone
Before: Each level any target poisoned has their attack reduced by 5%
After: Each level decrease damage ability of poisoned enemies by 5%.
3)	Underhandedness
Before: Target may take sustained poison damage.
After: Increase poison damage.
4)	Marvellous Medicine
Before: Target may be slowed by attacks from this unit.
After: Slow the move-speed of poisoned enemies. 
5)	Venomous Toxins of rattan vipers
Before: "Poison effects can stack up to 5 times, Changes unit appearance."
After: "Poison effects can stack up to 5 stacks. Changes unit appearance."
6)	Venomous Toxins of rattan pikemen
Before: Poison effects can now stack up to 3 times. Changes unit appearance.
After: Poison effects can stack up to 3 stacks. Changes unit appearance.

notes.title: 02/01/2020 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8 am to 10 am, 2 Jan (UTC +8). Here are the patch notes:

1.Important Updates: Map Adjustments 
1)Riverlands Castle (siege)
After reviewing Warlords’ feedbacks and checking background stats, we found that the winning ratio of attackers is higher than we expected. When the battle coming into the final area, Defenders are easy to be restrained and they have few ways to support the battlefield. At the same time, attackers are also easy to be squeezed into the two long steps heading to the inner city if they are not well organized. So we made the following adjustments: 
 
a.Decreased the number of ladders against inner city walls. Added a new set of ladders connecting the outer city wall and inner city wall

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e45176d95cbfc2217baee17876e800fddeb856b8.jpg

b.Added flaming pitchs upon the stairs aisle of the inner city 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d12c3a5da18e1f2ef16f73d508a338e0a7b3868.jpg

c.Decreased the number of plant in the final area

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/05d558d01206aae869e2404d82c33e8893440e8e.jpg

d.Widened the platform on each side of defenders’ tower in the final area

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7b5317a205f480bacecc0fd6d6941371ad1f005e.jpg

e.Adjusted the location of defenders’ final supply point, making it easier to defend and harder to attack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e8cc83e944e5f21fcf19f6ea9a23e6a1cbd0ac0b.jpg

f.Decreased the number of Trebuchets from 8 to 7

2)Border Fort (siege)
Based on your feedbacks and battlefield stats, we found that the winning ratio of attackers is a little bit higher than we expected. Especially when defenders trying to support their base camp, they are easy to be blocked out of the final area since there don’t have other effective defending routes. So we adjusted the lateral passage structure nearby the base camp by adding a new stair to provide one more path for Defenders to get to the final area.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b111d74cdcffa7f724921c50212d5544cf061fff.jpg

3)Frontier Camp (siege)
a.Adjusted the player number from 8 (Attackers) vs 7 (Defenders) to 8 vs 8
b.Added 4 Trebuchets for Attackers to deal with the above-mentioned adjustment

2.Auction House Guidance Price Adjustments
Based on the trading data, we have raised the guidance prices of the following items:
Rare Helmet Schematic
Rare Cuirass Schematic
Rare Glove Schematic
Rare Boots Schematic

Warlords can check the adjusted price in the Market.

3.Bug fixes and optimizations
1)Unit bug fixes and optimizations
a.Fixed the incorrect icon and description when Khorchins equipping Mobility doctrine
b.Fixed a bug where Khorchins couldn’t track enemies correctly when using [hunt] skill after equipping “Epic Mounted Archery Doctrine” or “Legendary Mounted Archery Doctrine”
c.Fixed the model distortion when Khorchins equipping with some unit mount attires
d.Fixed a unit challenge of Selemchid Cavalry’s unit challenge, in the filed or siege battle, the trigger of cumulative count of killing generals did not take effect properly
e.Fixed a bug where the [Focused fire] skill of Ironcap Arquebusiers and Demesne Arquebusiers couldn’t response immediately in the process of formation
f.Fixed a bug where the [Unswerving] of Cataphract Lancers did not take effect correctly
g.Fixed the incorrect effect of Imperial Archers’ [Force]
h.Fixed a bug that nodes which increase units’ defence sometimes did not take effect on the battlefield
i.Adjusted the [Improved Supplies] of Khevtuul Cavalry to [Hasten] (Each level increases rate of attack by 6%)

2)System bug fixes and optimizations
a.Fixed a bug where the trigger of Rebel Fighter series quests did not take effect properly after Warlords destroying medium rebel camps
b.Fixed some model collision issues of terrain and stairs in Riverlands Castle
c.Optimization the animation of Vanguard Archers’ [Move and Fire] 

The operation team of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier
January 2, 2020

notes.title: SEASON I PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
As previously announced, the Season II: Wrath of the Nomads update is due to be released on Thursday 23th December.

 (I) The New Season: 
Wrath of the Nomads: The Twilight of the Empire
-Through the [F5 Season] button on the main interface, you can enter the main interface of the season;
-Accumulate glory, you can level up your nobility;
-Accumulate season XP, you can upgrade the season level.
 During the season, you can get 1000 glory for each season level you increased.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1ff24e33cd726b8556277f8f89d1b17b776983e1.png

-Nobility can be level up by upgrading the season LV, participating in PVP matching battles, completing weekly challenge, using season item "Shaman’s Scroll" or "Khan’s Edict”;
-On the [Reward] tab, you can view the progression of rewards and hero journey. According to the progression your nobility, you can get various rewards include season-themed cosmetic, special title of the season, and so on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08219a3e85c124a16c1c06530b6b220dbf40b56d.png

-Hero journey rewards are automatically unlocked as soon as Wrath of the Nomads is online. 
- The upper reward progression can be unlocked by purchase item “Holy Mountain’s Guidance” or “Holy’ Mountain’s Will”

II, New season store:
-In the [F5 Season] interface, you can view the information through the [Season Store] tab;
-In the season store, you can exchange cool stuffs by spend Fangs, the unique tokens of this season. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/61f80fa80a0f7e1c321b7632c0e4de1984248717.png

III. Weekly Challenge Tasks in the New Season
Based on the feedback from warlords in the previous season, we have optimized the challenge types of weekly challenges, enriched more challenge types, including social networking, battlefield performance, participation in open-world games, and participation in daily activities. 
At the same time, try to make the task as engaged as possible, so that can more easily complete challenges and gain glory in the common game process

-S1 season offers a total of 10 weeks of challenges with 8 tasks per week.
-Provide 2 refresh charges per week, you can change the tasks you don't like
-Each challenge task provides a wealth of glory rewards, different difficulties, different rewards amount.
-When completing the challenge of the week, you can get additional rewards according to the progress of the progression this week.

IV. Units Challenge
1. Unlock season unit
Different from the previous units tree, the season units requires players to complete a series of challenge tasks. Once you complete all stage of a specific unit challenge, that unit is yours forever.
Players can open the season [F5] interface and select the [Unit Challenge] tab to view the season Units challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6567497311be7785c9129df2189c4822cdd4c5c.png

2. Rules of season units challenge:
Units challenge opening timeline:
-Tier 3 Units: as soon as S1 season is online
- Tier 4 Units: 7 days after S1 season online
- Tier 5 Units: 21 days after S1 season online

3. Preconditions of different units challenge tier:
-Tier 3 Units: No preconditions, challenges are turned on by default
-Tier 4 Units: After completing the challenges of any 2 of T3 units, start this challenge
-Tier 5 Units: After completing any challenge of any T4 units, start the challenge

The T3 units Challenge has 2 stages, the T4 units challenge has 4 stages, and the T5 units Challenge has 9 stages.  
After completing all the stages in a single Units Challenge, players can unlock this season unit permanently

There are 8 challenge tasks in each stage.  If you complete any 6 challenge tasks, the challenge in this stage is completed.
In each stage, whenever a task is completed, you will get certain reward, including Fangs, units flags, units cosmetic, units kits and so on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bfdd097662a16586ed99113040d81beed8611a48.png

4. The Units challenges Quick Done
After we the units challenge system for a period of time, the function of Quick Done will be released.
You can quick-complete the units challenge task with sovereigns by using Quick Done function.

Opening time-line:
-2 days after the Tier 3 Season units challenge opens
-3 days after the Tier 4 Season units challenge opens. 
-5 days after the Tier 5 Season units challenge opens.- 

V. Season Seal
In order to let players have the same starting point at the beginning of the season, and relive the fun of the battle, we have added a season seal system (exception: Free Battles Mode): 
The units in [Heroic] and [Golden] era are sealed
The attributes and sets effect of hero equipment are sealed.
All data of sealed units and hero equipment stay unchanged during the sealed time period.
The timeline below show when those sealed will be removed:

2 weeks after season launch, unseal all [Heroic era] units and all attributes on hero equipment
4 weeks after season launch, unseal all [Golden era] units and all sets effect on hero equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4291551e026d35688d0477f1b4e65b3891ba7a03.png

VI. Open-World new content

NEW TERRITORY WAR CONTENT
CONQUEROR’S CITY
Conqueror’s City is located on a mountain in the middle of The Borderlands, waiting for real heroes to come and conquer.

It is composed of the inner city and four major gates.

Once the Conqueror’s City opens, when attacking, Houses must occupy any one of the gates first before they can attack the inner city.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/17f51230d8993ae31a64a2d4b08b19269dca87fd.png

CAMPAIGNS:
Take part in new Territory War content by completing objectives for each Stage of the Campaign. You will be rewarded when completing specific tasks for your House.

Stage 1: The Baron’s War:

Conquer the fiefs in your region for the glory of your House.

Stage 2: Crossing Frontiers

Conquer a Border post to open the road into the Borderlands.

Stage 3: Heart of the World

Invade the Borderlands and conquer a fief for the glory of your House.

Stage 4: Conqueror’s Crown

To become world-conqueror, you must overcome the ultimate challenge and take over Conqueror’s City.

Stage 5: Imperial Dawn

Please note, if a Stage in the Campaign has ended, you cannot go back to that Stage to complete tasks and earn rewards. Stages duration is based on Season-Opening times.

LEGION ALLIANCE - NPC HOUSES:
Solo Warlords rejoice, you will now be able to take part in Territory War content by joining up with 1 of the 4 allied NPC Houses in our new Legion Alliance system. 

This feature will be available shortly after Season II’s launch. We will have a more indepth guide explaining this feature in the near future.

NOBILITY TITLE SYSTEM:
Receive new player titles when you fight and capture fiefs on behalf of your House: your titles will even earn you weekly rewards!
Rule of gaining nobility titles
-When your House captures fiefs in any of the four regions, it earns a corresponding amount of Influence. According to your influence，members of the house can dub different nobility title
-When your House captures fiefs in any of the four regions, it earns a corresponding amount of Influence.
Conquering fiefs of the same type in the Borderlands can earn you double the amount of Influence.
The higher the level of the fief, the greater its Influence.
The influence gain will resolved as soon as a territory war period end.
-After resolve，the nobility title of House Liege, at the same time，more nobility title for all house member.
-Influence will be calculated every Saturday evening at 22:30, at which time rewards will be given out the following Monday before 21:59
-Your house will earn influence for occupying fiefs during territory wars. 
-Fiefs in the borderlands provide double influence.  
-The higher Lv that fief has, the more influence it will provide.
-If house lose fiefs, that house will lose influence at the same time, that may cause decrease of the nobility title from both quantity and quality.
-Who ever occupy the city of heroes , center of borderlands, that house will get the royal title of "Hegemon".
-All nobility title will be reset once the season is over.

Quality of Nobility Title
Hegemon
Monarch（not open yet）
Regent
Royal Councillor
Lord Chamberlain
Chancellor
High Almoner
Captain of Guards
Grand Admiral
Protomystikos
Elector
Justiciar
Lord Lieutenant
High Sheriff
Burgess
Herald
Castellan
Councillor
Mayor
Reeve

Dubbing Nobility Title
All member of the house can press [N] to open [House] interface. Choose [Title] tab to view the details of nobility title information for your house.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f535d3377b186f0e89979b0f43286507db55ade6.png

Nobility title weekly reward
Liege of the house can dub nobility title until the resolve on each Saturday night 22:30. As soon as nobility title is dubbed, the new knight will get nobility reward directly. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a4956e16d92b8aa87f51d25a73c3a787a8ba8372.png

VIII. Major adjustments in the open-world
The Borderlands adjustment
Nysa: Nysa has been transformed into a village and, in turn, nearby resources have been painstakingly cultivated by the villagers, so that the road to the west of the plateau is now free of passes
Karlsbach: the defenders of the city of heroes have converted Karlsbach on the eastern side of the great rift valley into a pass and built a corresponding wall
Sobek: Sobek has been transformed into a city and the surrounding walls have been torn down. Travel from Chenau will now be unimpeded
Acheron: Acheron has been transformed into a city where people who pass through the desert to the chaos will be able to go straight north to the heritage plain

 Jastor and Tulapan: during the fierce war, Jastor and Tulapan were completely destroyed, leaving only the ruins left by the war. Fortunately, the archaeology team immediately set out and kept many precious records in the midst of the war. In the near future, the archaeology team will reproduce these destroyed cities in the form of historical records

Unaaagverija adjustment
Bourdourst and tigner: the people of Unaaagverija converted Ratot Var and Vaja into cities and removed the surrounding walls.

The rubble north of Keleti Csarda has now been cleared .

IX. TERRITORY WAR ADJUSTMENTS
1.BATTLE LINES:
The number of battle lines for Cities has been adjusted from 2 to 1.
The number of battle lines for Forts has been adjusted from 3 to 1.
2. WAR RULES:
After Territory War, you no longer need to declare war to enter the battle, but you still need to be in a House to open the battlefield.

XI. Level Balancing 
1.Level adjustment
We improve the play experience and level arranging of the intro-part of the game, for players who are new to Conqueror’s Blade, now you should have more fun in the early part.
a.Weapon Training
-We added the mounting training part into this training quest.
b.Units Control Training：
-We changed the units that you are using in this level, now you will use Iconcap Swordsmen and Demense Spearmen to train.
c.Unit Train Squad (Main city)：
-we added range attack training with Ironcap Archers，and anti-cavalry training with Pike Militia

2、Battlefield improvement：Battering Ram Mechanic Improvement
-Whenever the battering ram reach the gate position, the switcher of the gate cannot be interact until the battering ram is destroyed. 
-Whenever the battering ram reach the gate position, if the gate is open, the gate is destroyed immediately, after that, the battering ram fall back and destroy itself. 

3、Level BUG Fix
-Fix the problem of ladders in Riverlands Castle
–Fix the problem of some pre-deployed artilleries in the level didn’t have bullets limit.

VIII novice guidance adjustment

In order to allow new generals to experience the charm of the battlefield more quickly, we made a major adjustment to the novice guidance:
- greatly streamlined novice quest, now faster to experience the fun of the battlefield.
- optimized experience and related guidance for novice levels.
- after the player completes the weapon teaching level, we will automatically equip the player with the corresponding armor according to the weapon selected by the player.
- greatly increased initial Leadership. Player level 1 now has 400 Leadership and level 30 now has 700 Leadership (originally level 60).
- several units can be obtained upon completion of the novice phase: Ironcap Swordsmen, Demesne Spearmen ,Elite Pike Militia, Ironcap Archers (replacing - the original Denesne Pikemen, Levy Bowman).
- added battlefield guidance during the first game of training camp(AI), Field Battle and Siege Battle.
- due to the adjustment of quest lines, we will reset all quest lines for players below level 15.

XII. System improvement 
-The elevation and depression angle of the open world character camera has been enlarged, and you can see more scene content by operating the camera;
-Add a weekly 20 times challenge limitation of the Rebel Camps.

notes.title: 05/12/2019 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
Dear Warlords, we figured a serious problem currently in live causing abnormal attack speed of range unit and it hurts the fairness of game significantly. We decided to conduct a server maintenance urgently which will be starting at 24:00 pm tonight and lasting to 8:00 am tomorrow. After the maintenance, we will send the compensation by mail with 10000 bronze and 600 honors. 

1、Important feature： Doctrines Bag
We knew that too many doctrines in your inventory would inevitably occupy your rooms and become a pain in the ass. So we make this new Doctrines Bag system to free your inventory.
All doctrines will be stored in the Doctrines Bag, instead of your inventory or personal storage.

All doctrines that you currently have, will be moved into your Doctrines Bag, you can view all unequipped doctrine inside of this interface.

When you enter the game and open your inventory, all of your unequipped doctrines will be moved into your doctrines bag.

From now on, doctrines can not be salvaged at Smith, you can only salvage doctrines at [Salvaging] window from [War Scholar] Interface

Added two tag to The [Salvaging] interface, to show unequipped doctrines and signacula separately.  

2、Unit Balance Adjustment:
Viper Bowmen
With the analysis of data from last improvement of Viper Bowmen, we have to admit they are performing well as our design purpose. Low Piercing Armour Penetration and low attack speed restrict its performence，so we made these improvement：
Viper Bowmen : Attack Speed improved 15%
Viper Bowmen: Piercing Armour Penetration improved 20%

Repeater Crossbowmen
Repeater Crossbowmen are not performing well without veterancy bonuses，so we made this improvement:
Repeater Crossbowmen can shoot poison arrows at 25% without veterancy bonuse. 

Vassal Longbowmen
Though they have long attack range, but poor firing accuracy limit their performance, so we made this improvement:
Vassal Longbowmen : Firing Accuracy improved 20%

Fire Lance Cavalry
Their melee attack are superior, we also want to see their range attack ability shine, so we made this improvement:
Fire Lance Cavalry will shoot bullets during their normal melee attack, with 20s colddown

Javelin Sergeants
No longer ungroup after throw javelins.

Tercio Arquebusiers
Improve their AI, no longer tend to melee attack enemies with their graceful sword even though enemies are still quite far from them.

3、System Improvement
Improve the Unit Traits display of Imperial Pike Guards，now only show one [Relentless] trait instead of two separate traits. (The actual mechanic and value unchanged ) 
Deploy map UI improvement, now can view all artilleries easily. 
Dasuo Fort adjustment: Cleanup the props around B Flag.  
New High Level Military Rank display：After Lv.2360, Military Rank display will change once for each 100 Level.
