notes.title: 28/11/2019 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, Nov 28th (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note.

1.Map Adjustments
1)Dasuo Fort
After reviewing your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that Dasuo Fort was still imbalanced with relatively low win ratio of attackers. It was hard for them to capture Point B and C after taking control of Point A. We’re guessing that it is caused by the following reasons:

a)Complex internal layout of Dasuo Fort
b)After attackers capturing Point A, there was only one route for them to get to the nearest supply point. They will suffer a huge loss attacking this supply point even with the help of several ranged units.
c)It was hard for them to continuously attack Point B and C without taking over the supply point. 

So we made the following adjustments:
Added a stairs at the starting point of city wall, making it easier for Warlords to get to the supply point. Warlords who capture the city wall in advance may have a better chance to take over the supply point then quickly support the battles between Point A and Point B. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa8a07ca8a9079f6298ca4155c235cec03be651c.png

2)Allenburg 
After reviewing your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that there were two main issues when attackers trying to capture Point B:
a)Stairs were too narrow for attacking
b)Attackers have few attacking routes when attacking Point B

We made the following adjustments accordingly:
a)Widened the stairs from city wall to Point B
b)Added a new attacking route connecting the city wall. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d22c8bb8bea616df3f262fc99338d5b65fba0ae8.png

c)Added a stair and a set of ladders on the northeastern side of internal castle’s city wall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6fff51a1a8240e578d93e4b8115921f70f511f1c.png

d)Widened the stairs from city wall to Point A

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f13c287fe1e37cf3404335e7e8f3324c4620014b.png

2.Unit Balance Adjustment: Imperial Pike Guards
Imperial Pike Guards were underperforming on the battlefield due to the fact that they couldn’t effectively restrain high-tier cavalry units with relatively low damage. So we made the following adjustments:

1)The advancing of Imperial Pike Guards have damage bonus. They will cause more damage when advancing into relatively low move speed units. Greater speed difference will bring higher damage. 
2)The advancing of Imperial Pike Guards now have extra damage to charging units. 
3)Health growth for each level was increased by 42 points.

3.Artillery Balance Adjustments
Currently, large artillery (Trebuchet, Battering ram and Siege tower) would receive too high damage from Culverin (higher than eastern Cannon), resulting in attackers couldn’t take advantage of these large artillery in some western maps. So we made the following adjustments:

Decreased the Culverin’s damage dealt to large artillery (Trebuchet, Battering ram and Siege tower), city gate and city wall, similar to the damage of Cannon with same-quality. 
(The damage dealt to heroes, units and small artillery will remain unchanged.)

Besides that, added a notification when the artillery being pushing forward. If Warlords click on an artillery that has already been used, there will be a notification icon showing that it is unavailable now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5874650340feda9f5decc596a44d5e47c84a2517.png

4.Important Updates: Auction House Activity (For one week only)
1)Black Friday Promotion
All Hero Attires are discounted by 25%
All Weapon Attires are discounted by 25%
All Mount Attires are discounted by 25%
All Unit Attires are discounted by 25%
All Unit Flags are discounted by 25%

2)New Attires:
New Hero Attire: Varangian 
Discounted price: 1780 sovereigns, 10% off its usual price of 1980 sovereigns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/53b8c40367d4c2c5611c9fe6363babf9f7578157.jpg

New Mount Attire: Windblown 
Discounted price: 1780 sovereigns, 10% off its usual price of 1980 sovereigns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/46288b11f2989d003812f154e477cffbb242ed1d.jpg

New Unit Attire: Northern Wilderness 
Discounted price: 270 sovereigns, 10% off its usual price of 300 sovereigns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9acdc50b7cceb2130f30d95ea23340e019673d04.jpg

5.Newly-added Season Career Interface
Now Warlords can check your territory war stats during Season Eve by pressing P and find “Season Career” in Career interface. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/639197b4d7f3d14fd0cb8f835fe51298079c3f09.png

6.Bug Fixes
1)Unit Bug Fixes
a)Fixed the incorrect charge animation of Cataphract Lancers and Dagger-Axe Lancers
b)Fixed a bug that in some circumstances, the visual effect of cavalry charge didn’t play correctly.
2)Miscellaneous Fixes
a)Fixed a bug where the weather icon didn’t display correctly in deployment interface
b)Fixed a bug where Spear heroes couldn’t use Q to dismount when using “Full Tilt Charge”
c)Fixed a bug where weekly quest retrieval could retrieve wrong weekly quest reward chest.
d)Fixed the abnormal Season Eve Homepage in Traditional Chinese version due to the lack of localization. 

7.System Optimizations
1)Unit Optimizations
a)Optimized the scatter formation for all cavalry units.
b)Optimized the visual effect of cavalry charge, making it more obvious in bright scene.
c)Slightly increased the height of Iron Reapers, making it more in line with the historical prototype.
d)Optimized the dispersed formation of Iron Reapers with more regular layout. 

2)System Optimizations
a)Optimized the UI when units forming up, making it more obvious in grassland.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b68240d9290e10800d44c5e9ab83c046419239c3.png

b)When Warlords expanding the stable, Horse Trough could be purchased with just one click and then take effect automatically.

notes.title: 21/11/2019 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 4 am to 8 am, 21 Nov (UTC +8). 

The maintenance with long duration was conducted because the server of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier was migrated from Singapore to Hongkong. We have been preparing for this server migration during past few weeks and already had few rounds of tests. The average ping in Seoul and Busan has been decreased from 110ms to 67ms. Similar optimizations also can be found in other regions. 

We have been cooperating with Huawei Cloud during this server migration. New high quality internet has been added in our SEA server, which means that the game will remain fluent and stable even for cross-server matchmaking. 

Here are the patch notes:

1.Important Updates: Honour Redemption System
Warlords now can use Honour Redemption Token to seal one node and get relevant Honour back.

1)How to buy

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/26e14b7c657633052af9e8676c509789163f7873.png

Honour Redemption Token is now available in Auction House. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9eeb3e2519211e24f0e831f9006aed79e224e562.png

After launching this new system, we will offer a 40% discount on Hounor Redemption Token at first. Each Warlord can buy 10 Hounor Redemption Pack at most. Each one of them contain 100 Hounor Redemption tokens. Cost 300 sovereigns for each chest.  
This item can be found in Auction House.

2)How to use

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/00801ced4707eff6921cba35ab38c973d6dacafc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e7d16fa2c00a1e731826f7258d319d10bbf5d17d.png

Any one of nodes can be sealed. (Except nodes in Rustic Era) The consumption of Honour Redemption Token depends on the Honour required to unlock that node. Cost One Honour Redemption Token for every 100 Honour. (Cost One Honour Redemption Token for a node that have been unlocked less than 100 Hounor)

After one node been sealed:
-The buff effect will be inoperative
-The unit couldn’t be deployed on the battlefield however existing level and doctrines will remain unchanged.

Warlords can unseal the node with same amount of Hounor.

Please noted:
-Some Era may be no longer available if Warlords couldn’t reach the era unlock requirement after too many units were sealed.

-If Warlords get ready to seal one node, the following nodes will also be sealed at the same time. The consumption of Honour Redemption Token depends on the total Hounor of these nodes. 

We also made some adjustments to the era unlock requirement at the same time;
-Chivalric Era: unlock 4 units between one star to three and half stars
-Silver Era: unlock 4 units between two stars to three and half stars
-Heroic Era: unlock 4 three stars or three and half star units
-Golden Era: unlock 4 four stars or four and half star units

2.Important Updates: Camp system and open world Matchmaking

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/36363f32a0d275e51b7bfac101612a214be12a75.png

Now Warlords can press J or the camp icon below to camp in open world. After camp completed, Warlords can have matched battles in open world same as the normal matchmaking in a fort. Warlords who have already camped in open world can still team up and join in battles with other Warlords staying in a fort.

Please noted:
1)After camping, Warlords can’t move, pursue or be pursued by other Warlords. Other actions in open world would also be limited at the same time. 
2)The camp status can be cancelled by clicking “leave the camp”, however can’t be cancelled after battle countdown begins.
3)Warlords can’t camp during territory war and all camp will be cancelled by the system automatically. 

3.Unit Balance Adjustments: Rattan Units
Rattan units was known as their poison weapons. However it was underperforming on the battlefield especially in high-level battles. We decided to make the following adjustments to enhance it:
-Rattan Pikemen, Viper Bowmen and Mounted Crossbow Cavalry: The damage of weapon poison now can stack 5 times (previously 3 times)
-Decreased enemy’s damage by 15% (previously 5%)
-Slowing enemy by 20% (previously 15%)

Considering Viper Bowmen was underperforming on the battlefield due to low shooting accuracy, we decided to make the following adjustments to enhance it:
-Increased the shooting accuracy by 30%
-[Battle Technique]: increased the chance of shooting poison arrows by 50% (previously 30%)
-[Underhandedness]: increased the chance of shooting poison arrows by 80% (previously 60%)

4.Map Adjustments
1)Dasuo Fort
-Adjusted the supply point location between Point A and Point B

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fe3204101babdac7cecf526f8f247e859b6a1877.png

-Adjusted the supply point location on the left side of final flag

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2a66bb48b3c3602ae90f34af1a383f51c099b573.png

-A new supply point in the final area is available for Defenders after Attackers conquering the external supply point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bac597335eeca80f645ed2b9f1db93ed7166c41b.png

2)Kurak Castle Fort
Adjusted the artillery setting on the left side of Point A by switching the Culverin and Ballista. Ballista behind the left city wall was swapped with Culverin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b13edf4e7fe2d01c071c8dec8b3e8ec033fcc0d1.png

3)Other maps
-Fixed the object collision in Desert City Defence PVE level which leads to abnormal behaviors of enemy soldiers
-Adjusted the Defenders’ respawn area in Border Fort, making it quicker for defenders to get to the city wall. Fixed the incorrect location of respawn area in deployment interface. 
-Fixed the physical hit box in the right city wall in Allenburg.
-Fixed a bug where Warlords got stuck after falling into the wooden fence between Point B and Point C in Dasuo Fort. 

5.Bug fixes and optimization
1)Unit Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug that the second stage of Ironcap Swordsmen [Endurance Training] did not take effect correctly.
-Fixed the model issue of Winged Hussar where sometimes soldiers and their mount behave like separating from each other. 
-Fixed a bug sometimes Winged Hussars’ charge couldn’t hit enemies.
-Fixed a bug where Prefecture Archers could shoot flaming arrows in the rain
-Fixed a bug sometimes Men-at-Arms couldn’t attack enemies while protecting Warlords. 
-Fixed a bug where Serfs couldn’t charge during Schiltron formation.

2)Miscellaneous Fixes
-Fixed the incomplete display of allies’ units of in TAB interface during battles. 
-Fixed a bug that sometimes daily quest retrieval could retrieve wrong quests.
-Fixed a bug that sometimes weekly quest retrieval could retrieve quests from other week.

6.System Optimization 
1)Unit Optimization
Optimized the formation of Men-at-Arms, making it can block enemies while protecting Warlords.
2)Other Optimizations
-Now Warlords can get 3 Requisition Order at most from one Secret Vault (previously 5).
-The crafting tax consumption will be displayed when reforging equipments. 
-When Warlords resupplying the unit kit, relevant items will be directly showed in market interface with just one click.

notes.title: 7/11/2019 Patch Note
notes.content:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, Nov 7th (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note.

1.New Epic Mission---“Until the Blood Cold”(PVE)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b0bacaac01f69459bc352db4ff8bc075a26fd742.png
Enemy Commander conducted a surprise ambush. The city was at risk due to insufficient troops. Please help Commander Wu to defend the city till the end in the final stage of the Prefecture Guards epic mission.

During each battle, Warlords can kill enemies to earn Warhonor and exchange for advanced artillery in Warhonor Sergent (Advanced artillery will expire after each battle). In addition, incomplete notes from the first king and other rewards are also available.

Added exclusive badges for this level:
Twice Repay：Kill 2 enemy bosses in Until the Blood Cold
Fire on Command：Use artillery to kill 40 enemy soldiers in Until the Blood Cold

Available: 12:00-24:00 Nov 7th---Nov 13rd

2.Weekly Quest Rewards Adjustments
Some Warlords said the random drop rate of Treatises in Fine Campaign Reward had huge damage to their game experience. Now Warlords can get Treatises from the following weekly chests with a specific drop rate (Treatises are no longer available in fine campaign reward). Our adjustments are as follows: 
Page’s Gift: 100% 1 Treatise
Squire’s Gift: 100% 2 Treatises
Knight’s Gift: 100% 2 Treatises
Marshal’s Gift: 100% 2 Treatises

Warlords who have already got some rewards from above-mentioned chests before this update will receive Treatise compensations by mail within one week.

In addition, we also reduced the retrieval price for On Campaign quests:
On Campaign Ⅰ: 40 sovereigns (previously 50)
On Campaign Ⅱ: 80 sovereigns (previously 100)
On Campaign Ⅲ: 80 sovereigns (previously 100)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
3.Seasonal Challenges Optimizations
After checking your feedbacks, we decided to reduce the difficulty of some Seasonal challenges. Our adjustments are as follows:
1）Removed the difficulties requirement of Expedition Ⅰ,Ⅱ,Ⅲ
2）In Field Battle mode, defeat 50 shield-wielding enemy soldiers (previously eastern spearmen)

Warlords who have already completed “defeat 50 eastern spearmen” and some challenges in Expedition Ⅱ,Ⅲ before this update will receive extra seasonal XP rewards by mail within one week.

4.Purchase Limit of “Letter of the First King”
In order to make it easier for Warlords to get more rewards and higher Nobility in the last week of Season Eve. We decided to remove the Purchase Limit of “Letter of the First King”.

5.Personal Storage Modification Supply
Now Warlords can use 200,000 silver coins to buy “Personal Storage Modification Supply” from Smuggler

6.Newbie Tutorial Optimizations
1)Optimized the tutorial after Warlords entering main city. Simplified some side quests. Newbies can upgrade more quickly than before. 
2)Optimized the [Valen’s Last Stand] level: reduced the difficulty by adding few trebuchets to help Warlords win this battle.
3)Optimized the [The Battle On the Plain] level: Enemy eastern spearmen units have been adjusted to pikemen units. 
4)Optimized the [Battle at the Storehouse] level: Added some tips for artillery and Powder Keg. Added a warning alarm when Trebuchet is approaching. Warlords can also skip this level.

7.Level Balance Adjustments: White Elk
By October 30, White Elk has experienced 2,963 siege battles. The win ratio of attackers is 44.21%. Among that, the win ratio of attackers over level 100 is 46.22%, lower than we expected. After checking your feedbacks and having internal tests, we made the following adjustments:
For attackers:
1)Move middle two Trebuchets to the left. Attackers now can use Trebuchet to attack from both sides without being blocked by high buildings in the middle of battlefield. 
2)Move point A closer to the intersection. 
For defenders:
1)Move the base flag closer to the intersection.
2)Move one supply point inside the building instead of being totally exposed to enemy’s ranged attacks.
3)Add a new supply point in defenders’ respawn area. Defenders still have chance to choose new units even if they got surrounded in the base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3a3a47cdd6494d0ee1dc3c022048494c8fcc1dd3.png

8.Level Optimizations
1)Optimized the setting of some Hwacha Arrow Launcher in the city wall of Wall Fort so they couldn’t be blocked by buildings.
2)In PVE level, optimized the style and color of health bar and icon on top of AI allies, making it easier for Warlords to distinguish between allied Warlords and AI allies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/529f1e91d6a2dc5e901e868b6d79ca2474a9d899.png

9.Bug Fixes
1)Unit Bugs
a.Fixed a bug that the damage buff of some veterancy points did not take effect correctly in field and siege battles.
b.Fixed a bug that Mounted Crossbow Cavalry couldn’t charge in column formation
c.Fixed the incorrect attack speed of Ironcap Bowriders while Warlords spamming follow(c) orders. 
d.Unified the model of Demesne Archer in Unit Tree interface and battlefield. 

2)Miscellaneous Bugs
a.Fixed the overlapping interface when Warlords open season homepage while collecting resources. 
b.Fixed the incorrect horn sound effect while city wall being broken.
c.Fixed a bug that sometimes Warlords got stuck near the city wall in Hovd.

notes.title: 31/10/2019 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 31th, Oct (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note:

1.Season Eve important updates
1)Season Eve Extension
In order to let Warlords have more time to complete seasonal challenges and get more seasonal rewards, we decided to extend Season Eve for two more weeks. Season Eve will officially end at Oct 18.

2)New weekly challenges
We added some new weekly challenges including exploration in the open world and equipment crafting for week 6 and week 7.

3)Weekly challenges refresh
Now Warlords can choose one weekly challenge and click “refresh” to get a random new challenge, however the relevant rewards remain unchanged. Warlords only have two chances per week. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/22cd2ed510c223cd78ae9582d0874d769a819c50.png

4)Nobility Cap
The “Letter of the First King” will no longer be available for Warlords with Nobility over level 200. We will release an announcement soon to make compensations for those Warlords already bought this item after level 200. 

5)Territory War Point 
Now Warlords can check their Territory War points in the homepage of Season Eve. Join Territory War to earn more points for better rewards in Seasonal Settlement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/582306d4f1a79bc13c798a0404a0df29fae10c1a.png

6)Description optimization for seasonal items
Adjusted the description for Conquest Token, the letter of the First King and the incomplete notes from the First King. These items are only effective in Season Eve.

2.“Disguise Kit” and “Gender Change” item
Now Warlords can use Sovereigns to buy Disguise Kit and Gender Change item in the store. Warlords can use Disguise Kit to remake Character’s appearance. Use Gender Change to change the gender and remake the appearance. 
1)Disguise Kit: 300 sovereigns
2)Gender Change: 900 sovereigns

3.Important Fixes
We had received many feedbacks that after cavalry bracing or charging, the damage would continue to be taken by other units walking through that area. We already fixed this bug in this update.

4.Weekly Challenges Adjustment
After checking your feedbacks, we decided to adjust the difficulty of some weekly challenges.
In Expedition Ⅰ, inflict a total of 1,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In Expedition Ⅱ, inflict a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In Expedition Ⅲ, inflict a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In field battles, inflict a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In siege battles, inflict a total of 5,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In field battles, absorb a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In siege battles, absorb a total of 5,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)

Warlords who have already completed these challenges before this update will receive extra seasonal XP rewards by mail within one week.

5.“White Elk (Battle Drill)” Siege Free Battle Adjustment
After checking your suggestions, we decided to put siege free battle into the weekly free battle mode.
---“White Elk (Battle Drill)” Siege Free Battle will be available at 20:00-21:30 every Monday and Friday
---Random field free battle will be available at 20:00-21:30 every Thursday

6.Territory War Rules
Many Warlords said that some players are taking advantage of our adjustments in Oct 17 updates to conduct passive battles, maliciously kick other players out the battlefield and block the battle lines. So we made the following adjustments accordingly:
1)Warlords who have only engaged in the battlefield for 1 minute or less cannot be kicked. (previously 2 minutes)
2)Warlords who have engaged in the battle and ranking in the top one-third cannot be kicked. (previously two-thirds)

7.Hero Balance Adjustments
1)Shortsword & shield 
We made the following optimizations for Thunderstruck:
a)Warlords can press T again to jump and smash to the ground during running
b)Warlords can move the camera to adjust the direction before jump
c)Added a defence buff and slightly decreased the move speed at the moment of using this skill
d)Increased the move distance of Thunderstruck

2)Longsword & shield
After previous adjustments, we found that the second hit of Shield Bash was unable to attack enemies accurately. 
---Removed the “Repelled” effect for the first hit of Shield Bash.

3)Bow
We have checked your feedbacks on our previous adjustments to damage loss, mainly about the issue that Lightning Bolt couldn’t kill enemy heroes surrounded and protected by many soldiers. So we made the following adjustments:
a)Lightning Bolt Ⅰ: can shoot through 5 enemies, damage will be reduced by 20% per enemy.
b)Lightning Bolt Ⅱ: can shoot through 5 enemies, damage will be reduced by 15% per enemy.
c)Lightning Bolt Ⅲ: can shoot through 5 enemies, damage will be reduced by 10% per enemy.

4)Musket
With long duration of slowing enemies and wide attack range, the Deploy Caltrops could easily restrain the charge of cavalry and some infantries. Our adjustments are as follows:
a)Decreased the attacking radius from 3.5m to 3m for level Ⅰand level Ⅱ, from 4m to 3.5m for level Ⅲ
b)Deploy Caltrops Ⅰ: decreased skill duration from 8s to 5s
c)Deploy Caltrops Ⅱ: decreased skill duration from 8s to 6s, increased the bleeding damage from 100 points/s to 130 points/s
a)Deploy Caltrops Ⅲ: decreased skill duration from 8s to 7s, increased the bleeding damage from 100 points/s to 140 points/s

8.Unit Balance Adjustments
1)Mounted Crossbow Cavalry
a)Increased basic health by 10%
b)Veterancy point “Preparation”: “increases crossbow arrows fired each round by 1” was adjusted to “reduces the ranged damage taken by 20%”
c)Adjusted the F1 formation to “dispersed” formation, added a new “column” formation (F3) 

2)Tercio Arquebusiers
After checking your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that the performance of Tercio Arquebusiers didn’t meet our expectation. We made the following optimizations to unstable reloading time and aiming time.
a)Optimized the weapon structure, greatly increased the reloading speed and aiming speed
b)Fixed the bug that sometimes Tercio Arquebusiers could repeatedly switch between ranged and melee weapons.

3)Prefecture Pikemen
Some Warlords said that the current performance of Prefecture Pikemen didn’t in line with our design.
---Increased the charge distance by 10m
---The extra piercing armour penetration for charge will be increased by 15%

4)Ironcap Spearmen
---Decreased the leadership from 190 to 175, increased the unit size from 32 to 36

5)Palace Guards
The defence ability of Palace Guards was lower than we expected, resulting in a poor performance on the battlefield. So we made the following adjustments to enhance its defence ability.
a)Veterancy point “Stand Fast”: “increases blocks by 40” was adjusted to “ reduces damage taken by 5%”
b)Veterancy point “Rearguard”: “reduces damage taken from rear attacks by 5%” was adjusted to “reduces damage taken from rear attacks by 15%”
c)Added a new trait “Staunch Defenders”: reduces damage taken from pikemen, shortsword & shield infantry, archers and crossbow infantry by 12%.

notes.title: Dev blog: The Design of Honour Reset and Doctrine Removal
notes.content:
Dear Warlords:

Today we will share some thoughts about Honour reset and doctrine removal. We have been discussing about these two main concerned issues during this month. To be honest, we had many in-depth and intense discussions with different opinions. Our preliminary conclusion are as follows:

Honour Reset:
Using Honour to unlock units is the basic gameplay in our game. We fully understand that Warlords may get annoyed when unlocking a wrong node in Unit tree. However, we should be more careful about the honour reset system since the whole game ecology may be effected if this system was abused by some Warlords. Our current design are as follows:

1.We are thinking of offering limited number of Honour reset items

2.Only available for Heroic Era and Golden Era

3.After honour reset, the relevant technology and unit unlock node will be sealed. Accordingly,
1)The buff effect will be inoperative
2)The unit couldn’t be deployed in the battlefield however existing level and doctrines will remain unchanged.
3)Heroic Era and Golden Era may be no longer available if Warlords couldn’t reach the era unlock requirement after too many units were sealed.

Doctrine Removal
The doctrine system was initially designed to be non-removable. However we had received many feedbacks on removing doctrines, our current plan are as follows:
1.We are thinking of offering limited number of Doctrine Removal items

2.All doctrines could be removed for three times. The doctrine would be unchangeable after third removal.

3.The consumption of removal items is depended on the quality of doctrine which means Warlords need more items to remove higher-quality doctrines

We should admit that these two adjustments have profound impacts on the whole game system. We are considering to try these adjustments in some activities then maybe put them in the season system if they wouldn’t damage the game ecology.

This plan is just an initial design concept. Please feel free to share your suggestions.

notes.title: Patrol records of Augolia
notes.content:
Augolia Night patrol was organized by a group of soldiers interested in paranormal incidents. They shared the same passion for all the mysterious and unknown things.

Halloween was the best time of the year for those soldiers to explore the mystery and enrich their patrol records.

New Halloween attires will be available at 11am Oct 28 (UTC+8).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/af8745bb82b3e577bf6575cd68af1b521aeed901.jpg

No. 073
Name: Plague Master
Type: case
Status: pending
Time: Holloween, 173

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d4dce3481e831a4f7e242061db49efba65bb5811.jpg

Description: 
Augolia was nearly a ghost city in 173, no one dared to sneak out at night since the Plague has passed through the whole city. Night patrol Gult found this bird-face freak wandering the street.

Gult followed him all the way to the gutter in the east of the city. Suddenly this freak disappeared into the darkness. A few moments later, Gult finally found some traces right next to gangsters' house. However Gult got caught then woke up the next day. The last thing he remember was a horrible bird-face mask and horrible green light. 

One civilian occasionally saw that freak through the window and painted a portrait of his mount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7251f9cee394236fd1636c695585cbfdffb18d46.jpg

Notes: 
1.We sent a large number of soldiers to track this freak, end up with nothing.
2.All the Plague patients living in the gutter were cured and whole gangsters died of severe Plague. We had to burn their bodies outside the city.
3.Maybe this freak was a wizard or a Plague doctor, saving the good while cursing the bad. God bless us to survive the Plague. 

No. 105
Name: Butcher
Type: case
Status: pending
Time: Holloween, 192

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/130f3af2abd71c413a75e98fd9cfec2b8633acbb.jpg

Description:
Talking about this record, I would rather believe that this was just an illusion. 
All the children got back home earlier after trick or treat since our alliances were still confronting with the enemies outside the city. 

Patrol started from 9 o’clock in the evening nearby the city wall. At midnight, a soldier found something wrong in the distant battlefield. Dozens of corpses stood up slowly. Their face were covered by a crow mask full of blood. They just walked directly to enemy’s camp. 

Suddenly, wild and terrible scream broke the silence, echoing throughout the battlefield.
Ten minutes later, each one of them dragged an enemy’s body then disappearing into the thick fog. 

Notes: 
1.The enemy retreated the next day since main leaders were killed and their body were found in a mass grave 20 kilometers away. 
2.We reported to Alliance leaders. They claimed that those “corpses” were recruited from some secret execution units and told us to stop the investigation. But I never believed their stories.

No. 112
Name: Punkinhead
Type: tale
Status: investigation terminated
Time: Holloween, 193

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3b7169ab0f7b65370edf99d585cb811c8daeb961.jpg

Description:
This record was made for one bizarre incident witnessed by a little girl. 
On Halloween night, Jessica went out for trick or treat dressing up as a little devil. She met a pale young man at a gloomy house located far away from the main city. When Jessica said hello, that young man started to scream over and over again with that creepy smiles on his face. A lot of pumpkin seeds grew from his face then his head turned to a pumpkin with fire burning inside. 

Jessica got freaked out and run off after dropping all the candies. That monster waved and shouted loudly: I am Pumpkin Jack of Augolia. I am Pumpkin Jack of Augolia. 

When Jessica screamed into the main city, Pumpkin Jack just disappeared. We searched that area the next day but found nothing regarding any gloomy house and young man with pumpkin head. After checking relevant records, we found that there was a young man named Jack in Augolia, but he had died almost 120 years ago.

Notes:
The whole thing is full of irrationality and weirdness. So we thought it maybe just a bad dream of Jessica since she was too young to distinguish it from reality. We’ve decided to end our investigations into Pumpkin Jack and make it just a mysterious tale of Augolia.

notes.title: 17/10/2019 Patch Note
notes.content:
Dear Warlords:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 17th, Oct (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note:

1.Unit Balances: Prefecture Archers Adjustments
We have already shared our thoughts of adjusting the Prefecture Archers unit. Our adjustments are as follows:

a)The “A Hundred Paces” (Each level increases shooting range by 6%) will be replaced by “Mustering” (Each level add 1 more soldier to the unit). 
b)Adjusted the maximum shooting range to 87m.

Reasons:
This unit has strong explosive power to attack enemies when using arrow rain, which is in line with our design. But we realized that its maximum shooting range as 96m is higher than other same level units, making it easier to find better attacking position and produce high damage beyond the shooting range of enemy ranged units. The Prefecture Archers is supposed to be a unit of archers good at quick shooting rather than a Gatling or Katyusha rocket launcher. We also don’t want this situation that other same era units totally get suppressed by the Prefecture Archers.

A “Unit Training Plan” reward will be mailed to Warlords who already unlock the Prefecture Archers, allowing them to reset veterancy points.

2.Optimizations to the rights of Ruling House 
The commander system was designed to neutralize the influence by malicious and passive battles. But some players use this rule to declare war on themselves and maliciously kick everyone else out of the battlefield after randomly being assigned as commander. In order to deal with malicious kicking issues, we made the following adjustments: 

a)Warlords whose participation ranking in first two-thirds couldn’t be kicked out 
b)Warlords engaging in the battlefield less than 2 minutes couldn’t be kicked out.

3.Limited-time Seasonal XP Bonus
In order to make it easier for Warlords to upgrade with more glory, we offer 1.5 times Seasonal XP bonus for matched battles.
Available: 12:00-14:00; 18:00-20:00, October 21- October 23

4.  Purchase Limit Adjustments
We made the following adjustments to the purchase limit of "Letter of the First King":
Adjusted the purchase limit from "5 pieces per day" to "35 pieces per week".

5.Auction House Guidance Prices Adjustment
After checking the trading data, we found that the guidance price of some hero forging and schematics were lower than the market expected. So we raised the guidance prices for the following items:
Powdered Silver
Steel Shavings
Special Helmet Schematics
Special Chest Armour Schematics
Special Glove Schematics
Special Boots Schematics
You can check the adjusted guidance price in the auction house

6.Bug Fixes
1.Important Fixes
a)Fixed the abnormally intensive anti-cavalry formation of Pike Militia. This unit couldn’t use brace weapons during charging. 
b)Fixed the stretched model issue of Pike Militia, Javelin Militia, Ironcap Swordsmen and Ironcap Bowriders after their appearance being changed by unit training.
c)Fixed a bug when Archer units staying close to the city wall, they could shoot through it.


2.Unit Bug Fixes
a)Fixed the wrong description of Thick Armour and Razor-Sharp of Winged Hussars. The description of thick armour should be “Each level increases all defence by 2%”, razor-sharp should be “Each level increases slashing damage by 5%”.
b)Fixed a bug that the “Move as One” of Winged Hussars was inoperative.
c)Fixed a bug that the “Rudimentary Medicine” of Javelin Sergeants was inoperative.
d)Fixed a bug that the “Second Wind” of Rattan Swordsmen” couldn’t come into effect correctly. Now each level of this node can reduce CD by 10s.
e)Fixed a bug that the “Reinforced Bows” of Ironcap Archers couldn’t increase the shooting range.
f)Fixed a bug that the first two level of “Marching Drill” of Vanguard Archers were inoperative.
g)Fixed a bug that sometimes the Legendary Javelin DoctrineⅠcould invalidate the knock down and throw javelin skills.
h)Fixed a bug that the unit was unable to enter battle after their status reducing to 20 or 21.
i)Fixed a bug that the character still maintained their in-game posture after being killed.

3.Miscellaneous Bugs
a)Fixed a bug that Dual Blade heroes couldn’t use the “Alchemical Vapours” and “Infiltrator” in defending status. 
b)Fixed a bug that sometimes heroes could be sent to wrong location when they staying in some Western forts. 
c)Fixed the background music loss of “Surrounded in White Elk” PVE activity.
d)Fixed a bug that sometimes random epic artillery chest for Warlords whose nobility reaching level 90 had the incorrect items. 
e)Fixed the incorrect display when clicking the border posts of current region in open world map.
f)Fixed a bug when the personal storage is full, some item may disappear when being transferred.

7.Description and visual effect optimizations 
a)Optimized the reminder description when some Warlords leaving the territory war.
b)Optimized the description of “Strong Strikes” of Fire Lance Cavalry. Now the description should be: Level 1 can stun enemy units. Level 2 can stun enemy heroes.

notes.title: Chaos are coming, Let the battle begin!
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, do you know the origin of Season Eve?

Season Eve is the prelude for our new season system. Once the new season system launches, Warlords will usher in a brand new world of Conqueror's Blade : Frontier and experience new units and new levels. The Territory layout also will go through rounds of significant changes. 

Kingdom has fallen, Who will be the next King?
Such a long and lonely night, Such a chaotic World.
Fury heart covered by heavy armour, fight till the end to conquer. 

Since Conqueror's Blade : Frontier been officially launched on July 11, Warlords have created amazing legends: 
21 fierce territory wars;
197 Houses rallied their units to fight for glory and honor in the past two months;
16 Forts, 66 towns and 168 villages witnessed numerous battles;
932 wonderful and memorable battles;
8,842 Warlords trained superior units and improved their skills to get ready for battles;
1,565,760 soldiers injured or sacrificed for the glory of the Kingdom.

Achievements earned in the old Kingdom deserve to be rewarded. At the end of Season Eve, your achievements also will be recorded in our season history.

1. Seasonal titles contest and rewards
At Seasonal Settlement, your previous achievements will be remembered in the following ways:
1). Outstanding Houses and its extraordinary history will be listed on the career and ranking interface. These records will be engraved in the history of Conqueror's Blade : Frontier and respected by all Warlords. 
2). Warlords in superior Houses will get special seasonal titles, which will directly present preeminent seasonal achievements. 

In this settlement, there are two titles symbolize the glory of the territory war:
[Fief Seignior] represents the highest honor for House
To become a Fief Seignior, Houses need to meet all of the following rules:
Rule A: The House was the ultimate owner of the fief during Season settlements
Rule B: During the season, it has continuously occupied the fief for more than two weeks.
Rule C: The fief has reached certain level requirements during Season settlements

[Fief Patricians] is the ultimate owner of the fief at the end of season ( in line with Rule A only). 

Please noted: Now in our SEA battlefield , [Fief Seignior] and [Fief Patricians] title of one certain Fief is an exclusive rewards for one House. Maybe you have to fight for it in another way after we launch other server in SEA region.

When their House becoming Fief Seignior or Fief Patricians, House members who reaching the requirements for application time and contribution will get relevant titles and Fortune rewards. 
It means that in the next season, regardless of the fief ownership, the House still have certain benefits for crafting and resources collecting in that fief. 

Titles for House Members are as follows:

Titles for [Fief Seignior]:

At seasonal settlement, if one House get [Fief Seignior] or [Fief Patricians] of serval different fiefs, the House member will get more luxurious titles accordingly.

( Maybe as luxurious as this: Daenerys Stormborn of House Targaryen, rightful heir to the Iron Throne, rightful Queen of the Andals and the First Men, Protector of the Seven Kingdoms, the Mother of Dragons, the Khaleesi of the Great Grass Sea, the Unburnt, the Breaker of Chains.)

2. Rewards for Territory War Points
The Territory War Points are specially customized for Warlords fighting and conquering in the open world. 

Joining Territory Wars to attack or defend will get certain points (only for Warlords entering the battlefiedld, do not include Warlords in the status of queuing, preparing and supervising). Warlords can get extra points surviving until the battle wins.

At seasonal settlement, Warlords can get Bronze Coins, siege engines and even Treatises according to current points ranking. 

Warlords still get five weeks to fight for these abundant rewards and set a spectacular start for the first season.

Season Eve will be officially launched on September 30. Please stay tuned for more information tonight.

notes.title: Battle Pass, Sword & Lore
notes.content:
Dear Warlords,
Season Eve, a warm up activity for the season system of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier, will be officially launched to you guys on next Monday (September 30). The most important content of this update is Battle Pass. We already noticed that some Warlords had many speculations and doubts about it. Don’t worry, today we will give you a full description of this new content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c3b262dcb20d05fd3e2b93f109b0fcf8b256856f.jpg

You may wonder what is the Battle Pass ?
Actually, you can consider it as a “Legend list” for each season. After accumulating legends by joining battles and completing challenges, you can level up your Nobility in battle pass and get exclusive seasonal rewards.

The detail of Battle Pass are as follows:
1.Basic Information

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a5ad1b667f02bbbced756d82c4238b07ef332f16.png

There are two options of battle pass in Season Eve for Warlords to choose:
1)Free rewards:  Eternal Vigilance Unit Attire, “Fury Heart · Create Legends” Title, etc. 
Warlords can unlock Seasonal rewards for battle pass at any time, then will receive all previous rewards before current Nobility level. 

2)Seasonal rewards for battle pass:  Warlords can get this reward after unlocking Battle Pass with 980 sovereigns. 
Warlords unlocking seasonal rewards for Battle Pass can have: 
-More Nobility rewards, including Stygian Order Attire, Golden Sun Mount Attire, etc.
-More Conquest Tokens, can be used to exchange rich rewards
-Increased Seasonal XP for each battle during current season by 50%.
Tomorrow, we will tell the story behind our rewards for Season Eve, including Stygian Order， Righteous King and other mysterious attires. Stay tuned for more information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/edaa29c6f3e56f09a748a6c7ea340c56d9fbbb50.png

2.Seasonal Rewards
The way to upgrade the Nobility is also very simple, that is to accumulate glory. The glory can be obtained in two ways: 
1)Weekly Challenges: Season Eve will last for five weeks. Warlords can get a large number of glory by accomplishing current and previous weekly challenges. In the meantime, you can get extra chest rewards by accomplishing a specified number of weekly challenges. 

2)PVP battles: Warlords can get glory by joining PVP match-making battles. Warlords unlocking seasonal rewards for Battle Pass will get 50% extra glory in the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bc1f49596841ace7c235dcfc4ba017cea7f075e3.png

3.Seasonal Store
You can use the Conquest Token, one of the Nobility rewards, to exchange other rewards in Seasonal Store. 
We can share a small part of rewards for your reference:
-Legendary Hero/Mount/Unit attire for the “Sword & Lore” theme.
-Highly recognizable Weapon attire .
-Popular items such as Treatises and Rare Schematic.
You can experience other mysterious rewards all by yourself on September 30. 
Get ready to fight in a brand new season and create your own legends!

notes.content:
Dear Warlords:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 12th, Sep (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note： 

1. Important updates: Catch-up Mechanism
This Catch-up mechanism is designed to help the new Warlords to catch up the veteran Warlords. These potential Warlords will get more Bronze Coins, Unit XP, Honour and bonus of Honour cap. 
Warlords under level 60 can get a buff. Warlords with this buff will get extra 50% Bronze Coins, Unit XP, Honour and bonus of Honour cap during match-making mode.
Besides that, this buff also offer Warlords with 50% bonus to weekly honour cap. New Warlords will have 30,000 honor cap per week. This buff will last for a whole week even you reached level 60 before this week ends.  

2. Important updates: Epic Mission Activity---"Fight with The Prefecture Guards"
We will official launch our Epic Mission Activity tomorrow on SEA server. With the “The Prefecture Guards” as the main subject, we will bring you many wonderful activities for three weeks. Now let me introduce three activities in the first week:

Rewards for Mid-Autumn Festival
Get rewards from daily sign in after log in on Sep 13. Treatises and Bronze Coins and other rewards will be mailed to you in the next three days. 

Epic Mission Activity
Enemy commander is conducting a surprise attack! Join the Sword Militia and Ironcap Swordsmen to fight against the pirates!
Available: 18:00-24:00, Sep. 12-Sep. 19
Rewards: Exclusive achievements, Uncommon Schematics of your choice, New unit Attire

Collect Battle Information for Rewards
During Sep. 12 to Sep. 19, Warlords will have chance to get “Battle Information” after engaging in field battle, siege battle and activities. You can exchange for limited titles, treatises and forging materials in the activities interface. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0d3825f268b3254c95bdcb6033baa86ecf0ca0fc.png

3. Important updates: Added Retrieve System for Weekly Quest Rewards
We added the retrieve system for weekly quest rewards in order to decrease your burden and let you have more time to experience our game. But we found that there are some problems in this system, now we have to take it back and make adjustments to ensure your game experience. 
The official establishment of this retrieve system for weekly quest rewards will be postponed to Sep 16. You can check the weekly quests retrieve from the rewards in our activity interface.

notes.title: A letter from Developer Team of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier to all Warlords:
notes.content:
Dear Warlords:
It's has been two months since we conducted Early Access on steam for Conqueror's Blade: Frontier (SEA server). In the past two months, all the Warlords, as a community, gathered together in the world of Conqueror’s Blade and experienced excited battles in Maoyang, Liangyun, Ostaria, Ungverija and Borderlands.
We also noticed that some Warlords discussed about the content and future development of our game in the community. Our designers also had in-depth discussion about every comments. This time we will share our ideas and plans for some core problems that you may concerned.  

Q1: The background story of SEA server?
A1: Everyone knows that we have publisher in EU/NA and CN region. However, the SEA server on Steam is fully operated by our own developer team. To be frankly, this is a brave decision. It’s took a long time for us to consider a proper name for our game. At last, we decided to call it Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier. We hope to establish a fast and effective channel on SEA server to get feedbacks and communicate with all Warlords. 
So we selected several colleagues who have full passion towards operation and community management to be part of our first operation team. At the beginning of establishment, we have been devoted to solving bugs and technical problems. After several comprehensive discussions between our operation and developer team, we are starting to move forward as our game became more and more stable. 
We should admit that there was some deficiencies in our operation work: 
 
-Sometimes we might be a little inexperienced facing some unexpected problems;
-Sometimes we couldn't answer your feedbacks in-time due to the shortage of manpower;
-Some bugs couldn't be quickly handled due to the complex game system;
-We didn't have enough communication with community in advance and always let you know the updated content in the patch note;
-We could have conduct more transparent discussions about numerous design ideas;
-Insufficient operation experience have caused many difficulties while we improving the game environment.

We will make improvements accordingly. Although there are numerous difficulties, we will try our best to keep improving SEA server.

Q2：What is the main characteristic of SEA server?
A2: First of all, we hope to build the SEA server into a platform where player with different culture backgrounds can compete with each other. We believe it will generate a quite different ecology. The original design thoughts of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier is to create a dream battlefield with communication between different civilizations. So the SEA server is the best place for this battle spirit to grow.

Q3: Are we going to take seriously the promotion of the SEA server?
A3: Absolutely YES. In order to live up to your trust, we want to share our plan.
Currently, we have stop our propaganda strategically. That is because the relatively low evaluation in steam makes it hard for us to bring in new players and we also can't guarantee an excellent game experience for them. We will: 

1.Conduct update and server maintenance more actively and have closer communication with Warlords in the community. Make preparation for developing new players after the evaluation in steam get back to relatively reasonable range. 
2.Make Optimization for new players with better catch-up mechanism. 
3.Utilize more resources to conduct large-scale promotion in more regions. During the first round of promotion, we found that the language is the biggest problems, so we stop our promotion in some regions. In order to cover all SEA region, we have already started our Localization work in Japan and South Korea. We spent a lot of money and resources to co-operate with the best localization team to get more superior version. We also have been prepared for the localization of other languages. 

We consider the SEA server as our most long-standing and promising platform. So we hope you can join us to build a better game ecology for it.

Q4：What is our follow-up plan?
A4: I guess this part is what you cares the most. We also hope to share our update plan with you. 

Get rid of operation for three regions with different update progress
1.In the past three month, we have launched our old version in EU/NA region and Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier in SEA and CN region. Last week, we also successfully pushed forward the version updates in EU/NA region. Finally, we have launched the unified version in all regions. Before that, the update progress in three regions differed from each other, which seriously affected our development and release progress. This unification will make significant improvement. 

2.The Roadmap with new contents for September is on the way. From now on, at the end of each month, we will share our new Roadmap for the next month in the community.  

New Contents that we can share for now 
1.Optimizations for new players---catch-up mechanism.

2.Season System. 
As the most important system, it’s the foundation to enrich the whole game. We have already mentioned the season system in our developer's log. Our new season mechanism, differed from other common season system, will provide with best game experience with unique themes for all players, no matter you are newbie or veteran.

3.New Unit. 
First we want to apologize for the different release period of some contents due to the requirement of our contract. The Monastic Unit and The Skirmishers Unit will be available in SEA server ASAP. Hope you will understand. 

4.Attire System Upgrade
We will release new attire step by step. Varangian attire and Dragon shadow, Flying Fish attire will be available in SEA server soon.

5.Epic Mission activity system
This system has been prepared for a long time. This week, we will launch this activity both in SEA and CN region. The first story we choose is the Prefecture Guards fought against pirates in Ming Dynasty. This activity is just a beginning of this system. 

6.New Community Channel
We will start to operate in different new community channels. Steam community is a great place for you to give feedbacks and have discussions, but obviously not enough for Warlords from all over the world. In order to have in-time response and more effective communication, this month we will start to expand more channels (both in English and Chinese) after negotiating with partners from different regions.  

All in all, what we care the most is your love for Conqueror's Blade: Frontier and great faith in our team. We have been striving to produce good games. Please look forward to our Roadmap and new dev blog. We will try our best to bring a better Conqueror's Blade: Frontier to all Warlords. 

Operation team of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier
September 10, 2019

notes.title: 31/08/2019 Patchnote
notes.content:
Dear warlords, glad to meet again:
First of all, we were "faced". In the last developer log, we promised to follow a weekly maintenance plan to ensure that the version is updated in an orderly manner, and help warlords to plan their game time. However, after only two days, we have to conduct server maintenance to solve serious problems.

Now our review begins:
The first problem is: after the last update, the Dual Blade was too IMBA: after using the "new version" of Combat Dismount, it has been enhanced a lot. However, we found that we neglected an important setting that all attack/skills could not break the stealth, so DB could kill other players quickly and safely. If this problem was not fixed in time, the battlefield balance will be destroyed, so we judged that this bug must be fixed immediately.

The second question is: We had to reduce the loot rate of silver coins and equipment in Practice Mode. The main reason is that during data analysis in this two days we found a problem. Because we have reduced the difficulty of Practice Mode, it caused that some players could compress the game duration to about 4 minutes (or even shorter) in an abnormal way. This is twice as fast as the design time (7-8 minutes). We have found that some people and studios used this vulnerability to earn large amounts of silver coins and resell materials and to take advantage of offline transactions. This affected the value of money, equipments and materials in the normal trading market. If not adjusted in time, it may directly harm the game ecology and economic system.

Although it is very stressful to announce the adjustment data, we finally decided to report the details of our adjustment truthfully: in the Practice Mode, the loot rate of the silver coin bag was reduced to 1/4, and 1/3 for equipment. The reason is that in the product design structure, Practice Mode is not the main production of equipment and silver coins. The previous addition of loot is to add some surprises, but because of the mistakes in numerical calculations, it has become a vulnerability of economy system.

So, we will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 31, Aug (UTC+8).

Our goal is to do our best to maintain the balance on the battlefield and to protect the gaming experience. If a similar situation arises in the future, we will still solve it as quickly as possible.

notes.title: [Developer Blog 29.08.2019] Discussion of Units experience
notes.content:
Hi Warlords：
In the August 29 update, we left a bit of a mystery and a few more voices in the developer log. Not yet a day has passed, we already could not wait to invite Warlords to discuss about the Units experience.

In this morning's maintenance update, we fixed one of the most important bugs we found: Lvmax Units will still share the experience. After that we realized a problem: we haven't explained the settlement rules of the Units experience in detail. This developer log is an opportunity to share to all Warlords.

Cultivation of Units
First of all, we want the Units to be a growing band of brothers. They need to grow in real battle, rather than gain experience on bench like an exp baby. Our current approach is that the Units will gain more experience if they really joined battle. The specific settlement rules are as follows:

In the settlement, each Units will gain two parts of experience according to the military exploits in the battle: more experience in the battle, and less experience in the guarantee. Experience in the battle will be generated by real-played Units except some special ones (gold Units and lvmax Units) will not produce experience. The minimum guarantee experience will be generated regardless of whether the Units joined battle or not to ensure a stable income lower limit.

The direction of subsequent changes	
1. UI optimize
We found that based on the current experience settlement UI, Warlords can easily interpret the settlement rules as "I got these Units experience and then allocate it to my Units according to certain rules". This is actually a mistake we made in UX design and will be fixed as soon as possible in coming update.

2. Link Units experience to military exploits
Based on the current settlement rules, we foresee that it will inevitably lead to abnormal behaviors such as "change Units at the supply point to the one who wants to practice, and then change again", which we do not want to see. We hope to use a more objective and reasonable way to generate the experience that the Units should gain. Therefore, we will start to optimize the settlement rules with military exploits.

All above is what we want to say. The following time belongs to all warlords. Please let us know your thoughts on the settlement rules of the Units experience below, this will help us a lot.

notes.title: 28/08/2019 Path notes
notes.content:
Warlords, well met:

We know that a lot of you are looking forward to this update. Not only to get rid of a few bugs, but you are also expecting more and more new content. You Warlords may have heard that the CN version of CB is live now, and there are some doubts from it. Please relax your mind, this will not affect the normal pace of Frontier which is directly operated by our studio. Although we have very few people, the service is sometimes not enough, but our attention and love for SEA server will not be discounted, and we will make every effort to cultivate this small land of our own.
Recently, we also received a lot of feedback, hoping to see more new content in the game: like brand new units, new game-play modes, levels and etc. In fact, because we need to take care of CN, European and American server as well as SEA server, which is operated entirely by ourselves, we need some time to coordinate with the designer team to develop a reasonable and informative update plan, which is our most important task at this stage.
Finally, for the issue of the maintenance that you Warlords are concerned about, we are considering putting it at a fixed time each week, which also helps everyone arrange their own time better.
Last but not the least, please allow me introduce the patch notes of this update below:

First, added Unit souls to Secret Vaults.
After the opening of the search function, there are still many Warlords who have not obtained enough unit souls to assemble the units. We hope that the Warlords can use the unit soul to cultivate their own units. So, we decided to add normal, common, uncommon unit souls to the Secret Vaults. 

Second, important fixes:
- Received feedback from some Warlords that after the unit reaches the max level, it will still share the experience from battle settlement, which not only wastes the experience, but also affects the will of the Warlords to us the max level units. In this update, we have already fixed this problem to ensure that the experience of the units will only be distributed to the units that have not reached the max level;
- After character died in battle, there was a bug that you could not switch the third-person perspective of the teammates by clicking the mouse, observing the battlefield situation at that time, but only staying at the death interface. We have already fixed this problem in this update;
- When some Warlords are fight with Rebels in the open world, there is a certain probability that the enemy soldiers will continue to spawn even after they kill the enemy BOSS, which not only consumes the game time, but also causes unnecessary loss of the units. We have fixed this issue to ensure that the Warlords can end the battle normally.

Third, hero balance:
1. Longsword&shield
- The attack by the Sword Shield in the defense is now unable to cause stagger effect on heroes, and the stagger effect on the unit is reduced.

2. Dual blades
- Added a stealth effect to the Dual blades when uses dismount ability for 3 seconds.

3. Poleaxe
- Added a small amount of blunt area damage when Poleaxe uses dismount ability.

Fourth, Unit balance:
We have observed that some Warlords are switching Barricade of pike units very frequently, resulting in the effect of Barricade exceeding our expectations, so we added a short cd while switching.
- The unit skill: Barricade now has a short CD of 3s.

Fifth, Siege tower
In order to prevent the Range classes from easily stopping the siege tower by killing the unit who are pushing the tower(even kill one unit will stop the tower for a while), we have modified the minimum number of pushing from 8 to 7.

Sixth, Unit souls
For the unit soul which can give the new skill to unit, it no longer can be assembled on the unit that already has the skill.

Seven, Guidance price for uncommon weapon blueprints
We received feedback from players that the price for uncommon weapon blueprints is too low compared to crafted equipment. In this update, we have lifted the guidance price for uncommon weapon blueprints.

Eight, system optimization
- Optimized the resolution of hero interface and attire interface;
- Optimized the effects of the frontline camps during construction and offense;
- Optimized the frequency of unit shouts in some PVE levels;

notes.title: 21/08/2019 Patch notes
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, we will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 21st, Aug (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Once the server resumes service, you should receive compensation through the Mail System that consists of the following: 5000 Silver and 200 Honor.

1.	Important update: Bronze income
Many Warlords were complaining about the bronze income differences between NA/EU version and Frontier version. Firstly, we would like to clarify that we introduced a new battle point system for settlement in Frontier version.
Compared with the old settlement system, the new system is more intuitive and more comprehensive to evaluate the diverse contribution behaviors in the battlefield, such as damage, deploying siege machine, flag capturing time, type of eliminated units and etc. Also, for a single combat strategy, it has a certain upper limit. In the end, the system will add all points up to present players’ performance.
Because this is a brand-new mechanism and the bronze is a core currency in game, we are very cautious in the adjustment of the value. In addition, many Warlords also reported that some players are playing very passively but still get a decent reward compared to active players.
Based on these two points, we plan to optimize the mechanism of bronze income from battles to encourage positive combat behavior. Here are the changes.
-	It is expected that after the update on Wednesday (August 20th) to this Sunday (August 25th), a test-based “Bronze Vanguard” will be launched online.
-	During the event, bronze income of battle points and victory will be increased about 10 to 30 percentages than usual.

We would like listen to more voices about this change and if you are satisfied with this change in income and this change won’t affect the normal operation of the in-game economic system, we will retain this modification. 

2.	Important update: Matching-making mechanism update
The current matching system in the game is a level-based matching system, which is a relatively simple processing method. We believe that the ladder system that will enable the Warlords to show their skills in the future is very necessary. However, the design of ladder is very difficult, so we intend to introduce its foundation – battle ranking, to measure and express the combat capabilities of the Warlords in a more dynamic and performance-driven manner.
Therefore, over the past month or so, we are developing a new generation of dynamic “battle ranking” system, which should first be used in the matching system, which is not limited to the levels and based on the real battlefield performance. This system has just been released, and it will take a long time to adjust and stabilize with the help from all the Warlords.
Thus, we are planning to open the new match-making system as an activitiy for all the Warlords to try it out. The specific schedule is as follows:
-	August 20-August 22, 14:00-18:00; available both in field and siege mode
To be noted, at the beginning of the test, the Warlords may find that the level difference in the battlefield will be larger than normal. That’s because the system is new online, and the evaluation of the battle ranking of each player requires a period of data accumulation to be more accurate. The data gradually accumulates, and the skills and power between players in the same battlefield will become closer eventually. 

3.	Bots mode fixes
Our definition of a Bots mode is a low-pressure mode in which the Warlords can participate at any time when they need leisure, but not as the main income resources.
Before the update on last Thursday, we found that when the Warlords reached a certain level when he could only bring T2\T3 units, but the BOT had already brought the T3 or even the T4 units, which did not match the pace of the game, resulting in bad game experiences. Therefore, we adjusted the Bots’ units on last Thursday to make it more reasonable. notes.title: [Developer Blog 18.08.2019] Honor weekly cap
notes.content:
Dear Warlords, firstly, please allow me to introduce myself, I am a numerical designer from Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier development department. Here, for today, I would like to discuss with you about the Honor weekly cap we implemented in last patch and share our thoughts and incoming optimizations towards this mechanism. 

First of all, the purpose of Honor weekly cap mechanism is to narrow the gaps between different kind of players to create a better game experience. Our development team read all the feedback on this new design carefully and we will keep doing that in the future as well, meanwhile, we are planning to do some optimizations based on them.

Many of you believe that the design of the Honor weekly cap is not that reasonable of calculating not only battle settlement Honor rewards but also some systems beyond that like quests. After careful consideration, we are agreed that honor rewards from non-combat which does not require a lot of game time should be considered as equal for all players. At the same time, we observed that, involving non-combat honor rewards in the cap may hurt players’ enthusiastic of joining in these game plays and this is supported by our data analysis results as well. 

Therefore, based on your feedback, we are thinking of optimizing the design of Honor gain weekly cap in this way:

1. Only the Honor rewarded from battle settlement will be calculated in Honor weekly cap. Other approaches like daily quests, weekly quests, fief quests, secret vaults, and Honor reward items will not be included.
2. When you reach the Honor weekly cap, your Honor rewards from battle settlement will be converted into Bronze according to a certain ratio.

In addition, many of you have reported that the honor weekly cap is not friendly and fair enough for new comers, which would bring bad game experience when they try to catch up faster. Generally, we are agreed on this point and we are thinking of a new catch-up mechanism to solve this problem. Please give us some more time to think it through and do a full implementation. 

Last but not the least, I would like to say something, on behalf of development team, our responsibility and goal is to build a good experience for all of our gamers. We should admit that we still have a long way to go, especially on the design aspect. To take care of the interests of all kinds of players, sometimes, the outcome of a certain design may out of our expectations. The ideas and feedback from all of you are very important to us. We will keep up our work in community and pass our thoughts directly, only with you standing by us, we could build the world of Conqueror’s blade: Frontier better. Thank you and wish you the best!

Once the server resumes service, you should receive compensation through the Mail System that consists of the following: 5000 Silver and 200 Honour.

Here are the patch notes: 

1.Unit supply

When we start our concept of the game, we always wish to present a real warfare experience in the game. Based on that, we developed the unit kit and supply system. We actually do wish all the Warlords could wisely use their high tier units rather than take them in battlefield without any concerns, as in real war, the commanders are supposed to have the same tactics. However, we do realize the balance between cost and gain is a bit out of our exceptions and it’s becoming a huge burden for all the Warlords. This is actually not exactly what we wish to see. After careful consideration, we did some prices changes of unit kit in this patch.
Besides that, we also optimized the ironman mode by removing unit kit loss, unit death and leadership restrict in this mode. We may open this mode more often to see how the balance goes in this mode and we wish to receive more feedback from all the Warlords.

How to use：

- Inside the battlefield: open the tab menu, find the target player, right click on the report button, select the reason for reporting and submit.

3. Reforging system

In the former version, the loss of equipment durability is always a problem that brothers a lot of players, now we introduce the reforging system to solve it.

Rules for reforging:
- Only crafted equipment is allowed to be reforged
- Reforge needs the same amount of materials and blueprints
- Reforge will reset the upper limit of durability of the equipment 
- Reforge will give the equipment new random stats but you can always choose to keep the former one if you wish

4. battle supervising system

A battle supervising system was added in the territory war to inspire the real work of house leaders, vice leaders and commanders. 
Main features：
- The house leaders, vice leaders commanders can watch and instruct the battle through this system by pressing open world map, Hotkey “M”
- The supervisor has the authority to retreat his allies from the battle anytime
- In the battlefield the supervisor can inspire the allies or provoke the enemies by sending system default short messages.
- When supervising the battle, the supervisor could communicate with team via the in-game voice chat system.
- During the battle, for both sides, at most 3 supervisors are allowed to supervise the battle at the same time.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/fc716bc386fdd9a1278a719b71c7609b3657c6b9.png

- Judgement of the ownership:
The ownership of the city is decided on the contribution during the battle. Houses with the highest contribution own the city. When multiple fronts exist, contributions of each battle line will be added and then ranked.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/73fd8460ab3e4e004c2f43c47e0ffd3213d78e70.png 

9. Honor gain adjustment

In the last patches, we decreased honor gain after 20 games to narrow the gap between active players and casual players but it turns out not to be a good decision and actually discourages player’s behaviors like playing bots mode in the first 20 games. After carefully reconsideration, we decided to revert that change and replace it as honor cap per week. From this patch, players will not suffer any honor gain decrease after 20 games per day but capped with 20,000 honor gain per week. Our data shows, 90% players honor gain per week is lower than 20,000 honor and we think this change actually won’t affect most of our player base but at least could help us to narrow the gap between the top active players and causal players.  
At the same time, we are planning to add a new mechanism which allows new comers to chase the old players. We will give more details when this system is ready.

In current battle points system, a lot of behaviors that are considered actively playing the game will add battle points to give more rewards at the settlement. From the most basic behaviors like killing units/heroes to capturing a point or taking damages. These behaviors have different weights in the final calculations and they do have a cap for each. We should admit this system is still far from perfect and we do listen carefully to the community. We have noticed the weight of taking damage is not rewarded correctly as in today’s patch, we have increased the weight of taking damage with unit/heroes and decreased the weight of dealing damages.

12. Resources collecting system：

You can continue to collect resources from the place where the resource points already exhausted using the extraction token but the production will be halved.

13.Friend system optimization：
